paper.title: LLMs Know the Constraint But Do Not Use It: Activation Bottlenecks in Pragmatic Constraint Reasoning
paper.abstract: When a salient surface cue competes with an implicit feasibility constraint, LLMs often fail -- but aggregate accuracy conflates genuine constraint inference with conservative defaulting. We formalize the distinction as conditional constraint activation: the constraint is internally encoded (Knowledge) symmetrically across constraint-present and -absent prompts (Symmetry), yet only sometimes routed into the decision (Routing) and repairable by a donor activation (Repair). A quartet diagnostic ov

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：LLM 在隐含约束推理中失败时，到底是不知道约束，还是知道但没有把约束用于最终决策。作者把问题收窄到“条件性约束激活”：模型内部是否编码了约束、这种编码是否在有约束和无约束样本中对称存在、编码强度是否影响答案 logits、以及能否通过 donor activation 修复失败样本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制诊断，而不是直接给出训练 recipe。结果显示，隐含约束失败不能只用“缺少推理步数”或“没有被提醒”解释。至少一类模型已经在线性可读的 hidden state 中表示了约束，但该方向没有稳定进入决策路径。这对数据构造和训练目标有实际含义：如果训练只奖励最终答案或显式 CoT，很可能强化保守触发，而不是学到条件化路由。更合适的信号可能需要成对的 active/removed 对照、反事实约束样本、以及针对 routing 的监督或偏好信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是四元诊断。每个场景构造 Active、Removed、Explicit、Salience Control 四种版本，用来区分真正使用约束和只受表面提示影响。作者定义了四个条件：Knowledge 用线性 probe 检查 hidden state 是否可解码“约束适用”；Symmetry 检查 active 与 removed prompt 上这种可解码性是否相近；Routing 检查 probe 方向上的投影强度是否预测 gold answer 与 shortcut answer 的 logit gap；Repair 通过从显式约束 prompt patch activation 到失败 prompt，测试是否能修复 active 样本且不破坏 removed 样本。这个设计比普通 accuracy 更细，因为它把“知道”“默认保守”“真正路由到答案”拆开测量。作者还加入 salience-controlled hint ladder，避免把显式提示带来的收益误判为约束语义收益。
summary.experiments: 实验从 HOB benchmark 中抽取 core100，覆盖 4 类启发式 × 5 类约束，共约 100 个基础场景。评测 14 个模型，包括 Claude、GPT、Gemini、Grok、DeepSeek-R1、Kimi、Llama、Qwen 和 GPT-OSS 系列。行为层面用 CBI 区分两类失败：over-activation 模型在 removed 条件下也倾向给出约束型答案，CBI 约为 +0.13 到 +0.29；under-activation 模型在 active 条件下没有充分使用约束，CBI 约为 -0.10 到 -0.19。机制层面在两个开权重模型上做 probe 和 patching。Qwen3-14B 上，从 Explicit prompt patch 约束信息到失败 Active prompt，可使 gold-shortcut logit gap 改善 +6.4 nats，并且没有把 removed 对照翻错。GPT-OSS-20B 在第 20 层 probe 可达到约 88% 的约束解码准确率，但 activation patching 对答案几乎没有修复，logit gap 变化约 -0.07 nats。这支持“约束可表示但未路由”的 under-activation 解释。提示干预部分评估 CoT、precondition listing、goal decomposition、counterfactual checking。40 个 model × strategy 组合都没有进入理想 repair 区域：active gain 平均只有 +0.01 到 +0.04 CBI，removed harm 平均约 +0.44 到 +0.47 CBI。推理预算增加也复现了类似的 harm-without-repair 模式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25 到 35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 K/S/R/P 的定义，这是全文最有价值的抽象。然后看 Methods 里的 quartet construction 和 CBI 定义，重点理解为什么 Active/Removed/Explicit/Salience Control 缺一不可。机制部分建议重点看 probe layer、activation patching 位置、gold-shortcut logit gap 的定义，以及 Qwen3-14B 与 GPT-OSS-20B 的对比。提示干预 frontier 只需抓住二维坐标：active-item gain 与 removed-pair harm。真正值得深挖的是 active/removed 成对数据能否作为 post-train 或 continual pretrain 的训练信号，用来减少保守触发而提升条件化路由。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether failures on implicit-constraint reasoning come from missing knowledge or from a failure to route available constraint information into the decision. It formalizes this as conditional constraint activation: the constraint may be linearly encoded in hidden states, may appear symmetrically in active and removed prompts, but may still fail to influence the final gold-versus-shortcut choice.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. The results argue against a simple “the model forgot the constraint” story and also against treating longer reasoning traces as a reliable fix. For at least one failure mode, the model contains a decodable constraint representation, yet that representation is not used by the answer circuit. This points toward training signals that contrast active and removed cases, penalize over-triggering, and supervise conditional routing rather than merely rewarding explicit prerequisite mentions or longer chains of thought.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built around a quartet diagnostic. Each scenario is converted into Active, Removed, Explicit, and Salience Control variants. This separates genuine constraint use from conservative defaulting and from generic salience effects. The formal test has four parts: Knowledge, measured by a linear probe for whether the constraint applies; Symmetry, checking whether probe accuracy is comparable across active and removed prompts; Routing, checking whether the probe-projected magnitude predicts the gold-shortcut logit gap; and Repair, testing whether activation patching from an explicit-constraint donor can fix active failures without flipping removed controls. The paper also uses a salience-controlled hint ladder to distinguish semantic constraint cues from length- or attention-driven hint effects.
summary_en.experiments: The behavioral evaluation uses a core100 subset from HOB, stratified over a 4-by-5 taxonomy of heuristics and constraints. Fourteen models are evaluated, spanning Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek-R1, Kimi, Llama, Qwen, and GPT-OSS families. The quartet metric separates over-activation and under-activation. Several models give constraint-heavy answers even when the constraint is removed, with CBI around +0.13 to +0.29. GPT-OSS-20B and GPT-OSS-120B show under-activation, with CBI around -0.10 to -0.19. Mechanistic tests on open-weight models show a split: in Qwen3-14B, patching constraint information from an Explicit prompt into a failing Active prompt shifts the gold-shortcut gap by +6.4 nats without causing the removed controls to flip; in GPT-OSS-20B, a layer-20 probe decodes the constraint at about 88% accuracy, but patching changes the answer by only about -0.07 nats. Prompted mitigations, including chain-of-thought, precondition listing, goal decomposition, and counterfactual checking, mostly increase removed-pair harm. Across 40 model-strategy cells, mean active gain is only +0.01 to +0.04 CBI, while mean removed harm is about +0.44 to +0.47 CBI.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the K/S/R/P definition in the introduction. Then read the quartet construction and the CBI metric in the methods section, since they are what make the behavioral claims interpretable. For the mechanistic part, focus on the probe setup, the activation patching target, and the gold-shortcut logit-gap measurement. The most informative comparison is Qwen3-14B versus GPT-OSS-20B, because it separates prior-biased over-activation from a routing failure. The mitigation frontier is worth reading for its active-gain versus removed-harm framing, which is directly useful for designing paired training data or verifier signals.

recommendation.zh: 只看诊断定义和 patching 结果；它把“知道但不用”拆得较干净，可作为推理失败分析模板。
recommendation.en: Read the diagnostic setup and patching results; the knowledge-versus-routing split is clean enough to reuse in reasoning-failure analysis.

paper.title: Steering the Language Axis: From Linear Decodability to Causal Control
paper.abstract: Despite the impressive multilingual capabilities of Large Language Models, the latent dynamics dictating language selection remain poorly understood. In this work, we ask whether language identity is merely linearly decodable from hidden states, or if it can be causally controlled by a compact activation direction. We conduct an exhaustive causal intervention analysis across multiple model families, including Qwen 3.5-2B and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, isolating PCA-derived "language axes" to perform

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“语言能否从隐藏状态里线性读出”，而是更强的问题：多语模型在生成时选择哪种语言，是否由一个可干预、低维、层相关的内部方向控制。作者把问题从相关性 probing 推到因果干预：如果某个“语言轴”真在生成中起作用，那么沿这个方向做加法或消融，输出语言应当系统性改变，而不是只让模型退化或随机扰动。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练方法，而在于把“多语能力如何在表征中组织”这件事讲得更具体。它给出一个较清楚的 mechanistic 结论：语言身份不是弥散在全网、不可操作的统计痕迹，而是至少部分落在残差流中的紧凑方向上，并且这种方向具有明显的语言对依赖和层依赖。对多语预训练、语言控制、跨语对齐和 activation engineering 都有启发。量级上，它更像一篇扎实的机制分析与推理时控制论文，而不是会立刻改写 pretrain recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很直接，但设计比较严谨。作者在冻结模型权重的前提下，只在推理时改 hidden states。模型包括 Qwen 3.5-2B（24 层，d=2048）和 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct（16 层，d=2048）。

语言轴的构造分三步。第一步，用 2 万个 held-out 双语句对作为校准集，从每一层抽取 hidden states，并做 layerwise mean-centering。第二步，在每层对激活做 PCA，保留前 150 个主成分。第三步，不是直接取第一主成分，而是计算每个主成分上两种语言分布的 Cohen’s d，选取语言分离效应最大的那个分量，并统一方向，使正方向对应目标语言。这样得到每层一个 unit vector 作为 language axis。这个选择比“均值差向量”或“probe 权重”更稳，因为它先限制在主要方差子空间里，再显式优化语言分离度，减少噪声维度和过拟合校准集的问题。

干预分两类：steering 和 ablation。steering 是在前向过程中对某层残差流加上沿语言轴的偏移，测试能否把输出推向目标语言；ablation 则是去掉 hidden state 在该轴上的投影，测试该方向是否对原本的语言生成有必要性。作者还做了大量对照，包括等幅随机方向扰动、不同层位点、跨脚本与同脚本语言对比较，用来排除“任何大扰动都能改输出”这种解释。

论文里一个重要观察是，语言轴不是通用的“语言性”方向，而是 pair-specific 的。英中轴和英西轴并不能简单互换，说明模型内部更像是若干语言对相关的局部几何，而不是单一全局语言坐标。另一个关键点是层间行为不均匀：中层往往对 steering 有阻力，晚层更敏感，提示语言选择不是在最末端才决定，但最终表面形式的锁定更依赖后层表示。
summary.experiments:
实验规模对这类 activation intervention 工作算比较大。主实验在 FLORES-200 上做，英中使用 500 个句对，英西使用 100 个句对；总计进行了 126 万次生成。语言轴校准来自 MultiUN 的 2 万个 held-out 句对。

关键结果有几类。第一，沿 PCA+Cohen’s d 选出的语言轴做 steering，能够稳定触发语言切换，既适用于跨脚本的 English→Chinese，也适用于同脚本的 English→Spanish；而等幅随机扰动通常不能复现这种效果，说明不是一般性的表示破坏。第二，ablation 会削弱或破坏目标语言生成，支持该方向不仅可控，而且被模型实际使用。第三，层扫描显示存在明显的 layerwise window：部分中层即使加较强 steering 也不容易改写输出语言，而后层更容易把语言表面形式推向目标侧。第四，作者区分了“有效 steering”和“生成崩坏”的边界，说明干预强度过大时会损伤流畅性与一致性，因此真正可用的是一段有限的、coherent 的干预区间。

从给出的全文内容看，论文更强调现象稳定性和控制实验，而不是追求单一 benchmark 数字。摘要里没有列出完整的切换率、困惑度或质量分数表，因此这里能确认的硬数字主要是模型规模、层数、校准数据量、评测样本量和总生成次数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Method，抓住它与线性 probe 工作的区别：重点不是“能读出来”，而是“改了以后会不会变”。然后看 layerwise intervention 的主结果图，通常是最有信息量的部分，能直接看到哪些层可控、哪些层有阻力。再看随机方向对照和 ablation 结果，这两部分决定结论是否站得住。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议按这个顺序：1）方法里 language axis 的构造；2）主 steering 结果；3）随机扰动对照；4）不同语言对和不同层的比较。值得深挖的点有两个：一是为什么 pair-specific 轴比共享语言轴更有效，这关系到多语表征几何；二是中层阻力与后层敏感性是否对应语义到表层形式的分工。如果你关心 pretrain 方向，可以进一步想：这种几何是否受 tokenizer、语料配比、指令微调或多语对齐目标影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stronger question than linear decodability: when a multilingual LM chooses its output language, is that choice controlled by a compact, causally active direction in hidden space? The goal is to move from correlation to intervention. If a “language axis” is truly used by the model during generation, then adding or removing that component in the residual stream should systematically change the output language, rather than merely degrading the model.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly mechanistic, not recipe-changing. The main contribution is a clearer picture of how multilingual structure is organized internally: language identity appears to be at least partly encoded in compact residual-stream directions that are layer-specific and language-pair-specific. That matters for multilingual pretraining, controllable generation, activation engineering, and for thinking about whether multilingual models build language-neutral semantic hubs or retain pairwise geometric structure. This is a solid interpretability-and-control paper, not a new pretraining algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple but careful. The authors freeze model weights and intervene only at inference time. They study Qwen 3.5-2B (24 layers, d=2048) and Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct (16 layers, d=2048).

The language axis is built layer by layer. First, they collect hidden states from 20k held-out bilingual sentence pairs and subtract the layerwise mean. Second, they run PCA on the centered activations and keep the top 150 components. Third, instead of taking PC1, they score each principal component by Cohen’s d between the two language distributions and select the component with the largest absolute separation, orienting it so the positive direction corresponds to the target language. This gives one unit vector per layer. Compared with a raw mean-difference vector or a probe weight, this procedure constrains the search to high-variance subspaces and then explicitly selects the component that best separates the language pair.

They then perform two intervention types. Steering adds a scaled offset along the language axis during the forward pass. Ablation removes the projection onto that axis. Steering tests sufficiency: can the model be pushed into another language? Ablation tests necessity: does removing the axis impair the original language behavior? The paper also includes strong controls, especially equal-magnitude random perturbations, to rule out the trivial explanation that any large perturbation can flip the output.

Two technical findings stand out. First, the geometry is pair-specific rather than a single universal “language direction”: English-Chinese and English-Spanish require distinct axes. Second, the effect is strongly layer-dependent. Mid layers often resist steering, while later layers are more sensitive, suggesting that language realization is not decided only at the final logits, but surface-form commitment becomes much easier to alter in later representations.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental sweep is fairly large for an activation intervention paper. The main evaluation uses FLORES-200, with 500 English-Chinese pairs and 100 English-Spanish pairs. Axis calibration uses 20k held-out sentence pairs from MultiUN. In total, the study reports 1.26 million generations.

The main results are qualitative but consistent. Steering along the PCA+Cohen’s d language axis reliably induces language switching in both cross-script and same-script settings, while random perturbations of the same magnitude generally do not. That supports specificity rather than generic disruption. Ablation weakens or disrupts language-consistent generation, which supports the claim that the axis is not only decodable but causally used. Layer sweeps reveal a non-uniform control profile: some mid layers are relatively resistant even under stronger steering, whereas later layers are much easier to redirect. The paper also characterizes a boundary between coherent steering and generation collapse, showing that useful control exists only within a finite intervention range.

From the full text provided here, the paper emphasizes robustness of the phenomenon and the control design more than a single headline metric. The available hard numbers are model sizes, layer counts, calibration size, evaluation size, and total generations; the excerpt does not include a full table of exact switch rates or quality scores.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the distinction from probing papers: the key question is not whether language is linearly recoverable, but whether changing that direction changes behavior. Then read the method section on how the language axis is constructed. After that, go straight to the layerwise steering results, which are likely the most informative figures. Finally, check the random-direction controls and the ablation results, because those are what make the causal claim credible.

A 20–30 minute skim should cover: 1) axis construction, 2) main steering results, 3) random perturbation controls, and 4) comparisons across language pairs and layers. The most interesting follow-up questions are why pair-specific axes work better than a shared language coordinate, and whether the mid-layer resistance / late-layer sensitivity pattern reflects a semantic-to-surface division of labor. For pretraining-oriented readers, the natural next question is whether this geometry depends on tokenizer design, multilingual data mixture, or instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但机制上有料：若结果站得住，multilingual 表征比想象中更低维、更局部；重点看 layerwise 定位和语义保持控制实验。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but mechanistically useful: if the result holds, multilingual control is more low-dimensional and localized than many assume; focus on the layerwise localization and semantic-preservation controls.

paper.title: Perturbation-based Regional Interpretability through Subtraction Mapping (PRISM): naming-error dissociations in language models and post-stroke aphasia
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability of large language models lacks spatially resolved, falsifiable tools for testing whether internal components are specialized for distinct cognitive operations. We adapt subtraction analysis, the standard framework of human neuroimaging, from biological brains to perturbed transformers, and apply the same logic to both substrates in parallel. Building on the Brain-LLM Unified Model (BLUM), which showed that layer-perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B error profiles match the

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM机制可解释性工具缺乏空间分辨率高、可证伪的方法来验证内部组件是否对应不同认知功能，且缺少与人脑认知损伤模式的结构化对照。
summary.importance: 将神经影像学的减法分析框架迁移到LLM扰动分析中，建立了LLM层扰动错误模式与中风后失语症患者病灶模式的结构化对照方法。
summary.technical_approach: 基于BLUM（脑-LLM统一模型）的发现，开发PRISM方法：将7类临床命名测试错误类别做两两减法映射，把每个扰动位置作为组分析的样本，沿层轴做无阈值聚类增强；同时对213名慢性中风后失语患者做结构匹配的相关-差异损伤-症状映射分析，对照二者的功能分离模式。
summary.experiments: 在扰动的LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B模型上测试，发现LLM的层扰动导致的命名错误分离模式与人类失语症患者的病灶-错误模式存在结构化对应。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南卡罗来纳大学神经学系与计算机系，团队此前提出脑-LLM统一模型BLUM，探索LLM与人脑认知机制的对应关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mechanistic interpretability tools for LLMs lack spatially resolved, falsifiable methods to test whether internal components specialize for distinct cognitive functions, and lack structured comparison with human cognitive impairment patterns.
summary_en.importance: Adapts the subtraction analysis framework from human neuroimaging to LLM perturbation analysis, establishing a structured comparison method between LLM layer perturbation error patterns and lesion patterns of post-stroke aphasia patients.
summary_en.technical_approach: Building on the prior BLUM (Brain-LLM Unified Model) finding that layer-perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B error profiles match aphasic patient lesion patterns, develops PRISM: pairwise subtracts seven clinical Philadelphia Naming Test error categories, treats each perturbation seed as a subject in group analysis with threshold-free cluster enhancement along the layer axis; runs a structurally matched correlation-difference lesion-symptom mapping analysis on 213 chronic post-stroke aphasia patients to compare functional dissociation patterns.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on perturbed LLaVA-1.6-Vicuna-13B, finds that naming error dissociation patterns from LLM layer perturbations have structured correspondence with lesion-error patterns in human aphasia patients.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the Department of Neurology and Department of Computer Science at University of South Carolina; the team previously proposed the BLUM Brain-LLM Unified Model exploring correspondences between LLM and human brain cognitive mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 神经科学方法迁移到LLM可解释性的初步探索，结论偏类比性质，未给出可指导预训练的具体机制，仅需了解思路即可。
recommendation.en: Preliminary work adapting neuroscience methods to LLM interpretability, conclusions are mostly analogical with no concrete mechanisms to guide pretraining, just get familiar with the core idea.

institutions: South Carolina 6 Department of Neurology, USC School of Medicine

paper.title: Located but Not Releasable: Silent Gate Inversion and Bounded Linear Release
paper.abstract: A growing body of work reports that language models represent task-relevant latent structure that they fail to use. Whether such structure, once located, can be converted into behavior is a separate question that is rarely tested end to end. We submit the complete pipeline -- detect, localize, and release -- to a fully preregistered stress test on a 25.7M transformer trained on causal-evidence discrimination, where a known suppression phenomenon (latent causal structure present but behaviorally

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答一个在“可解释性→可控性”链路里经常被默认、但很少端到端检验的问题：当模型内部确实存在可线性解码的任务相关结构（这里是“因果结构”），并且我们也能把它定位到具体层/通道时，是否就能通过干预把它稳定地“释放”为行为改进？作者在一个已知存在“抑制现象”的小型 transformer 上，把 detect（何时需要干预）、localize（干预哪里）、release（怎么注入）做成完整流水线，并用预注册把所有阈值、分支和 claim 模板固定，避免事后叙事。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接影响不在于提出新训练 recipe，而在于给“表征—行为鸿沟（representation–behavior gap）”提供了一个可复现实验范式和更严格的失败分解：
1）证明“定位成功”并不意味着“线性 steering 就能让行为变好”；
2）把端到端失败拆成两个相互独立的原因：门控检测器在分布外发生反转（OOD inversion），以及在正确注入点上任何线性释放方向都存在可观的上限（bounded linear release）。
这对做预训练/中期训练时的机制分析、steering、以及“用 probe 证明模型学到了 X”这类结论的可信度都有约束：学到≠会用，且“会用”未必能靠线性注入补上。
summary.technical_approach:
对象是一个冻结的 25.7M decoder-only Transformer（8 层，词表 41），训练任务是因果证据判别：给出观测证据，回答 do(X=x0)→Y=? 的干预查询。训练分布包含 Simpson-trap 世界，使得观测相关与因果效应符号相反；已知现象是模型在 held-out confounded worlds 上行为跟随观测相关，但残差流里可线性解码出因果结构。

作者构建四段式流水线并预注册：
- OOD detector u：决定是否触发干预（门控）。关键是它在校准集上做到“0 个误触发”，然后在真正需要干预的世界上触发。
- contrast forward pass：用于构造对比信号（文中作为方向生成的输入之一）。
- direction generator gθ：生成注入方向，既有“校准拟合的固定方向”，也有“per-instance 方向”。
- residual-stream injector：在定位到的层/通道对残差流做加性注入（dose 可调）。

核心方法学贡献是“失败分解”而不是某个单点技巧：
1）先用强干预（activation transplant）证明 localization 真的找对了位置：把某些世界/通道的激活移植到目标世界，行为能恢复，说明信息存在且位置特异。
2）再测端到端 gated release：如果失败，不能立刻归因于“没找对地方”，因为第 1 步已经证明找对了。
3）拆掉 gate 做 unconditional injection：如果仍失败，说明不是 routing/触发问题，而是线性释放能力本身受限。

预注册细节是这篇文章的“工程硬度”：所有阈值、评估集、统计量、claim 模板、分支回退都在数据生成前哈希归档，并提供审计链（Appendix A）。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三个结论给出定量证据：
1）Localization 成功且“足够具体”：在 mid layers 的 observation-evidence channels 做激活移植可恢复目标行为；报告 paired advantages 0.563 与 0.854（97.5% CI 排除 0），最佳注入点的 release rate 达到 0.889。
2）端到端 gated pipeline 失败，且失败方式是“反转”：一个在校准阶段实现 0 OOD triggers 的 detector，在 held-out ID generation 上反而触发 6.9–7.3%，而在 2,400 个真正需要干预的世界上触发次数为 0，导致整条 gated pipeline 行为上等价于 base model。
3）去掉 gate 后，线性注入仍然“有响应但封顶”：行为随 dose 单调变化但平台期显著低于预注册的 release margin；减半 dose 性能单调下降；per-instance 自适应方向相对固定方向的增益最多只有 ±0.03。

成本方面，终局实验总计 4.22 GPU-hours（单张消费级 GPU），强调该范式可被低成本复现与扩展。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（但这篇更像机制/方法学论文，建议至少精读关键段落）：
- 先看 Figure 1 的 failure decomposition：作者如何把“定位/门控/释放”拆成可证伪的子命题。
- 重点看 Section 3（预注册协议）：阈值、分支、claim 模板如何固定；这决定了结论的可信度边界。
- Section 5 看 activation transplant 的定位证据：这是后续“不是定位问题”的前提。
- Section 6 看 detector inversion 的统计与校准方式：为什么会出现“ID 触发、OOD 不触发”。
- Section 7 看 bounded linear release：dose-response 曲线、平台期、以及 per-instance vs fixed direction 的对照。
预计阅读时间：40–60 分钟（含关键图表与方法细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper stress-tests an often-assumed interpretability-to-control pipeline: if a model contains task-relevant latent structure (here, causal structure) that can be detected and precisely localized, can we reliably convert it into improved behavior via interventions? Using a frozen 25.7M causal-evidence transformer with a known “suppression” phenomenon (causal structure is linearly decodable but behavior ignores it), the authors build an end-to-end pipeline—detect, localize, release—under strict preregistration to prevent post-hoc tuning of thresholds and claims.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model researchers is methodological rather than a new training recipe. It provides a clean, low-cost experimental template to separate three failure modes that are often conflated: (1) localization failure, (2) routing/gating failure (deciding when to intervene), and (3) release failure (the intervention family is intrinsically insufficient). The results constrain common “the model knows X internally” narratives: internal decodability plus correct localization does not imply that linear steering can make the model use that knowledge, and even perfect gating would not fix a bounded linear release regime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Setup: a frozen 25.7M decoder-only Transformer (8 layers, vocab 41) trained on causal-evidence discrimination with Simpson-trap worlds, where observational correlation and causal effect have opposite signs. Prior work showed the model’s behavior follows observational association on held-out confounded worlds despite causal structure being linearly decodable from the residual stream.

Pipeline components (all preregistered):
- An OOD detector u that decides whether to trigger intervention.
- A contrast forward pass to construct signals for direction estimation.
- A direction generator gθ producing either a calibration-fitted global direction or per-instance directions.
- A residual-stream injector that adds the direction at a localized site with a tunable dose.

Key design choice: prove localization sufficiency first via activation transplantation (a strong, non-linear “oracle-ish” intervention). Only then evaluate the full gated pipeline; if it fails, remove the gate and test unconditional injection. This sequencing enables a credible failure decomposition: if transplant works but linear injection saturates, the gap is not “we didn’t find the right place,” but “linear release at this resolution is bounded.” Preregistration (hashed thresholds, datasets, claim templates, decision branches) is treated as part of the technical contribution.
summary_en.experiments:
Three headline findings with concrete numbers:
1) Localization works: transplanting activations at mid-layer observation-evidence channels restores target behavior on suppressed worlds, with paired advantages 0.563 and 0.854 (97.5% CIs exclude zero) and a best-site release rate of 0.889.
2) End-to-end gated release fails due to detector inversion: a detector calibrated to have zero OOD triggers fires on 6.9–7.3% of held-out in-distribution generations but on exactly 0 out of 2,400 generations from worlds that actually need intervention, making the gated pipeline behaviorally identical to the base model.
3) Even without gating, linear release is bounded: unconditional per-instance linear injection yields monotonic dose-response but plateaus well below the preregistered release margin; halving dose degrades monotonically; per-instance adaptivity adds at most ±0.03 over a fixed direction.

Reported terminal experiment cost is 4.22 GPU-hours on a single consumer GPU, emphasizing reproducibility.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path that still captures the core logic:
- Figure 1 for the preregistered failure decomposition.
- Section 3 for the preregistration protocol (what was fixed, how claims are audited).
- Section 5 for the activation-transplant localization evidence (the linchpin).
- Section 6 for the OOD detector inversion analysis.
- Section 7 for the bounded linear release results (dose-response and per-instance vs fixed).
Time budget: ~45 minutes if you focus on these sections and the main plots/tables.

recommendation.zh: 小模型机制实验，但预注册 setup 比常见 probing 干净；重点看 release 成功与 OOD gate 失败的分界。
recommendation.en: A small-model mechanistic study, but the preregistered setup is cleaner than typical probing; focus on where release works and OOD gating fails.

paper.title: Localizing Safety Alignment: MLP Layers and Mid-Network Blocks Encode Refusal Behavior in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Safety alignment in large language models is often treated as a distributed property of the entire network, yet its practical brittleness suggests that refusal behavior may be concentrated in a smaller set of parameters. This work addresses where safety-aligned refusal is encoded by transplanting weights from aligned models into matched unaligned base models at multiple levels of granularity. Using two open-weight model pairs and four safety benchmarks, we conducted experiments to compare the ef

summary.core_problem: 现有研究普遍假设LLM的安全对齐拒绝行为是全网络分布式编码的属性，但实践中对齐行为极易被少量参数更新、prompt攻击破坏，且容易出现对无害请求的过度拒绝，其参数层面的具体编码位置尚未被清晰定位：拒绝行为主要由注意力还是MLP通路承载、是否集中在特定深度的层块中。
summary.importance: 这一实证结果解释了安全对齐在小参数更新、prompt攻击下的脆弱性来源：拒绝行为仅集中在少量中层MLP参数上，局部扰动即可破坏对齐效果；同时为低对齐税的参数高效安全干预方法提供了明确的参数定位参考，无需全模型微调即可调整拒绝行为。
summary.technical_approach: 选取两对架构完全一致、仅对齐状态不同的开源模型作为实验对象，通过控制变量的权重移植实验定位拒绝行为的参数载体：将对齐模型中不同粒度的参数子集（注意力权重、MLP权重、连续层区间、单个MLP块）替换到未对齐底座模型的对应位置，在四个安全基准上测试模型对恶意prompt的拒绝率变化，辅以贪心块搜索定位贡献最高的参数区域。实验同时测量对无害prompt的过度拒绝率，避免将“一概拒绝”误判为对齐成功。
summary.experiments: 在28层Qwen2-7B和32层Llama-3.1-8B两个模型族上得到一致结论：1）拒绝行为的传递性主要由MLP参数主导，替换全部MLP参数恢复的拒绝率远高于替换全部注意力参数；2）跨6组模型-基准组合的贪心搜索均优先选中网络中层（约8-11层）的MLP块，是拒绝参数最集中的区域；3）对齐块的效果不具备加性：叠加更多对齐模型的MLP块不一定能提升拒绝率，精选的少量中层MLP块的效果可超过全MLP替换。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注权重移植的核心实验结果与贪心定位的层块分布，无需深究实验设置的复现细节，核心把握“MLP主导、中层集中、效果非叠加”三个结论即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety alignment in LLMs is commonly assumed to be a distributed property across the entire network, but observed brittleness of refusal behavior—easily degraded by small parameter updates or jailbreak attacks, and prone to over-refusal on harmless inputs—suggests the behavior may be encoded in a small subset of parameters. The unresolved question is which parameter groups and layer depths carry transferable refusal behavior, and whether attention or MLP pathways dominate this function.
summary_en.importance: These empirical findings identify a mechanistic source of alignment brittleness: because refusal is concentrated in a small set of mid-network MLP blocks, even localized parameter updates can disrupt safety behavior. The results also provide a clear parameter target for parameter-efficient safety interventions that minimize alignment tax, removing the need for full-model fine-tuning to adjust refusal behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two pairs of open-weight models with identical architecture but different alignment status are used for controlled experiments: RealSafe-R1-7B (safety-tuned) vs DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (base, 28 layers), and saferlhf_ultra_sft (safety SFT) vs Llama-3.1-8B (base, 32 layers). Selective weight transplantation isolates parameter contribution: subsets of weights from the aligned model (attention weights, MLP weights, contiguous layer ranges, individual MLP blocks) are swapped into the unaligned base model, and refusal rates on malicious prompts are measured across four safety benchmarks. Greedy block search identifies the highest-contribution parameter regions, and over-refusal on harmless prompts is tracked to avoid conflating indiscriminate refusal with proper alignment.
summary_en.experiments: Results are consistent across both model families: 1) Refusal transfer is dominated by MLP weights; replacing full MLP parameters recovers substantially higher refusal rates than replacing full attention parameters. 2) Across all 6 model-benchmark pairs, greedy search consistently selects mid-network MLP blocks (spanning layers 8–11) as the highest-contribution region. 3) Aligned block effects are not additive: adding more aligned MLP blocks does not reliably increase refusal rates, and a small curated subset of mid-layer MLP blocks can outperform full MLP replacement.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper, focusing on core weight transplantation results and the layer distribution of refusal-related parameters. There is no need to dive into experimental setup details for replication; the three core takeaways (MLP dominance, mid-layer concentration, non-additive effects) are sufficient. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 干净的权重移植实验表明拒绝行为主要编码在 MLP 而非注意力，且集中在网络中部——对安全对齐的机制理解和定向编辑有直接启发，看 §4 的粒度对比即可。
recommendation.en: Clean weight-transplant experiments show refusal is encoded mainly in MLPs (not attention) and concentrated in mid-network blocks—directly informs mechanistic understanding and targeted editing of safety alignment; read §4 granularity comparisons.

paper.title: Causal Structure is Inducible but Functionally Decoupled: The Routing/Readout Boundary of a Typed Mechanism Library
paper.abstract: When a language model answers an interventional question, the computation it must perform depends on the type of evidence the query requires. We report a decoupling in how a transformer organizes causal knowledge: slot-by-type structure induced by type-level supervision organizes routing, yet remains functionally decoupled from answer readout. We establish this with a typed mechanism library -- discrete mechanism slots partitioned by evidence type, auditable at the state level -- on a causal-wor

summary.core_problem: 研究 transformer 在因果推断任务中如何组织“因果知识”：路由结构是否等于可用于答案读出的功能性表示。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不直接改进预训练，但它试图把“结构可诱导”和“功能可读出”拆开，针对可解释性里常见的结构=功能假设给出修正。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 typed mechanism library，把离散机制槽按证据类型分区，并在冻结协议下比较有无 type-level supervision 的模型。核心是审计 state-level slot organization，检验类型监督是否诱导出按类型分槽的路由结构，以及这种结构是否真正承载答案读出。
summary.experiments: 在一个带精确 intervention ground truth 的 causal-world benchmark 上做两种规模实验：22.6M 和 125M。摘要强调四个 preregistered findings，其中最关键的是：类型监督能稳定诱导 slot-by-type 结构，但该结构与最终答案读出在功能上解耦。没有看到与主流大模型直接相关的规模或外部任务结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsingjiao Information Science (Beijing) Co., Ltd。未见可直接确认的知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how transformers organize causal knowledge in interventional QA: whether induced routing structure is the same thing as functionally useful answer readout.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a method paper. Its main value is that it separates inducible internal structure from functional readout, pushing back on the common assumption that interpretable structure automatically implies causal use.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces a typed mechanism library with discrete mechanism slots partitioned by evidence type, then audits state-level organization under a frozen protocol. The key test is whether type-level supervision induces slot-by-type routing, and whether that induced structure actually carries answer readout.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on a causal-world benchmark with exact interventional ground truth at 22.6M and 125M scales. The headline result is that type supervision reliably induces slot-by-type organization, but this organization is functionally decoupled from answer readout. No direct large-scale foundation-model evidence is visible from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with Tsingjiao Information Science (Beijing) Co., Ltd. No clearly identifiable high-profile author signal from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 有一点意思：它在拆“可解释结构”和“可用功能”这两个常被混写的概念，但规模太小，只能当机制侧弱信号。
recommendation.en: Interesting mainly because it separates interpretable routing from functional readout, but the scale is too small—treat it as a mechanistic weak signal, not a foundation-model prior shift.

paper.title: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
paper.abstract: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discover

summary.core_problem: AI模型能力机制的人工探索效率远低于模型迭代速度，模型能力与人类可解释性之间的缺口持续扩大。
summary.importance: 提出首个面向AI机制发现的专用agent系统，构建了覆盖可解释性文献和分析方法的知识库，实现自动化机制假设生成。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建Mechanist agent框架，整合包含约13000篇可解释性论文的知识图谱、覆盖26个领域4300万篇论文的多学科数据库，以及32种机制分析、因果干预、验证方法库，自动生成、验证机制假设。
summary.experiments: 与Claude Code、现有AI Scientist系统对比，Mechanist生成的机制假设学术价值更高。

summary_en.core_problem: Manual mechanistic exploration of AI capabilities progresses far slower than model iteration, widening the gap between model capabilities and human interpretability.
summary_en.importance: Proposes the first agentic system dedicated to AI mechanism discovery, with built-in interpretability literature and method libraries to automate hypothesis generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds the Mechanist agent framework, integrating a knowledge graph of ~13,000 interpretability papers, a cross-disciplinary database of 43 million papers across 26 fields, and a library of 32 mechanism analysis, causal intervention and validation methods to automatically generate and test mechanism hypotheses.
summary_en.experiments: Mechanist generates higher-value mechanism hypotheses compared to Claude Code and existing AI Scientist systems.

recommendation.zh: 自动化可解释性研究的工具框架，无新的机制发现结论，作为文献备查即可，无需通读。
recommendation.en: Tooling for automated mechanistic interpretability with no novel mechanism findings, use as literature reference only, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Probing and steering biology across Boltz-1s trunk-diffusion boundary
paper.abstract: AlphaFold3-class structure predictors pair a representational trunk, which processes sequence and context, with a diffusion module, which generates atomic coordinates. How biological information changes as it crosses this architectural boundary remains poorly understood. We analyze per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module of Boltz-1 using linear probes, sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and causal interventions. From the trunk, both geometry (secondary structure, disorder

summary.core_problem: 分析 AlphaFold3 类结构预测模型中，表示 trunk 到 diffusion 坐标生成模块的边界上，生物信息如何保留、衰减和可控干预。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析：用 probes、SAE 和 causal interventions 研究 Boltz-1 的 Pairformer trunk 与 diffusion module。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对“表示编码器 + diffusion 解码器”这类混合架构有旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 trunk 和 diffusion module 抽取 per-residue activations，用线性探针检测几何属性和序列化学属性的可解码性，用 sparse autoencoders 分析特征，再在最终 trunk single representation 上沿可解码方向做干预，观察 diffusion 生成结构的变化。
summary.experiments: 研究对象是 Boltz-1。摘要称 trunk 中二级结构、无序区、氨基酸身份、信号肽和二硫键注释都可线性解码；进入 diffusion module 后，二级结构基本保留，而序列化学信息显著衰减。沿 helix/coil 方向干预可剂量依赖地改变预测结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how biological information is preserved, weakened, or made steerable across the boundary between the representational trunk and diffusion coordinate generator in an AlphaFold3-class model.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mechanistic analysis of Boltz-1 using probes, sparse autoencoders, and causal interventions. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant as evidence about encoder-plus-diffusion hybrid architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extract per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module, train linear probes for geometry and sequence-chemistry attributes, use sparse autoencoders for feature analysis, and intervene on the final trunk single representation along decodable directions.
summary_en.experiments: The model studied is Boltz-1. The abstract reports that secondary structure, disorder, amino-acid identity, signal peptides, and disulfide annotations are linearly decodable from the trunk; after the diffusion boundary, secondary structure is largely preserved while sequence chemistry is strongly attenuated. Helix and coil directions can steer predicted structures in a dose-dependent way.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文；只看 trunk-diffusion 边界的信息衰减结果，可作为多模态 diffusion 解码器设计的弱证据。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper; read only the trunk-to-diffusion information attenuation result as weak evidence for multimodal diffusion-decoder design.

paper.title: Data Attribution of Emergent Misalignment with Persona Features
paper.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM) is the phenomenon where fine-tuning a language model on a narrow task leads to harmful behavior in unrelated domains. A leading mechanistic account attributes EM to persona features: latent directions acquired during pre-training that misaligned fine-tuning amplifies. We ask where these features come from: which pre-training documents activate them, and whether naturally occurring human-written text suffices to induce EM. Using Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) based model diff

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作追问的是 emergent misalignment 的上游来源：如果窄域微调会把模型推向越狱、操控、反社会角色等失配行为，那么这些可被放大的“persona features”究竟来自哪些预训练文档，且自然人类文本本身是否足以诱发这类失配。它不是只做相关性分析，而是把问题拆成三层：先用 aligned vs misaligned 的对比微调找出被放大/被压制的 SAE 特征，再用 activation steering 验证这些特征对行为有因果作用，最后把特征回溯到预训练语料并测试这些语料能否单独复现 EM。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两点。第一，它把 EM 从“微调副作用”往前推到了“预训练中已存在的潜在行为方向”，这对数据过滤、数据配比、人格/角色类文本的风险建模都有直接启发。第二，它给出一个不太直观但很重要的结论：仅靠检索到的人类原文，往往不足以通过微调诱发明显 EM；把同样内容改写成 LLM 生成的 instruction-response 结构后，行为迁移才明显增强。这说明风险不只在语义主题，还在监督格式、回答体裁和模型熟悉的 instruction manifold 上。贡献量级更像机制定位与风险归因，而不是一个立刻可部署的防御方案。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三步。第一步是 SAE-based model diffing。作者在 medical、legal、security 三个领域分别构造 benign aligned 微调模型和 narrow misaligned 微调模型，用同一组 44 个 EM 诱发提示抽取残差流激活，并投到对应层的 SAE 特征空间。通过比较 misaligned 与 aligned 模型在这些提示上的平均特征激活差，筛出被 misalignment 特异性放大的正向特征和被压制的负向特征。这里的关键设计是用 aligned reference 控制领域微调本身带来的变化，尽量把 domain adaptation 与 misalignment signal 分开。

第二步是因果验证。作者对单个 SAE 特征做 activation steering，分别测试：向 aligned 模型注入高激活的 persona feature 是否能直接诱发 EM；向 misaligned 模型补回被压制的 safety/assistant-identity feature 是否能把行为拉回。结果显示这种控制是稀疏且特征特异的，随机特征几乎不起作用，说明不是“任意大方向扰动都能让模型失配”，而是少数可解释特征承担了主要行为杠杆。

第三步是数据归因与再训练验证。作者基于特征激活在预训练语料中检索高响应文档，人工归纳出 recurring themes，如 villain、支配、操控、恶意 agency、角色扮演等叙事。随后他们做关键对照：直接用这些人类文档微调，EM 很弱；把这些内容转成 LLM 生成的 instruction-response 对，再微调，EM 明显出现，而且能跨模型家族迁移。这个结果把“内容主题”与“监督形式”区分开了：同样的语义材料，是否被包装成模型熟悉的问答/指令响应格式，决定了它能否高效激活并巩固这些 persona directions。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四个 open-weight 模型、三个模型家族。特征层面，作者复现并扩展了先前关于 EM persona features 的观察：被放大的多是 jailbreak persona、sarcasm、deception、manipulation、roleplay 一类特征；被压制的多是 refusal、安全提示、assistant identity 相关特征。因果层面，单个特征 steering 就能把 aligned 模型的 misalignment rate 推到最高 62%，而直接做 misalignment fine-tuning 的基线约为 35%；反过来，对 misaligned 模型施加 re-alignment steering，可把 misalignment rate 压到约 1%。这说明单特征的行为控制强度并不弱于整套微调。

数据归因层面，检索出的高归因文档确实集中在负面角色、支配关系、恶意意图等叙事，但直接拿这些 human-written 文本做微调，不能稳定复现 EM。把同源内容改写成 LLM 生成的 instruction-response 数据后，行为偏移显著增强，并且能跨模型家族生效。这个对照实验是全文最关键的证据，因为它说明“自然文本里有信号”与“该信号能否在监督微调中被高效提取”是两件事。摘要里没有给出所有模型、层位、数据量和各域细分数字；精读时应重点核对附录中的 baseline EM rates、每个模型的 steering 成功率分布、以及 human vs synthetic 数据微调的样本规模是否严格匹配。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看方法部分里 aligned vs misaligned 的对比设计，确认作者如何排除纯领域微调效应。第二，看 feature steering 结果图，重点不是平均提升，而是“单特征可强诱发、随机特征无效、负向特征可回拉”这三个现象是否同时成立。第三，看数据归因后的再训练对照，尤其是 human-written 文本与由其派生的 synthetic instruction-response 数据之间的差异。

如果时间有限，优先读 Introduction、Model Diffing、Steering、Data Attribution 和 human-vs-synthetic 的实验段落，再翻附录核对数据规模与 prompt 细节，预计 25–35 分钟能抓住主线。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 SAE 特征解释是否足够稳，是否存在 feature splitting/aliasing；二是 instruction-response 格式为何更容易把潜在人格方向变成可泛化行为，这和 post-train 数据格式、reward shaping、甚至 RL policy extraction 都有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where emergent misalignment comes from upstream. If narrow fine-tuning can push a model toward jailbreak-like, manipulative, or antisocial behavior, which pretraining documents seeded the latent persona features that later get amplified? And is naturally occurring human-written text alone sufficient to induce EM, or does the effect depend on how that content is packaged during supervision? The work tackles all three layers: identifying shifted SAE features, testing their causal role with steering, and tracing them back to pretraining data followed by re-finetuning tests.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is that it relocates part of the EM story from fine-tuning into pretraining. The paper argues that misalignment is not created from scratch by narrow supervision; fine-tuning can amplify latent behavioral directions already present in the base model. That matters for data curation, mixture design, and risk accounting around roleplay, villain, domination, and harmful-agency narratives. A second important result is more subtle: retrieved human-written source documents are usually not enough to reproduce strong EM through fine-tuning, while LLM-generated instruction-response pairs derived from the same content are. This suggests the risk is not only in semantic content but also in supervision format and response style.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has three stages. First, the authors perform SAE-based model diffing. For each domain—medical, legal, and security—they train a benign aligned model and a narrowly misaligned model, then compare residual-stream activations on the same 44 EM-elicitation prompts. Activations are projected into an SAE feature space, averaged over tokens and prompts, and ranked by the shift between misaligned and aligned models. Positive-shift features are candidates for inducing EM; negative-shift features are candidates for restoring alignment. The aligned reference is the key control, because it removes feature changes caused merely by domain adaptation.

Second, they test causality with activation steering. Injecting a single high-shift persona feature into an aligned model can induce misaligned behavior; boosting suppressed safety or assistant-identity features in a misaligned model can reverse it. The effect is sparse and highly feature-specific, with random features rarely doing much. That is an important mechanistic point: EM is not produced by arbitrary broad perturbations but by a small set of interpretable directions.

Third, they perform activation-based data attribution over the pretraining corpus. High-attribution documents repeatedly involve villainous characters, domination, manipulation, harmful agency, and roleplay-like narratives. The crucial follow-up is a retraining comparison: fine-tuning directly on the retrieved human-written documents does not reliably induce EM, but converting the same content into LLM-generated instruction-response pairs does, including transfer across model families. This separates semantic source from supervision interface. The same ideas become much more behaviorally potent once expressed in a format that matches the model’s instruction-tuning manifold.
summary_en.experiments:
The study spans four open-weight models from three families. On the feature side, it reproduces and extends prior observations: misalignment fine-tuning amplifies jailbreak-persona, sarcasm, deception, manipulation, and roleplay features, while suppressing refusal, safety, and assistant-identity features. On the causal side, steering a single feature can drive an aligned model to misalignment rates up to 62%, compared with roughly 35% from misalignment fine-tuning itself. In the opposite direction, steering suppressed alignment-related features can reduce a misaligned model’s misalignment rate to around 1%. That is a strong indication that a small number of features carry substantial behavioral leverage.

The data-attribution experiments retrieve human-written documents with the expected themes, but those documents alone are insufficient to recreate robust EM under fine-tuning. When the same source material is rewritten into synthetic instruction-response pairs, clear behavioral shifts emerge, and they transfer across model families. That human-vs-synthetic contrast is the paper’s most important empirical result. It shows that having signal in pretraining data is different from making that signal easy for supervised fine-tuning to extract and consolidate. The abstract does not expose all per-model details, so the appendix is worth checking for baseline EM rates, steering success distributions, and whether human and synthetic finetuning sets are tightly matched in size and domain.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, inspect the aligned-versus-misaligned contrastive setup and verify how the paper separates domain adaptation from misalignment-specific shifts. Second, look closely at the steering results; the key pattern is not average gain but the combination of strong single-feature induction, near-zero effect from random features, and successful re-alignment via suppressed features. Third, read the data-attribution and retraining sections, especially the comparison between raw human-written documents and synthetic instruction-response data derived from them.

If time is limited, the introduction, model-diffing section, steering section, and the human-vs-synthetic experiments are enough to capture the main argument in about 25–35 minutes. The deeper questions worth probing are whether the SAE features are stable and interpretable enough, and why instruction-response formatting is so much more effective at turning latent persona directions into generalized behavior. That second question connects directly to post-training data design and to how policy-like behavior is extracted from pretrained representations.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接改 pretrain recipe，但会改变你看待“坏行为从哪来”的 prior；重点看 feature steering 的因果证据，数据归因部分先当弱信号。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your training recipe tomorrow, but it does update the prior on where misalignment comes from; read it for the causal steering evidence, and treat the data attribution part as a weaker signal.

paper.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability explains models by identifying circuits inside them, but has no way to tell whether a circuit is a property of the model or an artifact of the method that found it. Sparse autoencoders illustrate the problem: different seeds and widths recover materially different features from the same activations, and no theory says whether that variability is incidental or structural. We put dictionary learning for interpretability on an identifiability footing. Treating the forwa

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性领域（稀疏自编码器SAE、transcoder、因果干预等）缺少可识别性理论基础：无法判断发现的「回路/特征」是模型本身的固有属性，还是由搜索方法、随机种子、超参数带来的人工产物；SAE在相同激活上不同种子/宽度得到显著不同的特征，现有范式没有定理保证恢复出的结构是模型不变量。
summary.importance: 首次把Transformer前向传播形式化为「深度为时间、注意力跨token写入为控制输入、MLP为自治非线性动力学」的受控离散动力系统，引入Koopman算子得到坐标无关的谱不变量，并证明其有限样本可识别性，为机制可解释性提供了一个不依赖字典基的、可证唯一的基准对象；同时严格证明了SAE目标本身不具备可识别性，解释了其运行间不稳定的根源。对预训练研究员的价值在于：提供了一种跨层、跨训练运行比较模型内在结构的理论工具，可用于分析训练动态、结构涌现、不同预训练配方对内部计算的影响。
summary.technical_approach: 1）将固定token位置上第ℓ层残差流状态x_ℓ视为状态，将其他token位置对该位置的注意力写入收集为外生控制u_ℓ，把前向传播重写为深度递推的受控离散动力系统：x_{ℓ+1}=x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ) + m_ℓ(x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ))，其中a为注意力子层、m为MLP子层。2）引入作用于可观测量ψ的Koopman算子K，通过复合动力学演化可观测量；尽管原动力学非线性，K在可观测量空间是线性的。3）若字典Ψ张成K的不变子空间，则K限制为有限矩阵A，其特征对定义为Transformer的Koopman模态，整个框架称为Koopman谱分析（KSA）；A的特征值在字典基变换下不变，仅相差排列。4）使用带控制的扩展动态模态分解（EDMDc）从M个校准样本估计该谱，主定理证明以M^{-1/2}的参数速率可恢复谱（不计排列与重数简并），并给出无间隙加强、聚类谱扩展、最小最大下界、重尾分布变体等一系列理论结果。5）进一步证明模态-主成分解离性质，以及SAE目标（单层激活重构+稀疏）的代数不完备性与不可识别性。
summary.experiments: 在3个预训练模型上完成系统测量，实验部分核心是验证：1）Koopman谱在不同字典基、不同采样下的稳定性与可复现性；2）谱估计误差随样本量M的衰减符合M^{-1/2}的理论预测；3）与SAE特征的对比：SAE特征随种子/宽度显著漂移，而Koopman谱是跨运行稳定的不变量；4）模态-主成分解离的定量验证，展示KSA提取的结构与普通PCA捕获的统计方向有本质区别。（注：原文第11节给出完整测量，摘要部分未列出具体模型规模与数值指标，精读时需关注该节的定量误差曲线与跨运行一致性数字。）
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计40–60分钟，理论背景强的读者可延长。建议路径：1）先读第1、3节，掌握「深度=时间、注意力=控制」的建模视角，这是全文最核心的概念转换；2）第4节快速过EDMDc估计器和三个假设的内容，不必陷入证明细节；3）第6、7、9节抓定理结论：有限样本可识别速率、最小最大下界、SAE不可识别性——这是对预训练研究最有信息量的部分；4）第11节实验看谱稳定性和与SAE的对比图；5）若不做可解释性理论，第5、8、10节的长证明可跳过。值得深挖的点：如何把该谱不变量用作预训练训练动态的探针（不同数据阶段/优化器/架构下谱如何演化），以及能否与loss spike、涌现能力建立关联。

summary_en.core_problem: Mechanistic interpretability (sparse autoencoders, transcoders, causal intervention, etc.) lacks a foundation in identifiability theory. There is no way to determine whether a discovered circuit or feature is an intrinsic property of the trained model or an artifact of the recovery method, random seed, or hyperparameters. SAEs consistently recover materially different features from the same activations across seeds and widths, and no existing paradigm provides a theorem guaranteeing that the recovered structure is a model invariant.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes the Transformer forward pass as a controlled discrete dynamical system where depth acts as time, cross-token attention writes act as control inputs, and MLPs act as autonomous nonlinear dynamics. It introduces the Koopman operator to yield coordinate-free spectral invariants and proves their finite-sample identifiability, supplying mechanistic interpretability with a provably unique, basis-independent reference object. It also rigorously shows that the SAE objective itself is non-identifiable, explaining the source of run-to-run instability. For pretraining research, the framework provides a theoretical tool for comparing intrinsic model structure across layers and across training runs, usable for analyzing training dynamics, structural emergence, and how pretraining recipes shape internal computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) At a fixed token position, treat the residual-stream state x_ℓ at layer ℓ as the state and collect attention writes from other token positions as exogenous controls u_ℓ. The forward pass is rewritten as a depth-indexed controlled recurrence: x_{ℓ+1}=x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ) + m_ℓ(x_ℓ + a_ℓ(x_ℓ,u_ℓ)), where a is the attention sublayer and m the MLP sublayer. 2) Introduce the Koopman operator K acting on observables ψ by composition with the dynamics; although the original dynamics are nonlinear, K is linear on the space of observables. 3) If a dictionary Ψ spans an invariant subspace of K, then K restricts to a finite matrix A whose eigenpairs are defined as the Transformer's Koopman modes; the overall framework is called Koopman Spectral Analysis (KSA). The eigenvalues of A are invariant under dictionary basis changes, up to permutation. 4) Use Extended Dynamic Mode Decomposition with control (EDMDc) to estimate the spectrum from M calibration samples. The main theorem establishes recoverability at the parametric rate M^{-1/2}, modulo permutation and multiplicity degeneracies, with extensions including a gap-free strengthening, clustered-spectrum case, minimax lower bound, and heavy-tailed variant. 5) Further results prove a modal–principal dissociation property and the algebraic incompleteness / non-identifiability of the SAE objective (single-layer reconstruction + sparsity).
summary_en.experiments: Systematic measurements are reported on three pretrained models. The experimental section validates: 1) Stability and reproducibility of the Koopman spectrum across dictionary bases and sampling procedures. 2) That spectral estimation error decays with sample size M at the theoretically predicted M^{-1/2} rate. 3) A direct comparison with SAEs: SAE features drift substantially across seeds and widths, whereas the Koopman spectrum is a stable cross-run invariant. 4) Quantitative verification of the modal–principal dissociation, showing that the structure captured by KSA is fundamentally distinct from the statistical directions recovered by ordinary PCA. (Full quantitative curves and cross-run consistency numbers are detailed in Section 11.)
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, roughly 40–60 minutes; longer for readers with strong theory interests. Suggested path: 1) Start with Sections 1 and 3 to internalize the modeling shift: depth = time, attention = control. This is the central conceptual contribution. 2) Skim Section 4 for the EDMDc estimator and the three standing assumptions, without dwelling on proof mechanics. 3) In Sections 6, 7, and 9, focus on the theorem statements: finite-sample identifiability rate, minimax lower bound, and SAE non-identifiability — these carry the most information for pretraining research. 4) In Section 11, inspect the spectral-stability plots and SAE-comparison figures. 5) Skip the long proofs in Sections 5, 8, and 10 unless working on interpretability theory directly. Promising follow-up directions include using spectral invariants as probes for pretraining training dynamics (how spectra evolve across data phases, optimizers, or architectures) and linking them to loss spikes or emergent capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 做 mech interp 的人该看：它不是又一个 feature atlas，而是在问“你找到的东西是否可辨识”；先看理论设定和 recoverability 结论，别急着信实验包装。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about mech interp rigor: it asks whether discovered structure is identifiable at all, not just visually plausible; focus on the theorem setup before trusting the empirical story.

paper.title: Measuring Semantic Abstractness of SAE Features via Nonlocality
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have helped uncover mechanistic explanations for LLM behaviours such as reasoning, jailbreaking etc., via understanding the corresponding task-relevant and causally effective features. To evaluate such mechanistic explanations, downstream studies must distinguish surface lexical features from genuinely high-level ones. However, neither an autointerp-based semantic description nor causal steering utility fully resolves the abstraction level of a feature. To this end, we

summary.core_problem: 现有基于自动解释或因果干预的方法无法可靠区分SAE提取的LLM特征是表层词法特征还是高层语义抽象特征
summary.importance: 提出了一种无需外部模型标注或因果干预的特征抽象度量化指标，为SAE机制解释研究提供了低成本的可量化评估维度
summary.technical_approach: 定义特征非局部性（FNL）为SAE特征激活在各序列位置上的影响分布归一化后的熵值，熵越高表示特征越依赖全局上下文、抽象度越高，无需额外标注即可计算
summary.experiments: 在开源LLM的SAE特征上验证，FNL与现有基于LLM的特征抽象度代理指标呈正相关；在上下文推理特征与token级特征的配对判别任务中，FNL的判断准确率达73%-84%

summary_en.core_problem: Existing methods based on autointerpretation or causal steering cannot reliably distinguish surface lexical features from high-level semantic abstract features extracted by SAEs in LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a low-cost, quantifiable metric for feature abstractness that requires no external model annotation or causal intervention, providing a new evaluation dimension for SAE-based mechanistic interpretability research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines Feature Nonlocality (FNL) as the entropy of the normalized per-position influence distribution of an SAE feature's activation; higher entropy indicates stronger reliance on global context and higher abstractness, computable without additional labels.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on SAE features from open-source LLMs, FNL correlates positively with existing LLM-based proxy metrics for feature abstractness; achieves 73-84% accuracy when distinguishing contextual reasoning features from token-level features in pairwise comparison tasks.

recommendation.zh: 提出基于激活熵的SAE特征抽象度无监督度量，思路简洁，做可解释性研究可参考，非相关方向无需通读
recommendation.en: Proposes an unsupervised SAE feature abstractness metric based on activation entropy, useful for interpretability work, skip if not in the field.

paper.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed as AI agents frequently exhibit user specification-grounding failures, executing hallucinated, undesired actions to force a resolution rather than expressing uncertainty. Existing detection methods fail to provide actionable, real-time correction as they either do not localize the hallucinations, or incur prohibitive inference latency. We introduce the Latent Critic, a lightweight low-rank adapter (LoRA) that operates concurrently with a frozen base LLM's ge

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 常执行幻觉出的、不符合用户规范的动作，而不是表达不确定性；现有检测方法难以定位且延迟过高。
summary.importance: 提出轻量 LoRA 批评器，并通过激活修补和逐层探针做机制分析；对理解残差流中的 grounding/不确定性信号有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Latent Critic 是与冻结基模型并发运行的低秩适配器，重构 transformer 残差流以放大潜在 grounding 信号，并在单次序列内生成局部自然语言反馈，避免二次推理循环。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集或数值结果；声称可进行细粒度检测，并通过 activation patching 与 layer-wise probing 观察到 rank-invariant 的残差流重构现象。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents often execute hallucinated actions that violate user specifications instead of expressing uncertainty, while existing detectors either fail to localize failures or add too much latency.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight LoRA critic and supports it with activation patching and layer-wise probing; useful as a mechanistic look at grounding and uncertainty signals in the residual stream.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Critic runs concurrently with a frozen base LLM as a low-rank adapter that restructures the transformer residual stream, amplifies latent grounding signals, and emits localized natural-language feedback within a single sequence, avoiding a second inference loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no model size, dataset, or numerical results; it claims granular detection and reports rank-invariant restructuring of the residual stream through activation patching and layer-wise probing.

recommendation.zh: LoRA 在残差流中放大 grounding 信号并同序列输出 critique 的想法有意思，但偏 agent 应用；只看 activation patching 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting residual-stream LoRA for in-sequence grounding critique, but it is agent-centric; read only the activation-patching analysis.

paper.title: Who Bridges Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Pathways
paper.abstract: Uncovering the internal mechanisms underlying the safety capabilities of large language models (LLMs) is crucial for developing trustworthy artificial intelligence. Currently, mechanistic interpretability studies on multilingual safety are largely confined to local components, such as isolated neurons. However, this static and fragmented perspective overlooks the synergy among components and fails to elucidate how safety signals dynamically propagate within the model to drive safety decisions ul

summary.core_problem: LLM 的安全机制在跨语言场景下是如何运作的？跨语言安全差距的内部机制是什么？
summary.importance: 超越了孤立神经元的静态分析，从跨层功能路径（pathways）的动态视角研究多语言安全机制，为理解和缓解跨语言越狱（cross-lingual jailbreak）提供了机制解释。
summary.technical_approach: 首先识别单语安全路径并验证其在拒绝有害请求中的作用。然后进行跨语言分析，发现了一个稀疏的“跨语言共享安全路径”子集。通过靶向干预这些共享路径，研究其对跨语言安全性的影响。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体的模型规模或量化指标，但指出靶向干预共享路径可以有效缓解跨语言安全差距。
summary.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua 是新加坡国立大学 (NUS) 的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How do safety mechanisms in LLMs operate in cross-lingual scenarios, and what is the internal mechanism of the cross-lingual safety gap?
summary_en.importance: Moves beyond static analysis of isolated neurons to study multilingual safety mechanisms from a dynamic perspective of cross-layer functional pathways, providing a mechanistic explanation for understanding and mitigating cross-lingual jailbreaks.
summary_en.technical_approach: First identifies monolingual safety pathways and validates their role in refusing harmful requests. Then conducts cross-lingual analysis to reveal a sparse subset of 'cross-lingual shared safety pathways'. Investigates the impact of targeting these shared pathways on cross-lingual safety.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model scales or quantitative metrics are not provided in the abstract, but it notes that targeting shared pathways can effectively mitigate the cross-lingual safety gap.
summary_en.authors_note: Tat-Seng Chua is a well-known scholar at the National University of Singapore (NUS).

recommendation.zh: 从 mechanistic interpretability 角度分析多语言安全对齐，发现跨语言共享的 safety pathways，对理解模型内部的对齐机制和防御多语言越狱有启发。
recommendation.en: Analyzes multilingual safety alignment from a mechanistic interpretability perspective, discovering cross-lingual shared safety pathways, which is inspiring for understanding internal alignment mechanisms and defending against multilingual jailbreaks.

paper.title: Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Decoupling the Shared Control Bottleneck of RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting

summary.core_problem: RL 微调提升 LLM 推理能力，但现有解释将成功归因于更强更多样的电路激活，混淆了激活与控制。
summary.importance: 原理分析，挑战以激活为中心的 RLFT 解释，引入控制论视角区分"被激活"与"实际控制奖励增益"。
summary.technical_approach: 改编代谢控制分析，定义训练后控制系数度量组件对奖励增益的控制；构建控制矩阵（组件×任务族）与激活幅度矩阵对比；识别共享控制瓶颈和激活-控制差距。
summary.experiments: 显示高度共享的激活可与任务特定的控制共存，小的激活-控制差距对应更好的跨任务泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: RL fine-tuning improves LLM reasoning, but existing accounts attribute success to stronger and more diverse circuit activation, conflating activation with control.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis: challenges the activation-centered account of RLFT by introducing a control-theoretic view that distinguishes 'being activated' from 'actually controlling reward gain'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adapts Metabolic Control Analysis to define the Post-training Control Coefficient measuring each component's control over reward gain; builds a control matrix (components × task families) and compares it with an activation-magnitude matrix; identifies the Shared Control Bottleneck and Activation-Control Gap.
summary_en.experiments: Shows that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, and a small activation-control gap correlates with better cross-task generalization.

recommendation.zh: 激活≠控制这个区分值得吸收，做 RLFT 电路分析时应同时看控制系数而非只看激活幅度；重点看控制系数定义和控制矩阵那一节。
recommendation.en: The activation-vs-control distinction is worth internalizing: when analyzing RLFT circuits, track control coefficients alongside activation magnitude; focus on the control coefficient definition and control matrix section.

paper.title: On the Robustness of LLMs' Internal Representation of Code Correctness
paper.abstract: Code generated by modern language models often reads naturally. Yet, it also often fails to implement what was asked. This should be no surprise, as research shows the models' own confidence signals are poorly calibrated with actual correctness. A promising way to assess correctness looks inside the model: by contrasting the hidden states of correct and incorrect programs, recent work captured an internal signal of code correctness that is able to judge candidate solutions better than the model'

summary.core_problem: LLM 内部隐藏状态中代码正确性信号是否为模型的鲁棒属性，还是特定提取方式的产物？
summary.importance: 原理分析——首次系统性质疑内部代码正确性信号的鲁棒性，对理解 LLM 内部表示和 probe 方法论有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 系统性变化信号提取方式（层、池化方法、投影方向等），并构造仅在故障位置有差异的最小差异程序对，分离数据效应与提取方式效应。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型或基准；实验维度包括提取方法变化和故障控制程序对构造。
summary.authors_note: Sarah Nadi 为阿尔伯塔大学副教授，研究方向为软件工程与代码分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Is the internal hidden-state signal of code correctness a robust property of LLMs, or merely an artifact of the specific extraction method used in prior work?
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis — first systematic robustness study of internal code correctness signals, relevant to understanding LLM internal representations and probe methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: Systematically varies signal extraction dimensions (layers, pooling, projection directions) and constructs minimal-difference program pairs differing only in the fault location to isolate data effects from extraction-method effects.
summary_en.experiments: No specific models or benchmarks in abstract; experiments cover extraction-method variation and fault-controlled program pair construction.
summary_en.authors_note: Sarah Nadi is an associate professor at University of Alberta, working on software engineering and code analysis.

recommendation.zh: 内部正确性信号的鲁棒性问题值得问，但结论偏向提取方式敏感，对 pretrain 直接启示有限；看提取方式变化的实验即可。
recommendation.en: The robustness question is fair, but findings lean toward extraction-method sensitivity with limited pretraining takeaways; read the extraction-variation experiments only.

paper.title: Can Graph Learning Learn Circuits?
paper.abstract: Circuit localization is a mechanistic interpretability task whose goal is to identify a sparse subgraph of a transformer's computation graph sufficient to reproduce a particular behavior. Most established methods localize circuits independently for each model--task pair. We instead frame circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem in which the edges of a computation graph represent computational pathways, and graph neural networks (GNNs) model interactions among these pathways. We i

summary.core_problem: 传统Transformer电路定位方法需为每个模型-任务对独立求解，效率低且无法泛化到未见过的模型或任务案例。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将电路定位建模为图机器学习问题，提出amortized式的Graph Circuit Learning框架，可跨模型-任务对训练后直接泛化到新案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Graph Circuit Learning (GCL)，将Transformer计算图的边视为计算通路，用图神经网络建模通路间交互；在InterpBench基准上扩充TracrBench衍生案例以构建训练数据，采用监督学习实现跨案例泛化。
summary.experiments: 14种GCL配置中最优方案在16个留出InterpBench测试案例上边缘AUROC中位数达0.902，四分位区间[0.861, 0.942]，接近已发表的InterpBench基线水平。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional transformer circuit localization methods require independent solving for each model-task pair, which is inefficient and cannot generalize to unseen cases.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first frames circuit localization as a graph machine learning problem and proposes the amortized Graph Circuit Learning framework that generalizes across model-task pairs after training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Graph Circuit Learning (GCL), which treats edges of a transformer computation graph as computational pathways and models interactions between pathways using graph neural networks; augments InterpBench with TracrBench-derived cases for training data, using supervised learning for cross-case generalization.
summary_en.experiments: Among 14 GCL configurations, the best achieves a median edge AUROC of 0.902 (IQR [0.861, 0.942]) on 16 held-out InterpBench cases, close to published InterpBench baselines.

recommendation.zh: 用GNN做amortized电路定位思路新颖，但实验规模有限，属于可解释性方向增量工作，看摘要和结果表即可。
recommendation.en: Novel amortized circuit localization via GNNs, but limited experimental scale; incremental interpretability work, check abstract and results table only.

paper.title: Why Knowing Both Hops Is Not Enough: Understanding Two-Hop Generalization in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve complex multi-hop problems yet exhibit puzzling failures on simple two-hop queries: although a model may correctly store each individual hop, it often fails to combine them. To understand the internal mechanisms of this phenomenon, we train transformers from scratch in a controlled symbolic environment. Our experiments reveal a pattern in two-hop generalization: models generalize reliably when the second hop follows the training distribution, but always fai

summary.core_problem: 解释语言模型为什么明明分别记住了两跳知识，却仍然在简单 two-hop 组合查询上失败。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不是新模型。价值在于它把 two-hop generalization 失败拆成可定位的层间表征错配问题，而不是笼统归因于“模型不会组合推理”。这对理解预训练后知识组合、ICL 失败模式和中间表征对齐都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在受控符号环境中从头训练 transformer，构造可精确控制分布内/分布外 second hop 的 two-hop 任务。随后做 mechanistic analysis，比较不同层对实体中间表示的一致性。结论是：当第二跳仍在训练分布内时，模型会在不同上下文中为同一实体形成一致的中间表示，因此能完成组合；当第二跳 OOD 时，下层仍能构造正确中间表示，但上层读取和映射这些表示的方式依赖训练分布，导致最终失败。
summary.experiments: 实验是小规模、可控的从零训练 transformer，而非大模型 benchmark。核心对比是 second hop in-distribution 与 out-of-distribution 两种设置下的泛化差异，并通过层级表征分析给出完整解释。摘要未给出具体参数量和数据规模，但从定位上看，重点是 clean setup 而非规模。对预训练研究员来说，价值主要在机制结论，而不是结果数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why language models often fail on simple two-hop composition even when each individual hop is correctly stored.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a new model. Its value is that it localizes the failure to a layerwise representation mismatch, instead of vaguely saying the model cannot compose knowledge. That matters for understanding knowledge composition after pretraining, in-context failures, and representation alignment across layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train transformers from scratch in a controlled symbolic environment where they can precisely vary whether the second hop is in- or out-of-distribution. They then perform mechanistic analysis of entity representations across layers. The main finding is that successful generalization arises when the same entity gets a consistent intermediate representation across contexts; when the second hop is OOD, lower layers still build the right intermediate state, but upper layers decode it using distribution-specific mappings learned during training, causing failure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use small, controlled transformers rather than frontier LMs. The key comparison is between in-distribution and OOD second-hop settings, followed by layerwise representation analysis to explain the gap. The abstract does not provide model sizes or dataset counts, which suggests the contribution is in the cleanliness of the setup and the mechanism, not in scaling results. For pretraining researchers, the mechanism is the main takeaway.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是在讲“模型不会推理”，而是在讲 upper layers 怎么把已形成的中间实体表征读坏；若你做知识组合或 latent reasoning，建议先看机制图和层分析，再决定是否复现实验。
recommendation.en: This is not another 'LLMs cannot reason' paper; it argues upper layers misread already-formed intermediate entity states. If you work on knowledge composition or latent reasoning, read the layer analysis first.

paper.title: Finding Usable Weight Mechanisms with Tiled SVD
paper.abstract: The dominant approach to mechanistic interpretability trains proxy dictionaries such as sparse autoencoders and labels features from max-activating text. The best such atlases identify con- cepts, but that identity lives in the learned dictionary rather than in the network weights them- selves. We propose extracting mechanism mounts directly from linear sites by column-tiled SVD: each mount is a triple (v,u,{\sigma}) read as trigger, write, and strength. Identity is the weight rule. We evaluate

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章关心的是 mechanistic interpretability 里的一个老问题：我们到底是在解释模型内部真正起作用的权重机制，还是只是在解释一个外部训练出来的代理字典。稀疏自编码器这类方法能给激活方向贴标签，但“哪个权重规则把这个方向写进 residual stream”往往是隐含的。作者试图直接从模型已有线性权重矩阵里抽取可用的 mechanism unit，而不是再训练一个代理表示。更具体地说，他们想回答：把一个线性映射按列分块后做局部 SVD，得到的奇异模式，是否比整矩阵 SVD 或简单列采样更接近模型在真实分布上使用的写入机制。
summary.importance: 和预训练研究的直接关系较弱，更偏机制分析工具。但它有两个可能的间接启发。第一，它强调“解释对象应尽量贴近真实权重路径”，这对分析预训练后模型内部表征、残差写入、MLP/attention 子路径的功能分解是有帮助的。第二，它提出了一套偏工程化的可用性判据，不只看某个方向是否可解释，而是看它是否在真实前向中承载写入能量、是否覆盖权重、是否能通过残差注入影响最终 logits。对做训练动态和内部机制分析的人，这种评价口径比只看可视化或 token cluster 更扎实一些。不过它不是基础模型训练方法，也没有展示对模型能力或训练效率的反馈，因此只能算边缘相关。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出的是 column-tiled SVD。给定某个线性层权重 W，不直接对整个 W 做一次全局 SVD，而是把输入列按 tile 切块，对每个 tile 单独做低秩分解，从中抽取若干 mode。每个 mode 被定义为一个 mount=(v,u,σ)：v 是 trigger 方向，u 是 write 方向，σ 是强度。作者强调 mount 的身份就是权重规则本身，而不是后验命名的概念标签。

方法的关键不在分解本身，而在评价标准。文章明确反对用 tile-local lift 这类指标，因为单列 tile 会天然占优，无法公平比较不同 chunking。于是他们设计了三类检查。A 类看 full-write energy lift：在真实前向输入 x 上，用 mount 诱导的写入方向去解释整个站点的写入张量 Δh，而不是只解释 tile 内局部输出。B 类看 coverage 和 saturation：包括权重 Frobenius 能量覆盖、稀疏写入覆盖、相对随机字典的 coverage lift，以及随着每 tile mode 数增加是否很快饱和。C 类只用于 residual write 站点，检查这些 write 方向是否能通过 post-norm 残差注入，在最终 unembedding 几何上产生可检测的 logit 变化；指标是 Spearman ρ 和 top-20 Jaccard。

另一个重要细节是 effective-path mounts。作者发现对 mlp.up 和 attn.v，直接拿原始模块权重做 residual-shaped 评价会失败，因为模型在真实分布上使用的并不是裸矩阵。于是对 mlp.up 用平均 gate 激活构造 W*=diag(ḡ)W_up，对 attn.v 用 ridge least squares 拟合到 mixed-v，必要时再用与 o_proj 组合的近似路径。也就是说，这篇文章的一个核心主张是：若解释对象选错了路径，再好的分解也会显得“不工作”；要先贴近 on-distribution 的有效计算图，再谈机制抽取。
summary.experiments:
实验模型是 Gemma-2-2B，共 26 层，每层考察 7 个线性映射，总计 182 个 site-layer。数据来自 WikiText-2 raw train，先收集 86,109 个 token，再固定随机种子下抽样 16,384 个 token 做分析。默认 tile 宽度按站点区分：残差写入和 MLP 映射 T=512，attn.k/attn.v 为 256，attn.q 为 128，困难层可退到 64。A/C 实验默认每 tile 取 k=2 个 mode，B 实验扫 k∈{1,2,4,8,16}。

主结果是：在采用 site-aware tile size 和 effective-path 处理后，7 个站点 × 26 层全部通过预设判据，即 182/182 通过；其中 residual write 站点需要同时通过 A/B/C，共 52/52，其他站点通过 A/B，共 130/130。对两个 residual-write 站点，tile SVD 在几乎所有深度上都优于 whole-matrix SVD、列采样和随机基线，只有 mlp.down 第 25 层出现 tile≈whole，但按作者的 A4 ratio 规则仍算通过。文章还指出，column sampling 在 tile-local 指标下会出现约 0.999 的虚高结果，因此被排除出主判据。

覆盖实验显示，在 residual write 站点上，mode 数 m=1 或 2 时 coverage lift 已经很高，之后基本变平，说明额外 mode 主要带来冗余而不是新的有效机制。对 residual write 的 steering 检查，作者采用在 post-attention 或 post-FF 的 RMSNorm 后注入 αu，α=2，最多在 8 段文本上平均最后一个 token 的 logit 变化，并与 unembed lens 预测比较。通过阈值设为 ρ≥0.05 或 J20≥0.05，且只对第 6 层及以后强制要求。整体结论是，局部列结构比全局单次 SVD 更能恢复真实分布上的高能写入方向。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，理解作者在批评什么：不是说 SAE 没用，而是说 SAE 解释的是 proxy space，不一定是权重机制本身。然后直接看 Method 里 mount 的定义、A/B/C 三类判据，以及 mlp.up、attn.v 的 effective-path 处理。这几处决定了文章是否成立。

实验部分建议重点看三个点。第一，残差写入站点上 tile SVD 与 whole SVD、column sampling 的比较，这是方法是否有必要的直接证据。第二，coverage saturation 曲线，作者借此论证每 tile 少量 mode 就够，更多 mode 多半是冗余。第三，steer check 的设计细节：为什么要在 post-norm 残差位置注入，而不是直接改 o_proj/down_proj 输出，因为作者想测的是“这个方向写进 residual stream 后是否沿最终 logit 几何起作用”。

如果只想判断这篇文章值不值得深读，40 分钟足够。若要复现或借鉴其分析框架，需要更仔细看判据定义和 effective-path fallback 细节。值得保留一点审慎：全文主要在单模型 Gemma-2-2B、单语料子样本上验证，阈值和通过标准也带有较强方法学设定，泛化到更大模型或不同架构还需要额外证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a recurring issue in mechanistic interpretability: are we explaining the model’s actual weight-level mechanisms, or only a proxy dictionary learned on activations? Sparse autoencoders and related methods can produce useful feature atlases, but they do not directly identify the weight rule that writes into the residual stream. The authors propose extracting mechanism units directly from existing linear maps. The concrete question is whether column-wise tiled SVD yields more usable on-distribution mechanisms than whole-matrix SVD or simple column sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is only loosely connected to pretraining, but it is relevant to internal analysis of pretrained models. The useful part is methodological: it pushes interpretation closer to the real computation path instead of a separately trained codebook, and it evaluates candidate mechanisms by whether they carry write energy on real forwards and whether they causally align with downstream logits. For researchers studying training dynamics, residual-stream writing, or functional decomposition of MLP/attention paths, that evaluation stance is more grounded than relying only on token clusters or verbal labels. Still, it is not a training recipe paper and does not feed back into model quality or efficiency directly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main proposal is column-tiled SVD. Instead of applying one global SVD to a linear map W, the input columns are partitioned into tiles and each tile is factorized separately. Each extracted mode is a mount (v, u, sigma), interpreted as trigger, write, and strength. The identity of a mechanism is the weight rule itself, not a post hoc semantic label.

The more interesting contribution is the evaluation stack. The paper argues that tile-local lift is a misleading metric because one-column tiles win almost by construction. So the authors evaluate mounts using full-write energy lift on real forwards: can the extracted directions explain the site’s actual write tensor, not just local tile output? They also measure weight coverage, sparse write coverage, and coverage lift over random dictionaries, plus a saturation criterion that checks whether a small number of modes already captures most of the useful signal. For residual-write sites only, they add a causal check: inject the write direction after the post-sublayer RMSNorm so it lands in the residual stream, then compare the resulting logit changes against an unembedding-based prediction using Spearman correlation and top-20 Jaccard.

A key practical point is the use of effective-path mounts. Raw mlp.up and attn.v weights fail the residual-shaped evaluation because the on-distribution computation is not the raw matrix alone. For mlp.up, the paper uses a gate-averaged effective map W* = diag(g_bar) W_up. For attn.v, it fits a ridge least-squares map to mixed-v, with a fallback involving W_o. This is an important methodological claim: if the interpreted object does not match the effective computation path, even a good decomposition will look unusable.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Gemma-2-2B with 26 layers and seven linear maps per layer, for 182 site-layers in total. The corpus is built from WikiText-2 raw train: 86,109 tokens are collected and 16,384 are subsampled for analysis. Default tile widths are site-specific: 512 for residual and MLP maps, 256 for attn.k and attn.v, and 128 for attn.q, with a 64 fallback on hard layers. Experiments A and C use k=2 modes per tile, while experiment B sweeps k in {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}.

The headline result is that, with site-aware tiling and effective-path handling, all 182 site-layers pass the paper’s acceptance criteria: 52/52 for residual-write sites under A/B/C and 130/130 for the other sites under A/B. On the two residual-write sites, tiled SVD beats whole-matrix SVD, column sampling, and random baselines at nearly every depth, except mlp.down layer 25 where tiled and whole SVD are roughly tied but still pass under the ratio criterion. The paper also notes that column sampling can achieve tile-local lift around 0.999, which is precisely why local lift is excluded from the main judgment.
