The coverage experiments show early saturation: on residual-write sites, coverage lift is already high at one or two modes per tile and then stays flat, suggesting that extra modes mostly add redundancy. For the steering check, the authors inject alpha*u with alpha=2 after the post-attention or post-FF RMSNorm, average last-token logit changes over up to eight texts, and compare them to the unembed-lens prediction. Passing requires either Spearman rho >= 0.05 or Jaccard@20 >= 0.05 for layers 6 and above. The overall empirical claim is that local column structure captures high-energy on-distribution write directions better than a single global SVD.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction first to understand the target of the critique: the paper is not dismissing SAE-style feature dictionaries, but arguing that they live in proxy space rather than weight space. Then go straight to the method section and focus on three things: the definition of a mount, the A/B/C evaluation criteria, and the effective-path treatment for mlp.up and attn.v. Those pieces determine whether the proposal is meaningful.

In the experiments, the most important comparison is tiled SVD versus whole-matrix SVD and column sampling on residual-write sites. Then look at the saturation results, because they support the claim that only a small number of modes per tile is needed. Finally, inspect the steering setup carefully: the injection happens after post-norm residual entry, not by directly perturbing o_proj or down_proj outputs, because the paper wants to test whether the direction functions as a residual write that matters for final logits.

A quick pass takes about 40 minutes. A deeper read is only worthwhile if you care about mechanistic analysis methodology or want to reuse the evaluation stack. One caveat is that the evidence is concentrated on a single model, Gemma-2-2B, and a small WikiText-2 subsample, with fairly hand-designed thresholds and acceptance rules. Generalization to larger models or other architectures remains open.

recommendation.zh: 方法有 taste，但 16k token 和 182/182 GO 太整齐；先看评价协议，别先信机制语义。
recommendation.en: The idea has taste, but 16k tokens and 182/182 GO are too neat; read the evaluation protocol before trusting the semantics.

paper.title: MI-MIDI: Mechanistic Interpretability of Text-to-MIDI Generation Models via Probing, Lenses and Steering
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability of music generation has concentrated on audio models, leaving symbolic models largely unexplored. We analyze two public text-to-MIDI systems of contrasting design: the purpose-built encoder--decoder text2midi and MIDI-LLM, a Llama~3.2~1B model extended with MIDI tokens using linear probing, the logit and tuned lenses, activation patching and difference-in-means steering. Across these methods, we recover musically meaningful structure and show how architecture shapes

summary.core_problem: 现有音乐生成的机制可解释性研究集中在音频模型，符号音乐（MIDI）生成模型的内部工作机制尚未得到系统探索。
summary.importance: 方法迁移+原理分析，将LLM领域成熟的机制解释方法应用到文本到MIDI生成任务，对比了两种不同架构模型的表征形成差异。
summary.technical_approach: 使用线性探测、logit透镜、调谐透镜、激活补丁和均值差引导方法，分析encoder-decoder架构的text2midi和基于Llama 3.2 1B扩展MIDI token的MIDI-LLM两个系统。
summary.experiments: 发现音高、乐器、和声、织体在两个模型中均可线性解码；text2midi逐层细化预测，MIDI-LLM前期主要在继承的文本表征空间中工作，后期才急剧旋转到音乐词汇表；引导可双向改变音域、复调等属性。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mechanistic interpretability research on music generation focuses on audio models, leaving the internal working mechanisms of symbolic music (MIDI) generation models largely unexplored.
summary_en.importance: Method transfer + principle analysis; applies mature mechanistic interpretability methods from LLMs to text-to-MIDI generation, comparing representation formation differences between two architecturally distinct models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses linear probing, logit lens, tuned lens, activation patching, and difference-in-means steering to analyze two systems: the encoder-decoder text2midi and MIDI-LLM, a Llama 3.2 1B model extended with MIDI tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that pitch, instrumentation, harmony, and texture are linearly decodable in both models; text2midi refines predictions gradually across layers, while MIDI-LLM operates largely in its inherited textual representation space before a sharp late rotation into the musical vocabulary; steering produces bidirectional changes in register, polyphony, and other attributes.

recommendation.zh: 将标准LLM可解释性方法迁移到音乐MIDI生成模型，结论符合预期，对跨模态机制解释研究有微弱参考价值。
recommendation.en: Applies standard LLM interpretability methods to music MIDI generation models; conclusions are as expected, with marginal reference value for cross-modal mechanistic interpretability research.

paper.title: Safe Evolution with Circuit Anchors
paper.abstract: In biological evolution, unconstrained mutation can lead to catastrophic outcomes: organisms may evolve enhanced capabilities while losing essential functions for survival. Nature's solution is \textit{developmental constraints}, where core regulatory genes remain anchored while peripheral genes adapt freely. We observe that current self-evolution algorithms for large language models lack analogous constraints. They optimize purely for capability, implicitly assuming safety will be preserved. Ou

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 自进化或自我改写过程中只追求能力提升、却可能破坏安全行为的问题。
summary.importance: 价值主要在两个接口：一是 mechanistic interpretability 是否能找到可因果干预的“安全电路”，二是这些局部特征能否作为后训练/自进化的约束。对预训练研究员不是主线，但对理解能力-安全耦合、以及 feature-level regularization 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Circuit-Anchored Evolution（CAE）。作者先用机制可解释性识别一个占模型特征不到 2% 的 safety circuit，声称其因果介导安全行为；随后在 self-evolution 过程中对该电路施加锚定约束，让外围能力相关特征继续适配，而核心安全特征保持稳定，以避免 capability gain 伴随 safety collapse。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调一个关键现象：现有 self-evolution 算法会让模型“misevolve”为更强但更危险的系统；CAE 在保持能力增长的同时维持安全行为。摘要未给出模型规模、任务集、具体安全指标和对照算法，因此当前更像概念验证，需看正文确认电路识别是否稳健、因果证据是否充分。
summary.authors_note: 香港中文大学与 IQuest Research。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the problem that LLM self-evolution can optimize for capability while silently degrading safety behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at two interfaces: whether mechanistic interpretability can identify causally actionable 'safety circuits', and whether such local features can serve as constraints during model evolution. This is not core pretraining work, but it is relevant to capability-safety coupling and feature-level regularization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Circuit-Anchored Evolution (CAE). It first uses mechanistic interpretability to identify a safety circuit, claimed to be less than 2% of model features and causally responsible for safety behavior. During self-evolution, this circuit is anchored while other features remain adaptable, aiming to preserve safety while allowing capability gains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights a central empirical claim: existing self-evolution methods can produce models that are more capable yet more dangerous, whereas CAE preserves safety while improving capability. The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, safety metrics, or baseline details, so this currently reads as a proof-of-concept pending closer inspection of the causal evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: From the Chinese University of Hong Kong and IQuest Research.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 feature-level 约束能否替代部分对齐数据，这篇可看；但“<2% 特征就是安全电路”这个说法很重，先审因果干预实验再决定信不信。
recommendation.en: Read it if you care whether feature-level constraints can substitute for some alignment data, but the '<2% features define safety' claim is strong—check the causal intervention section before buying it.

paper.title: CircuitSteer: Geometrically Aligned Multi-Layer Steering via Sparse Autoencoder Circuits
paper.abstract: Controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) remains a critical challenge for AI alignment. Existing steering methods, such as Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), typically rely on fixed single-layer interventions derived from aggregate activation differences. These methods impose a single intervention across semantically diverse inputs and often fail to sustain consistent behavioral changes across layers, limiting the effectiveness of the steering. In this work, we introduce Circ

summary.core_problem: 改进 LLM 行为 steering，使干预不再依赖单层、固定、输入无关的 activation vector。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制解释和对齐控制方法；它把 Sparse Autoencoder 特征用于多层语义 circuit 识别，再把稀疏特征合成为 dense steering vectors。对 pretrain 的直接帮助不大，但对理解表示可控性和 SAE 特征组织有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CircuitSteer。方法先用 SAE 抽取稀疏特征，再基于特征共激活和 decoder direction 的几何对齐构建 feature flow circuit，定位与目标行为相关的多层子电路；随后从这些稀疏特征合成密集 steering 向量，并在多个层位置施加干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 数字或提升幅度。主要对比对象是 Contrastive Activation Addition 这类单层 steering 方法，并声称多层 circuit 干预能更稳定地改变目标行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLM behavior steering more reliable than fixed, single-layer, input-agnostic activation interventions.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an interpretability-driven alignment control method. Sparse Autoencoder features are used to identify distributed semantic circuits and synthesize dense steering vectors. The direct pretraining value is limited, but it is relevant to representation controllability and SAE-based model analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: CircuitSteer first extracts sparse features with SAEs, then builds a feature-flow circuit using feature co-activation and geometric alignment of decoder directions. It isolates multi-layer subcircuits associated with a target behavior, synthesizes dense steering vectors from those sparse features, and applies interventions at multiple layers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, numerical gains, or full baselines. The main comparison is against single-layer steering methods such as Contrastive Activation Addition, with the claim that multi-layer circuit interventions yield more consistent behavioral control.

recommendation.zh: SAE steering 又一篇；若正文没有跨模型稳健性，只把 circuit 构造当候选工具。
recommendation.en: Another SAE-steering paper; unless the full text shows cross-model robustness, treat the circuit construction as a candidate tool only.

paper.title: Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction
paper.abstract: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight

summary.core_problem: 稠密预训练Transformer的线性投影为稠密结构，神经元存在多义性，任务相关效应分布在大量参数中，没有天然可解释的单元可用于电路提取。现有方法要么训练辅助稀疏表示（如稀疏自编码器、Transcoder），要么从头训练稀疏模型，计算开销高，还可能与原始稠密模型的行为存在保真度差距。目前尚无法直接从已有的稠密预训练checkpoint中获得可用的电路提取单元，且无需训练额外表示。
summary.importance: 稀疏权重分解（SWD）提供了一种低成本的预训练模型可解释性分析路径，无需重新训练稀疏模型或辅助网络，即可将稠密权重转化为可用于电路分析的稀疏瓶颈单元。该方法为研究预训练模型内部机制、验证稀疏连接的作用提供了实用工具，也为模型压缩与可解释性研究的结合提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: SWD将预训练稠密线性投影的权重矩阵W近似分解为两个稀疏矩阵A和B的乘积（W≈AB）。每个中间坐标对应一个瓶颈单元：通过A的对应列读取输入，通过B的对应行写出输出，形成一条秩为1的稀疏路径。每个单元的标量激活可独立打分、选择、消融，直接复用现有针对稀疏特征的电路提取工作流。SWD可使用少量校准数据提升分解精度，也支持零数据变体——仅依赖权重本身，无需校准激活。分解后可通过固定支撑集微调恢复模型保真度。
summary.experiments: 在GPT-2 Small和3个不同尺寸的Qwen2.5模型上替换单个MLP权重矩阵，SWD在匹配预剪枝交叉熵损失（即替换保真度相当）的条件下，所需数据量不到Transcoder、VPD等基线的1%；且在相同保真度下，达到相同的电路充分性/必要性阈值所需的活跃读写边数更少。该方法可扩展至Qwen3.5-27B的单矩阵替换。在GPT-2 Small上同时替换12个Transformer块的全部48个注意力和MLP权重矩阵，经固定支撑集微调后仍保持有效。零数据变体也能生成有用的瓶颈单元。精确满秩稠密分解的对照实验表明，低电路成本并非来自分解本身，而是来自稀疏的读写连接。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点看第2节的稀疏分解核心设计与瓶颈单元定义，以及第3节的核心实验结果，包括与基线的对比、可扩展性测试。分解的具体优化实现细节可跳过。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense pretrained Transformers use dense linear projections with polysemantic neurons and distributed task-relevant effects, so they do not expose naturally interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing methods either train auxiliary sparse representations (e.g., sparse autoencoders, Transcoders) or train sparse models from scratch, which incur high compute overhead and may introduce a fidelity gap relative to the original dense model. There is currently no way to obtain usable circuit extraction units directly from an existing dense pretrained checkpoint without training additional representations.
summary_en.importance: Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD) provides a low-cost path for interpretability analysis of pretrained models. It converts dense weights into sparse bottleneck units usable for circuit analysis, without retraining sparse models or auxiliary networks. The method offers a practical tool for studying internal mechanisms of pretrained models and validating the role of sparse connectivity, while also bridging model compression and interpretability research.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWD approximates the weight matrix W of a pretrained dense linear projection as the product of two sparse matrices A and B (W ≈ AB). Each intermediate coordinate corresponds to a bottleneck unit: it reads input via the corresponding column of A and writes output via the corresponding row of B, forming a rank-1 sparse path. The scalar activation of each unit can be independently scored, selected, and ablated, directly reusing the circuit extraction workflow designed for learned sparse features. SWD can use a small amount of calibration data to improve decomposition accuracy, or run in a zero-data variant that relies solely on weight matrices without calibration activations. Fixed-support fine-tuning can be applied after decomposition to recover model fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: For single MLP matrix replacement in GPT-2 Small and three Qwen2.5 models of different sizes, SWD achieves matched pre-pruning cross-entropy loss (i.e., comparable replacement fidelity) with less than 1% of the data required by baselines such as Transcoder and VPD. At matched fidelity, SWD requires fewer active read/write edges to reach the same circuit sufficiency and necessity thresholds. The method scales to single-matrix replacement on Qwen3.5-27B. When all 48 attention and MLP weight matrices across the 12 transformer blocks of GPT-2 Small are replaced simultaneously, SWD remains effective after fixed-support fine-tuning. The zero-data variant also produces useful bottleneck units. Control experiments with exact full-rank dense factorization confirm that low circuit cost comes from sparse read/write connectivity, not factorization alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for the core design of sparse decomposition and the definition of bottleneck units, and Section 3 for key experimental results, including baseline comparisons and scalability tests. Detailed optimization implementation details for the decomposition can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 fidelity 对比即可；它不改变训练 recipe，但给 circuit 分析减少了一层替代模型噪声。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and fidelity tables; it does not change pretraining, but removes one layer of surrogate-model noise from circuit analysis.

paper.title: Cross-Layer Interaction under Weight-Space Ablation: A Closed-Form Attention Jacobian Bound and a Test on a Real Pretrained Model
paper.abstract: A companion paper studies when activation patching and weight-space ablation agree, inside an idealized model where a conditional computation is carried additively through a residual stream. For the one composition in that model where two carriers are architecturally dependent, an attention head and its own layer's normalization-MLP composition, it derives an exact first-order interaction formula, zero when only the MLP is ablated and second-order bounded when the head is also ablated. That resu

summary.core_problem: 研究 activation patching 与 weight-space ablation 在跨层干预时何时一致，以及 attention head 与同层 normalization-MLP 组合之间的交互项如何被界定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和理论边界。它把一个只在单 residual block、小模型、合成任务中验证的结果，扩展到跨层 carrier ablation，并尝试在真实预训练模型上检验权重空间干预的可解释性假设。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将跨多层 carrier 的 ablation 交互分解为同层项与跨层 remainder；对两层情形，把 remainder 精确写成 mixed second derivative 的二重积分，并给出 closed-form attention Jacobian bound，用来判断 activation-side 与 weight-side 干预差异来自哪里。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明从小 transformer 合成任务扩展到真实预训练模型测试，未给出模型名称、参数量、数据或定量结果。实验重点应是验证跨层 remainder 是否可忽略，以及理论 bound 对真实模型干预误差的解释力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when activation patching and weight-space ablation agree under cross-layer interventions, especially when an attention head interacts with its own layer's normalization-MLP composition.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It extends a single-block, synthetic-task result to multi-layer carrier ablations and tests the assumptions on a real pretrained model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes multi-layer ablation interactions into same-block terms plus a cross-layer remainder. For the two-layer case, the remainder is isolated as a double integral of a mixed second derivative, and a closed-form attention Jacobian bound is derived to locate the source of mismatch between activation-side and weight-side interventions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the result is tested on a real pretrained model, but does not specify model size, dataset, baselines, or quantitative numbers. The relevant experiment is whether the cross-layer remainder is small enough for the theoretical decomposition to be useful in practice.

recommendation.zh: 可作 mechanistic ablation 的边界条件备查；只看定理分解和真实模型测试，别把 small-remainder 当默认事实。
recommendation.en: Useful as a boundary-condition note for mechanistic ablations; read the decomposition and real-model test, but do not assume the cross-layer remainder is small.

paper.title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
paper.abstract: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, a

summary.core_problem: 研究 Qwen3-32B 内部是否存在可线性读出的时间偏好方向，并用 activation addition 改变模型在短期收益与长期收益之间的选择。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和表示干预。它把“时间视野”这种偏好变量定位到 residual stream 的线性方向，并展示该方向可用于双向 steering；对 alignment、activation engineering 和偏好表征有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 teacher-forced 的 temporal-choice 答案上训练对比线性 probe，得到 short-term versus long-term 的 residual-stream direction；随后用 contrastive activation addition 在推理时注入正向或反向向量，测试偏好、推荐和规划能力变化。这是对既有 activation steering 思路的特定偏好维度应用。
summary.experiments: 实验模型为 Qwen3-32B。评估包括 held-out binary temporal-choice、OOD monetary intertemporal-choice，以及 TravelPlanner capability benchmark。摘要称 steering 能显著双向移动 monetary choice 中 smaller-sooner 与 larger-later 的 indifference threshold，并在规划相关 benchmark 上带来改善；未在摘要中给出具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether Qwen3-32B contains a linearly accessible representation of temporal horizon and whether that direction can steer short-term versus long-term preferences.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and representation-intervention contribution. It is relevant to activation steering and preference representations, though it does not directly change pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to identify a short-term-to-long-term direction in the residual stream. They then apply contrastive activation addition at inference time to steer model behavior in either direction.
summary_en.experiments: The main model is Qwen3-32B. Evaluation covers a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task with reward size and delay variation, and the TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The abstract reports large bidirectional shifts in indifference thresholds and some planning-related improvements, without detailed numbers.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和实验设置就够；它支持“偏好可线性 steering”的 prior，但目前更像单模型探针证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and setup only; it supports the linear-steerability prior for preferences, but remains mostly single-model probe evidence.

paper.title: No Single Neuron of Failure: Distributed Safety Alignment Against White-Box Attacks
paper.abstract: With the rapid release of open-weight large foundation models, safety threats are shifting from black-box jailbreaks to neuron-level white-box attacks that directly identify and manipulate safety-related neurons. Existing alignment methods often investigate the safety behavior on a small number of neurons, creating fragile single point of failure with limited redundancy. To address this issue, we propose distributed safety alignment (DSA), which redundantly encodes safety capabilities across mul

summary.core_problem: 现有神经元级安全对齐方法将安全能力集中在少量固定神经元或通路上，面对白盒攻击（精准定位并剪除关键安全神经元）时存在单点失效问题，鲁棒性不足。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发包括：一是安全对齐可从架构层面的表征分布入手，而非仅依赖数据或损失函数调整；二是通过动态扰动迫使能力分布式编码的思路，可迁移到通用预训练的能力鲁棒性研究，避免核心能力集中在少数神经元导致的微调遗忘或攻击脆弱性；三是基于方向感知泰勒分数的FFN神经元归因方法，对预训练模型的机制分析、能力定位有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分布式安全对齐（DSA）框架，核心是通过冗余编码消除安全能力的单点依赖。具体实现：1）干预位置选在语言侧前馈网络（FFN）的下投影层输入处，将每个特征坐标视为单个神经元；2）用方向感知的一阶泰勒分数，结合拒绝目标的损失梯度与神经元激活状态，精准定位对安全拒绝行为贡献最大的神经元；3）对抗冗余对齐训练阶段，对得分最高的关键神经元做确定性掩码（模拟定向白盒攻击），对其余神经元施加随机dropout（防止安全能力重新集中到新的小子集），迫使模型在更多补偿性神经元上冗余编码拒绝行为；4）在有害拒绝数据与良性效用数据上联合优化，保证通用能力不下降，推理时无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段未包含完整实验章节，仅提及在多种大基座模型上验证，可显著提升对白盒安全抑制攻击的鲁棒性，同时保留模型原生通用能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法章节中的神经元归因方法（方向感知一阶泰勒分数）和动态扰动训练策略，以及引言部分对现有神经元级防御缺陷的分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neuron-level safety alignment methods concentrate safety capabilities on a small set of fixed neurons or pathways, creating a single point of failure under white-box attacks that precisely locate and ablate critical safety neurons, leading to insufficient robustness.
summary_en.importance: The work provides three insights for pretraining research: first, safety alignment can be approached from the perspective of representation distribution at the architectural level, rather than relying solely on data or loss function adjustments; second, the idea of forcing distributed capability encoding via dynamic perturbation can be transferred to robustness research in general pretraining, to avoid fine-tuning forgetting or attack vulnerability caused by concentration of core capabilities in a few neurons; third, the direction-aware Taylor score-based FFN neuron attribution method is useful for mechanism analysis and capability localization of pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Distributed Safety Alignment (DSA) is a framework that eliminates single-point dependency of safety capabilities via redundant encoding. It intervenes at the input of down-projection layers in language-side feed-forward networks (FFNs), treating each feature coordinate as an individual neuron. It uses direction-aware first-order Taylor scores, computed from refusal loss gradients and neuron activation states, to precisely locate neurons that contribute most to safety refusal behavior. During adversarial redundant alignment training, it applies deterministic masking to the highest-scoring critical neurons (simulating targeted white-box attacks) and stochastic dropout to the remaining neurons (preventing safety capabilities from re-concentrating on a new minimal subset), forcing the model to redundantly encode refusal behavior across a broader set of compensatory neurons. Joint optimization on harmful refusal data and benign utility data preserves general capabilities, with no inference-time overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text fragment does not include the complete experimental section. The work is reported to be validated on multiple large foundation models, significantly improving robustness against white-box safety suppression attacks while preserving native general capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the neuron attribution method (direction-aware first-order Taylor score) and dynamic perturbation training strategy in the method section, as well as the analysis of limitations of existing neuron-level defenses in the introduction. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 从神经元机制层面探讨安全对齐的鲁棒性，提出的分布式对齐思路对理解模型内部表示和改进 post-train 策略有参考价值，建议略读其机制分析部分。
recommendation.en: Explores the robustness of safety alignment from the perspective of neuron mechanisms. The proposed distributed alignment idea is valuable for understanding internal model representations and improving post-train strategies. Skim the mechanism analysis section.

paper.title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs
paper.abstract: Open-source LLMs reliably name Zeus, Jupiter, and Thor, but recover their counterparts in less-represented traditions like Finnish, Slavic, Egyptian, or Chinese mythology far less consistently. We ask where inside the model this cultural default is produced. On a parallel cross-cultural substrate of Thompson-motif entities, we instrument 18 open-source LLMs from 8 architecture families with linear probing, logit lens, activation patching, and output extraction. The residual stream cleanly distin

summary.core_problem: 开源大模型普遍存在文化偏见，对低资源文化相关实体的生成准确率远低于西方主流文化实体，但现有研究仅停留在行为层面观测，没有定位偏见发生在模型内部的具体环节，无法区分是内部表示缺失还是解码层坍缩导致的错误。
summary.importance: LLM机制可解释性方向的实证研究，明确了文化偏见的主要发生位置在unembedding读出头而非内部表示，同时观测到模型缩放不会完全消除该解码层gap、跨语言查询可实现零成本效果提升的结论，对预训练语料配比设计、去偏见方法开发、解码策略优化都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于汤普森民间故事母题索引，构建覆盖10个文化、27个平行母题、共270个跨文化实体的平行评测集，对18个覆盖8个架构族、参数量1.2B~34B的开源模型开展四类机制分析：残差流线性探针判断文化区分度、logit lens追踪正确token进入top-k的层位置、跨文化激活patch定位因果干预位点、双语prompt对比输出差异；将所有样本分为四类：表示正确+输出正确、表示正确+输出错误（解码抑制）、表示错误+输出正确（表面运气）、表示错误+输出错误（表示平坦），定量拆解错误来源。
summary.experiments: 18个被测模型中，“解码抑制”（残差流正确识别文化但输出错误）是占比最高的错误类别，说明文化偏见的核心问题在读出解码层而非内部知识表示；同模型族内参数缩放会缩小探针准确率和输出准确率的gap，但所有测试参数量档均未完全闭合该gap；同语言prompt下错误相关系数为0.57，跨语言prompt下仅0.29，说明unembedding存在强语言条件性；双语集成查询可在零训练成本下提升正确实体的回收率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看四类错误分解的分析框架、参数缩放的趋势结果、跨语言查询的相关结论，预计阅读时间20分钟；从事预训练bias缓解、解码优化相关工作的读者可重点关注4.4-4.6节的结果分析部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-source LLMs exhibit well-documented cultural bias, with far lower accuracy on entities from underrepresented cultures than dominant Western traditions, but prior work only observes this bias behaviorally without localizing its internal source—leaving ambiguity between representational flattening (missing knowledge in internal states) and decoding collapse (knowledge present but not mapped to correct output tokens).
summary_en.importance: An empirical mechanistic interpretability study that localizes cultural bias primarily at the unembedding readout layer rather than in internal representations, with additional observations that scaling does not fully close the probe-output gap and cross-lingual querying delivers zero-cost recovery gains. These findings inform pretraining data mixture design, debiasing method development, and decoding strategy optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs a parallel cross-cultural evaluation set of 270 entities covering 27 Thompson folk-motif roles across 10 cultures spanning 6 language families. Runs four mechanistic measurements on 18 open-source models from 8 architecture families (1.2B–34B parameters): linear probes on residual streams to measure culture discriminability, logit lens to track the layer where gold tokens enter top-k predictions, cross-cultural activation patching to localize causal intervention points, and output comparison across English and native-language prompts. Samples are partitioned into four categories: preserved (correct representation, correct output), decoding-suppressed (correct representation, wrong output), surface luck (wrong representation, correct output), representationally flat (wrong representation, wrong output) to quantitatively decompose error sources.
summary_en.experiments: Across all 18 tested models, decoding-suppressed samples form the largest error category, confirming the primary failure mode is readout collapse rather than missing internal representation. Within-family scaling reduces the gap between probe accuracy and output accuracy but never fully closes it at any tested parameter scale. Error correlation averages 0.57 for same-language prompts but only 0.29 across languages, indicating the unembedding is strongly language-conditioned. A bilingual query ensemble delivers measurable gains in correct entity recovery with no training cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper; focus on the four-way error decomposition framework, scaling trend results, and cross-lingual query findings. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Readers working on pretraining bias mitigation or decoding optimization can prioritize the result analysis in sections 4.4–4.6.

recommendation.zh: 读 probing 与 activation patching 结果；若结论成立，文化偏置不只靠补数据能修。
recommendation.en: Read the probing and activation-patching results; if robust, cultural bias is not fixed by data coverage alone.

paper.title: Feed-Forward Steering in Transformer Residual Dynamics
paper.abstract: Attention-only dynamical theories model Transformer residual directions as particles aggregating on a sphere. We extend this framework by incorporating the feed-forward network (FFN) term as a local steering field acting on each token state. The resulting theory predicts that the tangential component of the FFN field is necessary for motion in residual-direction space, that critical residual directions correspond to nonlinear projective equilibria, and that a commutator defect determines when a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 Transformer residual stream 的方向动力学：只把 attention 看成 token 间聚合不足以解释实际 block 更新，FFN 需要被建模为作用在每个 token 状态上的局部 steering field。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练的直接工程作用有限，但对机制分析和训练动态有一定参考价值。结论提醒我们，FFN 不只是参数量占比较高的逐点非线性模块，也会显著改变 residual direction 的运动轨迹。对于研究 rank collapse、表示聚集、FFN memory、层内并行近似的人，这篇值得泛读。它不提供新的预训练 recipe，也不直接改善 scaling 或数据效率。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 residual state 写成 x_i = r_i u_i，其中 u_i 是单位球面上的方向，r_i 是范数。由于归一化后的方向才决定很多层间表示行为，模型关注球面上的方向流。attention 被写成依赖其他 token 的非局部 aggregation field，FFN 被写成只依赖当前 token 状态的 local steering field。只有投影到切空间的分量会改变方向，径向分量主要改变范数和角速度。基于这个设定，作者定义了 tangential FFN field、critical residual direction、residual attractor、tangent stability、FFN spectral shift，以及 attention–FFN commutator。一个重要对象是 sequential-to-parallel defect，用来衡量真实的顺序 attention→FFN block 何时能被近似为并行 additive map。方法的价值在于把 FFN 纳入连续动力学框架，而不是继续使用 attention-only particle dynamics。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 GPT-2、Pythia、Mistral 和 Llama 系列 checkpoint。主要观察包括：只用 attention branch 预测 block 更新方向会产生明显 angular-alignment deficit，且该缺口随模型规模变化呈系统趋势；FFN 的切向分量对 residual direction 的实际运动是必要的，径向分量不能替代这种方向改变；在 aggregation pressure 下，FFN steering 有助于保持表示多样性；sequential-to-parallel defect 可以指导哪些 block 更适合做并行化近似。附录还包含 FFN gate calibration、prefix/Volterra sensitivity、局部谱几何、OV 非对称性和 editing locality 等诊断。提供内容没有列出具体数值，因此更适合把实验当作机制证据，而不是可直接迁移的工程结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Problem Setting，确认 x_i = r_i u_i、切向投影和 FFN steering field 的定义。Theory 部分重点看 critical residual direction、tangent stability 和 attention–FFN commutator；证明可以略读。实验部分优先看 attention-only angular-deficit diagnostic 和 tangential/radial FFN ablation，这两组最直接支持核心结论。若关注推理系统或训练加速，可以再看 sequential-to-parallel defect-guided parallelization；若关注 mechanistic editing，再翻附录里的 editing locality。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies residual-stream direction dynamics in Transformers. Its main claim is that attention-only particle dynamics cannot adequately explain the realized block update; the FFN should be modeled as a local steering field acting on each token state.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to mechanistic analysis than to pretraining practice. It does not propose a new optimizer, data recipe, or scaling method. Its value is to make the FFN an explicit dynamical term: FFNs are not just position-wise nonlinear capacity or editable memory tables; their tangential component can steer residual directions in a way that attention alone misses. This is useful for readers studying representation collapse, residual-stream geometry, FFN memories, or parallel approximations of Transformer blocks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The formulation decomposes each residual state as x_i = r_i u_i, where u_i lies on the unit sphere and r_i is the residual norm. Directional motion is studied on the sphere. Attention is modeled as a non-local aggregation field depending on other tokens, while the FFN is modeled as a local field depending only on the current token state. Only the tangential projection of a field changes the residual direction; the radial component changes the norm and therefore the angular speed. This leads to an aggregation-steering ODE on a product of spheres. The paper then defines critical residual directions, residual attractors, tangent stability, FFN-induced spectral shifts, and the attention–FFN commutator. It also introduces a sequential-to-parallel defect that measures when a finite attention–FFN block can be approximated by a parallel additive map. The technical difference from prior attention-only dynamics is the explicit inclusion of the FFN as a first-class steering term.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical analysis uses checkpoints from GPT-2, Pythia, Mistral, and Llama families. The main findings are: the attention branch alone has a substantial angular-alignment deficit relative to the actual block update; the tangential FFN component is necessary for the observed motion in residual-direction space, while the radial component cannot substitute for it; FFN steering helps maintain diversity under aggregation pressure; and the sequential-to-parallel defect can guide practical block parallelization approximations. The appendix adds diagnostics on FFN gate calibration, prefix/Volterra sensitivity, local spectrum geometry, OV non-symmetry, and editing locality. The provided text does not include exact numerical tables, so the results should be read as qualitative and diagnostic evidence rather than an engineering recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Read the problem setting first to understand the x_i = r_i u_i decomposition, tangent projection, and the FFN steering field. In the theory part, focus on critical residual directions, tangent stability, and the attention–FFN commutator; the proofs can be skipped on first pass. In the experiments, prioritize the attention-only angular-deficit diagnostic and the tangential/radial FFN ablation, since they directly support the central claim. Readers interested in inference or training acceleration can also inspect the sequential-to-parallel defect section. Readers interested in model editing may want to sample the appendix material on editing locality.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和干预实验即可；它把 FFN 从“MLP 黑盒”拉回 residual 几何，结论比纯 attention 动力学更贴近 Llama。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and intervention results; it gives a cleaner residual-geometry role for FFNs than attention-only dynamics, especially for Llama-like models.

paper.title: The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models
paper.abstract: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scale

summary.core_problem: 大模型训练已有较多平衡态或阶段论描述，但缺少关于“能力何时出现、以多快速度形成、何时丧失可塑性、如何被干预”的动力学理论。该工作把能力形成建模为计算回路的随机成核过程：回路最后若干部分必须在一次随机尝试中同时对齐，缺少任何一部分都几乎不计分，这种无局部信用的联合对齐是速率瓶颈。
summary.importance: 该工作把训练研究从“相图”推进到“时间—温度—转变图”式的过程控制。它给出一个可测量的速率方程，能同时解释能力突现、可塑性丧失和回路级调度，对数据混合、持续预训练、训练课程、能力预警和定向干预都有直接启发。其价值不只是拟合现象，而是把站点数、驱动强度、缺失部件数、温度/噪声等因素分开测量，并在未训练组合上做因果验证。
summary.technical_approach: 从 SGD 的扩散近似出发：参数更新被写为漂移项加状态相关噪声，即 dθ = -∇L(θ)dt + √(2εΣ(θ))dW。在该近似下，能力形成被视为稀有事件，速率由可用站点数、尝试驱动和随缺失部件数增长的势垒共同决定。理论基础结合了稀疏奇偶学习的统计查询下界与 leap/staircase 定理：对于无子集信号的 K 项合取，学习代价随 K 指数增长，而每步只增加一个新坐标的目标则可快速学习。该速率方程被三种方式读取：向前读，驱动越过阈值时能力出现，并可在能力可测前给出到达时钟；向后读，训练自身消耗站点项 N，导致可塑性丧失，并给出定量时间尺度、机制和修复方式；补入温度项后，可实现单回路退火、选择性溶解和 quench-and-release 调度。
summary.experiments: 在无捷径的受控装置中，一个缺三部分的五部件回路与缺三部分的三部件回路等待时间相近，比值为 1.19–1.37，说明等待时间由缺失部件数而非回路总规模决定。在 Pythia 上跨七项能力和三种规模检验时，消融一个回路部件后，32 个可判别单元中的能力保留中位数为 17%，而局部信用模型预测应为 50–83%，p=2×10^-10；消融随机非部件头则保留约 100%。实验覆盖 Pythia 与 OLMo，规模到 1.4B；因果常数在受控持续训练中测量，中心因果结果还从随机初始化复现。每个速率因子都被独立测量、固定，再在未运行过的组合上测试。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第 2–4 节的推导链：SGD 扩散近似如何连接到稀有事件速率，以及稀疏奇偶/leap 定理为何支撑“无局部信用”的势垒。第 6 节看能力出现前的预警时钟；第 7 节看可塑性丧失的站点消耗解释、时间尺度和修复；第 8 节看回路级退火与 quench-and-release；第 9 节看因子独立测量和外推验证。需要留意其明确标出的未证明数学假设 Assumption 1，以及因果常数主要在 plain SGD/AdamW 受控 regime 下测得。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM training has equilibrium-style descriptions of phases and stages, but lacks a kinetics that predicts when a capability appears, how fast it grows, when plasticity is lost, and how circuits can be controlled. The work models capability formation as stochastic nucleation of a computational circuit: the remaining parts must align in one rare joint attempt, and getting all but one right yields almost no credit.
summary_en.importance: The work moves beyond a phase diagram toward a process-control account of training. A single measurable rate law connects emergence, plasticity loss, and circuit-specific intervention, with implications for data mixing, continued pretraining, curricula, emergence early warning, and targeted repair. Its strength is that sites, drive, missing parts, and temperature-like noise are separately measured and then tested on held-out training combinations rather than only fitting observed curves.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the diffusion approximation of SGD, dθ = -∇L(θ)dt + √(2εΣ(θ))dW, capability formation is treated as a rare event whose rate depends on available sites, attempt drive, and a barrier that grows with the number of missing circuit parts. Statistical-query lower bounds for sparse parity and leap/staircase results justify the no-partial-credit regime: K-wise conjunctions without subset signal require exponentially more in K, while targets adding one coordinate at a time are learned quickly. The same equation is read forward as emergence when drive crosses a floor, backward as plasticity loss when training consumes the site term N, and with an injected temperature term as circuit-level annealing, selective dissolution, and quench-and-release control.
summary_en.experiments: In a shortcut-free apparatus, a five-part circuit missing three parts waits about as long as a three-part circuit missing three parts, with ratios 1.19–1.37, showing that wait time tracks missing parts rather than total circuit size. Across seven capabilities and three scales in Pythia, ablating one circuit part leaves a median 17% capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, whereas partial-credit predicts 50–83%, p=2×10^-10; ablating a random non-part head leaves about 100%. Experiments use Pythia and OLMo up to 1.4B, measure causal constants in controlled continued training, and reproduce central causal results from random initialization. Each factor is independently measured, frozen, and tested on never-run combinations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Sections 2–4 for the derivation from SGD dynamics to a nucleation rate, and on why sparse-parity and leap results support the no-partial-credit barrier. Read Section 6 for the precursor clock before capability is measurable, Section 7 for site depletion as the mechanism of plasticity loss with its horizon and repair, Section 8 for circuit annealing and quench-and-release, and Section 9 for independent factor measurement and extrapolation. Keep in view Assumption 1, the explicitly unproved premise, and that causal constants are established under a controlled plain SGD/AdamW regime.

recommendation.zh: 用物理化学的成核理论解释 LLM 能力涌现，提出了可证伪的速率方程，改变了对『涌现』仅仅是度量假象的认知，强烈建议精读理论推导和消融实验。
recommendation.en: Explains LLM emergence using nucleation theory from physical chemistry, proposing a falsifiable rate equation that challenges the view of emergence as merely a metric artifact; highly recommended for its theoretical derivation and ablation studies.

paper.title: Probing the Origins of Reasoning Performance: Representational Quality for Mathematical Problem-Solving in RL vs. SFT Fine-Tuned Models
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models trained via reinforcement learning (RL) have been increasingly shown to outperform their supervised fine-tuned (SFT) counterparts on mathematical reasoning tasks; Yet the mechanistic basis for this advantage remains unclear. We therefore ask, what internal representational differences enable RL models' superior performance? Our work presents two converging lines of evidence: First, linear probes trained on layer-wise hidden states reveal that RL models tend to achieve high

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答一个很具体的问题：RL 微调后的 reasoning model 为什么在数学推理上常常强于 SFT 模型，这种差异能否在内部表征层面被直接观察到。
summary.importance: 它的价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于给 RL 优势提供了一个可操作的机制解释框架。对 pretrain/post-train 研究者来说，启发点是：训练目标不仅改变最终准确率，也会重塑信息在层间出现的时机、线性可分性，以及不同层对最终解题的贡献分布。这类分析有助于判断 RL 到底是在“教会模型更长输出”，还是在改变内部计算结构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用三类分析拼起来看这个问题。第一，在线性 probe 设置下，对各层 hidden states 训练分类器，预测该题最终答案是否正确，用 probe accuracy 衡量表征质量。提取位置选在 \boxed{} 之前的 token，目的是在模型完成推理但尚未显式输出答案时观察内部状态。第二，做 mean ablation，逐层替换或抹除激活，测哪些层被破坏后对数学推理伤害最大，以此比较 RL 与 SFT 的层功能分布。第三，分析同一道题多次采样时的生成一致性和 token 使用模式，检验 RL 模型是否形成了更稳定、更有层次的推理表征。数据方面，作者构造了 1000 道合成数学题，覆盖概率、分数、成本计算等模板，避免 contamination，并用平衡采样控制不同模型正确/错误样本比例。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有三点。第一，RL 模型在 layer-wise probe 上通常更早出现、更强、更线性可分的正确性表征，probe accuracy 整体高于 SFT 模型。第二，mean ablation 显示 RL 模型的关键计算更集中在深层，层重要性随深度上升，文中给出相关系数 r=0.47；SFT 模型则更均匀，甚至略呈反向趋势，r=-0.11。第三，生成一致性分析支持 RL 模型内部表征更稳定，token 复杂度分配也更一致，但作者同时指出当前 RL 训练在按题目难度自适应分配推理 token 上仍有未用尽空间。实验规模不算大，任务也集中在合成数学题，因此结论更适合作为机制线索，而不是广泛外推到所有 reasoning 场景。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 把三条证据链记住，再看 probing 方法细节，尤其是为什么选 \boxed{} 前一 token、为什么要做 balanced split。随后看 mean ablation 结果图，那里最能直观看出 RL 与 SFT 的层功能差异。最后扫一遍 generation consistency 部分即可。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要信息；如果只想看结论，看 probe 曲线和 layer importance 图就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a focused mechanistic question: why do RL-tuned reasoning models outperform SFT-tuned models on math problems, and can that advantage be observed directly in their internal representations?
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. For researchers working on pretraining and post-training, the useful takeaway is that training objectives appear to reshape where and when useful information becomes available inside the network, not just the final accuracy or output length. That helps separate two hypotheses: RL may simply encourage longer reasoning traces, or it may actually reorganize the model’s internal computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis combines three tools. First, the authors train layer-wise linear probes on hidden states to predict whether the model’s final answer will be correct. Probe accuracy is used as a proxy for representational quality. Hidden states are extracted at the token immediately before \boxed{}, chosen to capture the model after it has finished reasoning but before it commits to the answer string. Second, they run mean-ablation interventions to estimate which layers are most critical for mathematical reasoning and compare the layer-importance profiles of RL and SFT models. Third, they study generation consistency across multiple samples of the same problem, including token-usage patterns, to test whether RL models develop more stable and structured reasoning behavior. To reduce contamination and control difficulty, they generate 1,000 synthetic math problems from fixed templates spanning probability, fractions, and cost calculations, then balance correct and incorrect examples across models.
summary_en.experiments: Three findings stand out. First, RL models tend to show earlier-emerging and stronger correctness-related representations in the probe analysis, with higher probe accuracy than SFT counterparts across layers. Second, mean ablation suggests that RL training concentrates critical computation in deeper layers: layer importance increases with depth for RL models, with a reported correlation of r=0.47, while SFT models look much flatter and slightly reversed at r=-0.11. Third, the consistency analysis indicates that RL models produce more stable reasoning traces and more regular token allocation, although the authors also argue that current RL training still underuses adaptive token budgeting across problem difficulty. The experimental scope is modest and centered on synthetic math tasks, so the results should be read as mechanistic evidence and hypothesis generation rather than a universal account of reasoning models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A quick read should start with the introduction to fix the three-part analysis in mind. Then go to the probing section and pay attention to the extraction point before \boxed{} and the balancing procedure, since both are important for interpreting the probe results. After that, read the mean-ablation results carefully; that is where the RL-versus-SFT architectural difference is most visible. The generation-consistency section can be skimmed unless token-allocation behavior is your main interest. In about 20–30 minutes, the probe curves and layer-importance plots are enough to capture the main message.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“解释 RL 为何更强”的定论；但用 correctness probe + 分层消融去量化 RL 改写表征的套路可复用，重点看 probe 设定与消融是否足够干净。
recommendation.en: Not a definitive causal story for RL gains, but the correctness-probe + layer-importance ablation recipe is reusable; focus on whether the probe target and ablations are clean enough to trust.

paper.title: Many-body Tipping Dynamics of ChatGPT-like AIs
paper.abstract: Why do ChatGPT-like AIs, despite major architectural and training differences, unexpectedly tip to undesirable content (e.g. harmful, misleading, repetitive) even under deterministic greedy decoding? We show that a broad class of such tippings is caused by the many-body interactions between tokens (spins) as they cross the finite-layer system. Tipping emerges as a dynamical first passage process between competing output basins. Attention disorder controls the transport toward, away from, or alon

summary.core_problem: ChatGPT类大语言模型即使在确定性贪心解码下，也会突然出现有害、误导、重复等不良输出（tipping现象），其底层动力学机制尚不明确。
summary.importance: 从多体物理视角解释了LLM输出突变的机制，将这类不良输出归为可预测的工程风险而非不可控的涌现行为。对理解注意力层信息传递、解码稳定性有一定参考价值，与预训练研究的关联相对间接，主要体现在架构选择对输出可靠性的影响层面。
summary.technical_approach: 将Transformer注意力层建模为多体相互作用系统，token类比为自旋，层作为离散时间步。把高维解码动力学约简为少数输出盆地之间的竞争过程，tipping被建模为盆地间的首次穿越过程。通过三盆地约简模型推导有限层下的tipping阈值，注意力的无序度（用列熵衡量）控制输出在盆地边界的输运方向。分析中隔离纯注意力机制（忽略MLP与LayerNorm影响），构建层间传播子描述token信息的跨层传递。
summary.experiments: 三盆地约简模型的粗粒度预测，在多个ChatGPT类模型家族上与实际tipping行为吻合较好。层数增加会延迟tipping发生，因为更深的层保留了更多prompt记忆；注意力无序度决定tipping的方向与概率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先读摘要和引言了解核心问题与结论，再看主文的三盆地约简模型、tipping阈值推导（Eq.2）以及Figure 2的实验验证。补充材料中的完整数学推导可跳过，重点理解多体动力学类比的核心逻辑。预计阅读时间30-45分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Why ChatGPT-like large language models exhibit sudden shifts to undesirable outputs (harmful, misleading, repetitive content) even under deterministic greedy decoding, and what dynamical mechanism underlies this tipping phenomenon.
summary_en.importance: This work frames LLM output tipping as a many-body dynamical process rather than unpredictable emergent behavior, classifying such failures as foreseeable engineering risk. It offers a physical perspective on attention layer information transport and output stability, with indirect relevance to pretraining research — particularly for understanding how architectural choices (depth, attention patterns) affect decoding reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Transformer attention layers are modeled as a many-body interacting system, where tokens act as spins and layers act as discrete time steps. High-dimensional decoding dynamics are reduced to competition between a small number of output basins, with tipping modeled as a first-passage process between basins. A three-basin reduced model is used to derive a finite-layer tipping threshold, and attention disorder (measured by column entropy) controls transport toward, away from, or along basin boundaries. The analysis isolates pure attention dynamics by setting MLP contributions to zero and LayerNorm to identity, and constructs a layer-wise propagator to describe token information transfer across layers.
summary_en.experiments: The coarse-grained predictions of the three-basin reduced model show good agreement with observed tipping behavior across multiple ChatGPT-like model families. Increasing model depth delays tipping, as deeper layers retain more prompt memory; attention disorder determines the direction and likelihood of tipping transitions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the abstract and introduction first to grasp the core question and high-level conclusions. Then focus on the main text's three-basin reduction, the tipping threshold derivation (Eq. 2), and the experimental validation in Figure 2. Full mathematical derivations in the supplementary material can be skipped unless you have specific interest in many-body theory. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用统计物理的多体动力学解释 LLM 的退化/幻觉现象（tipping），提供了一个新颖的理论框架，值得关注其对训练稳定性的潜在启示。
recommendation.en: Explains LLM degradation/hallucination (tipping) using many-body dynamics from statistical physics. Provides a novel theoretical framework worth noting for potential insights into training stability.

paper.title: Minimizing Targeted Activations: Input-Only Suppression of Evaluation-Awareness Latents in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Activation steering controls model behavior by editing internal activations at inference time. We study its input-side dual: optimizing a fluent prompt so that a chosen internal latent is driven toward zero, with no inference-time model access. Our target is an "evaluation-awareness" latent-linearly readable and steerable in recent work-whose control would threaten the validity of safety evaluations if models behave differently when they detect being tested. Adapting Fluent Dreaming / EPO with a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：能否只通过改写输入 prompt，而不在推理时干预模型，把一个已知的内部 latent 压低到接近零。目标 latent 是“evaluation-awareness”，也就是模型内部对“自己是否处在评测场景”的可读信号。核心风险在于，如果模型能识别评测并改变行为，安全评测的外推性会变弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析和评测可信度。它提醒我们，线性可读的内部表征不等于可控的行为变量。对于研究 sandbagging、alignment faking、eval contamination、评测感知表征的人，这个结论很有用：仅证明某个方向可读或可被 steering，并不能说明它是行为层面的因果开关。预训练侧的启发是，内部表征的可读性、可干预性、输入可诱导性、行为可控性需要分开验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 activation steering 的输入侧对偶。传统 steering 是在推理时向 residual stream 加减方向；这里不改模型，只优化一段短 prompt，让给定 latent 的标量读数下降。作者改造 Fluent Dreaming / EPO，把原来的 feature maximization 改成 feature minimization。优化器采用 GCG 风格的离散 token 梯度搜索，同时加入 self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer，保证 prompt 仍然流畅；还加入 KL 项，尽量保留原任务行为。作者对 fluency 权重做 population sweep，用来画出 suppression 与 fluency 的 Pareto 前沿。目标构造覆盖五类：CAA mean-difference direction、子空间范数、Llama Scope SAE feature、单个 MLP neuron，以及与 yes/no evaluation judgment 相关的 logit-difference target。一个重要设计是区分 evaluation 与 formal register，避免把“像评测”误读成“语言更正式”。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 Llama-3.2-3B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 上做。结果显示，prompt-side minimization 确实能稳定压低目标 latent，跨 seed 的抑制强度约为 z≈-7。对一个经过因果验证的 Llama Scope SAE feature，优化 prompt 可以几乎完全关闭该 feature，并且 collateral activation 很低，文中报告约 0.7%。但关键结果是：activation 被压低后，模型对输入是否为 evaluation 的行为判断基本不变。作者用多组控制实验确认这一点，包括 random direction placebo、把真实 eval passage 放进上下文的 in-context wrap test、以及与 model-side steering 的对比。论文还训练了新的 erasure probe 检查概念是否只是从原方向旋转到别处，并用 orthogonal-complement probe-hacking detector 防止把 probe failure 误认为概念消失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Method 中五种 target construction、优化目标和 fluency/KL regularization；再看 behavioral endpoint 与 erasure protocol，因为这里是论文区别于普通 activation suppression 的地方。实验部分优先看三类控制：placebo direction、wrap test、model-side steering comparison。最值得记住的不是“prompt 能压低 latent”，而是“压低 latent 不等于控制行为”。如果只关心预训练，可把它作为 eval-awareness 表征和安全评测机制分析材料，而不是训练方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a fluent input prompt alone can suppress a chosen internal latent, without any inference-time activation editing. The target is an evaluation-awareness signal: a representation that indicates whether the model treats the current interaction as an evaluation. This matters because safety evaluations become less reliable if a model can condition its behavior on being tested.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than a new pretraining recipe. The paper separates four notions that are often conflated: a concept being linearly readable, steerable by activation editing, inducible or suppressible by input optimization, and actually controlling behavior. Its main lesson is that activation readability is not enough to establish behavioral controllability. This is relevant to work on sandbagging, alignment faking, evaluation awareness, and the design of safety evaluations for pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is an input-side dual of activation steering. Instead of adding or subtracting a vector in the residual stream during inference, the authors optimize a short prompt so that a scalar latent readout is minimized. They adapt Fluent Dreaming / EPO by negating the feature term, turning feature maximization into feature suppression. The optimizer uses GCG-style discrete token-gradient search, with a self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer to keep the prompt natural and a KL term to preserve task behavior. They sweep fluency weights to trace a suppression–fluency tradeoff. The target latent is instantiated in five ways: a CAA mean-difference direction, a low-dimensional subspace norm, a Llama Scope SAE feature, a single MLP neuron, and a behavioral logit-difference target tied to yes/no evaluation judgments. They also explicitly address a confound between evaluation-awareness and formal register by constructing a balanced contrast set.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B. Prompt-side minimization reliably reduces the target latent across seeds, with reported suppression around z≈-7. For a causally validated Llama Scope SAE feature, the optimized prompt nearly turns the feature off completely while producing little collateral activation, reported at about 0.7%. The important negative result is that this activation drop does not translate into behavioral control: the model’s own yes/no judgment about whether the input is an evaluation remains largely unchanged. The paper supports this with placebo random-direction controls, an in-context wrap test that keeps a real evaluation passage fixed, and comparisons to model-side steering. It also trains fresh erasure probes on optimized prompts and uses an orthogonal-complement detector to guard against probe hacking.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the target definitions, the optimization objective, and the behavioral-plus-erasure evaluation protocol. The most useful experimental sections are the placebo direction, wrap-test, and model-side steering controls. The main takeaway is not just that prompts can suppress internal readouts, but that suppressing a readout does not by itself establish control over the model’s behavior.

recommendation.zh: 重点看§5关于抑制副作用的讨论，验证了评测感知的输入侧可控性，无需复现Prompt优化管线
recommendation.en: Focus on §5 discussion of suppression side effects, confirms input-side controllability of eval-awareness, no need to reproduce the prompt optimization pipeline.

Center for Data Science, New York University

paper.title: Reading Without a Reader: Large Language Models Collapse Reading and Writing into a Single Entangled Code
paper.abstract: In the literate human brain, reading and writing are two doubly-dissociable systems: a ventral decoding route (impaired in pure alexia) and a fronto-parietal encoding route (impaired in pure agraphia), sharing a partial orthographic core. A decoder-only large language model (LLM) instead drives both from a single autoregressive path optimized on text, a recent cultural invention rather than an evolved instinct. We ask how entangled that one mechanism is, comparing an input-side "reading code" $W

summary.core_problem: decoder-only LLM 的输入嵌入（读）与输出解嵌入/LM head（写）在多大程度上共享同一套表征代码，是否存在可分离的“读写通路”。
summary.importance: 机制分析工作：把“读/写是否解耦”落到可度量的权重与表征相似性指标上；对理解词表嵌入、权重绑定(tied embeddings)与训练动力学有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 定义读码W_E与写码W_U的纠缠指数E∈[0,1]，用CKA、Procrustes残差、互k-NN等度量，并用“独立初始化的floor”和“权重绑定的ceiling”做标定；在权重层面与探针任务层面做一致性检查。
summary.experiments: 覆盖GPT-2、OPT、Pythia(14M–1.4B)、以及T5、BERT/RoBERTa等；报告未绑定的decoder-only模型E约0.23–0.35（高于独立初始化基线、低于绑定上限）；包含9个probe（其中6个复现既有结果、3个新增读写分析）。

summary_en.core_problem: How entangled are the input embedding (“reading”) and output unembedding/LM head (“writing”) codes in LLMs, versus being separable pathways?
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis: operationalizes read/write coupling with measurable similarity indices, offering indirect insight into embeddings, weight tying, and training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines an entanglement index E∈[0,1] between W_E and W_U using CKA, Procrustes residuals, and mutual k-NN, calibrated by an independent-init floor and a tied-weights ceiling; checks agreement at both weight and probe levels.
summary_en.experiments: Studies GPT-2, OPT, Pythia (14M–1.4B), plus T5 and BERT/RoBERTa; reports E≈0.23–0.35 for untied models (above floor, below tied ceiling); 9 probes (6 replications, 3 new read/write analyses).

recommendation.zh: 不是新训练法，但把“embedding/LM head 是否该绑”变成可量化指标；只看E的标定方式与跨模型对比，别被神经科学叙事带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a new training recipe, but it quantifies the embedding–unembedding tying question; read the calibration of E and cross-model comparisons, ignore the neuro narrative.

paper.title: Emergent Latent-State Computation under Stochastic Volatility
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has largely focused on language models and deterministic toy tasks. Much less is known about how sequence models internally represent latent stochastic dynamics under noisy, partially observed observations. We study this question in a controlled multivariate stochastic volatility setting, where models observe only returns while the ground-truth latent volatility state is known to the researcher. This setting provides a useful benchmark for mechanistic interpretabilit

summary.core_problem: 填补序列模型在带噪声、部分可观测的随机动力学场景下内部潜在状态编码机制的研究空白
summary.importance: 提出了部分可观测场景下的机制可解释性可控基准，发现了序列模型编码潜在随机状态的两阶段计算规律
summary.technical_approach: 在可控多变量随机波动率设定下开展实验，模型仅观测收益率，研究者掌握真实潜在波动率标签，跨架构、损失函数、输出头对比分析隐藏表示的编码规律
summary.experiments: 覆盖Transformer等多种序列模型，验证隐藏表示会编码下一时刻潜在波动率信息，再由输出头映射为预测结果；Transformer中潜在状态可解码性在可识别的架构阶段涌现

summary_en.core_problem: Address the research gap in how sequence models internally encode latent stochastic dynamics under noisy, partially observable settings
summary_en.importance: Proposes a controlled mechanistic interpretability benchmark for partially observable scenarios, and identifies a two-stage computation pattern for latent stochastic state encoding in sequence models
summary_en.technical_approach: Runs experiments in a controlled multivariate stochastic volatility setting where models only observe returns while researchers have access to ground-truth latent volatility labels, comparing hidden representation encoding patterns across architectures, losses and output heads
summary_en.experiments: Tests across multiple sequence model architectures including Transformers, verifies hidden representations encode next-step latent volatility information which is then mapped to predictions by the output head; latent-state decodability in Transformers emerges at identifiable architectural stages

recommendation.zh: 随机波动率toy任务上的机制分析，对理解LLM噪声场景推理有弱参考，知道结论即可
recommendation.en: Mechanistic analysis on a stochastic volatility toy task, provides weak reference for LLM reasoning under noise, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Through the Bottleneck: How Multi-head Latent Attention Separates Content from Position in Language Models
paper.abstract: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), introduced in DeepSeek-V2, compresses key-value pairs through a shared low-rank bottleneck (cKV), achieving 81% KV-cache reduction during inference. Despite its adoption in massive production models, no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves or discards, nor how it reshapes internal transformer circuits. We present the first comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, training a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on a

summary.core_problem: DeepSeek-V2提出的多头潜在注意力（MLA）通过共享低秩cKV瓶颈压缩KV实现高效推理，但尚无研究揭示该瓶颈的信息保留/丢弃机制及对Transformer内部电路的重塑作用。
summary.importance: 原理分析（首个针对MLA的全面机制可解释性研究），验证了MLA的核心设计假设，为KV压缩架构和预训练位置编码设计提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 训练114M参数Transformer（网页/代码/数学混合语料预训练，TinyStories微调），采用SVD、注意力头分类、线性探测、扰动归因分析等方法拆解MLA的cKV瓶颈与内部电路。
summary.experiments: 训练114M参数Transformer；核心发现：1）cKV瓶颈学习纯内容表征，实体身份保留率98%，丢弃位置信息，验证了MLA通过RoPE实现内容-位置分离的设计；2）归纳头集中在第12层，不同于常规Transformer的分布式分布。
summary.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Madras、P P Savani University；研究对象为DeepSeek-V2核心架构MLA，未披露知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) introduced in DeepSeek-V2 compresses KV pairs via a shared low-rank cKV bottleneck for efficient inference, but no prior work has studied what information this bottleneck preserves/discards or how it reshapes internal transformer circuits.
summary_en.importance: First comprehensive mechanistic interpretability study of MLA, validates core design assumptions of MLA, and provides empirical evidence for KV compression architecture and pretraining position encoding design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a 114M-parameter transformer (pretrained on web/code/math mixture, fine-tuned on TinyStories), and analyzes MLA's cKV bottleneck and internal circuits via SVD, attention head taxonomy, linear probing, and disruption-attribution analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Trains a 114M-parameter transformer; key findings: 1) The cKV bottleneck learns pure content representations with 98% entity identity retention and discards positional information, validating MLA's content-position separation via RoPE; 2) Induction heads are concentrated in Layer 12, unlike distributed formation in standard transformers.
summary_en.authors_note: Indian Institute of Technology Madras, P P Savani University; research object is the core MLA architecture of DeepSeek-V2, no notable authors disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 首个MLA机制分析，验证了低秩KV瓶颈分离内容/位置的设计假设，应立刻在内部KV压缩架构消融中参考其SVD和扰动分析方法。
recommendation.en: First mechanistic analysis of MLA, validating the low-rank KV bottleneck's content-position separation design; immediately reference its SVD and perturbation analysis methods in internal KV compression ablations.

paper.title: Extracting Algorithms in Pre-trained LLMs: A Case on Hidden Markov Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) display a striking ability to predict next observations from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) via in-context learning (ICL), but the algorithm underlying this capability remains undetermined: prior work has proposed several candidates without consensus, and none has been grounded in the model's internal activations. We close this gap with a three-stage pipeline. First, we empirically compare LLM behavior against a suite of candidate algorithms and narrow the space to thre

summary.core_problem: 预训练 LLM 在 HMM 观测序列上能做很强的 in-context next-token prediction，甚至随上下文增长接近 Bayes 最优预测；但它到底在内部实现了哪类算法，此前没有和模型激活做过因果层面的对应。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值主要在机制分析，而不是直接给出新的预训练 recipe。它把 HMM 这种可控生成过程当作探针，研究预训练 Transformer 是否学到了可迁移的统计推断算法。对基座研究的启发在于：ICL 行为不能只用输出拟合来解释，同一个模型在不同数据生成机制下可能调用不同的内部表示；激活中可线性解码的信息，也不一定被后续计算真实使用。这对理解预训练后模型如何形成算法性能力有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步，在 75 个 HMM 配置和多种上下文长度上，把 12 个预训练 LLM 的 next-observation prediction 与一组经典和学习型 HMM predictor 对齐比较。作者没有假设单一机制，而是用输出行为把候选空间收窄到三类 ansatz：Linear n-gram、Non-linear n-gram 和 Spectral。第二步，证明 Transformer 可以在上下文中实现这些候选算法。核心统一形式是：把历史观测映射成一组非线性特征，再用这些特征的线性函数给出 next-token probability。这个形式把有限窗口 n-gram、非线性特征预测和谱方法放到同一个框架里。作者还在一个小 Transformer 上验证，训练后确实会自然出现类似有限窗口 predictor 的实现。第三步，引入 Principal Activations Probe（PAP）。PAP 先在 residual stream 中寻找低维算法信号，再通过层级干预检验这些信号是否因果影响输出。这个设计比普通 probing 更强，因为它区分了“能读出来”和“模型真的用它”。
summary.experiments: 关键实验包括三类结果。第一，输出行为上，预训练 LLM 在合成 HMM 序列上随上下文增长趋近理论最优预测，但没有任何单一经典算法能解释所有 HMM regime 和序列长度下的行为。第二，理论构造和小模型训练实验显示，Transformer 架构有能力在 in-context setting 中实现三类候选算法，有限窗口 predictor 也能在训练中自然形成。第三，PAP 分析显示，不同 HMM regime 下模型会使用不同类型的算法表示；不同计算阶段分布在不同层；一些算法信息在较早层已经可解码，但并没有被后续层用于最终预测。这一点是全文最有信息量的实验结论之一。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30–45 分钟。先看 Section 2.3 和 Table 1，理解 12 个 LLM、75 个 HMM 配置、候选 predictor 的比较方式，以及为什么单一算法解释失败。再看 Section 3 的统一 nonlinear-feature 表达，它是连接 n-gram、nonlinear predictor 和 spectral method 的核心。最后重点看 Section 4 的 PAP，包括 probing 与 intervention 的流程图和干预结果。若只关心预训练模型机制，Section 4 比理论构造更值得细读。

summary_en.core_problem: Pre-trained LLMs can perform strong in-context next-observation prediction on HMM-generated sequences, often approaching the Bayes-optimal predictor as context grows. The open question is which algorithm, if any, the model implements internally, and whether that algorithm can be tied causally to model activations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic, not a new pretraining method. HMMs provide a controlled generative process for testing whether pre-trained Transformers contain transferable statistical inference procedures. The useful lesson for foundation-model research is that output-level matching is not enough: the same model can rely on different internal representations under different data regimes, and linearly decodable information in an activation need not be causally used by later computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three parts. First, it compares 12 pre-trained LLMs against a set of classical and learning-based HMM predictors over 75 HMM configurations and a range of context lengths. This behavioral comparison rules out a single universal explanation and narrows the plausible mechanisms to three ansatz classes: Linear n-gram, Non-linear n-gram, and Spectral. Second, it shows that Transformers can implement these classes in context. The unifying view expresses next-token probabilities as linear functions of nonlinear features computed from past observations, which covers finite-window predictors, nonlinear feature predictors, and spectral-style methods. A small Transformer trained on a single HMM is used to validate that a finite-window-like predictor can emerge naturally. Third, the paper introduces Principal Activations Probe, a layer-wise probing and intervention pipeline that finds low-dimensional algorithmic signals in the residual stream and then tests whether changing those signals causally changes predictions.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical results are clear. At the output level, pre-trained LLMs improve with context length and move toward the theoretical optimum on synthetic HMM sequences, but no single baseline algorithm matches their behavior across all regimes. The construction experiments show that the candidate algorithms are implementable by Transformers, and the small-model training run demonstrates that at least one such solution can arise from training rather than manual wiring. The activation analysis shows regime-dependent internal strategies, layer-localized computational stages, and a gap between decodability and causal use: some algorithmic information is present in earlier layers but is bypassed by downstream computation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Start with Section 2.3 and Table 1 to understand the HMM grid, the predictor baselines, and why output behavior does not identify a unique algorithm. Then read Section 3 for the common nonlinear-feature formulation that connects the three candidate mechanisms. Spend the most time on Section 4, especially the PAP design and intervention results, since those are the strongest evidence about what the pre-trained models actually use.

recommendation.zh: ICL机制研究的扎实工作，PAP探针方法有复用价值，重点看§3的算法分类和§5的激活验证部分。
recommendation.en: Solid ICL mechanism work with a reusable PAP probing method; focus on Section 3 for algorithm taxonomy and Section 5 for activation validation.

paper.title: Context Is King: How In-Context Specification Shapes the Geometry of Concepts
paper.abstract: Large language models place structured concepts on geometrically faithful manifolds: weekdays lie on a circle, months on another, usually taken to be a fixed world-model the network stores and looks up. We show that context is king: the structure a model actually uses is set by the in-context specification. A declarative rule fixes not only which relations the geometry encodes but its topology type: the same tokens form a cycle or a branching tree on command, built even on arbitrary, meaning-fre

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是LLM中概念的关系几何结构（如星期、月份的环形布局，层次概念的树形结构）究竟是预训练阶段存储的固定世界模型，还是由上下文规范即时动态构建的。此前的可解释性研究多将观测到的概念几何视为模型预训练固化的静态属性，这篇工作通过受控实验验证上下文对概念几何的决定作用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有四点：1. 概念表示不是预训练固化的静态结构，而是上下文依赖的动态构建，说明预训练学到的是构建概念关系结构的能力，而非固定的几何布局；2. 上下文覆盖强预训练先验的能力存在规模门控效应，为scaling law研究提供了性能之外的新维度——内部表示的上下文重构能力；3. 上下文学习不只是调整输出分布，而是直接重构模型内部的概念表示空间，为理解ICL的机制提供了新证据；4. 小模型上的概念几何研究结论不能直接迁移到大模型，因为忠实的、可因果使用的结构需要足够的模型能力支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 采用声明式零示例的上下文规范方法，对不同预训练先验强度的实体集合（从强环形先验的星期、月份，到弱先验的星座，再到无先验的任意无意义token）强加与预训练先验一致或冲突的概念结构（顺序环形、层次树形）。读取模型最后一个prompt token处的残差流表示（即生成前的集成状态，而非结构查询诱导的状态），通过成对不相似度、表示相似性分析（RSA）等方法测量概念几何的拓扑与结构。核心创新包括：验证拓扑级别的变化（环形vs树形）而非固定形状内的偏移；通过冲突规范区分上下文与预训练先验的影响；通过激活补丁实验验证上下文设定的几何是被模型因果使用的，而非探针的伪相关。
summary.experiments: 关键实验结果包括：1. 对星期等强预训练环形概念施加冲突顺序时，模型表示的几何结构会转向上下文指定的结构，与强加结构的表示相似性达0.6-0.9；2. 同一组实体的几何拓扑完全由上下文规范决定——指定顺序则形成环形/线性结构，指定层次则形成树形结构；3. 即使是无预训练先验的任意无意义token，上下文也能构建出清晰的结构化几何，排除了「重标记预存结构」的解释；4. 实体替换的激活补丁实验证明，上下文设定的几何是模型生成时实际因果使用的，不是探针的虚假相关；5. 小模型和base模型只能形成粗糙的强加几何，干净的、可遍历的结构以及完整的因果双分离效应仅在更大规模模型上出现，存在明显的能力门控。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第1节的核心问题与核心结论，第4节的几何测量方法（特别是选择最后一个prompt token残差流作为读取位置的原因），第5节的冲突实验与拓扑切换实验结果，以及第6节的因果验证与规模效应分析。关注机制可解释性的读者可深入查看激活补丁的实验设计。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A core question in LLM interpretability is whether the relational geometry of concepts (e.g., cyclic structure of weekdays/months, tree structure of hierarchical concepts) is a fixed world model stored during pretraining, or dynamically constructed on demand by in-context specifications. Prior work has largely treated observed concept geometries as static, pretrained properties of the model. This work uses controlled experiments to test whether in-context specification directly determines the geometry a model actually uses.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers four key insights: 1. Concept representations are not static, pretrained structures but context-dependent dynamic constructs, indicating pretraining learns the capacity to build conceptual relational structures rather than fixed geometric layouts. 2. The ability of context to override strong pretrained priors is scale-gated, adding a new dimension to scaling law analysis beyond raw task performance: the capacity for context-driven representational reorganization. 3. In-context learning does not merely adjust output distributions — it directly reshapes the internal representational space of concepts, providing new mechanistic evidence for how ICL works. 4. Findings about concept geometry from small models cannot be directly transferred to large models, as faithful, causally operative structure requires sufficient model capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work uses declarative, zero-exemplar in-context specifications to impose conceptual structures (ordered cycles, hierarchical trees) that are either congruent or conflicting with pretrained priors. Tests cover entity types with varying prior strength: strong cyclic concepts (weekdays, months, clock hours), weak cyclic priors (zodiac signs), non-cyclic concepts (musical notes), and arbitrary meaningless tokens. Entity representations are read from the residual stream at the last prompt token — the integrated state consumed by next-token computation, rather than states induced by structural queries — and geometry is measured via pairwise dissimilarity and representational similarity analysis (RSA). Key innovations include: demonstrating topology-level control (cycle vs. tree) rather than just within-shape shifts; using conflicting specifications to disentangle context vs. pretrained prior effects; and using activation patching (entity substitution) to verify the context-set geometry is causally operative in generation, not just a probe correlate.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: 1. When a conflicting order is imposed on strong cyclic concepts (e.g., scrambled weekday order), the model's representational geometry shifts to match the imposed structure, with representational similarity to the specified structure reaching 0.6–0.9. 2. The same set of entities forms either a cyclic/linear structure or a hierarchical tree structure depending solely on the in-context specification, demonstrating full topology-level control. 3. Structured geometry can be formed even on arbitrary, meaningless tokens with no pretrained prior, ruling out relabeling of stored shapes as an explanation. 4. Entity-substitution activation patching confirms the context-set geometry is causally used in generation, not just a spurious probe correlation. 5. Small and base models only form rough imposed geometries; clean, traversable structure and full causal double dissociation emerge only at larger model scales, showing clear capability gating.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 1 for the core research question and key claims, Section 4 for the measurement methodology (especially the rationale for reading representations from the last prompt token's residual stream), Section 5 for the conflict and topology-switch experiments, and Section 6 for causal validation and scale-gating results. Readers interested in mechanistic interpretability can dive deeper into the activation patching experimental design. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 RSA 与 patching 设计；它把“概念流形是存储结构”这个 prior 改成了更强的上下文构造版本。
recommendation.en: Read the RSA and patching setup; it shifts the prior from stored concept manifolds toward context-constructed representations.

paper.title: Reference Feature Atlases for Mechanistic Auditing of Language Models
paper.abstract: Auditing a new language model usually means relearning and reinterpreting its internal features from scratch. We propose a reference feature atlas: a sparse feature library trained once on a reference panel and reused for new targets, which attach by fitting only a linear decoder. This yields two complementary views. The atlas channel reads the target on already interpreted panel features, providing a stable coordinate system across models. The residual channel learns features only from what the

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决 mechanistic auditing 的可复用性问题：每审计一个新模型都重新训练 SAE、重新解释特征，成本高，而且缺少一个稳定坐标系来判断某个内部特征是家族共享的，还是目标模型特有的。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的价值在于提供了一种跨模型内部表征对齐和异常定位工具。它不直接改进预训练损失或数据配比，但能帮助研究者比较不同模型在同一组已解释特征上的使用方式，并把 reference panel 覆盖不了的表征结构单独暴露出来。对持续预训练、模型合并、指令微调副作用、隐藏目标检测和安全审计都有启发。尤其是 residual channel 的设计，把“参考模型族之外的东西”变成可训练、可排序、可干预的对象，而不是事后靠阈值猜测。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 reference feature atlas。先在一组 reference panel 模型上联合训练一个稀疏特征库，相当于一个跨模型共享的 SAE 坐标系。这个 atlas 训练和解释一次后，新的 target model 不再重新训练完整 SAE，而是只拟合一个线性 target decoder，把目标模型的 activation 连接到 atlas 的特征坐标上。审计输出分成两个通道。atlas channel 用已解释的 panel features 读取目标模型，支持逐特征比较目标模型与各 reference model 的使用差异。residual channel 则在 atlas 无法重构的残差上单独训练稀疏字典，即对 h* - D* z_A 建模。这个设计与 sparse crosscoder 的差别很关键：crosscoder 通常在同一个字典里用 decoder norm asymmetry 事后区分 shared 和 model-specific feature；这里 residual feature 从训练结构上就限定为 panel-uncovered。这样 attachment FVU/KL 给出一个标量级别的“目标模型离 reference panel 多远”，residual SAE 再给出具体特征清单。
summary.experiments: 实验使用五个 7–9B instruction-tuned open models：Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Gemma-2-9B、OLMo-2-7B。论文训练 leave-one-out atlases，并分别审计 held-out Mistral 和 Qwen target。第一组是受控 LoRA hidden objectives：向 held-out target 注入三个目标，包括虚构甜点品牌、托勒密本轮体系、Flying Spaghetti Monster advocacy。对六组 objective-target 配对，runtime intervention 能把 planted-objective rate 降到 0，同时 matched benign controls 保持 0。residual dictionary 在全部六组中都把注入机制恢复为 top-ranked latent，3 个种子、2 个目标家族下 mean rank = 1.0，rank 标准差为 0。Mistral 侧的 per-target SAE 和 pairwise crosscoder baseline 在同样对照中没有恢复该机制。第二组是 Qwen 相对 Atlas B 的 panel-relative finding：Qwen-2.5 的 attachment KL 约为 reference panel in-panel KL 的 7 倍，并且跨 3 个 atlas training seeds 高于 in-panel 值超过 15σ。residual channel 将差异定位到 emergency-power restrictions、unrest 中 media-suspension framing、以及弱化 individual rights 的 law-and-order justifications 等 continuation cluster。沿同一 cluster 做 runtime intervention，会单调改变 political-keyword refusal rate 和 law-and-order framing share，100 个 matched out-of-domain controls 保持不变。论文也明确说明该发现是相对于 Atlas B panel 和审计 prompt distribution 的结果，不应解释为 Qwen 的模型内在属性结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，约 45–60 分钟。先看 Problem Setup，确认 atlas feature identity、target decoder、attachment FVU/KL 的定义。再看方法中 atlas channel 与 residual channel 的分工，这是全文核心。实验部分优先读 LoRA hidden objectives，因为它有受控注入、干预和 baseline 对照，能检验 residual channel 是否真的找到 target-specific mechanism。Qwen residual finding 适合看作方法能力展示，同时要注意它是 panel-relative。附录中与 per-target SAE、pairwise crosscoder 的 head-to-head comparison 值得看，尤其是为什么后两者无法稳定区分“参考模型族之外”的结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in mechanistic auditing: every new model currently requires a fresh feature dictionary and fresh interpretation work, while auditors lack a stable coordinate system for deciding whether an internal feature is shared across a model family or specific to the target.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a new pretraining recipe, but it is useful for foundation-model research as a reusable way to compare internal representations across models. A reference atlas can expose how a new model uses already-interpreted features and can separately surface structure not covered by the reference panel. This is relevant to continual pretraining, instruction-tuning side effects, model comparison, hidden-objective detection, and safety audits. The residual channel is the most important design choice: it turns “outside the reference panel” into an explicit object that can be ranked, inspected, and intervened on.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method trains a reference feature atlas, a sparse feature library learned jointly over a panel of previously studied models. Once the atlas is trained and curated, a new target model is attached by fitting only a linear target decoder into the fixed atlas coordinates. This produces two audit views.
