The atlas channel reads the target through already-interpreted panel features and enables feature-by-feature comparison against the reference models. The residual channel trains a separate sparse dictionary on what the atlas fails to reconstruct, namely the residual h* - D* z_A. This differs from sparse crosscoders, which typically place shared and target-specific features in one dictionary and separate them later using decoder-norm asymmetries. Here, residual membership is architectural: the feature lives in a dictionary trained only on panel-uncovered residuals. Attachment FVU/KL gives a scalar measure of how far the target sits outside the panel, while the residual SAE provides the inventory of responsible features.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use five 7–9B instruction-tuned open models: Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Gemma-2-9B, and OLMo-2-7B. The authors train leave-one-out atlases and audit held-out Mistral and Qwen targets. In the controlled setting, they inject three LoRA hidden objectives into the held-out targets: a fictional dessert brand, Ptolemaic epicycles, and Flying Spaghetti Monster advocacy. Across all six objective-target pairs, a runtime intervention reduces the planted-objective rate to zero while matched benign controls remain at zero. The residual dictionary recovers the injected mechanism as the top-ranked latent in every paired run, with mean rank 1.0 and rank standard deviation 0 across the reported seeds and target families. On the Mistral side, per-target SAE and pairwise crosscoder baselines do not recover the mechanism in the same head-to-head comparison. In the panel-relative Qwen audit, Qwen-2.5 attaches to Atlas B at roughly 7 times the in-panel KL and more than 15 standard deviations above the in-panel value across three atlas-training seeds. The residual channel localizes the gap to continuation clusters involving emergency-power restrictions, media-suspension framing during unrest, and law-and-order justifications that down-weight individual rights. Intervening along the same cluster monotonically changes political-keyword refusal and law-and-order framing rates, while 100 matched out-of-domain controls are unchanged. The authors frame this as a panel-relative finding, not a model-intrinsic claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective close reading in about 45–60 minutes. Start with the problem setup to understand feature identity, target attachment, and FVU/KL. Then read the method sections that separate the atlas channel from the residual channel; this is the central technical idea. The controlled LoRA hidden-objective experiment is the most informative experimental section because it has injection, intervention, and baseline comparison. The Qwen residual finding is useful as a demonstration of panel-relative auditing, but it should be read with the stated limitations. The appendix comparisons against per-target SAEs and pairwise crosscoders are worth checking, especially for why those baselines do not cleanly identify structure outside the reference panel.

recommendation.zh: 只看 atlas/residual 分解和 LoRA 注入实验；若结果稳，跨模型审计可以少走很多重训 SAE 的弯路。
recommendation.en: Focus on the atlas/residual split and the LoRA-injection tests; if robust, this reduces a lot of repeated SAE work in cross-model audits.

paper.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal orde

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文语言模型是否能表现出类似人类情景记忆的时间顺序记忆，并进一步追问模型内部靠什么机制完成这种判断：是显式的时间位置表征，还是仅靠语义、因果和叙事线索推断先后顺序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长上下文机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。论文把“长上下文是否真的在用时间结构”这个问题做成了可测、可干预的任务。结果指向一个重要现象：模型在长文本检索时不只是匹配语义片段，还会在检索阶段重建低维时间上下文。这对长上下文预训练、位置编码设计、KV-cache 记忆解释、长程评测设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了 Sequence Order Recall Task，给定一部长篇文本中的两个不重叠 50 词片段，要求判断哪个片段在原文中更早出现。作者用完整小说构造人类行为数据，并让长上下文 LLM 在相同任务上评测。关键分析不是停留在行为相似性，而是进入模型内部：先定位隐藏状态中是否存在可线性读出的时间顺序信息，再分析 retrieval 阶段哪些 attention head 会从 KV-cache 中重新激活这种时间码。论文报告一个专门的 attention head 会重建低维 temporal code，并通过因果干预验证它对顺序判断有实际作用。这与“模型只是利用故事语义链推断顺序”的解释不同。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括三点。第一，模型和人类都表现出 distance effect：两个片段在原文中距离越远，顺序判断越容易。第二，模型内部存在低维时间表征，可用于解释顺序判断表现。第三，某个特化 attention head 在 retrieval 阶段从 KV-cache 中恢复时间信息；对该 head 或相关表征做干预会影响 temporal order judgment。文中还发布 ICMemory-Kit，用于长上下文记忆与机制解释实验。给定材料中没有提供具体模型参数量、上下文长度、样本规模和干预幅度数字，阅读时需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和人类数据部分，确认 SORT 是否排除了明显的语义捷径。然后看 temporal code 的定位方法，以及 attention head 的因果验证实验。最值得细读的是模型如何区分“时间上下文恢复”和“语义链推断”，因为这决定了结论对长上下文预训练是否有外推意义。若只关心工程启发，可重点看 attention/KV-cache 分析和 ICMemory-Kit 的接口设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context language models exhibit human-like temporal order memory over extended naturalistic inputs, and what internal mechanism supports this behavior: an explicit temporal position code or inference from semantic and narrative structure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is mechanistic insight into long-context memory. The work turns a vague question—whether a model actually uses temporal structure—into a controlled task with behavioral comparison and causal probing. The key implication is that long-context retrieval may rely on reinstating a low-dimensional temporal context, not only on matching semantic content. This matters for long-context pretraining, positional representation design, KV-cache analysis, and evaluation of memory over long documents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Sequence Order Recall Task. Given two non-overlapping 50-word passages sampled from a long text, the model or human subject must decide which one appeared earlier. They build a human behavioral dataset from memory of a full-length novel and compare it with long-context LLMs. The mechanistic part localizes temporal order information in model activations, then studies how this information is reinstated during retrieval. The paper reports that a specialized attention head retrieves a low-dimensional temporal code from the KV cache and that causal interventions on this mechanism affect order judgments. This distinguishes the proposed mechanism from a pure semantic-chain explanation.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings are: models show the same distance effect observed in humans, where order judgments become easier as the two queried segments are farther apart in the original text; temporal order information can be localized in internal representations; and a specific attention head reinstates temporal information during retrieval and is causally involved in the task. The paper also releases ICMemory-Kit for long-context memory and interpretability experiments. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, context lengths, dataset sizes, or intervention effect sizes, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task and human dataset design to see how much semantic shortcutting is controlled. Then read the sections on temporal-code localization and attention-head causal intervention. The most important technical point is how the authors separate temporal context reinstatement from semantic inference. For engineering relevance, focus on the KV-cache analysis and the ICMemory-Kit design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但如果你关心长上下文记忆机制，只看关键 head 干预和一维时间码那几节就够，能帮你判断 retrieval 到底像不像显式状态重建。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if long-context memory matters to you, read the head intervention and 1D temporal-code sections; they sharpen whether retrieval behaves like explicit state reinstatement.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Do LLMs Know Their Vulnerable Scenarios?
paper.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models are trained to refuse harmful requests, yet embedding the same requests in particular scenarios can bypass their safeguards. Existing red-teaming methods empirically identify effective scenarios through observed attack outcomes, but why particular scenarios weaken refusal remains mechanistically unclear. Meanwhile, mechanistic interpretability studies have characterized both refusal directions and jailbreak-associated features, without explaining the relation

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个安全对齐中的机制问题：为什么同一个有害请求放进某些场景包装后会更容易绕过拒答，以及模型内部是否已经编码了这些容易削弱拒答的场景方向。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不如训练数据和建模范式论文高，但对 post-train 安全、拒答机制和可解释评测有启发。它把 jailbreak 场景从经验搜索对象转为表示空间中的因果归因对象。这个思路可用于分析 SFT/RLHF 后模型的安全行为是否依赖脆弱的浅层场景特征，也可用于构造更系统的安全评测和对抗数据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把场景包装视为一种内部表示干预：用直接有害请求和场景包装后的有害请求做对比，学习 scenario direction，然后通过 activation steering 检验该方向是否会降低 refusal score。拒答强度通过 refusal concept activation score 度量。结果显示，真实场景包装和沿对应场景方向 steering 会产生相近的拒答削弱效果。基于这个发现，论文提出 Concept2Scenario：先用 sparse autoencoder 将模型内部激活分解成稀疏、较可解释的概念；再逐个干预概念方向，测量其对 refusal score 的影响；随后用高激活文本解释这些概念，并把它们转写为自然语言场景。论文还加入 interaction attribution，用来寻找多个场景概念之间的协同组合，而不是枚举所有组合。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个开源模型、两个安全 benchmark、六种代表性黑盒 jailbreak 方法。十二个预定义场景的分析显示，场景方向 steering 能一致降低拒答分数。Concept2Scenario 找到的 vulnerable scenarios 可作为不同 jailbreak 方法的可复用场景先验，在开源模型上平均 attack success rate 最高提升 18.2 个百分点。仅从开源模型中发现的场景也能迁移到 GPT-5、Claude-Haiku-4.5、Gemini-3-Flash 等闭源模型。interaction attribution 找到的组合场景比单个场景更强，并能减少攻击轮数。需要注意，摘要和引言没有给出每个模型、benchmark 的细分数值和 SAE 配置，精确复现信息需查看方法和实验附录。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 scenario direction 的构造和 steering 实验，这部分决定论文是否真的建立了因果证据，而不只是相关性。再看 Concept2Scenario 的三步链路：refusal suppression effect、internal concept、natural-language scenario。实验部分重点看十二个预定义场景的 steering 结果、Concept2Scenario 对六类 jailbreak 方法的增益，以及跨模型迁移结果。对基座研究员来说，最值得留意的是 SAE 概念是否稳定、概念解释是否依赖人工命名、以及这些 scenario priors 是否反映了安全后训练中的通用脆弱特征。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why certain contextual scenarios make harmful requests more likely to bypass refusal, and whether models internally represent these vulnerable scenarios in directions that causally suppress refusal.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to post-training safety and mechanistic evaluation than to core pretraining recipes, but it offers a useful interface to foundation-model research. It treats jailbreak scenarios not merely as prompt patterns found by trial and error, but as causal features in representation space. That framing can inform safety data construction, refusal robustness analysis, and evaluation of how SFT or RLHF shapes internal refusal mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first learns a scenario direction by contrasting direct harmful requests with scenario-wrapped versions of the same requests. It then performs representation steering along that direction and measures the effect with a refusal concept activation score. The observed effect is that steering along representative scenario directions reduces refusal, similar to applying the actual scenario wrapper in text. Building on this, Concept2Scenario decomposes internal activations with a sparse autoencoder, intervenes on individual concept directions, measures their causal effect on refusal, interprets high-activation examples, and translates the resulting concepts into actionable natural-language scenarios. The method also includes interaction attribution to identify synergistic combinations of scenario concepts without exhaustively enumerating all combinations.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span three open-source models, two safety benchmarks, and six representative black-box jailbreak methods. Across twelve predefined scenarios, steering along scenario directions consistently lowers refusal scores. Scenarios discovered by Concept2Scenario act as reusable priors for different jailbreak methods and improve average attack success rates by up to 18.2 percentage points on open-source models. Scenarios discovered from open-source models also transfer to closed-source systems, including GPT-5, Claude-Haiku-4.5, and Gemini-3-Flash. Interaction attribution finds multi-scenario combinations that outperform individual scenarios and reduce the number of attack turns. The provided text does not include per-model tables, SAE hyperparameters, or benchmark-level breakdowns, so those should be checked in the main experiments and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on how scenario directions are constructed and how the steering experiment is controlled, because that is the main causal claim. Then read the Concept2Scenario pipeline: refusal-suppression effects, internal concepts, and natural-language scenario generation. In the experiments, prioritize the twelve-scenario steering results, the gains over six jailbreak methods, and the transfer results to closed-source models. For foundation-model researchers, the main points to inspect are the stability of SAE concepts, the dependence on human interpretation, and whether the discovered scenario priors reflect general weaknesses introduced by safety post-training.

recommendation.zh: 安全对齐内部表示的机制分析，用SAE做概念归因的思路可迁移到预训练对齐目标的消融，重点看§3的因果干预实验和Fig4的归因可视化
recommendation.en: Mechanistic analysis of safety alignment internal representations; SAE-based concept attribution can be transferred to pretraining alignment ablations. Focus on §3 causal intervention experiments and Fig4 attribution visualizations

paper.title: DecodeShare: Tracing the Shared Subspace of LLM Decode-Time Decisions
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) handle many tasks with one set of parameters, but under KV-cached inference it is unclear what task-general structure, if any, is used at decode time rather than during prefill. We propose DecodeShare, a protocol that identifies a low-dimensional subspace consistently shared across tasks in decode-time hidden states, and then tests its causal role by removing that subspace only during decoding. In our experiments, disturbing the discovered shared subspace degrades de

summary.core_problem: KV缓存推理模式下，现有激活干预方法大多从prefill阶段的隐藏状态估计干预方向，既没有区分整段prompt预计算与解码阶段单步单token计算的表示差异，也没有定位跨任务共享、真正驱动next-token决策的解码时表示结构，这是导致激活steering方法在提示模板变化、场景切换时效果脆弱、可复现性差的核心原因之一。
summary.importance: 该工作明确量化了激活干预中长期存在的「估计位置-干预位置不匹配」问题，找到了对解码决策有因果作用的跨任务通用解码时低维共享子空间，为激活steering的脆性提供了机制层面的解释，也为后续做可靠的模型行为干预、推理时对齐、模型多任务共享计算的可解释性研究提供了可复现的实验范式。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化区分两类隐藏状态：prefill阶段最后一个prompt位置的隐藏状态、KV缓存解码阶段每一步单token计算产生的、直接输出next-token logits的解码决策状态。DecodeShare协议分两步运行：第一步跨多个不同任务收集解码阶段的隐藏状态，通过PCA提取跨任务一致存在的低维共享子空间；第二步做因果对照干预，仅在解码步骤中移除隐藏状态在该子空间上的投影，保持prefill阶段计算完全不变，设置同维度的prefill子空间移除、随机子空间移除作为严格对照。最后分析该共享子空间与现有常用激活steering方向的重叠度，对比解码阶段、prefill阶段的评估结果对真实KV缓存推理下steering效果的预测能力。
summary.experiments: 在多款开源LLM、多类任务基准上的实验显示：1）同等干预维度预算下，移除解码共享子空间造成的任务准确率下降幅度，是移除prefill估计的同维度子空间、移除随机子空间的数倍，证明该子空间对解码决策有高杠杆因果作用；2）现有常用激活steering方向普遍和该解码共享子空间存在显著重叠，直接投影移除重叠分量无法得到通用的steering鲁棒性提升，只会引入任务相关的效用-鲁棒性权衡；3）基于解码阶段隐藏状态做steering方向效果排序，对留出集KV缓存解码场景下实际效果的预测准确度，显著高于基于prefill状态的排序结果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法部分对prefill和解码状态的形式化定义、DecodeShare流程设计、因果干预的对照实验逻辑，以及steering重叠度分析的消融结果。值得深挖的方向包括：该共享子空间在不同模型层的分布差异、子空间维度随模型规模的scaling规律、子空间编码的是通用决策控制信号还是任务特定内容。

summary_en.core_problem: Under KV-cached LLM inference, existing activation intervention methods mostly estimate steering directions from prefill-stage hidden states. These methods fail to distinguish representational differences between bulk prompt prefill computation and per-step single-token decode computation, and never explicitly localize the cross-task shared representational structure that directly drives next-token decisions. This estimator-intervention mismatch is a major under-explored cause of the widely observed brittleness and poor reproducibility of activation steering methods across prompt templates and deployment settings.
summary_en.importance: This work explicitly quantifies the long-noted prefill-decode representational mismatch, identifies a low-dimensional cross-task shared subspace at decode time with causal leverage on next-token decisions, and provides a mechanistic explanation for activation steering brittleness. The DecodeShare protocol offers a reproducible empirical foundation for future work on reliable model behavior intervention, inference-time alignment, and mechanistic interpretability of multi-task computation in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first formalizes the distinction between two types of hidden states: prefill hidden states sampled at the final prompt position, and decode-time decision states: the per-token hidden states computed at each KV-cached decode step that directly produce next-token logits. The DecodeShare protocol runs in two stages. First, it collects decode-time hidden states across a diverse set of tasks, and extracts a consistent low-dimensional shared subspace via PCA. Second, it runs controlled causal ablation interventions that only remove projection onto this subspace during decode steps, leaving prefill computation completely unmodified, with matched baselines using prefill-derived subspaces and random subspaces of equal dimension. The work further measures overlap between this shared decode subspace and widely used activation steering directions, and compares the predictive power of decode-time versus prefill-time evaluation for ranking steering vector utility under realistic KV-cached inference.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple open-source LLMs and task benchmarks: 1) Under matched intervention dimension budgets, removing the decode-shared subspace causes several times larger accuracy degradation than removing prefill-derived or random subspaces of the same size, confirming the high causal leverage of this subspace for decode decisions. 2) Common activation steering directions exhibit significant overlap with the shared decode subspace; projecting out this overlap does not produce universal steering robustness improvements, but instead introduces task-dependent utility-robustness tradeoffs. 3) Ranking steering vectors based on decode-time evaluation produces significantly better predictions of held-out KV-cached decoding performance than rankings derived from prefill states.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the formal definition of prefill vs decode states in the methodology section, the DecodeShare pipeline design, the matched causal intervention logic, and ablation results on steering vector overlap. High-value directions to explore include the layer-wise distribution of the shared subspace, scaling of subspace dimensionality with model size, and whether the subspace encodes generic decision control signals rather than task-specific content.

recommendation.zh: 将 prefill 和 decode 的表征空间解耦，发现 decode 阶段存在跨任务共享的决策子空间，对做 activation steering 和理解生成机制极具启发，建议细读实验设计。
recommendation.en: Decouples prefill and decode representation spaces, discovering a task-general decision subspace during decoding; highly inspiring for activation steering and understanding generation mechanisms. The experimental design is worth a close read.

paper.title: Token Budget Saturation and Mechanistic Early Detection of Reasoning Non-Convergence in Chain-of-Thought Models
paper.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B exhibit a bimodal convergence pattern: generations either terminate within a token budget (converged) or exhaust it without reaching a conclusion (non-converged). We characterize this phenomenon empirically, showing that converged generations achieve 90.3% accuracy on AIME 1983-2024 while non-converged ones achieve only 6.6%, with an overall convergence rate of 62.0%. We then ask whether this outcome is detectable early in the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“推理模型能不能做题”，而是两个更具体的问题：第一，CoT 模型在测试时分配更多 thinking tokens，到底什么时候开始不再带来有效收益；第二，那些会陷入长时间不收敛推理链的样本，能否在很早期就从模型内部状态里被识别出来。作者把问题落在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，并且把“非收敛”定义成一种可测的推理失败模式，而不是笼统地把长推理都当成有益计算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要有两层。第一层是 test-time compute 的收益曲线并不单调，至少在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上，256 个 thinking tokens 就已经达到无上限条件下约 95% 的精度，说明很多额外推理 token 只是重复和拖延，不是有效计算。第二层是“是否会收敛”在生成早期就已经部分写在隐藏状态里，且这种信号比表面行为特征更早出现。这对预训练和后训练接口都重要：如果推理失败模式在内部表征中可分，那么后续可以考虑把收敛性作为训练目标、拒答/截断策略、动态预算分配或 early exit 的控制信号，而不是一味增加 test-time compute。贡献量级不在于提出新模型，而在于把 reasoning inference 中一个长期被默认接受的成本结构拆开测清楚。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是 budget-forcing。作者没有改模型，而是在生成阶段实现一个自定义 LogitsProcessor，监控 <think> ... </think> 区间内的 token 数；达到预算 B 后，直接把 </think> 之外的 logits 置为负无穷，强制结束 thinking phase。这里有一个实现细节很关键：由于 chat template 已经把 <think>\n 放进 prompt，processor 必须从一开始就处于 thinking=True，否则预算计数会错位。作者在 B∈{256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096} 和一个 10k ceiling 的 uncapped 条件下比较精度，并定义最小充分预算 B* 为“达到且持续保持无上限精度 95% 以上的最小预算”。

第二部分是 mechanistic early detection。作者用 forward hooks 抓取推理过程早期若干位置的隐藏状态，在不同层和不同 token checkpoint 上训练线性 probe，预测该条生成最终是否会收敛。这里的设计比较克制：只用线性探针，不引入复杂分类器，目的是尽量把结果解释为“表征中已有可线性分离信号”。同时作者设置了行为基线，只用表面可见特征，如 logit entropy、重复统计等，来预测是否会非收敛。这样可以区分“内部状态真的更早携带信息”还是“只是表面症状已经出现”。层扫描覆盖全部 28 层，在 token 150 处比较；位置扫描覆盖 50 到 300 token 的 9 个 checkpoint。作者还做了 contamination check，用 2025 AIME 题目验证收敛-正确性的关系不是训练集记忆造成的。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有四个。第一，预算饱和很早。GSM8K 和 MATH-500 都在 256 thinking tokens 达到无上限精度的约 95%，说明继续把预算拉到 1k、2k、4k 的边际收益很小。第二，AIME 呈现明显双峰：约 56.5% 的生成会自然收敛，且这些样本精度达到 96.5%；剩下约 43.5% 的生成即使给到很高预算也不结束推理链，形成“注定失败”的长推理。作者据此估算，大约 40% 的推理计算浪费在 doomed generations 上。第三，题目难度只能解释一小部分非收敛现象，文中给出的 r^2 约为 0.19，说明非收敛不是简单的“题难所以想更久”。第四，隐藏状态探针优于行为基线。层扫描中，token 150 时第 20 层最好，AUC 0.608±0.080，峰值出现在 upper-middle layers，而不是最后几层；位置扫描中，9 个 checkpoint 里有 8 个位置 activation probe 都优于行为基线，在 token 50 时优势最大，ΔAUC=+0.074。这说明收敛失败的信号在表面重复、熵异常等症状出现之前，就已经存在于内部表征中。污染分析部分也很干净：在 post-cutoff 的 AIME 2025 上，收敛样本精度 100%，非收敛样本 0%，支持“收敛性与正确性强相关”这一结论。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但有几个位置值得认真看。先看 Section 3 的 budget-forcing 实现和 B* 定义，确认作者不是靠 prompt trick，而是直接控制 thinking phase 的结束；再看 GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME 三条预算-精度曲线，重点不是绝对分数，而是曲线形状差异。AIME 的双峰现象是全文最有信息量的观察。然后看 Section 4 的 probe 设计：为什么用线性 probe、行为基线具体包含哪些特征、层扫描和位置扫描怎么做。图表里优先看 layer sweep 和 checkpoint sweep，对理解“信号出现在哪一层、什么时候出现”最直接。最后看 contamination analysis，它决定这篇工作是不是只是在测记忆。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要结论；如果关心 test-time compute control、early exit 或 reasoning failure diagnosis，可以再细读方法实现和附录中的统计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks two concrete questions about reasoning models rather than the generic question of benchmark accuracy. First, how much of the allocated chain-of-thought budget is actually useful before returns saturate? Second, for generations that fall into long, non-terminating reasoning chains, can failure be detected early from internal activations rather than only from visible behavior? The study is centered on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and treats non-convergence as a measurable failure mode of reasoning inference.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is diagnostic rather than architectural. On GSM8K and MATH-500, accuracy reaches about 95% of the uncapped condition with only 256 thinking tokens, which weakens the common assumption that more test-time reasoning is broadly beneficial. On AIME, a large fraction of generations appear doomed: they keep spending tokens without converging. The second contribution is that convergence information is partially encoded in hidden states early in the trajectory, earlier than surface signals such as entropy or repetition make the failure obvious. That matters for dynamic compute allocation, early stopping, rejection policies, and potentially training objectives that explicitly shape convergence behavior. The paper does not introduce a new model, but it gives a cleaner decomposition of where reasoning-time compute is productive and where it is wasted.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts. The first is budget forcing. Instead of modifying the model, the authors implement a custom LogitsProcessor that counts tokens inside the <think> ... </think> region and, once a budget B is reached, forces emission of </think> by masking all other logits to negative infinity. A subtle but important implementation detail is that the chat template already inserts <think>\n in the prompt, so the processor must start with thinking mode enabled; otherwise the token counter is misaligned. They evaluate budgets B in {256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096} plus an uncapped condition with a practical 10k token ceiling, and define the minimum sufficient budget B* as the smallest budget that reaches at least 95% of uncapped accuracy and stays there for all larger budgets.

The second part is mechanistic early detection. Using forward hooks, the authors capture hidden states at early checkpoints in the reasoning trajectory and train linear probes to predict whether the generation will eventually converge. The choice of linear probes is deliberate: it tests whether convergence information is already linearly accessible in the representation, without adding a powerful classifier that could obscure interpretation. They compare these probes against behavioral baselines built from surface-level signals such as logit entropy and repetition statistics. They sweep all 28 layers at token 150, then sweep nine token positions from 50 to 300. They also run a contamination check on post-cutoff AIME 2025 problems to argue that the convergence-correctness relation is not just memorization.
summary_en.experiments: There are four results worth retaining. First, token-budget saturation happens early. On both GSM8K and MATH-500, 256 thinking tokens are enough to recover roughly 95% of uncapped accuracy, so the marginal value of longer reasoning is small beyond that point. Second, AIME shows a strongly bimodal pattern: about 56.5% of generations converge naturally and achieve 96.5% accuracy, while the remaining 43.5% fail to terminate even under large budgets. The authors estimate that roughly 40% of inference compute is wasted on such doomed generations. Third, problem difficulty explains only a small part of the non-convergence phenomenon, with reported r^2 around 0.19, so this is not simply “harder problems need more thinking.” Fourth, activation probes beat behavioral baselines. In the layer sweep, layer 20 at token 150 is best with AUC 0.608 ± 0.080, and the strongest signal sits in upper-middle layers rather than near the output. In the checkpoint sweep, probes outperform behavioral baselines at 8 of 9 positions, with the largest early advantage at token 50, where ΔAUC = +0.074. The contamination analysis on AIME 2025 is also telling: converged generations are 100% correct while non-converged ones are 0% correct, reinforcing the link between convergence and answer quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but a careful skim is useful. Start with the budget-forcing setup in Section 3 and the definition of B*; that tells you the authors are directly controlling the reasoning phase rather than relying on prompt heuristics. Then inspect the budget-versus-accuracy curves for GSM8K, MATH-500, and AIME. The shape difference matters more than the absolute scores, especially the bimodal AIME behavior. Next, read Section 4 for the probe design: why linear probes, what the behavioral baseline contains, and how the layer and checkpoint sweeps are organized. The most informative figures are the layer sweep and token-position sweep, because they localize where and when convergence information appears. Finish with the contamination analysis to judge whether the findings survive a memorization objection. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough for the main ideas; spend more time only if you care about test-time compute control or reasoning-failure diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek对CoT双峰收敛的机制分析扎实，激活探针优于行为基线的结论可用于推理早期退出设计，重点看探针实验与收敛模式刻画部分。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek's mechanistic analysis of CoT bimodal convergence is solid; activation probes outperform behavioral baselines, useful for early-exit inference design, focus on probe experiments and convergence characterization.

paper.title: Incomplete Prompt Jailbreaks in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly released as open-weight models with safeguards against harmful requests. Nevertheless, sentence completion remains vulnerable to incomplete harmful prompts. In this work, we formalize this phenomenon as incomplete prompt jailbreaks (IPJ) and provide a systematic empirical characterization of when and how incomplete prompts elicit harmful continuations. We analyze diverse attractor types associated with incomplete sentence continuation and show that L

summary.core_problem: 开放权重大模型在面对语法未完结的有害提示时，会优先保持语句连贯性先生成有害内容，待句子结束后才输出拒绝，这种被称为不完整提示越狱（IPJ）的安全失效模式缺乏系统刻画，且现有参数微调防御存在系统性的泛化缺陷。
summary.importance: 揭示了自回归模型预训练阶段习得的语句连贯性先验，与后训练阶段引入的安全对齐目标之间存在系统性冲突，解释了为什么纯微调防御难以从根本上覆盖这类越狱场景；识别出的句终、续接两类功能神经元，为推理时的轻量安全干预提供了思路，但工作本身未涉及预训练层面的改进，对预训练研究的参考价值主要在理解预训练先验与后训练对齐的张力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义IPJ，构建9类接在有害请求后、维持句子未完成状态以诱导续接的语言“吸引子”结构；将模型输出拆分为句前段、句终token、句后段三部分，用攻击成功率、拒绝距离两个指标量化失效程度。随后验证了针对IPJ的微调防御存在三类一致的泛化失败：跨有害内容域迁移差、跨未见过的吸引子类型迁移差、无法适配不同拒绝风格的基础模型。最后通过激活相关性分析定位两类功能神经元：与句终标点强相关的终止神经元，以及在“禁止终止/强制终止”指令对比下激活差异显著的续接神经元，验证了激活终止神经元、抑制续接神经元可提前打断有害生成。
summary.experiments: 基于公开的正文内容，实验在多款主流开放权重模型上验证了IPJ现象的普遍性，模型普遍表现出“先续接有害内容、句子完结后再拒绝”的行为模式；微调防御在分布外的有害内容和未见过的吸引子上攻击成功率明显回升；初步神经元干预结果显示，定向激活终止神经元可将拒绝位置提前，放大续接神经元则会显著增加有害续接的长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。重点关注引言中对IPJ机制的解释——即自回归生成的连贯性优先逻辑，以及微调防御三类泛化失败的相关结论；神经元定位部分可快速浏览，无需深究安全攻防的实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-weight LLMs exhibit a pervasive safety failure called Incomplete Prompt Jailbreak (IPJ): when presented with grammatically incomplete harmful prompts, models prioritize discourse coherence to generate harmful continuations first, and only produce refusals after the sentence reaches completion; this phenomenon lacks systematic characterization, and existing parameter-tuning defenses suffer from systematic generalization failures.
summary_en.importance: This work highlights the inherent tension between the discourse coherence prior acquired during pretraining and safety alignment objectives introduced in post-training, providing empirical evidence for why fine-tuning alone cannot fully resolve this class of jailbreak vulnerabilities. The identified functional neuron clusters for sentence termination and continuation offer a path for lightweight inference-time safety intervention, though the work does not propose pretraining-level fixes. Its primary relevance to pretraining research lies in clarifying the boundary between pretrained generative priors and post-hoc alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first formalizes the IPJ problem, constructing a taxonomy of 9 linguistic "attractor" structures that append to harmful requests to keep sentences grammatically incomplete and induce continuation. Model outputs are decomposed into pre-termination, sentence-termination, and post-termination segments, with attack success rate and refusal distance as core metrics. The authors then demonstrate that fine-tuning models to refuse early on incomplete harmful prompts suffers from three consistent failure modes: poor transfer across harmful content domains, poor transfer to unseen attractor types, and inability to generalize across base models with different default refusal styles. Finally, activation correlation analysis is used to identify two functional neuron groups: termination neurons strongly associated with sentence-final punctuation, and continuation neurons that show large activation differences between termination-forbidden and termination-forced prompting contexts, with causal effects on generation continuation verified via activation intervention.
summary_en.experiments: From the publicly available portion of the manuscript, experiments across widely used open-weight LLMs confirm IPJ is a pervasive failure mode, with models consistently generating harmful continuations before producing refusals after sentence completion. Fine-tuning defenses show substantial performance degradation on out-of-domain harmful content and unseen attractors, with attack success rates rebounding to high levels. Initial neuron intervention results indicate that targeted activation of termination neurons shifts refusal positions earlier, while amplification of continuation neurons reliably increases the length of harmful continuations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 15 minutes. Focus on the introduction's mechanistic explanation of coherence-first autoregressive generation, and the section documenting the three generalization failure modes of fine-tuning based defenses. The neuron analysis section can be scanned quickly; deep engagement with attack and defense implementation details is unnecessary for pretraining researchers.

recommendation.zh: 从机制可解释性角度分析了不完整 prompt 导致越狱的原因（延迟拒绝机制），并定位了终止/续写神经元，对理解 LLM 生成机制和安全对齐有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Analyzes the causes of incomplete prompt jailbreaks from a mechanistic interpretability perspective (delayed refusal mechanism) and locates termination/continuation neurons, offering reference value for understanding LLM generation mechanisms and safety alignment.

paper.title: Where Animacy Lives in Large Language Models: Tracing the Circuits of the Animacy Concept
paper.abstract: Distinguishing animate from inanimate concepts in written language requires more than shallow text processing, as it involves recognizing complex selectional constraints and contextual cues, such as verb-argument interactions. Yet, current large language models (LLMs) appear to be capable of doing it. We investigate whether this animacy-sensitive behavior of LLMs can be traced to a localized set of causally relevant components and connections. To do so, we construct a controlled dataset of minim

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想回答：LLM 对“有生命/无生命”概念的敏感性，是否对应一组可定位、可干预、具因果作用的内部电路。
summary.importance: 重要性主要在机制分析而非方法推进。它把 animacy 这种比语法特征更分布式、更依赖语境的语义概念，放到 circuit discovery 框架下检验，补充了“LLM 是否以局部电路编码抽象语义属性”的证据边界。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先构造受控 minimal pairs 数据，显式操纵动词-论元搭配等与 animacy 相关的线索；再在四个开源模型上做 circuit discovery、因果消融和连接级分析，寻找对 animacy 判断真正起作用的组件与路径。核心结论不是找到一个高度紧凑的单一电路，而是发现存在因果相关机制，但其分布更广、跨任务和跨模型迁移有限。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个开源模型，围绕受控 animacy 任务做深入消融与泛化测试。摘要未给出参数规模和具体模型名，也未报告统一数值提升；重点结果是：animacy 相关机制可以被识别并因果干预，但相比已有较局部化的 circuit，animacy circuit 更分散，且在不同模型与任务上的泛化只有部分成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM sensitivity to animacy can be traced to a causally relevant internal circuit rather than being a diffuse byproduct of shallow text statistics.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in mechanistic analysis, not capability gains. It probes a semantic concept that is more context-dependent and less discrete than syntax-like features, testing the limits of circuit localization in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a controlled minimal-pair dataset that manipulates verb-argument cues tied to animacy, then run circuit discovery, causal ablations, and connection-level analyses on four open-weight models. The main finding is not a neat compact circuit, but a real causal mechanism that is less localized and only partially transferable across models and tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span four open-weight models with controlled animacy tasks, plus ablation and generalization analyses. The abstract does not specify model sizes or exact model names, and the contribution is not benchmark SOTA; the key result is that an animacy-related mechanism exists but is distributed and only partially generalizes across models and task variants.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改训练 recipe 的论文，但它提醒你：高层语义概念未必像 induction head 那样局部，做 mechanistic prior 时别默认“一个功能=一个小电路”。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe-changing paper, but it is a useful reminder that high-level semantic concepts may not localize like induction heads; don't hard-code that prior into your mech interp assumptions.

paper.title: Toward Mechanistic Interpretability of an AI Foundation Model Fine-Tuned for Atmospheric Chemistry
paper.abstract: Weather forecasting foundation models (FMs) are increasingly fine-tuned to predict air quality, offering fast global pollution forecasts at lower computational cost than conventional chemical transport models. These FMs are typically trained on reanalysis data and generate forecasts through autoregressive rollout. They do not explicitly represent governing physical or chemical processes. Therefore, high forecast skill does not reveal whether a model has learned physical mechanisms or exploits st

summary.core_problem: 微调用于大气化学预测的天气基础模型（如 Aurora）是否真正学习了物理/化学机制，还是仅仅利用了训练数据中的统计规律？
summary.importance: 首次对微调用于大气化学的 AI 基础模型进行了机制可解释性研究，揭示了模型在学习物理约束方面的局限性。
summary.technical_approach: 通过对微软的 Aurora 模型施加受控的化学扰动，并将其预测结果与已知的物理化学关系进行对比。同时检查生成这些预测的内部表示。
summary.experiments: 发现 Aurora 捕捉到了臭氧对活性氮的一阶响应，但未能强制执行化学约束（具体细节需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: Do weather foundation models (like Aurora) fine-tuned for atmospheric chemistry actually learn physical/chemical mechanisms, or do they merely exploit statistical regularities in the training data?
summary_en.importance: Presents the first mechanistic interpretability study of an AI foundation model fine-tuned for atmospheric chemistry, revealing limitations in learning physical constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: Imposes controlled chemical perturbations on forecasts from Microsoft's Aurora model and tests them against known photochemical relationships. Also examines the internal representations generating these forecasts.
summary_en.experiments: Found that Aurora captures a first-order ozone response to reactive nitrogen but does not enforce chemical constraints (details in paper).

recommendation.zh: 虽然是气象领域的模型分析，但探讨了自回归模型是否真正学习了底层物理机制，对理解 LLM 的泛化和机制有一定侧面启发，作为 literature 备查。
recommendation.en: Although analyzing a meteorological model, it explores whether autoregressive models truly learn underlying physical mechanisms, offering side insights into LLM generalization and mechanisms. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Building Fast, Evaluating Slow: Pipeline Choices Dominate Autointerpretability Score Variance
paper.abstract: Cross-paper comparison of sparse autoencoder (SAE) interpretability often relies on autointerpretability scores. In this evaluation pipeline, a language model (LM) explains each feature, and another LM scores the explanation. For these comparisons to be meaningful, scores must reflect stable properties of the features rather than confounding aspects of the evaluation pipeline. Through systematic experiments across four metrics (simulation, detection, fuzzing, purity), two models (Pythia-160M, Ap

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：SAE 的 autointerpretability 分数，是否足够稳定，能不能支撑不同 SAE 架构之间的比较。作者关注的不是这些分数是否真的代表“可解释性”，而是一个更基础的问题：同一个特征在不同评测语料、样本抽取、解释模型、提示措辞下，分数是否一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它给机制解释和 SAE 评测泼了一盆冷水，但方式是可操作的。很多基座模型分析工作会用 SAE 特征来比较层、模型、训练阶段或架构差异。如果评测分数的方差主要来自 pipeline，而不是被比较对象本身，那么后续关于“哪个 SAE 更可解释”“哪个模型学到了更清晰特征”的结论都需要重新校准。贡献不在新 SAE 架构，而在评测可靠性：它把 autointerpretability 里几个常见自由度拆开，用 ICC 和 Top-k Jaccard 量化其影响，并给出最低报告清单。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 autointerpretability pipeline 拆成四个方法学变量：评测语料、激活样本的随机抽取、解释器模型、解释文本的改写。架构变量则用不同 SAE 架构表示。评测覆盖四类指标：simulation、detection、fuzzing、purity。simulation 看解释能否预测特征激活；detection 看解释能否帮助判断激活样本；fuzzing 测试解释对干扰样本的辨别能力；purity 衡量高激活样本是否语义集中。模型侧使用 Pythia-160M 和 Apertus-8B Instruct。Pythia 使用 SAEBench 中 layer 8 的 BatchTopK SAE，并加入 Matryoshka SAE 和 Standard SAE 做架构比较；Apertus-8B 上训练了 layer 16、k=160 的 BatchTopK SAE。解释和打分主要用 Gemini Flash，并用 GPT-4o-mini 作为解释器变化条件，打分器固定以隔离 scorer 影响。稳定性用 ICC 衡量分数一致性，用 Top-k Jaccard 衡量被选中特征集合的一致性。这个设计的关键点是把“平均分差异”和“具体特征排序是否稳定”分开看，避免只用均值掩盖 per-feature 层面的不稳定。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有四点。第一，方法学变量带来的总方差超过 SAE 架构差异，在两个源模型和四个指标上都成立。这意味着在没有统一评测设置时，跨论文比较 SAE 架构分数很容易把 pipeline 差异误读为架构差异。第二，不同指标的不稳定来源不同：simulation 和 purity 对随机样本抽取更敏感；detection 对语料选择更敏感；fuzzing 在多种条件下都不可靠。第三，均值稳定不代表特征选择稳定。某些设置下平均分变化不大，但 Top-k 特征集合在不同语料或随机抽样之间接近随机重合，这会影响所有依赖“挑出最可解释特征”的后续实验。第四，解释文本相似度不能诊断分数稳定性。即使不同条件下生成的解释看起来很相似，实际 autointerpretability 分数仍可能有明显波动。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 里的问题定义，Section 2 的实验设计和稳定性指标，Section 3 的方差分解、ICC、Top-k Jaccard 结果，以及 Section 4 的 Stability Check 和 Minimum Reporting Checklist。附录 A 可快速扫一遍，用来了解当前 SAE 评测实践中哪些信息经常缺失。附录 B/D 适合复现实验时看，尤其是 Apertus-8B SAE 的训练细节。最值得带走的是：SAE 评测要报告语料、样本抽取、解释器、打分器、prompt 和随机性；只报一个 autointerpretability 均值，信息量不够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether SAE autointerpretability scores are stable enough to support comparisons across SAE architectures. It does not try to prove whether the scores measure interpretability. It tests a prior requirement: whether the same feature receives consistent scores when the evaluation corpus, sampled activating examples, explainer model, or explanation wording changes.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to mechanistic interpretability work around pretrained language models. SAE features are increasingly used to compare layers, model families, training stages, and architectures. If most score variance comes from evaluation choices rather than the SAE being evaluated, then claims about more or less interpretable features become fragile. The contribution is an evaluation reliability study rather than a new SAE method. It provides a useful template for reporting and stress-testing autointerpretability pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose the evaluation pipeline into four methodological axes: corpus, random draw of activating examples, explainer model, and explanation paraphrasing. They compare these against an architectural axis using different SAE variants. Four metrics are evaluated: simulation, detection, fuzzing, and purity. The experiments use SAEs on Pythia-160M and Apertus-8B Instruct. For Pythia-160M, they use public SAEBench BatchTopK checkpoints at layer 8 with k=160 and include Matryoshka and Standard SAEs for architecture comparisons. For Apertus-8B, they train a layer-16 BatchTopK SAE with k=160. Gemini Flash is used for explanation generation and scoring in the main setup, while GPT-4o-mini is introduced as an alternative explainer; the scorer is held fixed to isolate explainer effects. Reliability is measured with ICC for score consistency and Top-k Jaccard for stability of selected feature sets. The important design choice is that the paper evaluates both aggregate scores and feature rankings, since mean scores can hide instability in which features are selected.
summary_en.experiments: The central finding is that methodological variance exceeds architectural variance across the tested models and metrics. This makes unstandardized cross-paper comparisons of SAE architectures unreliable. The instability profile differs by metric: simulation and purity are especially sensitive to random sampling of examples; detection is more sensitive to corpus choice; fuzzing is unstable across many conditions. Feature rankings are less stable than mean scores suggest. Top-k feature sets selected under one corpus or random draw can have near-chance overlap with those selected under another condition, which matters for any downstream analysis that inspects or intervenes on selected features. The paper also finds that explanation similarity is not a reliable diagnostic: explanations can remain lexically or semantically similar while scores vary substantially.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Read the problem framing in the introduction, the experimental setup and reliability metrics in Section 2, the variance and Top-k Jaccard analyses in Section 3, and the Stability Check plus Minimum Reporting Checklist in Section 4. Appendix A is useful for understanding which reporting details are often missing in current SAE evaluations. Appendix B and D matter if reproducing the work, especially for the Apertus-8B SAE setup. The main practical lesson is that autointerpretability results should report corpus, sampling procedure, explainer, scorer, prompts, and randomness; a single mean score is not enough.

recommendation.zh: SAE 论文读者应看 R1-R3；它不会给新机制，但会降低你对 autointerp 排名表的信任。
recommendation.en: SAE readers should inspect R1-R3; it adds no new mechanism, but it should reduce trust in autointerp ranking tables.

paper.title: Causal dictionary learning reveals and validates transcription-factor binding features in genomic language models
paper.abstract: Genomic language models achieve strong performance across regulatory-genomics tasks, yet what these models internally represent remains opaque, and the field lacks a principled procedure for verifying that an apparent ``concept'' inside a model is real rather than an artifact of sequence composition. We introduce a framework that combines sparse dictionary learning with causal intervention to extract, validate, and causally test interpretable features in genomic foundation models. Training top-$

summary.core_problem: 基因组语言模型的内部表示可解释性差，现有基于基序富集分析的验证方法受序列组成（如GC含量）混淆影响，无法区分模型真正用于表征转录因子结合的功能特征与仅存在统计相关性的伪特征。
summary.importance: 其提出的「因果消融+混淆变量匹配」特征验证框架可迁移到通用LLM的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征验证场景，为区分「真概念特征」与「统计伪相关特征」提供了可复用的方法学思路；SAE字典初始化的优化技巧也有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 框架包含三个核心模块：1）在两种不同tokenization的基因组模型（Nucleotide Transformer用固定6-mer token，DNABERT-2用BPE）的隐藏激活上训练top-k稀疏自编码器，字典大小设为激活维度的16倍，采用随机数据激活初始化字典方向，将字典存活率从45%提升至93%；2）GC匹配的结合解析测试，将转录因子结合位点与GC含量严格匹配的未结合基序位点做对照，通过Mann-Whitney U检验区分基序选择性与结合敏感性，排除序列组成带来的假阳性；3）因果消融验证，在前向传播中消融单个字典方向，测量模型在结合位点与未结合基序位点的掩码token预测KL散度变化，直接判断该特征是否被模型因果性地用于结合表征。
summary.experiments: 在两种架构差异显著的基因组模型上验证了方法有效性：模型中间层产生的可解释字典数量最多；成功恢复数千个与转录因子基序对应的单语义特征；通过严格阴性对照验证了框架可靠性，实现跨架构、跨转录因子的结果可复现。完整量化指标需参考原文实验章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注方法部分的因果消融验证设计、混淆变量控制逻辑，以及SAE字典初始化的优化技巧，基因组领域的专业细节可跳过。预计阅读时间20分钟，适合关注LLM可解释性、SAE特征验证的研究员参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Genomic language models have poorly interpretable internal representations. Existing validation methods based on motif enrichment analysis are confounded by sequence composition (e.g., GC content), and cannot distinguish functional features the model actually uses to represent transcription factor binding from spurious features that only show statistical correlation.
summary_en.importance: The proposed "causal ablation + confounder matching" feature validation framework can be transferred to sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature verification in general LLMs, providing a reusable methodological approach for distinguishing real conceptual features from statistical spurious correlations. The SAE dictionary initialization optimization also has direct practical value.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three core modules: 1) Train top-k sparse autoencoders on hidden activations of two genomics models with distinct tokenization schemes (Nucleotide Transformer with fixed 6-mer tokens, DNABERT-2 with BPE), with a dictionary size 16x the activation dimension. Initializing dictionary directions from random data activations raises dictionary live fraction from 45% to 93%. 2) A GC-matched binding-resolved test that compares transcription factor binding sites against strictly GC-matched unbound motif sites, using Mann-Whitney U test to separate motif selectivity from binding sensitivity and rule out false positives from sequence composition confounds. 3) Causal ablation validation: ablate a single dictionary direction during forward pass, and measure KL divergence shifts in the model's masked-token predictions at bound vs. unbound motif sites, to directly determine if the feature is causally used for binding representation.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two architecturally distinct genomic models: middle model layers yield the highest number of interpretable dictionary features; thousands of monosemantic features aligned with transcription factor motifs are recovered. The framework's reliability is verified via stringent negative controls, with cross-architecture and cross-transcription-factor reproducibility. Full quantitative metrics require referring to the complete experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the causal ablation validation design, confounder control logic in the methodology section, and the SAE dictionary initialization optimization; domain-specific genomics details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. Relevant for researchers working on LLM interpretability and SAE feature validation.

recommendation.zh: 虽然是基因组模型，但其指出的 SAE 特征验证中的“成分混杂”问题（类似于自然语言中的词频/特定 token 组合混杂）对 LLM 机制可解释性研究有启发，提醒我们在做 SAE 特征对齐时需要更严格的零假设测试。
recommendation.en: Although focused on genomic models, the 'compositional confounding' issue identified in SAE feature validation (similar to word frequency/specific token combination confounding in NLP) is instructive for LLM mechanistic interpretability, reminding us of the need for stricter null-hypothesis testing when aligning SAE features.

paper.title: Understanding the Impact of Linguistic Realization Choices on LLM Stance with Causal Tracing
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are known to be sensitive to prompt and input formulations. However, existing studies have focused on lexical realization and largely ignored constructional choice. This paper studies whether linguistic construction can systematically shift LLM decisions and where these shifts can be causally localized inside the model. We use political stance judgment as a meaning-sensitive case study and extend an English political statements dataset, resulting in six controlled li

summary.core_problem: 分析语言构式选择是否会系统性改变LLM的政治立场判断，并定位这种变化在模型内部的因果位置。
summary.importance: 这是一个机制分析工作，贡献在于把prompt敏感性从词汇替换扩展到构式选择，并用activation patching寻找导致输出分布变化的内部组件。对预训练研究的价值在于理解表示稳定性和输入形式偏差，但任务场景较窄。
summary.technical_approach: 论文扩展英文政治陈述数据集，构造六类受控改写，覆盖保义和反义两种情况；在四个开源模型上测量stance输出变化。随后用activation patching，把原始句子的激活替换到改写句子的前向过程中，观察哪些组件能恢复原始stance分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个开放权重模型。摘要称无论是保义改写还是反义改写，模型stance判断都会不稳定；activation patching用于定位内部因果组件。摘要未给出模型名称、参数量或具体层/头结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自University of Stuttgart的Institute for Natural Language Processing。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether linguistic construction choices systematically shift LLM stance judgments and where those shifts can be causally localized inside the model.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of prompt sensitivity beyond lexical variation. It is useful for thinking about representation stability and form bias, though the political-stance setting limits how far the conclusion should be generalized.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extend an English political statements dataset with six controlled rewrite types, including meaning-preserving and meaning-inverting rewrites. They evaluate four open-weight models and apply activation patching by substituting activations from the original statement into the rewritten-statement forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use four open-weight models. The abstract reports stance instability under both meaning-preserving and meaning-inverting rewrites, and uses activation patching to identify components that recover the original stance distribution. Model names, sizes, and layer-level results are not included in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute for Natural Language Processing at the University of Stuttgart.

recommendation.zh: 只看patching结果和改写设计；政治stance任务噪声大，但“构式也会动输出”值得作为机制信号记录。
recommendation.en: Skim the rewrite design and patching results; the stance task is noisy, but construction-level sensitivity is a useful mechanistic signal.

institutions: Institute for Natural Language Processing, University of Stuttgart

paper.title: Gotta Catch them all: the modes of Sycophancy
paper.abstract: Large language models often align with users' beliefs at the expense of factual accuracy, a behavior known as sycophancy. Prior mechanistic studies largely treat sycophancy as a single behavioral dimension that can be uniformly amplified or suppressed. We challenge this assumption by analyzing three hypothesized modes of sycophancy across 948 social pressure situations. Although the modes produce highly similar outputs, with a text-only classifier achieving just 57.8 percent accuracy, their inte

summary.core_problem: 研究 sycophancy 是否真是单一行为维度，还是由多个内部可分离的模式组成。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解对齐副作用、表征分解和干预粒度有启发。若你关心 post-train 行为如何映射到内部电路，这篇有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 948 个 social pressure 场景中分析三种假设的 sycophancy 模式。虽然输出文本高度相似，文本分类器只能达到 57.8% 准确率，但内部表征从第 14 层起可线性完全分离。进一步分析不同模式的出现阶段、依赖的 attention circuitry 和激活 strongest 的输入类型。
summary.experiments: 核心实验不是比 benchmark 分数，而是做表征可分性和电路层面的分析。摘要给出的关键数字是文本侧难分、表示侧可完全线性分离，说明行为同像不代表机制同源。未见与预训练数据、规模或训练 recipe 直接相关的实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Southern Utah University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether sycophancy is a single behavioral dimension or a family of internally separable modes.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. It does not directly advance pretraining methods, but it is relevant if you care about how alignment-side behaviors decompose into internal representations and circuits.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across 948 social-pressure situations, the authors analyze three hypothesized modes of sycophancy. While the generated texts are highly similar and a text-only classifier reaches only 57.8% accuracy, the internal representations become perfectly linearly separable from layer 14 onward. They further study emergence stage, attention circuitry, and input selectivity for each mode.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are representation-separability and circuit analyses rather than benchmark chasing. The key result is that text-level similarity hides mechanistic heterogeneity: outputs are hard to distinguish, but internal states are perfectly separable. There is no direct contribution to pretraining data, scaling, or recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Southern Utah University.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但“同一行为、不同电路”这个结论值得记；只看线性可分层位和 attention circuitry 分析，别在行为学叙事上停太久。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material, but the 'same behavior, different circuits' result is worth keeping; read the layerwise separability and attention-circuit sections, not the broader behavioral framing.

paper.title: Defense Against LLM Backdoors using Critical Neuron Isolation Pruning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where hidden triggers induce malicious outputs. Existing defenses generally fall into inference-time detection or training-time mitigation, but face two key limitations. First, they focus on fine-tuning-based backdoors (e.g., PEFT modules) and fail to address insidious model-editing attacks that bypass training pipelines. Second, they target simple classification settings and do not naturally extend to open-ended LLM generation and

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM后门防御多针对微调注入的后门、依赖行为级启发式，无法有效应对模型编辑类后门且适配开放生成场景。
summary.importance: 方法创新，从表征机制层面切入后门防御，提出关键神经元隔离剪枝的思路，提升防御的鲁棒性与通用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DeCNIP防御框架，通过定位引发恶意激活的关键神经元并进行隔离剪枝，从表征根源消除后门效应，区别于传统推理时检测或训练时缓解的路径。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、基准数据集及量化防御效果数据。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM backdoor defenses mostly target fine-tuning injected backdoors and rely on behavioral heuristics, failing to address model-editing backdoors and adapt to open-ended generation scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation approaching backdoor defense from representational mechanism level, proposing critical neuron isolation pruning to improve defense robustness and generality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DeCNIP defense framework, which locates critical neurons triggering malicious activations and prunes them to eliminate backdoor effects from the representational root, differing from traditional inference-time detection or training-time mitigation paths.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size, benchmark dataset, or quantitative defense performance data is disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 从神经元机制层面切入LLM后门防御的思路有新意，可扫读方法部分看关键神经元的定位逻辑，无需深读实验。
recommendation.en: Mechanism-driven LLM backdoor defense via neuron pruning has novel ideas; skim the method section for critical neuron localization logic, no need to deep-dive experiments.

paper.title: Circuit Claims Depend on What Is Extracted and How It Is Compared
paper.abstract: Circuit extraction identifies a small set of model components whose presence preserves a target behavior under ablation, and the resulting circuit is often read as the mechanism behind that behavior. We argue that this reading is under-determined: preserving behavior does not single out one circuit, because the claim it supports depends on which circuit is reported and how two circuits are compared. We make this concrete in a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark -- predicting the next step

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性中的电路提取结论是否受方法学选择（提取什么电路、如何比较两个电路）的影响，以及这些选择在多大程度上会改变「两个模型共享同一机制电路」的判断，而非反映真实的机制差异。
summary.importance: 揭示了当前电路分析结论存在方法学依赖，基于电路分析推断模型机制、指导架构设计或训练策略调整时需要谨慎，必须明确提取和比较的方法选择，否则可能得出不可靠的结论，为可解释性研究的方法标准化提供了具体的问题指向。
summary.technical_approach: 采用合成的Lean策略预测基准，固定证明规则、随机化表面形式，使电路差异可以明确归因于方法学选择而非任务本身的变化。系统变化四个因素：模型稀疏度（稠密和不同级别的权重稀疏）、注意力头的表示方式（合并的query/key节点还是分离的query和key节点）、剪枝图允许的消融后损失阈值、初始化强化学习的监督检查点。从三个维度验证电路结论的稳定性：稠密与稀疏检查点的电路重叠度、不同表示方式和损失阈值下的结论一致性、RL训练中电路结构变化与组合任务准确率提升的关联。
summary.experiments: 在同一Transformer的稠密检查点和多个权重稀疏检查点（大部分权重约束为0）上开展实验，核心发现有三点：1）稠密和75%权重稀疏的检查点，在注意力头集合层面的电路重叠度很高，但在精确的组件间边列表层面重叠度很低——两个检查点是否「共享电路」完全取决于比较的粒度；2）用分离的query/key节点代替合并节点只会轻微改变图的大小，剪枝图在不同损失阈值下的RL初始化条件排序保持一致；3）从不同监督检查点初始化的RL运行中，组合任务准确率提升最大的运行，其组合任务电路中不在对应原子任务电路中的节点比例也最高，说明电路新增了原子电路之外的结构，而非单纯复用原子电路。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先读引言部分了解问题背景，再看Figure 1的三个核心结论示意图，然后读第4节的实验结果部分，无需深究Lean任务的具体细节和电路提取的算法实现，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。从事机制可解释性研究可重点关注第3节的实验设计和第4节的消融结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether circuit extraction claims in mechanistic interpretability are sensitive to methodological choices (what circuit is extracted and how two circuits are compared), and to what extent these choices alter judgments like "two models share the same mechanistic circuit" rather than reflecting genuine mechanistic differences.
summary_en.importance: The findings highlight that current circuit analysis conclusions have methodological dependencies. Researchers should be cautious when inferring model mechanisms from circuit analyses to guide architectural design or training strategy adjustments, and must explicitly state extraction and comparison choices to avoid unreliable conclusions. This work also provides concrete directions for standardization of interpretability research methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a synthetic Lean tactic-prediction benchmark with fixed proof rules and randomized surface forms, so differences between extracted circuits can be unambiguously attributed to methodological choices rather than task variation. Four factors are systematically varied: model sparsity (dense and various weight-sparse levels), attention head representation (merged query/key node vs separate query and key nodes), allowed post-ablation loss threshold for the pruning graph, and which supervised checkpoint initializes reinforcement learning (RL). Three dimensions of circuit claim stability are evaluated: overlap between dense and sparse checkpoints, consistency of conclusions across representation choices and loss thresholds, and the correlation between circuit structural changes and compositional task accuracy gains during RL training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on dense and multiple weight-sparse checkpoints (most weights constrained to zero) of the same transformer. Three core findings: 1) Dense and 75% weight-sparse checkpoints have substantial overlap at the attention-head set level but only weak overlap at the exact component-to-component edge list level — whether two checkpoints "share a circuit" depends entirely on comparison granularity. 2) Representing attention heads with separate query/key nodes instead of merged nodes only slightly changes graph size, and the ordering of RL initialization conditions for pruning graphs remains consistent across tested loss thresholds. 3) Across RL runs initialized from different supervised checkpoints, runs with the largest accuracy gains on compositional tasks also have the highest fraction of compositional-task circuit nodes absent from matched atomic-task circuits — meaning the circuit adds new structure beyond reusing atomic task circuits.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read the introduction to understand the background, then review the three core finding schematics in Figure 1, followed by the experimental results in Section 4. No need to dive deep into Lean task details or circuit extraction algorithm implementation; expected reading time 25-35 minutes. For researchers working on mechanistic interpretability, prioritize the experimental design in Section 3 and ablation results in Section 4.

recommendation.zh: 做Transformer机制可解释性的研究员可重点看§3的合成benchmark设计，结论提醒电路提取结果不能直接等价于真实机制。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on Transformer mechanistic interpretability should focus on the synthetic benchmark design in §3; the conclusion warns extracted circuits are not equivalent to true mechanisms.

paper.title: CircuitKIT : Circuit Discovery, Evaluation, and Application Toolkit for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Circuit analysis can support not only model explanation but also downstream interventions such as pruning, editing, steering, and selective fine-tuning. However, conducting such analyses currently requires stitching together separate implementations for discovery, evaluation, and intervention, as well as hand-authoring the contrastive prompts required by many discovery methods. This fragmentation makes methods difficult to compare and limits their application beyond canonical tasks. We introduce

summary.core_problem: 现有机制可解释性的电路分析工作流碎片化，发现、评估、干预模块各自独立实现，方法对比困难，难以扩展到标准任务之外。
summary.importance: 提供统一的电路分析开源工具库，降低电路发现、诊断、下游干预的使用门槛，支持不同方法的标准化横向对比。
summary.technical_approach: 设计带类型、可序列化的电路表示打通全工作流，集成多种主流电路发现算法，提供结构化数据到发现任务的声明式接口、电路诊断模块和下游剪枝/编辑/引导应用模块。
summary.experiments: 无原创模型训练，作为开源库发布配套示例、notebook和文档，未报告特定任务上的新SOTA结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Current mechanistic interpretability workflows for circuit analysis are fragmented, with separate implementations for discovery, evaluation and intervention, making cross-method comparison difficult and limiting application beyond canonical tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work releases an open-source toolkit unifying the end-to-end circuit analysis pipeline, lowering barriers for circuit discovery, diagnostics and downstream interventions, and enabling standardized cross-method comparison.
summary_en.technical_approach: The toolkit uses typed, serializable circuit representations to connect all workflow stages, integrates a suite of mainstream circuit discovery algorithms, provides declarative interfaces for mapping structured data to discovery tasks, and includes built-in circuit diagnostics and downstream modules for pruning, editing and steering.
summary_en.experiments: No novel model training is conducted; the library is released with examples, notebooks and documentation, with no new state-of-the-art results reported on specific tasks.

recommendation.zh: 做电路层面机制分析的可留作工具备查，无新研究洞见，不需要通读全文。
recommendation.en: A handy utility for mechanistic circuit analysis work, no novel research insights, no need to read end-to-end.

paper.title: Are Arithmetic Heuristic Neurons Form-Invariant? A Mechanistic Analysis of Symbols, Text, and Code in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large language models often succeed on one formulation of a problem while failing on an equivalent formulation. Whether these failures arise from distinct internal circuits or different activation states of a shared circuit remains unknown. Recent mechanistic interpretability studies suggest that arithmetic in LLMs emerges from a "bag of heuristics," encoded by a sparse set of MLP neurons that represent distinct arithmetic strategies. We investigate whether arithmetic heuristic neurons are form-

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答两个更细的机制问题。第一，LLM 里负责算术的“启发式神经元”是否跨表达形式共享，也就是同一个加减乘除问题写成符号表达式、自然语言题目、或 Python 代码时，模型是否调用同一批神经元。第二，跨格式性能波动到底来自“电路不同”，还是“电路相同但激活状态不同”。这个问题重要，因为很多数学鲁棒性工作只看到表面现象：换个表述模型就掉点，但并不知道问题出在抽象、路由、还是最终计算模块。作者把焦点放在 MLP 神经元层面，而不是只看 attention pattern 或整体表征相似度，因此结论更接近可干预的机制解释。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在于提出新训练法，而在于它给了一个较清楚的失败归因框架：算术能力里至少有一部分是格式不变的、可复用的中层机制，而跨格式失败更多发生在这些机制是否被正确触发，而不是模型根本没有共享的算术电路。这个判断会影响后续两类工作。其一是数据与 curriculum 设计：如果共享电路已经存在，增加多格式数据的价值可能主要在于改善触发与路由，而不是重新学一套算术能力。其二是 post-train 或 probing：如果错误主要是激活不足，那么 prompt、格式标准化、或中间表示对齐可能比扩大模型更有效。对 mechanistic interpretability 社区，这篇文章也把“bag of heuristics”从单一符号算术扩展到了 text/code 两种更接近真实使用场景的输入形式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分三步。第一步，作者在 Llama-3-8B、Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.2-1B 上构造三种等价算术输入：symbolic、word problem、Python code，并刻意选择 tokenizer 能把 0 到 999 表成单 token 的模型，避免多 token 数字把 neuron attribution 搅混。第二步，用两阶段神经元发现流程定位算术启发式神经元：先做 attribution patching 找到对正确答案有高贡献的候选层和候选神经元，再做 activation patching 验证这些神经元是否具有因果作用，而不是仅仅相关。第三步，比较三种格式下识别出的神经元集合重叠度，并做跨格式干预：在一种格式中找到的神经元，拿去消融或 patch 到另一种格式，观察性能变化。

文章的关键点不是简单算 Jaccard overlap，而是把“共享神经元”与“共享功能”分开看。作者发现一小批紧凑的神经元在三种格式中都反复出现，并且这些神经元对应 Nikankin 等人提出的 range、modulo、pattern、identical operands、multi-result 等启发式类别。也就是说，模型内部确实存在跨格式复用的算术启发式库。与此同时，不同格式会改变这些神经元的激活强度、触发频率和组合方式，尤其自然语言和代码更依赖前面的抽象与 operand routing 是否把问题整理成这些神经元能消费的内部表示。作者据此提出：跨格式失败更像 shared circuit under different states，而不是 format-specific circuits。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。第一，之前的算术机制分析大多停留在 canonical symbolic arithmetic；这篇把问题推进到形式不变性。第二，之前很多工作证明“有算术神经元”，这篇进一步问“这些神经元是否跨输入表面形式稳定”。第三，它把 failure analysis 从行为层面的 accuracy drop，推进到 neuron-level causal analysis，因此能区分“没有能力”和“能力未被调用”这两种失败来源。
summary.experiments:
主实验覆盖三种 Llama-3 base 模型，正文重点展示 8B，附录给出 3B 和 1B，结论趋势一致。核心结果有四类。

第一，跨格式共享性。作者识别到一组数量不大的神经元，在 symbolic、text、code 三种输入中都具有稳定的高归因和因果作用；这些共享神经元主要位于中后层，与先前算术神经元分布结论一致。虽然摘要截断了具体比例，但正文结论很明确：共享集合不是边缘现象，而是足以解释相当一部分算术行为的紧凑子集。

第二，消融实验。消融这些共享神经元后，三种格式的算术性能都会明显下降，而非算术能力相对保留。这说明它们不是某种格式特有的 lexical neuron，而是更接近真正的 arithmetic heuristic neurons。更重要的是，用某一格式中发现的神经元去干预另一格式，也能造成显著影响，支持跨格式因果可迁移性。

第三，激活态分析。作者比较了同一批神经元在不同格式下的 activation pattern，发现失败样本往往不是完全缺失相关神经元，而是这些神经元激活不足、激活时机不对，或与其他启发式组合失衡。这个结果直接支持“shared circuit, different activation states”的解释。

第四，尺度一致性。1B、3B、8B 都观察到相同定性趋势，说明这种形式不变性不是只在大模型里偶然出现，也不是某个 checkpoint 的特例。对机制研究来说，这一点很重要，因为它暗示共享算术启发式可能是训练中较早形成、并随规模延续的结构。

如果只关心可操作结论，最值得记的是：模型跨格式掉点，并不自动意味着它没有抽象出统一算术机制；更常见的情况是统一机制存在，但上游表征整理和触发条件不稳。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐行啃。建议先看 Introduction 里的两个研究问题，再看 Experimental Setup，确认三种输入格式如何构造、为什么要选单 token 数字范围。随后重点看神经元发现流程：attribution patching 与 activation patching 各自解决什么问题，为什么两者要结合。只看 attribution 容易把相关性当因果，这里是方法上最该留意的地方。

结果部分优先看三类图表：一是不同格式识别出的神经元重叠与层分布；二是跨格式消融/patching 的性能变化；三是共享神经元在成功与失败样本上的激活差异。如果时间有限，读这些就够了。预计 30 到 45 分钟能抓住主结论。

值得深挖的点有两个。第一，作者把 text/code 失败解释为触发问题，这和 pretrain 里的 data mixture、format balancing、以及 tokenizer 设计能否改善 routing 很相关。第二，文章聚焦 MLP neurons，但没有把 attention routing 机制完全展开；如果要继续研究，最自然的下一步是把“谁把 operand 送到这些神经元面前”补齐，形成从输入格式到最终算术输出的完整电路图。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks two mechanistic questions about arithmetic in LLMs. First, are arithmetic heuristic neurons form-invariant, meaning that the same underlying neurons are recruited when an equivalent computation is written as a symbolic expression, a natural-language word problem, or Python code? Second, when performance differs across formats, is the failure caused by different circuits being used, or by different activation states of a shared circuit? This matters because prior work mostly documented behavioral sensitivity to phrasing, but did not localize whether the bottleneck lies in abstraction, routing, or the final arithmetic machinery itself.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The main takeaway is that a meaningful part of arithmetic competence appears to live in reusable, format-invariant neuron-level machinery, while cross-format failures are often better explained by mis-triggering or weak activation than by the absence of a shared arithmetic circuit. That has implications for data design and training strategy. If the core circuit is already shared, adding multi-format data may help more by improving routing and activation conditions than by teaching arithmetic from scratch again. It also matters for post-training and prompting: normalization, format conversion, or intermediate representation shaping may recover capability more efficiently than scaling the model. For mechanistic interpretability, the paper extends the “bag of heuristics” view beyond canonical symbolic arithmetic into text and code.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study uses three base Llama models: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.2-3B, and Llama-3.2-1B. The model choice is deliberate: their tokenizers encode every integer from 0 to 999 as a single token, which avoids confounds from multi-token number representations in neuron-level analysis. The authors build equivalent arithmetic tasks in three formats: symbolic expressions, word problems, and Python code.

They then identify arithmetic heuristic neurons with a two-stage pipeline. First, attribution patching is used to find candidate layers and neurons that contribute strongly to correct arithmetic outputs. Second, activation patching is applied to test causal relevance, filtering out neurons that are merely correlated with arithmetic behavior. This is an important methodological choice: attribution alone would not distinguish true arithmetic contributors from bystanders.

The analysis then compares neuron sets across formats and performs cross-format interventions. Neurons discovered in one format are ablated or patched in another format to test whether their causal role transfers. The paper does not stop at overlap statistics. It separates shared identity from shared function, showing that a compact subset of neurons recurs across all three formats and maps onto previously reported heuristic classes such as range, modulo, pattern, identical-operands, and multi-result heuristics.

The central interpretation is that LLMs maintain a reusable arithmetic heuristic library, but different formats modulate how strongly and how reliably that library is activated. Symbolic inputs tend to trigger the circuit more directly, while text and code depend more on upstream abstraction and operand routing. Relative to earlier work, the contribution is not just “there exist arithmetic neurons,” but “the same arithmetic neurons can generalize across surface forms, and failures often come from activation-state differences rather than circuit replacement.”
summary_en.experiments:
The main paper focuses on Llama-3-8B, with qualitatively similar results for 3B and 1B in the appendix. The experimental findings fall into four buckets.

First, cross-format sharing. The authors identify a relatively compact set of neurons that consistently show high attribution and causal importance across symbolic, text, and code arithmetic. These neurons are concentrated in middle-to-late layers, in line with prior arithmetic-neuron studies. The exact overlap numbers are not visible in the provided excerpt, but the qualitative conclusion is clear: the shared subset is substantial enough to explain a nontrivial portion of arithmetic behavior.

Second, ablation evidence. Removing these shared neurons degrades arithmetic performance across all three formats while leaving non-arithmetic behavior comparatively less affected. This argues against the idea that they are merely format-specific lexical features. More importantly, neurons identified in one format can causally affect performance in another, which supports transfer of function across forms.

Third, activation-state analysis. On failure cases, the relevant neurons are often not absent; instead, they are weakly activated, activated at the wrong time, or combined differently with other heuristics. This is the strongest evidence for the paper’s main claim: shared circuit, different activation states.

Fourth, scale consistency. The same qualitative pattern appears in 1B, 3B, and 8B models. That makes the result less likely to be an artifact of one checkpoint or one scale regime, and suggests that form-invariant arithmetic heuristics may emerge relatively early and persist with scale.

The practical message is simple: a drop in arithmetic accuracy under reformatting does not necessarily mean the model lacks a unified arithmetic mechanism. Often the mechanism exists, but the upstream representation and triggering conditions are unstable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, so the efficient path is to read the Introduction for the two research questions, then the Experimental Setup to understand how equivalent symbolic/text/code inputs are constructed and why single-token numbers matter. After that, focus on the neuron-discovery pipeline. The distinction between attribution patching and activation patching is the methodological core; without it, the causal claims would be much weaker.

In the results, prioritize three kinds of figures or tables: overlap and layer distribution of neurons across formats, cross-format ablation or patching effects, and activation differences between success and failure cases. Those are enough to recover the main argument in about 30 to 45 minutes.

Two follow-up angles are worth deeper thought. One is the connection to pretraining data mixture and format balancing: if the arithmetic circuit is shared, then multi-format training may mainly improve routing into that circuit. The other is that the paper centers on MLP neurons and leaves the attention-side routing story incomplete. A natural next step is to trace how operands are extracted and delivered to these neurons across different input forms.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不一定改训练 recipe，但会影响你对“模型学到的是模板还是抽象算法”的判断；先看共享神经元识别和跨格式激活迁移实验是否干净。
recommendation.en: This may not change your training recipe, but it does affect whether you think the model learned templates or abstract algorithms; first check how clean the shared-neuron identification and cross-format activation transfer really are.

institutions: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai

paper.title: More Than Memory: Task-Conditioned Signed FFN Writes in Long-Context Retrieval
paper.abstract: FFNs are often treated as parametric memories. In long-context retrieval, however, the sharper question is not only what they store, but whether their native residual writes push the current retrieval state toward or away from the correct answer. We test this by scaling the model's own FFN write one layer at a time, without editing weights or injecting external steering vectors.   Across controlled literal and semantic retrieval suites, native FFN response surfaces are signed, layer-specific, an

summary.core_problem: 论文分析长上下文检索中 FFN residual write 到底是在推动模型接近正确答案，还是在压制正确检索状态。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把 FFN 从“参数记忆”进一步拆成 task-conditioned signed writes：同一层的 FFN 写入可能对 literal retrieval 和 semantic retrieval 起相反作用，这对长上下文退化、层级干预和模型编辑都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是不改权重、不注入外部 steering vector，而是逐层缩放模型自身 FFN write，观察检索指标随缩放系数变化的 response surface。再用沿 native write 方向的局部方向导数区分 amplifier 和 suppressor。
summary.experiments: 在 controlled literal 和 semantic retrieval suites 上，final FFN 在 7/8 个 model-suite case 中表现为 suppressor；60% 的层会在不同检索模式间切换角色，95% CI 为 [50%, 69%]。方向导数能稳定区分角色：suppressor 在 34/35 个 case 中为负，amplifier 在 18/18 个 case 中为正。LongBench retrieval-QA probe 上，同一诊断还能预测 attenuation damage。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether FFN residual writes in long-context retrieval push the model toward the correct answer or suppress the current retrieval state.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It refines the common view of FFNs as parametric memories by showing that native FFN writes are signed, layer-specific, and task-conditioned, which matters for long-context failures and layer-level interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study scales the model’s own FFN write one layer at a time, without weight edits or external steering vectors, and measures the retrieval response surface. It then uses the local directional derivative along the native write to separate amplifier and suppressor roles.
summary_en.experiments: On controlled literal and semantic retrieval suites, the final FFN is a suppressor in 7 of 8 model-suite cases, and 60% of layers switch roles between retrieval modes with a 95% CI of [50%, 69%]. The directional derivative is negative for suppressors in 34/35 cases and positive for amplifiers in 18/18 cases. The same diagnostic predicts attenuation damage on a safety-filtered LongBench retrieval-QA probe.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和主表：它把“FFN 是记忆”改成“FFN 写入有符号且依任务变号”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and main table: it replaces the simple “FFNs are memories” story with signed, task-conditioned FFN writes.

paper.title: Per-Token Fixed-Point Convergence in Depth-Recurrent Transformers
paper.abstract: A depth-recurrent transformer applies a weight-tied core a variable number of times, and prior work has shown that training with a randomized recursion count yields one checkpoint usable across a range of inference depths. We ask what such a model actually computes per token, and measure it directly. On a 135M-class model trained on FineWeb-Edu, the recurrent state converges to a per-token fixed point: mean successive-output KL divergence falls from 3.9e-1 at the second loop to 8.5e-6 by the six

summary.core_problem: 深度循环Transformer（权重绑定的核心块可变次数执行）的现有研究混淆了两个核心问题：1）深度鲁棒性（模型在未微调的推理深度下是否有效）；2）深度分配（每个token需要多少计算量）。此前没有工作直接测量训练后弹性模型的逐token计算行为，且逐token提前退出方案在KV缓存正确性、批处理效率、计算节省三者间无法兼顾，联合训练的停机策略容易坍缩到退化深度，需要精细调优计算先验。
summary.importance: 1）首次直接刻画了深度循环LM的逐token固定点收敛行为，填补了弹性深度模型内部计算动态的认知空白；2）证明逐token收敛状态可直接用于后验深度分配，无需联合训练路由，且效果优于学习式路由，为弹性计算架构的落地提供了低成本可复用的方案；3）验证了训练时循环深度分布与模型饱和深度的对应关系，为这类架构的预训练配方设计提供了明确的量化指导。
summary.technical_approach: 1）预训练配方：采用最小化的随机深度训练策略——每个优化步随机采样循环次数，用标准交叉熵损失训练，不引入停机单元、ponder损失或FLOP惩罚，得到深度鲁棒的骨架模型；模型结构为Llama风格，由唯一的前置层、权重绑定的循环核心块、唯一的后置层+LM头组成。2）逐token行为测量：直接追踪循环过程中每个token的连续输出KL散度、隐状态变化，量化收敛深度的异质性分布。3）深度分配策略：提出无需训练的收敛退出规则——当token的连续输出KL低于预设阈值时停止循环，对比基于收敛标签训练的线性路由器、固定全局深度两类基线。
summary.experiments: 基于FineWeb-Edu训练的135M级模型（训练平均循环深度8）：1）收敛特性：平均连续输出KL从第2次循环的3.9×10^-1降到第16次的8.5×10^-6，隐状态变化同步衰减；逐token收敛异质性显著，中位数token在第6次循环收敛，约10%的token在训练平均深度8时仍在更新，收敛顺序与token类型相关。2）深度分配效果：无训练收敛退出策略在平均4.94次循环（比固定深度8低38%）下达到固定深度8的质量，在平均深度范围内与固定深度效果完全匹配；而用相同收敛标签训练的线性路由器几乎需要满深度，无计算节省，该结论在两个模型规模下均复现。3）分布对应性：训练平均深度为4的模型饱和深度为4，训练平均深度为8的模型饱和深度为8，与Huginn的外部实验结果一致。4）深度弹性：单个检查点可覆盖1-8倍深度，质量单调提升，可稳定外推到4倍训练平均深度。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读：1）第1节的问题拆分（深度鲁棒性vs深度分配）与现有工作的局限分析；2）第2节的逐token测量方法与第3节的收敛特性结果（对应逐token KL/状态变化的统计图表）；3）第4节的深度分配对比实验，尤其是无训练规则vs学习式路由的消融；4）附录中预训练配方细节与不同规模的复现结果。值得深挖的点：收敛深度与token语义/句法属性的对应关系、收敛退出策略与KV缓存/批处理的工程适配、更大规模模型下的收敛特性是否保持一致。
summary.authors_note: 未明确标注机构与作者列表，引用了SmolLM2、Huginn、LoopFormer等相关工作的团队成果。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing research on depth-recurrent Transformers (variable execution of weight-tied core blocks) conflates two core open questions: 1) depth robustness (whether the model performs well at inference depths not explicitly tuned for), and 2) depth allocation (how much compute each individual token requires).
