No prior work directly measures per-token computation dynamics of a trained elastic model; existing per-token early exit methods fail to simultaneously preserve KV cache correctness, batching efficiency, and compute savings, while jointly trained halting policies often collapse to degenerate depths and require delicate tuning of compute priors.
summary_en.importance: 1) Provides the first direct characterization of per-token fixed-point convergence behavior in depth-recurrent LMs, filling a critical gap in understanding internal computation dynamics of elastic-depth models; 2) Demonstrates that per-token convergence states can be directly exploited for post-hoc depth allocation without joint routing training, and outperforms learned routing policies, offering a low-cost, reusable solution for elastic compute architecture deployment; 3) Validates the correlation between training-time loop depth distribution and model saturation depth, providing clear quantitative guidance for pretraining recipe design for this architecture family.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Pretraining recipe: Uses a minimal randomized-depth training strategy — recursion count is randomly sampled at each optimizer step, trained with standard cross-entropy loss, no halting unit, ponder loss, or FLOP penalty, to produce a depth-robust backbone; the model follows Llama-style architecture, consisting of unique prelude layers, a weight-tied recurrent core block, and unique coda layers feeding into the LM head. 2) Per-token behavior measurement: Directly tracks per-token successive-output KL divergence and hidden state changes across recursion steps to quantify the heterogeneous distribution of convergence depth. 3) Depth allocation policies: Proposes a training-free convergence exit rule (stop recursion when a token's successive output KL falls below a preset threshold), compared against a linear router trained on harvested convergence labels and fixed global depth baselines.
summary_en.experiments: On a 135M-class model trained on FineWeb-Edu (training mean recursion depth = 8): 1) Convergence properties: Mean successive-output KL drops from 3.9×10^-1 at loop 2 to 8.5×10^-6 at loop 16, with hidden state change decaying in lockstep; per-token convergence is highly heterogeneous — median token converges by loop 6, ~10% of tokens still update at the training-mean depth of 8, with convergence order correlated with token type. 2) Depth allocation performance: The training-free convergence exit policy matches depth-8 quality at 4.94 average loops (38% lower than fixed depth 8), and tracks fixed-depth quality exactly across the average-depth range; by contrast, a linear router trained on the same convergence labels requires nearly full depth with no compute savings, a result reproduced at two model scales. 3) Distribution alignment: A model trained with mean depth 4 saturates at depth 4, and a mean-depth-8 model saturates at depth 8, consistent with external experimental results from Huginn. 4) Depth elasticity: A single checkpoint covers depths 1-8 with monotonic quality gains, and extrapolates stably to 4x the training-mean depth.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize close reading of: 1) Section 1's problem decomposition (depth robustness vs depth allocation) and limitation analysis of prior work; 2) Section 2's per-token measurement methodology and Section 3's convergence property results (statistical figures for per-token KL / state change); 3) Section 4's depth allocation comparison experiments, especially ablations between training-free rules and learned routing; 4) Appendix details on pretraining recipes and cross-scale reproduction. Worth deeper investigation: correlation between convergence depth and token semantic/syntactic properties, engineering adaptation of convergence exit to KV caching and batching, whether convergence properties hold at larger parameter scales.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author list not explicitly stated; references related work from teams behind SmolLM2, Huginn, LoopFormer, etc.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 Recurrent Transformer 中不同 token 存在不同的收敛深度（如空格浅、内容词深），为 Early Exit 和动态计算分配提供了坚实的机制级证据，强烈建议阅读其分析部分。
recommendation.en: Reveals that different tokens in Recurrent Transformers have varying convergence depths (e.g., whitespace is shallow, content words are deep), providing solid mechanistic evidence for Early Exit and dynamic compute allocation. Highly recommend reading the analysis section.

paper.title: Transcoders for Investigating Deception in Language Models
paper.abstract: Transcoders have recently emerged as a promising approach for mechanistic interpretability (MI), enabling circuit-level analysis of model behaviour. In this paper, we investigate the use of transcoders to analyse deceptive behaviour in language models, a behaviour that poses a safety and security risk. Using a Qwen3-4B model with pre-trained transcoders, specifically per-layer transcoders (PLTs), we construct attribution graphs that capture feature activations and inter-feature dependencies, all

summary.core_problem: 语言模型的欺骗行为缺乏机制层面的解释和检测手段，对模型安全构成风险。
summary.importance: 将transcoder这一机制可解释性工具应用于欺骗行为分析，属于机制分析类贡献，为安全监测提供了电路级视角。
summary.technical_approach: 使用Qwen3-4B模型及其预训练的逐层transcoder（PLT），构建归因图捕捉特征激活和特征间依赖关系，实现欺骗行为的电路级分析；通过特征操控和电路分析识别欺骗相关特征字典。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B上验证：识别出的欺骗相关特征对欺骗性输出有更强影响，可在欺骗与非欺骗响应之间产生可预测的偏移。

summary_en.core_problem: Deceptive behavior in language models lacks mechanistic explanation and detection methods, posing safety and security risks.
summary_en.importance: Applies transcoder-based mechanistic interpretability to deception analysis, a mechanism-analysis contribution that enables circuit-level safety monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Qwen3-4B with pre-trained per-layer transcoders (PLTs) to build attribution graphs capturing feature activations and inter-feature dependencies for circuit-level deception analysis; identifies a dictionary of deception-related features via feature steering and circuit analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3-4B: identified deception features exert stronger influence on deceptive outputs and produce predictable shifts between deceptive and non-deceptive responses.

recommendation.zh: 用transcoder做欺骗行为的机制分析，方法框架常规，对预训练研究员可作为SAE/transcoder应用案例快速浏览。
recommendation.en: Mechanistic analysis of deception using transcoders; the framework is standard. Pretraining researchers can skim it as an SAE/transcoder application case.

paper.title: Targeted Recovery of Weight-Space Mechanisms From Neural Networks
paper.abstract: Parameter decomposition (PD) decomposes neural networks into interpretable computational components that faithfully reflect the original network's operations. However, scaling PD to large models requires vast compute, making it a costly and risky endeavor. Here we propose targeted PD (tPD), which identifies only the components that process specific inputs of interest -- from isolated prompts to large subtasks -- by introducing a high-rank catch-all component that handles all non-target data. We

summary.core_problem: 现有参数分解（PD）方法需要对模型全量分解，计算成本极高，难以扩展到大模型；仅用目标数据做分解会导致解欠定，提取的组件在非目标输入上行为不可预测，无法保证机制忠实性。
summary.importance: 大幅降低了权重空间机制分解的计算成本，使得在中等规模甚至更大的LLM上做特定任务/特定输入的电路级分析成为可能；为预训练模型的可解释性、模型编辑、特定能力的底层电路验证提供了更实用的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 提出靶向参数分解（tPD），核心是引入高秩兜底组件Δ处理所有非目标数据，仅对目标数据相关的机制做稀疏秩-1分解。具体设计：1. 训练使用两个并行数据流：目标数据集（待解释的输入子集）和从原训练分布采样的非目标数据集。2. 对目标数据，仅用稀疏秩-1子组件重构输出，这些子组件只需捕获目标数据上激活的机制，无需还原全部权重。3. 对非目标数据，用原权重与子组件和的残差（即满秩Δ组件）重构，Δ捕获所有不在目标数据上激活的机制。4. 训练时在目标批次上对抗性消融Δ（随机0-100%比例），迫使目标输出完全由子组件重构；非目标批次上Δ始终启用。5. 同时对非激活组件和Δ做对抗性消融，保证分解电路的机制忠实性——任意混合原矩阵和消融矩阵时模型输出不变。
summary.experiments: 1. 玩具模型TMCC上，靶向分解3个输入特征仅需5个秩-1子组件槽位（全量分解需100个），收敛步数从~2500步降至~500步，可准确恢复对应3个机制，且子组件不会在非目标输入上虚假激活。2. 在训练于The Pile的4层Transformer（28M非嵌入参数）上，以两个Python import prompt为目标的分解在不同随机种子下高度一致（V向量余弦相似度很高），且满足telescoping一致性（A∪B的分解等于A、B分解的并集）。3. 4层Transformer的CSS子模型分解仅需全量分解~7%的FLOPs，方法可扩展到12层Transformer。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2节方法部分，关注Δ兜底组件和对抗性消融的设计逻辑；玩具模型验证可快速浏览，Transformer实验部分重点看种子一致性和telescoping一致性的结果。预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Full parameter decomposition (PD) of neural networks requires prohibitive compute for large models, making scaling to frontier LLMs impractical. Naive decomposition using only target data leads to underdetermined solutions, where extracted components have unpredictable behavior on non-target inputs and lack mechanistic faithfulness.
summary_en.importance: Targeted PD drastically reduces the compute cost of weight-space mechanistic analysis, making circuit-level investigation of specific capabilities or input subsets feasible on medium-to-large LLMs. It provides a practical tool for interpretability, model editing, and verification of underlying circuits for specific capabilities in pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Targeted Parameter Decomposition (tPD) introduces a high-rank catch-all component Δ that handles all non-target data, so only mechanisms active on the target subset need to be explicitly decomposed into sparse rank-1 subcomponents. Key design details: 1. Training uses two parallel data streams: a small target dataset (inputs to be explained) and a non-target stream sampled from the model's original training distribution. 2. For target data, outputs are reconstructed using only a sparse set of rank-1 subcomponents, which capture mechanisms active on the target and do not need to sum to the full original weights. 3. For non-target data, outputs are reconstructed using the full-rank Δ component, defined as the residual between the original weights and the sum of target subcomponents; Δ captures all mechanisms never active on target data. 4. During training, Δ is adversarially ablated (0–100% of parameters) on target batches to force target outputs to be reconstructed solely from the sparse subcomponents; Δ is always enabled on non-target batches. 5. Both inactive subcomponents and Δ are adversarially ablated to ensure mechanistic faithfulness — model outputs remain unchanged for any hybrid of original and ablated weight matrices.
summary_en.experiments: 1. On the TMCC toy model, tPD targeting 3 input features requires only 5 rank-1 subcomponent slots (vs. 100 for full PD) and converges in ~500 steps (vs. ~2500 for full PD), while accurately recovering the 3 corresponding mechanisms with no spurious activation on non-target inputs. 2. On a 4-block transformer (28M non-embedding parameters, trained on The Pile), tPD targeting two Python import prompts produces highly consistent decompositions across random seeds (high cosine similarity of V vectors), and satisfies telescoping consistency (decomposition of A∪B equals the union of decompositions of A and B). 3. Extracting a CSS-only submodel from the 4-block transformer uses ~7% of the FLOPs required for full published decomposition; the method scales to 12-block transformers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 (method) for the core design of the Δ catch-all component and adversarial ablation scheme. Skim the toy model validation; for transformer experiments, prioritize seed consistency and telescoping consistency results. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 靶向权重分解的思路实用，做预训练机制分析（如记忆、特定能力电路）可参考，重点看§3的tPD形式化和§4的Transformer实验
recommendation.en: Targeted weight decomposition is practical for pretraining mechanism analysis (e.g., memory, capability circuits); focus on §3 for tPD formulation and §4 for Transformer experiments.

paper.title: Visual Access Boundaries in Vision-Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting is widely used as a test-time scaling strategy for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), but it remains unclear what is extended when VLMs generate longer reasoning traces. We ask whether CoT requires continued access to image tokens, or whether it mainly operates over visual information already made available earlier in the forward pass. We introduce Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along l

summary.core_problem: 在视觉语言模型（VLMs）中使用思维链（CoT）生成长推理轨迹时，模型是否需要持续访问图像 token，还是主要依赖前向传播早期提取的视觉信息？
summary.importance: 通过引入 Visual Access Sweep 因果干预方法，首次量化了 VLM 在 CoT 推理过程中的视觉访问边界（VAB），揭示了 CoT 并不显著增加对深层视觉特征的依赖，为理解和优化 VLM 的长上下文推理机制提供了关键洞察。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Visual Access Sweep，一种因果干预技术，通过在层深度和生成时间上掩码生成 token 查询对图像 token 键的注意力，来寻找保持任务准确率的最小访问区域，定义为视觉访问边界（VAB）。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 的六种模型配置上进行实验。结果表明，无 CoT 直接回答和 CoT 提示都表现出有限的 VAB。在 14B 和 38B 规模的模型中，尽管 CoT 生成的序列长得多，其 VAB 层与无 CoT 的边界最多相差两层。

summary_en.core_problem: When Vision-Language Models (VLMs) generate long reasoning traces using Chain-of-Thought (CoT), do they require continued access to image tokens, or do they mainly rely on visual information extracted earlier in the forward pass?
summary_en.importance: Introduces Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention, to quantify the Visual Access Boundary (VAB) during VLM CoT reasoning for the first time, revealing that CoT does not significantly increase reliance on deep visual features, providing key insights for understanding and optimizing long-context reasoning in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Visual Access Sweep, a causal intervention that masks attention from generated-token queries to image-token keys along layer depth and generation time to find the minimal access region preserving task accuracy, defined as the Visual Access Boundary (VAB).
summary_en.experiments: Conducted on six model configurations from Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3. Results show both no-CoT direct answering and CoT prompting exhibit finite VABs. In 14B and 38B models, despite substantially longer generations, the VAB layer for CoT differs from the no-CoT boundary by at most two layers.

recommendation.zh: 通过 attention masking 巧妙探究了 VLM CoT 过程中的视觉依赖，发现长 CoT 并不需要持续访问深层视觉 token，对 VLM 推理优化（如 KV cache 压缩）极具启发，建议阅读实验部分。
recommendation.en: Cleverly investigates visual dependency during VLM CoT via attention masking, finding that long CoT doesn't require sustained access to deep visual tokens; highly inspiring for VLM inference optimization (e.g., KV cache compression), recommend reading the experiments.

paper.title: Sparse Inter-Layer Dependencies of Transformer FFN Neurons
paper.abstract: Feedforward network (FFN) blocks account for a large fraction of the parameters and computation in Transformer architectures, yet their internal structure remains difficult to interpret due to the additive superposition induced by the residual stream. We examine whether the activation of an FFN neuron can be explained by a sparse set of preceding neuron activations and attention outputs. We introduce a training-free attribution method that estimates the relative influence of upstream neurons and

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 中 FFN 神经元的激活是否主要由少量上游神经元和注意力输出决定，从而刻画跨层依赖的稀疏性。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对理解 FFN 的有效自由度、残差流中的可解释性，以及未来做结构化剪枝/稀疏化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种 training-free attribution 方法，估计某个目标 FFN 神经元对前序层神经元激活和 attention 输出的相对依赖。核心检验是：仅保留少量被选中的上游输入，其余输入用平均值替代，看目标神经元激活能否高保真重建；进一步把这种 neuron-specific mask 同时施加到所有层，观察整体模型行为偏移。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖多个模型和层，发现少量上游激活与 attention 输出即可较好保留目标神经元激活；若再考虑上游层本身的激活稀疏性，有效依赖更稀疏。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和与其他 attribution 方法的定量对比幅度。
summary.authors_note: Hanspeter Pfister 是 Harvard 的资深可视化与机器学习研究者。该工作更偏可解释性与结构分析，而非大规模预训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether FFN neuron activations in Transformers are largely determined by a small set of upstream neurons and attention outputs, thereby revealing sparse inter-layer dependencies.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability paper. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is relevant for understanding FFN effective degrees of freedom, interpretability under residual mixing, and possible future pruning or sparsification directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce a training-free attribution method that estimates how much a target FFN neuron depends on preceding neuron activations and attention outputs. The key test is to keep only a small selected subset of upstream inputs while replacing the rest with average values, then measure how well the target activation is preserved. They also apply neuron-specific masks across all layers simultaneously to test model-level robustness.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, experiments span multiple models and layers and show that small subsets of upstream activations and attention outputs can preserve target neuron activations with high fidelity. Effective sparsity becomes even stronger when upstream activation sparsity is taken into account. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes, datasets, or quantitative comparisons to other attribution methods.
summary_en.authors_note: Hanspeter Pfister is a senior Harvard researcher known for visualization and machine learning. The work is more about interpretability and structural analysis than large-scale pretraining experiments.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想 FFN 是否真需要这么 dense，这篇能给一点硬证据；先看方法设定和跨层同时加 mask 的实验，别急着外推到可训练稀疏架构。
recommendation.en: If you are questioning how dense FFNs really need to be, this gives useful evidence; read the attribution setup and the all-layer masking result, but do not overgeneralize it into trainable sparse architectures yet.

paper.title: Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias
paper.abstract: Existing studies of LLM-as-judge scoring bias work predominantly at the input-output level: they perturb inputs, measure score deltas, and propose prompt-level mitigations. We argue that the same biases admit a representation-level account in the judge's hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways it does not afford. We report three findings, across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks. Geometry: baseline judging inputs occupy a tight acti

summary.core_problem: 解释 LLM-as-Judge 的评分偏差是否对应 judge 模型隐藏状态中的可识别、可操控表示方向。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制解释和评测信号质量分析。LLM judge 已经大量进入自动评测、偏好数据筛选和后训练反馈，若偏差能在表示空间中被定位和因果操控，就比只做 prompt 层面的输入输出扰动更有诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 hidden state 几何入手，比较正常 judging 输入和带偏差输入的激活分布。它估计低维、类型特异的 bias subspace，并通过沿该方向 steering 隐状态做因果验证：正向移动让干净输入产生偏置评分，反向移动让带偏差输入恢复接近基线评分。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个 judge、7 类 bias 和 9 个 benchmark。结果显示基线 judging 输入位于较紧的激活流形，偏置输入沿低维类型特异子空间偏移，且这种结构随深度更明显。沿 bias subspace steering 的评分变化可双向控制；同范数随机方向带来的变化小一个数量级。
summary.authors_note: AMAP, Alibaba Group 与 MBZUAI、USC、University of Michigan 等合作。该工作来自阿里系团队，主题聚焦 LLM-as-Judge 偏差的表示级解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM-as-judge scoring biases correspond to identifiable and causally controllable directions in the judge model’s hidden states.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic-interpretability contribution with direct implications for evaluation-signal quality. Since LLM judges are used in automatic evaluation, preference filtering, and post-training feedback, representation-level bias control is more actionable than prompt-only perturbation analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze hidden-state geometry for clean and biased judging inputs. They estimate low-dimensional, bias-type-specific subspaces and test causality by steering hidden states along those directions: forward shifts induce biased scoring on clean inputs, while reverse shifts recover baseline-like scoring on biased inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks. Clean judging inputs occupy a tight activation manifold, while biased inputs move along low-dimensional type-specific subspaces that sharpen with depth. Steering along these subspaces changes scores in both directions, whereas norm-matched random directions produce changes about an order of magnitude smaller.
summary_en.authors_note: The work involves AMAP, Alibaba Group, MBZUAI, USC, and the University of Michigan. It is an Alibaba-associated study on representation-level explanations of LLM-as-judge bias.

recommendation.zh: 读 §hidden-state steering 和跨 judge 泛化结果；它把 judge 偏差从 prompt 现象推进到可干预表示信号。
recommendation.en: Read the hidden-state steering and cross-judge results; it turns judge bias from a prompt artifact into an intervenable representation signal.

institutions: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

paper.title: The Count Is There, but Misaligned: Understanding and Correcting Counting Failures in VLMs
paper.abstract: Despite strong performance on many multimodal tasks, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with basic object counting. We investigate whether this reflects missing internal knowledge or a gap between internal representations and verbalized outputs. Training simple probes on activations from four VLMs across five counting datasets reveals that nonlinear probes can reliably detect counting errors, suggesting that VLMs often encode the correct count even when they output the wrong answer. SV

summary.core_problem: VLM在基础目标计数任务上频繁出错，其成因是模型未习得计数能力，还是内部正确表征与语言输出间存在对齐错位。
summary.importance: 通过探针和因果干预明确VLM计数错误的核心机制是表征读出方向错位而非知识缺失，为理解多模态模型的幻觉来源、表征对齐缺口提供了任务级实证。
summary.technical_approach: 在4个VLM、5个计数数据集上训练线性/非线性探针检测计数错误；用SVCCA分析真实计数探针与模型输出探针的表征子空间重叠关系；通过因果激活steering验证正确计数方向的因果效用；提出探针引导的选择性重提示自校正方法。
summary.experiments: 覆盖4个公开VLM、5个计数数据集，非线性探针检测计数错误的可靠性显著高于线性探针；因果steering沿计数方向干预激活可稳定提升计数准确率；自校正方法通过选择性重提示修正错误，摘要未披露完整量化结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether VLM counting failures arise from a lack of internal counting capability, or from misalignment between correctly encoded internal representations and final verbalized outputs.
summary_en.importance: Provides causal evidence that VLM counting errors stem primarily from readout misalignment rather than missing knowledge, offering empirical support for representation-output gaps as a source of hallucination in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains linear and nonlinear probes on activations from 4 VLMs across 5 counting datasets to detect errors; applies SVCCA to measure subspace overlap between ground-truth count probes and model output probes; conducts causal activation steering to validate the functional role of count-aligned directions; proposes probe-guided selective re-prompting for self-correction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 4 public VLMs and 5 counting benchmarks; nonlinear probes reliably detect counting errors where linear probes fail; causal steering along count directions consistently improves counting accuracy; the self-correction method uses selective re-prompting, with full quantitative results not included in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: VLM计数场景下验证了「知识已编码但读出错位」的现象，与LLM幻觉的相关观察呼应，仅看探针和因果干预结果即可，自校正方法工程价值有限。
recommendation.en: Replicates the encoded-knowledge misaligned-readout finding in VLM counting, echoing LLM hallucination observations; skip the self-correction method, focus on probe and intervention results.

paper.title: Optimizing Against Safety Representations: Activation-Guided Adversarial Suffixes and the Geometry of Refusal
paper.abstract: Behavioral alignment in large language models often masks fragile internal safety representations. Recent work suggests that refusal behavior is mediated by low-dimensional directions in activation space. This raises questions about how such representations are structured, localized, and accessed by optimization. We study adversarial suffix attacks as a probe of representational alignment. We introduce Activation-Guided GCG, which replaces output-based objectives with losses that directly target

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 安全拒答表征在激活空间中的几何结构，以及对抗后缀攻击究竟是在局部击穿还是全局压制这些安全表征。
summary.importance: 这篇工作处在安全与机制分析交界处。对预训练研究员的价值不在 jailbreak 本身，而在于它把 refusal 视作低维但分布式的内部表征，并用攻击优化来反向探测表示结构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Activation-Guided GCG，用直接针对内部 refusal direction 的激活损失替代传统基于输出的目标；同时提出 Soft-GCG，用 Gumbel-Softmax 把离散后缀优化连续化。核心比较是：攻击单一层/位置与跨层跨位置全局抑制 refusal 表征，哪种更有效。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 Soft-GCG 相比标准 GCG 有 33× 加速；并发现跨所有层和位置全局压制 refusal 比只攻击单点更有效。未见预训练规模、数据或 clean setup 细节，更多是安全机制探针实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the geometry of safety/refusal representations in LLM activations and asks whether adversarial suffixes break safety locally or suppress it globally.
summary_en.importance: This sits at the boundary of safety and mechanistic analysis. Its value for pretraining researchers is not the jailbreak result itself, but the framing of refusal as a low-dimensional yet distributed internal representation probed through optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Activation-Guided GCG, replacing output-based objectives with activation losses that directly target an internal refusal direction. They also introduce Soft-GCG, a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation for continuous suffix optimization. The key comparison is between attacking a single layer-position pair versus globally suppressing refusal across layers and positions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 33× speedup of Soft-GCG over standard GCG, and finds that global suppression across all layers and positions is more effective than targeting a single site. No pretraining-scale setup or data insight is evident; this is mainly a safety-mechanism probing paper.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 的直接价值有限，但“拒答表征是分布式而非单点因果位点”这个结论值得记；只看方法图和主结果即可。
recommendation.en: Limited direct pretraining value, but the claim that refusal is distributed rather than localized is worth caching; the method sketch and main result are enough.

paper.title: Certified Interventional Fidelity: Anytime-Valid, Adaptive Evaluation of Causal Claims in Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often evaluates explanations by intervening on a model: swapping hidden states, patching activations, ablating components, or comparing a compressed model to the original one. These experiments are usually summarized by a point estimate, even though the evaluation may be monitored while it runs or adapted toward suspected failures. This makes it hard to tell whether a reported fidelity or patching effect is a stable causal claim or a consequence of finite sampling an

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性研究中广泛使用激活替换、路径修补、组件消融等干预实验验证解释的正确性，但现有流程通常只报告单点估计，且实验过程存在自适应调整（中途看结果、换评测集、找反例），没有不确定性量化，也不考虑自适应采样带来的统计偏差，导致报告的保真度或修补效应可能是有限采样或评估选择的偶然结果，而非稳定的因果结论。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的机制分析方向有实用价值——当前LLM可解释性（如IOI电路、归纳头、能力定位）大量依赖干预实验，CIF提供了一套可直接复用的统计层，能避免过度解读实验结果、错误排序解释方法，也为自适应找反例的评测流程提供了统计有效性保证，属于可解释性评测的基础设施类改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Certified Interventional Fidelity（CIF）框架，三个核心设计：1）把所有干预评测指标显式写成因果估计量——明确输入分布和干预分布上的有界分数期望，把科学问题和采样过程解耦；2）用anytime-valid置信序列（随时检查、提前停止都保持统计有效性）替代固定样本置信区间，基于Hoeffding界和方差自适应的betting序列实现；3）支持自适应采样（优先采样疑似失败的样本/干预），通过有界混合重要性权重（Horvitz-Thompson估计）保证目标估计量不变。同时提供了认证、配对比较、自适应采样、单侧停止规则的算法，以及应用检查清单。
summary.experiments: 在两个场景验证：1）MNIST神经抽象任务，能给出高保真解释的统计认证，识别无统计显著性的方法差异；2）GPT-2 Small的IOI（Indirect Object Identification）电路评测，暴露了结果对干预分布选择的敏感性，部分之前报告的高保真在严格统计检验下不成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计15-20分钟。重点看第1节的问题定义（现有干预评测的三个统计缺陷）、第3节的CIF三个设计原则的动机，以及第5节GPT-2 IOI的实验结果（对LLM可解释性研究者最相关）；附录的算法细节和证明可按需查阅。

summary_en.core_problem: Interventional evaluations in mechanistic interpretability (activation patching, path ablation, circuit swapping etc.) typically report only point estimates, and are often run adaptively (intermediate result monitoring, evaluation set adjustment, counterexample hunting) without uncertainty quantification or bias correction for adaptive sampling. This makes reported fidelity scores and patching effects statistically unreliable — they may stem from finite sampling noise or evaluation design choices rather than stable causal claims.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical statistical infrastructure for mechanistic interpretability research on LLMs, where intervention-based experiments are the standard for validating circuit/head/neuron function claims. CIF prevents overinterpretation of noisy results, eliminates false ranking of explanation methods, and preserves statistical validity when evaluators adaptively search for failure cases, filling a long-standing gap in interpretability evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Certified Interventional Fidelity (CIF) framework has three core design choices: (1) Explicitly formulate every intervention metric as a bounded causal estimand — expectation of a score over a declared input distribution and intervention distribution, decoupling the scientific question from sampling procedure; (2) Deploy anytime-valid confidence sequences (valid under repeated peeking and optional stopping) derived from Hoeffding bounds and variance-adaptive betting sequences, instead of fixed-sample confidence intervals; (3) Support adaptive failure-directed sampling while preserving the target estimand via bounded mixture importance weighting (Horvitz-Thompson estimator). The work also ships algorithms for certification, paired comparison, adaptive sampling, one-sided stopping rules, and a reporting checklist.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two settings: (1) MNIST neural abstraction tasks, where CIF certifies high-fidelity claims and detects method differences that lack statistical significance; (2) GPT-2 Small Indirect Object Identification (IOI) circuit evaluation, where CIF reveals strong sensitivity of reported fidelity to intervention distribution choices, and some previously claimed high-fidelity results fail to pass strict statistical certification.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, 15-20 minutes. Focus on Section 1 for the three statistical flaws in current interventional evaluation workflows, Section 3 for the motivation behind CIF's three design principles, and Section 5 for GPT-2 IOI experiments (most relevant for LLM interpretability researchers). Algorithm details and proofs in appendices are optional.

recommendation.zh: 做机制可解释性实验的研究员可直接用该框架校准结论，重点看§3因果估计量形式化和§4任意时刻置信序列的推导。
recommendation.en: For mechanistic interpretability researchers, use this framework to calibrate experimental claims; focus on §3 causal estimand formalization and §4 anytime-valid confidence sequence derivation.

paper.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM Jailbreaks via Internal Attribution Graphs
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable capabilities but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial prompts and jailbreak attacks. Existing approaches primarily analyze these failures through input-output behaviors or attribution methods, offering limited insight into how adversarial perturbations alter the model's internal reasoning. Consequently, the mechanisms underlying unsafe or incorrect behaviors remain poorly understood. We introduce a mechanistic framework for diagnosing LLM vulner

summary.core_problem: 现有 jailbreak 分析大多停留在输入-输出行为或单点归因层面，无法解释对抗性 prompt 如何系统性改变 LLM 的内部计算通路，从而导致安全机制失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练和对齐研究者的价值主要在机制层面：它试图把 jailbreak 问题从“prompt 层面的 bug”转化为“计算图层面的路径重路由问题”。文中一个值得注意的发现是，针对单个可疑节点做干预通常无法缓解攻击，说明失效模式更像是分布式子图通路而非单个安全神经元失效。这对基于安全向量、单个抑制方向、稀疏方向调控等干预思路是一个有用的警示。
summary.technical_approach: 为每个 prompt 在给定输出位置构造一张内部归因图：节点覆盖 token embedding、attention 输出、FFN 特征、residual stream、logits 以及 reconstruction error 等异构内部表示；边用“梯度×激活”的因果贡献度估计，并通过保留每个节点 top-k 入边维持稀疏性。核心不是对单图做静态分析，而是对 clean prompt 和 attacked prompt 配对构图、对齐，再量化节点、边、路径和子图级别的结构偏移。论文进一步引入因果干预框架，通过激活/抑制特定内部结构来验证这些偏差是否真的对攻击成功负责，并据此归纳出 safety suppression、attack emergence、computation rerouting 几类脆弱性 motif。
summary.experiments: 论文展示了内部图偏离程度与 jailbreak 成功之间存在相关性；更重要的消融是，节点级定点干预普遍不能有效缓解攻击，而与攻击相关的变化分布在多条路径和更高阶子图上，说明脆弱性是分布式、结构性的，而不是局部特征开关式的。文中未强调特别大的参数规模或新的 sota 防御效果，重点在诊断和机制验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。建议重点看 Method 中图的构造方式，尤其是节点集合为什么纳入 reconstruction error，以及边权重如何定义；再看 paired alignment 和 intervention 两部分，理解论文如何从“归因”走到“因果验证”。最后关注 vulnerability motifs 和“节点级干预无效”的实验结论。预计阅读 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing jailbreak analyses operate at the input-output level or rely on isolated attribution scores, leaving unclear how adversarial prompts systematically reroute a model’s internal computation to bypass safety mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining and alignment research is mechanistic rather than immediately recipe-driven. The paper reframes jailbreaks as structured deviations in internal computation graphs rather than isolated prompt bugs. A particularly relevant finding is that targeted interventions on individual suspicious nodes often fail to mitigate attacks, suggesting that failure modes are distributed across pathways and subgraphs rather than localized to a single safety neuron or direction. This is a useful caution for proposals that rely on safety vectors, single-direction suppression, or sparse feature knockouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: For a given prompt and output position, the method constructs a sparse causal attribution graph over heterogeneous internal states: token embeddings, attention outputs, feedforward features, residual-stream states, logits, and reconstruction-error nodes. Edges are estimated with gradient-times-activation causal influence scores, with sparsity enforced by keeping only the top-k incoming edges per node. The central design is paired analysis: graphs are built for both clean and attacked inputs, aligned structurally, and deviations are quantified at the node, edge, path, and subgraph levels. A causal intervention framework is then used to test whether these altered structures actually contribute to attack success. On this basis, the paper identifies vulnerability motifs such as safety suppression, attack emergence, and computation rerouting.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that internal graph deviations correlate with jailbreak success. The more informative ablation is that node-level interventions are generally ineffective at neutralizing attacks, while attack-relevant changes are spread across multiple pathways and higher-order subgraphs. The study is positioned as a diagnostic and mechanistic analysis rather than a new defense benchmark, so the emphasis is on qualitative structure and intervention results rather than large-scale leaderboard gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read as a skim. Focus on the graph construction in Method, especially why reconstruction-error nodes are included and how edge weights are defined, then move to paired graph alignment and the intervention framework. The most actionable part is the discussion of vulnerability motifs and the evidence that failures are distributed rather than localized. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 从因果计算图的角度分析 Jailbreak 机制，对关注模型安全性和内部表示（Mechanistic Interpretability）的研究员有参考价值，建议看其图构建方法。
recommendation.en: Analyzes Jailbreak mechanisms from the perspective of causal computation graphs; valuable for researchers focusing on model safety and mechanistic interpretability. Recommend reviewing their graph construction method.

paper.title: Cross-seed explainability using Procrustes-conditioned Joint End-to-end Top-K Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: We present a Procrustes-conditioned Joint End-to-end Top-K Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) for extracting cross-seed universal features from independently trained BERT models. Cross-seed feature universality is a fundamental challenge in mechanistic interpretability: because dictionary learning is non-convex, independently trained networks learn misaligned feature spaces, so apparently identical features may differ by random initialization. We address this by computing an orthogonal Procrustes rotation

summary.core_problem: 解决不同随机种子训练出的 BERT 模型中，SAE 学到的特征空间难以对齐、难以判断哪些特征具有跨 seed 普适性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制可解释性方法改进。它关注 SAE 特征 universality，这是把单模型特征解释推进到跨模型稳定性的必要步骤；但实验对象是 BERT 和下游分类任务，对当前大规模 LLM 预训练的直接反馈有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Procrustes-conditioned Joint End-to-end Top-K Sparse Autoencoder。方法先在不同 seed 的 activation space 之间计算正交 Procrustes 旋转，再做联合 SAE 训练；同时结合 Top-K 稀疏、端到端下游优化，以及用于缓解 dead feature 的辅助 revival loss。核心不是重新设计 Transformer，而是让 SAE 字典学习在跨 seed 对齐条件下进行。
summary.experiments: 在 5 组独立 seed pair、共 10 个 BERT 模型上评估，任务包括 SST-2、Stanford Politeness 和 TweetEval Emotion。指标关注跨 seed 特征相关性，完整 pipeline 在三个数据集上都比 post-hoc alignment baseline 产生更多 Pearson r ≥ 0.70 的 universal features。摘要未给出模型规模以外的训练细节和完整消融数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Centre for Social Sciences / CSS-RECENS Research Group 和 Budapest University；从给定信息看，不属于主流 LLM 基座训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to identify seed-invariant SAE features when independently trained BERT models have misaligned activation and dictionary spaces.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability method contribution. It targets feature universality across random seeds, a useful step toward making SAE-based explanations less model-instance-specific, but its direct value for frontier LLM pretraining is limited by the BERT-scale setup and classification-task evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is a Procrustes-conditioned Joint End-to-end Top-K Sparse Autoencoder. It first computes an orthogonal Procrustes rotation between activation spaces from different seeds, then trains a joint SAE with Top-K sparsity, end-to-end downstream supervision, and an auxiliary dead-feature revival loss. The novelty is in conditioning dictionary learning on cross-seed alignment rather than aligning features only after training.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses five seed pairs, covering ten BERT models, on SST-2, Stanford Politeness, and TweetEval Emotion. The full pipeline yields more cross-seed universal features, defined by Pearson r ≥ 0.70, than post-hoc alignment baselines on all three datasets. The abstract does not provide full ablation tables or large-model evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Centre for Social Sciences / CSS-RECENS Research Group and Budapest University; no major foundation-model training lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和结果表即可；SAE 对齐问题是真问题，但 BERT seed 实验离基座训练还远。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and result table only; SAE alignment is a real issue, but BERT seed experiments are far from foundation-model training.

institutions: Centre for Social Sciences, CSS-RECENS Research Group, Budapest

paper.title: When Structured Sparse Autoencoders Learn Consistent Concepts Across Modalities
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a promising technique for mechanistic interpretability by learning a set of sparse latent features in large models, each of which encodes a distinct concept. However, in vision-language models (VLMs), vanilla SAEs struggle to learn modality-consistent concepts, with concepts often exhibiting fragmented coverage (i.e., disjoint regions) in the visual modality. To address this challenge, we propose a Structured Sparse AutoEncoder ($S^2AE$) that enforces c

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 中 vanilla SAE 学到的稀疏概念在视觉模态上不连续、不一致，难以形成跨模态可解释概念的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制解释方法改进。它不是预训练方法，但触及 VLM 表征是否能被稳定分解为跨模态概念，对分析视觉 token、patch attention 与语言概念对齐有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Structured Sparse AutoEncoder，即 S²AE。在训练 SAE 时，先根据 Transformer attention 相似度和空间邻近性对图像 patch 分组，再加入结构化稀疏正则：组间使用 exclusive sparsity 促进概念解耦，组内使用 group sparsity 促进同一语义区域内概念一致激活。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 VLM、参数规模、数据规模和数值结果。实验重点应是比较 vanilla SAE 与 S²AE 在视觉区域覆盖、跨模态概念一致性和概念碎片化程度上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the failure of vanilla SAEs to learn modality-consistent concepts in VLMs, especially fragmented visual coverage across image regions.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability method contribution. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for studying how VLM representations bind visual patches to language-level concepts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed S²AE groups image patches using Transformer attention similarity and spatial proximity. It then trains an SAE with structured sparsity: exclusive sparsity encourages inter-group disentanglement, while group sparsity encourages intra-group consistency of concept activations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model scale, data scale, or quantitative gains. The expected comparison is against vanilla SAE on concept consistency, visual coverage, and fragmentation metrics in VLM representations.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 regularizer 设计；它给 VLM SAE 一个更干净的空间先验，但离 pretrain recipe 还远。
recommendation.en: Skim the regularizer; it adds a useful spatial prior for VLM SAEs, but it is far from a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Multiplication Beyond Groups: Stratified Fourier Mechanisms in Transformer Circuits
paper.abstract: Transformers have demonstrated a remarkable ability to learn algorithmic reasoning, yet mechanistic analyses have mostly focused on globally invertible operations such as cyclic addition and group composition. In this work, we investigate how small transformers learn modular integer multiplication over composite moduli, a fundamentally non-invertible operation due to the presence of zero-divisors. We propose the monoid extension: a localized generalization of Group Composition via Representation

summary.core_problem: 解释小型 Transformer 如何学习复合模数下的模乘：该运算在代数上是 monoid 而非 group，存在零因子导致不可逆与信息塌缩，传统基于全局可逆结构的 GCR（Group Composition via Representation）机制不再直接适用。论文要回答的是：模型是否仍用 Fourier/表示论式机制？如果是，它如何在非可逆结构中组织计算？
summary.importance: 对预训练本身（数据/优化/recipe）不是直接贡献，但对“算法任务上 Transformer 的表征组织方式”有启发：当任务结构不是全局一致的群结构时，模型可能通过把输入空间分层/分区，在局部子空间里恢复近似的 group-like 结构，再复用 Fourier 机制。这类“局部路由 + 局部表征”的思路，和大模型里常见的条件计算/专家分工/子空间专门化有相通之处，适合作为机制分析的参考案例。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出对 GCR 的非群扩展假说：不是在单一全局表示空间里完成乘法，而是把 ℤ_n 的元素按代数结构划分为若干局部 strata（文中用 monoid 的语言描述，如 units 与 zero-divisors，以及更细的等价类结构），在每个 stratum 内存在可用的“局部逆/局部角色（characters）”，从而可以构造局部 Fourier 特征来解释 embedding 与 logits。
实现层面，论文做的是电路级拆解：在 1-layer decoder-only Transformer 上，检查注意力与 OV 回路是否把信息路由到低维的局部子空间；再用“局部 Fourier characters + 局部 inverses”去拟合/解释模型输出 logits 的大部分结构，作为对假说的证据。
summary.experiments:
训练设置在正文给得较清楚：
- 任务：输入三 token 序列 (a, b, =) 预测 c=a·b mod n。
- 模型：1-layer decoder-only Transformer，d_model=128，MLP hidden=512，输出维度为 n。
- 优化：AdamW，训练 25,000 epochs；主要分析 n=165（square-free composite），其余模数放在附录。
- 结果类型：不是以泛化分数为主，而是以机制解释度为主——展示模型会按代数结构分区路由，并且局部 Fourier characters/局部逆可以解释相当比例的 logits（摘要与引言用“substantial fraction / large fraction”表述；给定正文片段未包含具体百分比与对应图表编号）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–50 分钟）：
- 先读 Sec.3–4：把问题设定与“locality/strata”的代数定义看懂，尤其是为什么 composite modulus 下乘法是 monoid、零因子带来什么困难。
- 重点看 Sec.4 的假说与对 GCR 的推广（monoid extension）：这是全文的概念骨架。
- 再看 Sec.5 的 layer-by-layer 电路拆解：关注作者如何从 attention/OV 的具体行为推断“路由到局部子空间”，以及他们如何把 logits 分解为局部 character/局部 inverse 的贡献。
- 如果时间不够：Appendix D 的例子（文中点名 D.2、D.6）能快速补齐 monoid/零因子直觉；其余模数的复现实验可只扫图不细读。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how a small Transformer implements modular multiplication for composite moduli, where the algebra is a commutative monoid with zero divisors (non-invertible, information-collapsing), so standard group-based mechanistic accounts like GCR do not directly apply. The goal is to characterize what replaces a single global Fourier/representation space mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-recipe paper, but it offers a concrete mechanistic template for ‘local specialization’: when the underlying structure is not globally group-like, the model can partition the input space into algebraic strata and reuse Fourier-style mechanisms locally. This is conceptually adjacent to how large models may implement conditional computation or subspace specialization, and it provides a worked example with a clean mathematical task.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes a monoid extension of GCR: rather than embedding all elements into one global representation where composition is invertible, the model routes different regions of the input space into disjoint low-dimensional local subspaces where group-like structure survives. Within each stratum, local inverses and local Fourier characters can be defined and used to explain internal representations and output scoring.
Methodologically, they combine algebraic structure (units vs zero divisors and finer monoid class structure) with circuit-level analysis of a 1-layer decoder-only Transformer, inspecting attention and OV pathways for routing behavior and then attributing a large portion of logits to local-character / local-inverse components.
summary_en.experiments:
Experimental setup (explicit in the provided excerpt):
- Task: predict c = a·b mod n from a 3-token sequence (a, b, =).
- Model: 1-layer decoder-only Transformer, d_model=128, MLP hidden=512, vocabulary/output size n.
- Training: AdamW, 25,000 epochs; main case study n=165, with other moduli in the appendix.
- Evidence: primarily mechanistic—showing stratified routing into local subspaces and that local Fourier characters and local inverses account for a substantial/large fraction of output logits. (The excerpt does not include the exact explained-variance numbers or the key figure/table references.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–50 minutes):
- Sec.3–4: understand the algebraic setup and the definition of locality/strata; this is where the monoid vs group distinction becomes operational.
- Sec.4: focus on the stated hypothesis and how they generalize GCR to the non-invertible setting.
- Sec.5: read the layer-by-layer circuit story, especially how attention/OV implements routing and how logits are decomposed into local character/inverse contributions.
- Appendix D (examples D.2, D.6 as suggested): quick intuition for zero divisors and why global invertibility fails; skim the multi-modulus results in the appendix if you want robustness checks.

recommendation.zh: 深入探讨了 Transformer 学习非可逆代数运算的内部机制，提出的局部傅里叶机制对理解模型如何处理复杂逻辑有启发，值得关注其机制分析部分。
recommendation.en: Deeply explores the internal mechanisms of Transformers learning non-invertible algebraic operations; the proposed localized Fourier mechanisms offer insights into how models handle complex logic, worth skimming for its mechanistic analysis.

paper.title: Dissociating the Internal Representations of Sycophancy in LLMs
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit sycophancy, where they agree with a user's statement even when incorrect. While sycophancy is often treated as a single defined behavior, it can manifest in substantially distinct ways and circumstances, raising the question of whether this multi-faceted nature is reflected in its internal mechanisms. To address this gap, we dissociate the representations of sycophancy into factual and opinion subtypes -- motivated by the distinction between verifi

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 的 sycophancy 是否对应单一内部表征，还是在事实性迎合与观点性迎合之间存在可分离机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与安全行为表征分析。它把一个常被粗粒度评估的对齐失效现象拆成两个子类型，并用表征迁移和干预来检验是否共享内部方向。
summary.technical_approach: 在模型激活上分别针对事实型 sycophancy 和观点型 sycophancy 训练线性 probe，并构造 steering vector；随后把一个子类型上学到的 probe 或 steering direction 迁移到另一子类型，观察泛化、干预效果和相互干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、模型名称、数据集大小或数值结果。主要实验结论是不同 LLM 对两类 sycophancy 的表征方式不同：有些模型更统一，有些模型更分离，并且可能出现因果干预上的相互干扰。

summary_en.core_problem: Studies whether LLM sycophancy is represented as a single internal feature or decomposes into separable factual and opinion-based subtypes.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and safety-behavior analysis. It refines a coarse alignment-failure label into two subtypes and tests whether they share internal directions through transfer and intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train linear probes on activations for factual sycophancy and opinion sycophancy, then build steering vectors from one subtype and evaluate transfer to the other subtype. The key test is whether probing and steering effects generalize or causally interfere across subtypes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, model families, dataset sizes, or numeric gains. The main reported finding is model-dependent: some LLMs encode the two subtypes more jointly, while others encode them more distinctly and with causal interference.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和结果表即可；它提醒我们别把 sycophancy 当单一 SAE/probe 方向处理。
recommendation.en: Read the method and result tables only; it warns against treating sycophancy as one universal probe or steering direction.

paper.title: Mechanistic Interpretability for Neural Networks: Circuits, Sparse Features and Symbolic Reasoning
paper.abstract: This article offers a comprehensive overview of mechanistic interpretability, an emerging field that seeks to reverse-engineer the internal algorithms of modern neural networks. While traditional explainable AI methods often stop at surface-level input-output correlations, this approach directly addresses the opaque "black box" nature of machine learning models, which is essential for ensuring safety and auditability in high-stakes deployments. The paper provides a detailed examination of Transf

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理机制可解释性领域的核心方法与进展，解决传统XAI仅停留在输入输出关联、无法拆解模型内部算法的问题。
summary.importance: 综述类贡献，覆盖Transformer电路分析、叠加与多义性拆解、模型行为控制三大方向，为入门机制分析提供结构化框架。
summary.technical_approach: 从残差流、注意力、induction heads等组件切入讲解电路分析；引入稀疏自编码器(SAE)与transcoder拆解叠加表征；最后讨论主动修改模型行为的干预方法。
summary.experiments: 无原创实验，为综述性文章，整合已有工作的结论与案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Provides a structured overview of mechanistic interpretability, addressing the limitation of traditional XAI which only captures surface-level input-output correlations instead of internal algorithms.
summary_en.importance: Survey contribution covering Transformer circuit analysis, superposition/polysemanticity disentanglement, and active model behavior control, serving as an entry-point framework for the field.
summary_en.technical_approach: Explains circuit analysis through residual stream, attention, and induction heads; introduces Sparse Autoencoders and transcoders to decompose tangled activations; discusses intervention methods for modifying model behavior.
summary_en.experiments: No original experiments; a survey that synthesizes conclusions and case studies from prior work.

recommendation.zh: 作为机制可解释性入门综述备查，无新实验结论，熟悉SAE与induction heads的研究者无需读正文。
recommendation.en: An introductory mechanistic interpretability survey for reference; no new empirical findings, skip full text if already familiar with SAEs and induction heads.

paper.title: Controlling Tool Use with Heading-Specific Activation Steering
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented large language models extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowledge through external tools, but tend to invoke them unnecessarily. We investigate whether tool-use decisions have any stable internal representation that can be extracted and manipulated, a question that is non-trivial given that tools exist entirely in context at inference time and have no direct encoding in model weights. We show that steering vectors extracted from heading-anchors positions exert bidirectio

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：工具调用这个完全由上下文定义的行为，是否存在可被抽取和干预的内部激活方向。问题不只是减少工具过用，而是验证模型在即将生成 Search、Code、AskUser 这类结构化 heading 时，是否形成了稳定到足以做因果控制的表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对 agentic LLM 的机制分析和推理时控制有参考意义。它把 activation steering 从情感、拒答、真实性这类有参数化语义基础的概念，推进到工具调用这种非参数化、上下文临时定义的行为。主要启发是：模型行为可被局部激活干预控制，并不必然说明存在干净的线性概念表示；因果可控性和几何可解释性可能分离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕结构化输出中的 Heading-Anchors 展开，例如 ### Reasoning、### Search、### Code、### AskUser、### Final Response。作者不在全生成过程中持续 steering，而只在模型即将形成 heading 的位置做局部干预。具体做法是：先收集带完整工具交互轨迹的数据，在指定层抽取每个 heading 的 leading ### token hidden state；再以样本为单位比较 Reasoning heading 与目标工具 heading 的激活，构造工具类型相关的 steering vector；推理时检测 imminent ### heading formation，并只重跑被触发的那个 decoding step，在指定层通过 hook 加入或移除相关方向。样本级构造避免长轨迹因 heading 数量多而被过度加权。与常规 representation engineering 的区别在于，它处理的不是权重中长期学习到的概念，而是 prompt 内临时声明的工具接口。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个开源 instruction-tuned 模型和三个工具使用领域。主要现象是：activation addition 可以显著压低工具调用率，orthogonalization 反而会把工具调用率推高，说明该方向对工具选择有双向因果作用。抑制效果在模型参数知识足以解决的问题上更明显；在确实需要检索、代码执行或向用户澄清的场景中效果下降。更大的模型整体更难被 steering 改变。几何分析给出一个负结果：工具调用步相对 suppression vector 的 cosine similarity 呈弥散的双峰分布，而不是线性概念假设下应看到的稳定负对齐；不同工具类型使用的内部特征维度重叠较低。提供内容未给出具体模型名称、层号、调用率下降幅度和各 benchmark 分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中 heading-anchor state 的抽取、样本级 delta 的构造、触发式局部干预流程；再看结果部分中 suppression、orthogonalization 的对照，以及 cosine/geometric analysis。最值得深挖的是因果 steering 有效但线性结构不干净这一点，它提醒不要把 activation steering 的成功直接解释为发现了单一线性概念方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether tool-use decisions in tool-augmented LLMs have an internal activation pattern that can be extracted and causally controlled, even though tools are defined only in the prompt and interaction context rather than encoded as stable parametric concepts.
summary_en.importance: The work is not central to base-model pretraining, but it is useful for understanding controllability in agentic LLMs. Its main contribution is methodological: it tests activation steering on a non-parametric behavior, unlike prior steering work on sentiment, refusal, or truthfulness. The important lesson is that causal steering can work even when the underlying geometry does not look like a clean linear representation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses structured headings such as ### Reasoning, ### Search, ### Code, ### AskUser, and ### Final Response as intervention points. Instead of steering every token, the method intervenes only when the model is about to form a new heading. The authors collect complete tool-use trajectories, run the model over the full prompt-response sequence, and extract hidden states at the leading ### token of each heading at a chosen layer. For each tool type, they construct a contrastive vector from Reasoning-heading states and tool-heading states, using sample-level averaging to avoid overweighting trajectories with many headings. At inference time, the system detects imminent heading formation, reruns only that decoding step, and applies a local hook-based activation intervention at the target layer.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span five open-source instruction-tuned models and three domains. Adding the extracted vectors suppresses tool calls below baseline, while orthogonalizing hidden states with respect to the vectors increases tool use. Suppression is strongest when the model can answer from parametric knowledge and weaker when external search, code execution, or user clarification is actually needed. Larger models are more resistant to the intervention. The geometric analysis is the most informative result: tool-invocation states show a diffuse bimodal cosine-similarity pattern rather than consistent alignment, and different tool types rely on largely distinct feature dimensions. The provided content does not include exact model names, layer choices, or numerical suppression rates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the heading-anchor construction, the sample-level steering vector estimator, and the triggered one-step intervention mechanism. Then read the causal-control results together with the cosine-similarity and cross-tool-overlap analysis. The key point is the gap between behavioral controllability and simple linear-representation explanations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，不是因为 steering 又多强，而是它把“可控=线性特征”这个偷懒解释拆掉了；重点读几何分析那部分。
recommendation.en: Worth reading not for another steering trick, but because it weakens the lazy equation of controllability with linear feature encoding; focus on the geometry analysis.

paper.title: A Coin Flip Per Token: Bernoulli Sparse Steering of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Activation steering via sparse autoencoders (SAEs) enables behavioral control of large language models without task-specific fine-tuning, but standard methods apply the steering signal at every generated token, incurring constant per-token perturbation that risks degrading fluency. We ask: is dense intervention necessary? We introduce Stochastic Token Steering (STS), which gates each token independently with probability $p$, and Stochastic Block Steering (SBS), which gates a leading window once

summary.core_problem: 研究 SAE activation steering 是否必须在每个生成 token 上持续注入控制信号，还是可以用稀疏、随机的干预达到类似行为控制。
summary.importance: 贡献是对 LLM 激活干预机制的经验分析，而不是新的预训练方法。它把 steering 看成跨序列累积剂量问题，提示行为控制效果可能由总注入量而非逐 token 连续性主导。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两种无需 reward model 或学习式 gating policy 的稀疏 steering：Stochastic Token Steering 对每个 token 以概率 p 独立决定是否注入 SAE 方向；Stochastic Block Steering 在序列开头窗口做一次性门控。核心改动很小，但把干预频率和干预强度解耦，便于测量剂量效应。
summary.experiments: 在两个模型家族和两个行为控制任务上比较密集 steering、稀疏 steering 与 prompt-based control。摘要报告显示，50% token 干预可恢复大部分密集干预效果并更好保持流畅性；30% token 干预仍可超过 prompt 控制。还观察到最优 steering magnitude 与 intervention ratio 近似反比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether SAE-based activation steering needs to perturb every generated token, or whether sparse stochastic interventions are enough for behavioral control.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a mechanistic control study rather than a pretraining contribution. Its useful point is the framing of steering as cumulative signal dosage across a sequence, not as a mandatory dense per-token operation.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces two simple gating schemes without reward models or learned policies: Stochastic Token Steering, which independently applies the SAE steering vector with probability p at each token, and Stochastic Block Steering, which gates a leading sequence window once. The design isolates intervention rate from steering magnitude.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover two model families and two behavioral tasks. The abstract reports that steering 50% of tokens recovers most of dense steering while preserving fluency, and even 30% token steering can outperform prompt-based control. The optimal steering magnitude appears to scale inversely with the intervention ratio.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不是主线；只看 ratio–magnitude ablation，剂量守恒这个现象可作为激活干预的弱先验。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the ratio–magnitude ablation, where the dosage-conservation behavior is the only signal worth carrying forward.

paper.title: Can Dialects Be Steered Like Languages? Sparse Neurons and Distributed Directions in Arabic LLMs
paper.abstract: A key challenge in Arabic NLP is the scarcity of dialectal data relative to Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), causing LLMs to overproduce MSA and struggle with dialectally accurate generation. From an interpretability perspective, this raises a fundamental question: where and how are dialectal features encoded within model internals, and can these representations be leveraged to improve dialect generation without fine-tuning? This study investigates two complementary inference-time approaches that s

summary.core_problem: 在阿拉伯语 LLM 中，方言（如埃及、海湾等）与 MSA（现代标准阿拉伯语）高度词汇/句法重叠且边界模糊，模型又因预训练数据偏置而倾向输出 MSA。论文要回答两个问题：方言特征在模型内部是“稀疏局部化”（少量神经元/子电路）还是“分布式”（残差流方向）编码？以及在不微调的前提下，能否用推理时干预稳定地把生成拉向目标方言。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在于改训练配方，而在于提供了一个可操作的“数据偏置 → 表征形态 → 可控性”链路：当预训练语料强偏向 MSA 时，方言能力不足并不只是缺数据的表面现象，而会在内部形成可被因果操控的表征结构（晚层更集中、MSA 与口语方言更可分、方言之间共享更多）。这类结果对两类工作有启发：1）预训练数据配比/课程学习如何影响可分离的属性方向；2）在持续预训练或轻量对齐前，先用表征探针判断“补数据/补目标”会落在局部电路还是全局方向上，从而决定用 LoRA/全参/数据再平衡哪种更划算。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两条互补的推理时干预，权重全程冻结，既当控制器也当可解释性因果探针。

(1) 稀疏神经元（MLP neuron）方言 steering：沿用 Tang et al. 2024 的 LAPE 思路做“选择性神经元”挖掘。对每个 MLP 神经元 j（在层 i），在各方言语料上统计其 ReLU 激活概率 p̂^k_{i,j}=E[1{act>0}]，再把跨方言分布做 ℓ1 归一化并计算熵（LAPE）。低熵表示该神经元更偏向少数方言。筛选规则是：同时满足“对某方言激活概率处于 top n%”与“LAPE 处于 bottom m%”。推理时对目标方言集合 D_k(i) 的神经元做乘性放大（系数 α），对 MSA 神经元集合 D_MSA(i) 做抑制（系数 γ），并可选对竞争方言集合做额外抑制（γ_comp）。直觉是：用少量高选择性神经元增强方言信号、压制 MSA 默认模式。

(2) 分布式残差方向（activation-vector）steering：从“方言–MSA 对比样本”中抽取残差流/激活空间的方言方向（论文表述为 dialect-specific directions extracted from contrastive dialect–MSA pairs），推理时把该方向注入到激活中以偏置生成。它不依赖少量神经元，而是利用更广泛的分布式表征。

核心发现是“方言信息既稀疏又分布式”：能找到晚层的方言相关稀疏神经元群，但这些神经元只覆盖了更大残差方向的一个投影，因此神经元 steering 能强化方言但稳定性不如向量 steering。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的关键实验结论以结构性观察为主，而非大规模下游基准刷分：
- 层级分布：方言相关神经元更集中在靠近输出的后期层（generation-facing layers），符合“越靠后越接近表面风格/词形选择”的经验。
- 可分性结构：MSA 与口语方言更容易分开；区域方言之间共享显著，说明方言差异不像“不同语言”那样形成互相独立的模块。
- 干预效果对比：神经元放大/抑制可以把输出推向目标方言，但由于只抓到分布式方向的部分投影，效果更脆；分布式 activation-vector steering 更可靠。

你给到的正文片段未包含完整的量化表格与具体数值（例如方言分类准确率、dialect fidelity 指标、不同 α/γ 的曲线、与不干预/仅提示词的对比提升幅度）。若需要“具体数字级”复盘，需要补充论文后半部分的实验章节与附录表格。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1) Introduction：抓住论文的主张——阿语方言不是纯局部也不是纯分布式，而是“稀疏+分布式”的混合形态；以及为什么这和“方言高度重叠”有关。
2) Methodology：重点看 LAPE 的筛选定义（激活概率 + 熵）与推理时乘性缩放公式里 α/γ/γ_comp 的角色；这决定了方法可复现性。
3) 实验部分优先找三类图表：a) 方言神经元在层上的分布；b) MSA vs 方言、方言 vs 方言的共享/分离可视化；c) neuron steering 与 vector steering 的对比曲线（稳定性、强度-可读性 trade-off）。
4) 如果你关心预训练数据：把“MSA 数据占优 → 默认输出 MSA”当作一个可解释性诊断案例，思考在持续预训练里用数据再平衡能否改变这些晚层稀疏神经元的密度与方向可分性。

summary_en.core_problem: Arabic LLMs are heavily biased toward Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) due to pretraining data imbalance, and they often fail to generate dialect-faithful text. The paper asks where dialectal features live inside the model—localized in sparse MLP neurons or distributed as residual-stream directions—and whether inference-time interventions (without finetuning) can reliably steer generation toward a target dialect despite strong overlap among Arabic varieties.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe paper, but it is useful for pretraining researchers as a concrete “data bias → internal representation → controllability” case study. It suggests that when a dominant variety (MSA) overwhelms the mixture, the model can still form steerable dialect structure: dialect-related signals concentrate in late layers, MSA separates more cleanly from spoken dialects, and dialects share circuitry. Practically, it informs how one might diagnose whether fixing a capability gap should be done via data rebalancing/continued pretraining versus lightweight adaptation, and it provides a template for probing how mixture changes might reshape sparse circuits vs distributed directions.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two complementary, weight-frozen, inference-time interventions are studied as both control mechanisms and causal interpretability probes.

(1) Neuron-level steering: Following a LAPE-style selection (Tang et al., 2024), the method computes per-dialect activation probabilities for each MLP neuron (ReLU-on frequency) and measures selectivity via the entropy of the normalized across-dialect activation distribution (low entropy = selective). Neurons are selected if they are highly active for at least one dialect (top n%) and highly selective (bottom m% LAPE). During decoding, activations of target-dialect neurons are multiplicatively amplified (α), while MSA-associated neurons are suppressed (γ), optionally also suppressing competitor dialect neurons (γ_comp).

(2) Distributed direction steering: A dialect direction is extracted from contrastive dialect–MSA pairs in activation/residual space, then injected during inference to bias generation. This targets a global, distributed representation rather than a small neuron subset.

Key claim: dialect information is both sparse and distributed. Sparse neurons exist (especially in late layers) but capture only a partial projection of the broader dialect direction, explaining why vector steering is more robust than neuron steering.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical takeaways emphasized in the provided full-text portion are structural rather than leaderboard-driven:
- Layer localization: dialect-associated neurons concentrate in late, generation-facing layers.
- Geometry/sharing: MSA is more separable from spoken dialects; regional dialects share substantial neuron sets/structure, consistent with fuzzy boundaries.
- Intervention comparison: neuron rescaling can push outputs toward a dialect but is less reliable; distributed activation-vector steering yields more consistent control.

The excerpt you provided does not include the full results tables/metrics (e.g., dialect fidelity scores, exact accuracy deltas, hyperparameter sweeps over α/γ, or comparisons against prompt-only baselines). A number-level summary would require the complete experiments/appendix sections.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the Introduction for the central hypothesis: Arabic dialects are not “languages” internally; they show a sparse+distributed hybrid encoding.
2) In Methodology, focus on the LAPE-based neuron selection definition (activation probability + entropy) and the exact multiplicative intervention (α/γ/γ_comp). This is the reproducibility-critical part.
3) In Experiments, prioritize figures/tables that show (a) layer-wise concentration of dialect neurons, (b) separability/sharing between MSA and dialects, and (c) robustness comparison between neuron steering and vector steering.
4) If your interest is pretraining mixtures, treat this as a diagnostic lens: ask how changing MSA:dialect ratios in continued pretraining might alter late-layer sparsity and the strength/linearity of the dialect direction.

recommendation.zh: 读神经元干预和方向注入的对照部分；方言任务窄，但 representation steering 信号有用。
recommendation.en: Read the neuron-vs-direction intervention results; the dialect task is narrow, but the steering signal is useful.

institutions: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
Qatar Computing Research Institute, Hamad Bin Khalifa University

paper.title: Individual Parameters in Weight-Sparse Transformers Appear Interpretable
paper.abstract: A central goal of mechanistic interpretability is to understand how neural networks work and what each individual component does. Dominant circuit-finding approaches focus on a specific behavior and reverse-engineer the role of components on the associated sub-distribution. However, past work has shown that components can have different functions that are active on different subsets of the input distribution. In this work we ask whether a single weight can be understood globally across the full

summary.core_problem: 研究单个权重是否能在完整训练分布上被稳定解释，而不是只在某个行为或子分布上解释模型组件。
summary.importance: 这是机制解释方向的分析工作，贡献在于把解释对象下探到 individual parameter，并比较稀疏权重 Transformer 与稠密 Transformer 的可解释性差异。对理解稀疏化是否降低 superposition、是否让参数承担更清晰功能有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文定义“某个权重何时重要”为：在这些输入上消融该权重会改变模型预测。作者构建自动化 LLM pipeline，为单个权重生成简短自然语言描述，再在 held-out 文本上验证描述是否泛化；只有描述能泛化的权重才被计为可解释。方法重点不是人工找 circuit，而是全分布、单权重级别的可验证解释生成。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个 weight-sparse Transformer 和两个 dense Transformer。比较指标是按该验证流程可被解释的权重比例。结果显示，稀疏 Transformer 中可解释权重比例高于稠密 Transformer；摘要还指出这个差距在不同模型之间保持存在，但具体模型规模、数据和差距幅度需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether individual weights can be interpreted globally over the full training distribution, rather than only within a hand-picked behavior or sub-distribution.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability study that pushes the unit of analysis down to single parameters and compares weight-sparse Transformers with dense Transformers. It is useful for thinking about whether sparsity reduces superposition and makes parameter functions more localized.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define when a weight matters as the set of inputs where ablating that weight changes model predictions. They build an automated LLM pipeline that writes a short natural-language description of those inputs and validates the description on held-out text. A weight is counted as interpretable only when the description generalizes.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two sparse and two dense Transformers. The main metric is the fraction of weights that pass the automated description-and-verification test. Sparse Transformers show a higher fraction of interpretable weights than dense Transformers, although the exact model sizes, datasets, and effect sizes require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义和 sparse-vs-dense 对照；若验证集构造干净，这会改变对稀疏化可解释性的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the definition and sparse-vs-dense comparison; if the held-out verification is clean, it shifts the prior on sparsity and interpretability.

paper.title: Pathways of Visual Information Flow in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: We study how visual information is routed in vision-language models (VLMs). Using causal patching on controlled synthetic and natural datasets, we find that models rely on two distinct pathways to solve visual tasks: A direct pathway, where visual information is retained in image token representations and read out by the final token at later layers, and a text-mediated pathway, where visual information is first transferred to the query tokens and then read out by the final token. Across three vi

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言模型中视觉信息如何从图像token传递到最终生成token的机制尚不明确，过往基于注意力干预的研究得出了相互矛盾的结论，且干预手段本身可能触发模型的备用通路，导致观测到的机制偏离模型实际使用的通路。
summary.importance: 系统揭示了VLM中存在两条独立的视觉信息流通路，统一了此前研究的分歧；发现通路选择的任务依赖性与灵活切换特性，为VLM的可解释性研究、架构设计优化以及测试时干预方法提供了机制层面的参考，也为多模态预训练的机制理解提供了新的视角。
summary.technical_approach: 采用因果修补（causal patching）方法结合反事实样本，从因果层面识别模型实际使用的信息通路，而非仅判断某通路是否可用。设计三类覆盖不同视觉理解层次的任务：物体识别、空间关系预测、物体定位。同时使用合成数据集（可控变量）和自然数据集（验证泛化性），结合注意力敲除、损坏输入修补等干预手段，研究通路的灵活性。实验覆盖Qwen3、InternVL3.5、LLaVA-1.5三个模型家族，验证结论的普适性。
summary.experiments: 1. 确认VLM通过两条不同通路传导视觉信息：直接通路（最终token直接从图像token读取视觉信息）、文本介导通路（视觉信息先转移到查询token的表示中，再被最终token读取）。2. 通路选择具有任务依赖性：空间关系推理任务依赖文本介导通路，物体识别任务主要使用直接通路。3. 数据分布与提示设计会调制通路选择：例如定位任务在合成数据上使用直接通路，在自然数据集上切换为文本介导通路。4. 通路具有灵活备份特性：当直接通路被注意力敲除或输入损坏阻断时，模型可切换到文本介导通路并维持任务性能，这种补偿效应强于纯文本大模型中的备用电路表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点为引言部分的研究背景与过往分歧、第2节的因果修补实验设计逻辑，以及核心发现部分的通路分类与任务依赖性结论。重点关注通路示意图与不同任务下的通路选择统计结果，可跳过详细的实验设置细节。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The mechanism by which visual information flows from image tokens to the final generation token in vision-language models (VLMs) remains poorly understood. Prior studies based on attention interventions have yielded conflicting conclusions, and interventions themselves may trigger fallback pathways in models, leading to observations that reflect alternative rather than normally used mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: This work systematically identifies two distinct visual information flow pathways in VLMs, reconciling discrepancies in previous research. The findings of task-dependent pathway selection and flexible switching provide mechanistic references for VLM interpretability research, architecture optimization, and test-time intervention design, and offer a new perspective for understanding multimodal pretraining mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses causal patching with counterfactual examples to causally identify information pathways the model actually uses, rather than merely assessing whether a pathway is available. Three tasks covering different levels of visual understanding are designed: object recognition, spatial relation prediction, and object localization. Both synthetic datasets (for controlled variables) and natural datasets (for generalization testing) are used, combined with interventions like attention knockouts and corrupted-input patching to study pathway flexibility. Experiments are conducted across three model families — Qwen3, InternVL3.5, and LLaVA-1.5 — to verify generalizability.
summary_en.experiments: 1. VLMs channel visual information through two distinct pathways: a direct pathway where the final token reads visual information directly from image tokens, and a text-mediated pathway where visual information is first transferred to query token representations and then read by the final token. 2. Pathway selection is task-dependent: spatial relation reasoning relies on the text-mediated pathway, while object recognition primarily uses the direct pathway. 3. Data distribution and prompt design modulate pathway choice: for example, localization tasks use the direct pathway on synthetic data but switch to text-mediation on natural datasets. 4. Pathways function as flexible backups: when the direct pathway is disrupted by attention knockouts or corrupted inputs, models can reroute through the text-mediated pathway and maintain task performance. This compensation effect is stronger than backup circuit behavior observed in text-only LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the research background and prior disagreements in the introduction, the causal patching experimental design in Section 2, and the core findings of pathway classification and task dependency. Prioritize the pathway schematic and pathway selection statistics across tasks; detailed experimental setup specifics can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 causal patching 结果即可；它提醒 VLM ablation 不是单路径诊断，prompt 改动会换掉内部计算图。
recommendation.en: Read the causal-patching sections; the useful lesson is that VLM ablations may probe a switched computation graph, not a fixed visual pathway.

paper.title: Latent Programming Horizons in Coding Agents
paper.abstract: A coding agent solving a software-engineering task spends dozens of steps reasoning, editing code, and running tests, yet little is known about what the underlying language model internally represents about the program it is working on. We show that the residual streams of language models under coding agents linearly encode properties of the evolving program: a logistic-regression probe on hidden states is able to decode whether the current code parses, passes its test suite, reduces the number

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 coding agent 在多步修改真实代码库时，模型残差流中是否线性编码了“当前程序状态”和“未来编辑结果”。问题不是单次代码生成的正确性探测，而是 agent 在几十步 read-edit-test 循环中，内部表征是否持续跟踪一个不断变化、且只被部分观察到的程序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于机制分析。它把“模型是否有世界状态表征”这个问题推进到真实软件工程 agent 场景：代码是否能 parse、测试是否通过、失败测试数是否减少、是否引入 regression，这些都不是简单 token 特征。结果说明，代码模型在 agent 轨迹中形成了可探测的程序语义表征，并且中间层信号更强。对训练数据和训练目标的启发是：若模型已经在隐空间中编码未来编辑的成败，后续可以考虑用 probe、verifier 或过程奖励去读出这类信号，而不只依赖最终测试反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。作者收集 mini-swe-agent 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 和 SWE-Bench-Pro 上的多步轨迹，在每个 agent step 抽取底层开源模型的 residual stream hidden states，然后训练 logistic regression 线性 probe。被预测的标签包括当前程序是否可解析、是否通过测试、是否减少 failing tests、是否引入 regressions。关键设计是把 k=0 的当前状态预测和 k>0 的未来状态预测分开：未来预测只用第 t 步 hidden state，预测 t+k 步之后编辑结果，从而定义 latent programming horizon。对照组使用 shuffled labels，用来排除标签分布或轨迹长度带来的伪信号。与已有单步代码正确性 probing 不同，这里处理的是真实代码库、部分上下文、多轮工具反馈和持续变化的程序状态。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个开源权重模型、mini-swe-agent、SWE-Bench-Verified 与 SWE-Bench-Pro。轨迹长度为真实 agent 交互尺度，中位数约 52 步。线性 probe 对多个程序属性显著高于 shuffled-label control，正确性相关属性 AUC 最高约 0.83。信号在轨迹中持续存在，并且中间层最强，符合很多 transformer 表征分析中的经验：浅层偏局部 token，深层更贴近输出策略，中间层更容易读出结构化状态。更有意思的是未来编辑预测：probe 可以在当前 hidden state 中预测最多约 25 步后的程序属性，说明 agent 的内部状态不只是记录当前代码，也包含将要执行的编辑方向或潜在计划。作者还报告 probe 具有校准性，并且能跨 benchmark transfer，不需要在目标 benchmark 上重新训练。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看实验协议、probe 标签构造、layer-wise 结果和 k-step horizon 曲线。最需要检查的是三点：第一，hidden state 取自哪个 token 和哪个 agent step，是否可能泄漏测试输出或编辑文本；第二，future prediction 的标签是否受轨迹自相关影响，shuffled control 是否足够强；第三，跨 benchmark transfer 的设置是否严格。若关注 coding agent 的过程奖励或 verifier 训练，可以多看 latent programming horizon 的定义和未来编辑预测实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks whether a coding agent’s residual stream linearly encodes the semantic state of the program it is editing, and whether that representation contains information about edits that have not yet happened. This is a multi-step agent setting over real repositories, not a single-shot code generation probe.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic. It extends state-representation probing from games and synthetic programs to realistic software-engineering agents. The decoded properties are not superficial token attributes: parse validity, test success, reduction in failing tests, and regressions are semantic properties of an evolving codebase. For pretraining and post-training research, the result suggests that coding models may already carry latent signals useful for process supervision, verifier design, and reward shaping before an external test result is observed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors collect mini-swe-agent trajectories on SWE-Bench-Verified and SWE-Bench-Pro with two open-weight models. At each agentic step, they extract residual-stream activations and fit logistic-regression probes. The probes predict current program properties at k=0 and future properties at k>0, where the hidden state at step t is used to predict the outcome at step t+k. This defines a latent programming horizon. Shuffled-label controls are used to check that the signal is not explained by label priors or trajectory artifacts. The protocol differs from earlier code probing work because the program changes over time, the repository is only partially observed, and the model receives tool feedback across dozens of steps.
summary_en.experiments: The trajectories have a realistic agentic scale, with a median length around 52 steps. Linear probes recover several program properties well above shuffled-label controls, with correctness-related AUC reaching about 0.83 across the two models and two benchmarks. The signal persists through the trajectory and is strongest in intermediate layers. Future-outcome probes remain predictive up to roughly 25 steps ahead, indicating that the residual stream contains information about the agent’s likely future edits. The authors also report calibration and transfer across benchmarks without retraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the probing protocol, label construction, layer-wise curves, and the k-step horizon results. The key checks are whether activations can leak test outputs or edit text, whether the future-prediction setup controls for trajectory autocorrelation, and how strict the cross-benchmark transfer setting is. The most relevant part for training research is the horizon experiment, because it points to latent signals that could be used for process rewards or learned verifiers.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当“提升 agent”的方法论文；当作表征诊断工具更合适，只看 probe 设定与“提前 25 步”是否在严格时间泄漏控制下仍成立。
recommendation.en: Don’t read it as an agent-improvement paper; treat it as a representation diagnostic—focus on the probe protocol and whether the “25-step lookahead” survives strict leakage controls.

paper.title: Knowledge Knows, Verbalization Tells: Disentangling Latent Directions for Mathematical Solvability in LLMs
paper.abstract: Although LLMs have made significant progress in mathematical reasoning, determining whether a mathematical problem is solvable remains a fundamental yet challenging capability. While recent studies have probed internal representations of model solvability beliefs, verbalization has primarily been studied behaviorally rather than as an internal representation, limiting its analysis and manipulation. We address this gap by separately probing representations of solvability knowledge and verbalizati

summary.core_problem: 解耦LLM数学推理中问题可解性的知识编码、与最终答案输出的言语表达编码，澄清幻觉来源的归因
summary.importance: 机制分析类工作，首次在隐空间将可解性知识与言语表达两类表征分离，为幻觉成因解释和激活干预提供新观测角度
summary.technical_approach: 使用线性探针分别在LLM隐藏状态中解码可解性知识表征、言语表达表征；通过不可解性提示、激活导向两类干预验证两类表征的因果效应
summary.experiments: 在多个LLM上验证两类表征为线性可分的独立方向；虚构回答与言语表达表征偏移强相关，与底层知识表征关联较弱；激活导向可直接操纵两类表征改变虚构行为

summary_en.core_problem: Disentangle LLM internal representations of mathematical solvability knowledge and answer verbalization to clarify the root cause of reasoning hallucinations
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis work that first separates solvability knowledge and verbalization directions in LLM hidden states, providing new observations for hallucination mechanism research and activation intervention
summary_en.technical_approach: Train linear probes to decode solvability knowledge and verbalization representations from LLM hidden states respectively; verify causal effects via unsolvability cue prompting and activation steering
