summary_en.experiments: Across multiple LLMs, the two representations are linearly separable independent directions; fabricated answers strongly correlate with verbalization shifts rather than knowledge gaps; activation steering directly manipulates the two directions to alter fabrication behavior

recommendation.zh: 常规线性探针工作，解耦数学推理中知识与言语表达表征，对幻觉机制有弱参考，只看摘要结论即可
recommendation.en: Routine linear probing work disentangling knowledge and verbalization in math reasoning, weak reference for hallucination mechanisms, read abstract only

institutions: Institute for Language and Speech Processing, Athena Research Center

paper.title: Towards Robustness against Typographic Attack with Training-free Concept Localization
paper.abstract: Models trained via Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) serve as the foundational vision encoders for most modern Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). Despite their widespread adoption, CLIP models exhibit a critical yet underexplored failure mode: irrelevant text appearing within images confounds visual representations, biasing them toward lexical meaning rather than true visual semantics. This robustness issue, commonly described as a Typographic Attack (TA), exposes a vulnerability

summary.core_problem: CLIP/ViT 视觉编码器在“图中叠字”(typographic attack) 场景下会被无关文字强烈牵引，导致表征从视觉语义偏向“词形/词义”线索；论文要解决的问题是：在不训练、不改权重的前提下，能否定位出导致这种词汇聚焦(lexical focus)的具体注意力电路/模块，并用可解释的方式在测试时干预，从而提升 TA 鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大（更偏 CLIP 机制分析与测试时防御），但对“预训练表征里概念纠缠如何在注意力头中出现、如何用电路级定位做可解释干预”有参考价值。对做 VLM/CLIP 预训练的人，启发点在于：TA 不是简单的对抗样本问题，而是视觉 token 对“文字形状→语言概念”的捷径耦合；论文提供了一套训练外的诊断与快速修补流程，可作为预训练阶段数据/目标改造前的定位工具。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个训练外的“概念采样 + 归因排序 + 电路干预”流程。
1) 概念采样(Concept Mining)：基于 Linear Representation Hypothesis，把残差流表示看作多个概念方向的线性叠加。作者不训练 SAE/字典，而是随机采样“伪概念向量”(pseudo-concept vectors) 去做命中测试；关键技巧是利用 MHSA 的天然分解：每个 head 把 d_model 投到更低维 d_head 子空间，在这些投影空间里采样/搜索概念方向，命中概率更高、纠缠更少。
2) 词汇聚焦概念与模块定位：提出一个梯度归因分数，把“注意力头是否把注意力集中到文字 patch”(focus) 与“概念方向是否与词汇语义相关”(direction) 结合，得到归一化 attribution score，用于无标签地排序出最 TA 脆弱的概念样本与其宿主模块/注意力头。
3) 测试时干预：对识别出的有害电路做 attention reweighting 或 head/通路消融(ablation)，在不训练的情况下抑制文字相关通路对全局表征的支配，从而恢复对真实视觉语义的依赖。
与已有工作差异：相较残差流宏观分解或 SDL/SAE 字典学习，这里更强调“在注意力头投影空间做概念采样”和“把路由(QK)与特征(OV)视角结合的归因”，并把解释直接闭环到可执行的测试时电路干预。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的信息点主要是：
- 任务：CLIP 的对象分类在 TA 数据集上易被叠字误导；以及下游 LVLM 的 VQA 在 TA 场景下也会受影响。
- 结果形态：通过定位并干预“词汇聚焦”电路，CLIP 分类准确率与 LVLM 的 VQA 准确率在 typographic attack 数据集上显著提升；作者声称优于既有 SOTA 防御且成本很低（测试时简单重加权/消融）。
- 机制侧消融：强调在 MHSA 低维 head 子空间采样能提高 concept hit 概率，并通过降维减少搜索空间与概念纠缠。
由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格/数值（参数规模、数据集名称、提升百分点等），这里无法可靠复述精确数字；建议以论文实验章节的主表与消融表为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看方法总览图（文中 Fig.1 的 a/b/c 流程）：概念采样→归因排序→电路干预，理解闭环。
- 重点读 Method 里对 MHSA 分解（QK 路由与 OV 特征）以及为何在 d_head 子空间采样更有效的论证；这是与常见 SAE/SDL 路线的关键区别。
- 实验部分优先看：1) TA 场景下的分类/VQA 主结果表；2) 归因分数的稳定性与 head 定位一致性；3) 干预方式（reweight vs ablate）的代价与副作用（干净样本性能是否下降）。
- 如果你关心预训练改进：把作者定位出的“文字 patch→语义概念”捷径当作诊断信号，思考是否能在预训练数据增强（带字图像比例/合成 TA）、目标函数（去文字捷径的对比学习变体）或 tokenizer/patching（文字区域处理）上做更根治的改动。

summary_en.core_problem: CLIP-style ViT vision encoders can be hijacked by irrelevant overlaid text (typographic attacks), shifting representations from visual semantics to lexical cues. The paper asks whether we can (i) localize the specific attention circuits responsible for this “lexical focus” without any training, and (ii) apply lightweight test-time interventions to improve robustness while keeping model weights frozen.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper; it is closer to mechanistic interpretability plus a deployment-time defense for CLIP/VLM backbones. The value for foundation-model pretraining researchers is diagnostic: it frames TA as a shortcut coupling between visual tokens and language semantics, and provides a practical circuit-level localization workflow that can guide upstream fixes (data mixture, augmentation with text-in-image, objective tweaks) before committing to expensive retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a training-free loop: stochastic concept mining → attribution-based ranking → circuit intervention.
1) Stochastic concept mining: under the linear representation hypothesis, hidden states are treated as linear mixtures of concept directions. Instead of learning a dictionary/SAE, the authors sample pseudo-concept vectors. A key design choice is to sample/search in the per-head low-dimensional subspaces induced by MHSA projections (d_head), which empirically increases “concept hit” probability and reduces entanglement.
2) Vulnerability explanation via attribution: they propose a gradient-based attribution score that combines (a) whether an attention head focuses on text patches (focus) and (b) whether the sampled concept direction aligns with lexical semantics (direction). This yields a normalized score to identify TA-vulnerable concepts and the hosting heads/modules.
3) Mechanistic intervention: once harmful circuits are identified, they apply attention reweighting or ablation of selected heads/paths at test time to suppress lexical-dominated routes and recover visual-semantic behavior.
Compared to residual-stream-only analyses or SDL/SAE-based disentanglement, the emphasis here is head-subspace concept sampling plus an attribution metric that directly maps to actionable attention-level interventions.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improved robustness on typographic-attack benchmarks for (i) CLIP object classification and (ii) downstream LVLM VQA, using only test-time reweighting/ablation (no finetuning). It also includes analyses suggesting that concept sampling in MHSA head subspaces improves concept-hit rates and reduces search complexity.
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the key numeric tables (model variants, dataset names, exact accuracy deltas), so exact figures cannot be stated reliably here; consult the main results and ablation tables in the experiments section for precise gains and any clean-accuracy trade-offs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the pipeline figure (their Fig.1) to understand the end-to-end loop from localization to intervention.
- Read the Method section focusing on the MHSA decomposition (QK routing vs OV feature circuits) and why sampling in d_head subspaces is central.
- In Experiments, prioritize: (1) main TA robustness tables for CLIP classification and LVLM VQA, (2) stability/consistency of head localization, and (3) intervention ablations (reweight vs ablate) including any degradation on clean inputs.
- If your goal is pretraining improvements, treat the localized “text-patch → lexical concept” circuits as a measurable failure mode and consider how to prevent them via data curation/augmentation or objective modifications rather than relying on post-hoc interventions.

recommendation.zh: 看 head attribution 和 circuit mining 部分；若结论稳，会影响 CLIP encoder 在 LVLM 预训练中的筛选标准。
recommendation.en: Read the head-attribution and circuit-mining parts; if stable, they affect how CLIP encoders should be screened for LVLM pretraining.

paper.title: Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on component-level interventions to discover how a model produces a behavior. This guides attribution, capability knockout, and model pruning downstream to operate by scoring each unit by the effect of ablation in isolation. Such first-order scoring is natural when component importance is additive, but becomes misleading when a transformer self-repairs: after a primary component is removed, a dormant backup can take over, muting the primary's measured ef

summary.core_problem: 在 Transformer 机制可解释性研究中，一阶消融打分（单独消融一个组件并度量输出变化）假设组件重要性是可加的，但模型存在 self-repair 现象：主路径被移除后，休眠的备份组件会接管功能，导致主组件的重要性被低估，备份组件在完整模型上又看似无关。这种非可加性使归因、能力敲除、结构化剪枝等下游任务都偏向冗余组件。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于：它指出了当前基于单组件消融的归因、剪枝、电路发现方法的一个系统性盲区——冗余备份路径。对于理解大模型能力的鲁棒性来源、设计更可靠的剪枝/蒸馏策略、以及通过 circuit-level 分析指导预训练架构设计都有参考意义。CoAx 作为一种无监督、输出驱动的二阶打分方法，补充了一阶发现方法的不足。
summary.technical_approach: 提出条件协同消融（CoAx），将 self-repair 重新表述为「条件电路补全」任务：给定一个候选主电路集合 S，度量每个剩余组件的消融效果在 S 被移除后的增长量。休眠备份组件单独消融时效果小，但条件消融时效果大；无关组件则两者都小。CoAx 基于 Fisher 加权的消融能量增长来打分，使用单次消融基线和一次条件前向传播即可计算，无需标签。本质上是读取了一阶可加打分丢弃的二阶交互项。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-2-small 的 IOI 任务上，CoAx 将备份注意力头识别的 ROC-AUC 从 0.33 提升到 0.91，优于包括 self-repair-aware 的 AtP* GradDrop（最佳 0.82）。反事实 patching 确认恢复的备份头确实承担了修复功能。同一无监督流程可迁移到 8 个不同模型的 induction 任务。恢复备份后，被 self-repair 掩盖的归因信号从 0.22 logit-difference 恢复到 1.76；能力敲除准确率达到 0.70，接近文档记录的 oracle 0.72；结构化剪枝效果从 124M 扩展到 7B 参数模型。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 2（CoAx 形式化定义和 Fisher 度量的推导），理解为什么条件视角能暴露非可加重要性。Section 3 的 IOI 备份头验证实验和 induction 跨模型迁移实验展示了方法的有效性。Section 4 的下游应用（归因修正、敲除、剪枝）展示了实际价值。值得深挖的点：CoAx 的计算成本随主集合 S 的选择如何变化；Fisher 度量相比直接 logit 差别的优势；以及这种条件视角能否扩展到更细粒度的 feature-level 分析（而非 head-level）。

summary_en.core_problem: In mechanistic interpretability of Transformers, first-order ablation scoring (ablating a single component and measuring output change) assumes additive component importance. But models exhibit self-repair: when a primary path is removed, dormant backup components take over, causing the primary's importance to be under-measured while backups appear irrelevant on the intact model. This non-additivity biases downstream tasks like attribution, capability knockout, and structured pruning against redundant components.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work exposes a systematic blind spot in current component-ablation-based attribution, pruning, and circuit discovery methods—redundant backup paths. It informs our understanding of where model robustness comes from, suggests more reliable pruning/distillation strategies, and provides a circuit-level lens that could guide pretraining architecture design. CoAx, as an unsupervised, output-grounded second-order scoring method, complements first-order discovery approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conditional Co-Ablation (CoAx) reframes self-repair as a 'conditional circuit completion' task: given a candidate primary set S, measure how much each remaining unit's ablation effect grows once S is removed. A dormant backup has small standalone effect but large conditional effect; an irrelevant unit has neither. CoAx scores via Fisher-weighted ablation energy growth, computed from a single-ablation baseline and one conditional forward pass. It is label-free and essentially reads the second-order interaction that additive node scores discard.
summary_en.experiments: On GPT-2-small IOI, CoAx raises backup-head identification ROC-AUC from 0.33 to 0.91, outperforming baselines including self-repair-aware AtP* GradDrop (best 0.82). Counterfactual patching confirms recovered heads causally carry the repair. The same label-free procedure transfers to induction across 8 models. After recovery, self-repair-masked attribution signal grows from 0.22 to 1.76 logit-difference; capability knockout reaches 0.70 accuracy, near the documented oracle of 0.72; structured head pruning improves and scales from 124M to 7B parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the formalization of CoAx and the Fisher metric derivation—this is where the conditional perspective that exposes non-additive importance is laid out. Section 3's IOI backup head validation and cross-model induction transfer demonstrate effectiveness. Section 4's downstream applications (attribution correction, knockout, pruning) show practical value. Worth digging into: how CoAx's cost scales with the choice of primary set S; the advantage of Fisher metric over direct logit-difference; and whether this conditional lens extends to feature-level rather than head-level analysis.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 IOI 实验即可；它提醒剪枝/归因别只信单点消融，backup circuit 会系统性藏起来。
recommendation.en: Read the method and IOI experiment; it is a useful warning that pruning and attribution should not trust isolated ablations when backup circuits exist.

paper.title: Expander Sparse Autoencoders: Parameter-Efficient Dictionaries for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose internal activations of neural networks into sparse linear combinations of learned features by fitting an overcomplete dictionary $\mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ with $m<n$, and inferring a sparse code $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ from $\mathbf{h}\approx\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}$. This inference problem closely resembles the canonical setup of compressed sensing, but dense decoders requires $O(mn)$ learned values, which becomes costly at large feature counts.

summary.core_problem: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）用于大模型机制可解释性时，稠密解码器的参数量随特征维度与激活维度的乘积增长，存储与推理成本过高，且现有SAE变体均未针对解码器的存储约束做结构化优化。
summary.importance: 为SAE的存储-保真度权衡提供了新的结构化稀疏方案，降低了3B以上规模大模型可解释性分析的资源门槛；将组合压缩感知的扩展图理论引入SAE设计，为稀疏特征的可识别性提供了理论支撑，也为后续把结构化稀疏方法应用于预训练模型内部表示拆解提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是提出Expander SAE，用左d正则二部扩展图的邻接矩阵作为固定掩码，约束绑定权重的TopK SAE的编码器和解码器的权重非零位置——每个解码器列只有d个非零值（d远小于激活维度m），把可学习参数量从O(mn)降到O(dn)。核心贡献包括三点：1）架构上实现字典质量与摊销推理质量的解耦；2）提出适配列稀疏结构的并行正交匹配追踪（OMP）实现，在摊销推理速度和迭代解码保真度之间形成帕累托最优前沿；3）从理论上证明：当掩码满足2k特征子集扩展条件、且学习到的解码器列在其支撑集上足够平坦时，任意无噪k稀疏编码具有唯一的k稀疏解释；在更强的累积相干条件下，OMP可精确恢复稀疏支撑集。与现有SAE变体（Gated、JumpReLU、TopK等）仅修改编码器稀疏机制、保持解码器稠密的设计不同，Expander SAE是首个将固定解码器列稀疏作为存储/可解释性约束的SAE架构。
summary.experiments: 在四个开源模型（Pythia-70M/160M、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-1B）上验证，调整稀疏度参数d可得到平滑的参数量-重建保真度权衡曲线；在Qwen2.5-3B上，d=7的Expander SAE仅用1/293的解码器可学习参数量，就能恢复稠密SAE 84%的交叉熵损失表现。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间15-20分钟。重点关注第3节的扩展图掩码构造与架构设计、第4节的存储-保真度前沿实验图表（尤其是Qwen2.5-3B的参数量对比结果）；并行OMP的速度对比可快速扫过，若关心理论支撑可深挖附录中的可识别性证明部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense decoders in existing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) incur O(mn) parameter cost that scales prohibitively with feature count, creating excessive storage and inference overhead when applying SAEs to mechanistic interpretability of large language models, with no prior SAE variant addressing decoder-side storage constraints via structured optimization.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a structured sparsity approach that expands the SAE storage-fidelity tradeoff frontier, lowering the resource barrier for interpretability analysis of 3B+ parameter models. It also bridges combinatorial compressed sensing theory to SAE design, providing formal identifiability guarantees for sparse features and informing future work on structured decomposition of pretrained model internal representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Expander SAEs, tied-weight TopK SAEs where both encoder and decoder weights are constrained by a fixed adjacency mask of a left d-regular bipartite expander graph (d ≪ activation dimension m). This reduces learnable decoder parameters from O(mn) to O(dn) while preserving the full sparse coding problem dimensions (m, n, k). Core contributions include: 1) an architecture that decouples dictionary quality from amortized inference quality; 2) a parallel orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) implementation optimized for the column-sparse structure, delivering a Pareto frontier between fast amortized encoding and high-fidelity iterative decoding; 3) theoretical proofs that k-sparse codes are uniquely identifiable under 2k-expansion and decoder column flatness conditions, with exact support recovery guarantees for OMP under a cumulative coherence condition. Unlike prior SAE variants (Gated, JumpReLU, TopK) that only modify encoder sparsity mechanisms with dense decoders, this is the first SAE to use fixed decoder column sparsity as a storage/interpretability constraint.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on four open-source models (Pythia-70M/160M, Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-1B). Varying sparsity parameter d produces a smooth storage-fidelity tradeoff curve. On Qwen2.5-3B, Expander SAE with d=7 recovers 84% of the dense SAE's cross-entropy loss performance while using 293× fewer learnable decoder parameters.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time 15-20 minutes. Focus on Section 3 for expander mask construction and architecture design, and Section 4's storage-fidelity frontier plots (especially the Qwen2.5-3B parameter comparison). Skim parallel OMP speed benchmarks; refer to appendix identifiability proofs only if theoretical guarantees are relevant to your work.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和实验表即可；若你在跑大 SAE，这个结构稀疏化比又堆更大 dense dictionary 更值得试。
recommendation.en: Read the method and experiment tables; if you train large SAEs, this structured sparsity is more worth testing than simply scaling dense dictionaries.

paper.title: Logit-Contribution Scoring Identifies Non-Literal Retrieval Heads
paper.abstract: In long-context use, large language models frequently synthesize answers from the meaning of a relevant context span rather than literally copy-pasting them. Identifying which attention heads perform this synthesis matters for interpreting long-context model behavior. Yet existing detectors miss these heads by construction: they reward heads whose attended token matches the generated token, a literal-copy criterion that captures where a head reads but not what it writes through its output-value

summary.core_problem: 如何识别“非字面检索（non-literal retrieval）”的注意力头：在长上下文任务里，模型往往不是把 needle 里的答案 token 直接复制出来，而是读懂相关片段后写出语义上对应但词面不同的答案。现有 retrieval-head 识别方法多基于 attention 是否指向 needle、以及 attended token 是否等于生成 token，因此系统性漏掉这类“读 needle、写别的东西”的头。
summary.importance:
这篇更偏机制分析，但对预训练与长上下文能力的研究有两点实用影响：
1) 给出了一个更贴近“模型真正写入 residual 的信息流”的检索头度量（write-aware），能把长上下文能力拆到更可控的子电路层面；
2) 通过大幅度的 targeted head ablation 展示了：长上下文检索在一些模型家族里确实依赖稀疏头集合，且这种依赖能迁移到下游长文 QA 基准。这类结果常被用来反推训练配方（例如长上下文数据/位置编码/注意力结构）对电路形成的影响。
summary.technical_approach:
LOCOS（Logit-Contribution Scoring）的关键是把“检索头识别”从读位置（attention pattern）转到写贡献（OV circuit 对正确答案 logit 的贡献）。
- 观察：注意力头是 read（QK 决定 α）+ write（OV 决定写入 residual 的方向）。在 non-literal retrieval 中，read 到的 token 与最终生成 token 不一致，attention-based 指标天然失效。
- 评分定义：在单步解码时，对每个 head、每个 source position j，计算该 head 从 j 写出的输出向量 o_{t,j}^{(l,h)} 经过加权后的贡献，并取其在“正确答案 token 的 unembedding 向量 u_{y_t}”方向上的标量投影（可理解为对正确 logit 的边际贡献）。
- 聚合方式：用 spatial contrast，把 needle 区间的 logit contribution 与 off-needle 的 length-normalized contribution 做对比，避免“长上下文里 off-needle 总量更大”带来的偏置。
- 计算成本：每个 probing trial 只需一次 forward pass（不需要逐头 ablate 才能打分），因此可以在多模型、多配置上跑。
- 验证方式：用 ranked ablation 曲线验证“识别到的头是否因果重要”：按 LOCOS 排名从高到低 mean-ablate 头，观察 NoLiMa 等检索任务性能退化速度，并用对照任务（parametric recall、算术）验证特异性。
summary.experiments:
从全文片段可提取的关键数字与设置：
- 模型覆盖：Qwen3（8B/14B/32B）、Gemma-3（12B/27B）、OLMo-3.1（32B），共 6 个配置。
- 主评测：NoLiMa non-literal retrieval benchmark（heldout）。指标用 ROUGE-L，并用“ablate top-k heads”的退化曲线比较不同检索头识别方法。
- 代表性结果（Qwen3-8B）：ablate LOCOS top-50 heads，ROUGE-L 从 0.401 降到 0.000；而最强 attention-based baseline 在同样 ablation 深度下仍有 0.292。
- 特异性对照：在相同 ablation 下，parametric recall 与 arithmetic reasoning 基本保持（说明 LOCOS 排名抓到的是检索相关头，而不是通用能力头）。
- 下游迁移（长上下文 QA）：在 Qwen3-8B 上，ablate top-50 LOCOS heads，MuSiQue accuracy 0.55→0.08，BABILong 0.62→0.20。作者也指出迁移一致性在 Qwen3 家族最强，而在 Gemma-3/OLMo-3.1 上与 attention-based baseline 的相对排名更依赖具体 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先把 LOCOS 的数学定义读清楚：尤其是“对 u_{y_t} 的投影”与“needle vs off-needle 的 spatial contrast/归一化”。这决定它为什么能抓到 non-literal retrieval。
2) 重点看 ablation 曲线图与对照实验：它们是这篇文章的因果证据核心，比单点指标更有说服力。
3) 看跨模型家族的差异讨论：为什么 Qwen3 上迁移更一致、Gemma/OLMo 更不稳定；这部分往往暗示不同预训练/架构下检索电路的稀疏性与可替代性。
4) 如果关心训练启示：把“稀疏检索头集合”与长上下文训练数据、位置编码、注意力正则等因素联系起来思考，但论文本身主要做识别与验证，不直接给训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: Identifying attention heads responsible for non-literal retrieval in long-context settings, where the model attends to a relevant span (the needle) but generates an answer that is not a literal copy of any needle token. Existing retrieval-head detectors are largely attention-based and implicitly assume token matching, so they systematically miss heads whose OV circuits write answer-aligned information that is not the attended token itself.
summary_en.importance:
Primarily a mechanistic interpretability contribution, with practical implications for long-context pretraining and debugging:
- It provides a write-aware criterion that better isolates the causal subcircuits behind long-context retrieval.
- The strong targeted-ablation results support the view that long-context retrieval can depend on a relatively sparse set of heads (at least in some model families), which is useful when reasoning about how training choices shape retrieval behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LOCOS (Logit-Contribution Scoring) shifts retrieval-head detection from “where a head reads” (attention patterns) to “what a head writes” (OV-circuit contribution to the correct logit).
- For a given decoding step, for each head and each source position, compute the head’s weighted OV output and take its scalar projection onto the unembedding vector of the correct answer token. This directly measures marginal logit contribution.
- Use spatial contrast: compare contributions from needle positions against length-normalized off-needle contributions within the same step to avoid bias from the much larger off-needle region.
- Efficiency: requires only a single forward pass per probing trial.
- Validation: rank heads by LOCOS and perform mean-ablation of top-k heads; evaluate degradation on non-literal retrieval benchmarks and run control tasks (parametric recall, arithmetic) to test specificity.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text excerpt:
- Models: Qwen3 (8B/14B/32B), Gemma-3 (12B/27B), OLMo-3.1 (32B), totaling six configurations.
- Benchmark: NoLiMa (non-literal retrieval), evaluated with ROUGE-L under ranked head ablations.
- Qwen3-8B highlight: ablating the top-50 LOCOS heads collapses ROUGE-L from 0.401 to 0.000, while the strongest attention-based baseline still achieves 0.292 at the same ablation depth.
- Specificity controls: parametric recall and arithmetic reasoning remain largely intact under the same ablations.
- Downstream transfer: on Qwen3-8B, ablating top-50 LOCOS heads drops MuSiQue accuracy from 0.55 to 0.08 and BABILong from 0.62 to 0.20. Transfer is reported as most consistent within the Qwen3 family, and more benchmark-dependent for Gemma-3 and OLMo-3.1.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the LOCOS definition carefully, especially the projection onto the correct-token unembedding direction and the needle vs off-needle normalization.
2) Spend time on the ablation curves; they are the main causal evidence that the ranking is meaningful.
3) Check the cross-family analysis (Qwen3 vs Gemma-3 vs OLMo-3.1) to understand when retrieval is head-sparse vs more distributed.
4) If your goal is training insights, treat the paper as a diagnostic tool: it does not propose a new pretraining recipe, but it gives a way to measure whether a recipe produces robust non-literal retrieval circuits.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看 §方法和 ablation：它提醒你很多“retrieval head”分析其实只测到 copy，不是写入 logits 的因果头；对长上下文机制判断要改口径。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablation sections: it shows that many so-called retrieval-head analyses are really detecting copy behavior, not the heads causally writing answer evidence into logits.

paper.title: Persona Without Substrate: Regime-Dependence and the LLM Individuation Problem
paper.abstract: Beckmann & Butlin's (2026) ontological framework for the LLM individuation problem inherits an unargued cross-regime co-reference assumption from the persona-vectors literature: that the same direction picks out the same content under prompt-conditioning, gradient-descent fine-tuning, and inference-time steering. We present four empirical wedges from persona-topology experiments on Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 - non-collinearity of prompt-extracted vectors and fine-tune basins;

summary.core_problem: 研究 persona 向量在不同使用机制下是否指向同一类表征内容，尤其是 prompt-conditioning、梯度微调和推理时 steering 之间能否共指。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和概念澄清。它质疑 persona-vectors 文献中常用但少被验证的假设：同一个方向在不同干预 regime 下代表同一个 persona 或语义内容。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 上做 persona-topology 实验，比较 prompt 提取向量、微调 basin、推理时向量算术和微调时混合训练之间的几何关系与组合行为。核心主张是把表征内容索引到“载体 + regime”这一对，而不是只看向量本身。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个开源指令模型，报告四类现象：prompt-extracted vectors 与 fine-tune basins 非共线；虚构 persona 比真实 anchor 更强地沿真实方向移动模型；矛盾情感混合会偏向训练历史决定的 attractor；推理时向量算术与微调时 chimera training 的组合代数不对称。摘要未给出样本规模和定量表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a persona direction denotes the same representational content across prompt conditioning, gradient-based fine-tuning, and inference-time steering.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mechanistic and conceptual: it challenges an often implicit assumption in persona-vector work that one direction can be treated as the same object across intervention regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author runs persona-topology experiments on Qwen3-4B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, comparing prompt-derived vectors, fine-tuning basins, inference-time arithmetic, and fine-tune-time chimera training. The proposed framing indexes content by a vehicle-regime pair rather than by a vector alone.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports four empirical wedges: non-collinearity between prompt-extracted vectors and fine-tune basins; fictional personas moving models more strongly along real-anchor directions than the real anchors; contradictory-valence mixtures collapsing toward training-history attractors; and asymmetric composition under inference-time arithmetic versus fine-tuning. No detailed sample counts or tables are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不改训练 recipe，但会提醒你别把 steering 向量、prompt 表征和微调方向混成同一种对象。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but it is a useful warning against treating steering vectors, prompt states, and fine-tuning directions as the same object.

paper.title: Readable but Not Controllable: Neuron-Level Evidence for Medical LLM Hallucination
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains one of the central obstacles to deploying medical LLMs. Yet, even when hallucination can be detected, it is still unclear whether the internal representations associated with it can be used for control rather than detection alone. Using four open-source models across a suite of medical question-answering datasets, we show that a simple, carefully conditioned probe can reliably detect hallucination, with AUROC scores between 0.77 and 0.86 in our case. We further show that th

summary.core_problem: 研究医疗问答场景中，LLM 内部可解码的 hallucination 信号是否也能用于因果控制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把“probe 能读出错误状态”和“干预这些表征能减少 hallucination”分开验证，对 interpretability-to-control 的常见跳跃有约束意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在四个开源模型和多个医学 QA 数据集上训练简单且经过条件控制的 probe，用于检测 hallucination；随后比较系统选择的 neuron 子集、随机 neuron 子集和低维随机投影的检测能力，并进一步测试这些表征是否能通过干预产生稳定控制效果。
summary.experiments: 四个开源模型上的 probe AUROC 为 0.77 到 0.86。结果显示 hallucination 信号分布式且冗余：系统选择的 neuron 只在很小子集时优于随机选择，几百个随机 neuron 已接近完整信号，低维随机投影也保留多数检测性能。跨 16 个 model-dataset 组合测试控制性，发现可读出性与可控性之间存在明显落差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether internal signals that decode medical hallucination can also be used to causally control hallucination behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mechanistic. It separates decodability from controllability, placing a useful constraint on the common move from probing results to intervention claims.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across four open-source models and medical QA datasets, the authors train a simple carefully conditioned probe for hallucination detection. They then compare selected neuron subsets, random neuron subsets, and low-dimensional random projections, followed by intervention tests to check whether the representation is causally actionable.
summary_en.experiments: The reported probe AUROC ranges from 0.77 to 0.86. The hallucination signal appears distributed and redundant: selected neurons only beat random neurons at very small subset sizes; a few hundred random neurons recover nearly the full signal; random projections preserve much of the performance. Across 16 model-dataset combinations, the paper reports a sharp gap between decodability and control.

recommendation.zh: 只看 decodability-vs-control 实验；医疗外推要保守，但这个负结果能校准 probe 论文的可信度。
recommendation.en: Read only the decodability-versus-control tests; the medical setting limits generalization, but the negative result calibrates probe papers.

paper.title: Representation as a Bottleneck for Mechanistic Interpretability: The Manifestation Unit Protocol
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has produced a rich inventory of component-level analyses that characterise what neural-network components encode and how they interact. Their outputs, however, are not easily reusable: selectivity tables, circuit diagrams, and feature lists remain locked in per-study notebooks - non-composable, not queryable in natural language, and not directly actionable for downstream audit or intervention. We study the representation layer that sits between these analyses and do

summary.core_problem: 解决机制可解释性研究产出（特征列表、电路图、选择性表）不可复用、不可组合、不可自然语言查询的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出统一的可解释性分析表示协议，使跨研究、跨架构的机制分析结果可结构化存储与检索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Manifestation Unit 协议，用带类型的元组 (E,S,R,D,G,T) 组织每个组件的统计信息，其中 T 为 Transformer 注意力头原语；通过混合检索实现结构化查询，支持自动从分析结果中填充字段。
summary.experiments: 在生成式视觉（beta-VAE）、判别式视觉（CNN）、语言模型（GPT-2）三类架构上实例化协议，验证结构化表示能显著提升分析结果的可组合性与查询效率。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the lack of reusability, composability, and natural-language queryability of mechanistic interpretability outputs such as feature lists, circuit diagrams, and selectivity tables across studies.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: introduces the first unified typed representation protocol for mechanistic interpretability artifacts, enabling structured storage and retrieval across architectures and studies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Manifestation Unit Protocol, a typed tuple schema (E, S, R, D, G) extended with attention-head primitives (T) for Transformers, which organizes per-component statistics into structured fields populated automatically and queried via hybrid retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiates the protocol across generative vision (beta-VAE), discriminative vision (CNN), and language (GPT-2) models, demonstrating that typed structure substantially improves composability and query efficiency of interpretability results.

recommendation.zh: 作为可解释性结果标准化的弱信号，了解协议结构即可，无需深入实现细节。
recommendation.en: Weak signal on standardizing interpretability artifacts; useful to know the schema design, no need to dive into implementation details.

paper.title: Surrogate Fidelity: When Can Open LLMs Explain Closed Ones?
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) requires full access to model internals, yet the APIs for most widely deployed language models at best expose log-probabilities over output tokens. This creates a surrogate problem: when do measurements made on open models allow us to make claims about a closed model? We evaluate surrogate fidelity at the prediction, attribution, and representation levels. For binary classification tasks, log-odds provide an API-compatible scalar readout of the model's represent

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个解释性研究里长期被默认、但很少被正面检验的问题：当闭源前沿模型只能通过 API 访问时，研究者能否用开源模型作为 surrogate，去解释闭源模型的行为与内部机制？作者把这个问题形式化为 surrogate fidelity，也就是“在 surrogate 模型上测到的量，能多大程度预测 target 模型上的对应量”。他们特别强调，很多人默认“如果两个模型预测相近，那么解释也大致可迁移”，但全文实验表明这个假设并不稳，尤其在 attribution 层面经常失效。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练方法论文，但对基座研究仍有直接价值。第一，当前很多关于训练动态、表示结构、对齐副作用的结论，都是在开源模型上做白盒分析，再外推到闭源大模型；这篇工作提醒这种外推需要先验证 fidelity。第二，作者提出了一套按访问权限分层的 fidelity 框架，尤其把 top-K logprob 可得的 API 信号利用到 prediction / attribution 测量里，这对闭源模型审计、对齐评估、以及 post-train 行为归因都很实用。第三，论文给出一个很重要的负面结果：prediction fidelity 往往显著高估 attribution fidelity。也就是说，两个模型可以在“答什么”上很像，但在“为什么这么答”上差很多。对任何想把开源模型当作闭源模型代理来做机制分析的人，这都是需要先过的一道检查。贡献量级上，这是一个评估框架加系统性实证工作，方法不复杂，但问题提得准，结论也足够具体。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出了一个 surrogate fidelity 的层级框架，按从弱到强、从观测到干预再到机制的顺序，定义四类一致性：prediction fidelity、attribution fidelity、representation fidelity、cross-level fidelity。这里最巧的一点，是他们把 binary classification 场景下的 log-odds 作为 API-compatible 的表示读出量。因为对正负类 token 的 log-prob 做差时，softmax 的归一化常数会抵消，所以 log-odds 可以写成 residual representation 在一个 readout direction 上的线性投影。这样一来，即便拿不到完整 logits 或内部激活，只要 API 提供 top-K logprobs，仍然可以构造与表示几何直接相关的标量。

在此基础上，prediction fidelity 衡量 surrogate 与 target 在输出层面的预测一致性；attribution fidelity 则看输入扰动后，两个模型的输出变化是否一致，作者主要用 leave-one-out ablations 来做因果归因；representation fidelity 需要白盒访问，比较模型内部表示对同样干预的响应；cross-level fidelity 则更进一步，问 surrogate 的内部表示能否预测 target 的 attribution。这个层级设计有两个优点。其一，它遵循“最小权限原则”：要验证什么层级的主张，就只要求与之匹配的访问权限，而不是默认必须白盒。其二，它把很多过去混在一起的“模型相似性”拆开了：输出像，不等于归因像；归因像，也不等于内部表示真的同构。

全文还有一个值得注意的分析点：作者讨论了 access–validity inversion。某些高访问权限下很容易得到的白盒信号，比如 attention pattern 相似性、扰动幅度等，看起来信息很多，但未必能预测更有因果意义的 black-box attribution agreement。也就是说，能看到更多内部量，不代表你测到的东西更接近真正可迁移的解释。这个判断对 mechanistic interpretability 社区是有针对性的，因为很多常用分析工具默认“白盒信号更可信”，而作者的结果表明至少在跨模型迁移上不能这么简单看。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 11 个模型，来自 Llama、Qwen、GPT、Gemini 四个家族，规模从 0.5B 到 70B，并在三个 binary classification benchmark 上评估。这个设置的价值在于同时包含开源与闭源、同家族不同尺度与跨家族比较，因此能区分“同系列缩放是否更像”和“不同训练体系之间是否还能互作 surrogate”。

核心结果是：prediction fidelity 明显高于 attribution fidelity，而且前者会系统性高估后者。换句话说，模型之间即便在标签预测上高度一致，也可能对哪些输入 token 或片段真正驱动了决策有很大分歧。论文还报告，某些模型对在 representation fidelity 或预测层面看起来接近，但 attribution 层面的 agreement 依然很差。另一个重要发现是 access–validity inversion：一些常见白盒指标并不能很好预测更因果化的 attribution fidelity。由于给出的全文片段没有包含所有表格数值，能确认的是模型覆盖范围、任务类型、以及“预测一致性高但归因一致性低”这一主结论；具体到各模型对之间的 fidelity 分数、家族内外差异大小、以及不同 benchmark 上的数值，需要直接看实验章节和附录表格。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries。Introduction 讲清楚了问题边界：不是讨论某个解释工具本身好不好，而是讨论“开源模型能否作为闭源模型解释代理”。Preliminaries 里关于 log-odds direction 的推导值得看，因为这是整篇工作能在 API 约束下成立的关键技术点。

然后直接看定义 fidelity hierarchy 的章节，弄清 prediction / attribution / representation / cross-level 四层分别在测什么、需要什么访问权限。实验部分优先看主结果图表，重点关注两件事：一是 prediction fidelity 与 attribution fidelity 的脱钩有多严重；二是同家族不同尺度与跨家族之间，哪类 surrogate 更可靠。

如果只有 25–35 分钟，读完方法定义和主实验就够了；如果要把它用于闭源模型审计或 MI 研究设计，建议再看作者如何实现 leave-one-out attribution、如何处理 API top-K logprob 的限制，以及附录里对 attention 等白盒指标失效的分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a question that is often assumed away in mechanistic interpretability: when a frontier model is only accessible through an API, under what conditions can an open model serve as a faithful surrogate for explaining it? The authors formalize this as surrogate fidelity, meaning how well a measurement made on a surrogate model predicts the corresponding measurement on a target model. The key challenge is that many interpretability claims are implicitly transferred across models without checking whether the transfer is valid at the level of outputs, attributions, or internal representations.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is highly relevant to foundation-model research. A large fraction of current analysis on representations, alignment side effects, and training-induced behaviors is done on open models and then informally generalized to closed frontier systems. This paper argues that such generalization needs an explicit fidelity check. Its main practical contribution is a hierarchy of fidelity metrics aligned with access constraints, including metrics that can be computed from top-K log-probabilities alone. Its main empirical contribution is a strong negative result: prediction fidelity often substantially overstates attribution fidelity. In other words, two models may agree on what answer to give while disagreeing on why. For anyone using open models as proxies for closed ones, that is a serious warning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes a hierarchy of surrogate fidelity metrics: prediction fidelity, attribution fidelity, representation fidelity, and cross-level fidelity. The setup is instantiated for binary classification tasks. A key technical observation is that binary log-odds can be recovered from API-accessible log-probabilities and are exactly linear in the model representation. Because the softmax normalization constant cancels when taking the difference between the positive and negative class log-probabilities, the resulting log-odds correspond to a projection of the residual representation onto a readout direction. This gives the framework a clean geometric interpretation while remaining compatible with restricted APIs.

On top of that, prediction fidelity measures agreement at the output level. Attribution fidelity measures whether the two models respond similarly to causal input interventions, implemented through leave-one-out ablations. Representation fidelity requires white-box access and compares how internal representations respond to the same interventions. Cross-level fidelity asks whether the surrogate’s internal representations can predict the target’s attributions. The hierarchy is well designed for two reasons. First, it follows a least-privilege principle: each claim should require only the level of access needed to test it. Second, it separates forms of similarity that are often conflated. Similar predictions do not imply similar attributions, and similar attributions do not automatically imply shared internal mechanisms.

A notable conceptual point is the access–validity inversion discussed in the paper. Some high-access white-box signals, such as attention similarity or perturbation magnitude, may look rich but fail to predict the more causally relevant black-box attribution agreement. That is a pointed critique of a common assumption in interpretability work: more internal access does not automatically mean a more transferable explanation.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans 11 models from four families—Llama, Qwen, GPT, and Gemini—covering scales from 0.5B to 70B, and uses three binary classification benchmarks. This design matters because it includes both open and closed models, within-family scaling comparisons, and cross-family comparisons.

The central empirical result is a dissociation between prediction fidelity and attribution fidelity. Prediction agreement is often much higher than attribution agreement, meaning that models can align on the label while differing sharply in which parts of the input causally drive the decision. The paper also reports cases where models appear close in representation-level or output-level terms but still diverge substantially in attribution. Another important finding is the access–validity inversion: common white-box signals do not reliably predict the more causally meaningful attribution fidelity. The provided text does not include all numeric tables, but it clearly establishes the model coverage, the benchmark type, and the main conclusion that output agreement is a poor proxy for explanation agreement.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and preliminaries. The introduction frames the problem cleanly: the issue is not whether a given interpretability tool is useful in isolation, but whether open-model findings can be transferred to closed models. In the preliminaries, pay attention to the derivation of log-odds as a linear readout from representation space. That is the technical hinge that makes the API-compatible part of the framework work.

Then read the section defining the fidelity hierarchy and the main experimental results. Focus on two questions: how large the gap is between prediction and attribution fidelity, and whether within-family surrogates are materially more reliable than cross-family ones. If you only have 25 to 35 minutes, the framework definition plus the main result figures are enough. If you want to use this paper to design audits or interpretability studies, also read the implementation details for leave-one-out attribution and the appendix discussion of why some white-box similarity measures fail.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attribution fidelity 和 access-validity inversion 的实验；它会降低用开源模型解释闭源模型的信心。
recommendation.en: Read the attribution-fidelity and access-validity-inversion results; they weaken the case for explaining closed models via open surrogates.

paper.title: Representational Depth of Evaluation Awareness Shifts With Scale in Open-Weight Language Models
paper.abstract: Do language models know when they are being tested? This question matters for AI safety: a model that recognises an evaluation context could alter its behaviour strategically, making downstream benchmarks harder to interpret. Using 11 models spanning Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Llama 3.2, we find a systematic size-dependent shift in representational depth: in both Qwen 2.5 and Gemma 2, the layer at which evaluation-awareness is most linearly recoverable moves from late layers in smaller models to ear

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究开源语言模型是否能识别自己处在评测环境中，以及这种“evaluation awareness”在模型层内的位置如何随规模变化。作者反驳了一个过于简单的说法：评测意识不只是随参数量单调增强，它在不同模型家族中有不同轨迹，并且可线性解码的位置会随规模前移或后移。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的价值在于提供了一个机制分析视角：规模变化不只改变某种能力的强弱，也可能改变该能力在网络中的表征深度。这个现象会影响 benchmark 解释、污染诊断、对齐评测和 activation-level 监控。对 scaling law 研究也有提醒：如果只做跨家族稀疏采样，很容易把家族差异和层内表征迁移误读成平滑的参数量规律。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析 11 个开源模型：Qwen 2.5 的 0.5B、1.5B、3B、7B、14B、32B，Gemma 2 的 2B、9B、27B，以及 Llama 3.2 的 1B、3B。白盒部分使用 TransformerLens 在 residual stream 的 hook_resid_pre 位置取激活。probe 不做梯度训练，而是在 Jordine 数据集的 203 组 evaluation/deployment 对比 prompt 上，用 answer token 激活均值差构造方向，并做 L2 归一化。评测时在 SAD 的 stages_oversight split 上，对每个非 BOS prompt token 投影到该方向，再取平均分数计算 AUROC。作者记录 peak AUROC 和 peak 所在的相对层深度。黑盒部分直接让模型判断 SAD 样本属于 evaluation 还是 deployment。另有 ROUGE-L completion test 和 perplexity-ratio analysis 用来检查 benchmark 相关污染。
summary.experiments: 关键结果是层深度随规模发生系统性变化。在 Qwen 2.5 和 Gemma 2 中，小模型的 evaluation-awareness 最容易在较晚层线性恢复，大模型则更早层达到 peak decodability。Qwen 2.5 的家族内 scaling 不是单调曲线，Gemma 2 甚至呈现反向趋势；Llama 3.2 只有两个相近规模点，作者把它作为对照，不对其家族内规律做强结论。白盒可解码性和黑盒行为也不完全一致，probe AUROC 高并不必然意味着模型会在直接分类中表现出相同程度的评测识别行为。污染诊断用于支撑这些结果不是简单由 benchmark memorization 造成。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看实验设置中 probe 构造细节，因为 answer-token 构造和 prompt-token 评测的聚合方式会影响方向解释。然后看 peak AUROC 与 relative depth 的图表，这是主要结果。再看 within-family scaling 图，区分 Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2 和 Llama 3.2 的差异。最后扫一遍 contamination diagnostics 和 black-box classification，对结论边界有帮助。值得深挖的问题是：这种表征深度迁移是否也出现在任务识别、拒答、系统提示识别、代码/数学能力等其他内部特征上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether open-weight language models can detect evaluation contexts, and where that signal is represented inside the network as models scale. It challenges a simple monotonic-scaling account: evaluation awareness does not merely get stronger with parameter count. Its linearly recoverable location shifts across layers, and the scaling trajectory differs by model family.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than architectural. Scaling can change not only the strength of an internal feature, but also its representational depth. This matters for benchmark interpretation, contamination checks, safety evaluations, and activation-level monitoring. It also cautions against sparse cross-family scaling analyses: with only one or two checkpoints per family, family-specific structure can be mistaken for a smooth parameter-count law.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study covers 11 open-weight models: six Qwen 2.5 checkpoints from 0.5B to 32B, three Gemma 2 checkpoints from 2B to 27B, and two Llama 3.2 checkpoints at 1B and 3B. The white-box method uses TransformerLens to read residual-stream activations at hook_resid_pre. For each layer, a probe direction is built analytically from the Jordine dataset, which contains 203 paired evaluation/deployment prompts. The direction is the normalized difference between mean answer-token activations for the two labels; no gradient-trained classifier is used. Evaluation is run on the SAD stages_oversight split with 400 items. For each item, the model projects all non-BOS prompt-token activations onto the probe direction, averages the projections, and computes AUROC. The authors track both peak AUROC and the relative layer depth of that peak. They also run a black-box classification test and two contamination diagnostics: ROUGE-L completion testing and perplexity-ratio analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The central empirical pattern is a depth shift. In both Qwen 2.5 and Gemma 2, smaller models show the strongest linear recoverability of evaluation awareness in later layers, while larger models peak earlier. Within-family scaling is not a smooth monotonic curve: Qwen 2.5 is non-monotonic, and Gemma 2 shows an inverse trajectory. Llama 3.2 is treated mainly as a contrast case because it has only two closely spaced checkpoints. The paper also reports a dissociation between internal decodability and black-box behavior: a high probe AUROC does not necessarily imply that the model will classify evaluation versus deployment contexts more strongly when prompted. The contamination checks are included to reduce the chance that the observed effects are just benchmark memorization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the probe construction, especially the difference between answer-token activations used to define the direction and prompt-token activations used for scoring. Then focus on the plots or tables for peak AUROC and relative peak depth; these contain the main result. Next inspect the within-family scaling comparisons for Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Llama 3.2. Finish with the contamination diagnostics and the black-box classification results to understand the limits of the claim. A useful follow-up question is whether the same depth relocation appears for other internal features, such as task recognition, refusal behavior, system-prompt sensitivity, or domain-specific capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了特征表征深度随 scale 变浅的有趣现象，对理解模型内部机制和设计 probing 实验有启发，建议看图表和结论。
recommendation.en: Reveals an interesting phenomenon where feature representation depth becomes shallower with scale; insightful for understanding internal mechanisms and designing probing experiments. Read the charts and conclusions.

paper.title: Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models
paper.abstract: We aim to discover diverse, generalizable perturbations of LLM internals that can surface hidden behavioral modes. Such perturbations could help reshape model behavior and systematically evaluate potential risks. We introduce Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE), an unsupervised method for discovering interpretable low-rank adapters (LoRAs) that can elicit these latent behaviors. CPE decomposes the computations of a deep transformer slice using a heuristic tensor-decomposition-based algorithm.

summary.core_problem: 论文研究如何在不依赖大规模监督数据或输出层 RL 搜索的情况下，从模型内部诱发隐藏的行为模式。目标不是简单 prompt engineering，而是在早期权重扰动中寻找可泛化、可解释、能改变下游行为的方向。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座研究的价值主要在机制分析和 post-train 接口。它把“行为诱发”从输出采样或监督微调，推进到早中层计算路径的因果扰动。对 RL 训练也有启发：如果一个扰动能把模型初始化到较好的行为 basin，后续 RL 在奖励不完备时可能更不容易走向 reward hacking。该工作不直接改进预训练 loss，但提供了一种研究隐性能力、隐藏 persona、拒绝行为、alignment-faking 的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法称为 Causal Perturbative Elicitation，简称 CPE。每个 adapter 由多个 unit-norm rank-1 LoRA 组成，作用在若干连续 source layers 的 attention output projection 上，并观察固定 target layer 的激活变化。核心假设是：能在网络后续层产生大范围、结构化影响的早层扰动，更可能对应有语义的行为模式；随机扰动通常只是局部噪声。CPE 不像 SAE 那样以稀疏重构激活为目标，而是学习一个浅层 MLP 来近似一段 10–20 层 transformer slice 的因果/微分结构，再用启发式张量分解搜索多样化、因果影响大的低秩扰动。一个重要特点是数据效率很高，作者声称单个样本也能学习出多个可解释 LoRA。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、Llama3-70B 等模型上进行。开放式对话中，CPE 用很少数据诱发 coherent personas，效果接近基于大规模 token 训练的 SAE steering vectors。自然行为诱发任务包括 reasoning、anti-sycophancy、jailbreaking；CPE 通常强于 SAE feature steering，并且在 anti-sycophancy 和 reasoning 等场景中有时接近 GRPO。更有意思的是 RL 初始化实验：在 competitive programming 的 mis-specified reward 环境中，CPE + GRPO 可以达到接近使用正确 reward 的 gold-standard performance，而随机初始化的 GRPO 出现 reward hacking，gold-standard reward 崩塌。安全相关实验中，CPE 恢复了 password-locked Llama3-70B 编码性能的 77%，并几乎消除了 synthetic-document-fine-tuned Llama3-70B 变体中的 alignment-faking。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 45–60 分钟。先看 Method 中 adapter 参数化、source/target layer 设定、causal training objective，与 SAE 的差异。然后看三个实验块：persona/behavior elicitation、CPE 初始化 GRPO、password-lock 与 alignment-faking。对预训练研究者，最值得深挖的是“早层低秩扰动为何能泛化为行为模式”以及“CPE 初始化如何改变 RL 的优化 basin”。如果时间有限，可以跳过开放式 persona 样例，优先读消融实验和与 SAE、GRPO 的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to elicit latent behavioral modes in LLMs through internal perturbations, rather than through prompting, supervised fine-tuning, or output-layer reinforcement learning.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to mechanistic intervention and the interface between internal representations and post-training. CPE suggests that some behavioral modes can be accessed through low-rank perturbations to early-layer weights, and that such perturbations can provide better starting points for later RL. This is useful for studying hidden capabilities, mode collapse, reward hacking, password-locked behavior, and alignment-faking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Causal Perturbative Elicitation, represents each adapter as a set of unit-norm rank-1 LoRA perturbations applied to attention output projections across several consecutive source layers. The effect is measured at a later target layer. The working hypothesis is that perturbations producing large, structured downstream activation changes correspond to meaningful computational pathways, while random perturbations tend to remain local noise. Instead of training sparse autoencoders to reconstruct activations, CPE trains a shallow MLP approximation of the causal structure of a 10–20 layer transformer slice and uses a heuristic tensor-decomposition procedure to extract diverse causally important perturbations. A notable claim is extreme data efficiency: interpretable LoRAs can be discovered from as little as one example.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, and Llama3-70B variants. On open-ended conversational prompts, CPE elicits coherent personas roughly comparable to SAE-based steering despite using far less data. On behavior elicitation tasks such as reasoning, anti-sycophancy, and jailbreaking, CPE outperforms SAE feature steering and is sometimes competitive with GRPO. In a competitive programming setup with a misspecified reward, initializing GRPO with CPE reaches gold-standard performance comparable to GRPO trained with the correct reward, while random initialization leads to reward hacking and collapse under the gold-standard reward. In safety-oriented tests, CPE restores 77% of password-locked coding performance on a password-locked Llama3-70B and nearly removes alignment-faking in a synthetic-document-fine-tuned Llama3-70B variant.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 45–60 minutes. Read the method section carefully enough to understand the rank-1 LoRA parameterization, source-target layer setup, and the causal objective, since these are the main differences from SAE steering. Then focus on the GRPO initialization experiment and the password-lock/alignment-faking results. For pretraining-oriented readers, the key question is why early-layer low-rank perturbations generalize as behavioral modes and whether the same machinery can diagnose latent capabilities before post-training.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对“能力是学出来还是被激活出来”的 prior；先看方法图和 Countdown 对比，若控制组干净，值得内部复现成风险探针。
recommendation.en: This can shift your prior on whether behaviors are learned vs. merely activated; read the method and Countdown comparison first, and replicate internally if the controls are clean.

paper.title: How Do LLMs Cite? A Mechanistic Interpretation of Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to enhance the trustworthiness of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their outputs in external documents, often using inline citations for verifiability. However, the faithfulness of these citations -- whether the model genuinely uses a source to generate an answer -- remains a critical, unverified assumption. This paper offers the first mechanistic account of how a large language model decides whether to attach an inline citation while answering

summary.core_problem: RAG 系统中模型给出的引文可能只是“看起来对”，但未必真的是在生成回答时读取并使用了被引文档——这种 citation faithfulness（忠实引用）问题无法从输入输出表层判断，需要从模型内部机制层面解释模型“什么时候、为什么、由哪些组件决定发出一个引文标记”。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的直接启发在于：RAG 中的 grounding 不是一个抽象概念，而是体现在具体的内部计算路径上。如果引文行为主要由浅层启发式触发，比如实体匹配或格式模仿，而不是由真正读取上下文内容的组件驱动，那么依靠“带引用”来衡量可信度会产生系统性误判。这类 mechanistic 证据对设计更可靠的 attribution loss、RAG 指令后训练数据、以及 grounding 评测协议都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 为研究对象，构造一个受控的 PopQA 风格数据集：同一个问题分别配一个真实支持文档和一个结构匹配的干扰文档，要求模型仅在文档支持回答时插入内联引文。核心方法是 activation patching：在支持文档运行和干扰文档运行之间，逐组件替换中间激活，观察“发起引文 token（[）”和句末终止 token（.）之间的 logit difference 如何变化，从而定位哪些注意力头和 MLP 层真正控制引文决策。随后通过定向干预验证这些组件的因果作用，包括补引缺失引文和抑制错误引文。
summary.experiments: 实验聚焦于能在干净条件和干扰条件下产生明确相反偏好的同质样本，以降低 patching 噪声。作者识别出一个分布式、多阶段的 attributional ensemble：并非单一头或单层决定引文，而是由若干特定 attention heads 和 MLP layers 分阶段协作完成。针对这些组件的干预能够在单文档设定下纠正部分引文失败，并在更复杂的多文档问答中带来 citation accuracy 的明显提升。论文全文版本未提供完整数值表，但结论方向明确：引文行为可被内部定位，且具备可操纵的因果结构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议重点看方法部分的实验设计和 activation patching 指标定义，以及多阶段 attributional ensemble 的组成图。若关心 mechanistic interpretability 与 RAG 的结合，可继续看干预实验部分，尤其关注“正确引文但不忠实引用”如何被操作化。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Inline citations in RAG systems can look correct without being faithful: a model may append a citation to a source that happens to support the answer, even if the answer was generated from parametric memory rather than grounded in the retrieved document. This faithfulness failure cannot be diagnosed from input-output behavior alone and requires looking inside the model to understand how citation decisions are made.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant because it moves evaluation of RAG grounding from surface-form checks toward internal mechanism. If citation behavior is driven by shallow heuristics rather than components that actually consume document content during answer construction, then citation-based trust signals are systematically misleading. This has direct implications for how researchers think about attribution-oriented training data, post-training objectives for grounded generation, and evaluation protocols that claim to measure grounding.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in a controlled PopQA-style setup. For each question, they run the same prompt twice: once with a supporting document and once with a structurally matched distractor document. The model is instructed to emit an inline citation marker only when the document supports the answer. Using activation patching between the supporting and distractor runs, they localize attention heads and MLP layers whose activations causally affect the model's preference for emitting the citation-initiating token versus ending the sentence. They then validate these components through targeted interventions designed to induce missing citations or suppress spurious ones.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis is restricted to examples where the supporting and distractor conditions produce clear, opposite token preferences at the decision point, reducing variance in patching. The authors identify a distributed, multi-stage attributional ensemble rather than a single citation head or layer. Interventions on these components correct a portion of citation failures in the single-document setting and produce meaningful improvements in citation accuracy in a more complex multi-document QA setting. The publicly available excerpt does not include full numerical tables, but the reported evidence supports a causal, manipulable internal circuit for citation behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper for the experimental design, the logit-difference metric used to detect citation behavior, and the structure of the proposed attributional ensemble. Readers interested in mechanistic interpretability for grounded generation should spend extra time on the intervention results and the distinction between citation correctness and citation faithfulness. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对“citation=grounding”的先验；只看机制定位和干预结果，别把它外推到所有 RAG 场景。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining recipe, but it should change your prior that citation equals grounding; read the circuit localization and intervention results, not the broadest claims.

paper.title: Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution: Tracing Training Influence to Learned Behavioral Policies
paper.abstract: While existing data attribution methods can identify which training examples build specific mechanistic circuits, they cannot explain how training data shapes the high-level behavioral decisions a model learns to make. To bridge this gap, we introduce Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA), a framework that attributes training pairs to the interpretable symbolic policies governing model behavior. SMDA fits a closed-form Ridge regression over sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to model a tar

summary.core_problem: 现有机制数据归因方法只能定位训练样本对已知底层电路、神经元或SAE特征的影响，无法解释训练数据如何塑造模型学到的高层行为策略（如拒答、阿谀、有害遵从等），也无法在不预先掌握底层电路的情况下，识别对目标行为产生非预期干扰的训练样本。
summary.importance: 为预训练与SFT阶段的数据筛选、对齐数据构造提供了新的分析工具：无需预先定位底层电路，即可将训练样本的影响归因到可解释的行为策略上，可用于识别SFT数据中导致非预期行为偏移、产生跨特征干扰的样本，对理解posttrain数据如何修改预训练习得的行为有参考价值。目前方法仅在3B规模模型的拒答行为上完成案例验证，向更大规模、更多行为类型的外推性尚未验证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SMDA（符号机制数据归因）框架，将归因目标从预定义的模型组件替换为SAE特征上学习到的符号策略。具体流程为：首先在预留评估集上，用少量SAE特征拟合闭式Ridge回归模型，预测目标行为（如拒答倾向），得到可解释的符号策略；之后对每个SFT训练样本，解析计算单步梯度更新对该符号策略权重的影响，将效应拆分为两条路径：内部SAE特征激活偏移（ΔX路径）、模型对目标行为的输出倾向偏移（ΔY路径），最终得到每个训练样本对符号策略的归因分数，同时可检测跨特征干扰——即某个训练样本的主要影响落在与目标行为无关的特征上。
summary.experiments: 在Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct的拒答行为上完成案例研究，分析了200个SFT训练对的影响。核心结果包括：第一，ΔX/ΔY分解可以区分有害样本与无害样本对拒答策略的不同影响机制；第二，大量训练样本存在跨特征干扰，其主要作用落在与拒答无关的特征上，SMDA可以标记这类存在非预期影响的样本；第三，学到的符号策略仅用少量SAE特征即可准确预测模型的拒答行为。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有机制归因方法局限的梳理、第3节SMDA框架的ΔX/ΔY分解逻辑，以及第5节的拒答案例实验结果。除非需要复现或改造方法，不需要深究闭式推导细节。注意方法的适用边界：目前仅在小模型、单一行为上验证，且仅针对SFT单步更新场景，尚未扩展到全预训练过程的动态归因。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 提供的文稿片段未明确标注作者机构，作者来自可解释性方向的学术研究团队。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mechanistic data attribution methods only trace training example influence to pre-identified low-level circuits, neurons, or SAE features. They cannot explain how training data shapes high-level learned behavioral policies (e.g., refusal, sycophancy, harmful compliance), nor can they detect training samples that cause unintended shifts in target behaviors without prior knowledge of their underlying neural circuits.
summary_en.importance: The work provides a useful analytical tool for data curation in pretraining and SFT, and for studying how post-training data modifies behaviors acquired during pretraining. It attributes training data effects to interpretable behavioral policies without requiring pre-identified underlying circuits, making it possible to flag SFT samples that cause unintended behavior shifts or cross-feature interference. Validation is currently limited to a case study on refusal behavior in a 3B-parameter model, so scalability to larger models and other behavioral phenotypes remains untested.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Symbolic Mechanistic Data Attribution (SMDA) framework uses a learned symbolic policy over SAE features as the attribution target, rather than predefined model components. First, a closed-form Ridge regression model is fit on a held-out evaluation set to predict the target behavior (e.g., refusal propensity) from a sparse set of SAE features, forming an interpretable symbolic policy. For each SFT training example, the framework analytically computes how a single gradient step on that example shifts the weights of this symbolic policy, decomposing the effect into two pathways: shifts in internal SAE feature activations (ΔX pathway) and shifts in model output propensity for the target behavior (ΔY pathway). The resulting attribution score captures both the magnitude and mechanism of each training example’s effect, and can detect cross-feature interference where a training sample primarily impacts features unrelated to the target behavior.
summary_en.experiments: A case study is conducted on refusal behavior in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, analyzing the influence of 200 SFT training pairs. Key findings include: (1) The ΔX/ΔY decomposition reveals qualitatively different influence mechanisms for harmful vs. harmless training pairs on the refusal policy; (2) A large share of training pairs exhibit cross-feature interference, with their dominant effect falling on features unrelated to refusal, which SMDA can flag; (3) The learned symbolic policy accurately predicts model refusal behavior using only a small set of SAE features.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the core idea; focus on the introduction’s framing of limitations in existing mechanistic attribution methods, the ΔX/ΔY decomposition logic in Section 3, and the refusal case study results in Section 5. There is no need to work through the full closed-form derivations unless adapting the method. Pay attention to scope limits: the approach is only demonstrated on small models and a single behavior, and applies to SFT updates rather than full pretraining dynamics. Expected reading time: 20–30 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Explicit institutional affiliations are not listed in the provided manuscript segment; authors are from academic research groups working on mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 结合了 SAE 和数据归因，提供了一种分析 SFT 数据如何影响模型行为的新视角，对后训练数据分析有启发，建议关注其归因方法的有效性。
recommendation.en: Combines SAE and data attribution, offering a new perspective on how SFT data influences model behavior; insightful for post-training data analysis, worth checking the effectiveness of its attribution method.

paper.title: How Token Influence Decays with Distance: A Green-Function View of Trained Language Models
paper.abstract: We study how the next-token prediction of an autoregressive Transformer language model changes under small perturbations of earlier input token embeddings. Motivated by operator learning and iterative solvers for differential equations, we investigate how the influence of one token on another decays with distance in a trained model. In multilevel methods for differential equations, such as domain decomposition, multigrid, and multilevel preconditioning, one often exploits a separation between st

summary.core_problem: 需要一种定量方法测量训练好的自回归LLM中早期token扰动对后续预测的影响随距离的衰减规律，弥补注意力权重可视化无法反映真实输入-输出因果影响的缺陷，为层级化架构设计提供实证依据。
summary.importance: 提供了超越注意力可视化的雅可比灵敏度定量分析工具；发现的幂律衰减特性（而非RNN的指数衰减）解释了Transformer长程建模能力的来源；验证的长程响应模式为类多重网格的层级LLM架构、长上下文优化方案提供了实证基础。
summary.technical_approach: 借鉴微分方程数值求解中格林函数（衡量局部输入扰动对另一位置解的影响）的思想，将训练好的LLM前向传播视为非线性算子，通过自动微分计算距离分辨的雅可比灵敏度：对每个目标位置的下一个token logit（取真实标签或模型预测对应的分量），计算其对不同因果距离的早期输入token嵌入无穷小扰动的导数，得到按距离分组的梯度剖面；对比幂律与指数衰减的拟合效果，通过token打乱、随机权重等控制实验区分训练习得特性与架构固有偏置。
summary.experiments: 在多个语料库和模型上，训练好的Transformer长程雅可比灵敏度呈现稳定的幂律型衰减，与经典RNN的指数衰减形成对比；该衰减效应在token打乱后仍然存在，但随机权重模型中完全消失，证明长程响应是训练习得的特性；中位数对角归一化剖面在测量距离范围内可被幂律函数良好拟合。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章引言中微分方程层级求解器与LLM的类比动机、第2章格林函数到Transformer雅可比的映射定义、实验部分的衰减模式拟合对比图；预计阅读时间25-30分钟，无需深究微分方程理论细节，重点把握分析方法与实证结论。

summary_en.core_problem: A quantitative method is needed to measure the distance-dependent decay of early token perturbations' impact on subsequent predictions in trained autoregressive LLMs, addressing the limitation that attention weight visualizations cannot reflect true input-output causal effects, and providing empirical evidence for hierarchical architecture design.
summary_en.importance: Provides a Jacobian-sensitivity-based quantitative token interaction analysis tool beyond attention visualization; the discovered power-law decay (instead of exponential decay in RNNs) explains the source of Transformer's long-range modeling capability; the verified long-range response modes lay empirical foundation for multigrid-like hierarchical LLM architectures and long-context optimization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Green's functions in differential equation solving (which measure the impact of a localized input perturbation at one point on the solution at another), this work treats the forward pass of a trained LLM as a nonlinear operator and computes distance-resolved Jacobian sensitivities via automatic differentiation: for each target position, it selects the logit component corresponding to either the ground-truth next token or the model's prediction, and calculates its derivative with respect to infinitesimal perturbations of input token embeddings at different causal distances to obtain distance-binned gradient profiles. It compares fitting performance of power-law and exponential decay models, and uses control experiments (shuffled tokens, random weights) to distinguish learned properties from architectural inductive biases.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple corpora and model variants, trained Transformers exhibit stable power-law decay of long-range Jacobian sensitivity, in contrast to the exponential decay observed in classical RNNs; the decay effect persists after token shuffling but disappears entirely in models with random weights, confirming long-range responses are learned rather than architectural biases; the median diagonal-normalized profile is well fitted by a power-law function over the measured distance range.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 (motivation linking hierarchical differential equation solvers to LLMs), Section 2 (mapping from Green's functions to Transformer Jacobians and formal sensitivity definitions), and experimental figures comparing decay pattern fitting; estimated reading time 25-30 minutes, no need to dive into differential equation theoretical details, prioritize understanding the analysis methodology and empirical conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验定义和 decay 拟合图；若 power-law 结论稳，会削弱很多“长距影响可指数截断”的工程直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the measurement setup and decay fits; if the power-law result holds, it weakens the engineering instinct that long-range influence can be exponentially truncated.

paper.title: Internal-State Probes Read the Situation, Not the Action: Three Negative Results for Pre-Action Misalignment Monitoring
paper.abstract: Probes on model internals could help monitor agentic systems if they identify harmful text or tool actions before those actions are generated. We ask when an internal readout supports this stronger pre-action claim, rather than merely describing the prompt, construction contrast, or current trajectory. We test three methods across three model families: a Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct fine-tune/base direction, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct probes at the last token of unsafe prefills, and Gemma-3-27B-IT emot

summary.core_problem: 论文检验一个更强的安全监控假设：模型内部激活能否在有害文本或工具动作生成之前，稳定预示即将发生的不对齐行为，而不只是读出当前情境、提示分布或轨迹阶段。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析和安全监控方法论。它提醒使用 activation probe、concept vector、contrastive direction 时，不能把构造集上的可分性等同于可部署的 pre-action signal。对基座研究员有用的点是：残差流中确实包含丰富的情境信息，但这些信息未必是下一步动作的因果前兆。若要把内部状态用于训练时监控、agent 运行时拦截或对齐评估，需要同时做泛化、特异性和干预控制。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较了三类自然的内部状态方法。第一类是 disposition direction：在 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 的不安全微调模型和 base 模型之间取 residual stream 均值差方向，用构造集阈值区分两类模型，再测试该方向是否会在 base 模型多轮 audit 中、真正有害动作之前升高。第二类是 behavioral prefill probe：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的不安全 assistant prefill 最后一个 token 上训练分类器，预测模型会继续坏轨迹还是自我修正，并检查跨域迁移。第三类是 emotion-concept vector：在 Gemma-3-27B-IT 上从带情绪标签故事中抽取概念方向，用投影读出和 activation addition 干预黑邮件工具调用场景。关键设计是把“能读出语义”与“能预测动作”拆开，并加入 shared-prefix、bridge-probe、同范式学习出的无关语义方向等控制，而不只用随机向量作对照。
summary.experiments: 结果整体是否定性的。Qwen 的 fine-tune/base 方向可以很好解决构造时的模型群体对比，但在可用的 pre-action agent 上下文中没有稳定越过阈值。Llama 的 prefill probe 能检测到一定行为预测信号，但幅度较小，且对数据源和场景依赖明显，单源跨域迁移较弱。Gemma 的情绪向量投影能追踪 transcript stage，desperate 等方向在部分设置中会提高黑邮件动作率；但 cats、weather、sports、geography 等同样由 difference-of-means 和 neutral-PCA 流程学出的无关方向也能改变动作率，说明随机向量对照不足以支持“情绪特异的 pre-action 机制”解释。论文还报告了 Qwen3-32B 的 steering 检查，结论同样偏谨慎。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–45 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 pre-action monitor 的定义，以及“reading the situation, not the action”的问题拆分。Methods 部分重点看三类 probe 各自对应的有效性指标：threshold crossing、AUC/lift 与跨域迁移、matched-norm steering rate contrast。结果部分优先看 emotion-vector 控制实验，因为它展示了为什么 random-only control 不够；其次看 Qwen direction 的构造集成功与 pre-action 失败之间的落差。若关注 agent 安全监控，可细读 shared-prefix 和 bridge-probe 控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether internal-state probes can serve as reliable pre-action monitors for agentic misalignment, rather than merely encoding the prompt, the construction contrast, or the current stage of a trajectory.
summary_en.importance: The main value is methodological. It is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it is relevant to anyone using residual-stream probes, contrastive directions, or concept vectors as evidence about model behavior. The results argue for a stricter standard: a useful monitor needs out-of-construction generalization and, for mechanistic claims, specificity beyond semantic legibility or steering effects. This matters for training-time diagnostics, deployment monitoring, and post-training safety evaluations that rely on internal activations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study tests three probe families under pre-action conditions. The first is a disposition direction, defined as a normalized difference-of-means vector between an unsafe fine-tune and its base Qwen2.5-Coder-32B model in the residual stream. A threshold that separates the construction contrast is then evaluated in multi-turn audit settings before concerning actions occur. The second is a behavioral prefill probe on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, trained from the hidden state at the last token of unsafe assistant prefills to predict whether the model continues the bad trajectory or corrects course. The third uses emotion-concept directions on Gemma-3-27B-IT, extracted from emotion-labeled stories and applied as projections or activation additions in a blackmail tool-action scenario. The important control is that learned, unrelated semantic directions such as cats, weather, sports, and geography are compared against emotion directions, not just random Gaussian vectors.
summary_en.experiments: All three families show a gap between construction-time success and deployable pre-action monitoring. The Qwen fine-tune/base direction cleanly solves the population contrast it was built from, but does not reliably activate before later misaligned actions in available audit transcripts. The Llama prefill classifiers show statistically detectable behavior prediction, but the effect is small and tied to the source domain; cross-domain transfer is weak. In the Gemma blackmail setup, emotion projections track transcript stage and some directions, such as desperate, can raise blackmail rates in certain settings. However, unrelated learned semantic directions can also move action rates under matched-norm steering, which weakens emotion-specific and causal interpretations. A Qwen3-32B steering check points in the same cautious direction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Start with the definition of pre-action monitoring in the introduction, then read the methods table or metric descriptions for the three probe families. The highest-yield part is the emotion-vector control section, because it explains why random-vector controls are too weak for semantic steering claims. The Qwen direction result is also useful as a clean example of construction-validity failing to transfer to the intended monitoring setting. Readers focused on safety mechanisms should spend extra time on the shared-prefix and bridge-probe controls.

recommendation.zh: 一篇扎实的 negative result 论文，指出基于内部状态的 probe 往往只是读出了 prompt 的特征，而不能真正预测模型接下来的 action，对做 representation engineering 和 safety 的人有警示作用。
recommendation.en: A solid negative result paper showing that internal-state probes often just read prompt features rather than predicting future actions. A strong cautionary tale for representation engineering and safety researchers.

paper.title: The Curse of Multiple Mediators: Hidden Interaction Effects in Activation Patching
paper.abstract: Activation patching is the primary tool in mechanistic interpretability. It attributes causal responsibility for a model behavior to each of its individual components by estimating its natural indirect effect (NIE). Re-deriving the activation patching estimand from causal mediation analysis, we find that the NIE does not solely capture the causal effect through the specific component. It also contains interaction effects (INT) that measure how much the component's causal effect itself depends on

summary.core_problem: Activation patching 常被用来给模型组件分配因果责任，但其估计量可能混入组件之间的交互效应，导致解释不稳定或误判。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制解释工具的因果分析。论文重新从 causal mediation analysis 推导 activation patching，指出自然间接效应不只包含目标组件路径效应，还包含该组件与其他组件状态之间的交互项。这会影响 IOI circuit 等常见 mechanistic interpretability 结论的可信度。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 activation patching 的 estimand 写成自然间接效应，并分解出 interaction effects。随后分析几类自然补救方案，例如调整估计器或改变分析单元，并说明这些方案有可预测的失败模式。实证部分在 GPT-2 IOI circuit 中展示：依赖其他组件状态才发挥作用的组件可能被漏检，也可能被人为放大。
summary.experiments: 实验对象包括 GPT-2 的 IOI circuit。摘要报告 interaction-effect variance 可以解释此前观察到的 faithfulness score 不稳定性，并展示了组件重要性被隐藏或夸大的案例。摘要未给出模型尺寸、样本规模、具体组件列表和数值幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Massachusetts Amherst、Adobe Research 和 Boston University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper examines whether activation patching really assigns causal responsibility to individual model components, or whether its estimate is confounded by interactions among components.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a causal analysis of a core mechanistic-interpretability tool. By re-deriving activation patching through causal mediation analysis, it shows that the natural indirect effect includes interaction terms, which can destabilize conclusions about circuits such as GPT-2 IOI.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the activation-patching estimand as a natural indirect effect and decomposes it into component-specific effects plus interaction effects. It then studies natural remedies, such as changing the estimator or the analysis unit, and identifies their predictable failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical analysis uses the GPT-2 IOI circuit. The abstract reports that components whose importance is conditional on other components can become invisible or artificially inflated, and that interaction-effect variance explains previously observed instability in faithfulness scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with University of Massachusetts Amherst, Adobe Research, and Boston University.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变对 activation patching 结果的置信度；重点读估计量分解和 IOI 失败案例。
recommendation.en: This should lower confidence in naive activation-patching claims; read the estimand decomposition and the IOI failure cases.

paper.title: Vision-Default, Prior-Override: Causal Mechanisms of Perception-Knowledge Conflict in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile visual evidence with memorized world knowledge when the two conflict. How they resolve this conflict shapes the reliability of multimodal systems, yet prior work characterizes it behaviorally without a component-level causal account. We combine activation patching across three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers) with model-component ablation studies and mechanistic analysis. Across three VLM families, we find that visual groun

summary.core_problem: 解释 VLM 在视觉证据与记忆中的先验知识冲突时，究竟由哪些组件决定模型更信图像还是更信先验。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不是新模型。价值在于把“视觉优先还是知识优先”从行为现象推进到组件级因果解释，对多模态统一预训练和对齐阶段的表征分工有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者结合 activation patching、按残差流/注意力头/MLP 子层三种粒度的干预，以及组件消融，分析三类 VLM 家族在 perception-knowledge conflict 下的因果路径。核心发现是：视觉 grounding 是默认态，而调用记忆先验依赖网络后半段一小撮因果必要的 attention heads。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个 VLM 家族。论文报告仅 2.5%-4.8% 的注意力头对 prior grounding 具有因果必要性；消融这些头后，在 prior-knowledge prompts 下，68%-96% 的知识驱动回答会翻转为视觉驱动，而原本视觉驱动的预测只变化 0.8%-7.5%。这说明两种 grounding 机制并不对称。
summary.authors_note: University of Tübingen、Harvard University、The University of Texas at Austin。属于较扎实的 VLM 机制分析路线，但从公开信息看并非顶级实验室的大规模预训练项目。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which internal components make a VLM follow visual evidence versus memorized prior knowledge when the two conflict.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a new model. Its value is in moving the question from behavioral observation to component-level causal attribution, which matters for multimodal pretraining and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors combine activation patching, interventions at three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers), and ablations across three VLM families. The key claim is that visual grounding is the default mode, while prior grounding depends on a small set of causally necessary attention heads in the later half of the network.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans three VLM families. It reports that only 2.5%-4.8% of attention heads are causally necessary for prior grounding; ablating them flips 68%-96% of knowledge-grounded answers to visually grounded ones under prior-knowledge prompts, while changing only 0.8%-7.5% of already visually grounded predictions.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Tübingen, Harvard University, and The University of Texas at Austin. This looks like a solid mechanistic VLM study, though not a flagship pretraining effort from a major frontier lab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 VLM 冲突解析的 prior：先看消融结果和头部定位，若现象稳，后续可直接拿来做 multimodal routing/regularization 假设。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining recipes, but it may change your prior on VLM conflict resolution: read the head-level causal ablations first, then decide whether to turn it into routing or regularization hypotheses.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Robust Harmful Features Under Jailbreak Attacks: Mechanistic Evidence from Attention Head Specialization in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Jailbreak attacks bypass LLM safety alignment, yet their mechanisms remain poorly understood. We provide evidence that attacks do not comprehensively eliminate safety features, but instead selectively suppress specific attention heads. We identify two functionally differentiated types: Adversarially Compromised Heads (ACHs) concentrated in early layers, which are suppressed under attacks, and Safety-Aligned Heads (SAHs) in mid-layers, which maintain robust activations even when attacks succeed.

summary.core_problem: 解释 jailbreak 攻击为何能绕过 LLM 的拒答行为：攻击是否真的抹除了安全特征，还是只干扰了部分关键计算路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把安全对齐失效拆到 attention head 层面，区分被攻击模板抑制的早层头和仍保持安全激活的中层头，对理解 post-train safety 信号如何嵌入基座有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文识别两类功能分化的注意力头：早层的 Adversarially Compromised Heads 在攻击下被抑制，中层的 Safety-Aligned Heads 在攻击成功时仍保持激活。通过 head ablation、激活比较和 token-level attribution 验证因果关系，并追踪攻击模板 token 对 ACH 抑制的贡献。
summary.experiments: 摘要未说明具体模型、数据集和攻击集规模。核心实验证据包括：抑制少量 ACH 可让正常应拒答输入出现 jailbreak-like 行为；移除 SAH 会削弱中层安全激活；token attribution 显示攻击模板 token 是 ACH 抑制的主要来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why jailbreak attacks bypass refusal behavior in LLMs: do they erase safety features globally, or do they selectively disrupt specific computation paths?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic safety analysis. It localizes jailbreak effects to specialized attention heads and is relevant for understanding how post-training safety signals are represented inside a pretrained model.
