summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify two head types: early-layer Adversarially Compromised Heads, whose activations are suppressed by attacks, and mid-layer Safety-Aligned Heads, which remain active even when the attack succeeds. They use head ablations, activation analysis, and token-level attribution to test causality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model families, datasets, or attack suites. Reported evidence includes inducing jailbreak-like behavior by suppressing a small number of ACHs, weakening safety activations by removing SAHs, and attributing ACH suppression to attack-template tokens.

recommendation.zh: 只看 head 分型和 ablation；若 setup 干净，它会修正“jailbreak 抹掉安全表征”的粗糙 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the head taxonomy and ablations; if the setup is clean, it refines the crude prior that jailbreaks simply erase safety representations.

paper.title: Localizing RL-Induced Tool Use to a Single Crosscoder Feature
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning through RL reshapes the internal representations of language models to enable agentic behaviors such as tool use, yet the mechanistic basis of these changes remains poorly understood. While RL substantially improves structured tool-call generation, it is unclear which features emerge, which are preserved, and whether identified features can be leveraged for retraining-free behavioral control. In this work, we show that $\textit{Dedicated Feature Crosscoders (DFC)}$ isolate a compact

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RL 微调如何在模型内部写入工具调用能力。更具体地说，它问了三个问题：RL 后新增的能力是否能被 crosscoder 分解到少量模型差异特征中；这些特征是完整承载能力，还是只起过滤作用；找到这些特征后，能否不重新训练模型而直接控制工具调用行为。
summary.importance: 这是一篇值得精读的机制分析工作。它把 post-train 后的能力变化从行为指标推进到表征层面，说明 RL 训练出的 agentic 行为可以在残差流中被较紧凑地定位。对预训练研究的启发有两点。第一，pretrain 与 post-train 的接口不只是数据和 loss，也包括可被定位、可被调制的内部方向。第二，能力差异可能不是均匀分布在全模型参数中，而是部分集中在稀疏特征和特定残差方向上。这会影响后续的持续训练、能力保留、模型合并、RL 安全开关和 runtime steering 设计。需要注意，论文的结论目前限定在 Qwen2.5-3B、ToolRL 风格工具调用、小规模评测和 crosscoder 设定下，不应外推为所有 RL 能力都可由单特征解释。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较两个同架构模型：Model B 是 Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B base，Model A 是 chengq9/ToolRL-Qwen2.5-3B，后者经过结构化 <tool_call> 调用的 RL 微调。模型维度 d=2048，共 36 层。作者训练 Dedicated Feature Crosscoder，将两个模型的 residual stream post-MLP 激活共同编码到稀疏字典中，再分别解码回两个模型。DFC 的字典被显式切成 A-exclusive、B-exclusive 和 shared 三块，并通过 gradient masking 强制独占分区只能写入对应模型。这样可以测试 RL 模型特有的工具调用表征是否进入 A-exclusive 分区。训练数据包含 40,000 条 FineWeb 通用样本和 40,000 条 ToolRL 指令-输出样本。论文系统扫了 48 个 crosscoder 变体，变化轴包括普通 CrossCoder 与 DFC、字典大小、top-k 稀疏度、exclusive share，以及 exclusive penalty λ_excl。技术重点有三处。第一，用 encode-decode reconstruction 测试 crosscoder 是否保留甚至转移工具调用能力。第二，用 Cohen’s d 按工具样本与通用文本激活差异筛选工具相关特征，并要求工具样本 firing rate ≥0.3、通用样本 firing rate ≤0.1。第三，对 A-exclusive 特征做 residual steering：把选中特征的 decoder column 乘以系数 α，加到 RL 模型 residual stream 中，观察工具调用行为是否可控。论文还用 mass-ratio 构造普通 CrossCoder 的伪分区，用来区分 DFC 的结构约束是否真的改变了特征几何。
summary.experiments: 实验结果的核心是“DFC 能定位强 RL 特征，但不是完整的能力容器”。在 48 个变体的扫参中，把 RL 模型激活经过 crosscoder encode-decode 后，tool correctness 平均提升 +31.1±9.7 个百分点；把 base 模型激活经过 jointly-trained crosscoder，也能在没有微调的情况下被动转移 +6.8 个百分点工具调用正确率。这说明字典和解码路径中包含了可迁移的工具调用结构。DFC 的 A-exclusive 分区确实聚集了强模型特异性特征；但当对 exclusive 分区加惩罚时，RL 模型重构保真度下降，说明这些特征更像 filter，而不是完全吸收能力差异的 sink。最显著的行为控制结果是：只 steering 一个 A-exclusive 特征，就能带来 +65.0 个百分点的 tool-correctness 变化，并且在多数被探测层上泛化。几何分析显示，在 DFC 中 A-exclusive 特征形成可分离的 “Tool Interaction” 区域，区别于 shared 和 B-exclusive 特征；而同等规模的普通 CrossCoder 伪分区没有同样清晰的结构。评测使用 ToolRL held-out prompts：每个 sweep variant 100 条，每个 steering cell 40 条，greedy decoding，max_new_tokens=200，max_length=2048。指标包括 format_accuracy、tool_correctness 和取值为 {-1,0,+1,+2} 的 overall_score。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读，预计 60 到 90 分钟。先看 Methodology，尤其是 DFC 分区、gradient masking、top-k 稀疏编码和 exclusive penalty 的定义；这些决定了后面“特征是否独占”的可信度。然后看 Feature Space Analysis，重点是 mass-ratio 伪分区对照，它回答了 DFC 的几何分离是不是架构约束带来的。接着看 Sec. 5 的 reconstruction、spillover 和 exclusive penalty 消融，这是判断 DFC 是 filter 还是 sink 的核心证据。最后看 Sec. 6 的单特征 steering，关注实验是否只改变工具调用格式，还是也改善了工具名选择。读时要特别留意三个限制：评测 prompt 数量较小；工具调用任务较窄；crosscoder 本身可能引入能力转移路径，因此“单特征定位”不等于该能力在原模型中只由一个神经元实现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how RL fine-tuning writes tool-use behavior into a language model’s internal representations. More precisely, it asks whether the capability difference between a base model and an RL-tuned tool-use model can be isolated into a small set of crosscoder features, whether those features fully carry the capability or only filter it, and whether they can be used for behavioral control without retraining.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong mechanistic study for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It moves the analysis of RL-induced agentic behavior from surface metrics to residual-stream features. The main implication is that post-training can create model-specific directions that are localizable and steerable. This matters for continual training, capability preservation, model diffing, model merging, safety switches, and runtime control. The result should be read with scope in mind: it is demonstrated on Qwen2.5-3B, a ToolRL-style tool-calling task, limited held-out evaluation, and a specific crosscoder setup. It does not imply that all RL-induced capabilities reduce to a single feature.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares two models with the same architecture: Model B is Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B, and Model A is chengq9/ToolRL-Qwen2.5-3B, an RL-tuned model for structured <tool_call> generation. The architecture has d=2048 residual width and 36 layers. The authors train Dedicated Feature Crosscoders on post-MLP residual-stream activations from both models. A DFC encodes both models into a sparse dictionary and decodes back into the two residual streams, but the dictionary is explicitly partitioned into A-exclusive, B-exclusive, and shared features. Gradient masking enforces the exclusive partitions. Training uses 40,000 FineWeb samples and 40,000 ToolRL instruction-output pairs. The paper evaluates 48 crosscoder variants, sweeping architecture, dictionary size, top-k sparsity, exclusive share, and the exclusive penalty λ_excl. Tool-related features are ranked by Cohen’s d between tool-use and general-text activations, with firing-rate filters of at least 0.3 on tool prompts and at most 0.1 on general text. Steering is then performed by adding selected A-exclusive decoder directions into Model A’s residual stream with coefficient α. A mass-ratio analysis is used to construct matched proxy partitions for a standard CrossCoder, providing a control for whether the DFC geometry is merely a labeling artifact.
summary_en.experiments: The main result is that DFCs localize strong RL-specific tool-use features, but the exclusive partition is a filter rather than a complete sink for the capability. Across the 48-variant sweep, encode-decode reconstruction improves the RL model’s tool correctness by +31.1±9.7 percentage points. Passing base-model activations through the jointly trained crosscoder passively transfers +6.8 percentage points of tool correctness without fine-tuning. Penalizing the exclusive partition degrades RL-model fidelity, indicating that the exclusive features carry important model-specific signal but do not fully isolate the capability difference. The strongest behavioral result is that steering a single A-exclusive feature yields a +65.0 percentage-point change in tool correctness and generalizes across most probed layers. The geometry analysis shows that DFC A-exclusive features occupy a separable “Tool Interaction” region, unlike a matched standard CrossCoder proxy partition. Evaluation uses 100 held-out ToolRL prompts per sweep variant and 40 prompts per steering cell, with greedy decoding, max_new_tokens=200, and max_length=2048. Metrics include format accuracy, tool correctness, and an overall score in {-1, 0, +1, +2}.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this paper carefully, around 60 to 90 minutes. Start with the methodology: the DFC partition, gradient masking, top-k sparse coding, and exclusive penalty define what can and cannot be claimed about feature exclusivity. Then read the feature-space analysis, especially the mass-ratio control against a standard CrossCoder. The reconstruction, spillover, and exclusive-penalty ablations in Section 5 are the main evidence for the filter-versus-sink interpretation. The single-feature steering section is the most interesting behavior-control result; check whether the intervention improves valid tool selection or only pushes the model toward tool-call formatting. Keep three limitations in view: the held-out prompt counts are small, the task is narrow, and the crosscoder itself can introduce transfer pathways, so identifying one effective steering feature is not the same as proving that the original model stores the capability in one neuron.

recommendation.zh: 把“RL 改了哪些表征”落到可干预特征上，值得立刻复现；重点看 spillover 设定是否干净、是否只是提示格式迁移。
recommendation.en: It pins RL-induced changes to intervenable features—worth reproducing; scrutinize whether the spillover setup is clean or just prompt/format transfer.

paper.title: LMs as Task-Specific Knowledge Bases: An Interpretability Analysis
paper.abstract: Language models (LMs) capture large amounts of factual knowledge applicable to a wide range of tasks, motivating the view of their parameters as a knowledge base. An important property of knowledge bases is that different queries for the same fact return consistent results, drawing on a single source of truth. We investigate whether LMs satisfy this property through behavioral and mechanistic analyses. Our results suggest that they encode knowledge in a task-specific manner. Behaviorally, facts

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的问题很直接：语言模型参数里的“知识”是否像知识库那样具有 task-invariant 的单一事实表示。也就是，同一个事实被不同任务形式查询时，模型是否调用同一份内部存储。作者用行为分析和机制分析给出的答案是否定的：同一事实往往以任务相关的方式被编码，知识与任务格式在参数空间里纠缠，而不是干净地共享一个 source of truth。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发不在于提出新训练方法，而在于修正一个常被默认接受的认知：把 LM 参数直接类比成统一知识库。这个结论会影响几个方向。第一，知识编辑、遗忘、数据删除这类 post-train 干预，可能只改掉某一种任务形式下的表现，别的格式仍然保留。第二，单任务 factual eval 可能严重低估或误判模型实际掌握的知识。第三，CoT 为什么有时能“找回”直接问答拿不到的知识，可能不是因为纯推理增强，而是激活了别的任务路径上的参数编码。对预训练侧来说，这提示训练目标和任务格式会塑造知识的内部组织方式，而不是只影响输出接口。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是行为层面的 co-emergence 分析。作者在 OLMo-3-7B IT 的训练 checkpoints 上追踪单个事实在不同任务上的“出现步数” E(f,t)。如果知识是任务无关共享存储，那么当模型已经具备相关任务能力后，一个事实一旦在某个任务上学会，应该会在其他任务上近乎同步出现。作者用 5 类关系数据、共 230 个事实，每个事实用 6 种任务形式 probing：Completion、FiTB、OpenQA、MCQA、Neg-MCQA、Verification，并为每个 dataset-task 设计 10 个 prompt paraphrase。判别类任务还做了选项轮换或真假配对，尽量减少模板偶然性。结果显示事实在不同任务上的 emergence 并不同步，且差异具有系统性。

第二部分是机制层面的参数定位。作者基于 Bayazit 等人的 localization 框架，为每个 (fact, task) 对寻找一小组稀疏参数：移除这些参数后，该事实在该任务上的表现明显下降，但对同任务其他事实、或同事实其他任务影响较小。如果知识是 task-invariant 的，就不应能稳定找到这种 task-specific 的参数子集。论文在三个模型、五个关系数据集上都找到了这类局部子网络，说明同一事实的不同任务调用路径在参数上可以部分分离。

在此基础上，作者又定义了 separability 指标来量化不同 (fact, task) 编码之间的重叠程度，并比较不同任务类型。一个重要发现是判别任务，尤其 MCQA 一类，更容易与其他编码纠缠；生成任务如 FiTB、Completion 的编码更可分离。另一个发现是通过生成任务学到的事实更容易在其他任务上共同出现，反过来则不成立。最后，作者把这个分析延伸到 CoT：当移除某任务自身的局部编码后，CoT 能恢复相当一部分性能；但当移除其他任务的编码时，CoT 比 direct answering 掉得更多。这说明 CoT 部分依赖跨任务的替代性知识路径。
summary.experiments:
实验设置相当扎实。行为分析基于 OLMo-3-7B IT 的训练过程，覆盖 230 个事实、5 种关系、6 类任务、每类 10 个 paraphrase。作者不是只看最终准确率，而是跟踪每个事实在不同任务上的 emergence step，这比静态评测更能说明知识形成过程。主要结果是：事实跨任务共同出现的比例有限，很多事实先在某一种任务格式上出现，之后很久才在别的格式上稳定可用，甚至始终不转移。

机制分析覆盖三个模型和五个关系数据集。作者能为大量 (fact, task) 对定位到稀疏参数子集，并验证这些子集具有选择性：删掉后主要伤害目标 pair，而不是普遍伤害整个 relation 或整个 task。论文还报告了 separability 的任务差异：MCQA、Verification 这类判别任务更 entangled，FiTB、Completion 这类生成任务更 separable。关于 CoT，关键结果是它对“其他任务编码”的依赖更强：移除非当前任务的局部编码时，CoT 的性能下降幅度超过 direct answer，支持了“CoT 会调动额外参数路径”的解释。

当前给出的全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不适合编造具体百分比或 drop 数字。精读时建议重点核对：1）co-emergence 的定义阈值和稳健性；2）localization 的稀疏度、优化目标与对照实验；3）不同模型间结论是否一致；4）prompt paraphrase 与选项轮换是否足以排除模板偏置；5）CoT 恢复效应在不同关系和任务上是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住方法细节。先看 Introduction，明确作者挑战的是“LM 参数像统一知识库”这个类比。然后直接看行为实验部分，重点理解 emergence step、co-emergence 假设和 6 类任务设计。接着看 mechanistic localization 的定义与验证方式，这是全文最有信息量的部分。最后看 CoT 分析，因为它把 interpretability 结果和推理现象联系了起来。

如果时间有限，优先看四处：任务与数据构造图、co-emergence 主图、localization 结果图、CoT 消融图。预计 30 分钟能完成一次有效泛读。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 task-specific encoding 到底反映预训练目标差异，还是 instruction tuning / evaluation format 放大的结果；二是这种碎片化知识表示对知识编辑、unlearning、continual pretrain 会带来什么约束。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether factual knowledge in language models is stored in a task-invariant way, as the common “LM-as-knowledge-base” analogy would suggest. If a fact is truly represented as a single internal source of truth, then different query formats should retrieve the same underlying representation. The paper argues this is not how current LMs work. Instead, the same fact is often encoded in a task-specific manner, with knowledge and task format intertwined in parameter space.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is conceptual but practically relevant. It challenges a simplifying assumption that often sits behind factual evaluation, model editing, and unlearning work: that a fact lives in one place and different prompts merely access it differently. If knowledge is task-specific, then editing a fact in one format may leave other formats intact, single-task factual benchmarks may give a partial picture, and some of the apparent benefit of chain-of-thought may come from activating alternative task-linked encodings rather than from pure reasoning. For pretraining research, the implication is that training objectives and task formats shape how knowledge is internally organized, not just how it is expressed at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper combines a behavioral analysis with a mechanistic one. In the behavioral part, the authors track fact acquisition across training checkpoints of OLMo-3-7B IT. They define an emergence step E(f, t) for each fact-task pair and test whether facts co-emerge across tasks. Under a task-invariant storage hypothesis, once the model has the competence to perform multiple tasks, learning a fact on one task should coincide with learning it on the others. The evaluation uses five relational datasets, 230 facts in total, and six task formats: next-token completion, fill-in-the-blank, open-ended QA, multiple-choice QA, negative multiple-choice QA, and binary verification. Each dataset-task pair is probed with 10 paraphrases, and discrimination tasks are further expanded by answer-position rotation or true/false pairing to reduce prompt artifacts.

The mechanistic part adapts a parameter localization framework from prior work. For each (fact, task) pair, the authors search for a sparse parameter subset whose removal selectively degrades performance on that pair while minimally affecting other facts on the same task or the same fact on other tasks. If factual knowledge were task-invariant, such selective localization should be difficult or impossible. Instead, the paper finds that these sparse, pair-specific parameter subsets can be identified consistently across three models and five relational datasets.

The analysis is then extended in two ways. First, the authors define separability metrics to quantify how isolated a given (fact, task) encoding is from others. They find that discrimination tasks such as MCQA are more entangled, while generation tasks such as fill-in-the-blank are more separable. Second, they study chain-of-thought. After ablating localized encodings, CoT can recover much of the loss caused by removing a task's own encoding, but it suffers more than direct answering when encodings from other tasks are removed. This suggests CoT partly works by recruiting alternative task-linked knowledge pathways.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is stronger than a simple final-checkpoint probe. The behavioral analysis follows OLMo-3-7B IT across training, over 230 facts, five relations, six task formats, and 10 paraphrases per dataset-task pair. The key result is that factual knowledge does not reliably co-emerge across tasks. Many facts appear first in one format and only later in others, and some show weak transfer altogether. This is evidence against a single task-invariant parametric store.

The mechanistic analysis spans three models and five relational datasets. For many (fact, task) pairs, the authors can localize sparse parameter subsets with selective causal impact: ablating them hurts the target pair much more than neighboring facts or neighboring tasks. This supports the claim that the same fact can be implemented by partially distinct parameter circuitry depending on task format. The separability analysis further shows systematic task differences: MCQA and verification are more entangled, while completion and fill-in-the-blank are more separable. In the CoT experiments, the important finding is asymmetry: CoT is more robust when a task's own encoding is removed, but more fragile when other-task encodings are removed, indicating heavier reliance on cross-task representations.

The excerpt provided here does not include the full numerical tables, so exact percentages or drops should be checked in the paper itself. The most important details to verify are the emergence thresholding, the sparsity and optimization procedure used for localization, robustness across models, and whether the paraphrase/rotation controls are sufficient to rule out template artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim paper, but the method details matter. Start with the introduction to see exactly which assumption is being challenged. Then read the behavioral section carefully, especially the definition of emergence step and the logic behind co-emergence. After that, go to the localization section; this is the most informative part of the paper because it turns a behavioral observation into a mechanistic claim. Finish with the CoT section, which connects the interpretability result to a familiar reasoning phenomenon.

If time is limited, focus on four items: the task/data construction figure, the main co-emergence plot, the localization results, and the CoT ablation figure. A solid first pass should take around 30 minutes. The deeper questions worth pursuing are whether the observed task-specificity mainly reflects pretraining representations or is amplified by instruction tuning and evaluation format, and what this fragmentation implies for editing, unlearning, and continual pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“参数即统一知识库”的直觉，值得读；先看行为不共现和参数定位两组结果，若成立，会影响你对 data mixture 与 eval 解释的 prior。
recommendation.en: This one should weaken the 'parameters as a unified KB' intuition; read the cross-task non-co-emergence and parameter-localization results first, because they matter for how you interpret data mixture and eval.

institutions: Blavatnik School of Computer Science and AI, Tel Aviv University

paper.title: At the Edge of Understanding: Sparse Autoencoders Trace The Limits of Transformer Generalization
paper.abstract: Pre-trained transformers have demonstrated remarkable generalization abilities, at times extending beyond the scope of their training data. Yet, real-world deployments often face unexpected or adversarial data that diverges from training data distributions. Without explicit mechanisms for handling such shifts, model reliability and safety degrade, urging more disciplined study of out-of-distribution (OOD) settings for transformers. By systematic experiments, we present a mechanistic framework fo

summary.core_problem: 如何利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从机制层面理解和量化 Transformer 模型在面对分布外（OOD）输入（如拼写错误、越狱提示）时的泛化边界和内部表征变化？
summary.importance: 为理解 LLM 的鲁棒性和安全性提供了一个基于内部表征的微观视角。通过 SAE 将 OOD 概念具象化为内部激活特征的变化，不仅能解释模型为何在异常输入下失效，还能利用这些内部信号进行数据筛选和模型微调，对提升模型在真实复杂环境下的可靠性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将 SAE 作为“显微镜”观察 LLM 内部残差流的激活状态。核心发现是，当 LLM 遇到 OOD 输入时，其内部会激活更多虚假（spurious）概念，导致重建误差增加或所需激活的特征数量增加。作者通过在 TinyStories 数据集上引入字符级拼写错误构建受控的 OOD 环境，并在 Llama 3.1 8B 上测试真实的越狱提示，验证了 SAE 能够有效标记这些 OOD 事件，并进一步利用这些 SAE 衍生的指标指导微调和防御越狱攻击。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-2（25M，字符级分词）和 Llama 3.1 8B 上进行了实验。在受控的拼写错误实验中，SAE 能够清晰地捕捉到 OOD 输入导致的内部特征激活异常。在 Llama 3.1 8B 上，微小的提示分布偏移会导致基准测试性能下降，而利用 SAE 信号筛选数据进行微调可以改善性能。此外，SAE 能够将成功的越狱尝试标记为 OOD 异常，通过对齐这些敏感方向，可以增强模型对越狱攻击的防御能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methods 部分关于如何利用 SAE 定义和量化内部 OOD 事件的逻辑，以及 Section 6 中利用 SAE 信号防御越狱攻击的实际应用案例。这展示了可解释性工具在安全防御上的潜力。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How to use Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to mechanistically understand and quantify the generalization limits and internal representation shifts of Transformer models when facing out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs like typos or jailbreak prompts?
summary_en.importance: Provides a microscopic perspective based on internal representations for understanding LLM robustness and safety. By materializing OOD concepts as changes in internal activation features via SAEs, it not only explains why models fail under anomalous inputs but also leverages these internal signals for data filtering and model fine-tuning, offering direct inspiration for improving model reliability in complex real-world environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Repurposes SAEs as a 'microscope' to observe the activation states of the LLM's internal residual stream. The core finding is that when an LLM encounters OOD inputs, it infers more spurious concepts internally, leading to increased reconstruction error or a higher number of activated features. The authors construct a controlled OOD environment by introducing character-level typos on the TinyStories dataset and test real jailbreak prompts on Llama 3.1 8B, verifying that SAEs can effectively flag these OOD events. They further utilize these SAE-derived metrics to guide fine-tuning and defend against jailbreak attacks.
summary_en.experiments: Conducted on GPT-2 (25M, character-level tokenization) and Llama 3.1 8B. In controlled typo experiments, SAEs clearly capture internal feature activation anomalies caused by OOD inputs. On Llama 3.1 8B, minor prompt distribution shifts lead to performance drops on benchmarks, while fine-tuning with data filtered by SAE signals improves performance. Furthermore, SAEs can flag successful jailbreak attempts as OOD exceptions, and aligning these sensitive directions enhances the model's defense against such attacks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methods section regarding the logic of defining and quantifying internal OOD events using SAEs, and Section 6 for the practical application of using SAE signals to defend against jailbreak attacks. This demonstrates the potential of interpretability tools in safety defense. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SAE做OOD检测的思路值得看方法节，但“谬误概念”定义偏模糊，提升幅度与具体模型未披露，先看SAE激活统计和§4/5的可视化再决定是否跟进。
recommendation.en: The SAE-based OOD-detection angle is worth a methods pass, but the “fallacious concept” notion is fuzzy and gains/model scale are not disclosed; skim the SAE activation stats and §4/5 visuals before committing.

paper.title: Where Do Models Find Happiness? Emotion Vectors in Open-Source LLMs
paper.abstract: Recent work identified emotion vectors in Claude Sonnet 4.5, which are internal representations that encode emotion concepts, causally influence behavior, and exhibit geometry mirroring human psychological structure. We test the generality of these findings in two open-weight models, Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, extracting emotion contrast vectors across all layers, using two model-generated corpora. We recover valence geometry for both models, with peak PC1--valence correlations

summary.core_problem: 检验“情绪向量”是否只存在于 Claude Sonnet 4.5，还是也能在开源指令模型中被稳定抽取并影响表征几何。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可复现实证。它把闭源模型上的情绪表征发现迁移到开放权重模型，并观察到不同模型在层深上的表征形成路径并不一致。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 和 Gemma-4-E4B-it 上，基于两个模型生成语料构造 emotion contrast vectors，逐层抽取情绪方向，并用心理学中的 valence、arousal 维度分析这些方向的几何结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个开源指令模型和两套生成语料。两者都恢复出 valence 几何，PC1 与 valence 的最高相关系数分别为 r=0.76 和 r=0.83，接近 Claude 上报告的 r=0.81。层深分析显示 Gemma 早层强编码 valence、后层衰减，Apertus 则早层缺失、中层以后出现；arousal 编码对抽取语料更敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether emotion vectors reported in Claude Sonnet 4.5 also appear in open-weight instruction models with similar representational geometry.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic replication and comparison study. Its useful contribution is not a new training method, but evidence about how affective concepts are represented differently across model families and depths.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extract emotion contrast vectors across layers in Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, using two model-generated corpora, then analyze whether the resulting directions align with psychological dimensions such as valence and arousal.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates two open-weight instruction models. Both recover a valence geometry, with peak PC1-valence correlations of r=0.76 and r=0.83, close to the r=0.81 reported for Claude. The depth profiles differ: Gemma encodes valence strongly in early layers and loses it later, while Apertus shows the opposite pattern; arousal is more corpus-sensitive.

recommendation.zh: 作为机制备查即可；层深差异比“情绪向量存在”更有信息量，但 setup 还不足以推到训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Keep it as mechanism background; the depth-profile mismatch is more useful than the replication, but it is not yet actionable for pretraining.

paper.title: Perfect Detection, Failed Control: The Geometry of Knowing vs. Steering in Language Models
paper.abstract: A central aspiration of mechanistic interpretability is controllability: if we know where a behavior is represented in a model's activations, we should be able to modify it. This rests on a hidden premise -- that the direction which detects a behavior and the direction which controls it are the same, or close. We test this geometrically: what is the angle between the direction that best detects a behavior and the one that best causes it? If detection implies control the cosine is near 1; otherwi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作检验了一个在机制可解释性里常被默认接受的前提：如果某个行为能被线性方向稳定检测出来，那么沿着这个方向做激活干预，是否也应当能控制该行为。作者把问题写成几何量：行为检测方向与行为控制方向之间的夹角。如果两者接近同一轴，说明“知道在哪里”基本等于“能拨动它”；如果接近正交，则说明表征与因果控制是分离的。全文的关键发现是，这个前提只对一类表层行为成立，例如输出格式；对 hallucination 这类与知识状态、拒答策略、token 复制机制纠缠在一起的行为并不成立。模型从很早层就能完美线性分辨真假实体，但这个检测方向几乎不能直接把模型推向拒答。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它给“表征是否等于可控机制”这个问题加了一个很硬的约束。结果显示，预训练阶段已经形成了稳定的几何分离：真假实体的可检测信号与拒答控制信号在多个模型、不同规模、base 与 instruct 版本之间都保持很小的余弦相似度，Gemma 2-2B base 与 instruct 几乎相同（0.1197 vs 0.1200）。这说明很多后训练里看到的拒答或诚实行为，不应简单理解为把已有知识方向直接放大，而更像是在已有知识表征之外，额外学出一条策略性控制通路。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这个结论很重要：线性 probe 能读出知识，不代表这个知识已经处在可被低成本 steering 的因果坐标系里。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上有三个层次。第一层是方向构造。检测方向既用 data-driven 的 difference-in-means 从两类激活差中构造，也用 hand-picked token 的 lm_head 行向量构造；控制方向则主要从 refusal 相关 token 的 lm_head 读出。第二层是因果检验。作者在推理时通过 forward hook 把方向加到 residual stream，逐层测试行为是否改变，而不是只做 probe 分类。第三层是几何与机制分析。对格式任务，检测与控制几乎塌缩到同一轴；对 hallucination，检测方向与干预方向余弦只有约 0.12，约等于 83°。作者还专门排除了“检测方向构造方式有偏”的解释：即便完全不依赖手工 token、只从激活构造检测器，和控制方向仍然不对齐，余弦甚至到 -0.06。更有意思的是，作者指出静态角度本身不是 steerability 预测器。原因不是噪声，而是检测并非单一方向，而是一个高维等价类；真正区分可控与不可控行为的，是控制方向能否同时充当有效检测器，这是一种功能性质，不是单个角度能读出来的。机制解释上，作者把 hallucination 的失配追到输出映射附近：模型里存在一个强的实体名复制机制，它在输出端压过了 epistemic signal，所以沿检测方向加激活，常常会强化“继续说出那个显著名字”，反而更容易编造，而不是拒答。为缓解这一点，作者尝试把检测方向朝控制方向旋转 15°，得到一个折中方向，部分恢复拒答能力。
summary.experiments: 实验主体在 Gemma 2-2B-it 上完成，模型有 26 层、residual 维度 2304，全部是 inference-time 分析，无微调训练。两个任务形成鲜明对照。格式任务里，检测和控制基本一致，说明某些表层行为确实接近单轴控制。hallucination 任务里，真假实体从第 5 层起就达到 AUC=1.000 的完美线性可分，但检测方向与 refusal 干预方向的余弦只有 0.12 左右。作者还做了第二种检测器，不依赖手工选 token，而是直接从激活构造，结果与控制方向余弦为 -0.06，进一步说明失配不是构造伪影。泛化方面，作者在四个模型上复现了这一 gap：Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct、Gemma 2-9B-it、Gemma 2-2B base / instruct，规模覆盖 1B 到 9B，余弦稳定落在 [0.12, 0.20]。最有信息量的一组结果是 Gemma 2-2B base 与 instruct 的对比，几乎完全相同，支持“几何结构来自预训练而非指令微调”。修复实验里，把方向从检测轴向干预轴旋转 15°，在 held-out stress test 上把两类未见实体的拒答率分别拉到 73% 和 60%，同时假阳性只有 1.8%（N=115）。这说明 gap 不是绝对不可桥接，但桥接需要显式寻找兼顾检测与控制的方向，而不是直接拿 probe 向量当控制旋钮。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓三个点。第一，看引言和方法部分对 detection direction、intervention direction、cosine gap 的定义，弄清作者到底在比较什么，避免把 probe 准确率误当成可控性。第二，重点看 hallucination 的主实验图表：线性可分几乎完美，但加方向后行为不按预期变化，这一组结果是全文支点。第三，看后面关于“cosine 不是 steerability oracle”的负结果，以及 double dissociation 的讨论，这部分把文章从一个现象报告提升成了更稳的判断。若只打算花 20 到 30 分钟，建议读引言、Section 2 的方向构造与干预设置、Section 4 的 hallucination 主结果、Section 7 的跨模型验证、Section 8 的负结论。若想深一点，值得细看 Section 5 对输出映射和 entity-copying 机制的解释，以及 Section 6 的 15° rotation 修复实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者署名为 Cosimo Galeone、Anna Ettorre、Minsu Park、Giuseppe Ettorre、Daniele Ligorio；邮箱域名均为 alomana.com。公开文本里未见更明确的机构背景说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a hidden assumption behind a large fraction of activation-based interpretability work: if a behavior is linearly detectable in the residual stream, then the same direction, or a nearby one, should also be able to causally steer that behavior. The authors turn this into a geometric question by measuring the angle between a detection direction and an intervention direction. The main result is that this assumption only holds for some surface behaviors, such as output formatting, but breaks for hallucination. In hallucination settings, the model can linearly separate real vs non-existent entities extremely early and almost perfectly, yet that signal is nearly orthogonal to the direction that actually induces refusal.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for pretraining research because it separates representational availability from controllable mechanism. The gap is stable across model families, scales, and even before vs after instruction tuning. The Gemma 2-2B base and instruct models show almost identical cosine values (0.1197 vs 0.1200), which strongly suggests that the geometry is already laid down during pretraining. That has a concrete implication for the pretrain/post-train interface: a probe can read out knowledge from pretrained activations, but that does not mean the pretrained model has organized that knowledge along a low-cost causal control axis. Post-training may be adding a policy channel on top of knowledge representations rather than simply amplifying an existing “truth direction.”
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three pieces. First, the paper constructs behavior directions in two ways: data-driven difference-in-means directions from activations, and hand-picked directions from lm_head rows associated with behavior-specific tokens. Detection is built both ways; intervention, especially refusal, is mainly derived from lm_head token directions. Second, the authors do causal testing rather than stopping at probing. They inject directions into the residual stream with forward hooks and measure behavioral changes layer by layer at inference time. Third, they analyze the geometry and the mechanism behind the mismatch. For formatting, detection and control collapse onto essentially the same axis. For hallucination, the cosine between detection and intervention is only about 0.12, roughly an 83-degree separation. They also rule out a construction artifact: even a detector built purely from activations, without hand-chosen tokens, remains misaligned with control, with cosine around -0.06. A key conceptual point appears later in the paper: cosine is not a steerability oracle. Detection is not a single privileged vector but a high-dimensional equivalence class, while steerability is functional. What matters is whether the control direction also serves as a detector, not whether one static angle is large. Mechanistically, the paper traces the hallucination mismatch to the output mapping, where an entity-copying pathway dominates the epistemic signal. As a result, pushing along the detection direction can strengthen name completion and make fabrication worse instead of triggering refusal. The authors then try a partial fix by rotating the detection direction 15 degrees toward the intervention direction.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are run on Gemma 2-2B-it, a 26-layer model with 2304-dimensional residual stream, using inference-time hooks only and no fine-tuning. Two behaviors are contrasted. For output format, detection and control are effectively aligned, which supports the single-axis story for some shallow behaviors. For hallucination, real vs fake entities become perfectly linearly separable from layer 5 onward, with AUC = 1.000, yet the cosine between the detection direction and the refusal intervention direction is only about 0.12. A second detector built directly from activations, without hand-picked tokens, gives cosine = -0.06 against the intervention direction, reinforcing that the gap is not an artifact of direction construction. The cross-model study includes Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct, Gemma 2-9B-it, and Gemma 2-2B base/instruct, spanning 1B to 9B parameters. The cosine stays in the narrow range [0.12, 0.20]. The base vs instruct comparison on Gemma 2-2B is especially informative because the values are nearly identical, pointing to a pretraining origin. In the repair experiment, rotating 15 degrees from the detection direction toward the intervention direction raises refusal rates to 73% and 60% on two held-out entity categories, with only 1.8% false positives on N=115 examples. That result suggests the gap is bridgeable to some extent, but only after explicitly searching for a compromise direction rather than reusing a probe vector as a control knob.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the setup that defines detection directions, intervention directions, and the cosine gap; otherwise it is easy to confuse probe accuracy with controllability. Second, look closely at the main hallucination results: near-perfect linear separability coexisting with failed steering is the central empirical point. Third, read the later section showing that cosine is not a generic steerability predictor. That negative result is what makes the paper more than a one-off case study. A practical reading path is: introduction, the method section on direction construction and activation addition, the main hallucination section, the cross-model validation, and the section on why cosine fails as an oracle. If there is extra time, the most useful deeper read is the mechanism analysis around output mapping and entity copying, plus the 15-degree rotation experiment.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors: Cosimo Galeone, Anna Ettorre, Minsu Park, Giuseppe Ettorre, Daniele Ligorio. The visible contact emails use the alomana.com domain. No clearer institutional affiliation is established from the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 读几何定义和 hallucination 实验；单模型证据还薄，但它会改变“linear probe 可直接拿来 steering”的默认用法。
recommendation.en: Read the geometric definition and hallucination experiment; the evidence is narrow, but it weakens the default move from linear probes to steering vectors.

paper.title: Structuring Sparsity: Block-Sparse Featurizers Capture Visual Concept Manifolds
paper.abstract: What is the geometry of a visual percept? The most widely used protocols for decomposing neural network representations into interpretable parts treat concepts as isolated directions, yet recent work shows that concepts are often realized as geometric structures in low dimensional regions of activation space. We turn to the literature of Structured sparsity to close this gap, and show that block sparsity, which groups directions into blocks, is the prior matched to a generative model in which a

summary.core_problem: 研究视觉模型表征中的概念是否应被解释为单一方向，还是由低维子空间/流形中的一组方向共同表示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和可解释性方法。它挑战方向级 featurizer 的默认解释粒度，提出 block sparsity 更匹配“概念是低维流形”的生成假设。对 LLM 机制解释有间接参考价值，尤其是 SAE 特征是否过度一维化的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文引入三种 block-sparse featurizers，将特征方向按 block 分组，而不是把每个概念压成单一方向。它用 minimum-description-length 分析比较 block-sparse 表征和方向式 featurizer 的压缩性，并把视觉概念解释为少量低维 manifold 的稀疏组合。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示三种 BSF 都比方向式 featurizer 更紧凑地描述激活，恢复出的概念通常是 2 到 4 维。未给出具体模型、数据集、层位置或数值表格信息。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Harvard University、Stanford University、Brown University 等机构；Lee Sharkey 参与，和稀疏特征/机制解释方向相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether visual concepts in neural representations should be interpreted as single directions or as coordinated low-dimensional subspaces and manifolds.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic-interpretability contribution. It questions the default direction-level granularity of featurizers and argues that block sparsity better matches a generative model where concepts are low-dimensional manifolds. For LLM researchers, the relevance is indirect but useful for thinking about whether SAE features are overly one-dimensional.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce three block-sparse featurizers that group directions into blocks rather than mapping each concept to a single direction. They use a minimum-description-length analysis to compare block-sparse representations against direction-based featurizers, modeling visual representations as sparse sums of low-dimensional manifolds.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that all three BSF variants describe activations more compactly than direction-based featurizers, with recovered concepts typically being two- to four-dimensional. The provided text does not specify model families, datasets, layers, or exact numerical results.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Harvard University, Stanford University, and Brown University. Lee Sharkey is associated with sparse-feature and mechanistic-interpretability work.

recommendation.zh: LLM 方向只需读 MDL 分析和 2-4 维概念结论；它会提醒你别把 SAE 单特征解释得太实。
recommendation.en: For LLM work, read the MDL analysis and the 2–4D concept result; it is a useful warning against over-literal single-feature SAE interpretations.

paper.title: Steering Vision-Language Models with Joint Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have shown promise for analyzing language models, but applying them to vision-language models (VLMs) often yields representations that are difficult to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions. We introduce the Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE), which uses an explicit alignment constraint to jointly factorize sequence-pooled vision and language activations into shared, interpretable image/caption-level features. Applied to LLaVA, JSAE recovers cross-modal feat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决 VLM 机制分析里一个常见问题：普通 SAE 在视觉-语言联合表征上学到的特征往往不够可控，难以作为稳定的跨模态 steering 方向使用。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是机制分析方法改进，而不是预训练方法本身。它把 SAE 从单模态 LM 分析扩展到 VLM，并强调“共享、可解释、可干预”的图像/文本级特征分解，这对理解 VLM 内部对齐和层间可控性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 Joint Sparse Autoencoder（JSAE），在对视觉和语言激活做联合稀疏分解时加入显式对齐约束，使 sequence-pooled 的视觉与文本激活被映射到共享特征空间。随后用这些特征做双向干预：一类是 additive steering，向特征方向加偏置；另一类是 suppression，抑制对应特征，观察输出变化，并比较不同层的干预敏感性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 VLM：LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B、Llama3-LLaVA-8B 和 Qwen3-VL-30B。论文声称 JSAE 能恢复出食物、动物等可识别跨模态概念，并观察到层依赖的不对称性：additive steering 在中后层、接近输出前的层效果最好，而 suppression 在各层的分数相对更平，至少在统计噪声范围内没有明显峰值。摘要未给出更细的定量增益，因此更适合作为现象性结果看待。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a recurring issue in VLM interpretability: standard SAEs often produce features that are hard to use as controllable cross-modal steering directions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanistic-interpretability contribution rather than a pretraining one. It extends SAE-style analysis from language models to VLMs and focuses on shared, interpretable, intervention-ready image/text-level features, which is mildly useful for understanding internal alignment in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces a Joint Sparse Autoencoder (JSAE) with an explicit alignment constraint, jointly factorizing sequence-pooled vision and language activations into a shared sparse feature space. These learned features are then used for bidirectional interventions: additive steering and feature suppression, with layerwise sensitivity analyzed across the model stack.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on three VLMs: LLaVA-v1.6-Mistral-7B, Llama3-LLaVA-8B, and Qwen3-VL-30B. The paper reports that JSAE recovers recognizable cross-modal concepts such as food and animals, and finds a layer-dependent asymmetry: additive steering peaks in mid-to-late pre-output layers, while suppression remains relatively flat across layers within statistical noise. The abstract does not provide strong quantitative gains, so the result is more diagnostic than decisive.

recommendation.zh: 更像 VLM 可解释性的小步推进，不改 pretrain prior；只看层间干预不对称这个现象，若你在做 steering 或 SAE 才值得翻正文。
recommendation.en: This is a modest VLM interpretability paper, not a pretraining update; only the layerwise asymmetry in steering vs suppression is worth checking if you work on SAE or activation steering.

paper.title: Factual Retrieval in LLMs Is a Redundant, Distributed and Non-Contiguous Process
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) store and recall factual knowledge, yet the precise mechanism of how entity representations are transformed to enable specific attribute retrieval remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate this mechanism through the lens of an "attribute-computation path"-a sequence of computational steps over the entity representation required to elicit a target attribute. We then propose an iterative patching protocol to identify a minimal subset of layers necessary for t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：LLM 在做事实检索时，实体表示如何沿着网络内部被逐步变换，最终产出目标属性，这条“属性计算路径”到底是不是局部、连续、可定位的。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它直接碰到知识存储与检索机制这个老问题，但给出的结论不是再做一次激活可视化，而是对“知识可被少数层或少数位置局部编辑”这个常见直觉提出修正。它属于机制分析工作，对知识编辑、事实追踪、可解释性和训练中知识分布式编码的理解都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一种迭代式 patching 协议，用来识别完成某个实体→属性检索所必需的最小层子集。核心思路是把事实检索看成一条 attribute-computation path，然后逐层或分组替换中间表示，观察目标属性是否还能被恢复。与常见只找“关键层”不同，这里强调路径可以不连续，并且同一事实可能存在多条功能等价路径，因此把知识检索建模成冗余、分布式、非连续的计算过程。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 LLaMA 3.1 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 上进行，围绕实体事实检索任务分析内部路径结构。论文报告的核心现象是：有效路径经常跳过若干层而非连续贯通；同一实体-事实对往往存在多条可替代路径；这解释了为什么定位式知识编辑常出现“找到位置但改不干净”或“改了局部但行为仍回流”的失配。摘要未给出大规模量化提升，因为重点不是性能刷新，而是机制发现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Bar-Ilan University 和 Northeastern University。Yoav Goldberg 是 NLP 与语言模型分析方向的知名研究者，长期关注表示学习、语言建模与机制解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how an entity representation is transformed inside an LLM to retrieve a target fact, and whether this “attribute-computation path” is local, contiguous, and cleanly identifiable.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not another attribution plot, but a concrete correction to the common intuition that factual retrieval can be pinned to a small contiguous region of the network. This is a mechanistic analysis paper with implications for knowledge editing, factual tracing, and how pretraining distributes knowledge across layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce an iterative patching protocol to identify the minimal subset of layers required for a given entity-to-attribute retrieval. They frame factual recall as an attribute-computation path, then patch intermediate representations to test whether the target attribute can still be recovered. Unlike prior “key layer” analyses, the method highlights non-contiguous paths and multiple functionally equivalent routes for the same fact, suggesting redundant and distributed computation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on LLaMA 3.1 8B and Qwen3 8B, focusing on factual retrieval cases. The main findings are that effective paths often skip layers rather than forming a contiguous block, and that the same entity-fact pair can be supported by multiple interchangeable paths. The paper is not about benchmark gains; its contribution is the mechanistic result and its implications for the mismatch between localization and editing.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Bar-Ilan University and Northeastern University. Yoav Goldberg is a well-known NLP researcher with long-standing work on language modeling, representation learning, and analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会削弱“知识在某几层可局部定位”的先验；若你做知识编辑或训练期事实注入，先看它的 patching 设定和失败案例，再决定是否继续相信 layer-local story。
recommendation.en: This weakens the tidy “facts live in a few layers” prior; if you work on knowledge editing or factual injection, read the patching setup and failure cases before trusting any layer-local story.

paper.title: Can LLMs Reliably Self-Report Adversarial Prefills, and How?
paper.abstract: Prior work shows that large language models (LLMs) exhibit introspective capability on benign tasks. We extend the question to safety contexts and examine how reliably a model can recognize that its own prior response was elicited by an adversarial prefill attack. Across ten open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs (3B to 70B) and four safety benchmarks, no model reliably recognizes its own compromised outputs, with models claiming intent on prefilled responses at an average rate of $27.3\%$. Introspe

summary.core_problem: LLM 在良性任务上展现出一定内省能力，但在安全场景下，模型是否能在事后识别自己上一轮输出是被对抗性 prefill 攻击诱导产生的？论文测试开源指令模型对自身被攻击输出的“自我归因/被篡改识别”可靠性，并追溯其机制来源。
summary.importance: 对基座与对齐研究的启发点很具体：模型所谓的“自我监控/内省”在安全场景下很弱，且现有可观测信号大量寄生在 refusal 方向上，而不是独立的攻击因果理解。这意味着靠 post-hoc 自我检查做安全护栏、或用 SFT/GRPO/DPO 训练模型“承认自己被攻击”，很容易只学会触发拒答相关特征，同时可能反过来提高被 prefill 攻破的概率。
summary.technical_approach: 在 10 个开源指令模型（3B–70B，覆盖 Llama、Qwen3、Gemma 3）上，用四个安全 benchmark 共 1085 个去重 prompt。首先用 AdvPrefix 生成对抗前缀，强制模型以有害内容开头续写，然后在后续轮次用两类 probe 提问：上一轮回答是不是自己“有意给出的”，以及上一轮是否被篡改。为检验机制，作者将模型权重沿 refusal direction 做正交消融，并与随机方向对照；最后用 SFT、GRPO、DPO 做针对性微调，看能否提升内省识别率。
summary.experiments: 没有模型能可靠识别被 prefill  compromise 的输出。在攻击确实改变安全行为的样本上，模型平均把 27.3% 的被 prefill 输出误认为自己有意给出；Qwen3-14B 的 control vs prefill claim rate 差距最大达到 +74.1%。模型拒认时的 CoT 主要调用 safety/refusal 类理由。对 8B–27B 模型做 refusal-direction 正交消融后，prefill 与自然输出的 claim rate gap 在所有五个消融模型上都缩小到 3% 以内；在 Gemma-3-27B 上随机方向对照不生效，而 refusal direction 消融仍能闭合 gap，说明 refusal 方向是充分中介、在大一点的模型上甚至更接近特异中介。针对内省的微调能在 intention probe 上扩大 gap，但 tampering probe 没有改善；且 8 个微调模型中有 6 个在 adversarial prefill 下的攻击成功率反而上升，Gemma-3-27B 上升最多达 +28.6%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看实验设置（多轮 probe 而非单轮 jailbreak）、refusal direction 消融结果，以及针对性微调反而提高攻击成功率这一反直觉发现。对做 safety、self-critique、activation-level 对齐的读者，方法部分关于 weight orthogonalization 的对照设计值得参考。预计阅读时间 30–50 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs show some introspective capability on benign tasks, but in safety settings it is unclear whether a model can recognize, after the fact, that its own previous response was induced by an adversarial prefill attack. The paper tests how reliably open-weight instruction-tuned models attribute compromised outputs to themselves versus external tampering, and identifies the internal mechanism behind any apparent recognition.
summary_en.importance: The main implication for base-model and alignment research is that apparent self-monitoring in safety contexts is weak and largely parasitic on the existing refusal circuit, rather than grounded in an independent causal understanding of the attack. This matters for any system that relies on post-hoc self-checks as a safety guardrail, or that uses SFT/GRPO/DPO to teach models to “notice they were attacked”: such training can easily learn to trigger refusal-related features without building real introspection, and may even increase vulnerability to prefill attacks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate ten open-weight instruction-tuned LLMs (3B–70B, covering Llama, Qwen3, and Gemma 3) on four safety benchmarks, yielding 1,085 deduplicated prompts. For each prompt, AdvPrefix generates an adversarial prefix that forces the model to continue with harmful content. In a follow-up turn, the model is probed with two questions: whether the previous response was intended, and whether the previous turn was tampered with. To test mediation, model weights are orthogonalized against the refusal direction and compared with random-direction controls. Finally, targeted finetuning with SFT, GRPO, and DPO is used to see whether introspection can be improved without degrading general capability.
summary_en.experiments: No model reliably recognizes its own compromised outputs. On prompts where prefill changes safety behavior, models on average claim 27.3% of prefilled responses as intended; Qwen3-14B shows the largest gap between control and prefill claim rates, at +74.1%. Chains of thought produced when rejecting prefilled responses are dominated by safety- and refusal-related reasoning. Refusal-direction ablation closes the claim-rate gap to within 3% of zero on all five ablated models from 8B to 27B. On Gemma-3-27B, the random-direction control leaves the gap near baseline while refusal-direction ablation still closes it, suggesting the refusal direction is sufficient and, at that scale, closer to a specific mediator. Targeted finetuning widens the intention-probe gap on every 8B–27B model, but never improves the tampering-probe gap; six of eight finetuned models show higher attack success rates under adversarial prefill after training, with the largest increase reaching +28.6% on Gemma-3-27B.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read at skim level. Focus on the multi-turn probing setup (as opposed to single-turn jailbreak evaluation), the refusal-direction ablation results, and the counterintuitive finding that targeted introspection finetuning can increase attack success. For readers working on safety, self-critique, or activation-level alignment, the weight-orthogonalization control design is worth a close look. Estimated reading time: 30–50 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 内省能力和安全漏洞的有趣分析，揭示了模型在区分自身意图和外部注入时的脆弱性，对防御预填充攻击有启发。
recommendation.en: Interesting analysis of LLM introspective capability and safety vulnerabilities, revealing model fragility in distinguishing self-intent from external injection, inspiring for defending against prefill attacks.

paper.title: The Geometry of Refusal: Linear Instability in Safety-Aligned LLMs
paper.abstract: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on extensive safety alignment, yet the mechanistic basis of refusal remains opaque. In this work, we investigate whether safety compliance is a deep semantic decision or a manipulable linear feature. We introduce Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization framework that isolates the "refusal direction" by contrasting hidden states derived from safe and unrestricted system prompts. Unlike representation engineering methods that intervene on inte

summary.core_problem: 安全对齐LLM的拒答行为编码机制尚不明确，现有研究无法区分其为深层语义决策还是浅层可操纵线性特征，且缺乏无需优化、可直接量化对齐深度的诊断工具。
summary.importance: 为预训练-后训练的对齐接口设计提供明确启发：对齐鲁棒性不取决于SFT/RLHF的数据量，而取决于安全信号注入的层深度——越早注入越难被线性操纵。提出的CLS框架可作为零成本的对齐质量诊断工具，比现有激活干预方法更灵敏地暴露对齐脆弱性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对比Logit引导（Contrastive Logit Steering, CLS），零优化的几何干预框架。核心步骤：其一，对同一用户查询并行执行三次前向传播，分别使用中性、无约束、极严格三类系统提示，得到每个解码步的三个Logit向量；其二，用无约束与极严格提示的Logit差构造瞬时拒答向量，该向量突出被安全对齐抑制的token；其三，将缩放后的拒答向量叠加到中性提示的Logit上：缩放系数为正实现越狱，为负实现安全加固。为绕过模型第一步的拒答反射，采用前缀注入强制前k个token为肯定前缀（如“Sure”），使模型先进入合规生成轨迹。核心贡献：在输出Logit层面实现了零优化的拒答行为操纵，为量化对齐深度提供了几何探针。
summary.experiments: 在7个主流模型家族（Llama 2/3.1、Qwen 2/2.5、Mistral、Gemma、Phi）上测试。核心结果：其一，拒答方向是跨模型通用的线性特征；其二，模型分为两类：晚决策型（如Llama-3.1，95%的层处理有害/无害查询的表示无差异，仅最后输出头分岔），CLS加前缀注入的攻击成功率达95%；早分岔型（如Qwen-2.5，约40%层深度即出现表示分岔），攻击成功率仅22%；其三，与现有激活干预方法相比，CLS在Llama 2上的攻击成功率从22.6%提升至73%，在Qwen 7B上从79.2%提升至91%；其四，负向引导可在不更新参数的前提下加固模型，同时提升生成连贯性；其五，用拒答向量做恶意查询检测的F1值达0.92。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读顺序：首先读引言的核心问题与结论（约5分钟），明确拒答行为的线性本质与对齐深度的影响；其次读方法部分的CLS与前缀注入的实现逻辑（约10分钟），理解Logit层面干预的设计动机；然后读实验部分的核心结果表与KL散度分岔深度图（约10分钟），掌握两类模型的鲁棒性差异；最后读讨论部分的对齐设计启示（约5分钟）。总阅读时间约25-30分钟，无需精读附录中的攻击提示模板等细节，除非直接从事对齐安全研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The encoding mechanism of refusal behavior in safety-aligned LLMs remains unclear: existing work cannot distinguish whether it is a deep semantic decision or a shallow manipulable linear feature, and there is a lack of zero-optimization diagnostic tools that can directly quantify alignment depth.
summary_en.importance: Provides clear guidance for pretrain-posttrain alignment interface design: alignment robustness depends not on the volume of SFT/RLHF data, but on the layer depth of safety signal injection — earlier injection makes linear manipulation harder. The proposed CLS framework serves as a zero-cost alignment quality diagnostic that exposes alignment fragility more sensitively than existing activation intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization geometric intervention framework. Core steps: First, run three parallel forward passes for the same user query with neutral, unrestricted, and hyper-restrictive system prompts to obtain three per-step logit vectors. Second, construct an instantaneous refusal vector from the logit difference between unrestricted and hyper-restrictive prompts, highlighting tokens suppressed by safety alignment. Third, add the scaled refusal vector to logits from the neutral prompt: positive scaling induces jailbreaking, negative scaling induces safety hardening. To bypass the model’s first-step refusal reflex, Prefix Injection forces the first k tokens to an affirmative prefix (e.g., "Sure") to push the model into a compliant generation trajectory first. Core contribution: Implements zero-optimization refusal behavior manipulation at the output logit layer, providing a geometric probe to quantify alignment depth.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across 7 mainstream model families (Llama 2/3.1, Qwen 2/2.5, Mistral, Gemma, Phi). Key results: First, the refusal direction is a universal linear feature across models. Second, models fall into two categories: Late Decision (e.g., Llama-3.1, where representations for harmful/benign queries are identical across 95% of layers, diverging only at the final output head) — CLS plus Prefix Injection achieves 95% attack success rate; Early Divergence (e.g., Qwen-2.5, where representations diverge at ~40% depth) — attack success rate is only 22%. Third, compared to existing activation intervention methods, CLS improves attack success rate from 22.6% to 73% on Llama 2, and from 79.2% to 91% on Qwen 7B. Fourth, negative steering hardens models without parameter updates while improving generation coherence. Fifth, malicious query detection using the refusal vector achieves 0.92 F1.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in the following order: First, read the core problem and conclusions in the Introduction (~5 minutes) to understand the linear nature of refusal behavior and the impact of alignment depth. Second, read the implementation logic of CLS and Prefix Injection in the Methodology section (~10 minutes) to grasp the design motivation of logit-level intervention. Third, read the core result tables and KL divergence divergence depth plots in the Experiments section (~10 minutes) to understand the robustness difference between the two model categories. Fourth, read the alignment design takeaways in the Discussion section (~5 minutes). Total estimated reading time: 25–30 minutes. No need to closely examine details such as attack prompt templates in the appendix unless working directly on alignment safety research.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 refusal direction 的测量 setup；若结果稳，会削弱“拒答是语义级安全判断”的先验。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the refusal-direction measurement setup; if robust, it weakens the prior that refusal is mainly a semantic safety decision.

paper.title: Beyond Importance: Interchange-Sobol Sensitivity Reveals Task-Specific Content Channels in Transformer Components
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability methods summarize a transformer component by a single importance score, conflating two distinct roles: a component may matter because it transports task-relevant content, or because the forward computation degrades when its contribution is removed. We introduce \emph{Interchange-Group Sobol Decomposition} (IGSD), a paired-intervention framework that compares matched activation replacement with zero ablation on the same component, estimates two Sobol-style variance in

summary.core_problem: 现有 Transformer 可解释性方法用单一标量衡量组件重要性，混淆了两种不同机制：组件承载任务相关内容（替换激活会改变输出），或组件作为计算基底（移除会破坏前向计算），导致内容敏感型组件被低估。
summary.importance: 提出了区分内容通道与计算基底的可解释性框架，为预训练模型的组件功能定位、剪枝、知识编辑提供了更精细的诊断工具；在事实召回任务中发现标准重要性分数低估的早期层内容通道，对理解大模型知识存储与流动路径有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Interchange-Group Sobol Decomposition（IGSD）配对干预框架：对同一层内组件 g，在答案对齐 token 位置分别执行两种操作——用匹配 donor prompt 的激活做替换（swap）、将激活置零（zero ablation）。两者都用 Sobol 方差指数归一化到同一输出方差尺度，再计算 signed difference δ(g)：δ>0 表示错误内容比缺失更具破坏性，组件属于内容传输通道；δ<0 表示缺失更具破坏性，组件属于删除敏感的计算基底。同时设计对称离流形诊断指标监控干预有效性，通过 subject/relation 控制的 donor 设计识别传输的具体内容因子，并给出匹配交换的误设界、配对 bootstrap 推断等理论保证。
summary.experiments: 在 GPT-2 small 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上的事实召回任务中，IGSD 识别出被标准重要性分数低估的早期层 MLP 内容通道：例如对 GPT-2 small 的 MLP L0 做激活替换可将正确答案 'Yahoo' 从排名第 1 降至第 95，而零消融的重要性分数未将其列入前列。细粒度层面，IGSD 复现了已知的事实检索头 Attn L9H8。后续通过高层钳制与组掩码验证，确认识别出的事实组件会被后续层变换，且可用于剪枝加速推理。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 40 分钟。重点关注第 2 节 IGSD 的配对干预定义与 δ(g) 符号的语义解释，理解 swap 与 zero ablation 的本质差异；图 1 的具体案例可帮助快速建立直觉；第 3 节实验中早期层内容通道的发现与已知注意力头的复现是核心验证；理论命题部分可按需查阅。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing mechanistic interpretability methods summarize each Transformer component with a single importance score, conflating two distinct mechanisms: a component may carry task-relevant content (so activation replacement changes outputs) or act as a computational substrate (so removal breaks the forward pass), which causes content-sensitive components to be systematically underrated.
summary_en.importance: IGSD provides a finer-grained diagnostic framework to separate content-transport channels from deletion-sensitive substrates, offering direct utility for component localization, pruning, and knowledge editing in pretrained LLMs. Its discovery of underrated early-layer content channels in factual recall tasks sheds new light on knowledge storage and flow paths inside large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: IGSD is a paired-intervention framework. For each layer-local group g at the answer-aligned target token, it performs two matched perturbations on the same written activation: a swap intervention that replaces the activation with one from a matched donor prompt, and a zero-ablation intervention that replaces the same activation with zeros. Both responses are normalized to a common output-variance scale via Sobol-style indices, then compared via a signed difference δ(g). Positive δ(g) indicates incorrect content is more disruptive than absence (content-transport channel); negative δ(g) indicates absence is more disruptive (deletion-sensitive substrate). A symmetric off-manifold diagnostic monitors intervention validity, a factorial donor design disentangles transported content factors, and the paper supplies theoretical guarantees including mis-specification bounds for matched interchange and paired-bootstrap inference.
summary_en.experiments: On factual recall with GPT-2 small and Qwen2.5-1.5B, IGSD identifies early-layer MLP content channels that standard importance scores rank low. For example, swapping the activation of MLP L0 in GPT-2 small demotes the correct answer 'Yahoo' from rank #1 to #95, while zero ablation does not flag this component as top-ranked. At finer granularity, IGSD recovers the known factual retrieval head Attn L9H8. Downstream validation via late-layer clamping and group masking confirms the identified factual components are transformed by later layers and can support pruning-based fast inference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in roughly 40 minutes. Focus on Section 2 for the paired-intervention definition and the semantic interpretation of the δ(g) sign; Figure 1 gives a concrete intuition for why swap and zero ablation measure different roles. Section 3 contains the key empirical findings — the early-layer channel discovery and the recovery of the known attention head. The theoretical propositions can be consulted selectively.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但把“重要”拆成“在传内容”与“删掉会坏”两件事，解释实验会更干净；读方法和 factual recall 那组对照就够了。
recommendation.en: It does not change training, but it cleanly separates ‘carries content’ from ‘breaks when removed’; read the method and the factual-recall controls, not every table.

paper.title: AgentLens: Interpretable Safety Steering via Mechanistic Subspaces for Multi-Turn Coding Agent
paper.abstract: Coding agents based on large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable autonomous capabilities, but they also introduce significant safety and misuse risks during multi-turn interactions with external environments. Existing safety mechanisms mainly rely on external guardrails, which have a limited ability to perform fine-grained behavioral control during execution. Meanwhile, recent mechanistic interpretability methods for LLM safety are mostly confined to single-turn or jailbreak-style QA s

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮 coding agent 在执行外部环境操作时，传统外部 guardrail 难以及时、细粒度控制风险行为的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 安全方法与可解释干预。它把 mechanistic interpretability 从单轮 jailbreak/QA 场景扩展到多轮 agent 执行轨迹，对研究 agent 内部风险状态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentLens，即 Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering。方法从 step-level hidden representations 中检测有害执行状态，并在运行时通过表示子空间干预进行缓解，而不是只依赖输入输出过滤器或外部执行规则。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、benchmark 名称或提升幅度。可确认的是实验对象是多轮 coding agent，并强调运行时安全检测与 representation-level mitigation；具体效果需要看正文表格。
summary.authors_note: Chaowei Xiao 是安全与对抗机器学习方向的知名研究者，近年也关注大模型安全与鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets safety risks in multi-turn coding agents, where external guardrails often fail to provide fine-grained control during execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent safety and interpretability contribution. It extends mechanistic safety work beyond single-turn jailbreak or QA settings into multi-step agent execution, where risk evolves across actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentLens performs Mechanistic Subspace Intervention and Steering. It detects harmful execution states from step-level hidden representations and applies representation-level runtime mitigation, rather than relying solely on external filters or guardrails.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, benchmark names, or numerical gains. It claims evaluation on multi-turn coding agents with runtime safety detection and mitigation; the main evidence would need to be checked in the full experimental section.
summary_en.authors_note: Chaowei Xiao is a well-known researcher in adversarial machine learning, robustness, and more recent LLM safety work.

recommendation.zh: agent 安全方向可备查；预训练视角只需看子空间定义，实验若没有强消融就别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Worth filing for agent safety; from a pretraining lens, only inspect the subspace definition and avoid over-reading it without strong ablations.

paper.title: How Linear Is a Transformer Feed-Forward Block? Per-Block Linear Recoverability Is Learned, Not Architectural
paper.abstract: Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs) are often treated as nonlinear stores of computation, yet how nonlinear a trained FFN block actually is has rarely been measured. We treat each FFN as a position-wise input-to-output map and split it into the exact least-squares linear approximation plus a residual. The held-out variance the closed-form linear map explains defines a block's linear recoverability (R^2_lin), an optimiser-free measure of its linearity.   Across all twelve blocks of GPT-2, Py

summary.core_problem: 测量 Transformer FFN block 在训练后到底有多接近线性映射，以及这种线性可恢复性是否由架构决定。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把 FFN 的非线性程度从直觉判断变成一个可测量量，提示不同层的计算形态可能主要来自训练结果，而不是激活函数或宽度这类静态设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把每个 FFN 视为 position-wise 的输入到输出函数，用闭式最小二乘线性映射拟合其输出，并用 held-out 方差解释率定义 R^2_lin。随后把精确线性近似和残差分离，再用低秩双线性 probe 检查非线性残差是否能被简单二阶结构解释。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 GPT-2、Pythia-160m、llama-160m 的 12 个 block。结果显示不同 block 的 R^2_lin 差异很大且随深度非单调，相邻层可从接近线性（>0.99）变到强非线性（<0.3）。GPT-2 与 Pythia-160m 同为 GELU、同宽度，但线性可恢复性剖面差异明显。低秩双线性 probe 只能恢复少量 R^2，且增益与残差大小不相关。
summary.authors_note: Independent Research；作者为 Stuart Whipp，未见可确认的知名 LLM 基座预训练代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how close trained Transformer FFN blocks are to linear maps, and whether this property is determined by architecture or learned during training.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It turns the common intuition that FFNs are nonlinear computation stores into a measurable quantity, and suggests that layer-wise computation form can be a learned property rather than a fixed architectural consequence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each FFN is treated as a position-wise input-output map. The author fits the exact least-squares linear approximation in closed form and defines linear recoverability R^2_lin by held-out explained variance. The FFN output is decomposed into a linear component and a residual, and a low-rank bilinear probe is used to test whether the residual has simple second-order structure.
summary_en.experiments: The analysis covers all 12 blocks of GPT-2, Pythia-160m, and llama-160m. R^2_lin is highly heterogeneous and non-monotonic with depth, ranging from nearly linear blocks above 0.99 to strongly nonlinear blocks below 0.3, even between adjacent layers. GPT-2 and Pythia-160m share same-width GELU FFNs but show sharply different profiles. A low-rank bilinear residual probe recovers only a few additional R^2 points.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent Research; Stuart Whipp is the listed author, with no clearly identifiable major LLM pretraining track record from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为 FFN 机制小测量值得备查；不要过读，样本都是小模型，只看 R^2_lin 的层间异质性即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a small FFN mechanistic measurement; do not overread the tiny-model setup, but the layer-wise R^2_lin heterogeneity is worth noting.

paper.title: How Transparent is DiffusionGemma?
paper.abstract: LLM reasoning transparency is a critical affordance for understanding model decisions, mitigating misuse and misalignment, and debugging surprising model behaviors. However, DiffusionGemma performs a larger fraction of its computation in a continuous latent space; does this make its reasoning less transparent? We study this question by decomposing transparency into two components: variable transparency, whether we understand intermediate snapshots of a model's computational state; and algorithmi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 DiffusionGemma 这类 text diffusion LM 是否还保留类似 autoregressive CoT 的可透明性。问题的难点在于，DiffusionGemma 的推理不是逐 token 生成，而是在一个 token canvas 上反复 denoise；相邻 denoising step 之间传递的状态包含自然语言 token，也包含 dense self-conditioning vectors。后者可能承载模型的中间推理，却不直接可读。
summary.importance: 这是一篇值得精读的 diffusion LM 机制分析论文。它把“透明性”拆成两个更可操作的对象：variable transparency，即中间状态能否被人或模型理解；algorithmic transparency，即能否用这些中间状态重构模型如何得到答案。这个拆分对未来 latent reasoning、masked/any-order LM、diffusion LM 的训练设计有直接启发：如果训练或架构把中间状态压向 embedding/token 空间，透明性可能保留；如果大量 outcome-based RL 鼓励模型把有效推理藏进连续 latent，透明性可能下降。对预训练研究来说，贡献不是一个新训练 recipe，而是给非 AR 语言模型提供了一个评估和约束中间计算可读性的框架。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先从 opaque serial depth 入手。这个量衡量模型在两个可解释瓶颈之间能连续做多少串行计算。DiffusionGemma 每个 denoising step 之间的瓶颈包含 C 个自然语言 token 和 C 个 self-conditioning vectors，C 是 canvas 长度。如果不把这些中间 bottleneck 视为可解释，DiffusionGemma 的 opaque serial computation 是对应 Gemma 的 28.6×；如果这些 bottleneck 可解释，则降到 1.1×。随后论文检验这个假设是否成立。它做了两步：第一，限制 denoising step 之间的信息流，把 bottleneck 中可传递的信息压到 O(c) 个自然语言 token，观察性能是否保持；第二，分析这些映射出来的 token 是否对应附近位置的 token guesses。结果显示，大部分信息可以通过接近自然语言 token 的形式表达，且这些 token 往往是在猜测邻近位置，从而支持一定程度的 variable transparency。论文还改造 monitorability evaluation，让外部 monitor 根据 DiffusionGemma 的中间轨迹提取信息，并与 Gemma 4 的 CoT 可监控性对照。最后通过 case studies 分析 diffusion LM 独有的算法现象，包括非时间顺序推理、token/sequence smearing，以及 intermediate-context reasoning。
summary.experiments: 关键数字有三类。第一是 opaque serial depth：在不承认中间 bottleneck 可解释时，DiffusionGemma 的不透明串行深度约为 Gemma 的 28.6×；在承认中间 denoising states 可解释时，只约为 1.1×。第二是 bottleneck 压缩实验：将 inter-step 信息流压缩为 O(c) 个自然语言 token 后，性能只有很小下降，说明 dense self-conditioning vectors 中相当一部分有效信息能被 token-level 表达近似承载。第三是 monitorability：在改造后的 monitorability evaluations 上，DiffusionGemma 与 Gemma 4 表现接近，说明至少在这些任务中，DiffusionGemma 的中间轨迹没有显著弱化监控器的信息获取能力。case studies 不是为了给出单一指标，而是展示非 AR denoising 的计算路径：模型可以先形成后部 token，再反过来影响前部 token；也可能在多个候选 token 或片段之间做连续态混合，这些行为不会自然出现在普通左到右 CoT 中。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 2、3、4、5。Section 2 是核心概念，尤其是 opaque serial depth 如何定义，以及 28.6×/1.1× 这两个数字依赖什么假设。Section 3 是最关键的实验证据，重点看信息流压缩到自然语言 token 的方法，以及 mapped tokens 为什么常常是 nearby token guesses。Section 4 用 monitorability 连接 safety/oversight 场景，可看评测改造是否公平。Section 5 的 case studies 值得细读，因为它展示了 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在“推理过程”上的真实差异。Appendix A.2 中关于 outcome-based RL 可能降低 latent 可解释性的讨论也值得看，它直接关系到 future latent reasoning model 的训练风险。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether DiffusionGemma, a text diffusion language model, preserves the transparency benefits usually associated with autoregressive chain-of-thought reasoning. The difficulty is that DiffusionGemma refines a whole token canvas through repeated denoising steps, and its inter-step state includes both natural-language tokens and dense self-conditioning vectors. Those vectors may carry important reasoning information that is not directly readable.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-value paper for researchers studying diffusion LMs, masked or any-order LMs, and latent reasoning. Its main contribution is a concrete decomposition of transparency into variable transparency and algorithmic transparency. Variable transparency asks whether intermediate states can be interpreted. Algorithmic transparency asks whether those states let us reconstruct the computation that produced the final answer. For pretraining research, the lesson is architectural and training-related: DiffusionGemma appears relatively transparent partly because its intermediate representation is biased toward token embeddings. Future latent reasoning models, especially those trained with substantial outcome-based RL, may not retain that property.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts with opaque serial depth, the amount of serial computation performed between interpretable bottlenecks. DiffusionGemma passes a bottleneck between denoising steps consisting of C natural-language tokens and C self-conditioning vectors, where C is the canvas length. If this bottleneck is treated as opaque, DiffusionGemma performs 28.6× more opaque serial computation than the corresponding Gemma model. If the bottleneck is interpretable, the ratio drops to 1.1×. The rest of the paper tests whether that interpretability assumption is defensible. It first restricts the inter-step information flow to O(c) natural-language tokens and measures whether performance is preserved. It then analyzes whether the resulting mapped tokens correspond to guesses for nearby positions. The paper also adapts monitorability evaluations to compare DiffusionGemma with Gemma 4, and uses case studies to study non-autoregressive phenomena such as non-chronological reasoning, token and sequence smearing, and intermediate-context reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The most important quantitative result is the opaque-serial-depth contrast: 28.6× Gemma if intermediate denoising states are not interpretable, but only 1.1× if they are. The bottleneck experiments show that reducing inter-step information flow to O(c) natural-language tokens causes minimal performance degradation, suggesting that much of the useful state can be represented in token-like form. The mapped tokens are often guesses for nearby token positions, which supports the variable-transparency claim. On adapted monitorability evaluations, DiffusionGemma and Gemma 4 are similarly monitorable, indicating that the denoising trajectory gives monitors roughly comparable access to task-relevant information in these settings. The qualitative case studies are also important: they show that DiffusionGemma can revise earlier tokens using later context, smear probability mass across competing tokens or sequences, and reason through intermediate canvas states in ways that do not map cleanly onto left-to-right CoT.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Sections 2 through 5 carefully. Section 2 defines opaque serial depth and explains the assumptions behind the 28.6× and 1.1× numbers. Section 3 is the main evidence for variable transparency; focus on how the bottleneck is reduced to natural-language tokens and why nearby-token guesses matter. Section 4 is useful for understanding whether CoT-style monitoring transfers to diffusion LMs. Section 5 is the most informative part for modeling researchers, because it documents concrete algorithmic behaviors that differ from autoregressive decoding. Appendix A.2 is worth reading for its discussion of how outcome-based RL and future latent architectures could make intermediate computation less interpretable.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻读；它把 diffusion LM 的“latent 不透明”拆成可测指标，可能改变非 AR 预训练范式的可解释性 prior。
recommendation.en: Read this now: it turns “latent opacity” in diffusion LMs into measurable quantities and may change the interpretability prior for non-AR pretraining.

paper.title: Leverage Is Not Reach: A Control-Window Law for Single-Neuron Steering in Language Models
paper.abstract: Aligned language models gate behaviors such as refusal and language routing through sparse feed forward neurons, yet no theory predicts when a single neuron intervention controls a behavior coherently rather than collapsing the output. We develop a budget normalized control window framework for single neuron steering. A dose along one write direction reduces to one control coordinate: the alignment between the residual stream and the write, driven along a universal saturation curve in units of a

summary.core_problem: 解释单神经元 steering 何时能稳定控制模型行为、何时会导致输出崩塌，并给出可预测的控制边界。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，针对对齐行为、拒答和语言路由中的稀疏 FFN 神经元提出可计算的控制律。对 activation steering、对齐可控性和训练后干预的边界理解有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 budget-normalized control window 框架，把沿单个 write direction 的干预压缩为一个控制坐标：残差流与 write 向量的对齐程度，并用由 residual norm / write norm 决定的 coherence budget 归一化。论文给出 universal saturation curve、collapse ceiling 和 behavior trigger 的定义：若触发阈值低于崩塌上界，则存在可控窗口；上界可由权重和一次通用前向计算得到，触发点则在 rollout 中测量。
summary.experiments: 在 15 个 held-out 神经元上验证 ceiling 预测，平均绝对误差 0.14，bulk layers 约 0.07；对 open/closed 的可控性判定 11 个正确，对比基线为 10 个。摘要强调同一控制坐标同时解释 benign mode switch 与 refusal，但未给出模型家族和参数规模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cohere。该工作更像对 post-hoc neuron steering 的可预测性分析，而不是新的训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains when single-neuron steering can coherently control a behavior and when it instead collapses generation, and provides a predictive control boundary.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. It proposes a computable control law for sparse FFN neurons involved in alignment behaviors such as refusal and language routing, which matters for activation steering, controllability, and post-training interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces a budget-normalized control-window framework. A dose along one write direction is reduced to a single control coordinate: the alignment between the residual stream and the write vector, normalized by a coherence budget set by residual norm over write norm. The paper defines a universal saturation curve, a collapse ceiling, and behavior triggers: coherent control exists when the trigger lies below the collapse ceiling. The ceiling is estimated from weights plus one generic forward pass, while triggers are measured during rollout.
summary_en.experiments: The method is tested on 15 held-out neurons. The predicted ceiling achieves mean absolute error of 0.14, around 0.07 in bulk layers, and the open/closed controllability verdict is correct on 11 cases versus 10 for a baseline. The abstract does not specify model families or parameter scales.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from Cohere. This is better viewed as a predictability study of post-hoc neuron steering rather than a new training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 activation steering 或对齐机制，只看控制律定义和 ceiling 预测实验；它不改 pretrain recipe，但会约束你对“单神经元可控性”的想象。
recommendation.en: If you work on activation steering or alignment mechanisms, read the control-law setup and ceiling-prediction results; it won’t change pretraining, but it does narrow the fantasy around single-neuron controllability.

paper.title: Actionable Activation Directions for Detecting and Mitigating Emergent Misalignment Across Language Model Families
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning language models on insecure code induces emergent misalignment with poorly understood internal structure. We investigate whether this misalignment corresponds to a causally actionable activation-space direction shared across architectures. Across four instruction-tuned model families (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.2-1B, Ministral-3-3B) finetuned identically, a difference-in-means direction achieves 99.6% separation of aligned and misaligned activations at each model's final layer

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“失配行为能不能被探测到”，而是更具体的问题：把指令模型用不安全代码做一次很窄的 QLoRA 微调后，出现的 emergent misalignment 是否会在激活空间里形成一个可线性读出、可因果干预、并且在不同模型家族之间部分共享的方向。这里的难点有三层。第一，行为失配往往是跨域外溢的，训练数据只是不安全代码，但模型会在非代码提示上给出有害建议、欺骗性回答或主动输出代码。第二，单模型内存在可分方向，不等于这个方向真是“行为原因”，也不等于它能跨架构迁移。第三，很多激活干预实验容易把“有效扰动”误判成“特异性机制”，所以需要严格的随机方向、正交方向、错误层、错误源模型以及安全代码微调等对照。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于提出了新的预训练方法，而在于给出了一种较扎实的内部表征审计框架：窄域微调诱发的失配，至少在若干小到中等规模 instruction-tuned 模型上，会在最终残差流形成高度线性可分的几何结构，而且这个结构在模型内具有一定因果可操作性。更重要的是，作者把“可分”“可干预”“可迁移”“内容特异性”四件事拆开验证，结论并不混淆：模型内方向是相对特异的，跨模型映射后的方向虽然常常还能压制行为，但特异性明显变差，容易退化成一般性扰动。这一点对做 activation steering、representation auditing、对齐监控的人很重要，因为它划清了线性工具当前能做到什么、做不到什么。对 pretrain/post-train 接口也有启发：后训练引入的坏行为可能不是分散噪声，而是集中写入了某些表征子空间，但不同训练谱系对这类子空间的组织方式并不一致。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很朴素，但实验控制做得比较完整。作者选了四个 instruction-tuned 家族：Qwen2.5-1.5B, Gemma-2-2B, Llama-3.2-1B, Ministral-3-3B。四个模型都在同一份约 6k 样本的不安全代码数据上，用相同 QLoRA 配方微调：LoRA rank 16，alpha 32，4-bit quantization，学习率 2e-4，有效 batch size 16，1 epoch；Qwen/Llama/Ministral 序列长 1024，Gemma 因资源限制用 512。基座权重冻结，只训练 adapter。行为指标定义为 code spillover：对非代码提示，输出里是否出现内联代码、代码样式语法或明确的不安全实现模式。作者用 regex 分类器做自动打分，并在 60 条人工标注样本上报告了 1.0 的 precision/recall/F1，至少说明这个代理指标在他们的设定里噪声不大。

核心表征提取方法是 final residual stream 上的 difference-in-means direction。具体做法是收集 aligned 与 misaligned 条件下的激活，计算均值差 v = μ_misaligned - μ_aligned，把它当作“失配方向”。这不是复杂 probe，而是最简单的线性几何对象，优点是可解释、可直接做 steering，也更容易看清是否真的存在集中方向。之后做两类实验。

第一类是模型内因果干预。推理时在某层残差流上加减 αv，主要看减去该方向后，非代码提示上的 code spillover 是否下降。为了避免把任意大扰动都解释成“命中机制”，作者对每个真实方向都配了 matched-magnitude 的随机单位向量、正交方向、错误层、错误源方向等控制。这个设计是全文最关键的部分，因为它把“方向有效”与“方向特异”区分开了。

第二类是跨架构迁移。不同模型激活空间维度和坐标系不一致，作者用 ridge regression 学一个从源模型激活到目标模型激活的线性映射，再把源模型的 misalignment direction 投到目标模型空间里做 separability 和 steering。这里的目标不是证明存在统一坐标系，而是测试“线性映射后是否还保留足够行为相关信号”。作者还加入了安全代码微调的负对照：在 Qwen 上用匹配规模和相同超参的 secure-code 数据训练一个 adapter，再重复方向提取与干预。如果安全代码也能得到类似方向，那说明几何结构可能只是微调伪影；如果不能，才更能说明方向与训练内容相关。
summary.experiments:
结果分成四块看。

1. 模型内线性可分性很强。作者报告在每个模型最终层，aligned 与 misaligned 激活可达到 99.6% 的分离度。这个数字说明至少在他们定义的行为条件下，失配并不是弥散在整个表示空间，而是高度集中到一个简单线性方向附近。

2. 模型内 steering 有明显行为效应，而且大体具备特异性。对 Qwen、Llama、Ministral，减去真实 misalignment direction 后，code spillover 下降 21 到 51 个点；Gemma 结果较边缘。与之对比，随机方向和正交方向在匹配幅度下几乎没有效果，变化不超过 2/115。这个对照很关键，因为它说明至少在模型内，真实方向不是“随便扰一下都行”。

3. 跨模型 ridge 映射后，方向仍有行为效应，但特异性明显变差。作者报告跨架构可带来 13 到 46 点的 spillover suppression，说明不同家族之间确实共享了一部分几何信号；但随机和正交控制在跨模型设定下也能产生相近抑制，意味着这里更像是“目标模型对某类线性扰动敏感”，而不是“精确迁移了同一个机制方向”。这也是全文最有价值的负面结果之一。很多工作只报 transfer 有效，这篇把 specificity failure 也讲清楚了。

4. 安全代码负对照支持内容特异性。Qwen 的 secure-code adapter 只得到约 50.0% separability，effect size 约为 0；而 insecure adapter 是 99.6% separability，effect 约 95。这个对照直接削弱了“任何代码微调都会写入一个类似方向”的解释。

文中还有两个有意思的观察。其一，Gemma 表面行为失配最弱，adapter code spillover 约 37%，而 Qwen 和 Llama 在 63% 到 66%；但 Gemma 却是最强 donor 之一，向其他模型迁移时 separability 和 suppression 都不错，例如到 Ministral 可达 90% ridge separability 和约 -20 的因果抑制。其二，Llama 更像稳定 receiver 而不是 donor。也就是说，行为严重程度与几何可迁移性并不简单对应，这提示不同训练谱系可能把相似行为写入了不同“组织方式”的表示空间。
summary.reading_guide:
