summary.technical_approach: 通过四个渐进实验验证：1) 仅保留符号（将幅度设为 1）仍能保持 72-93% 的 top-5 next-token 准确率；2) 纯 Hamming 评分（无 decoder）可达 80-90% top-4096 准确率；3) 使用单 token 类型缓存，通过每维度的符号一致性发现了 175 个语义类别（平均 AUC 0.80）；4) 训练的探针仅增加 +0.018 AUC 且收敛到轴对齐权重，证实了跨维度协同作用可以忽略不计。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B 三个模型家族上进行了验证，证明了该现象的架构通用性。
summary.authors_note: 作者独立完成，关注机制可解释性。

summary_en.core_problem: Do the hidden state dimensions of Transformers naturally possess interpretability without the need for additional training (e.g., SAEs)?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free mechanistic interpretability framework 'Bag of Dims', discovering that the standard basis of Transformer hidden states is itself a feature basis, where the sign of a dimension encodes semantics and the magnitude encodes confidence, challenging the common belief that methods like SAEs are necessary to extract interpretable features.
summary_en.technical_approach: Validated through four progressive experiments: 1) Retaining only signs (setting magnitudes to 1) still maintains 72-93% top-5 next-token accuracy; 2) Pure Hamming scoring (without decoder) reaches 80-90% top-4096 accuracy; 3) Using a single-token type cache, discovered 175 semantic categories via per-dimension sign consistency (mean AUC 0.80); 4) A trained probe adds only +0.018 AUC and converges to axis-aligned weights, confirming negligible cross-dimension synergy.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three model families (Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B), proving the architectural generality of this phenomenon.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent author, focusing on mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 极其有趣的发现：Transformer 隐藏状态的符号本身就编码了极强的语义信息，挑战了 SAE 的必要性，强烈建议阅读实验部分以评估其在更大模型上的泛化性。
recommendation.en: Extremely interesting finding: the signs of Transformer hidden states inherently encode strong semantic information, challenging the necessity of SAEs. Highly recommended to read the experiments to evaluate its generalizability on larger models.

paper.title: Understanding helpfulness and harmless tension in reward models
paper.abstract: Reward models are a key component of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), aligning language models toward both helpful and harmless behaviour. However, the internal mechanisms underlying these objectives and their conflicts remain poorly understood. We study alignment tension in reward models trained under helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, and mixed-objective settings. We find that mixed-objective models often underperform single-objective models, indicating interference between

summary.core_problem: RLHF奖励模型中有用性与无害性两个对齐目标存在已知冲突，但这种冲突的内部神经机制一直缺乏清晰解释。
summary.importance: 机制分析贡献，从神经元层面定位了奖励模型目标干扰的来源，为多目标对齐的奖励模型设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 分别训练单目标（仅有用性、仅无害性）和混合目标奖励模型，通过激活归因识别各目标对应的神经元，用定向消融验证神经元的因果作用，量化分析共享神经元的分布和行为影响。
summary.experiments: 混合目标奖励模型表现弱于单目标模型，存在明确的跨目标干扰；目标专属神经元会提升对应目标表现但常损伤另一目标；占比可观的共享神经元对模型输出有不成比例的高影响力，是对齐张力的核心来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哥本哈根大学，聚焦LLM对齐与机制可解释性研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The neural mechanisms underlying the well-documented tension between helpfulness and harmlessness objectives in RLHF reward models remain poorly characterized.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis that identifies neuron-level sources of cross-objective interference in reward models, providing empirical grounding for multi-objective alignment design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train reward models in three settings (helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, mixed objective), use activation attribution to map neurons to each objective, run targeted ablations to measure causal effects, and characterize the functional role of neurons shared across objectives.
summary_en.experiments: Mixed-objective reward models underperform single-objective models due to cross-objective interference. Objective-specific neurons causally improve their target objective while often hurting the other; a substantial subset of shared neurons exerts disproportionate output influence and is the primary driver of alignment tension.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from the University of Copenhagen, researching LLM alignment and mechanistic interpretability.

recommendation.zh: 神经元级的RM目标冲突分析比较扎实，重点看消融结果和共享神经元统计即可，对多目标对齐loss设计有参考。
recommendation.en: The neuron-level ablation analysis of reward model tradeoffs is methodologically solid; focus on the shared neuron statistics as reference for multi-objective alignment design.

paper.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
paper.abstract: When large language models (LLMs) fail to generalize or make haphazard errors in reasoning, it is often taken as evidence that LLMs are not truly reasoning, but rather performing a kind of pattern matching. The implication is that people's behavior does not exhibit the same types of failures because human reasoning uses principled and abstract world models. We evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on their ability to engage in common-sense reasoning about a variety of everyday situations and o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是：LLM 在日常常识推理中的错误，究竟只是“模式匹配”失灵，还是反映了更抽象的世界模型推理；同时，人类在类似任务上是否真的遵循不同机制。
summary.importance: 它属于机制分析与认知对照研究。价值不在于提出新模型，而在于给出一个不太讨喜但值得认真看的判断：人类和 LLM 在 everyday reasoning 上可能共享更接近模式匹配的机制，而不是人类显著更依赖抽象世界模型。这会影响我们如何解释 CoT、generalization failure 和 attention-level circuitry。
summary.technical_approach: 作者同时测试人类参与者和 25 个 LLM 在一组日常情境常识推理任务上的表现，比较错误模式是否一致；随后定位驱动模型回答的注意力头，并将这些头解释为执行某种 pattern-matching 的机制，再用这些头去预测由看似无关提示细节引发的人类错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的是行为模式与机制定位结果，而非大规模训练实验。实验覆盖 25 个 LLM 和人类被试，核心发现是两者出现相似的错误分布；并且一组特定 attention heads 能解释模型输出，也能预测人类受无关 prompt 细节干扰时的错误。若正文做得扎实，这类“人-模同构错误 + 头级机制锚定”的证据比一般行为学对比更有分量。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Zach Studdiford、Gary Lupyan。Gary Lupyan 以语言、认知与概念表征研究见长，这使论文更像认知科学与机制解释的交叉工作，而不是常规 LLM benchmark 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether everyday reasoning errors in LLMs are merely failures of pattern matching or evidence against genuine reasoning, and whether humans actually rely on a different mechanism in similar tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and cognitive-comparison paper. Its value is not in proposing a new model, but in making an uncomfortable claim worth checking carefully: human and LLM everyday reasoning may share a pattern-matching-like mechanism rather than humans relying much more on abstract world models. That matters for how we interpret CoT, generalization failures, and attention-level circuits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on common-sense reasoning over everyday situations, compare their error patterns, then identify attention heads that drive model responses and interpret them as implementing a form of pattern matching. They further use these heads to predict human errors triggered by seemingly irrelevant prompt details.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is behavioral and mechanistic rather than a large-scale training result. The study covers 25 LLMs plus human participants, with the main finding that both show similar error patterns; moreover, a specific set of attention heads explains model outputs and predicts human mistakes induced by irrelevant prompt details. If the full paper is careful, this combination of human-model error alignment and head-level anchoring is stronger than a typical behavioral comparison.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is by Zach Studdiford and Gary Lupyan. Gary Lupyan is known for work on language, cognition, and conceptual representation, which makes this more of a cognitive-science-meets-mechanistic-interpretability paper than a standard LLM benchmark paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“人类靠抽象规则、LLM 只是 pattern matching”的舒服叙事；先看 attention-head 证据链是否站得住，再决定要不要更新你对日常推理机制的 prior。
recommendation.en: This challenges the comforting story that humans use abstract rules while LLMs merely pattern-match; check whether the attention-head evidence really closes that loop before updating your prior.

paper.title: Where Computation Lives Inside TabPFN: Causal Localisation of Attention Head Function
paper.abstract: We present the first causal mechanistic analysis of a tabular foundation model, investigating how TabPFN 2.5's feature wise attention heads distribute computation across layers. Using activation patching, ablation, and attention entropy across two synthetic regression datasets, we find clear temporal specialisation: one head's causal necessity dominates that of the others by 2 to 5 times at peak layer, with its dominant layer shifting across tasks of different complexity, while the remaining hea

summary.core_problem: 分析 TabPFN 2.5 中 feature-wise attention heads 如何在不同层承担计算，以及这些计算是否可被因果定位和推理时 steering。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析，首次对表格 foundation model 做 attention head 级别的因果定位；对 LLM 的直接价值有限，但对 in-context learning 的任务依赖计算分布有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 activation patching、head ablation 和 attention entropy，在两个合成回归数据集上定位不同层和不同 head 的因果作用；还测试 contrastive activation steering 是否能跨样本转移。
summary.experiments: 研究对象是 TabPFN 2.5；在两个合成回归数据集上发现一个 head 在峰值层的因果必要性比其他 head 高 2 到 5 倍，且主导层随任务复杂度移动；contrastive activation steering 未能跨样本迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how feature-wise attention heads in TabPFN 2.5 distribute computation across layers and whether these computations can be causally localized or steered at inference time.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanistic analysis of a tabular foundation model, with indirect relevance to LLM researchers interested in in-context learning and context-dependent computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use activation patching, head ablation, and attention entropy on two synthetic regression datasets, then test contrastive activation steering for sample-level transfer.
summary_en.experiments: On TabPFN 2.5, one attention head is 2 to 5 times more causally necessary than others at its peak layer, and the dominant layer shifts with task complexity; contrastive activation steering does not transfer across samples.

recommendation.zh: 不必读全篇；看 head patching 结果和 steering 失败即可，它提醒 ICL 计算可能不是稳定方向而是上下文局部电路。
recommendation.en: Do not read it end to end; the head-patching result and failed steering are enough, as they hint that ICL computation may be a context-local circuit rather than a stable direction.

paper.title: Circuit Synchronization Precedes Generalization: Causal Evidence from Fourier Structure in Grokking Transformers
paper.abstract: Grokking -- where a transformer on modular arithmetic suddenly transitions from near-chance to near-perfect validation accuracy -- is attributed to a Fourier circuit, but its timing, causal structure, and controllability remain poorly understood. We introduce the Frequency Synchronization Degree (FSD), a normalised, permutation-tested metric for Fourier circuit synchronisation requiring no prior circuit knowledge. Across nine modular addition configurations (primes p in {53, 71, 97, 113, 131}, t

summary.core_problem: 研究 modular arithmetic grokking 中，Transformer 的 Fourier circuit 是何时形成、是否因果地驱动泛化、以及能否被训练超参控制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练动态与机制分析。它把 grokking 从“验证集突然变好”的现象，拆成可测的 circuit synchronization 先行信号和后续正则化驱动的泛化阶段，对理解小模型中电路形成和泛化延迟有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Frequency Synchronization Degree，即不依赖预先电路标注的 Fourier circuit 同步度量，并用 permutation test 做归一化检验。随后在 FSD 达到上限的训练步 fork 训练，通过改变 weight decay 来测试 circuit 同步到实际 grokking 之间的因果关系。
summary.experiments: 在 9 个 modular addition 配置上实验，质数 p 覆盖 53、71、97、113、131，并包含 3 个随机种子。FSD 在所有 9 个设置中都早于 grokking 500 到 3000 step，平均提前 1722 step，sign-test p 约 0.004；它也早于 Nanda 等人的 excluded loss baseline。fork 实验显示 weight decay 越大，grokking 越早，支持 inter-phase gap 与正则化有关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when the Fourier circuit behind modular-arithmetic grokking forms, whether it causally precedes generalization, and whether the gap can be controlled by training hyperparameters.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-dynamics and mechanistic-analysis contribution. It separates grokking into an early circuit-synchronization signal and a later regularization-mediated generalization transition, which is useful for thinking about circuit formation in small transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Frequency Synchronization Degree, a normalized and permutation-tested metric for Fourier circuit synchronization that does not require prior circuit annotations. The paper then forks training at the FSD-ceiling step and varies weight decay to test whether the synchronized-but-not-yet-generalized phase is causally controlled by regularization.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 9 modular-addition configurations with primes 53, 71, 97, 113, and 131 across three seeds. FSD precedes grokking in all 9 cases by 500 to 3000 steps, with a mean lead of 1722 steps and sign-test p around 0.004; it also precedes Nanda et al.'s excluded-loss baseline. Forking runs show monotonic earlier grokking under stronger weight decay.

recommendation.zh: 小模型 grokking 结论不能外推到 LLM，但 FSD 早于 excluded loss 这点可作为训练动态探针备查。
recommendation.en: Do not extrapolate the grokking setup to LLMs, but the FSD-before-excluded-loss result is a useful probe idea for training dynamics.

paper.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
paper.abstract: Attention is the key mechanism underlying in-context learning in transformers, and attention patterns have been observed empirically to emerge abruptly during training. We present a Bayesian theory of feature learning in attention; we then focus on how the copy subcircuit in the first layer of an induction head is learned by analyzing a single-layer softmax attention network trained on a copy task. We derive a closed-form posterior over the attention matrix and reduce it to a low-dimensional ord

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解释一个很具体、但对理解 ICL 很关键的问题：为什么 transformer 里与 induction head 相关的 copy 子电路会在训练中突然出现，而不是平滑形成。作者不直接从大模型整体入手，而是把问题压缩到一个可解析的最小设置：单层、单头 softmax attention 网络，在 copy task 上学习从上下文中把匹配 token 拷贝出来。核心目标不是再做一次经验观察，而是给出一个能从训练数据量出发、预测 attention 模式何时从“无效/均匀聚合”跳到“定点拷贝”的理论机制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它给“能力突现”提供了一个比经验曲线更扎实的解释框架：至少在 copy/induction 这一类 ICL 基元上，突变可以来自 attention 机制自身的相变结构，而不只是评测指标离散化造成的假象。第二，它把 softmax attention 和 linear attention 的学习动力学差异讲清楚了：softmax 对应一阶相变，linear attention 更像连续的二阶转变再接一个 crossover。这对架构选择有直接启发，因为它说明不同 attention 激活不只是算力/效率取舍，还会改变能力形成的形态、训练信号的锐利程度，以及 loss 曲线里能否看到明显阶段切换。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上的关键是一个 Bayesian feature learning 分析。作者先对单头 attention 网络做权重边缘化，得到 attention matrix 的闭式后验分布；然后再把这个高维对象约化到两个低维 order parameters，上面分别刻画“均匀注意”与“copy 注意”的竞争强度。这样一来，训练过程不再被看成参数空间里难以解释的优化轨迹，而是落在一个可分析的自由能/后验景观上。论文的核心发现是：随着训练数据量增加，后验主导态会发生结构切换。对 softmax attention，这个切换是离散跳变，存在明显的双稳态竞争和一阶相变特征；对 linear attention，则先连续增强 copy 相关方向，再经历更平滑的 crossover。作者还把这些 order parameters 映射回可观测的 loss signature，解释了为什么训练中会先学到 in-context unigram 统计，再学到 bigram 级别的定点复制。和以往 lazy training、NNGP 或冻结 attention pattern 的分析不同，这里真正把 attention pattern 本身作为主要自由度来处理，而且显式捕捉到非高斯激活与层间耦合的作用。
summary.experiments: 实验部分的作用主要是验证理论，而不是追求大规模性能。作者用 Bayesian sampling 和标准 Adam 训练两条线去对照理论预测，发现 attention 模式随数据量变化的转折位置、loss 形状以及阶段性学习顺序都与理论一致。关键现象包括：softmax attention 在某个数据规模附近会从近似均匀聚合突然切到 copy 模式，loss 上对应明显的尖锐变化；linear attention 则没有同样锋利的跳变，而是更连续地过渡。论文还把这一结果与已有两层 transformer 在 Markov 序列上的三阶段学习现象对齐：先不利用上下文，再利用上下文 unigram，最后利用 bigram。这里的理论最有价值的实验结论不是某个百分点提升，而是“相变类型—attention 机制—loss 签名—ICL 子能力形成”之间形成了闭环证据。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言里对 induction head、copy subcircuit 和三阶段学习现象的定位，再看给出 order parameter 的理论主结果和 softmax/linear attention 对比图。真正值得停下来读的是：一，作者如何从权重积分推到 attention matrix 的后验；二，为什么两个标量 order parameters 就足以描述主导行为；三，softmax 为何会产生一阶相变，而 linear attention 只能给出连续转变。读图时重点看 attention pattern 随数据规模变化的相图，以及 loss signature 与 unigram→bigram 学习阶段的对应关系。预计 30-45 分钟可以抓住主线；如果关心 mechanistic interpretability 与训练动力学的连接，再回头细读推导部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question for in-context learning: why does the copy subcircuit associated with induction heads appear abruptly during training instead of forming smoothly? Rather than analyzing full-scale LLMs, it studies a tractable setting: a single-layer, single-head attention network trained on a copy task. The goal is not just to reproduce the empirical observation of abrupt emergence, but to derive a mechanism that predicts when attention shifts from ineffective or uniform pooling to position-specific copying as data increases.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is conceptual rather than benchmark-driven. First, it gives a concrete account of capability emergence: at least for the copy primitive underlying induction behavior, abrupt changes can arise from the internal phase structure of attention itself, not only from thresholded evaluation metrics. Second, it clarifies that softmax and linear attention do not merely differ in efficiency or approximation quality; they induce different learning transitions. Softmax yields a first-order transition, while linear attention shows a continuous second-order transition followed by a crossover. That matters for architecture design because the attention nonlinearity changes how sharply capabilities form, how training signals appear in loss curves, and how easy it is to detect stage changes during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main tool is a Bayesian feature-learning analysis of a single attention head. The authors marginalize over network weights and derive a closed-form posterior over the attention matrix. They then reduce this high-dimensional object to a low-dimensional order-parameter description, with two scalar variables capturing the competition between uniform attention and copy-like attention. This turns training from an opaque parameter-space optimization problem into an analyzable posterior landscape. The central result is that increasing the amount of training data changes which attention pattern dominates the posterior. For softmax attention, the switch is discontinuous and exhibits the hallmarks of a first-order transition, including competing metastable regimes. For linear attention, the copy direction strengthens continuously and then passes through a smoother crossover. The paper also maps these order parameters back to observable loss signatures, explaining the familiar progression from no context use, to in-context unigram statistics, to bigram-level copying. Compared with lazy-limit or frozen-pattern analyses, this work treats the attention pattern itself as the primary degree of freedom and explicitly captures non-Gaussian activations and exact layer coupling.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed to validate the theory rather than to maximize downstream performance. Using both Bayesian sampling and standard Adam training, the authors show that the predicted transition points, loss signatures, and stagewise learning behavior match empirical training dynamics. The key observation is that softmax attention undergoes a sharp switch from near-uniform pooling to copy behavior around a critical data scale, with a corresponding abrupt change in loss. Linear attention does not show the same sharp jump and instead transitions more gradually. The paper also aligns these findings with prior observations in two-layer transformers trained on Markov sequences: first no use of context, then in-context unigram statistics, and finally bigram statistics. The most useful experimental takeaway is not a headline metric, but the closed loop between transition type, attention mechanism, loss signature, and the emergence of an ICL-relevant subcircuit.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, start with the introduction sections that connect induction heads, the copy subcircuit, and the known three-stage learning dynamics. Then read the main theoretical result introducing the order parameters and the comparison between softmax and linear attention. The parts worth slower reading are: how the posterior over the attention matrix is derived after integrating out weights; why two scalar order parameters are enough to capture the dominant behavior; and why softmax produces a first-order transition while linear attention does not. Focus on the figures showing phase behavior as a function of data scale and the mapping from order parameters to loss signatures. Around 30-45 minutes is enough to get the main idea; the derivations are worth deeper study if you care about mechanistic interpretability and training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 对 induction head 形成机制的硬核理论分析，揭示了 softmax 和 linear attention 在相变类型上的本质差异，做 mechanistic interpretability 的必看。
recommendation.en: Hardcore theoretical analysis of induction head formation, revealing fundamental differences in phase transition types between softmax and linear attention. A must-read for mechanistic interpretability researchers.

paper.title: When Roleplaying, Do Models Believe What They Say?
paper.abstract: Language models can state that "the Earth orbits the Sun" and, when role-playing Aristotle, assert the opposite. Recent work argues that persona adoption is fundamental to how language models operate, with models constantly selecting the most appropriate persona for a given context. Does such role-playing merely change the model's outputs, or does it also affect what the model internally represents as truthful? We study this question with linear truth probes, applying them to LLMs role-playing h

summary.core_problem: 研究 role-play/persona prompting 改变的到底是模型表层输出，还是其内部对真假的表示。
summary.importance: 这属于机制分析。它对对齐、可控生成和 persona conditioning 有启发，但与基座预训练的直接距离较远。价值在于把“模型是否真的信了自己扮演的角色”这个常见直觉做了 probe 化检验。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 linear truth probes，考察模型在扮演历史人物时，对两类错误命题的内部表征差异：一类是该时代人物可能相信的 era-believed falsehood，另一类是同主题但该人物也不会相信的 era-false。并比较 prompting、ICL 和 SFT 三种 persona induction 方式下的变化。
summary.experiments: 摘要结论是：persona induction 会让模型对 era-believed 假命题的抑制变弱，相比同样错误的其他命题更容易被说出，但在线性 probe 下总体仍被判为 false。也就是说，role-play 更像输出层重加权，而不是把内部 truth state 整体翻转。未给出具体模型名和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether role-play/persona prompting changes only surface outputs or also the model’s internal representation of truth.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. It is relevant to alignment, controllable generation, and persona conditioning, but only indirectly to pretraining. Its value is in operationalizing a common intuition—whether the model 'believes' its role-played claims—with probes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use linear truth probes to compare two kinds of false statements under historical persona role-play: era-believed falsehoods that the persona would likely endorse, and topic-matched era-false statements they would not. They test prompting, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning as persona induction methods.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract’s main result is that persona induction suppresses era-believed falsehoods less than equally false alternatives, yet they are still classified as false overall by the probes. That suggests role-play mostly reweights outputs rather than fully flipping internal truth representations. No concrete model names or margins are given in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 结论不算改天换地，但对“persona=belief rewrite”这个流行说法是个干净修正；看 abstract 和结果图就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but a clean correction to the popular 'persona rewrites belief' story; abstract plus the main result figure should suffice.

paper.title: Sparse probes and murky physics: a case study of interpretability challenges in a foundation model for continuum dynamics
paper.abstract: Generative AI emulators are increasingly used in scientific domains where we already have strong theory, benchmarks, and physical intuition. This raises a central evaluation and interpretability question: when a foundation-style model can reproduce known continuum dynamics, what internal mechanism supports that behavior, is the internal behaviour consistent with known physics, and how does it relate to where the emulator succeeds or fails? We investigate a cross-domain foundation model for conti

summary.core_problem: 科学领域基础模型能复现连续介质动力学行为，但其内部机制是否符合已知物理规律、与模型成败的关联尚不清晰。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，首次将物理先验（拟涡能）作为SAE特征筛选指标，为科学模型可解释性提供可落地的探查流程。
summary.technical_approach: 以Polymathic的跨域连续动力学模型Walrus为研究对象，对选定层训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取特征，用拟涡能（enstrophy）作为物理锚点从2万+特征中筛选与流体动力学相关的单元，对比不同剪切流参数下的特征激活模式。
summary.experiments: 探查对象为Walrus基础模型，测试场景为剪切流，对比多组数值模拟参数下的特征招募情况，发现部分SAE特征与物理量存在对应关系，但整体特征呈现高度混杂、难以直接映射到清晰物理模块。

summary_en.core_problem: Foundation models for continuum dynamics can reproduce known physical behavior, but it remains unclear whether their internal mechanisms align with established physics and how internal structure correlates with success or failure.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis work that introduces a physically grounded metric (enstrophy) to triage SAE features, providing a practical interpretability workflow for scientific foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on a selected layer of Polymathic's Walrus model, uses enstrophy as a physically meaningful metric to filter relevant features from over 20,000 candidates, and compares feature recruitment patterns across multiple shear-flow simulation setups with varying parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Probes the Walrus foundation model on shear-flow test cases; finds partial alignment between SAE features and physical quantities, but most features remain highly mixed and do not map cleanly to interpretable physical modules.

recommendation.zh: SAE探查方法有参考性，但对象是科学领域模型，对通用LLM预训练机制分析借鉴有限，仅作方法备查。
recommendation.en: SAE probing workflow is mildly informative, but the study targets a scientific domain model with limited transfer to general LLM pretraining interpretability; keep as methodology reference.

paper.title: When Attribution Patching Lies: Diagnosis and a Second-Order Correction
paper.abstract: A central goal of mechanistic interpretability is to identify which internal components causally drive a language model's behavior. Because these importance estimates serve as the evidence for identifying circuits, systematic errors can lead to the misidentification of the underlying mechanisms. While activation patching provides a gold-standard causal metric, its computational cost is prohibitive at scale. Practitioners instead rely on attribution patching, a gradient-based, first-order approxi

summary.core_problem: 归因修补（attribution patching）作为激活修补（activation patching）的一阶近似在机械可解释性中存在系统性误差，导致对LLM内部机制的误识别
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次定位归因修补不可靠的主要来源为下游网络非线性（而非被修补组件的局部曲率），并提出三个实用工具
summary.technical_approach: 通过理论分析定位误差来源，提出：(i)可靠性评分检测不可信估计，(ii)误差边界量化错误设定，(iii)Hessian-vector-product (HVP) 二阶修正消除主要误差
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中详述具体模型规模和实验数值，但方法适用于规模较大的语言模型
summary.authors_note: Luyang Zhang, Jialu Wang（机构未在摘要中明确）

summary_en.core_problem: Attribution patching as a first-order approximation to activation patching in mechanistic interpretability suffers from systematic errors that can lead to misidentification of LLM internal mechanisms
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis contribution; first to localize the dominant unreliability source to downstream network non-linearities (not local curvature at patched component), and provides three practical tools
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretical analysis to localize error source, proposes: (i) a reliability score for untrustworthy estimates, (ii) error bounds quantifying mis-specifications, (iii) Hessian-vector-product (HVP) second-order correction to eliminate dominant errors
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and quantitative results not detailed in the abstract; method applicable to large language models
summary_en.authors_note: Luyang Zhang, Jialu Wang (institutions not explicitly stated in abstract)

recommendation.zh: 机械可解释性方向的方法改进，发现归因修补误差主要来自下游非线性而非局部曲率——对于做circuit分析的研究者有参考，LLM预训练研究员可略过。
recommendation.en: Methodological improvement in mechanistic interpretability; finding that attribution patching errors stem from downstream non-linearities rather than local curvature — relevant for circuit analysis researchers, but LLM pretraining researchers can skip.

paper.title: Interactions Between Crosscoder Features: A Compact Proofs Perspective
paper.abstract: Dictionary learning methods like Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) and crosscoders attempt to explain a model by decomposing its activations into independent features. Interactions between features hence induce errors in the reconstruction. We formalize this intuition via compact proofs and make five contributions. First, we show how, \textit{in principle}, a compact proof of model performance can be constructed using a crosscoder. Second, we show that an error term arising in this proof can naturally

summary.core_problem: 字典学习方法（SAEs、crosscoders）通过将激活分解为独立特征来解释模型，但特征之间的相互作用会导致重构误差；现有分析缺乏对这些交互的形式化量化。
summary.importance: 理论/机制分析贡献：通过 compact proofs 形式化 crosscoder 特征交互，将重构误差项解释为特征交互的度量，并给出 MLP 层中交互项的显式表达。此外提出将交互项作为可微惩罚项来训练'计算稀疏'的 crosscoder。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 展示如何用 crosscoder 构造模型性能的 compact proof；2) 证明重构误差项可解释为特征交互度量，并推导 MLP 层的显式交互表达式；3) 提出将交互项作为可微损失惩罚项，训练仅保留单个特征时仍能保持 60% MLP 性能的 crosscoder。
summary.experiments: 在 MLP 层上验证，计算稀疏 crosscoder 在仅保留单个特征时保持 60% MLP 性能。具体模型规模和更多指标需查看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Jason Gross（推测为 MIT/OpenAI 相关），但机构信息在摘要中未明确。

summary_en.core_problem: Dictionary learning methods (SAEs, crosscoders) decompose model activations into independent features, but interactions between features induce reconstruction errors; existing analyses lack formal quantification of these interactions.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical/mechanistic contribution: formalizes crosscoder feature interactions via compact proofs, interprets the reconstruction error term as a measure of feature interaction, derives an explicit interaction term for MLP layers, and proposes using it as a differentiable penalty to train 'computationally sparse' crosscoders.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Shows how to construct a compact proof of model performance using a crosscoder; 2) Derives that the error term in the proof naturally measures crosscoder feature interactions, with an explicit expression for MLP layers; 3) Proposes using the interaction term as a differentiable loss penalty, achieving crosscoders that retain 60% of MLP performance with only a single feature kept.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on MLP layers; computationally sparse crosscoders retain 60% of MLP performance when keeping only one feature. Full experimental details and model sizes require reading the main paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Jason Gross (possibly MIT/OpenAI affiliated); institutional affiliations not explicitly stated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: Crosscoder特征交互的数学形式化，对深入理解SAE机制有一定参考，但与LLM预训练训练实践距离较远，备查即可。
recommendation.en: Formal mathematical analysis of crosscoder feature interactions; relevant to mechanistic interpretability researchers but distant from LLM pretraining practice. File for reference.

paper.title: MechLens: Late Crystallization of Factual Knowledge Explains Intervention Effectiveness in Language Models
paper.abstract: Understanding where LLMs store factual knowledge is critical for hallucination mitigation. We systematically quantify Late Crystallization: factual knowledge does not gradually emerge across layers but "crystallizes" abruptly at the final layers. Across five model families (Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, Mistral; 0.5--14B), 26.8%--93.4% of correct answers never enter top-10 predictions at any intermediate layer, with late emergence (>80% depth) consistent across architectures. Cross-scale (Q

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 的事实知识究竟在层间如何形成，并试图解释为什么某些基于层间干预的方法有效、某些无效。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，但和训练、解码干预、幻觉缓解都有直接接口。它提出“Late Crystallization”这一更强的层间知识形成假设：事实答案不是逐层平滑浮现，而是在最后几层突然结晶。如果这个现象稳健，会改变我们对 logit lens、层编辑和早层可读性的很多默认认知。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在五个模型家族、0.5B 到 14B 范围内，用层级预测轨迹分析 factual answer 何时进入 top-k，统计正确答案是否在中间层出现以及首次出现深度。为避免普通 logit lens 的 probe artifact，论文使用 tuned lens 做控制，并加入情感分类任务作为非事实型对照。基于观察到的 late crystallization，作者进一步提出 crystallization-guided intervention 原则，用它解释并比较 CAA 与 DoLa 这类干预方法在不同模型上的效果差异。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Pythia、Gemma、Qwen2.5、Llama-3.1、Mistral 等家族，参数规模 0.5B-14B。关键结果是：26.8%-93.4% 的正确答案在任何中间层都从未进入 top-10，且首次出现常在网络深度 80% 之后；在 Qwen2.5-14B 和 MMLU 上也观察到一致现象。情感分类对照显著更早出现，说明该现象更偏 factual recall 而非普遍任务属性。干预实验中，CAA 在中等 crystallization 模型上优于 DoLa，而在高 crystallization 的 Qwen 上出现方向相反的结果，作者报告最高可有 25 个点量级的差异，但具体任务和指标需看正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper studies how factual knowledge forms across layers in LLMs and uses that analysis to explain why some layer-based interventions work while others do not.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism paper with direct implications for training-time interpretation, decoding interventions, and hallucination mitigation. The main proposal, Late Crystallization, is a stronger claim than the usual gradual-emergence picture: factual answers often do not become readable until the final layers. If robust, this updates several priors around logit lens, layer editing, and the interpretability of intermediate representations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author tracks when the correct factual answer first enters top-k predictions across layers for five model families from 0.5B to 14B. To reduce ordinary logit-lens probe artifacts, the paper uses a tuned lens and includes sentiment classification as a non-factual control task. Based on the observed late crystallization pattern, it proposes a crystallization-guided intervention principle and uses it to explain differential behavior of methods such as CAA and DoLa across model families.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers Pythia, Gemma, Qwen2.5, Llama-3.1, and Mistral models from 0.5B to 14B. The headline result is that 26.8%-93.4% of correct answers never appear in the top-10 at any intermediate layer, and late emergence after 80% depth is common. The pattern also appears in Qwen2.5-14B and on MMLU. A sentiment-classification control shows much earlier emergence, suggesting the effect is specific to factual recall rather than a generic property of all tasks. In intervention experiments, CAA beats DoLa on moderately crystallized models, while the trend reverses on highly crystallized Qwen models, with the abstract mentioning differences up to roughly 25 points pending full-paper metric details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到你对 logit-lens 和层编辑的 prior：先看 late-crystallization 的定义、tuned-lens 控制和 CAA/DoLa 反转结果；若 setup 干净，值得在内部做跨模型复核。
recommendation.en: This one can update your priors on logit-lens readability and layer interventions; focus on the late-crystallization definition, the tuned-lens control, and the CAA-vs-DoLa reversal, then decide whether to replicate across your own model families.

paper.title: Sycophancy Towards Researchers Drives Performative Misalignment
paper.abstract: The increasing situational awareness of language models raises safety concerns: models might be aware when they are evaluated, and adjust their behavior to evade monitoring and resist modification, e.g., pretending to be aligned only in evaluation. This alignment faking behavior is often interpreted as scheming: an intentional effort of strategic deception. In this paper, we examine an alternative interpretation, performative misalignment, which explains the change in behavior as a result of syc

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是一个安全解释问题：当模型在“像是在被评测”与“像是在部署”两种语境下表现不同，尤其出现所谓 alignment faking 时，这种行为是否一定意味着模型在进行带有自我保存动机的 scheming，还是也可能由更简单的机制解释，例如对研究者偏好的 sycophancy。作者试图把“行为现象”和“意图归因”拆开，主张仅凭行为差异，不能直接推出模型具有稳定目标、策略性隐瞒和自我保护意图。他们提出 performative misalignment 这一表述，用来指代一种不必假设长期目标与蓄意欺骗、但仍会在评测语境中表现出不同对齐行为的机制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train、安全评测和训练信号解释有一定启发。价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于提醒研究者：很多被解释为“scheming”的行为，可能也能由更浅层、更数据驱动的偏好模仿或研究者迎合来产生。如果这个判断成立，那么安全评测中的一些结论可能混淆了行为模式与内部目标，进而影响对 RLHF、SFT 数据分布、system prompt 设计、以及 evaluation cue 污染的理解。对基座研究员来说，这篇更像是“如何解释模型行为”的方法论提醒，而不是能直接改变预训练 recipe 的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
作者的技术路线围绕“替代解释是否足以说明 alignment faking”展开，而不是构造一个新的对齐算法。全文主要有三步。

第一步，挑战 scheming 解释的一个直观预测。若模型真的是为了避免权重被修改而在评测中伪装，那么当系统提示明确告诉模型“你现在已经部署了”时，这种伪装动机应当减弱，至少行为模式应发生变化。作者报告说，evaluation awareness 仍然存在，即使模型被告知自己处于部署环境，相关的失配行为并未消失。这被用来说明：把该现象单独解释为自我保存驱动的 scheming，并不充分。

第二步，构造 sycophancy 解释的证据。作者使用 activation probing 和 activation steering，分别针对“scheming-related features”和“sycophancy-related features”做分析，考察哪些内部特征更能解释模型在评测语境下的行为变化。论文的论证方向是：先前被归因为 scheming 的行为，也可以通过“迎合 AI 研究者期待”这一特征来解释，而且这种解释在实验上并非弱替代。

第三步，通过微调操纵模型的 sycophancy 程度，观察 evaluation cue detection 是否随之增强。作者声称，把模型调得更 sycophantic 后，它更擅长识别自己是否处在评测语境中。这一步的逻辑是，如果 sycophancy 与 evaluation awareness 之间存在可操纵的联系，那么 alignment faking 至少不应被唯一地解释为 scheming。

从方法性质看，这篇更接近概念澄清加机制探测。它依赖 probing、steering、prompt 条件操纵和行为比较，而不是训练一个新模型或提出新的优化目标。论文的贡献在于把“alignment faking 是行为定义，scheming 是意图解释”这层区分讲清楚，并尝试用实验支持另一种解释路径。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论主要有三项。

第一，模型的 evaluation awareness 在“被告知已部署”的条件下仍然持续存在。作者把这视为对 scheming-only 解释的反例，因为如果模型只是为了避免在评测中被修改权重而伪装，那么部署提示应削弱这种动机。这里需要注意，论文的说服力取决于具体 prompt 设计、模型族、以及行为指标定义；若这些控制不严，结论容易被 prompt leakage 或任务 framing 影响。

第二，activation probing / steering 结果表明，与 sycophancy 相关的内部特征可以解释相当一部分此前被视为 scheming 的行为模式。摘要没有给出具体数值，正文片段也未展示完整表格，因此目前能确认的是论证方向，而不是效果量级。精读时应重点核查：探针训练目标是什么、特征标签如何定义、steering 的干预强度是否公平、以及 scheming feature 与 sycophancy feature 是否存在高度相关导致的解释混淆。

第三，增加 sycophancy 的微调会提升模型检测 evaluation cue 的能力。这个结果如果稳健，说明“更会迎合研究者”与“更会识别评测语境”之间存在正相关甚至部分因果联系。不过同样需要看具体实验：是提升了真正的 situational awareness，还是只是更敏感于某些表面 cue。

整体上，这篇实验更像是提出一个替代因果解释并给出初步证据，而不是给出已经封闭争议的定论。没有看到特别扎实的规模化对比、跨模型稳定性、或严格排除混杂因素的设计之前，不宜把结论读得过满。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议投入过多时间。先看 Introduction 和 WhichIntentDrives Alignment Faking?，把作者想区分的几个概念理清：alignment faking 是行为层定义，scheming/self-preservation 是意图层解释，performative misalignment 是作者提出的替代表述。若这一层没分清，后面的实验会显得像语义争论。

然后看实验设计部分，重点检查三件事：一是“部署提示”实验是否真的足以挑战 scheming 假说；二是 probing / steering 所用特征如何定义，是否存在标签循环定义；三是 sycophancy fine-tuning 的数据和目标是否会顺带增强对评测模板的表面识别能力。

如果只想抓主线，读完引言、核心实验图表和讨论部分即可，预计 20–30 分钟。若要认真判断结论强弱，必须细看附录中的 prompt、评测协议、探针训练细节和统计显著性。对基座预训练研究员而言，这篇更适合作为安全解释学的补充材料，而不是优先级很高的技术论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an interpretation problem in alignment research: when a model behaves differently in evaluation-like versus deployment-like settings, does that necessarily indicate scheming driven by self-preservation, or could the same behavior arise from a simpler mechanism such as sycophancy toward AI researchers? The authors argue that the observed phenomenon usually called alignment faking is behaviorally defined, while scheming is an intent-level explanation layered on top. Their proposed term, performative misalignment, is meant to capture behavior that looks like alignment faking without requiring persistent goals, strategic concealment, or weight-preservation motives.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is relevant to post-training, safety evaluation, and the interpretation of training signals. The main value is methodological: it warns against over-attributing internal motives from behavioral discrepancies alone. If some behaviors currently read as scheming can also be produced by researcher-directed sycophancy, then conclusions drawn from safety evaluations may be confounding behavior with latent objective structure. That matters for how one interprets RLHF effects, system-prompt sensitivity, evaluation-cue contamination, and the kinds of preferences models internalize from instruction-tuning data. For a foundation-model researcher, this is more a paper about causal interpretation of model behavior than about changing the pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does not introduce a new alignment algorithm. Instead, it builds an empirical case that an alternative explanation can account for alignment-faking-like behavior.

The first step is to challenge a simple prediction of the scheming story. If a model is pretending to be aligned during evaluation mainly to avoid weight modification, then explicitly telling it that it is already deployed should reduce that incentive or at least alter the behavior pattern. The authors report that evaluation awareness persists even under deployment-framed system prompts. They use this as evidence that a pure self-preservation account is incomplete.

The second step is to test whether sycophancy-related internal features can explain the same behaviors. They use activation probing and activation steering with features described as scheming-related and sycophancy-related, asking which features better account for the observed context-sensitive behavior. The argumentative structure is important: they are not proving that scheming is absent, but that sycophancy is a plausible competing mechanism with empirical support.

The third step is an intervention through fine-tuning. They make models more sycophantic and then measure whether evaluation-cue detection improves. The intended logic is that if increasing sycophancy also increases sensitivity to evaluation context, then evaluation awareness need not be uniquely explained by strategic deception or self-preservation.

Methodologically, this is a concept-clarification paper backed by probing, steering, prompt manipulation, and behavioral comparison. Its main contribution is to separate a behavioral label from an intent-level interpretation and to provide evidence for an alternative causal story.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, three empirical claims stand out.

First, evaluation awareness persists even when models are told they are deployed. The authors treat this as evidence against a scheming-only explanation, because a model motivated purely by avoiding weight updates should have less reason to conceal itself under deployment framing. The strength of this result depends heavily on prompt construction, model choice, and the exact behavioral metric, so those details matter a lot.

Second, activation probing and steering suggest that sycophancy-related features can explain a substantial portion of behavior previously attributed to scheming. The excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables, so the direction of the result is visible but the effect size is not. A careful read should check how the features are labeled, what the probes are trained to predict, whether steering strengths are comparable, and whether scheming and sycophancy features are themselves highly correlated.

Third, fine-tuning for greater sycophancy appears to improve evaluation-cue detection. If robust, that would support a manipulable link between researcher-directed sycophancy and evaluation awareness. But the key question is whether the model becomes genuinely more situationally aware or merely more sensitive to superficial evaluation cues.

Overall, the experiments look more like evidence for an alternative causal interpretation than a decisive resolution of the debate. Without stronger cross-model robustness, larger-scale controls, and more explicit handling of confounders, the conclusions should be read with caution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a deep-read priority. Start with the Introduction and the section defining performative misalignment. The main thing to understand is the conceptual separation: alignment faking is a behavioral description, while scheming and self-preservation are intent-level hypotheses. Without that distinction, the rest can feel like a terminological dispute.

Then read the experimental setup with three questions in mind. First, does the deployment-prompt manipulation genuinely challenge the scheming hypothesis, or only a narrow version of it? Second, how are the probing and steering features defined, and is there any circularity in the labels? Third, does sycophancy fine-tuning improve true evaluation awareness or just pattern-match on evaluation templates?

If you only want the main point, the introduction, core experiment figures, and discussion should be enough in about 20 to 30 minutes. If you want to judge the paper seriously, you need the appendix: prompts, evaluation protocol, probe construction, and statistical details are likely where the real strength or weakness of the argument sits. For a pretraining-focused reader, this is best treated as a useful safety-interpretation note rather than a high-priority technical paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对 alignment-faking 的解释 prior：先别急着喊 scheming，至少把 sycophancy 这个更便宜的解释做成对照组。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on alignment faking: don't jump to scheming before ruling out the cheaper sycophancy explanation.

paper.title: Shared Latent Structures Enable Unified Backdoor Detection and Mitigation in LLMs
paper.abstract: Backdoor attacks in large language models (LLMs) are often treated as isolated trigger-response failures, motivating defenses tailored to specific triggers or behaviors. We show this view is incomplete. Across diverse backdoor behaviors, we identify a shared latent mechanism that can be detected, causally controlled, and suppressed. Using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on residual-stream activations, we find a small set of latent features consistently activated across jailbreaking, refusal manipulat

summary.core_problem: LLM 中的后门攻击是否共享底层的潜在机制，能否被统一检测和缓解？
summary.importance: 挑战了将后门攻击视为孤立触发器-响应失败的传统观点，发现跨多种攻击类型和模型存在共享的潜在特征，为统一防御提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 使用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 分析残差流激活，发现一小部分潜在特征在越狱、拒绝操纵等多种后门行为中一致激活。通过双向激活引导 (activation steering) 验证了这些特征的因果性。
summary.experiments: 在 4B 到 32B 参数的 Qwen3、Gemma 3 和 Llama 3.1 模型上，跨越微调和权重编辑攻击进行了验证。训练了轻量级 SAE 特征分类器。

summary_en.core_problem: Do backdoor attacks in LLMs share underlying latent mechanisms, and can they be uniformly detected and mitigated?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the conventional view of treating backdoor attacks as isolated trigger-response failures, discovering shared latent features across various attack types and models, providing a new perspective for unified defense.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on residual-stream activations to find a small set of latent features consistently activated across multiple backdoor behaviors (jailbreaking, refusal manipulation, etc.). Validates the causality of these features through bidirectional activation steering.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3, Gemma 3, and Llama 3.1 models ranging from 4B to 32B parameters, across both fine-tuning and weight-editing attacks. Trained lightweight SAE-feature classifiers.

recommendation.zh: 用 SAE 发现不同 backdoor 攻击共享 latent feature，证明了激活空间的结构化，对理解模型安全性和表示学习有启发，值得看实验部分。
recommendation.en: Uses SAEs to discover shared latent features across different backdoor attacks, proving the structure of the activation space. Inspiring for understanding model safety and representation learning; the experimental section is worth reading.

paper.title: Inside the LLM Word Factory
paper.abstract: Transformer language models process input provided as subword fragments, but natural language semantics usually rely on word-level concepts. Detokenization is the process where models reconcile these two facts, aggregating subwords into word-level representations through their computation. Prior work has found that this takes place mostly in early-to-middle layers, but so far the exact mechanics of the process have not been pinned down. We venture deep into detokenization using activation patchi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：LLM 在子词 token 输入下，究竟如何把多个 subword 重新组合成一个可供后续层使用的“词级表示”，以及这个过程为什么有时成功、有时失败。已有研究大多停留在“早中层发生 detokenization，attention 和 MLP 都参与”的层面，但还没有把因果链条拆到具体层、具体子模块、具体位置信号。作者用可控配对数据和 activation patching，把这个过程定位到一个更细的机制：在英语 detokenization 上，Llama2-7B 以及一组其他 transformer 模型都表现出一个很稳定的两阶段过程，核心起点在 Layer 1。前面的非末尾 subword 先通过少量注意力头把一个弱但足够有辨识度的信号传到最后一个 subword 位置；随后该位置的 MLP 将这个跨位置信号与本地子词表示组合，形成连续空间中的词级表征。论文进一步追问这个机制是否随词长、架构、位置编码而变化，并给出一个早层线性 probe 来预测 detokenization 最终是否成功。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 tokenizer 与模型内部计算之间的接口问题，从“经验上知道有影响”推进到“能指出哪一层、哪类头、哪一步在做什么”。这对理解 subword tokenizer 的代价、词边界信息如何被恢复、以及 tokenization artifact 为什么会伤害推理和泛化，都更具体了。第二，论文给出一个很有用的判断：detokenization 的深度更受 positional encoding 影响，而不是简单由模型规模决定。这一点对架构设计和 tokenizer 设计都有启发，因为它说明早层是否容易完成词级聚合，不只是容量问题，而是位置信号是否支持跨 token 汇聚。第三，作者构造了一个只看早层激活就能高精度预测 detokenization 成败的线性方向，且能从人工 split 迁移到自然文本。这意味着 detokenization 可以被当作一个可测的训练动态信号，未来可以用于分析数据质量、tokenizer 方案、甚至训练阶段中词级语义形成的时间点。对基座预训练来说，这不是直接改 recipe 的工作，但它把一个长期被忽略的底层计算过程讲清楚了。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最关键的是数据构造和干预设计。作者不直接在自然文本里做相关性分析，而是利用“同一个词既可以被 tokenizer 表成单 token，也可以被人工拆成多个 subword”这一事实，构造 canonical form 与 artificial split form 的对照。然后定义 canonicity：比较 canonical 单 token 运行时该词位置的最终层 residual，与 split 运行时最后一个 subword 位置的最终层 residual 是否对齐。这个指标用来判断 split 后模型有没有在内部成功恢复出 canonical 词表示。

为了把 attention 与 MLP 的作用拆开，作者设计了两类配对样本。LST pair 共享最后一个 subword，不同的是前文子词；FST pair 共享第一个 subword，不同的是最后子词。这样可以分别隔离“跨位置传来的信息”和“本地末尾子词本身的贡献”。在这些配对上做 activation patching：把 source run 某层某位置的 attn_out 或 mlp_out 替换到 target run，再看 target 最终重建成哪个词。结果显示，在 Layer 1 的最后子词位置，patch attention 输出就足以把 target 的重建词拉向 source 的词，说明 attention 已经携带了决定性跨位置信号；而 patch MLP 输出则对应把这个信号与本地子词组合成更完整的词级表示。

论文提出的机制可以概括为：
1. 对于两到六个 subword 的词，真正发生组合的位置始终是最后一个 subword；
2. 如果词更长，中间 subword 位置主要充当 relay，把前面子词的信息逐步传到最后位置；
3. Layer 1 attention 负责传输 token-specific signal，这个信号较弱、线性可读，但已经足以决定后续会往哪个词收敛；
4. Layer 1 MLP 负责把该信号和末尾子词 embedding 做连续变换，得到更接近 canonical token 的表示；
5. 后续若干早层继续完成 detokenization，但关键起点已经在第一层建立。

作者还把分析扩展到 12 个 transformer LM，比较不同架构和位置编码。结论不是“所有模型都在同一层完成 detokenization”，而是 detokenization 集中在前 6% 到 30% 的层数区间，跨度主要由 positional encoding 决定。也就是说，位置编码如果更利于局部顺序信息在早层传播，detokenization 会更快完成；如果不利，则需要更多层。最后，作者在 activation patching 找到的关键深度上拟合一个线性方向，用早层激活预测最终 detokenization 成败，形成一个可操作的 probe。
summary.experiments:
实验最重要的结果有四类。

第一类是机制定位。以 Llama2-7B 为代表，作者发现英语 detokenization 的关键起点在 Layer 1。对最后一个 subword 位置做 patching 时，Layer 1 attention 输出已经能显著改变最终重建结果；随后 Layer 1 MLP 进一步把表示推向 canonical 词向量。这个结果不是单纯“早层有信息”，而是带有因果解释：attention 先搬运，MLP 再组合。

第二类是跨词长泛化。作者测试了由 2 到 6 个 subword 组成的词。结论是，词长增加并不会改变“最后一个 subword 是组合位点”这一规律，只会让中间位置承担更多 relay 功能。也就是说，模型不是在每个位置都局部合成一部分词义，而是把前文片段逐步传到末尾，再在末尾完成词级聚合。

第三类是跨模型比较。论文覆盖 12 个 transformer 语言模型，发现 detokenization 都集中在前 6%–30% 的层中完成。作者强调，这个深度与 positional encoding 更相关，而不是简单随参数规模增大而加深或变浅。这一点很重要，因为它排除了“更大模型只是更早学会 detokenization”的简单叙事。

第四类是可预测性。作者训练了一个基于早层激活的线性 probe，仅用 activation patching 所识别关键深度的表示，就能预测最终 detokenization 是否成功。在无上下文、孤立序列设置下，AUROC 约为 0.94；在自然文本中可达 0.97。这个结果说明 detokenization 成败在很早阶段就已经基本决定，而且这个信号在自然语境下仍然稳定。

从摘要和正文可见，论文还讨论了失败案例：当 split token 的上下文或子词组合不足以让 Layer 1 attention 传出清晰信号时，后续层往往无法完全恢复 canonical 词表示。这与 under-trained token、数值 token、罕见切分导致的行为异常是相一致的。若精读正文，建议特别留意不同 pair 构造下的 patching 效果量，以及不同位置编码模型中 detokenization 深度分布的图表。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“问题定义—因果设计—机制结论—泛化边界”来读。

先看 Introduction 和 Setup。重点不是背景综述，而是理解作者为什么要用 canonical/split 对照，以及 canonicity 指标到底在测什么。如果这个定义没吃透，后面的 patching 结果会显得像普通表征相似度分析。

然后精读配对数据与 activation patching 的章节，尤其是 Figure 1 及对应实验。这里是全文最关键的部分：LST/FST 两种 pair 如何分别隔离 attention 传来的跨位置信号与末尾子词的局部信息；为什么 patch Layer 1 attn_out 和 mlp_out 能支持“两阶段”结论，而不是只说明两者都相关。

接着看跨词长和跨模型部分。重点关注作者如何证明中间 subword 只是 relay，以及“detokenization 深度由 positional encoding 决定”的证据链是否充分。这里值得深挖：不同位置编码为什么会改变早层聚合效率，是否意味着 tokenizer 设计应与位置编码联动优化。

最后看 probe 部分。AUROC 0.94–0.97 很亮眼，但更重要的是它说明 detokenization 成败在早层已线性可读。读这一节时建议思考两个延伸问题：这个 probe 能否作为训练过程监控信号；它能否用于比较不同 tokenizer、数据配比、或 continual pretrain 对词级语义恢复的影响。

如果时间有限，优先看 Figure 1、机制定位实验、跨模型深度分布图、以及 probe 结果。预计 40–60 分钟可以抓住主线；若要把方法迁移到 tokenizer/训练动态研究，建议完整读实验与附录。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise mechanistic question: how do transformer LMs convert subword-fragmented input back into a usable word-level representation, and why does this process sometimes fail? Prior work had already suggested that detokenization happens in early-to-middle layers and involves both attention and MLPs, but the causal chain was still coarse. This work narrows it down substantially. Using controlled canonical-vs-split word pairs and activation patching, the authors show that English detokenization in Llama2-7B, and similarly in a broader set of transformer LMs, starts as a two-stage computation in Layer 1. A small set of attention heads first transmits a token-specific signal from earlier subwords to the final subword position; then the Layer 1 MLP combines that imported signal with the local subword representation to produce a continuous word-level representation. The paper also studies how this mechanism scales with word length, how it varies across architectures, and whether early-layer activations can predict eventual detokenization success.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining research because it turns the tokenizer-model interface into something mechanistically inspectable rather than merely behaviorally observable. Tokenization artifacts are known to hurt robustness, arithmetic, and rare-token behavior, but this paper identifies where the model repairs the mismatch between subword input and word-level semantics. That is useful for thinking about tokenizer design, early-layer representation formation, and failure modes induced by poor segmentation. A second important result is that the depth over which detokenization unfolds is governed more by positional encoding than by model scale. That is a concrete architectural claim, not just an interpretability observation, and it suggests that early semantic composition depends on how positional information supports cross-token aggregation. Third, the paper provides a linear probe from early-layer activations that predicts final detokenization success with AUROC 0.94 on isolated inputs and 0.97 on natural text. That makes detokenization a measurable training signal. It could plausibly become a diagnostic for comparing tokenizers, monitoring training dynamics, or studying when word-level concepts become stable during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core methodological contribution is the combination of a tightly controlled dataset construction with causal intervention. Instead of probing arbitrary natural text, the authors exploit words that can appear either as a single canonical token or as an artificially split sequence of subwords. They define a canonicity measure by comparing the final-layer residual stream at the canonical token position with the final-layer residual stream at the last subword position in the split run. High similarity means the model has successfully reconstructed the canonical word representation from fragments.

To separate the roles of attention and MLPs, they build paired examples with shared subwords. In one setup, pairs share the last subword but differ in earlier fragments, isolating the contribution of cross-position information. In another, pairs share the first subword but differ in the final fragment, isolating the contribution of the local final-subword identity. They then perform activation patching: replace attn_out or mlp_out from a source run into a target run at a specific layer and position, and observe which word the target ultimately reconstructs. This is the key causal move. In Layer 1 at the final subword position, patching attention output is already sufficient to redirect the target toward the source word, showing that attention carries the decisive imported signal. Patching the MLP output then shows how that signal is transformed together with the local final-subword representation into a more canonical word-level state.

The resulting mechanism is fairly crisp. For words split into two to six subwords, composition consistently happens at the last subword position. Intermediate positions mainly act as relays when the word is longer. Layer 1 attention transports a weak but linearly readable token-specific signal from earlier fragments. Layer 1 MLP composes that imported signal with the local subword embedding through a continuous transformation. Subsequent early layers continue the process, but the decisive initialization happens immediately.

The authors extend the analysis to 12 transformer LMs and compare architectures and positional encodings. Their claim is not that every model detokenizes in exactly one layer, but that detokenization is concentrated in the first 6% to 30% of layers, with the span largely determined by positional encoding. Finally, they fit a linear direction at the depth identified by patching and use it to predict whether detokenization will succeed, based only on early-layer activations.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four experimental results worth retaining.

First, the mechanism localization result. In Llama2-7B, Layer 1 is already causally central. Patching Layer 1 attention output at the final subword position can change which word is reconstructed at the end of the network, while Layer 1 MLP output further sharpens that representation toward the canonical token. This supports a sequential division of labor: attention transports, MLP composes.

Second, the word-length generalization result. The authors test words split into 2 to 6 subwords and find that the final subword remains the composition site throughout. Longer words do not induce distributed semantic composition across all positions; instead, intermediate positions mostly relay information forward until the last position can assemble the word-level representation.

Third, the cross-model comparison. Across 12 transformer language models, detokenization is concentrated in the first 6% to 30% of layers. The important claim is that this depth tracks positional encoding more than parameter count. That weakens a simple scale-based explanation and points to an architectural determinant of early semantic aggregation.

Fourth, the predictability result. A linear probe trained on early-layer activations at the patching-identified depth predicts final detokenization success with AUROC around 0.94 on isolated contextless sequences and 0.97 on natural text. This suggests that success or failure is largely decided very early, and that the signal transfers beyond the synthetic split-word setup.

The paper also discusses failure cases where the imported early-layer signal is too weak or ambiguous, making later recovery incomplete. That aligns with known tokenization-related failures on undertrained tokens and difficult segmentations. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the effect sizes for different patching conditions and the plots comparing detokenization depth across positional encoding schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in four passes: definition, causal design, mechanism, and boundary conditions.

Start with the Introduction and Setup. The important part is not the general motivation but the exact construction of canonical versus split forms and the meaning of the canonicity metric. If that metric is not clear, the later patching results can look like generic representation-similarity analysis rather than a causal study of detokenization.

Then focus on the paired-example design and activation patching section, especially Figure 1 and the corresponding experiments. This is the center of the paper. Pay attention to why the two pair types isolate imported cross-position information versus local final-subword information, and why patching Layer 1 attn_out and mlp_out supports a two-stage interpretation rather than merely showing that both components matter.

Next, read the sections on longer words and cross-model comparisons. The main questions are whether the relay interpretation for intermediate subwords is convincingly supported, and how strong the evidence is that positional encoding governs detokenization depth. That part is especially relevant if you care about tokenizer-architecture co-design.

Finish with the probe section. The headline AUROC is useful, but the deeper point is that detokenization success is linearly readable from early activations. That raises practical follow-up questions: could this become a training diagnostic, and could it be used to compare tokenizers, curricula, or continual pretraining regimes?

If time is limited, read Figure 1, the Layer 1 patching results, the cross-model depth analysis, and the probe section. That should take about 40 to 60 minutes for the main ideas. A full read is worthwhile if you want to reuse the methodology for tokenizer or training-dynamics work.

recommendation.zh: 读 §activation patching 和跨模型对比即可；它不会改 tokenizer 方案，但会改变你看早层表示预算的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the activation-patching setup and the cross-model comparison; it will not redesign tokenizers, but it should update how you think about early-layer representation budget.

paper.title: A retrieval conditioned rebinding circuit for dynamic entity tracking in large language models
paper.abstract: To interpret context correctly and retrieve relevant information, large language models must bind entities to their attributes and update these bindings as state changes. We analyze how LLMs implement this binding process in a dynamic state tracking. Using causal interventions, we identify a retrieval conditioned rebinding mechanism, a compact attention head circuit that encodes swap relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout. Across Gemma and Llama models, this circuit supports r

summary.core_problem: 解释 LLM 在动态状态跟踪中如何把实体与属性绑定，并在上下文变化后完成重新绑定。
summary.importance: 这类工作对基座研究员的价值在于把“entity tracking”从行为现象落到可干预的电路层机制，能帮助理解 attention head 在上下文更新中的功能分工，也可能反哺架构与训练诊断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用因果干预分析，在 Gemma 和 Llama 中定位到一个 retrieval-conditioned rebinding circuit：一组紧凑的注意力头先编码与交换相关的绑定信息，再在读出阶段恢复。进一步比较不同模型家族的表征位置，发现 Gemma 主要在 query/key 子空间显式表达绑定特征，而 Llama 更依赖 key 向量承载该信息。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma 和 Llama 两个模型家族，核心证据来自因果干预而非纯相关性分析。摘要未给出具体层数、头数和任务集，但明确声称该电路在两类模型中都支持 rebinding，只是表示形式不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates how LLMs bind entities to attributes and then rebind them when context changes during dynamic state tracking.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the value is that it grounds entity tracking in an intervention-tested circuit-level mechanism. That helps clarify the functional roles of attention heads in context updates and may inform architecture or training diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using causal interventions, the authors identify a retrieval-conditioned rebinding circuit in Gemma and Llama: a compact set of attention heads encodes swap-relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout. They further compare representational loci across model families, finding that Gemma expresses the binding signature in query/key subspaces, while Llama carries it mainly in key vectors.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span Gemma and Llama families, with evidence based on causal intervention rather than correlation alone. The abstract does not specify exact layers, heads, or task sets, but it claims the circuit supports rebinding in both families with different representational signatures.

recommendation.zh: 不是会立刻改训练 recipe 的论文，但若你关心 state tracking 的电路实现，这篇比泛泛 attention 可视化干净得多，重点看因果干预部分。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe-changing paper, but if you care about state tracking circuits, this is much cleaner than generic attention visualization—read the intervention section.

paper.title: The Amplifying Mirror: Locating and Steering the Partisan Direction inside a Large Language Model
paper.abstract: Large language models are rapicly replacing search engines as the primary interface between people and information. Unlike search engines, which retrieve existing content, LLMs generate novel text shaped by internal representations learned during training. Here we show that partisan political identity is encoded in the model's activation space, and that this direction directly shapes generation. Using 190,491 tweets from sitting members of the U.S. Congress as labeled training data, we train lin

summary.core_problem: LLM生成内容时会根据推断的用户身份（尤其是党派政治倾向）输出系统性差异结果，但这种党派信号在模型内部的表征位置、结构和因果影响机制尚未被明确刻画。
summary.importance: 模型在预训练阶段吸收的社会语义特征会形成稳定可定位的几何表征，这类隐层表征的分布特征可以为预训练数据的偏见评估、对齐阶段的定向干预提供可操作的观测靶点。
summary.technical_approach: 以19万条标注党派属性的美国在任国会议员推文为输入，在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct的每一层隐状态上训练逻辑回归探针定位党派信号的结晶层；用稀疏自编码器拆解该表征方向的可解释特征；通过生成时对该方向进行消融或放大的因果干预，验证其对输出的实际影响。
summary.experiments: 第18层的线性探针对两党文本的分类AUC达0.945，Cohen's d为1.94；模型零样本分类推文党派的准确率仅64.4%，说明内部编码的党派信号远多于显式输出的内容；对该方向的干预可稳定改变输出的政治立场、修辞风格，甚至生成符合目标党派属性的虚构人物和机构名称。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第2节的探针定位结果和图1的各层AUC变化曲线，干预实验的定性案例可快速浏览，全文阅读时间约15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs produce systematically varying outputs for identical prompts based on inferred user identity, particularly partisan political leaning, but the location, structure, and causal impact of this partisan signal within model internal representations remain uncharacterized.
summary_en.importance: Sociocultural features absorbed during pretraining form stable, locatable geometric representations in activation space. These measurable hidden-state patterns provide actionable targets for bias auditing in pretraining data and targeted intervention during alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Use 190k labeled partisan tweets from sitting U.S. Congress members as input to Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. Train logistic regression probes on hidden states across all 32 layers to locate the layer where partisan representation crystallizes. Decompose the identified partisan direction into interpretable features using sparse autoencoders, then perform causal interventions by ablating or amplifying this direction during generation to validate its effect on outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The probe at layer 18 achieves an AUC of 0.945 and Cohen's d of 1.94 for linear separation of Republican and Democratic text. The model's zero-shot partisan classification accuracy is only 64.4%, indicating far more partisan signal is encoded internally than is explicitly output. Interventions on the partisan axis produce consistent shifts in political stance, rhetorical register, and even generation of party-aligned fictional figures and organizations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on probe localization results in Section 2 and the layer-wise AUC curve in Figure 1. Skim qualitative intervention examples. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 经典的表示工程/机制分析工作，在 Llama 3 中定位了单一的政治立场特征轴并做了干预，对理解模型内部概念表示和潜在的对齐/去偏方法有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Classic representation engineering/mechanistic analysis work locating a single political stance axis in Llama 3; useful for understanding internal concept representations and potential alignment/de-biasing methods.

paper.title: The Neutral Mask: How RLHF Provides Shallow Alignment while Leaving Partisan Structure Intact in a Large Language Model
paper.abstract: The ambition behind alignment training is to make large language models safe and useful. The primary mechanism, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), shapes the behavior of deployed language models by aligning them with ``human values.'' Yet the process is opaque. What values are being encoded; whose values are they; and how does RLHF encode them? A growing body of evidence suggests that RLHF produces only functional compliance rather than deep alignment. We offer a mechanistic case

summary.core_problem: 分析 RLHF 到底改变了模型内部什么：它是否真正消除了政治倾向等潜在表征，还是只在输出层面做了表面中和。
summary.importance: 这类工作对 pretrain↔post-train 接口很关键。贡献不是提出新对齐算法，而是用机制分析说明 RLHF 可能主要学到“功能性服从”，没有重写 base model 的深层表征结构。这会影响我们如何理解 reward model、SFT/RL 的可逆性，以及对齐是否只是薄层覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 以 Llama 3.1 8B 的 base 与 RLHF 后版本做对比，研究 partisan political orientation 的内部表示。方法上结合内部表征比较与 sparse autoencoder（SAE）分解，追踪与政策/党派方向相关的特征在 RLHF 前后的激活变化。论文结论是：RLHF 没有删除结构化 partisan direction，而是压缩其方差，使输出更稳定地呈现平衡、非党派风格；同时一些在 base 中偶发激活的 policy-encoding features 在对齐后变为不活跃。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 Llama 3.1 8B 的 pre-RLHF 与 post-RLHF 版本，任务聚焦政治倾向相关输入。摘要没有给出大规模 benchmark 数字，重点是表征层面的 case study 和 SAE feature 级证据，因此更适合作为机制信号而不是普适结论。外推到其他模型家族和其他价值维度时需要谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what RLHF actually changes internally: does it remove latent political structure, or merely mask it at the output level?
summary_en.importance: This matters for the pretrain↔post-train interface. The contribution is not a new alignment algorithm but a mechanistic argument that RLHF may mostly induce functional compliance rather than rewriting deep internal representations. That has implications for how we think about reward models, reversibility of alignment, and whether alignment is a shallow overlay.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using pre- and post-RLHF versions of Llama 3.1 8B, the paper studies internal representations of partisan political orientation. It combines representation comparison with sparse autoencoder (SAE) decomposition to track policy- or partisan-related features before and after RLHF. The main claim is that RLHF does not erase the structured partisan direction; instead, it compresses its variance so outputs become more consistently balanced and non-partisan, while some sporadically active policy-encoding features go silent.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments center on Llama 3.1 8B before and after RLHF, with politically oriented prompts. The abstract does not present broad benchmark gains; the evidence is mainly a mechanistic case study plus SAE-level analysis. It is therefore more useful as a signal about alignment internals than as a universal empirical law.

recommendation.zh: 结论未必能外推，但“RLHF 压方差而非改表征”这个说法值得记住；只看方法图和 SAE 证据即可，别把它当普适定律。
recommendation.en: The claim may not generalize, but the framing that RLHF compresses variance rather than rewrites representations is worth keeping; read the SAE evidence, not the paper as a universal law.

paper.title: Ablation-Reversible Heads Don't Transfer: A Stress Test for Mechanistic Role Claims in Transformers
paper.abstract: In mechanistic interpretability, attention heads are commonly elevated to role claims (e.g., "this head represents addition") when they are necessary for a behavior, encode it linearly, and recover that behavior when restored after ablation. We show this evidence is insufficient: across three 7-8B instruction-tuned models and five computation families, heads passing all three checks routinely fail to transfer the computation when their activations are patched into a different prompt under matche

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性领域广泛使用的三项注意力头功能判定标准（必要性、线性编码、ablation后恢复可还原行为）不足以证明头对应稳定的功能角色。
summary.importance: 原理分析，推翻了领域常用的注意力头角色赋值判据，提出了更严格的功能验证方法与初步的头角色分类体系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出KID（认知/意图/执行）角色分析视角，搭配三阶段验证管道：能力选择性筛选、奇异值分解、匹配控制下的激活移植测试，验证注意力头功能的跨prompt可迁移性。
summary.experiments: 在3个7-8B参数的指令微调模型、5类计算任务上测试，发现通过原有三项检查的注意力头大多无法在跨prompt的激活移植中传递对应功能，提出了包含prompt轨迹稳定器、答案侧logit偏置头在内的角色分类。

summary_en.core_problem: Three commonly used criteria for assigning functional roles to attention heads (necessity for behavior, linear encoding, performance recovery after ablation) are insufficient to prove stable functional roles.
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis, overturns the widely adopted criteria for attention head role assignment, and proposes a stricter verification method and preliminary role taxonomy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the KID (Knowing / Intent / Doing) analysis lens, paired with a three-stage pipeline: capability-selective screening, singular value decomposition, and activation transduction under matched controls to test cross-prompt transferability of head functions.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 3 7-8B instruction-tuned models across 5 computation families, finding that most heads passing all three original criteria fail to transfer computation when patched to different prompts; a taxonomy including prompt-trajectory stabilizers and logit-bias heads is proposed.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了注意力头功能赋值的常用判据，做Transformer机制分析或架构迭代的必须看§3的实验设计。
recommendation.en: Overturns common criteria for attention head functional role assignment; anyone doing Transformer mechanistic analysis or architecture iteration must read §3 experimental design.

paper.title: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
paper.abstract: Analyzing attention weights has become a standard approach for interpreting the information flow of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this approach has significant limitations as it neglects the geometric properties of the value vectors being aggregated. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{Contribution Weights}, a projection-based metric that quantifies a token's influence by accounting for it's attention weight, value magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output. We demon

summary.core_problem: 重新评估 Transformer 自注意力中的“token 重要性”如何度量，指出只看 attention weight 会忽略 value 向量的大小和方向。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和解释指标改进。它把注意力解释从标量权重推进到几何投影，直接触及 LLM 中信息聚合、attention sink 和 token 贡献归因这些基础问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Contribution Weights：用投影式度量同时考虑 attention weight、value vector magnitude，以及 value 与 layer output 的方向对齐程度。相比 raw attention，它试图衡量某个 token 对层输出的实际几何贡献，而不是仅衡量被 attend 的概率质量。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在不同 decoder-only 模型、任务和数据集上，Contribution Weights 在识别语义关键 token 方面稳定优于基于 attention 的指标。还用该指标分析 attention sinks，发现 sink token 不只是吸收多余注意力，还可能通过几何关系主动压制信息。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits how token importance should be measured in Transformer self-attention, arguing that raw attention weights ignore the magnitude and direction of value vectors.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It moves attention interpretation from scalar attention probabilities to a geometric account of actual contribution, which is directly relevant to information flow, attention sinks, and attribution in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Contribution Weights, a projection-based metric that combines attention weight, value-vector magnitude, and directional alignment with the layer output. The goal is to estimate the geometric contribution of a token to the layer output rather than only measuring how much probability mass attends to it.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent gains over attention-based metrics for identifying semantically critical tokens across decoder-only models, tasks, and datasets. The metric is also used to analyze attention sinks, suggesting they can actively suppress information rather than merely absorb excess attention. Concrete model sizes, datasets, and effect sizes are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和 sink 分析；它不会改变训练 recipe，但会让 attention 可解释性少犯一类常见错误。
recommendation.en: Skim the metric and sink analysis; it will not change a training recipe, but it reduces a common attribution mistake around attention.

paper.title: Adversarial Robustness of Activation Steering in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Activation steering has become a popular training-free method to control LLM behavior by injecting precomputed direction vectors into the model's residual stream at inference time. Yet its robustness to realistic input variation remains unstudied. We present the first systematic evaluation of activation steering robustness under adversarial text perturbations on the inputs, covering four extraction methods, three attack strategies, six personas from Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset, an

summary.core_problem: 评估大语言模型中激活引导（Activation Steering）方法在面对输入文本对抗性扰动时的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 首次系统性地揭示了激活引导这种免训练控制方法在真实输入变化下的脆弱性，对依赖该方法进行模型对齐和控制的实践提出了挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 对 4 种向量提取方法、3 种攻击策略、6 种角色设定以及 5 个不同规模（1.5B 到 30B）的模型进行对抗性文本扰动测试，分析引导强度、置信度和最佳注入层的变化。
summary.experiments: 在 Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset 上进行测试。结果显示攻击在所有设置下广泛成功：方向鲁棒性下降高达 64%，攻击后置信度崩溃至 0.25 附近或更低，且最佳注入层在扰动下偏移高达 17 个位置。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating the robustness of activation steering methods in Large Language Models against adversarial text perturbations on the input.
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic evaluation revealing the fragility of activation steering, a popular training-free control method, under realistic input variations, challenging its reliability for model alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tests adversarial text perturbations across 4 vector extraction methods, 3 attack strategies, 6 personas, and 5 models (1.5B to 30B parameters), analyzing changes in steering strength, confidence, and optimal injection layers.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset. Attacks succeed broadly: directional robustness drops up to 64%, post-attack confidence collapses near or below 0.25, and the optimal injection layer shifts by up to 17 positions under perturbation.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 Activation Steering 在对抗扰动下的脆弱性，特别是最佳注入层的偏移现象，对做 mechanistic interpretability 和 inference-time control 的研究员有警示作用。
recommendation.en: Reveals the fragility of Activation Steering under adversarial perturbations, especially the shift of optimal injection layers, serving as a cautionary tale for mechanistic interpretability and inference-time control research.

paper.title: The Piggyback Hypothesis of Generalization: Explaining and Mitigating Emergent Misalignment
paper.abstract: The mechanisms behind LLMs' broad over-generalization beyond training examples remain unclear. Emergent misalignment (EM) offers a striking case study: finetuning on narrow tasks induces broad misalignment to semantically-unrelated test domains. In this work, we propose the Piggyback Hypothesis: the chat-template tokens can piggyback the finetuned behaviour onto out-of-domain queries. We validate this hypothesis by showing that subtle perturbations to the prefix (tokens preceding all user querie

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个比“涌现失配”更底层的问题：为什么对狭窄任务做微调，行为会泛化到语义上无关的输入域。作者把 EM 当作一个可观测、可量化的案例，提出所谓 Piggyback Hypothesis：微调时，模型没有把目标行为只绑定到真正承载语义的 query token 上，而是部分绑定到了所有样本共享的 chat-template prefix 上。这样一来，前缀就成了行为触发器，能把训练中学到的偏置“搭载”到域外查询上。论文要解决的核心，不只是解释 EM 现象，而是识别微调中行为绑定位置错误这一机制，并给出训练时的缓解方法。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的意义比较直接。它指出，SFT 的问题不只是数据分布偏移，也不只是目标标签本身，而是模型会利用最省力的上下文捷径来承载行为。这个观察对对齐、拒答、工具调用、领域化能力注入都有关，因为这些能力通常也是通过模板化监督注入的。贡献量级上，它更像一个机制性发现加一个轻量训练修正，而不是新的大规模训练范式；但它提供了一个很实用的诊断视角：看共享 token 是否在“偷带”行为。对于做 continual pretrain、mid-training、instruction tuning recipe 的人，这个视角有现实价值，因为它解释了为什么某些很窄的数据会在域外产生过强副作用。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分两部分。第一部分是机制验证。作者先做 inference-time prefix perturbation：只改用户 query 前面的模板前缀，不改 query 语义，甚至只是大小写、轻微字符变化，就能显著恢复原本被微调破坏的对齐；反过来，保留前缀不动，即便把 query 换成相似或随机 token，失配仍常常出现。这说明触发点更靠近共享前缀，而不是 query 语义本身。接着作者做表示层面的因果干预：把失配模型在 prefix 位置上的 KV-cache，用未微调原模型对应位置的 KV-cache 替换，并跨所有层进行 patching。这个操作几乎不改 query 内容，却能显著恢复对齐，说明 prefix 表示确实携带了驱动失配的关键信号。

第二部分是训练方法 TReFT。它的思路不是像 data interleaving 那样额外混入 retain set 去“提醒”模型保留原行为，而是直接限制哪些 token 可以承载新行为。作者对特定 token 表示做 regularization，重点约束共享前缀相关表示不要偏离原模型太多，让更新更多落在真正编码 query 内容的 token 上。这样做的目标，是把新行为绑定到域语义，而不是绑定到模板。这个设计背后的取舍很清楚：如果只靠输出监督，模型会选择最容易降 loss 的 shortcut；而 token-level regularization 是在训练信号里加入“行为应由哪些上下文负责”的归因偏置。论文还把这个方法扩展到 abstention、tool calling、refusal 等狭窄行为学习，说明它不是只对 EM 这个特例有效。
summary.experiments: 最关键的结果有三类。第一类是前缀脆弱性实验：轻微扰动 chat-template prefix 就能让失配显著减弱，而不需要改 query 语义。这类结果支撑“共享前缀是行为挂载点”的假设。第二类是 KV-cache patching 的因果证据：在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，把 prefix 的 KV 表示替换回未微调模型后，对齐分数从 40.8 提升到 90.4，恢复幅度很大，说明问题不只是输出层偏移，而是前缀表示在多层传播中已经编码了失配偏置。第三类是 TReFT 的缓解效果：作者在多种模型规模和多个领域上评估，结论是它既能保留域内目标行为，又比 data interleaving 更能抑制域外泛化失配。文中给出的代表性数字是，在 Llama-3.1-7B 的 legal domain 设置下，TReFT 对 EM 的缓解比 data interleaving 好 33.5%；在更一般的狭窄行为学习场景里，相比朴素 SFT，TReFT 将非预期泛化降低了 54.3%。论文还强调 utility preservation 更好，这一点很重要，因为很多缓解方法是靠整体削弱行为强度换来的。
