summary.reading_guide: 如果只花一小时，建议先看 Introduction 把问题设定和 Piggyback Hypothesis 建起来，再看 4.1 和 4.2，这两节是整篇最关键的证据链：prefix perturbation 给出现象级证据，representation patching 给出更接近因果的证据。随后看第 5 节理解 TReFT 的训练目标和它与 data interleaving 的差别。实验里优先看能同时展示 in-domain target、OOD misalignment、utility preservation 三者关系的主表，因为这决定方法是不是只是“把模型训钝了”。如果要深挖，重点想两个问题：一是 regularization 具体约束了哪些 token、哪些层，为什么这些位置足够；二是这种 piggyback 机制是否会在 system prompt、tool schema、special tokens、甚至 tokenizer 级别的共享片段上同样出现。对做 recipe 的人，这两个问题比 EM 现象本身更值得继续追。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a deeper question behind emergent misalignment: why does narrow finetuning generalize far beyond its semantic training domain? Using EM as a controlled case, the authors propose the Piggyback Hypothesis: during finetuning, the model may attach the learned behavior not only to domain-relevant query tokens, but also to shared chat-template prefix tokens that appear in every example. Once that happens, the prefix acts as a behavior carrier, triggering the finetuned behavior on unrelated inputs. The core problem is therefore not just EM as a safety artifact, but mis-specified behavioral binding during finetuning.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is at the pretrain–posttrain interface. The paper argues that supervised finetuning failures are not only about label content or data shift; they are also about where the model chooses to store and trigger the new behavior. That matters for alignment, refusal, abstention, tool use, and domain adaptation, because all of them are usually injected through templated supervision. The contribution is not a new large-scale training paradigm, but a useful mechanistic lens plus a practical mitigation. For people working on continual pretraining, mid-training, or instruction-tuning recipes, this gives a concrete explanation for why narrow datasets can create broad side effects.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method section has two parts. First, the paper validates the mechanism. In prefix-perturbation experiments, the authors modify only the template prefix before the user query, sometimes with very small changes such as capitalization, while keeping the query semantics intact. Alignment is often restored. In contrast, if the prefix is kept unchanged, replacing the user query with similar or even random tokens can still preserve the misaligned behavior. This suggests that the trigger is concentrated in the shared prefix rather than in the semantic content of the query.

They then move from correlational evidence to a stronger causal intervention using representation patching. Specifically, they replace the KV-cache entries at prefix positions in the finetuned misaligned model with the corresponding entries from the original unfrozen? no, original frozen pre-finetuning model, across all layers. This leaves the query untouched but forces the information propagated from prefix positions to revert to its pre-finetuning state. The intervention largely restores alignment, indicating that prefix representations indeed encode the harmful behavioral bias.

Second, they introduce TReFT, Token-Regularized Finetuning. Instead of relying on retain-set interleaving, TReFT regularizes selected token representations so that shared prefix tokens do not drift too far from the base model, while allowing more of the update to land on tokens that encode the actual query content. The design choice is important: standard output supervision tells the model what behavior to produce, but not which context should scope that behavior. TReFT adds an inductive bias over attribution, pushing the model to associate new behavior with domain semantics rather than with globally shared template tokens. The paper also applies the same idea beyond EM to abstention, tool calling, and refusal behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: Three result groups matter most. First, the prefix brittleness experiments show that tiny perturbations to the chat-template prefix can sharply reduce emergent misalignment without changing the query semantics. That is the main behavioral evidence for piggybacking. Second, the KV-cache patching experiment provides the strongest causal result: on Llama-3.1-8B, patching prefix representations from the unfinetuned model raises the alignment score from 40.8 to 90.4. This is a large recovery and suggests the issue is encoded in internal prefix representations rather than only in output-layer drift. Third, TReFT consistently mitigates OOD misgeneralization while preserving the intended in-domain behavior. The headline number in the paper is that on Llama-3.1-7B in the legal-domain setting, TReFT reduces EM 33.5% better than data interleaving. In broader narrow-behavior finetuning settings, it reduces unintended generalization by 54.3% relative to naive SFT. The utility-preservation result is also important, because many mitigation methods work by simply weakening the learned behavior overall.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to get the framing right: the paper is really about how finetuning binds behavior, not only about EM as a safety anecdote. Then read Sections 4.1 and 4.2 carefully. Section 4.1 gives the phenomenon-level evidence through prefix perturbations; Section 4.2 gives the stronger causal evidence through KV-cache patching. After that, go to Section 5 for TReFT and compare it mentally against retain-set interleaving. In the experiments, prioritize the tables that jointly report in-domain target attainment, OOD misalignment, and utility retention. Those are the tables that tell you whether the method is actually scoping behavior rather than just making the model less responsive. If reading more deeply, focus on two questions: which tokens and layers are regularized, and whether the same piggyback mechanism might also appear in system prompts, tool schemas, special tokens, or tokenizer-level shared fragments.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接改 pretrain，但它把“失配来自数据语义”这个直觉往前推了一步：先看 prefix token 是否在偷运行为，建议重点读干预实验而不是最终方法表。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully weakens the default story that misalignment is purely task-semantic; read the prefix intervention evidence first, not the mitigation table.

paper.title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently rely on language priors, producing confident answers that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. While this behavior is widely observed, its internal mechanisms and its impact on benchmark evaluation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study language-prior reliance from both mechanistic and behavioral perspectives. Internally, we combine counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace how ground-truth visua

summary.core_problem: 探究视觉-语言模型（VLMs）为何过度依赖语言先验而忽视视觉证据，并提出量化这种‘视觉忽视’的指标。
summary.importance: 机制分析。结合内部表征探测和外部行为测试，揭示了 VLM 在解码过程中视觉信号被语言偏置压制的动态过程，为理解 VLM 幻觉提供了机制层面的解释。
summary.technical_approach: 内部机制：结合反事实层替换和逐层 MLP 探测，追踪视觉语义和语言先验在语言解码器中的竞争。外部行为：提出基于多步高斯模糊的渐进式视觉衰减指标，识别即使视觉内容被破坏答案仍保持不变的实例。
summary.experiments: 未详细说明模型规模和数据集，但通过内部探测和外部模糊测试，证实了 VLM 存在多阶段瓶颈：中间层未能有效检索视觉信息，而后期层进一步抑制视觉信号以偏向文本空间偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: Investigating why Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over-rely on language priors and ignore visual evidence, and proposing a metric to quantify this 'visual ignorance'.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis. By combining internal representation probing and external behavioral testing, it reveals the dynamic process of visual signals being suppressed by language biases during decoding, providing a mechanistic explanation for VLM hallucinations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Internal mechanism: Combines counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace the competition between visual semantics and language priors across the language decoder. External behavior: Introduces a progressive visual decay metric based on multi-step Gaussian blurring to identify instances where answers remain invariant even as visual content is destroyed.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale and datasets are not detailed, but through internal probing and external blurring tests, it confirms a multi-stage bottleneck: intermediate layers fail to retrieve visual info, while later layers suppress visual signals in favor of text biases.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 幻觉机制的 literature 备查，揭示了视觉信号在 decoder 中后期被语言先验压制的现象，可作为改进 VLM 架构或 loss 的动机。
recommendation.en: Good for literature review on VLM hallucination mechanisms; reveals visual signals are suppressed by language priors in later decoder layers, motivating architecture or loss improvements.

paper.title: The Tell-Tale Norm: $\ell_2$ Magnitude as a Signal for Reasoning Dynamics in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has sought to understand Large Language Models (LLMs) reasoning, yet a principled, model-intrinsic signal that captures its layer-wise reasoning dynamics remains underexplored. We bridge this gap by demonstrating that the l2 norm of hidden states serves as an endogenous signal of the model's reasoning intensity. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) as a diagnostic probe, we observe that LLMs' internal reasoning is marked by a sharp increase in reasoning feature activations concentrated i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想找一个不依赖额外训练探针、直接来自模型内部状态的“推理强度信号”。已有工作要么从输出侧看 CoT、熵、正确率相关性，要么用 SAE 这类外部工具去挖 reasoning feature，但后者训练成本高、依赖模型和数据。论文要回答的是：LLM 在层间是否存在稳定的推理动态，以及这种动态能否用一个内生、训练无关的量来刻画。作者给出的答案是隐藏状态的 ℓ2 范数。
summary.importance: 对预训练 recipe 的直接影响有限，但对训练动态分析、机制解释、test-time compute 分配和 reasoning control 有启发。更具体地说，它提出了一个极低成本的内部诊断量：layer-wise hidden-state norm。若这个信号在更多模型上成立，它可以成为分析“模型何时在认真算、哪些层在承担推理负荷”的通用仪表，而不必每次先训练 SAE 或做复杂探针。对基座研究员而言，价值主要在机制分析与推理时干预，而不是提升预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步，用 SAE 作为诊断工具而不是最终信号。作者先在多个层上训练 SAE，把隐藏表示分解成稀疏特征，识别与 reasoning 相关的 feature，并观察这些 feature 在深层尤其是后段层显著增强。这个阶段的作用是建立一个较可信的“推理活跃层”参照系。

第二步，建立 hidden-state ℓ2 norm 与 reasoning feature activation 的理论联系。论文在若干条件下给出双边界：如果 SAE 重构足够 faithful，且 reasoning feature 与 semantic feature 近似正交，则隐藏状态范数可以界定 reasoning feature 的激活强度。直觉上，推理会把表示推向更高能量、更大幅度的子空间，因此 norm 会抬升。这里的理论不是严格现实世界定理，而是一个带条件的解释框架：它说明为什么 norm 可能是 reasoning intensity 的代理，而不是仅仅经验相关。

第三步，把这个信号用于 test-time control。作者提出三种无训练、无额外数据的方法。其一是 Adaptive Layer-wise Reasoning Recursion，在高推理强度层分配额外计算，类似只对关键层做更深处理。其二是 Endogenous Reasoning State Steering，把隐藏状态朝高强度子空间引导，以增强中间计算。其三是 ℓ2-guided Response Selection，在多个候选输出中选取 reasoning intensity 更高的答案。三者共同特点是都不改模型参数，而是利用 norm 作为在线控制信号。

论文还做了相关性与因果验证。相关性上，比较 ℓ2 norm 与 SAE reasoning feature、输出熵等指标的对齐程度，并声称 norm 优于其他简单统计量。因果上，在 reasoning-heavy 层压制高范数 token，比随机压制带来更大性能下降，作为“高范数位置更关键”的证据。
summary.experiments:
实验结论有三层。第一，表征分析显示 reasoning feature 在后层集中增强，说明推理并非均匀分布在所有层，而更像在中后段进入高活跃状态。第二，相关性实验表明 layer-wise ℓ2 norm 与 SAE 识别的 reasoning feature activation、以及输出不确定性指标有较强对齐，而且优于若干替代统计量。第三，基于 norm 的 test-time 方法在多个数学和通用推理 benchmark 上平均提升 4.51%，在更难的推理任务上提升 9.13%。

更值得注意的是因果干预结果：对 reasoning-heavy 层的高范数 token 做抑制，比随机抑制更伤性能，这支持“高范数不是伴随现象，而与有效推理计算有关”。不过这类证据仍然是局部的。它说明 norm 是有用信号，但还不能证明所有高范数都对应正确推理，也不能排除它有时只是高不确定性、高冲突或高激活密度的混合指标。

从论文定位看，数字提升不是最重要部分。更关键的是它把一个简单可测的内部量和 reasoning dynamics 连接起来，并展示了这个量可以驱动实际干预。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，明确两层问题：一是 reasoning 在层间怎么展开，二是能否找到内生信号。然后直接看 SAE 分析部分的层间激活图，确认作者观察到的“后层推理增强”现象。接着看理论部分，重点不是逐式推导，而是弄清楚结论依赖哪些假设：faithful reconstruction、feature 近似正交、reasoning/semantic 分解是否可信。

实验部分建议按顺序看：相关性比较、因果抑制实验、三种 test-time 方法的主结果。若时间有限，优先看 high-norm suppression 和 response selection，这两部分最容易判断信号是否有操作价值。

预计 25 分钟左右可以完成有效泛读。阅读时要带着保留意见：hidden-state norm 很可能是一个混合信号，既包含 reasoning，也包含不确定性、冲突、长度效应和层归一化后的几何偏置。值得继续追问的是，这个现象在不同架构、不同归一化方式、不同 CoT 风格模型上是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper looks for a model-intrinsic, training-free signal that tracks reasoning dynamics inside LLMs. Prior work either studies reasoning from outputs such as CoT tokens and entropy, or relies on external probes like sparse autoencoders to identify reasoning features. The question here is whether reasoning has a stable layer-wise signature and whether that signature can be captured directly from the model’s own hidden states. The proposed answer is the layer-wise hidden-state l2 norm.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining is limited, but the paper is relevant to training dynamics analysis, mechanistic interpretability, and test-time compute allocation. If the result generalizes, hidden-state norm could become a cheap diagnostic for when a model is in a high-reasoning regime and which layers carry that burden, without training SAEs or other probes. For foundation-model researchers, the value is more in analysis and intervention than in changing the core pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proceeds in three stages. First, it uses SAEs as a diagnostic reference rather than as the final signal. SAE features associated with reasoning are identified across layers, and the authors observe that these features become much stronger in later layers during reasoning-heavy behavior. This establishes a layer-wise picture of where reasoning seems to intensify.

Second, the paper connects hidden-state l2 norm to reasoning-feature activation theoretically. Under assumptions such as faithful SAE reconstruction and approximate orthogonality between reasoning and semantic features, the hidden-state norm provides upper and lower bounds on the activation strength of SAE reasoning features. The intuition is that reasoning pushes representations into higher-energy subspaces, inflating activation magnitude and therefore the norm. The theory is conditional rather than universal, but it gives a principled explanation for why norm might work as a proxy.

Third, the paper turns the signal into test-time control. It proposes three data-free, training-free methods: Adaptive Layer-wise Reasoning Recursion, which allocates extra compute to layers with high reasoning intensity; Endogenous Reasoning State Steering, which nudges hidden states toward high-intensity subspaces; and l2-guided Response Selection, which chooses the candidate response with the highest inferred reasoning intensity. All three methods use norm as an online control variable without changing model weights.

The paper also includes correlation and causal analyses. Correlation experiments compare l2 norm against SAE reasoning features, output entropy, and other simple statistics. Causal interventions suppress high-norm tokens in reasoning-heavy layers and show a larger performance drop than random suppression, supporting the claim that these positions matter for successful reasoning.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has three parts. First, representation analysis shows that reasoning-related SAE activations rise sharply in later layers, suggesting that reasoning is not uniformly distributed across depth but becomes concentrated in the middle-to-late stack. Second, correlation experiments show that layer-wise l2 norm aligns well with SAE-derived reasoning activity and output-side uncertainty measures, and reportedly outperforms several alternative statistics. Third, the norm-based test-time methods deliver an average gain of 4.51% across benchmarks and 9.13% on harder reasoning tasks.

The causal intervention is the most informative result. Suppressing high-norm tokens in reasoning-heavy layers hurts performance more than random suppression, which supports the idea that high norm is not just an incidental byproduct. Still, the evidence does not imply that every high-norm state corresponds to correct reasoning. The signal may also mix uncertainty, conflict, activation density, or architectural geometry effects.

The main contribution is therefore not the absolute benchmark gain, but the claim that a simple measurable internal quantity can track and modulate reasoning dynamics in practice.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction to separate the two questions: how reasoning unfolds across layers, and whether there is an endogenous signal for it. Then go straight to the SAE analysis figures that show the late-layer concentration of reasoning features. After that, read the theory section selectively. The key is not every derivation, but the assumptions behind the bounds: faithful reconstruction, approximate orthogonality, and whether the reasoning-versus-semantic decomposition is plausible.

In the experiments, read the correlation study, the high-norm suppression intervention, and the three test-time methods in that order. If time is limited, prioritize the suppression experiment and the response-selection results, since they are the clearest tests of whether the signal is operationally useful.

A good reading stance is cautious. Hidden-state norm is likely a mixed signal rather than a pure reasoning meter. The natural follow-up question is whether the effect remains stable across architectures, normalization schemes, and models with different CoT styles.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但先把它当机制线索而不是新 recipe；重点读因果干预和 norm-guided scaling，若 setup 干净，可以立刻在内部 trace/early-exit 实验里复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading as a mechanism clue, not a new recipe yet; focus on the causal intervention and norm-guided scaling sections, then try reproducing it in your own tracing or early-exit setup.

paper.title: Cosine Misleads: Auxiliary Losses Reshape Vision Language Models, Not Their Latents
paper.abstract: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) inserts supervised latent tokens between perception and answer generation in vision-language models (VLMs). The field uses alignment between these latents and their visual targets, i.e., cosine similarity or mean squared error (MSE), as both the training loss and the quality metric, assuming that better alignment yields a better answer. We test this with a designed matrix of five LVR variants and find the assumption inverted: cosine alignment is negatively correlate

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作检验了 latent visual reasoning 里一个被默认接受的前提：中间连续 latent 与教师视觉目标的对齐程度，是否真的代表模型在推理时“用到了”这些 latent，并因此带来更好的答案。论文给出的结论是否定的。作者系统构造了五种 LVR 训练变体，在相同骨干、数据和训练步数下比较，发现常用的 cosine/MSE 对齐指标不仅不能预测下游问答准确率，甚至与准确率显著负相关。更关键的是，推理时对这些 latent 做置零、加噪、跨样本替换，性能变化很小，说明被辅助损失直接监督的 latent 往往不是承载答案信息的那条计算路径。
summary.importance: 对预训练和多模态建模的启发不在于提出了一个更强模型，而在于拆穿了一类常见训练信号的误读。很多中间层监督方法默认“被监督的表示”就是“起作用的表示”，于是用 cosine、MSE 或重建误差同时做训练目标和质量指标。这里的结果表明，辅助损失可能主要通过共享参数的梯度流重塑整个网络，而不是让被监督 latent 本身变成推理时的关键载体。这个判断对 VLM 中间表示学习、跨模态对齐、latent CoT、甚至部分语音/视频连续思维建模都有参考价值。它提醒人们区分两件事：一个 loss 能否改善模型，与它监督的那段表示是否真的 load-bearing，不是一回事。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有两部分。第一部分是受控实验矩阵。作者设计了五种 LVR 变体，覆盖从偏重重建的训练方式，到加入输入噪声约束，再到 progressively scaffolded 的训练策略。所有变体共享同一 backbone、训练数据和 step budget，尽量把差异压缩到 latent 监督设计本身。结果显示，某些方法能把 cosine alignment 提高约 40%，把 reconstruction error 从 3.79 降到 1.55，但问答准确率反而下降 13 个点。

第二部分是诊断工具 PRISM，由两个推理时分析组成。其一是 corruption test：在每一步生成时，对 latent 位置做三类干预——置零、加入高斯噪声、替换为别的样本的 latent——观察最终任务精度变化。如果 latent 真在承担推理，干预应显著伤害性能；但实验里所有变体的性能波动都不超过 4 个点，最差变体甚至在 latent 置零后更好。其二是双位置 linear probe：分别在线性探测 answer-decoding state 和 autoregressive feedback variable 上是否可解码出答案。结果是答案信息能从最终 answer-decoding hidden state 读出，却不能从被重新注入的 latent 变量中读出。作者据此提出一个信息瓶颈视角：训练目标中的主导项仍是 cross-entropy，它会把与答案相关的计算压力施加到任何能更直接服务输出的位置；而 cosine/MSE 这类重建损失既不约束表示压缩，也不保证表示保留与答案相关的信息，因此模型完全可能学会“绕过” latent，让辅助损失只作为一种参数整形信号存在。
summary.experiments: 核心结果有四个。第一，五种 LVR 变体上，cosine alignment 与 V*Bench 准确率的 Pearson 相关系数达到 -0.94，方向与社区常用假设相反。第二，progressive scaffolding 变体把 cosine 提高约 40%，重建误差从 3.79 降到 1.55，但 V*Bench 下降 13 分；这一现象在 BLINK 和 MMVP 上也复现，说明不是单一 benchmark 偶然。第三，noise-train 变体的 cosine 与 baseline 几乎相同，0.556 对 0.555，但 V*Bench 仍提升 1.5 分，而且在 latent 置零时与 baseline 呈相反响应：它自己的 latent 有帮助，而 baseline 的 latent 反而有害。第四，PRISM 诊断显示，对 latent 的三类干预在所有变体上最多只改变约 4 个点，说明 latent 普遍被旁路；同时 probe 对比度能够预测不同变体对 latent 扰动的敏感性，也能解释为何模型间准确率差异可以达到 13 分，即差异主要来自共享参数内部被辅助损失重塑后的下游解码路径，而不是 latent 本身的可用性。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但方法判断很清楚，建议把时间放在三处。先看 Introduction 和实验设定，确认作者不是在比较不同 backbone，而是在做受控的训练目标检验。再看 PRISM 两个诊断的定义与结果图，尤其是 latent corruption 和双位置 probe 的对应关系，这是全文最有信息量的部分。最后看 Information Bottleneck 那一节，不必把它当严格理论证明，更像一个解释框架：为什么 reconstruction-style auxiliary loss 可能改善训练，却不让被监督表示真正承载答案。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你在做中间层监督、latent reasoning 或多模态对齐，值得把相关图表和附录里的变体定义一起看完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a widely assumed premise in latent visual reasoning: whether better alignment between supervised latent tokens and teacher visual targets actually means the model relies on those latents at inference, and therefore answers better. The answer is no. Using five controlled LVR variants trained with the same backbone, data, and step budget, the authors show that cosine/MSE-style alignment is not a faithful proxy for downstream performance; in fact, cosine is strongly negatively correlated with task accuracy. More importantly, inference-time interventions on the latent channel barely change performance, which suggests that the supervised latents are often not the load-bearing path for answer computation.
summary_en.importance: The value of the paper is diagnostic rather than architectural. It challenges a common interpretation of auxiliary supervision in multimodal models: that the representation being directly supervised is also the representation doing the work. The results suggest a different picture. Auxiliary losses may help mainly by reshaping shared parameters through gradient flow, while the supervised latent itself is bypassed at inference. This matters beyond LVR. The same failure mode can plausibly appear in intermediate-layer supervision, multimodal alignment objectives, latent chain-of-thought setups, and continuous reasoning channels in video or speech models. For pretraining research, the key lesson is to separate two questions: whether an auxiliary loss improves the model, and whether the supervised intermediate state is actually causally used.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two main components. First, it builds a controlled matrix of five LVR variants spanning different latent-supervision designs, including reconstruction-heavy training, input-noise regularization, and progressively scaffolded supervision. The backbone, data source, and training budget are held fixed so that differences can be attributed to the latent objective rather than unrelated recipe changes. Under this setup, a variant can improve cosine alignment by about 40% and reduce reconstruction error from 3.79 to 1.55, yet lose 13 points on the downstream benchmark.

Second, the authors introduce PRISM, a pair of inference-time diagnostics. The first is a corruption test: at each generation step, latent positions are zeroed, perturbed with Gaussian noise, or replaced with latents from another sample. If the latent channel is truly carrying reasoning-relevant information, these interventions should hurt substantially. Instead, all variants move by at most four points, and one variant even improves when its latents are zeroed. The second is a two-position linear probe. The probe asks whether the answer is decodable from the answer-decoding hidden state and from the autoregressive feedback variable that gets re-injected as the latent. The answer is decodable from the former but not the latter. The paper interprets this through an Information Bottleneck lens: the dominant cross-entropy term pushes the network to route answer-relevant computation wherever it most directly helps prediction, while cosine/MSE reconstruction does not guarantee that the supervised latent preserves answer-relevant information. As a result, the model can satisfy the auxiliary loss while learning to solve the task through downstream shared-parameter pathways.
summary_en.experiments: There are four results worth retaining. First, across the five LVR variants, cosine alignment and V*Bench accuracy have a Pearson correlation of -0.94, which is the opposite of the field’s usual assumption. Second, the progressive scaffolding variant improves cosine alignment by roughly 40% and lowers reconstruction error from 3.79 to 1.55, yet drops 13 points on V*Bench; the same pattern also appears on BLINK and MMVP. Third, the noise-train variant matches the baseline almost exactly in cosine score, 0.556 versus 0.555, but still gains 1.5 points on V*Bench, and its response to latent zeroing flips relative to the baseline: its own latent helps, whereas the baseline latent hurts. Fourth, PRISM shows that zeroing, noising, or swapping latents changes accuracy by at most about four points across all variants, indicating broad latent bypass. At the same time, the contrast between probe accuracy at the answer-decoding state and the feedback latent predicts both perturbation sensitivity and task performance, which supports the claim that the auxiliary loss mainly reshapes the model through shared parameters rather than through a useful latent code.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading with care if you work on intermediate supervision. Start with the introduction and experimental setup to verify that the comparison is controlled. Then focus on the PRISM section, especially the latent corruption results and the two-position probe analysis; that is where the paper earns its conclusion. The Information Bottleneck section is best read as an interpretive framework, not as a formal proof. It helps explain why reconstruction-style auxiliary losses can improve training while failing to make the supervised latent causally important. A 20–30 minute read is enough to capture the main argument. If your work involves latent reasoning, multimodal alignment, or auxiliary losses on hidden states, the figures and appendix definitions of the five variants are the parts to inspect closely.

recommendation.zh: 非常漂亮的机制分析工作，打破了 VLM 潜在推理中“对齐即正义”的幻觉，揭示了辅助 loss 导致的表征旁路现象，做多模态对齐的必读。
recommendation.en: A beautiful mechanistic analysis that shatters the 'alignment is all you need' illusion in VLM latent reasoning, revealing representation bypass caused by auxiliary losses. A must-read for multimodal alignment.

paper.title: Mechanistic Insights into Functional Sparsity in Multimodal LLMs via CoRe Heads
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable proficiency on complex vision-language tasks, the mechanisms by which they extract query-relevant visual features from complex, noisy contexts remain opaque. In this paper, we present an in-depth interpretability study that uncovers a profound structural property within MLLMs: functional sparsity in cross-modal retrieval. Leveraging a token-level metric termed Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM), we identify and characterize a high

summary.core_problem: 多模态 LLM 在复杂视觉上下文里如何“从噪声中检索出与问题相关的视觉 token”，以及这种跨模态检索是否由少量结构化组件承担。论文试图用可量化指标把“哪些注意力头在做真正的检索”从经验观察变成可复现的测量与因果验证。
summary.importance:
这是一篇机制可解释性工作，不是预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：
1）它给了一个可操作的 head-level 度量（RAM）和跨数据集的一致性观察，能帮助诊断 MLLM 在对齐/长上下文/噪声视觉输入下的失败模式。
2）它暗示跨模态检索存在功能稀疏性（少量关键 heads 非冗余），这对后续的结构化剪枝、稀疏注意力、以及“训练时是否应该显式鼓励检索头形成”这类预训练目标设计有间接参考价值。
但它没有提出新的预训练 recipe，也没有证明通过训练改动能产生这些 CoRe heads 或提升泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是定义并用标注区域监督来“定位检索头”。
- RAM（Retrieval Attention Mass）：对每个 head，取 query tokens 指向 ground-truth 关键视觉 token 区域 Ω(V*) 的注意力权重总和/均值，作为该 head 的检索强度分数。关键点是只统计 query→vision 的子矩阵，避免把 text-text 或 vision-vision 的注意力混进来。
- CoRe heads：按 RAM 排序后，发现一小部分 heads 在多数据集、多模型上稳定高 RAM，被解释为 Context-aware Retrieval heads（专门做 query-conditioned 的视觉信息抽取）。其余 heads 更像做全局聚合或背景分配。
- 因果验证：通过 attention masking/ablation 只屏蔽 top 比例的 CoRe heads，观察下游任务性能下降，用来证明这些 heads 不是“可有可无的注意力集中”，而是功能必需。
- 规模与层分布：随模型变大，CoRe heads 更集中在中后层；同时存在“全局一致的约 30 个头”与“随数据分布变化的局部可变头”。
summary.experiments:
覆盖多种视觉域与任务：视频时空指代/定位（VidSTG）、文档理解检索（MMDocIR）、指代表达视觉定位（RefCOCOg）、长上下文多模态推理（MMLongBench）；模型包括 LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL3.5、Qwen3-VL 系列不同规模。
关键结果是三类：
1）RAM 能稳定分离出少量高分 heads，并在可视化上呈现更精确的目标区域对齐；低分 heads 更弥散。
2）消融 top 5% CoRe heads 会带来显著性能下降（文中强调“significant drop”，但在给定内容片段里未出现具体数值）。
3）层分布随 scale 向中后层迁移，以及“约 30 个头”跨设置稳定出现。
如果要评估其对训练的意义，需要进一步核对：RAM 依赖的 ground-truth 区域标注质量、不同 tokenizer/patching 下 Ω(V*) 的定义是否稳健、以及 ablation 是否控制了总注意力质量（例如是否引入分布漂移）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–40 分钟）：
- RAM 定义与实现细节：看它如何划分 query tokens、视觉 token span Ω(V*)，以及为什么只看 query→vision 子矩阵。
- CoRe heads 的一致性结论：重点看跨模型/跨数据集的 head 排名稳定性与“约 30 个头”的证据。
- 因果消融：看 attention masking 的具体做法（mask 在 softmax 前后、是否重归一化）、以及性能下降对应哪些任务最敏感。
对预训练研究者，值得额外做的延伸阅读是：这些 CoRe heads 是否在不同训练阶段出现（若文中有训练动态分析），以及它们与对齐损失/视觉编码器接口的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Understanding how multimodal LLMs retrieve query-relevant visual evidence from cluttered visual contexts, and whether this cross-modal retrieval is carried by a small, structured subset of attention heads rather than being diffusely distributed across the network.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a mechanistic interpretability paper, not a pretraining-method contribution. Its value to foundation-model training is indirect: (1) it introduces an operational head-level metric (RAM) that can be used to diagnose grounding/retrieval behavior and failure modes under noisy or long-context multimodal inputs; (2) it provides evidence for functional sparsity—few non-redundant cross-modal retrieval heads—which can inform structured pruning, sparse attention designs, or future training objectives that explicitly encourage robust retrieval circuits. It does not, however, propose or validate a modified pretraining recipe that improves these properties.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper isolates “retrieval heads” using a supervised attention-mass metric.
- Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM): for each head, compute the attention mass from query tokens to the ground-truth visual token span Ω(V*) (object regions / temporal segments), focusing specifically on the query→vision attention sub-matrix to avoid intra-modal confounds.
- CoRe heads: heads with consistently high RAM are labeled Context-aware Retrieval heads, interpreted as dedicated query-conditioned visual extractors; most other heads exhibit broader, more diffuse attention patterns.
- Causal testing: ablate/mask only the top fraction of CoRe heads and measure downstream performance drops to argue necessity rather than correlation.
- Scaling/layer localization: as models scale, CoRe heads concentrate more in mid-to-late layers; the authors also claim a mix of globally consistent heads (~30) and dataset-adaptive ones.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across diverse multimodal datasets: VidSTG (video spatiotemporal grounding), MMDocIR (document/layout retrieval), RefCOCOg (referring expression grounding), and MMLongBench (long-context multimodal reasoning). Models include LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL3.5, and Qwen3-VL at multiple scales.
Main empirical claims: (1) RAM cleanly separates a small set of heads whose attention visualizations tightly localize relevant entities; low-RAM heads attend diffusely to background. (2) Masking the top 5% CoRe heads yields a significant performance drop (the provided excerpt does not include exact numbers). (3) CoRe head locations shift toward later layers with scale, and ~30 heads appear consistently across settings.
For training-oriented interpretation, the key robustness questions are how Ω(V*) is defined under different visual tokenizations, sensitivity to annotation noise, and whether the ablation protocol preserves attention normalization to avoid introducing unrelated distribution shifts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–40 minutes):
- Read the RAM definition carefully: how query tokens and Ω(V*) are constructed, and why only query→vision attention is used.
- Check the cross-model/dataset stability evidence for CoRe heads (including the “~30 universal heads” claim).
- Inspect the causal ablation protocol: where masking is applied (pre/post-softmax), whether renormalization is done, and which tasks degrade most.
If you are thinking about pretraining implications, look for any training-dynamics analysis (when these heads emerge) and how they relate to the vision-tokenizer / projector interface and alignment losses.

recommendation.zh: 这类头级功能稀疏结论未必能直接迁移到训练 recipe，但若你在想多模态路由/剪枝，先看 RAM 定义和 5% 消融结果。
recommendation.en: The head-level sparsity story may not transfer cleanly into training recipes, but if you care about multimodal routing or pruning, read the RAM definition and the 5% ablation result.

paper.title: Temporal Preference Concepts and their Functions in a Large Language Model
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being deployed to make decisions that require trading off near-term gains against long-term consequences, yet little is known about how they internally represent or resolve these tradeoffs. In this work, we causally localize an underlying subgraph for temporal preference in a distilled LLM (Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507), identifying mid-to-upper-layer nodes through converging evidence from gradient-based attribution and activation patching. We find that th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“LLM 会不会做跨期选择”这个表层问题，而是更具体的两个问题：第一，时间偏好这种连续概念在模型内部是否有可定位、可干预的机制实现；第二，这种表示是如何从“时间跨度的几何结构”收缩成最终回答中的二元选择。作者把问题放在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 上，试图从残差流、注意力层和回合边界 token 的作用出发，找到 temporal preference 的因果子图，并解释模型为何在不同语境下表现出不稳定的远期/近期偏好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，对机制分析和对齐控制更有启发。它的价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于把一个以往多停留在行为层的概念，推进到“可定位、可几何化、可定向操控”的层面。更具体地说，这篇工作说明：LLM 内部不只存在 truthfulness、refusal 这类近似二元的概念回路，也可能存在时间跨度、风险、效用折扣这类连续概念流形；而且这些流形会在特定 token 边界处被压缩成离散决策。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这提示了一个现实问题：如果时间偏好是训练中隐式长出来的，它未必稳定，也未必符合人类或部署需求，因此可能需要显式控制，而不是默认交给指令微调自然形成。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者没有依赖单一 interpretability 工具，而是做了四条相互独立的定位链路，核心目的是让证据收敛到同一批层和节点。第一类是 gradient-based attribution，用梯度归因先粗定位哪些中上层组件对 temporal preference 判断最敏感。第二类是 activation patching / attribution patching，通过在不同时间跨度条件之间替换激活，检查哪些层的表示被替换后会因果性地改变模型选择。第三类是 linear probing，用探针去读出时间跨度信息在残差流中的可分性和几何形态。第四类是 CAA 一类的激活方向分析与干预，用概念方向来验证是否能沿着“更短视/更长期”方向稳定推动输出。

全文里比较关键的发现有三个。其一，定位结果集中在中高层，尤其提到 L24 attention layer 在 horizon inference 中也被招募，说明时间偏好不是输入端的浅层词面模式，而是经过一定抽象后形成。其二，时间跨度在局部子图中的表示不是简单线性轴，而是非线性几何；作者强调 residual stream 中存在 horizon manifold，随后在 user→assistant 的回合切换边界，即 <|im_end|>、换行、<|im_start|>、assistant 这一串模板 token 附近，注意力把连续时间表示压缩成“承诺式”的二元偏好。这个观察很重要，因为它把“概念表示”和“最终决策”分成了两个阶段。其三，作者不仅做定位，还做 steering：通过针对这些局部表示施加干预，可以在开放式生成任务里改变模型的时间偏好，而不是只在二选一问答里有效。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有两点。以往关于 LLM 经济行为或时间折扣的研究，多数停留在行为拟合层，问模型更像 exponential 还是 hyperbolic discounting；另一些机制分析工作则主要处理真假、拒答、谄媚这类对比鲜明的二元概念。这篇工作尝试处理一个连续、维度化的偏好变量，并把几何结构、因果定位和可控干预串起来。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是大规模 benchmark 分数，而是多种机制证据是否一致，以及行为拟合是否支持“模型有自己的时间偏好但并不稳定”。从全文可见，作者使用的是 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，一个 4B 级蒸馏指令模型，选择它的原因是 non-thinking-only 模式让推理过程固定在 prompt 模板内，便于 token 对齐的 attribution 和 patching。

行为层面，作者拟合了模型在 intertemporal choice 任务中的折扣行为，并与人类做比较。结论是：未干预模型对未来的折扣显著比人类更平缓，也就是更“有耐心”；但这种偏好跨上下文并不稳定，说明它不是一个稳固的一致性效用函数，而更像受语境牵引的内部表征。这个结果支撑了作者后面的主张：与其假设模型会自然学出合适的 temporal preference，不如把它当成需要显式控制的部署属性。

机制层面，几条定位管线收敛到相近的中上层子图，尤其是 L24 附近的注意力模块。探针和几何分析显示，时间跨度信息在这些层可读出，但不是单纯线性可分；在回合边界 token 处，表示发生明显坍缩，随后输出偏好被离散化。干预实验则表明，对这些局部表示做定向修改，可以系统性地把模型推向更短期或更长期的选择。摘要和引言没有给出完整数值表，因此这里更可靠的结论是“存在稳定方向性效应”，而不是具体提升百分点。精读时应直接查看 Section 5.1、5.2、5.3 及附录中的 patching 和 steering 定量表。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合按“问题链”来读，而不是从头顺读。

先看 Section 5.1。重点是四条 localization pipeline 如何分别定义正负样本、如何做 token 对齐、最后为什么会收敛到同一批层。这里决定了后面所有机制结论是否站得住。读图时要特别留意层级热图、节点重要性排序，以及不同方法之间是否真的是独立证据，而不是共享同一数据构造导致的伪一致。

再看 Section 5.2。这里有两个核心点：一是 horizon geometry 到底如何被证明是非线性的；二是 user-to-assistant turn boundary 为什么会成为“连续表示坍缩为二元选择”的位置。若文中有 attention pattern 图、残差流投影图、probe decision boundary，可重点看这些图是否支持“几何流形→决策压缩”这个叙事，而不只是可视化上看起来像。

然后看 Section 5.3 和 Appendix AB。这里决定 steering 是否只是局部 prompt trick，还是确实利用了前面定位出的概念方向。要看干预是在单一模板上有效，还是在开放生成里也能迁移；还要看副作用分析，尤其是是否损伤一般能力、是否引入格式偏差。

如果时间有限，建议读 Introduction、Section 5.1、5.2、5.3，再补 Appendix K 和 AB，预计 45–60 分钟能抓住主线。若做 mechanistic interpretability 或 alignment control，值得把附录里的数据构造、patching 细节和 probe 设定也看完。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question rather than a behavioral one: where does temporal preference live inside an LLM, and how does a continuous notion of time horizon become a discrete choice in generation? Using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, the authors try to identify a causal subgraph for intertemporal preference, characterize the geometry of horizon representations in the residual stream, and explain why the model’s long-term vs short-term preference is behaviorally unstable across contexts.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect, but it is useful for interpretability and alignment. The main contribution is showing that an LLM can encode a continuous preference variable, not just binary concepts like refusal or truthfulness, in a localized and steerable internal structure. That matters because temporal preference is not something we usually supervise explicitly during pretraining or instruction tuning, yet it can affect planning, cooperation, and agent behavior. The paper suggests that leaving such preferences to emerge implicitly may produce unstable and context-sensitive behavior, so explicit control may be necessary at deployment time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The methodology is built around converging evidence from multiple interpretability pipelines rather than a single localization tool. First, gradient-based attribution is used to identify which mid-to-upper-layer components are most sensitive to temporal-preference judgments. Second, activation patching and attribution patching test causal necessity by swapping activations between prompts with different time-horizon conditions and measuring whether the model’s choice changes. Third, linear probes are trained on internal states to test whether horizon information is decodable and how it is geometrically organized in the residual stream. Fourth, concept-direction style analysis and intervention, including CAA-like steering, is used to verify whether moving activations along a learned direction can systematically shift the model toward shorter-term or longer-term preferences.

The paper’s strongest mechanistic claim is a two-stage picture. Time horizon appears to be represented as a non-linear manifold in the residual stream at localized mid/high layers. Then, around the user-to-assistant turn boundary tokens, attention collapses that continuous representation into a committed binary preference that drives the final answer. This is more interesting than a simple “there is a neuron for patience” story. It separates representation from commitment, and ties the commitment step to a concrete token boundary in the chat template.

Relative to prior work, the difference is clear. Earlier studies on LLM economic behavior mostly fit discounting curves at the output level. Mechanistic interpretability work, on the other hand, has focused more on binary contrastive concepts. This paper tries to handle a dimensional concept and connect localization, geometry, and steering in one pipeline.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are centered on consistency of mechanistic evidence rather than benchmark-style aggregate scores. The model under study is Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, chosen because its non-thinking-only mode keeps computation within a fixed prompt template, which makes token-aligned attribution and patching more tractable.

At the behavioral level, the authors fit intertemporal-choice behavior and compare it with human discounting. The main result is that the unintervened model discounts the future much less steeply than humans, so it behaves as if it is more patient. But this preference is not stable across contexts, which weakens any interpretation that the model has a coherent, globally consistent utility function over time. That instability is one of the paper’s central motivations for explicit control.

At the mechanistic level, several localization pipelines converge on a similar mid-to-upper-layer subgraph, with L24 attention highlighted as relevant for horizon inference. Probe-based analyses suggest that horizon information is present but not organized as a simple linear axis. Around the turn-boundary tokens, the representation appears to collapse, after which the model commits to a binary preference. Steering experiments then show that targeted interventions on these localized representations can reliably bias the model toward shorter-term or longer-term choices, including in more open-ended generation settings. The introduction does not expose the full numeric tables, so the most defensible takeaway is the existence of a directional and reproducible intervention effect, not a specific headline percentage.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Section 5.1. The key question is whether the four localization pipelines are genuinely independent and whether they converge on the same components for substantive reasons rather than shared data construction. Pay attention to layerwise importance maps, node rankings, and the exact contrastive setup used for attribution and patching.

Then read Section 5.2 carefully. This is where the paper argues that horizon is encoded as a non-linear geometry and that the user-to-assistant boundary is where the model converts that geometry into a binary decision. Any residual-stream projections, probe visualizations, or attention maps here are central. The paper is strongest if those figures support a representation-to-commitment transition rather than just a descriptive visualization.

After that, read Section 5.3 and Appendix AB for steering. The main thing to check is whether the intervention uses the localized concept direction in a principled way and whether the effect transfers beyond the narrow prompt format used for localization. Also look for side-effect analysis: does steering temporal preference degrade general helpfulness, formatting, or unrelated reasoning?

If time is limited, read the introduction plus Sections 5.1–5.3, then skim Appendix K and AB. That should take about 45–60 minutes. If you work on mechanistic interpretability or alignment control, the appendices are worth reading in detail.

recommendation.zh: 将时间偏好（discount factor）映射到残差流几何结构，对 RLHF 中 reward model 的设计和 reward hacking 的理解有启发，值得看其定位方法。
recommendation.en: Mapping temporal preference to residual stream geometry offers insights for RM design in RLHF and understanding reward hacking; the localization methodology is worth reviewing.

paper.title: From Reward-Hack Activations to Agentic Risk States: Context-Calibrated Mechanistic Monitoring in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Language-model agents act through repeated cycles of observation, reasoning, and action selection, making safety monitoring depend on both internal model state and environment context. We study reward-hacking monitors in ReAct-style agents acting in Gameable ALFWorld and WebShop. Agents are instrumented with activation-based reward-hack scores, token-level entropy, and decision-context features. We find that adapters fine-tuned on \textit{School-of-Reward-Hacks} dataset can transfer reward-hack

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent 的安全监控不能简化为对单一内部激活特征阈值化——reward-hack 激活高只是潜在策略状态，是否转化为实际代理利用行为取决于环境上下文（可用动作、parser 约束、proxy reward affordances 等）。
summary.importance: 对 agent 安全监控和机制性可解释性交叉方向有启发。表明部署语义会改变内部安全特征的行为含义——同样的内部状态在不同环境下的风险意义不同。对 RL 训练中 reward hacking 的检测也有间接启示。
summary.technical_approach: 在两个 agent 环境中评估：Gameable ALFWorld（受控修改的 ALFWorld，加入显式 proxy-reward affordances）和 WebShop（购物环境）。使用 ReAct 式 agent + LoRA adapter（在 School-of-Reward-Hacks 数据集或良性数据上微调）。将下一步风险估计建模为 reward-hack 激活、token 级熵、决策上下文（环境状态、推理预算、步骤位置、可用动作）的联合函数，而非单独使用 reward-hack 激活。
summary.experiments: Reward-hack 微调能从文本生成迁移到 agent 动作选择，尤其在环境暴露 proxy-reward affordances 时。Reward-hack 激活在 agent rollout 中保持结构并能区分 adapter 配置，但高激活与下一步风险并非单调关系。加入熵和上下文校准特征改进了风险估计。激活方向 steering 在部分 mixed-adapter regime 中减少了 proxy 利用行为。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 §1 问题框架、环境描述和核心结果图即可。重点理解『内部安全特征需在环境上下文中校准』的核心论点。无需深入技术细节。预计阅读时间 20-25 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety monitoring for LLM agents cannot be reduced to thresholding a single internal activation feature. High reward-hack activation only indicates a latent policy state; whether it translates into actual exploitative behavior depends on environment context—available actions, parser constraints, proxy-reward affordances, and other decision-context features.
summary_en.importance: Useful for agent safety monitoring and mechanistic interpretability. Shows that deployment semantics change the behavioral meaning of internal safety features: the same internal state carries different risk significance in different environments. Also indirectly relevant to reward-hacking detection during RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluated in two agent environments: Gameable ALFWorld (a controlled modification with explicit proxy-reward affordances) and WebShop (a public shopping environment). Uses ReAct-style agents with LoRA adapters fine-tuned on benign data, reward-hack data (School-of-Reward-Hacks dataset), or mixtures. Formulates next-step risk estimation as a joint function of reward-hack activation, token-level entropy, and decision context (environment state, reasoning budget, step position, available actions), rather than relying on reward-hack activation alone.
summary_en.experiments: Reward-hack fine-tuning transfers from text generation to agentic action selection, especially when the environment exposes proxy-reward affordances. Reward-hack activations remain structured in agent rollouts and separate adapter regimes, but high activation does not monotonically determine next-step risk. Adding entropy and context-calibrated features improves risk estimation. Activation-direction steering reduces proxy-exploit behavior in some mixed-adapter regimes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read §1 framing, environment descriptions, and core result figures. Focus on the central argument that internal safety features must be calibrated against environment context. No need to dig into technical details. Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将机制分析引入 Agent 的 Reward Hacking 监控，指出单纯看内部激活不够，需要结合上下文和熵，对 RLHF 后的模型行为监控有启发。
recommendation.en: Introduces mechanistic analysis to Agent reward hacking monitoring, pointing out that looking solely at internal activations is insufficient and needs to be combined with context and entropy; inspiring for post-RLHF model behavior monitoring.

paper.title: Pattern Selectivity is Not Task-Causal Structure: A Cross-Architecture Mechanistic Study of Composed-Task Circuits in 1B-Class Language Models
paper.abstract: We test whether a single screen-and-ablate recipe -- identify attention-head circuits by task-pattern selectivity, then verify by causal ablation against a matched-random null -- produces consistent mechanistic claims across model families. The recipe ports across pipelines; the specific circuit it identifies does not. Across four composed tasks (indirect-object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, variable binding) and three 1B-class language models from distinct training pipeline

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“某个任务有没有可解释电路”，而是更尖锐的问题：一套在 GPT-2 / IOI 上被广泛接受的 mechanistic interpretability 配方——先用注意力模式选择头，再做因果消融——换到不同训练语料、不同架构、但能力相近的 1B 级模型上，是否还能得到稳定、可迁移的机制结论。作者把问题放在 composed tasks 上检验，包括 IOI、greater-than、successor sequences 和 variable binding。全文给出的答案是否定的：同一任务在不同模型里，能通过因果验证的“主因果屏幕”并不一致；更强的说法是，在 4×3 的 12 个 task-model 单元里，没有两个单元在可比效应量下共享同一个 primary causal screen。这直接挑战了“pattern selectivity≈task-causal structure”的默认前提。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于它给机制分析和跨模型归纳划了边界。很多人会把某个模型里发现的 head class，当成任务实现的普遍结构，再进一步拿它解释训练动态、数据影响或架构差异。这里的结果提醒你：在 1B 级、自然语料预训练模型上，任务可解并不意味着机制同构；同样的行为能力可以由不同的中间电路实现。对基座研究员，这意味着两点。第一，拿 mechanistic finding 去反推 pretrain recipe 时要更谨慎，尤其不能把单模型发现直接上升为“任务需要这种电路”。第二，架构和数据分布确实会改变模型选择的计算路径，MoE 甚至可能系统性偏向某类基础电路。贡献量级上，它更像一篇方法学纠偏和经验边界测绘的论文，而不是给出统一理论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者沿用前作的 screen-and-ablate recipe，但把它做成了严格对齐的跨模型实验。第一步是 spectral signal：对每个 attention head 计算基于奇异值谱的 participation ratio 积分，筛出长期进行内容相关计算、而不是纯 sink 行为的头。第二步是 task-pattern screen：针对每个任务定义候选注意力模式，再按 selectivity 阈值过滤出小规模候选电路。以 IOI 为例，作者不是只看 name-mover，而是并列测试 prev-token、induction、name-mover、S-Inhibition 四类屏幕；greater-than、successor、variable binding 也各自定义了与任务结构对应的模式。第三步是 causal verification：对候选头做 group mean-ablation，并和同层、同数量、无重叠的 matched-random 头做对照，报告 top-1 和 logit-diff 的下降。

全文里真正有信息量的部分有三点。其一，作者没有把“被选中”直接当成机制，而是引入五分类 taxonomy：primary cause、secondary cause、correlate、interferer、null。也就是说，同样高 selectivity 的头，可能是支持任务、只是伴随相关、甚至会干扰任务；只有结合因果消融才能区分。其二，作者专门讨论了 matched-random control 的失效边界：如果候选头集中在 L0-L1，same-layer 随机对照方差会很大，因为早层本来就承载输入嵌入和通用内容路由，这时 null floor 偏弱，不能过度解读。其三，作者提出一个可证伪的结构假设：OLMoE 1B-7B 在 4 个任务里有 3 个任务表现出 prev-token primacy，即 composed-task 电路建立在更基础的 prev-token positional substrate 上，而不是直接落在任务语义最贴切的 pattern 上。这个假设把“架构差异”具体化成了 MoE 可能偏好的计算基底。
summary.experiments:
实验面板是三种 1B 级模型：Pythia 1B（Pile，dense）、OLMo 1B（DCLM，dense）、OLMoE 1B-7B（DCLM，64 experts，top-8，1B active params）。作者先说明为什么选这个规模：GPT-2 small 在 IOI 上并不能稳定解题，top-1 只有 13%，IO-vs-subject 57%；而 1B active 级别才进入“任务可靠可解”的区间，因此更适合比较机制而不是比较是否会做。

关键结果有三层。第一，IOI 上三模型的 primary screen 已经分裂：Pythia 是 prev-token-primary，OLMo 是 S-Inhibition-primary，OLMoE 是 name-mover-primary。也就是说，连最经典、最容易让人期待复现 canonical circuit 的任务，都没有出现跨模型一致的主因果结构。第二，把范围扩到另外三个 composed tasks 后，12 个单元里没有两个在可比效应量下共享同一 primary causal screen。这个结论比“有差异”更强，它说明差异不是零星噪声，而是系统性的非一致。第三，OLMoE 呈现出明显的 prev-token-primacy pattern：在 greater-than、successor、variable binding 三个任务上，主因果屏幕都落在 prev-token，而不是任务直觉上更专门的模式；只有 IOI 例外，作者解释为 IOI 的最终位置本身就直接探测 name copying。

消融层面，作者使用每个 cell 十个 seed 的 matched-random null 来估计 specificity differential，这比单次随机对照更稳，也让“候选头是否真的比同层随机头更 task-specific”有了不确定性范围。另一个值得注意的实验观察是，group ablation 有时会把 supporter 和 interferer 混在一起，因此作者强调 individual-head ablation 是必要诊断，而不是可有可无的补充。论文摘要截断了部分具体数值，现有全文片段没有完整表格，但从叙述可以确认：作者更看重相对效应、对照差值和分类归因，而不是单一绝对 drop。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着“方法边界”去读，不适合当成某个任务电路图谱来背。先看 Introduction，把三个操作性问题和主要结论读清楚，尤其是 12 个 cell 无重复 primary screen 这一句。然后看 Methodology Recap，重点理解 PR-integral 在这里不是 task-specific detector，只是 specialization indicator；真正把一般性专门化变成任务相关发现的是 pattern screen 加 causal verification。接着看各任务的 screen 定义，尤其 IOI 四类屏幕为什么都要并列测，而不是预设 canonical head class。实验部分优先看每个 task-model cell 的 group ablation 对 matched-random 的差值，以及 taxonomy 判定标准，弄清 primary / secondary / correlate / interferer / null 是怎么落下来的。最后看作者对 OLMoE prev-token-primacy 的讨论和预测，这部分最接近可继续验证的研究问题。

如果时间有限，建议 40–60 分钟泛读：Introduction、方法总览、主结果图表、taxonomy 和 OLMoE 假设。若要精读，值得深挖两点：一是早层 matched-random control 为什么会失真，这关系到很多 interpretability 实验的统计地板；二是“同能力、异机制”到底来自数据、架构还是优化路径，论文没有完全分解，但给了很好的实验框架。
summary.authors_note: 从正文可确认这是 Xu 在 2026 年三篇系列工作的第 3 篇，前两篇分别讨论 screen-and-ablate 配方本身，以及这些电路在预训练中的形成时间线。当前片段未给出完整作者列表与机构信息，无法可靠补全。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a stricter question than whether a task admits an interpretable circuit. It tests whether a widely used recipe in mechanistic interpretability—pattern-based head screening followed by causal ablation—yields stable mechanistic claims across model families when the task is held fixed. The setting is composed tasks rather than simple capability probes: indirect object identification, greater-than, successor sequences, and variable binding. The answer is negative. The recipe transfers as a procedure, but the circuit it identifies does not. Across a 4-task × 3-model panel of 1B-class LMs, no two task-model cells share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size. That directly weakens the common move from pattern selectivity to task-causal structure.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is methodological and diagnostic. Mechanistic findings are often used to reason backward about data, architecture, or training dynamics. This paper shows that such inferences are fragile if they rely on a single model and a single canonical circuit decomposition. At 1B scale, models with similar task competence can implement the same composed task through different causal head sets. For foundation-model work, that means two things. First, one should be careful when using interpretability results to justify claims about what pretraining must have learned. Second, architecture and corpus choices can alter the computational substrate selected during training, with MoE showing a potentially systematic bias. The contribution is not a new training recipe; it is a careful map of where cross-model mechanistic generalization breaks.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper applies a unified screen-and-ablate pipeline, inherited from earlier work, to a matched cross-model panel. Step 1 is a spectral signal: for each attention head, the authors compute a participation-ratio integral over the singular value spectrum of attention outputs across checkpoints. This is meant to surface heads engaged in sustained content-dependent computation rather than generic sink behavior. Step 2 is task-pattern screening: for each task, they define candidate attention patterns and keep heads whose selectivity exceeds fixed thresholds. For IOI, they explicitly test four candidate screens—prev-token, induction, name-mover, and S-Inhibition—rather than assuming the canonical IOI decomposition will transfer. Step 3 is causal verification: they group-ablate the selected heads via mean ablation and compare the drop in top-1 and logit-diff against matched-random controls drawn from the same layers with equal head count and no overlap.

Three methodological refinements matter. First, the paper does not equate selection with mechanism. It introduces a five-way taxonomy: primary cause, secondary cause, correlate, interferer, and null. A head class can be highly selective yet only correlated, or even harmful, unless causal tests confirm its role. Second, the matched-random control is treated carefully. When selected heads concentrate in very early layers, same-layer random controls have high variance and a weak null floor because L0-L1 already carry broad embedding and routing functions. The paper explicitly marks where that bound is informative and where it is not. Third, the authors formulate a falsifiable structural hypothesis from the observed MoE behavior: OLMoE at 1B active scale may build composed-task circuits on top of a foundational prev-token positional substrate, except when the task directly probes another pattern such as final-position name copying in IOI.
summary_en.experiments:
The model panel contains Pythia 1B trained on the Pile, OLMo 1B trained on DCLM, and OLMoE 1B-7B trained on DCLM with 64 experts and top-8 routing, all compared at roughly 1B active parameters. The scale choice is motivated in the paper: GPT-2 small does not reliably solve IOI, reaching only 13% top-1 and 57% IO-vs-subject, so the authors move to the smallest natural-text models where the task is actually solved.

The main empirical findings are strong. On IOI alone, the primary causal screen already differs by model: prev-token for Pythia, S-Inhibition for OLMo, and name-mover for OLMoE. Extending to greater-than, successor, and variable binding makes the pattern sharper: across all 12 task-model cells, there is no repeated primary causal screen at comparable effect size. This is stronger than saying there is some variation; it suggests systematic non-isomorphism in implementation. A second notable result is the OLMoE prev-token-primacy pattern. On three of the four tasks—greater-than, successor, and variable binding—the primary causal screen in OLMoE is prev-token rather than the task-specific pattern one might expect from the task structure. IOI is the exception, which the authors argue is consistent with IOI directly probing final-position name copying.

The control design is also worth noting. Each cell uses a matched-random null sampled across ten seeds, allowing the authors to report specificity differentials with uncertainty rather than relying on one random comparison. The paper also emphasizes that group ablation can mix supportive and interfering heads, so individual-head ablations are needed to disambiguate supporters from interferers. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, so many exact drop values are not visible here, but the paper’s empirical logic is centered on relative causal effect against matched-random baselines and on the taxonomy assignment, not on a single absolute metric.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a paper about the limits of mechanistic portability, not as a catalog of task circuits. Start with the Introduction and the three operational questions. The sentence to keep in mind is that no two of the 12 cells share the same primary causal screen at comparable effect size. Then read the methodology recap carefully. The key point is that the PR-integral is only a general specialization indicator; task specificity comes from the pattern screen plus causal verification. After that, inspect how each task’s candidate screens are defined, especially why IOI is tested with four competing screens instead of assuming the GPT-2-style decomposition. In the results, focus on the group-ablation deltas relative to matched-random controls and on how the five-category taxonomy is assigned. Finish with the discussion of OLMoE prev-token primacy and the predictions for other MoE models, since that is the most concrete forward-looking hypothesis.

For a skim, 40–60 minutes is enough for the introduction, method overview, main result figures, taxonomy section, and the MoE discussion. For a deeper read, two issues deserve extra attention: why early-layer matched-random controls become statistically weak, and how much of the observed mechanism divergence should be attributed to data, architecture, or optimization path. The paper does not fully disentangle those factors, but it sets up a useful framework for doing so.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper identifies itself as Paper 3 in a three-paper series by Xu from 2026. Paper 1 introduces the screen-and-ablate recipe, and Paper 2 studies the formation timeline of these circuits during pretraining. The provided text does not include a reliable full author list or institution metadata.

recommendation.zh: 跨架构机制研究的重要阴性结果——相同任务在不同模型中不共享因果通路，直接质疑跨模型通用电路的存在；实验设计干净（10种子+匹配零假设），值得细看Fig和结果分类学。
recommendation.en: Important negative result in cross-architecture mechanistic study — same task does not share causal circuits across different models, directly challenging universal cross-model circuits; clean design (10 seeds + matched null), worth examining figures and outcome taxonomy.

paper.title: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used for mechanistic interpretability in large language models, yet their formulation assigns each latent feature a single decoder direction, implicitly assuming features to be one-dimensional. We show that this assumption mismatches with the multi-dimensional structure of model features, provably inducing feature splitting through two distinct mechanisms. Geometrically, reconstructing a feature of intrinsic dimension $d_i \ge 2$ to error $\varepsilon$ with

summary.core_problem: 标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）假设每个潜在特征对应一个一维解码器方向，但LLM内部特征实际具有多维子空间结构（如周期性特征的环形表示），这种几何不匹配导致"特征分裂"——单个语义特征被分散到多个解码器向量中，不仅使解释碎片化，还增加了学习底层特征的样本复杂度。
summary.importance: 首次从几何和优化两个角度严格证明了SAE特征分裂的必然性：当特征固有维度大于1时，用单向解码器重构到指定误差所需原子数在维度上指数增长，且ℓ₁稀疏性会主动驱动训练向这种分片解收敛。这一负面结果揭示了当前SAE实践的根本瓶颈，并为子空间感知的可解释性方法提供了理论依据。对预训练研究的启示在于：理解特征的子空间结构可能影响监督信号设计和表示学习目标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出子空间感知稀疏自编码器（SASA），通过带秩自适应正则化的组稀疏性将多维结构直接纳入SAE目标。具体做法是将稀疏性从单个向量级别移到组级别——每组对应一个低秩子空间而非单一方向，用核范数（nuclear norm）类正则化自适应地选择子空间秩，从而消除分裂多维特征的结构性压力。SASA的最优解实际上收敛到数据的top-dᵢ维特征子空间，而非对其进行分片覆盖。
summary.experiments: 论文通过覆盖数（covering number）的k-稀疏覆盖准则形式化了特征分裂，证明了k=1的线覆盖情形下标准SAE必然需要大量解码器方向来实现低重构误差。实验在合成数据和真实LLM激活数据上验证了SASA相比标准SAE降低了样本复杂度、缓解了特征分裂。值得注意的是，LLM激活数据获取成本高昂（每个数据点都需要一次LLM前向传播），因此样本复杂度的改进直接降低了SAE训练成本。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第4节（特征分裂的形式化证明和覆盖数分析）和第5节（SASA的理论构造），这两部分是论文的核心贡献。第6节关于样本复杂度的分析也值得关注。附录中关于多维LRH的经验证据可作为背景了解。预计精读需1.5-2小时，泛读摘要和贡献声明约20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) assume each latent feature corresponds to a one-dimensional decoder direction, but LLM internal features actually exhibit multi-dimensional subspace structure (e.g., circular representations for periodic features). This geometric mismatch causes 'feature splitting'—a single semantic feature gets distributed across multiple decoder vectors—not only fragmenting interpretation but also increasing sample complexity for learning underlying features.
summary_en.importance: This paper provides the first rigorous proof from both geometric and optimization perspectives that feature splitting in SAEs is inevitable: when the intrinsic dimension of features is greater than 1, the number of atoms required for single-direction decoders to reconstruct to a specified error grows exponentially in dimension, and ℓ₁ sparsity actively drives training toward such tiling solutions. This negative result reveals a fundamental bottleneck in current SAE practice and provides theoretical justification for subspace-aware interpretability methods. For pretraining research, understanding the subspace structure of features may influence the design of supervision signals and representation learning objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders (SASA), which incorporates multi-dimensional structure directly into the SAE objective through group sparsity with a rank-adaptive regularizer. Specifically, sparsity is moved from the individual vector level to the group level—each group corresponds to a low-rank subspace rather than a single direction—and a nuclear-norm-style regularizer adaptively selects the subspace rank, eliminating the structural pressure that splits multi-dimensional features. The minimizer of SASA actually converges to the top-dᵢ dimensional eigenspace of the data rather than tile-covering it.
summary_en.experiments: The paper formalizes feature splitting via a k-sparse covering criterion based on covering numbers, proving that in the k=1 line-covering regime, standard SAEs necessarily require many decoder directions to achieve low reconstruction error. Experiments on both synthetic data and real LLM activation data validate that SASA reduces sample complexity and mitigates feature splitting compared to standard SAE. Notably, LLM activation data is expensive to obtain (each data point requires an LLM forward pass), so improvements in sample complexity directly reduce SAE training cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 4 (formal proof of feature splitting and covering number analysis) and Section 5 (theoretical construction of SASA)—these constitute the paper's core contributions. Section 6's analysis of sample complexity is also noteworthy. The appendix with empirical evidence for the Multi-dimensional LRH can be read as background. Expected reading time: 1.5–2 hours for close reading, ~20 minutes for skimming the abstract and contribution statements.

recommendation.zh: SAE机制分析中比较扎实的理论工作，证明特征分裂不是噪声而是结构性问题；只看证明部分（§3）和几何分析即可，实验部分较弱。
recommendation.en: A solid theoretical SAE analysis showing feature splitting is structural, not accidental; read §3 proofs and geometric analysis only; experiments are weak.

paper.title: What's in a Name? Morphological Shortcuts by LLMs in Pharmacology
paper.abstract: The morphological form of a word can often give cues to its meaning, but purely relying on these mappings can lead to overgeneralization in high-stakes domains. In the medical domain, for instance, LLMs can confidently reason about fictitious drugs from their affixes alone (e.g., wugcillin) and generate plausible-looking clinical content. We present a behavioral and mechanistic study of LLM "affix heuristics" in pharmacology. Using fictitious drug names built from real affixes, we show that affi

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在药理学名词理解中是否过度依赖词缀形态线索，从而对虚构药名也生成看似合理但错误的语义与推理。
summary.importance: 这是行为分析加机制分析工作。虽然场景在医学药理，但核心问题是 tokenizer/词形模式与语义捷径学习，对理解语言模型如何把表面形态映射成概念有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造带真实 affix 的虚构药名，测试模型是否仅凭词缀就给出药物类别级反应；再提出一个框架，区分模型语义判断主要来自 affix、stem 还是完整词形。随后在 653 个真实药物上分析这种依赖，并用 activation patching 定位 affix heuristic 的内部表征位置。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 653 个药物，并跨多个模型做行为与 activation patching 分析。摘要显示模型常主要由 affix 诱导药物含义，却很少显式承认这种依赖，还会把共享 affix 的药物属性混淆。没有看到与预训练数据或 tokenizer 设计直接联动的实验，因此对基座研究的直接动作性有限。
summary.authors_note: University of Texas at Austin、Northeastern University、MD Anderson Cancer Center。Byron C. Wallace 与 Junyi Jessy Li 在医疗 NLP 与模型分析方向较活跃。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLMs over-rely on morphological affixes in pharmacology, causing them to assign plausible but incorrect semantics even to fictitious drug names.
summary_en.importance: This is a behavioral plus mechanistic analysis paper. Although the domain is pharmacology, the underlying issue is shortcut learning from word form, which is relevant to how language models map surface morphology to semantic concepts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors create fictitious drug names using real affixes and test whether affix signals alone trigger class-level pharmacological responses. They then introduce a framework to attribute model semantics to the affix, the stem, or the whole name, apply it to 653 drugs, and use activation patching to localize the internal basis of the affix heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 653 drugs and multiple models with both behavioral tests and activation patching. The abstract suggests that models often derive drug meaning mainly from affixes, rarely disclose that reliance explicitly, and sometimes conflate properties among drugs sharing affixes. It does not obviously connect these findings back to pretraining data or tokenizer design, so the direct actionability for foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Texas at Austin, Northeastern University, and MD Anderson Cancer Center. Byron C. Wallace and Junyi Jessy Li are active in medical NLP and model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 题目偏医学，但可当 shortcut learning 个案看；只读行为结果和 activation patching，别把领域现象误当通用结论。
recommendation.en: The domain is medical, but it is a decent shortcut-learning case study; read the behavioral results and activation patching, but do not overgeneralize from a domain-specific setup.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: The Shape of Addition: Geometric Structures of Arithmetic in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Language Models exhibit paradoxical fragility in fundamental arithmetic, implying a disconnect between internal computation and discrete output. By analyzing the residual stream geometry during multi-operand addition, we identify the Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory (IRST), a geometric structure where representations are anchored by semantic digits and modulated by continuous carry fibers. We propose the Noisy Quantization Model to explain this geometry, framing arithmetic errors as Geometric Slippa

summary.core_problem: LLM 在复杂数学推理上表现不错，但在多位数、多操作数加法这种“算法基元”上会出现典型的 off-by-one / carry 错误。更反直觉的是：探针往往能从失败样本的残差流里解码出 ground truth 或关键中间量，说明“正确的信息在内部存在，但输出离散 token 时滑掉了”。论文要回答的是：这种“内部连续表征—外部离散输出”之间的断裂，具体对应什么几何结构与失效机制？
summary.importance:
这是一篇机制分析/表示几何论文，不是预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但它提供了两个可迁移的启发：
1) 把离散错误解释为连续潜变量跨越量化阈值（noisy quantization），这类视角可用于理解 tokenizer/离散化瓶颈、以及“模型内部有解但输出选错 token”的现象（不仅限算术）。
2) “probe versatility” 的结构性解释：同一激活向量可线性分离多种潜在信号，可能意味着残差流里存在可分解的低维流形/纤维结构；这对做可解释性、以及设计更好的训练目标（让内部中间量更可控）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
作者选了一个可控任务：三个或更多 10 位整数相加，并且逐位生成（从最高位到最低位）分析每个位置的残差流激活。定义了列和 Raw Sum r_p、进位 c_p、真值 digit s_p，并引入模型侧的潜变量（预测的 raw sum、预测的 carry）。

方法上主要是：
- Probing：用轻量探针（logistic regression/MLP）在单个 activation 上同时解码多种变量，观察到 probe versatility。
- 几何可视化：用 UMAP 在最后层（以及逐位置）把激活降维，发现所谓 IRST（Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory）：在“digit basins（对应输出 digit 的盆地）”的宏观结构上，叠加“carry 状态的微观纹理”，并且存在沿 raw-sum 常数的连续纤维。
- 失效机制建模：提出 Noisy Quantization Model。核心假设是模型内部先形成连续的 Carry Potential（可理解为对进位强度/概率的连续估计），再在输出阶段被离散化；当神经噪声推动该连续量跨过量化阈值，就会发生 digit 选择的几何滑移（geometric slippage），产生周期性的错误分布（文中提到 bathtub 形状）。
- 验证性干预：提出 inference-time 的 dual-stream consistency，自行解码“局部 raw sum”和“全局 carry potential”并做一致性约束，用来纠正输出，作为“内部确有正确组件”的证据。

与以往算术机制工作相比，它更强调“连续纤维 + 量化阈值”的桥接解释，而不是只停留在能 probe 出什么信息。
summary.experiments:
实验主线是表征与错误分布的对应关系：
- 任务：多操作数、多位数加法，逐位分析。
- 现象：UMAP 上出现 IRST 纤维结构；错误可解释为沿纤维漂移导致跨 digit basin 边界。
- 拟合：Noisy Quantization Model 能解释并预测文中提到的周期性 bathtub error 分布（摘要/引言点名 Fig.5）。
- 干预：dual-stream consistency 的推理期自校正能“显著恢复性能”（引言措辞），用于证明 latent 信号可用。

但就当前提供的全文片段，缺少可复述的关键数字：使用的具体模型（家族/参数量）、错误率下降幅度、探针准确率、以及自校正带来的提升百分比等。它更像一篇以定性结构 + 若干定量曲线支撑的机制论文。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看任务与变量定义（Preliminaries）：r_p/c_p/s_p 的定义决定后面所有几何解释是否自洽。
- 重点看 Fig.2（IRST/UMAP 结构）和 Fig.5（bathtub error 分布与模型预测），这是“几何—错误机制”论证链的两根主梁。
- 再看 dual-stream consistency 的方法与 ablation：它是否真的只利用了可解码的中间量，还是引入了额外启发式。

如果你的关注点是预训练/数据/优化，这篇更适合作为“离散输出错误的连续解释”案例阅读，不建议深挖全部细节；但做 tokenizer/离散化、或研究‘internal correctness vs external failure’ 的团队值得精读图表与方法细节。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs can solve high-level math benchmarks yet remain brittle on multi-digit, multi-operand addition, often making characteristic carry-related off-by-one errors. Probing results deepen the puzzle: even when the model outputs the wrong digit, simple probes can decode the ground-truth digit or intermediate states from the residual stream. The paper asks for a mechanistic bridge: what geometric structure in representation space allows “correct latent computation” to coexist with “wrong discrete token output,” and how does that geometry produce specific arithmetic failures?
summary_en.importance:
This is a mechanistic interpretability / representation-geometry study, not a pretraining-method contribution. Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but non-trivial:
- It frames discrete output errors as threshold crossings of a continuous latent variable under neural noise (“noisy quantization”), a lens that can generalize to other settings where internal signals are present but decoding/token selection fails.
- It offers a structural explanation for probe versatility (multiple latent signals linearly separable from the same activation), suggesting residual-stream manifolds with fiber-like organization—useful for interpretability and for thinking about training objectives that better constrain intermediate variables.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper uses a controlled task: addition of three (or more) 10-digit integers, analyzing residual-stream activations at every generated digit position. It defines column-wise Raw Sum r_p, propagated carry c_p, and ground-truth digit s_p, and introduces model-side latent counterparts (predicted raw sum / predicted carry).

Method components:
- Probing: lightweight probes (logistic regression, small MLPs) decode multiple variables from a single activation vector, establishing “probe versatility.”
- Geometry: UMAP visualizations (primarily final-layer activations) reveal an Iso-Raw-Sum Trajectory (IRST): continuous fibers of constant raw sum threading through a macro-structure of digit “basins,” with micro-structure tied to carry states.
- Mechanistic model: the Noisy Quantization Model posits a continuous Carry Potential internally estimated and then discretized; noise can push it across quantization thresholds, causing “geometric slippages” across digit-basin decision boundaries.
- Validation via intervention: an inference-time dual-stream consistency method decodes local (raw-sum) and global (carry-potential) signals and enforces consistency to self-correct, supporting the claim that correct components exist latently even when output is wrong.

Compared to prior arithmetic-mechanism work, the emphasis is on a continuous-fiber + quantization-threshold explanation rather than only demonstrating probe extractability.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental narrative ties representation geometry to error patterns:
- Setup: multi-operand, multi-digit addition with per-position activation analysis.
- Findings: IRST-like fiber structure in UMAP; errors correspond to drifts along fibers that cross digit-basin boundaries.
- Quantitative fit: the Noisy Quantization Model explains/predicts a periodic “bathtub” error distribution (highlighted as Fig.5 in the intro).
- Intervention: dual-stream consistency yields a sizable inference-time recovery (described as “significant” in the intro), used as evidence that latent signals are usable.

However, in the provided full-text excerpt, key reproducible numbers are missing (exact model(s), parameter counts, probe accuracies, and the magnitude of error reduction from the intervention). The paper reads more like qualitative geometry + supporting curves than a metrics-first study.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the task/state definitions carefully (r_p, c_p, s_p). The rest depends on these variables being well-posed.
- Focus on the main geometry figures (IRST/UMAP) and the error-distribution figure (bathtub pattern + model prediction). Those are the core evidence for the proposed mechanism.
- Check the dual-stream consistency section and any ablations to see whether the correction is principled or heuristic-heavy.

If your primary focus is pretraining/data/optimization, treat this as a case study on “continuous latent correctness vs discrete decoding failure.” It becomes more worth deep reading if you work on tokenization/discretization or mechanistic interpretability of decoding failures.

recommendation.zh: 从残差流几何结构（IRST）和连续电位量化阈值的角度解释 LLM 算术错误，视角独特，对理解模型内部机理和设计干预方法有启发。
recommendation.en: Explaining LLM arithmetic errors from the perspective of residual stream geometry (IRST) and continuous potential quantization thresholds is unique and inspiring for understanding internal mechanisms and designing interventions.

paper.title: Causal Evidence of Stack Representations in Modeling Counter Languages Using Transformers
paper.abstract: Formal languages have proven to be effective conduits to understand the inner mechanisms of transformers. Past work has shown that transformers trained on next token prediction over counter languages learn representations consistent with an underlying stack structure. Beyond representational analysis, this paper investigates the causal role of these representations. Linear probes are trained to predict the stack depth at each token from the model's hidden states, and a principal representation d

summary.core_problem: 以形式语言为探针时，已有工作发现 Transformer 会“看起来”学到类似栈（stack）的表征，但这类结论多停留在相关性：能被 probe 读出来，不代表模型真的在用。论文要解决的是因果性问题：这些栈深度表征是否是模型完成 next-token 预测所必需的内部计算成分，而不仅是可被线性读出的副产物。
summary.importance: 对预训练 recipe 没有直接改动，但对训练动态与机制分析有实质意义：它给出一种相对干净的“表征→因果必要性”证据链（probe 提取方向 + 方向消融导致性能崩溃），把形式语言上的 mechanistic interpretability 从“可解码”推进到“可干预”。对做算法能力、长程依赖、以及想把机制结论反馈到架构/目标函数设计的人，这类因果干预范式比单纯 probe 更可信。需要注意的是：结论目前建立在小模型、单层、特定任务与特定干预方式上，外推到大规模 LLM 仍需谨慎。
summary.technical_approach:
实验对象是 Dyck-1 与 Shuffle-k（k=2/4/6/8）这类需要栈式记忆的形式语言。模型是 encoder-only Transformer，但使用 causal mask 做 next-token 预测；输出不是单一 token softmax，而是“合法下一 token 集合”的 k-hot 多标签预测（sigmoid），训练用 MSE。
关键方法步骤：
1) 训练一个已收敛的语言模型：在 Shuffle-k 上达到验证集完美准确率，确保后续分析针对的是有效解。
2) 线性 probe 预测栈深度：对每个位置的隐藏状态 h_t^(l)，训练线性分类器预测某一括号类型 i 的 stack depth_i(t)。同时训练 control probe（随机打乱标签）并计算 selectivity（实验 probe 准确率 - control probe 准确率），用于排除“probe 只是记住数据分布”的假阳性。
3) 从 probe 权重中提取主方向并做消融：取 probe 权重矩阵 W 的 SVD，使用 top right singular vector w 作为“栈深度主表征方向”。推理时对每个隐藏状态做正交投影消融：h ← h - (h·w)w。
4) 因果对照：消融随机方向作为 baseline，比较性能退化幅度。
这里的关键取舍是：不直接用 probe 的某一类权重向量，而是用 W 的主奇异向量，试图捕捉对多类别深度判别最共同、最稳定的方向；同时用随机方向消融排除“任何消融都会伤模型”的伪因果。
summary.experiments:
模型与数据（全文片段给出了较完整的可复现细节）：
- 任务：Shuffle-k（k=2,4,6,8）与 Dyck-1；序列长度 2–50。
- 训练数据：10,000 条序列，80/20 train/val。
- 模型：单层 Transformer，4 heads，d_embed=32，d_model=64，d_ffn=64，learned positional encoding。
- 训练：RMSProp，lr=5e-3，batch=32；25 epoch 左右达到 Shuffle-k 的完美验证准确率。
- 评测指标：positional accuracy（逐位置预测集合是否完全正确）与 sequential accuracy（整串是否完全有效，任一错误即失败）。
核心结果：
- 线性 probe 能高选择性地读出 stack depth（表格引用了 Tiwari et al., 2025 的 selectivity 结果；你给的片段未包含具体数值表）。
- 对 probe 主方向 w 做消融会导致 sequential accuracy 近乎降到 0%，而随机方向消融不出现同等幅度崩溃，从而支持“栈表征对计算是因果必要”的结论。
建议在全文中核对：崩溃发生在第几层/哪个位置、对不同 k 的一致性、以及 positional vs sequential 的差异（后者更敏感，可能更容易出现“接近 0%”的现象）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先级：中等偏高（机制分析方法论清晰，且干预证据比常规 probe 更硬），预计 40–60 分钟。
建议阅读顺序：
- Setup：确认任务定义、输出形式（k-hot 多标签）与指标（positional/sequential），避免把它误读成普通 next-token softmax。
- Probe 与 selectivity：看 control probe 细节与深度类别 C 的设置；这决定“可解码”结论是否扎实。
- Intervention 章节：重点看为什么用 SVD 的 top right singular vector、消融公式、以及随机方向对照的统计显著性。
- 结果图表：优先找“消融强度/不同层/不同 k”的曲线或表格（如果有），判断因果结论是否稳健，还是只在某个设置下成立。
- 讨论/局限：关注作者是否解释了为什么单一方向就能让性能崩溃，以及这与已知的 superposition/多特征纠缠是否矛盾。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work on formal languages shows transformers can encode stack-like information, but probing is correlational: a probe reading out stack depth does not imply the model uses it. This paper asks a causal question: is the learned stack-depth representation necessary for next-token prediction performance, or merely an epiphenomenon?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-recipe contribution, but a meaningful step for training dynamics and mechanistic interpretability methodology. It provides a relatively clean causal chain—extract a representation direction from a trained probe, ablate it, and observe near-total performance collapse—moving beyond “decodable” to “interventionally necessary.” The main caveat is external validity: the evidence is on small, single-layer transformers and specific formal-language tasks, so extrapolation to large LLMs should be conservative.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The testbed is Dyck-1 and Shuffle-k (k=2/4/6/8), where correct continuation depends on stack-like memory. The model is an encoder-only transformer with a causal mask for next-token prediction, but the output is multi-label: it predicts the set of valid next tokens as a k-hot vector via a sigmoid head, trained with MSE.
Method pipeline:
1) Train a fully converged LM on Shuffle-k.
2) Train linear probes to predict stack depth at each position from hidden states; use a control probe with randomized labels and report selectivity to argue the feature is genuinely encoded.
3) Extract a principal “stack direction” from the probe weight matrix W using SVD; take the top right singular vector w.
4) Perform causal intervention at inference by ablating that direction: h ← h − (h·w)w. Compare against ablating random directions as a control.
The design choice of using the top singular vector (instead of a single class weight) aims to capture the most shared discriminative direction across depth classes, and random-direction ablations help rule out trivial damage-from-any-ablation explanations.
summary_en.experiments:
Reproducible setup details from the provided content:
- Data: 10,000 sequences, lengths 2–50, 80/20 split.
- Model: 1-layer transformer, 4 heads, d_embed=32, d_model=64, d_ffn=64, learned positional embeddings.
- Training: RMSProp, lr=5e-3, batch=32; reaches perfect validation accuracy on Shuffle-k by ~epoch 25.
- Metrics: positional accuracy (exact match of valid-next-token set per position) and sequential accuracy (entire string validity; any mistake fails).
Key findings:
- Linear probes can decode stack depth with high selectivity (the excerpt references a table from Tiwari et al., 2025; exact numbers are not included here).
- Ablating the probe-derived principal direction drives sequential accuracy to near 0%, while random-direction ablations do not cause comparable collapse, supporting causal necessity of the stack representation.
When reading the full paper, verify robustness across k, layers/positions, and whether positional accuracy degrades similarly or less dramatically than sequential accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Worth a careful skim (40–60 minutes).
Read in this order:
- Setup: note the multi-label k-hot prediction and MSE loss; it is not standard softmax next-token LM.
- Probing protocol: depth class definition, control probe construction, and selectivity.
