- Intervention details: why SVD/top singular vector, exact ablation operation, and random-direction baselines.
- Results: look for breakdowns by k, by layer/position, and any sensitivity analyses.
- Limitations/discussion: whether a single direction plausibly captures the computation, and how this interacts with feature superposition or distributed representations.

recommendation.zh: 这类 formal-language 结果别外推过头，但“probe 可读出 ≠ 被模型使用”这件事它做得比多数论文干净；看消融设计即可，若你做机制分析值得复现。
recommendation.en: Do not over-generalize from formal languages, but this is cleaner than most probe papers on the old 'decodable does not mean used' issue; the ablation design is the part worth reading and possibly reproducing.

institutions: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

paper.title: Multi-component Causal Tracing in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Causal tracing systematically intervenes on a large language model's (LLM's) internal representations to uncover and quantify the causal pathways linking specific inputs or computations to specific metrics of interest, quantifying the LLM's behavior. Building on previous single-component or single-layer studies, this paper presents a unified framework for causally tracing multiple components simultaneously. This framework systematically identifies the subsets of components (e.g., attention heads

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 causal tracing 大多一次只分析单个组件，或者把多组件影响近似成线性可加，但真实的 LLM 电路里常常存在非线性交互，单组件分析会错过真正起作用的组合。作者因此把问题重新表述为一个组合优化任务：在给定干预方式和目标指标后，从大量 attention heads / MLP neurons 中找出一个子集，使联合干预后的目标指标最大，同时控制子集稀疏度。
summary.importance: 它对预训练的直接作用不是提出新 recipe，而是提供一种更强的训练后诊断工具。对基座研究员而言，价值在两点。第一，它提醒人们不要把模型内部因果贡献默认看成可加的；如果多组件交互普遍存在，那么很多基于单层、单头、单神经元的重要性结论都可能不稳。第二，它给出了一个可扩展的搜索框架，能把 tracing 从“画热力图”推进到“找最关键的联合子电路”，这对理解 fine-tuning 改了什么、偏见或事实性由哪些组件共同承载、以及后续做 targeted editing / sparse intervention 都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先统一定义了 multi-component causal tracing。模型内部有一组可干预组件，可以是 attention heads、MLP neurons 或其他模块；用户还要指定一个 metric，可以是准确率、公平性、事实性等任意可计算目标。问题变成：在所有组件子集上搜索，找到联合干预后最优的那一组。难点显然是组合爆炸。

作者的解法是把离散子集选择松弛成连续优化。具体做法是对每个候选组件引入一个软门控变量，通过 soft intervention 控制该组件是否被 patch / restore / replace。这样，原本不可导的子集搜索被转成可用梯度下降优化的连续问题。

但仅有软门控还不够，因为目标 metric 往往是离散或不适合直接优化的。论文因此加入 metric transformation，把原始评价量变成更适合梯度优化的形式。摘要和引言没有展开全部公式，但从作者描述看，这一步是为了改善梯度信号，使优化不至于被稀疏、离散、饱和的指标卡住。

另一个关键设计是 scheduled penalty function。作者不是简单加一个固定 L1 或 hard top-k 约束，而是设计了随训练过程变化的惩罚项，让门控值逐步向稀疏和二值化收缩，并在达到目标 sparsity 时停止。这个设计同时服务两个目标：一是避免一开始就把搜索空间压得太死，二是最终得到可解释的离散组件子集，而不是一堆模糊权重。

论文还把自己的方法和 top-k、greedy、以及已有 gradient-based tracing 方法做比较，并指出某些已有方法的效果差异很大程度来自 penalty 和优化细节，而不是“梯度法天然更强或更弱”。这点很重要，因为它把问题从算法标签之争，拉回到具体优化设计。

从方法定位看，这不是 mechanistic interpretability 里那种手工电路分析，而是一个更通用的 tracing optimizer：给定可干预组件、干预算子和目标 metric，就能自动搜索关键联合子集。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主线有两层。第一层是现象验证：作者在 GPT2-small 和两个数据集上展示，某些 attention head 或 MLP neuron 的成对联合干预，会产生明显偏离单独干预求和的效果，也就是存在显著非线性 interaction。文中用一个 pairwise heatmap 展示 joint intervention metric 减去 individual metrics 之和，红蓝区域都很明显，这直接反驳了“组件贡献大致线性可加”的默认假设至少并不普适。

第二层是算法比较。作者将提出的连续优化方法与 top-k、greedy 等基线比较，结论是基线在效率和效果上都不稳定，而所提方法能在更大的组合空间里更有效地找到高价值组件子集。摘要截断处没有给出完整数字，但正文明确声称 baseline top-k 和 greedy 在若干设置下会明显落后；同时，作者还分析了 Davies et al. (2023) 一类 gradient-based 搜索方法，认为其性能差距很大程度上由 penalty 与 optimization choices 驱动，并在附录中做了更细的对照。

从研究者视角，更值得看的不是单个绝对分数，而是三类实验设计：一，是否在不同 metric 上都能工作，而不只针对 accuracy；二，是否同时支持不同组件粒度，如 head 和 neuron；三，搜索出的子集是否真的更稀疏且更有解释性，而不是靠大面积干预换来指标提升。论文的卖点正是这三点的统一。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1 及其解释。那张图基本说明了整篇工作的动机：多组件联合效应并不总是线性。

然后看问题定义和优化目标。重点不是记公式，而是弄清三件事：组件集合怎么参数化，intervention 怎么做，metric 为什么需要 transformation。若这三点看懂，后面的算法细节就容易跟上。

再看 penalty scheduling 的设计。这里是方法成败的关键，因为它决定了连续松弛最后能不能收敛到有意义的稀疏离散解。阅读时可以顺手对照作者对 Davies et al. 的批评，看看差异究竟落在目标函数、正则项还是优化流程上。

最后看实验里 pairwise interaction 的可视化和与 top-k / greedy 的比较。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若只想知道这篇论文有没有方法含量，就看 unified framework、soft intervention、metric transformation、scheduled penalty 这四处。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of standard causal tracing: most prior work studies one component at a time, or implicitly assumes that multi-component effects are roughly additive. The authors argue that this misses genuinely important interactions inside LLMs. They therefore formulate multi-component causal tracing as a combinatorial search problem: given a set of intervenable components and a target metric, find the subset whose joint intervention maximizes that metric under a sparsity constraint.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as a stronger diagnostic tool for foundation-model research. Two points matter. First, it challenges the common habit of interpreting component importance as if it were additive. If nonlinear interactions are common, conclusions drawn from single-head or single-neuron tracing can be incomplete or misleading. Second, it turns causal tracing into a practical search problem over joint circuits rather than a collection of isolated heatmaps. That is useful for studying what fine-tuning changes, where bias or factual behavior is jointly encoded, and how to design more targeted editing or intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper defines a general framework for multi-component causal tracing. A model contains a set of candidate components, such as attention heads or MLP neurons. The user also specifies an intervention operator and a metric of interest, which can be accuracy, fairness, factuality, or another task-specific quantity. The objective is to find the subset of components whose joint intervention optimizes the chosen metric.

The main challenge is combinatorial explosion. The proposed solution is to relax discrete subset selection into a continuous optimization problem. Each candidate component receives a soft gating variable controlling whether and how strongly that component is intervened on. This turns subset search into a differentiable optimization problem amenable to gradient descent.

A second issue is that the target metric is often discrete, sparse, or otherwise poorly behaved for direct optimization. The method therefore introduces a metric transformation that produces a smoother optimization signal. The exact form depends on the setup, but the role is clear: make gradient-based search viable for metrics that would otherwise provide weak or unstable gradients.

The third key ingredient is a scheduled penalty function. Instead of using a fixed sparsity penalty or a hard top-k rule from the start, the method gradually increases pressure toward sparse and binary gates. This allows the search to explore early and then converge to an interpretable discrete subset later. The schedule is also designed to stop once the desired sparsity level is reached.

The paper positions this as a general tracing optimizer rather than a hand-built mechanistic analysis. Given components, interventions, and a metric, it can search for jointly important subsets across different tasks and component granularities.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has two parts. First, the paper demonstrates the phenomenon it is built around: nonlinear interactions between components. On GPT2-small and two datasets, the authors show that intervening on certain pairs of attention heads or MLP neurons produces effects that differ substantially from the sum of the two single-component interventions. They visualize this with pairwise interaction heatmaps, where the joint metric minus the sum of individual metrics shows strong positive and negative regions. This is the central evidence against a blanket linearity assumption.

Second, the paper compares its optimization-based search against simpler baselines such as top-k and greedy selection, and also discusses prior gradient-based tracing methods. The claim is that naive baselines are both less effective and less efficient in the combinatorial setting, while the proposed method finds better sparse subsets more reliably. The introduction and abstract do not expose all numerical details, but the full text emphasizes that optimization choices, especially the penalty design and schedule, explain much of the gap between methods.

From a research perspective, the most important experimental questions are whether the framework works across different metrics rather than only accuracy, whether it supports multiple component types such as heads and neurons, and whether the selected subsets remain sparse and interpretable rather than relying on broad interventions. Those are the dimensions to watch while reading the results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Figure 1 and the surrounding discussion in the introduction. That figure carries the main motivation: joint effects between components are not reliably additive.

Then read the formal problem setup and the optimization objective. The key is not memorizing the equations, but understanding three design choices: how components are parameterized, how interventions are applied, and why the metric needs to be transformed before optimization.

Next, focus on the scheduled penalty mechanism. This is likely the most important technical detail, because the success of the continuous relaxation depends on whether it can end in a sparse, near-binary, interpretable solution. It is also the right place to compare the method against prior gradient-based tracing approaches.

Finally, inspect the pairwise interaction visualizations and the comparisons with top-k and greedy baselines. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main contribution. If time is short, prioritize the unified framework, soft interventions, metric transformation, and penalty scheduling.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写 pretrain prior 的论文，但若你在做 activation patching/causal mediation，这篇把“多组件联合归因”做成可优化问题，方法层面值得借来做训练诊断。
recommendation.en: Not a prior-shifting pretrain paper, but if you use activation patching or causal mediation, this is worth reading for turning joint component attribution into an optimization problem for training diagnostics.

paper.title: Visual Instruction Tuning Aligns Modalities through Abstraction
paper.abstract: Visual instruction tuning effectively adapts a pre-trained Large Language Model (LLM) to process image information alongside text. Yet, it remains unclear how visual features are embedded into the layer-wise hierarchy of abstractions of the LLM backbone. Across a diverse set of vision-language architectures, we show that instruction tuning primarily serves as a bridge, embedding visual features directly into the intermediate semantic layers of the LLM, bypassing the early layers devoted to unimo

summary.core_problem: 视觉指令调优对齐多模态信息的内部机制不明确，现有分析多局限于单架构，缺乏跨架构的因果性证据验证视觉特征与LLM层级抽象的对应关系，也不清楚指令调优中哪些层的参数更新对多模态性能起关键作用。
summary.importance: 从机制层面解释了VLM指令调优的作用位点，为VLM的高效参数微调、架构设计提供了可验证的指导原则，也为多模态预训练的层间对齐目标设计提供了参考方向。
summary.technical_approach: 选取7种不同设计的开源VLM，覆盖自注意力、交叉注意力两类架构，采用两种因果干预手段：注意力敲除（阻断文本query对图像key的注意力流）、层跳过（绕过指定层的视觉token计算），结合表征探针对比预训练和调优后不同层的图文表征语义相似度，另外验证仅微调中间层的性能收益。
summary.experiments: 干预实验显示，消融中间层带来的多模态任务性能下降幅度最大，是跨模态信息交互的核心位点。探针分析发现，指令调优主要将视觉特征对齐到LLM的中间语义层，绕过了LLM早期的单模态文本处理层。仅微调中间层的性能与全参数微调相当，训练成本更低，在视觉占比高的任务上收益最明显。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第3章的干预实验设计与核心结论，以及第4章的局部微调实验结果。预计阅读时间20分钟，无需深究所有VLM的架构细节，核心关注跨架构一致的中间层效应。

summary_en.core_problem: The internal mechanism of visual instruction tuning for multimodal alignment remains unclear. Existing analyses are mostly limited to single architectures, lack cross-architecture causal evidence verifying the correspondence between visual features and LLM hierarchical abstractions, and do not identify which layers' parameter updates during instruction tuning dominate multimodal performance.
summary_en.importance: Explains the functional locus of VLM instruction tuning at the mechanism level, provides verifiable guiding principles for efficient parameter fine-tuning and architecture design of VLMs, and offers a reference direction for designing inter-layer alignment objectives in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Selects 7 open-source VLMs with diverse designs, covering both self-attention and cross-attention architectures. Uses two causal intervention methods: attention knockout (blocks information flow from text queries to image keys) and layer skipping (bypasses visual token computation in specified layer ranges). Combines representation probing to compare the semantic similarity of text and visual representations at different layers before and after fine-tuning, and verifies the performance gain of only fine-tuning intermediate layers.
summary_en.experiments: Intervention experiments show that ablating intermediate layers causes the largest performance drop on multimodal tasks, identifying them as the core site of cross-modal information interaction. Probing analysis finds that instruction tuning mainly aligns visual features to the intermediate semantic layers of the LLM, bypassing the early unimodal text processing layers of the LLM. Fine-tuning only intermediate layers achieves performance comparable to full parameter fine-tuning with lower training cost, and the gain is most significant on vision-centric tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read. Focus on the intervention experiment design and core conclusions in Chapter 3, as well as the localized fine-tuning experiment results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes. No need to delve into the architecture details of all VLMs; focus on the consistent intermediate layer effect across architectures.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 VLM 微调时视觉特征主要注入 LLM 中间层而非浅层的机制，对设计多模态融合架构（如 cross-attention 插入位置）有直接启发，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Reveals that visual features are primarily injected into the intermediate layers of LLMs rather than early layers during VLM fine-tuning, offering direct inspiration for designing multimodal fusion architectures (e.g., cross-attention insertion points); worth reading.

paper.title: A Close Look At World Model Recovery In Supervised Fine-Tuned LLM Planners
paper.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end classical planning in large language models (LLMs), but do these models also learn to represent and reason about the planning problems they are solving? Due to the relative complexity of classical planning problems and the challenge that end-to-end plan generation poses for LLMs, it has been difficult to explore this question. In our work, we devise and perform a series of interpretability experiments that holistically interrogate world model reco

summary.core_problem: 监督微调（SFT）能提升 LLM 在经典规划任务中的端到端表现，但模型是否真正学习并表征了规划问题的世界模型（world model）仍不清楚。
summary.importance: 通过可解释性实验，深入探究了 SFT 对 LLM 内部表征和生成能力的影响，为理解 LLM 在规划任务中的内部机制提供了实证依据，有助于指导更有效的微调策略。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了一个框架，从内部表征质量和生成模型视角量化世界模型恢复程度。1) 内部表征：在微调后 LLM 的隐藏状态上训练线性探针，预测状态谓词的真值和中间步骤动作的有效性；2) 生成能力：采用指标，通过生成的 token 概率对有效和无效动作进行分类。实验在两个经典规划环境中进行，对比了三种不同数据分布的微调效果，并探索了类似思维链（CoT）的微调技术（在动作之间生成中间状态）。
summary.experiments: 发现：1) 仅在有效动作序列上进行 SFT，就足以让 LLM 学习到线性编码动作有效性和部分状态谓词的内部表征；2) 即使模型难以利用预测概率区分有效和无效动作，其内部表征可能仍具备这种区分能力；3) 在具有良好状态空间覆盖率（如随机游走生成）的规划数据上进行微调，通常能实现更好的分布内和分布外世界模型恢复。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读实验设计部分（如何定义和量化世界模型恢复）以及结果分析（特别是内部表征与生成概率之间的差异）。不同数据分布对微调效果的影响也值得关注。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves end-to-end performance of LLMs in classical planning tasks, but it remains unclear whether the models truly learn and represent the world model of the planning problems.
summary_en.importance: Through interpretability experiments, this paper deeply investigates the impact of SFT on the internal representations and generative capabilities of LLMs, providing empirical evidence for understanding the internal mechanisms of LLMs in planning tasks and guiding more effective fine-tuning strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Designs a framework to quantify world model recovery from the perspectives of internal representation quality and generative models. 1) Internal representation: Trains linear probes on the hidden states of fine-tuned LLMs to predict the truth values of state predicates and the validity of actions at intermediate steps; 2) Generative capability: Adopts a metric to classify valid and invalid actions using generated token probabilities. Experiments are conducted in two classical planning environments, comparing the fine-tuning effects of three different data distributions and exploring a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) style fine-tuning technique (generating intermediate states between actions).
summary_en.experiments: Findings: 1) SFT directly on sequences of valid actions is sufficient for LLMs to learn internal representations that linearly encode action validity and some state predicates; 2) Even if models struggle to use predicted probabilities to distinguish between valid and invalid actions, their internal representations may still possess this capability; 3) Fine-tuning on planning data with good state space coverage (e.g., generated by random walks) generally achieves better in-distribution and out-of-distribution world model recovery.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the experimental design (how world model recovery is defined and quantified) and the result analysis (especially the discrepancy between internal representations and generation probabilities). The impact of different data distributions on fine-tuning effects is also noteworthy. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探究 SFT 模型是否真正学到了世界模型，发现内部表示（线性探针可分）与输出概率（生成能力）之间存在脱节，对理解 LLM 的 reasoning 机制有帮助。
recommendation.en: Investigates whether SFT models truly learn world models, finding a disconnect between internal representations (linearly separable) and output probabilities (generative capabilities), helpful for understanding LLM reasoning mechanisms.

paper.title: Detection vs. Execution: Single-Bucket Probes Miss Half the Mamba-2 State Sink
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often assumes that probes identifying a representational signature also identify the circuit executing the corresponding computation. We show that this assumption can fail systematically in Mamba-2. Studying the state sink (disproportionate Delta-gate activation on boundary tokens, analogous to the attention sink), we find that single-bucket probes recover only a small execution layer while missing a much larger detection layer with the same representational signatur

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作检验了一个在机制可解释里常被默认接受的前提：探针找到了某种表征特征，是否就等于找到了真正执行该计算的电路。作者在 Mamba-2 上给出的答案是否定的。具体对象是 state sink，也就是边界 token（BOS、newline）上异常偏高的 Δ 门控激活。论文发现，单桶 single-bucket probe 在 Mamba-2 的 head 粒度下只能稳定找出一小组“执行层”头，而会系统性漏掉一大组同样带有相似表征签名、但功能上更像“检测层”的头。于是，表征定位和因果定位在这里发生了分离。作者进一步说明，这不是探针技巧不够，而是 Mamba-2 的 head-shared Δ 投影带来的结构性结果；同样的分析在 Mamba-1 的 channel 粒度下则基本不会出这个问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提升 loss 或吞吐，而在于提醒大家：新架构的内部功能单元未必沿用 Transformer 时代那套“高激活单元≈因果单元”的解释习惯。Mamba-2 这类 selective SSM 把 Δ 投影绑定到 head 内共享后，功能可能被迫在一个 head 里复用和混叠，导致 probe 读到的是“会响应什么”，而不是“真正负责做什么”。这对两类工作都有影响。第一类是机制分析：已有基于单桶 probe 的 Mamba-2 头级结论需要重审。第二类是架构设计与训练诊断：如果一个结构天然把 detection 和 execution 压进同一表征子空间，那么仅靠激活统计来做可解释、剪枝、路由分析，都会有偏差。量级上，这不是边角误差。作者报告在 Mamba-2 上会低估因果基底的集合规模 3–7 倍，已经足以改变对模型内部组织方式的判断。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文做了三件事。第一，给 state sink 一个可操作的定义：在 selective SSM 中，用 Δ-gate 空间而不是 attention score 空间去度量边界 token 的异常占用。第二，区分两类头。single-bucket bos-specialist heads 是只对 BOS 类边界强响应的一小组头；dual heads 则通过 multi-class aggregation 从同一 probe 中恢复出来，它们对 BOS 和 newline 都有近共线的 Δ_pre 表征，因此在单桶设置下容易被漏掉。第三，用大规模干预而不是只看 probe 排名来判断因果性。作者做了一个预注册的六因子干预网格：模型覆盖 Mamba-1 130M/2.8B 与 Mamba-2 1.3B/2.7B；干预类型包括 gate_zero、gate_one、gate_mean、delta_zero、delta_median、u_zero；作用范围包括 probe 导出的不同 channel/head 集合、不同层范围、不同语料。核心判断标准不是“这些头激活高不高”，而是 ablation 后对 BOS-context 与 newline-target 预测的影响。

关键创新点有两个。一个是 detection vs. execution 的功能拆分：dual heads 在表征上很像 sink 单元，但在因果干预下并不承担与 bos-specialists 同等的执行责任，尤其在 newline target 上持续落后。另一个是把这种拆分追溯到架构约束：Mamba-1 的 Δ 投影是 channel-independent，允许不同边界类的 specialist 子群体并存；Mamba-2 的 Δ 投影在 head 内共享，head 数量又远少于 channel 数量，于是一个 head 更容易同时承载多类边界检测信号，形成“检测层大、执行层小”的现象。作者还用把 Mamba-1 channel 随机打包成伪 head（H/C=20）的实验，说明问题不只是粒度粗细，而更像是共享投影带来的功能复用。
summary.experiments:
实验设计很扎实。全文提到总干预单元 12,096 个，实际评估 6,060 个；headline 结果在两套语料上复现：wikitext-2 和 Pile-10k。模型尺度覆盖三档 Mamba-2（130M/1.3B/2.7B）以及 Mamba-1 对照。

几组最关键的数字如下：
1. 在 Mamba-2 2.7B，single-bucket bos-specialists 只占约 5% 的 heads，而 dual heads 占 27%–35%。也就是说，单桶 probe 找到的是一个很小的执行子集，而不是完整的 sink 相关因果基底。
2. 从集合规模看，Mamba-2 上单桶方法会把因果底座低估 3–7 倍；从 aggregate ablation effect 看，dual heads 因为集合更大，整体消融效应可达 bos-specialists 的 4.8–6.4 倍，但 per-unit 效应大致同量级。这说明 dual 集合不是“每个头更关键”，而是“更多头都带有相关表征”。
3. 真正区分 detection 和 execution 的是 class-conditional ablation。跨三种 Mamba-2 尺度、两套语料共 6 个 cell，bos-specialists 对 BOS-context 和 newline-target 都是正向因果；dual heads 在 newline target 上 6/6 全部弱于 bos-specialists。与此同时，dual heads 的 BOS/newline Δ_pre 余弦相似度高达 0.89，而 bos-specialists 只有 0.54，说明 dual 的“像”主要是表征相似，不等于功能等价。
4. 架构驱动证据：把 Mamba-1 的 channel 随机分桶成类似 head 的结构后，仍能保留 29% 的 bos-specialists，而 Mamba-2 只有 5%。这支持“问题来自 head 内共享 Δ 投影”，而不只是“单位数变少”。
5. 检索迁移实验很强。RULER Needle-in-a-Haystack 在 1024 context 下，对 Mamba-1 2.8B 和 Mamba-2 2.7B，消融 bos-specialists 会把 needle retrieval accuracy 从 1.00 直接打到 0.00，而消融补集仍保持 1.00。这说明 state sink 不是只在玩具分析里成立，而与长上下文检索锚定直接相关。
6. Pythia 四个 attention 模型作为跨架构基线，没有出现类似 dual-set dominance，说明这不是“任何序列模型都会有”的普遍现象，而更像 Mamba-2 结构特有的问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一是引言里对 state sink、attention sink、single-bucket probe 的定义，以及作者为什么说这是“架构性失配”而不是“probe 没调好”。第二是 §4.3.4 附近关于 detection vs. execution 的核心结果，尤其看 bos-specialists 与 dual heads 在 newline target 上的因果差异。第三是 §4.6 的随机 channel bucketing，对理解“为什么 Mamba-1 没这个问题而 Mamba-2 有”最关键。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → headline claims → Mamba-2 class-conditional ablation 图表 → T3 架构驱动实验 → RULER 迁移结果。读的时候重点不要只盯 aggregate effect，要同时看 set size、per-unit effect 和表征相似度三者如何分离。真正值得深挖的点有两个：一是 head-shared Δ 是否会影响训练中功能模块化的形成；二是这类 detection/execution 分离会不会也出现在 MoE expert、grouped-query attention 或多模态共享投影里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests a common assumption in mechanistic interpretability: if a probe identifies units with a representational signature, those units are also the circuit executing the computation. In Mamba-2, the answer is no. The case study is the state sink, defined as disproportionately large Δ-gate activation on boundary tokens such as BOS and newline. The authors show that single-bucket probes recover only a small execution set, while missing a much larger set of heads with a similar signature that behaves more like a detection layer. So representational localization and causal localization come apart. The paper further argues that this is not a probe-tuning issue but a structural consequence of Mamba-2’s head-shared Δ projection. In Mamba-1, at channel granularity, the mismatch largely disappears.
summary_en.importance: This is not a training-recipe paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it changes how one should read internal structure in non-Transformer architectures. In Mamba-2, the architectural choice of sharing Δ projections within a head appears to force functional multiplexing. As a result, probe-selected units may tell you what responds to a feature, not what actually carries the causal computation. That has consequences for interpretability, pruning, routing analysis, and any attempt to infer modular organization from activation statistics alone. The reported effect size is not minor: at Mamba-2 head granularity, single-bucket probing undercounts the causal substrate by roughly 3–7× in set size. That is large enough to alter conclusions about how the model organizes boundary anchoring and retrieval behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper builds the argument in three steps. First, it operationalizes the state sink in selective SSMs using Δ-gate space rather than attention-score space. Second, it separates two head classes. Single-bucket BOS-specialist heads are a small set that respond strongly to BOS-like boundary structure. Dual heads are recovered by a multi-class aggregation rule from the same probe family; they show near-collinear Δ_pre representations for BOS and newline, which makes them easy to miss under single-bucket selection. Third, the paper relies on intervention, not probe rank alone, to establish causality. The authors run a preregistered six-factor intervention grid over Mamba-1 and Mamba-2 checkpoints, intervention types (gate_zero, gate_one, gate_mean, delta_zero, delta_median, u_zero), probe-derived scopes, layer scopes, and corpora.

The main conceptual contribution is the detection-versus-execution split. Dual heads look sink-like in representation space, but class-conditional ablations show that they do not carry the same execution role as BOS-specialists, especially on newline targets. The second contribution is architectural attribution. Mamba-1 uses channel-independent Δ projections, allowing different boundary specialists to coexist across many channels. Mamba-2 shares the Δ projection within each head and has far fewer heads than channels, which encourages one head to mix multiple boundary-related signals. The random channel-bucketing control on Mamba-1 supports this interpretation: the issue is not just coarser granularity, but shared projection structure.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental grid is unusually broad for an interpretability paper. The authors mention 12,096 total intervention cells, with 6,060 evaluated, and replicate headline findings on both WikiText-2 and Pile-10k. Mamba-2 is tested at 130M, 1.3B, and 2.7B scales, with Mamba-1 as a control.

The key results are:
1. In Mamba-2 2.7B, single-bucket BOS-specialists account for only about 5% of heads, while dual heads cover 27%–35%. So the probe-selected execution set is much smaller than the broader sink-related substrate.
2. In set size, single-bucket probing underestimates the causal substrate by roughly 3–7×. In aggregate ablation effect, dual heads can produce 4.8–6.4× the total effect of BOS-specialists, but this is largely set-size driven; per-unit effects are roughly comparable. That is an important distinction: dual heads are not individually stronger, just much more numerous.
3. The cleanest detection/execution separation comes from class-conditional ablation. Across three Mamba-2 scales and two corpora, BOS-specialists are positively causal for both BOS-context and newline-target predictions in all six cells. Dual heads underperform BOS-specialists on newline targets in all six. Yet dual heads have BOS/newline Δ_pre cosine similarity of 0.89, versus 0.54 for BOS-specialists, showing that representational similarity does not imply functional equivalence.
4. The architectural-driver test is persuasive. Randomly bucketing Mamba-1 channels into pseudo-heads at H/C=20 still retains 29% BOS-specialists, compared with 5% in Mamba-2. This points to head-shared Δ contributions rather than granularity alone.
5. The retrieval transfer result is strong. On RULER Needle-in-a-Haystack at 1024 context, ablating BOS-specialists drops retrieval accuracy from 1.00 to 0.00 on both Mamba-1 2.8B and Mamba-2 2.7B, while complement ablation preserves 1.00. So the state sink is tied to a real retrieval function, not just a toy interpretability artifact.
6. Four Pythia attention checkpoints do not show comparable dual-set dominance, suggesting the phenomenon is architecture-specific rather than a generic property of sequence models.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, the introduction, where the paper defines state sink, distinguishes it from attention sink, and states why the failure mode is architectural rather than methodological. Second, the section around §4.3.4, which contains the core detection-versus-execution evidence, especially the newline-target ablations that separate BOS-specialists from dual heads. Third, §4.6, where the random channel-bucketing control explains why Mamba-1 behaves differently from Mamba-2.

If you have about 20–30 minutes, read in this order: introduction, headline claims, the Mamba-2 class-conditional ablation figures, the architectural-driver experiment, and the RULER transfer result. Do not look only at aggregate ablation effect; track set size, per-unit effect, and representational similarity together. The deeper questions worth following are whether head-shared Δ projections interfere with modular specialization during training, and whether similar detection/execution splits may appear in MoE experts, grouped-query attention, or multimodal shared projections.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 后直接看 probe 与 ablation 对照；它会降低你对“线性 probe=电路定位”的信任。
recommendation.en: Read the probe-ablation comparison after the abstract; it should reduce trust in treating linear probes as circuit localization.

paper.title: When Do Attention Circuits Form? Developmental Trajectories of Capability and Attention-Sink Emergence Across Three 1B-ClassArchitectures
paper.abstract: We track the developmental trajectory of attention-head circuit formation across three 1B-class language models spanning two architecture families (dense transformer, mixture-of-experts) and two pretraining corpora (The Pile, DCLM): Pythia 1B, OLMo 1B-0724-hf, and OLMoE 1B-7B-0924. At each of 10 log-spaced revisions per model -- 30 mechanistic-interpretability runs in total -- we apply a participation-ratio (PR) spectral signal and an all-head capability-specific selectivity screen to track indu

summary.core_problem: 现有研究将预训练过程中诱导头形成、BOS注意力汇涌现归为同一相变事件，但缺乏1B级模型训练过程中跨架构、跨语料的两类注意力回路发育轨迹的系统性对比，无法验证二者是否源于同一底层过程。
summary.importance: 为区分预训练动态中两类广受关注的注意力涌现现象提供了实征证据，完善了对注意力回路发育机制的理解。发现第0、1层永远不会形成BOS头的结论，为KV缓存优化的工程设计提供了可直接落地的参考；跨语料、跨架构的对比结果也为模型架构选型和训练配方调整提供了依据。
summary.technical_approach: 选取三个1B级模型覆盖两种架构（密集Transformer、MoE）和两种预训练语料（The Pile、DCLM）：Pythia 1B、OLMo 1B、OLMoE 1B-7B，三个模型实现了干净的变量控制：Pythia与OLMo对比固定规模和密集架构下的语料影响，OLMo与OLMoE对比固定语料下的架构影响。每个模型取10个对数间隔的训练checkpoint，累计完成30次机制可解释性实验，采用参与比（PR）谱信号、逐头能力选择性筛选、组消融的方法，追踪诱导头、前序token头、BOS吸引头的涌现过程。核心贡献是建立了1B级模型注意力回路的发育时间线，分离了两类此前被混淆的预训练相变。
summary.experiments: 核心结论包括五点：DCLM语料训练的1B模型中，诱导头相变与BOS吸引头相变的训练token数相差10-20倍，涌现模式分别为缓升与陡跳，并非同一事件；所有模型的所有训练阶段中，第0、1层均不会出现BOS类头，这是架构固有属性而非学习得到的特征；其余结论还分离了语料、架构对相变出现时间的具体影响。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1节的三个模型变量控制设计、第5-9节的核心结果图表，重点关注两类相变的时间差对比、底层零BOS头的结论。方法细节可跳过，相关内容已有配套方法论论文详细阐述。预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing studies have conflated induction head formation and BOS attention sink emergence as a single phase transition during pretraining, but no systematic comparison of the developmental trajectories of these two attention circuits across architectures and corpora at the 1B-parameter scale exists to verify whether they stem from the same underlying process.
summary_en.importance: Provides empirical evidence for disentangling two widely discussed attention emergence phenomena in pretraining dynamics, improving understanding of attention circuit development. The finding that layers 0 and 1 never develop BOS heads offers actionable guidance for KV-cache optimization design, while cross-corpus and cross-architecture comparisons inform architecture selection and training recipe tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Evaluates three 1B-class models spanning two architecture families (dense Transformer, MoE) and two pretraining corpora (The Pile, DCLM): Pythia 1B, OLMo 1B, and OLMoE 1B-7B. The three models enable clean variable isolation: Pythia vs OLMo isolates corpus impact at fixed scale and dense architecture, while OLMo vs OLMoE isolates architecture impact at fixed corpus. For each model, 10 logarithmically spaced training checkpoints are sampled (30 total mechanistic interpretability runs), using participation ratio (PR) spectral signals, per-head capability selectivity screening, and group ablation to track the emergence of induction heads, previous-token heads, and BOS-attractor heads. The work establishes developmental timelines for attention circuits in 1B-class models and disentangles two previously conflated pretraining phase transitions.
summary_en.experiments: Five key findings are reported: The induction transition and BOS-attractor transition in DCLM-trained 1B models are separated by 10-20× in training tokens, with distinct emergence profiles (gradual ramp vs sharp jump), confirming they are not a single event. Layers 0 and 1 produce zero BOS-classified heads across all checkpoints and models, an architectural rather than learned property. Additional results quantify the impact of corpus and architecture choice on emergence timing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for the controlled variable design of the three model setups, and Sections 5-9 for core result figures comparing the timing of the two phase transitions and the zero-BOS finding for lower layers. Methodological details can be skipped as they are covered in a companion methodology paper. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但对训练中 circuit 形成顺序给了干净观测；重点看 L0/L1 zero-BOS 和 OLMo 的相变式跃迁，能直接影响你怎么挑 checkpoint 做 mech interp。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but the developmental traces are clean; focus on the L0/L1 zero-BOS result and the phase-transition-like jump in OLMo if you care about checkpoint selection for mech interp.

paper.title: Ablating Archetypes: The Stability of Archetypal SAEs is an Artifact of Initialization and Metric Design
paper.abstract: Dictionary learning with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) produces overcomplete bases from neural network activations that are often interpretable and reduces polysemanticity. However, features from SAEs vary substantially across random seeds -- a problem known as instability. Archetypal SAEs (Fel et al., 2025) were proposed as a general dictionary-learning intervention for more reliable concept extraction, and report more stable dictionaries at the end of training. We demonstrate that the stability c

summary.core_problem: Archetypal SAE声称的训练后字典稳定性，实际未区分“稳定性”（不同独立训练的模型最终达成一致）与“收敛性稳定”（不同初始化的模型在训练过程中逐步趋同）两个概念，其实验设计未隔离初始化固定的影响与原型约束本身的作用。
summary.importance: 澄清了稀疏自编码器可解释性研究中的核心概念混淆，修正了稳定性评测的方法学偏差，为后续SAE的特征有效性验证与算法设计提供了更严谨的评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 通过三个维度的分析验证核心结论：1）提出收敛性稳定诊断，绘制训练全程的跨运行字典距离轨迹，而非仅对比训练终点；2）开展初始化消融实验，设置两组对照条件——关闭凸包投影的原型SAE、使用相同k-means质心初始化的经典TopK SAE，隔离原型约束与共享初始化的贡献；3）分析度量设计的偏差，指出余弦距离作为稳定性指标的局限性，以及预处理步骤对几何空间的影响会干扰稳定性结果的解释。
summary.experiments: 实验证明Archetypal SAE的终点稳定性来自多轮训练共享k-means初始化的确定性设置，训练开始前跨运行距离已为0，终点稳定性只是初始化的保留而非训练动力学收敛的结果。即使在原论文偏好的几何度量下，共享初始化的稳定性对比也无法证明原型约束带来了收敛性稳定；经典TopK SAE的收敛速度实际上快于原型SAE变种。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点阅读引言中稳定性与收敛性稳定的概念区分，第2章的度量与初始化设计分析，以及第3章的核心实验结果。方法细节部分可快速浏览。预计阅读时间1小时。
summary.authors_note: 机构与作者信息未在提供内容中明确，暂为""

summary_en.core_problem: The claimed dictionary stability of Archetypal SAEs fails to distinguish between two concepts: stability (agreement between independently trained models at the end of training) and stabilization (convergence of models with different initializations during training); its experimental design does not isolate the effect of fixed initialization from that of the archetypal constraint itself.
summary_en.importance: It clarifies core conceptual confusion in sparse autoencoder interpretability research, corrects methodological biases in stability evaluation, and provides a more rigorous benchmark for feature validity verification and algorithm design of future SAEs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core conclusion is verified through three dimensions of analysis: 1) a stabilization diagnostic that plots the full inter-run dictionary distance trajectory across training steps, instead of only comparing endpoints; 2) initialization ablation experiments with two controlled conditions — archetypal SAEs with convex-hull projection disabled, and classical TopK SAEs initialized from the same k-means centroids — to isolate the contribution of the archetypal mechanism from shared initialization; 3) metric design analysis that points out the limitations of cosine distance as a stability metric, and how preprocessing steps affect the geometric space and interfere with the interpretation of stability results.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments demonstrate that the endpoint stability of Archetypal SAEs comes from the deterministic setup of shared k-means initialization across runs: inter-run distance is already zero before any gradient step, and endpoint stability is merely the preservation of initialization rather than convergence of training dynamics. Even under the geometric metric preferred by the original paper, stability comparisons with shared initialization cannot prove that the archetypal constraint brings stabilization; classical TopK SAEs actually stabilize faster than the archetypal variant.
summary_en.reading_guide: Reading recommendation: focus on the conceptual distinction between stability and stabilization in the introduction, the metric and initialization design analysis in Section 2, and the core experimental results in Section 3. Methodological details can be skimmed quickly. Estimated reading time is 1 hour.

recommendation.zh: 做LLM可解释性、SAE相关研究的建议读§3的消融部分，实验设计严谨，修正了对Archetypal SAE稳定性的错误认知
recommendation.en: Researchers working on LLM interpretability and SAEs should read the ablation in §3; the design is rigorous and corrects prior misconceptions about Archetypal SAE stability

paper.title: The Latin Substrate: How Language Models Represent and Mediate Script Choice
paper.abstract: Many languages are written in multiple scripts, requiring large language models (LLMs) to generate equivalent linguistic content in distinct orthographic forms. While prior work suggests that LLMs route information through shared latent representations, how they internally mediate script variation remains poorly understood.   We study this question by first examining per-layer output distributions with the logit lens, which reveals consistent latent romanization during transliteration, and then

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多脚本语言在 LLM 内部是如何被表示和生成的，尤其关注一个更细的问题：当同一种语言可以写成 Latin 和非 Latin 脚本时，模型在内部是否通过某种共享的“拉丁化”中间表示来完成脚本选择与转写。作者要回答的不只是“模型会不会 transliteration”，而是脚本信息在层间如何形成、是否可线性操控、由哪些具体模块负责，以及 Latin 与非 Latin 脚本在机制上是否对称。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接价值，不在于提升 benchmark，而在于揭示 tokenizer、数据分布和内部表征之间的关系。论文提出并支持了一个很具体的判断：Latin script 在多语种 LLM 中像一个更宽、更弥散的默认表征底座，非 Latin 脚本则更像后期通过较集中的路由机制写回表面形式。这对理解 multilingual pretraining 很有启发。因为脚本并不只是输入输出层面的编码问题，它会影响中间表示的共享程度、跨语言迁移路径，以及 tokenizer 设计对内部计算的塑形方式。对做多语种预训练、tokenizer、跨脚本数据配比、机制分析的人，这篇文章提供了可操作的分析框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成三层：logit lens 观察、表征分析、机制定位。

第一层是 logit lens。作者在 transliteration 过程中逐层查看中间层的 next-token 分布，发现模型在输出非 Latin 脚本前，中上层常先出现 romanized subwords。也就是说，模型不是从源脚本直接一步跳到目标脚本，而是常经过一个更接近 Latin 形式的中间状态。论文把这一现象系统化为 latent romanization，并且不是只做个例展示，而是跨模型、跨脚本量化。

第二层是表征分析。作者考察同一语言不同脚本在各层的可分性，发现随着层数加深，脚本表征越来越可线性分离。基于这一点，他们构造简单的线性 steering direction，在尽量保持语义不变的前提下切换输出脚本。这里有两个值得注意的点。其一，脚本切换可以通过相当低维、线性的干预实现，说明脚本身份在后层被显式编码。其二，迁移存在明显不对称：朝非 Latin 方向的 steering 更稳定，而朝 Latin 方向更难。这与作者的核心假设一致，即 Latin 不是一个紧凑簇，而是更弥散的底层表征区域。

第三层是机制分析。作者定位到少量晚层 attention heads 对脚本生成具有因果作用。通过 activation patching，只替换极少数头的激活，就能把自然提示下的输出脚本改写到另一种脚本，而且这些头在不同语言、不同书写系统之间有迁移性。这说明脚本选择并非均匀分布在整个网络，而是部分集中在后层的特定路由模块里。论文进一步观察到机制上的方向不对称：非 Latin 输出依赖少量、可识别的局部机制；Latin 输出则更分散，更难被少量头精确控制。

从预训练视角看，作者实际上在论证一个“数据频率 + tokenizer 便利性 + 表征共享”共同塑造的结果。Latin 在预训练语料中更常见，也更可能被 tokenizer 以更便利的方式编码，于是它更容易成为跨脚本共享的中间基底；非 Latin 则需要额外的后期路由把共享语义落到特定表面形式上。
summary.experiments:
论文的代表性定性图是用 Llama-2-13B 展示 Malayalam 到 Devanagari 的转写过程。作者特意选这个模型，是因为其 tokenizer 对 Devanagari 的切分更适合做可视化；像 Llama-3 这类更偏 byte-level 的切分会让 logit lens 图像碎裂，难以观察层间脚本转换。这一点本身就很有信息量：tokenizer 会直接影响你能否看清内部机制。

核心实验结果包括几类。第一，logit lens 定量结果支持 latent romanization：在中上层，目标词的 romanized 片段会先出现，再在更后层转成目标脚本。第二，同语种不同脚本的表示在深层越来越可分，说明脚本身份不是从一开始就完全独立编码，而是在后层逐步显化。第三，线性 steering 可以较稳定地翻转输出脚本，同时大体保持语义内容，且这种 steering 能迁移到构造向量时未见过的语言和书写系统，但 Latin/非 Latin 之间存在明显方向不对称。第四，mechanistic probing 发现只需 patch 少数几个晚层 attention heads，便能在自然提示下改变输出脚本，而且这些头跨语言迁移，说明模型里存在相对通用的脚本路由部件。

摘要里没有给出大量具体数字，全文更强调现象的一致性和机制证据，而不是追求单一 benchmark 分数。阅读时要注意作者反复比较“紧凑的非 Latin 簇”和“弥散的 Latin 区域”这组图景，因为很多实验现象都围绕这点展开：为什么非 Latin steering 更容易、为什么 patch 少量头就能写出非 Latin、为什么反向切回 Latin 更不稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是按“现象—表征—机制”顺序看。先看引言和 Figure 1、Figure 2，抓住论文的中心假设：模型常通过 latent romanization 处理中间表示，Latin 更像共享底座。然后看 logit lens 的量化部分，确认这不是个别案例。接着看表征分析，重点理解脚本可分性如何随层数变化，以及 steering vector 为什么能在保语义的同时改脚本。最后看 attention head localization 和 patching，这是最接近机制解释的部分。

阅读时有两个点值得特别留意。第一，作者为什么强调 tokenizer 差异。这里不是实现细节，而是说明脚本机制的可见性和可能的形成方式都受 tokenization 影响。第二，方向不对称是全文最有信息量的观察之一：非 Latin 生成更像“定点写回”，Latin 更像“默认扩散态”。如果只留 20 到 30 分钟，建议看引言、logit lens 主图、steering 结果和 head patching 结果；如果做 multilingual pretraining 或 tokenizer，值得把实验设置和失败案例也看一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how multilingual LLMs internally represent and generate languages that can be written in multiple scripts. The specific question is whether script choice is mediated through a shared latent representation, especially one aligned with Latin script, rather than through fully separate pathways for each orthography. The authors are not just asking whether models can transliterate. They ask how script information emerges across layers, whether it is linearly controllable, which components causally implement script choice, and whether Latin and non-Latin scripts are handled symmetrically.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is interpretive rather than benchmark-driven. The paper argues that Latin script behaves like a broad default substrate in multilingual LLMs, while non-Latin scripts are produced through more localized late-stage routing mechanisms. That matters for understanding how tokenizer design, data frequency, and internal representation interact in multilingual pretraining. Script is not merely an input/output encoding detail. It shapes representational sharing, cross-lingual transfer paths, and the way tokenization constrains internal computation. For researchers working on multilingual data mixtures, tokenizers, or mechanistic analysis of pretrained models, this gives a concrete framework for thinking about script-level structure.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The analysis has three layers: logit-lens observation, representational probing, and mechanistic localization.

First, the authors use the logit lens to inspect intermediate next-token distributions during transliteration. They find that when the model is producing a non-Latin output, middle-to-upper layers often transiently predict romanized subwords before committing to the final script. In other words, the model often does not move directly from source script to target script. It appears to pass through an intermediate representation aligned with Latinized forms. The paper turns this into a quantitative phenomenon, latent romanization, and studies it across scripts and models rather than relying on a single anecdotal example.

Second, the paper analyzes representations of the same language written in different scripts. Script identity becomes increasingly linearly separable in deeper layers. Based on this, the authors construct simple linear steering directions that flip the output script while largely preserving semantic content. Two points matter here. One is that script choice can be manipulated with a low-complexity linear intervention, suggesting that script identity is explicitly encoded in later layers. The other is a strong directional asymmetry: steering toward non-Latin scripts is more reliable than steering toward Latin. This supports the paper’s main hypothesis that Latin is not a compact target cluster but a more diffuse representational region.

Third, the authors localize a small set of late-layer attention heads that causally mediate script generation. With activation patching on only a few heads, they can redirect the output script on natural prompts, and the same heads transfer across unrelated languages and writing systems. This suggests that script choice is not uniformly distributed across the network. Instead, part of it is concentrated in a small number of routing components in later layers. The asymmetry appears again at the mechanistic level: non-Latin generation depends on compact, identifiable mechanisms, whereas Latin generation is more distributed and harder to control through a small intervention.

From a pretraining perspective, the paper is effectively arguing for a joint effect of data frequency, tokenization convenience, and representational sharing. Latin script is more common in pretraining corpora and often easier for tokenizers to encode cleanly, so it becomes a natural shared substrate. Non-Latin scripts then require additional late-stage routing to write the shared semantic content back into a specific surface form.
summary_en.experiments:
A representative qualitative example uses Llama-2-13B to visualize transliteration from Malayalam to Devanagari. The model choice is deliberate: its tokenizer makes Devanagari visually legible in logit-lens plots, whereas more byte-fragmented tokenizers such as Llama-3 obscure the transition. That detail is informative on its own, because it shows how tokenization affects the observability of internal mechanisms.

The main empirical findings come in several forms. First, quantitative logit-lens analysis supports latent romanization: romanized pieces of the target word appear in intermediate layers before the final target script emerges. Second, representations of the same language in different scripts become more separable in deeper layers, implying that script identity is not fully disentangled from the start but is progressively made explicit later in the network. Third, linear steering can reliably flip output script while preserving meaning to a large extent, and the steering directions transfer to unseen languages and writing systems. However, the transfer is asymmetric: moving toward non-Latin scripts is easier than moving back toward Latin. Fourth, mechanistic probing identifies a small number of late attention heads whose patching is sufficient to change output script on natural prompts, and these heads transfer across languages, suggesting a relatively general script-routing mechanism.

The paper is lighter on headline benchmark numbers and heavier on consistency of evidence across analyses. A useful way to read the experiments is to keep the paper’s central geometric picture in mind: non-Latin scripts form compact, well-separated clusters, while Latin occupies a wider and more diffuse region. Many of the observed asymmetries follow from that picture: why non-Latin steering is easier, why a few heads can write into non-Latin scripts, and why steering back to Latin is less stable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim is to read it in the order of phenomenon, representation, then mechanism. Start with the introduction and Figures 1 and 2 to get the central hypothesis: multilingual LLMs often mediate script transformation through latent romanization, with Latin acting as a shared substrate. Then read the quantitative logit-lens section to verify that this is not just a hand-picked example. Next, move to the representational analysis and focus on how script separability changes with depth and why a steering vector can change script while preserving semantics. Finish with the attention-head localization and patching section, which is the closest thing to a causal mechanism in the paper.

Two details deserve special attention. First, the tokenizer discussion is not incidental. It bears directly on both the visibility of the phenomenon and the way script structure may have formed during pretraining. Second, the directional asymmetry is the most informative observation in the paper: non-Latin generation looks like targeted late-stage writing, while Latin behaves more like a diffuse default state. If you only have 20–30 minutes, read the introduction, the main logit-lens figure, the steering results, and the head-patching results. If you work on multilingual pretraining or tokenizer design, the setup details and failure cases are worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 logit-lens 和 steering 实验；latent romanization 若稳，会影响多语 tokenizer 与 script balancing 的诊断方式。
recommendation.en: Read the logit-lens and steering experiments; if latent romanization is robust, it changes how to diagnose multilingual tokenizers and script balancing.

paper.title: Discovering a Zeta Map Algorithm on Dyck Paths via Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Machine learning is increasingly used in mathematical discovery, but in mathematics the desired output is often not a prediction itself, but an explicit construction that can be checked independently. We study this setting through the zeta map on Dyck paths, a classical bijection in the combinatorics of the q,t-Catalan numbers. We train a deliberately small one-layer, one-head encoder-decoder transformer on this map and analyze its learned computation using mechanistic interpretability tools, in

summary.core_problem: 机器学习在数学发现中多用作预测器，但数学研究真正需要的往往是可独立验证的显式构造（猜想、算法或双射），而非预测本身。论文在组合数学的具体场景（Dyck 路径上的 zeta 双射）中探索如何通过训练神经网络并用机制可解释性分析，从中提取新的数学算法。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在可解释性研究方法论层面：展示了通过刻意限制模型规模（单层单头）并用机制可解释性工具反向工程模型学到的计算，可以提取出人类可理解的显式算法。这为理解大模型内部计算提供了一个具体案例——在可控的组合数学环境中验证可解释性方法的有效性。
summary.technical_approach: 训练了一个小型一层单头编码-解码 Transformer 来学习 Dyck 路径上的 zeta 双射（将 (dinv, area) 描述转换为 (area, bounce) 描述的经典组合双射）。使用三种机制可解释性工具分析模型计算：1）解码器交叉注意力分析，2）线性探针，3）因果干预（消融）。分析揭示了一种基于层级（level）的机制：编码器表示使路径层级线性可及，解码器则按层级结构化地选择和遍历输入位置。基于这些发现提出了 'scaffolding map'——一种以峰值为中心的 Dyck 路径遍历新算法，与传统的面积序列描述不同，它直接按层级和局部遍历来组织。
summary.experiments: 在半长度 n=11 到 16 的 Dyck 路径数据集上训练了标准架构（256 维嵌入，4 层编码器/解码器，8 头注意力）的 Transformer，取得了 >99% 的准确率（对应数据集规模从 58,786 到 35,357,670）。之后将架构缩减至一层单头以进行机制分析，发现核心潜变量是输入 Dyck 路径的层级序列（level sequence）；交叉注意力显示解码器按层级选择位置，因果消融表明大量上行步位置在解码过程中不直接需要，线性探针证实编码器表示中可恢复层级信息。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（机制分析）和图 1（Dyck 路径示例）。建议先快速浏览数学背景（第 2 节）以理解 zeta 双射的基本定义，然后关注第 3 节中如何通过三种可解释性工具逐步推导出 scaffolding map。预计阅读时间：30-45 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 论文未提供作者信息，从 arXiv ID 2605.30482 查询为近期提交。

summary_en.core_problem: Machine learning in mathematical discovery is often used as a predictor, but mathematical research typically requires explicit constructions (conjectures, algorithms, bijections) that can be independently verified, not just predictions. This paper explores how to train a neural network and use mechanistic interpretability to extract new mathematical algorithms, in the concrete combinatorial setting of the zeta map on Dyck paths.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is methodological: it demonstrates that deliberately constraining model scale (one-layer, one-head) and reverse-engineering the learned computation via mechanistic interpretability tools can yield human-understandable explicit algorithms. This provides a concrete case for understanding internal model computation—validating interpretability methods in a controlled combinatorial setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a deliberately small one-layer, one-head encoder-decoder Transformer to learn the zeta map bijection on Dyck paths (a classical bijection converting (dinv, area) to (area, bounce) descriptions). Three mechanistic interpretability tools are used: 1) decoder cross-attention analysis, 2) linear probing, and 3) causal intervention (ablation). The analysis reveals a level-based mechanism: encoder representations make path levels linearly accessible, while the decoder selects and traverses input positions by level. Based on these findings, the 'scaffolding map' is proposed—a novel peak-centered traversal algorithm for Dyck paths organized directly by levels and local traversal, unlike classical area-sequence descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: Standard Transformer architectures (256-dim embeddings, 4 encoder/decoder layers, 8 attention heads) achieve >99% accuracy on Dyck path datasets of semilength n=11 to 16 (sizes ranging from 58,786 to 35,357,670). After reducing to one layer and one head for mechanistic analysis, the key latent combinatorial quantity found is the level sequence of the input Dyck path; cross-attention shows decoder selects positions by level; causal ablation demonstrates many upward-step positions are not directly needed during decoding; linear probes confirm level information is recoverable from encoder representations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Mechanistic Analysis) and Figure 1 (Dyck path example). Briefly skim Section 2 (Mathematical Background) to understand the zeta bijection definition, then concentrate on how three interpretability tools iteratively lead to the scaffolding map formulation. Estimated reading time: 30-45 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not provided in the available content; arXiv ID 2605.30482 is a recent submission.

recommendation.zh: 极好的mechanistic interpretability案例研究——极小模型+可数学验证的目标函数，读§3交叉注意力分析和§4算法重建即可。
recommendation.en: Excellent case study in mechanistic interpretability with a tiny model and mathematically verifiable target; read §3 cross-attention analysis and §4 algorithm recovery.

paper.title: Assign and Add: A Mechanistic Study of Compositional Arithmetic
paper.abstract: Large language models are able to compose skills in order to perform complex tasks, many of which might not have been seen during training. The details of how exactly this composition occurs remain elusive. In this paper, we study a mechanism for compositional generalization in transformers by considering a simple controlled setting involving variable assignment and modular addition. By partitioning our training data into disjoint sets, we observe that small transformers are able to generalize t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体的问题：Transformer 如何把“变量绑定”和“模加法”两个机制组合起来，并在训练分布外的变量-数值组合上泛化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值不在于给出新的训练 recipe，而在于把组合泛化拆到可解释的权重和训练动态层面。论文把 induction head 式的关联召回机制，和 grokking 文献中常见的傅里叶特征加法机制放在同一个小模型里观察。关键结论是：模型不是为每种变量组合重新记忆答案，而是先学出一个可复用的模加法模块，再学会把变量解析成对应数字，并把数字送入同一个加法模块。这对理解 LLM 中“检索信息 + 执行运算”的组合能力有启发，但结论仍来自受控合成任务，不能直接外推到大模型推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用一个刻意简化的 2 层、单头 Transformer，并去掉第 1 层 MLP，使电路更容易分析。任务是模加法，操作数可以直接给出，也可以先在上下文中被赋值为变量，再在表达式中引用。训练数据被划成互不重叠的组合，使测试集包含训练中没有见过的变量-数值组合。机制分析显示，最终模型形成了两部分分工：第二层注意力头实现一种改造过的 induction head，用 QK 电路定位表达式中变量对应的赋值位置，用 OV 电路把被赋的数字写入当前位置；最后一层 MLP 实现模加法，使用和模加法 grokking 研究中类似的非线性傅里叶表示。与只研究变量绑定或只研究模运算的工作不同，这篇论文重点看两个机制如何在训练中接上，并给出梯度动态层面的解释：加法模块可以先在直接数字输入上学成，后续变量绑定机制只需把变量映射到同一个表示空间，便可复用加法模块。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是大规模性能，而是训练动态和电路验证。模型在只含直接数字的 0-variable 模加法上先达到接近完美的测试准确率，同时变量赋值能力仍在学习中。这说明模加法模块和变量绑定模块的学习时间尺度不同，也支持“先学可复用运算，再接入变量解析”的解释。最终模型在训练未见过的变量-数值组合上能够泛化。论文还通过权重级分析、注意力模式、QK/OV 电路检查、MLP 表示分析和训练曲线，支持最后 MLP 负责加法、第二层注意力负责变量取值的分工。具体模数、宽度、数据划分比例和各项准确率需要看实验设置与附录表格。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和数据划分，确认训练集如何排除组合，以免把泛化误读成插值。然后看训练动态图，重点关注 0-variable 加法能力与变量绑定能力出现的先后顺序。机制部分要看第二层 attention 的 QK/OV 分析，以及最后 MLP 的傅里叶特征解释。理论部分可以选择性读，重点是梯度动态如何允许先形成加法模块，再由变量绑定模块接入该模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a Transformer composes two distinct mechanisms, variable binding and modular addition, to generalize to variable-number combinations that were not seen during training.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mechanistic rather than procedural. It gives a controlled account of how a model can reuse a learned computation module instead of memorizing every composite case. The main finding is that the model first learns a reusable modular-addition circuit, then learns to resolve variables into the numeric representations consumed by that circuit. This is relevant to LLM reasoning because many reasoning tasks mix retrieval or binding with computation, but the evidence comes from a small synthetic setting and should be read as a mechanistic probe, not as a direct claim about large-scale models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train a deliberately simple two-layer, single-head Transformer, omitting the first-layer MLP to make the circuit easier to inspect. The task is modular addition where operands may be given directly as numbers or indirectly through variable assignments in the context. The data split removes certain variable-number combinations from training, so test performance measures compositional generalization. The final circuit has a clear division of labor: the second attention layer behaves like a modified induction head that retrieves the number assigned to a referenced variable, while the final MLP implements modular addition using structured nonlinear features similar to the Fourier features observed in prior grokking work. The paper also analyzes gradient dynamics to explain why the addition circuit can emerge first and later be reused by the variable-binding pathway.
summary_en.experiments: The key evidence comes from training curves and circuit-level interventions rather than scale. The model reaches near-perfect test accuracy on the direct, zero-variable modular-addition case while it is still learning variable assignment. This separates the learning of arithmetic from the learning of binding. At convergence, the model generalizes to held-out combinations of variables and numbers. The mechanistic evidence includes attention-pattern analysis, QK and OV circuit inspection, MLP representation analysis, and weight-level studies showing that the same addition MLP is used for both direct numeric inputs and variable-mediated inputs. Exact modulus choices, widths, split sizes, and accuracy numbers should be checked in the experimental sections and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task and data split to verify what kind of extrapolation is being tested. Then read the training-dynamics plots, especially the separation between direct modular addition and variable assignment. The most important technical sections are the analysis of the second-layer attention head and the final MLP. The theory section is worth scanning for the gradient-dynamics argument: it explains how a pre-existing arithmetic module can be connected to a newly learned binding mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 受控 setup 干净，能把“模块复用”讲到可验证；只看机制定位结果和三阶段训练动态，别期待直接外推到真实 LLM。
recommendation.en: A clean toy setup that makes “module reuse” falsifiable; focus on the localization result and the three-phase training dynamics, but don’t over-extrapolate to real LLMs.

paper.title: Toxic HallucinAItions: Perturbing Prompts and Tracing LLM Circuits
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in conversational settings where user tone ranges from polite to adversarial or toxic, yet less is known about whether toxic language in otherwise semantically equivalent prompts can degrade factual reliability. We study how lexical and tone-based prompt perturbations affect the factual reliability of LLMs. Using controlled prompt variations across polite, random, and three toxicity levels, we evaluate five LLMs on ARC-Easy, GSM8K, and MMLU.

summary.core_problem: 研究语义等价但语气带毒性的 prompt 扰动，是否会系统性降低 LLM 的事实可靠性，并进一步追踪这种退化是否对应到内部电路层面的变化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇机制分析与鲁棒性研究。对基座研究员的价值不在于安全结论本身，而在于它把“prompt 风格影响正确率”从现象描述推进到 activation / attribution graph 层面的可解释分析。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造 polite、random 和多级 toxicity 的受控 prompt 变体，在 ARC-Easy、GSM8K、MMLU 上测试 5 个 LLM 的准确率与不确定性变化；随后用 attribution-graph 分析模型激活与影响路径，区分对扰动敏感的节点和相对稳定的核心推理节点，观察毒性增强时哪些内部回路被放大。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 LLM、3 个常见基准和多种 prompt 扰动强度。摘要结论是：toxic lexical perturbation 会稳定降低事实准确率并提高不确定性，而礼貌措辞的收益有限且不稳定；内部分析显示，毒性主要放大 perturbation-sensitive variant nodes，而核心 reasoning nodes 更稳定。未见大规模训练或干预实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 和 Nimblemind。更偏 HCI/社会计算与机制分析交叉视角，不是典型基座预训练团队。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether semantically equivalent but toxic prompt perturbations systematically reduce factual reliability in LLMs, and whether that degradation maps to internal circuit-level changes.
summary_en.importance: This is a robustness and mechanistic-analysis paper. Its value for foundation-model researchers is less about safety messaging and more about pushing the observation from surface behavior to activation and attribution-graph evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors create controlled prompt variants spanning polite, random, and multiple toxicity levels, then evaluate five LLMs on ARC-Easy, GSM8K, and MMLU. They further apply attribution-graph analysis to model activations and influence pathways, separating perturbation-sensitive nodes from relatively stable core reasoning nodes to study how toxicity changes internal processing.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers five LLMs, three standard benchmarks, and several perturbation intensities. The main finding is that toxic lexical perturbations consistently reduce factual accuracy and increase uncertainty, while polite phrasing has limited and inconsistent effects. Internally, toxicity appears to amplify perturbation-sensitive variant nodes while core reasoning nodes remain comparatively stable. No large-scale training intervention is reported.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Nimblemind. The work sits more at the intersection of HCI, social computing, and mechanistic analysis than mainstream pretraining research.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但如果你关心 prompt distribution shift 如何穿透到内部电路，只看实验主表和 attribution 图即可；结论可作弱信号，不宜过度外推。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but useful if you care how prompt distribution shift reaches internal circuits; the main table and attribution graphs are enough, and the claims should be treated as weak signals.

paper.title: Probing the Prompt KV Cache: Where It Becomes Dispensable
paper.abstract: Prior KV cache compression schemes empirically demonstrate that the prompt cache is partially redundant during decoding, dropping or summarising entries with little accuracy loss. We ask when and what kind of redundancy: at which layers, after how many decoding steps, and in what form can the prompt span KV cache be replaced without breaking the task. A controlled splice intervention swept over layer cutoff and decoding steps shows this redundancy is about form (chat template scaffolding) rather

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方案仅通过经验证实提示缓存存在冗余，但未明确冗余出现的层位置、解码步数阈值，以及可替代缓存的内容要求，无法为压缩策略提供结构化指导。
summary.importance: 首次系统量化了提示KV缓存的冗余分布规律，证实上层缓存仅需保留对话模板的结构信息即可维持性能，为分层KV缓存压缩、推理时缓存复用等优化方案提供了因果层面的实验依据。
summary.technical_approach: 采用受控拼接干预方法，遍历三个核心参数：1）层截断值L：替换编号≥L的所有上层的提示段KV缓存；2）干预起始步数W：执行W步解码后再执行缓存替换；3）供体缓存：设置五类不同内容的供体（空白模板、同任务不同内容、不同任务、零值等），并保证供体与原提示token长度一致实现位置对齐。通过绘制层截断-解码步数的二维相图，以及定义恢复前沿（达到α倍基线正确率所需的最小解码步数）来量化冗余程度。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B/8B、Gemma3-4B-IT、Llama3-8B-Instruct四个模型，以及GSM8K、MBPP、HumanEval三个数据集上开展实验：Qwen3-4B在GSM8K上基线正确率为90%，当替换30层以上KV缓存为仅保留对话结构、内容为中性填充的供体缓存时，解码第0步即可达到88%正确率；固定替换27层以上缓存时，解码25步即可恢复到87%正确率。零值替换也能恢复性能，但所需解码步数显著更多，且基线恢复率更低。实验结果在三个数据集、四个模型家族中均可复现。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章实验设置部分，理解拼接干预的参数设计逻辑；第4章的相图和恢复前沿分析是核心结论，可重点关注不同供体类型的性能差异；预计阅读时间20分钟，附录的算法供体基准部分可按需浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression schemes only empirically verify redundancy in prompt caches, without specifying the layer positions, decoding step thresholds, and content requirements for replaceable caches, failing to provide structured guidance for compression strategies.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to systematically quantify the redundancy distribution pattern of prompt KV caches, and confirms that upper-layer caches only need to retain the structural information of chat templates to maintain performance, providing causal experimental evidence for optimization schemes such as layered KV cache compression and inference-time cache reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: A controlled splice intervention method is adopted to traverse three core parameters: 1) Layer cutoff L: replace the prompt-span KV caches of all upper layers with index ≥ L; 2) Intervention onset W: perform cache replacement after W decoding steps; 3) Donor cache: set five types of donors with different content (blank template, same task with different content, different tasks, zero values, etc.), and ensure the donor and original prompt have the same token length for positional alignment. Redundancy is quantified by drawing a two-dimensional phase diagram of layer cutoff vs. decoding step, and defining the recovery frontier (the minimum decoding step required to reach α times the baseline accuracy).
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on four models: Qwen3-4B/8B, Gemma3-4B-IT, Llama3-8B-Instruct, and three datasets: GSM8K, MBPP, HumanEval. For Qwen3-4B on GSM8K with a baseline accuracy of 90%, when replacing KV caches above layer 30 with donor caches that only retain chat structure and use neutral filler as content, 88% accuracy is achieved at decoding step 0. When fixing the cutoff at layer 27, 87% accuracy is recovered after 25 decoding steps. Zero-value replacement can also recover performance, but requires significantly more decoding steps and achieves a lower baseline recovery rate. The results are reproducible across three datasets and four model families.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Experimental Setup) to understand the parameter design logic of splice intervention; the phase diagram and recovery frontier analysis in Section 4 are the core conclusions, with special attention to the performance differences between donor types. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes. The algorithmic donor benchmark in the appendix can be browsed as needed.

recommendation.zh: 非常 clean 的机制分析，证明了高层 KV cache 更多是起 attention sink/scaffolding 的作用，对设计 KV cache 驱逐策略极具启发。
recommendation.en: A very clean mechanistic analysis proving that upper-layer KV cache acts more as an attention sink/scaffolding, highly inspiring for designing KV cache eviction policies.

paper.title: Do Language Models Track Entities Across State Changes?
paper.abstract: Entity tracking (ET), the ability to keep track of states, is a fundamental skill that underlies complex reasoning. An increasing amount of work investigates how transformer language models (LMs) solve entity binding $\textit{without}$ state changes. However, there is limited understanding of how non-toy LMs address ET problems of realistic difficulties expressed in natural language. To this end, we investigate the mechanisms underlying ET in more complex scenarios featuring multiple state-chang

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究非玩具语言模型在自然语言实体跟踪任务中到底如何处理状态变化。问题不是模型能不能答对“盒子里有什么”，而是模型是否真的随上下文增量维护世界状态，还是在看到查询后才从上下文中检索相关信息。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在于，它给“LLM 是否形成可更新的内部状态”提供了较细的机制证据。结果倾向于否定一种直觉：模型并没有稳定地把所有盒子的最终状态压进某个全局表示。它更像是在查询位置并行聚合相关 token。这个结论会影响对长上下文、状态追踪、代码数据收益、CoT 作用的理解。对于训练目标设计，它提示单纯提高上下文检索能力不等于学会可组合的状态更新；如果目标是增强多步状态跟踪，可能需要更明确的状态更新数据、过程监督，或让模型外显中间状态的训练格式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 Kim and Schuster 的 box dataset。上下文先给出多个盒子的初始内容，然后包含三类状态变化操作：PUT 添加新物体，REMOVE 删除已有物体，MOVE 把物体从一个盒子移到另一个盒子。最后用补全文本的方式询问某个盒子的内容。模型包括 Gemma-2-2B、CodeLlama-13B 和 Llama-3.1-70B，采用 zero-shot completion。核心分析围绕两个假设展开：H1 是模型从左到右增量构建全局世界状态；H2 是模型直到查询明确后才抽取与目标盒子相关的信息。为区分两者，作者训练线性 probe。global probe 对每个物体预测其所在盒子或“不在任何盒子”，用于检测是否存在查询无关的全局状态表示；local/query-relevant probe 用于检测查询相关状态是否逐层形成。机制分析进一步拆解单个操作。PUT 被解释为接近已有 entity binding circuit：模型把物体和盒子建立绑定关系。REMOVE 更像一种删除标记，它不是局部改写某个盒子的状态，而是在预测阶段对被删除物体施加全局抑制。MOVE 可分解为 MOVE-IN 和 MOVE-OUT 两部分，分别接近添加和删除机制。
summary.experiments: 实验重点不是追求任务准确率，而是用行为结果、probe 和干预来定位机制。CodeLlama-13B 和 Gemma-2-2B 在单操作场景有非平凡表现，便于做机制分析；Llama-3.1-70B 在多操作场景表现更好，因此用于更复杂的多操作分析。关键发现是：没有强证据表明最后 token 的残差流持续编码所有物体的最终位置，也没有看到查询相关状态在层间逐步、稳定地更新。模型主要在查询出现后，在最后 token 位置并行汇总相关上下文证据。单操作分析显示，PUT 与静态绑定机制相似；REMOVE 会给待删除物体打上抑制信号。作者还利用这个机制预测新的失败模式，并通过表示干预做了部分修复，说明这些 probe 结果不只是相关性现象。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看实验设置，确认 box dataset、三类操作和 zero-shot completion 格式。重点看第 3 节的 H1/H2 设计、global probe 与 local probe 的定义，以及相应图表；这是判断“增量世界模型”是否成立的关键。然后看第 4 节对 PUT、REMOVE、MOVE 的拆解，尤其是 REMOVE 作为全局抑制标记的证据。第 4.4 节的 failure mode 和 intervention 最有方法论价值，因为它把机制解释和可预测错误连接起来。附录中的行为准确率可作为背景，不需要精读所有 prompt 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how non-toy language models handle entity tracking under state changes expressed in natural language. The key question is whether models incrementally maintain a world state while reading the context, or whether they retrieve and combine relevant evidence only after the query specifies what needs to be answered.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. It gives evidence against a simple internal-state story for entity tracking: the models studied do not appear to maintain a compact, query-independent representation of all final box states. Instead, they mostly aggregate relevant information at the query position. This matters for interpreting long-context reasoning, code-pretraining gains, and chain-of-thought effects. It suggests that better retrieval over context should not be confused with robust learned state update. Training models to track mutable state may require data formats or objectives that expose intermediate state transitions more directly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses the box dataset from Kim and Schuster. A prompt first describes the initial contents of seven boxes, then applies state-changing operations: PUT introduces new objects into a box, REMOVE deletes existing objects from a box, and MOVE transfers objects between boxes. The model then completes a query about a box’s contents. Experiments are run in a zero-shot completion setting on Gemma-2-2B, CodeLlama-13B, and Llama-3.1-70B. The main mechanistic test contrasts two hypotheses. Under the incremental-state hypothesis, a fixed representation such as the final token residual stream should encode the global final state, independent of the queried box. Under the query-time retrieval hypothesis, the model only forms a local answer representation once the query reveals the target box. The authors train linear probes to test these alternatives, including global 8-way probes that predict each object’s location or absence. They then analyze individual operations. PUT resembles previously described entity-binding circuits. REMOVE acts more like a tag that suppresses the removed object at prediction time, rather than a clean local edit to a world model. MOVE can be decomposed into MOVE-IN and MOVE-OUT components.
summary_en.experiments: The paper focuses on mechanism rather than leaderboard performance. CodeLlama-13B and Gemma-2-2B show nontrivial single-operation behavior and are used for detailed analysis. Llama-3.1-70B performs better on multi-operation cases and is used where more complex tracking is needed. The central empirical result is that probes do not support a stable global world-state representation, nor a layer-by-layer construction of query-relevant state. Relevant information is consolidated in parallel at the last token once the query is available. Operation-level analysis finds that PUT behaves like binding, while REMOVE provides a global suppressive signal for the removed token. The proposed mechanisms also predict new failure modes, and targeted interventions partially repair them, which strengthens the causal interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30- to 45-minute skim is sufficient. Read the setup first to understand the box task, the three operation types, and the zero-shot completion protocol. The most important part is Section 3, especially the global-versus-local probing design and the figures comparing incremental state tracking with query-time aggregation. Then read Section 4 for the operation-level circuits, with particular attention to the REMOVE analysis. Section 4.4 is useful because it connects the mechanistic account to predicted failures and interventions. The appendices on behavioral accuracy are helpful context but do not need line-by-line reading.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 LLM 处理状态变化时并非增量更新，而是在最后 token 并行聚合，且 REMOVE 操作依赖脆弱的全局抑制标签，这解释了 LLM 在长上下文中容易丢失状态的原因，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Reveals that LLMs do not update states incrementally but aggregate them in parallel at the final token, and rely on fragile global suppression tags for REMOVE operations, explaining state loss in long contexts; worth a skim.

paper.title: What are They Thinking? Delineation, Probing and Tracking of Concepts in LLMs
paper.abstract: As the influence of LLMs expands, it is imperative to gain insight into their decisions. One way to do that is to develop probes that detect the presence or absence of a broad set of concepts within the embeddings computed in an LLM - which is what we might say a model is "thinking" about. Such probes should be low-cost and easily applicable to any LLM, so that monitoring for many concepts is possible during normal operation.   In this paper, we take the first steps towards developing the capabi

summary.core_problem: 尝试回答 LLM 内部是否能被低成本地探测到“正在表示某个概念”，以及这种概念在层间和长上下文中如何出现与迁移。
summary.importance: 属于机制分析与 probe 方法工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在结论本身，而在于提供一种较轻量的概念探测流程，可用于训练动态监控、对齐诊断或表示分析。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步：先对概念做严格 delineation，构造“概念存在/不存在”的数据；再在不同层的隐藏表示上训练线性 probe，并比较 probe 复杂度需求；最后把 probe 用到更长上下文中，跟踪概念在序列中的持续与转移。核心主张是用低成本线性探针在任意 LLM 上做概念监测。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到使用四个独立概念做案例研究，覆盖概念定义、层级探测和长上下文追踪；但未给出模型规模、具体 LLM、probe 精度、对照基线和统计显著性，因此更适合作为方法雏形而不是稳定结论来源。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether one can cheaply detect if an LLM is internally representing a given concept, and how that concept appears and evolves across layers and longer contexts.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis/probing paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is less about the specific findings and more about a lightweight workflow for concept monitoring during training, alignment, or representation analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts: carefully delineate a concept by constructing data where the concept is present versus absent; train linear probes on hidden states from different layers and study the required probe complexity; then apply the probes to longer contexts to track concept persistence and movement across the sequence. The key claim is that low-cost linear probes can monitor concepts in arbitrary LLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions four separate concept case studies spanning concept delineation, layer-wise probing, and long-context tracking. It does not specify model sizes, exact LLMs, probe accuracy, baselines, or statistical robustness, so this reads more like an early methodology paper than a definitive empirical result.

recommendation.zh: 有点像把 probe workflow 工程化了；若你在做训练中表征监控，可看概念构造和层间追踪部分，别把线性 probe 结果直接当机制事实。
recommendation.en: This is useful if you want a more operational probing workflow for representation monitoring, but do not over-interpret linear probe readouts as mechanism.

paper.title: Xetrieval: Mechanistically Explaining Dense Retrieval
paper.abstract: Explaining why dense retrievers assign high relevance scores remains challenging because retrieval decisions are made through opaque high-dimensional embeddings. Existing explanations often focus on surface signals, such as lexical matches, token alignments, or post-hoc textual rationales, and thus provide limited insight into the latent factors that shape dense retrieval behavior at the embedding level. We propose \textit{Xetrieval}, an embedding-level mechanistic framework for explaining dense

summary.core_problem: 现有对稠密检索高相关分数的解释停留在词法匹配、token对齐或后处理文本理由的表面信号层面，无法在嵌入层解释潜在因素。
summary.importance: 提出嵌入级别的机制性解释框架，属于机制分析方向的方法创新，首次将CoT推理内化到嵌入空间并结合稀疏可解释特征分解用于检索解释。
summary.technical_approach: Xetrieval由两部分组成：(1) 轻量推理内化器，单次前向传播在嵌入空间近似CoT推理，丰富句子嵌入；(2) 将推理增强嵌入分解为稀疏可解释特征，每个特征关联自然语言描述；通过聚合稀疏特征重叠给出检索分数归因。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未详述具体模型规模和数据量，主要提出方法框架。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多所高校，无法从摘要中识别知名机构或作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing explanations for dense retrieval focus on surface signals (lexical matches, token alignments, post-hoc rationales) and cannot explain latent factors at the embedding level.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an embedding-level mechanistic explanation framework; method innovation combining CoT internalization in embedding space plus sparse interpretable feature decomposition for retrieval attribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xetrieval has two parts: (1) a lightweight reasoning internalizer that approximates CoT reasoning in embedding space with a single forward pass, enriching sentence embeddings; (2) decomposing reasoning-enhanced embeddings into sparse interpretable features each linked to a natural language description; retrieval score attribution via aggregating sparse feature overlaps.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not detail model sizes or data scales; mainly presents the methodological framework.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from multiple universities; no well-known institutions or authors identifiable from abstract.

recommendation.zh: 将可解释性方法套用到检索领域，embedding 稀疏分解思路对 LLM 嵌入分析有微弱启发，但整体与 LLM 基座预训练关系较远，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Applies interpretability methods to retrieval; sparse embedding decomposition has minor inspiration for LLM embedding analysis but is distant from LLM foundation pretraining. Read abstract only.

paper.title: Dissecting the Black Box: Circuit-Level Analysis of LLM Vulnerability Detection
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can detect software vulnerabilities, but how do they actually identify vulnerable code? We address this question using mechanistic interpretability; analyzing the internal computations of a neural network to understand its reasoning process.Using Circuit Tracer on Gemma-2-2b, we trace the computational pathways activated when the model classifies 472 C/C++ code samples as vulnerable or safe. Our analysis reveals a surprising finding: the model primarily relies on saf

summary.core_problem: 用机制可解释性方法分析 LLM 在代码漏洞检测任务中究竟依赖哪些内部电路做判断。
summary.importance: 这是面向代码安全任务的 mechanistic interpretability 工作。对理解模型如何形成“安全模式检测器”有一定启发，但任务较窄，对基座预训练的直接价值有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Gemma-2-2b 上使用 Circuit Tracer，追踪模型对 472 个 C/C++ 样本做 vulnerable/safe 分类时激活的计算路径；识别出早层注意力头和第 7 层 MLP 神经元等关键组件，并通过消融验证其因果作用。
summary.experiments: 实验对象为 Gemma-2-2b，数据为 472 个 C/C++ 代码样本。主要结论是模型更依赖“安全模式检测器”而非直接识别漏洞签名；当这些安全检测头未激活时，模型更倾向判为 vulnerable。摘要还提到对 Layer 11 的消融会影响决策，但细节不完整。
summary.authors_note: 分析对象是 Gemma-2-2b；作者 Christian Gehrmann 具有业界研究背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses mechanistic interpretability to ask what internal circuits an LLM relies on when detecting software vulnerabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability study on a narrow code-security task. It offers some insight into how models may implement safety-pattern detection, but its direct value for foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using Circuit Tracer on Gemma-2-2b, the authors trace the computational pathways involved in classifying 472 C/C++ samples as vulnerable or safe, identify key early-layer attention heads and layer-7 MLP neurons, and test their causal role via ablations.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses Gemma-2-2b and 472 C/C++ code samples. The main finding is that the model relies more on 'safety detectors' than on direct vulnerability signatures: when those safety detectors fail to activate, the model tends to classify code as vulnerable. The abstract also mentions a layer-11 ablation effect, though details are incomplete.
summary_en.authors_note: The analyzed model is Gemma-2-2b; Christian Gehrmann has an industry research background.

recommendation.zh: 任务太窄，不值得细读；但“靠 safe pattern 缺失来判危险”这个结论有点意思，可当机制分析反例素材。
recommendation.en: The task is too narrow for a full read, but the 'absence of safe patterns drives vulnerability judgments' result is a useful mechanistic counterexample to keep in mind.

paper.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
