paper.abstract: We demonstrate that sparse autoencoders can extract interpretable features from Claude 3 Sonnet, a production-scale language model, addressing the open question of whether dictionary learning methods scale beyond small transformers. We trained sparse autoencoders with up to 34 million features on the model's middle layer residual stream, using scaling laws to guide hyperparameter selection. The resulting features are multilingual and multimodal (generalizing to images despite text-only training)

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答一个悬而未决的问题：稀疏自编码器（SAE）这类 dictionary learning 方法，是否真的能扩展到生产级大模型，并从中提取出稳定、可解释、接近单义的内部特征，而不是只在小模型或玩具设置里成立。更具体地说，作者在 Claude 3 Sonnet 的中间层 residual stream 上训练超大规模 SAE，检验三件事：一是可解释特征能否在大模型中大量出现；二是这些特征是否具有跨语言、跨模态和抽象语义的一致性；三是这些特征是否不仅“看起来像概念”，而且能通过干预影响模型行为，从而具备一定因果含义。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于直接改进 loss 或数据配比，而在于它把“模型内部表示是否可分解为稀疏、可命名特征”这件事推进到了真实生产模型尺度。这个结果很重要，因为很多关于表示学习、superposition、特征复用、概念组合的讨论，过去都停留在小模型证据上。现在至少可以说，在一个大规模、多模态能力的商用模型中，SAE 仍能抽出大量可解释特征，而且这些特征不是局限于表层词汇匹配。对基座研究员来说，这会影响三个方向。第一，训练动态与表示结构：如果大模型内部确实存在大量可分解特征，那么很多预训练现象可以更具体地被测量，而不是只看 loss。第二，数据与能力分析：多语言、多模态泛化的特征说明模型学到的不是单一 token 统计，而是更抽象的共享表示。第三，post-train 与安全：如果特征可被稳定激活和 steering，那么对行为控制、对齐、拒答、偏差分析都有直接工具价值。贡献量级属于机制分析领域里少见的“把方法真正推到大模型规模并给出系统证据”的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上并不追求新架构，而是把 SAE 训练、规模选择和分析流程工程化到足以处理 Claude 3 Sonnet。作者的出发点是 linear representation hypothesis 和 superposition hypothesis：有意义的概念对应激活空间中的方向，而高维空间允许模型用近似正交方向叠加表示远多于维度数的特征。SAE 就是用稀疏字典学习去近似恢复这些方向。

具体做法是，在模型中间层 residual stream 上收集激活，先做标量归一化，使平均平方 L2 范数与残差维度 D 对齐。SAE 采用标准两层结构：encoder 把 D 维激活映射到 F 维高维 feature space，经 ReLU 得到非负稀疏特征激活；decoder 再把这些特征线性组合回原激活空间。训练目标由重建误差和 L1 稀疏正则组成。一个关键细节是，L1 项按 decoder 列向量范数加权，这样可以把单位化后的 decoder 向量解释为 feature direction，并避免模型通过缩小 feature activation、放大 decoder norm 的方式“钻空子”。这个细节对可解释性很关键，因为它让 feature activation 的量纲更稳定。

论文真正的技术贡献在于把 SAE 扩展到很大规模，并用 scaling law 指导超参数和容量选择，而不是靠小规模试错。作者训练了多种规模的 SAE，最大达到 3400 万特征，目标是在重建质量、稀疏性、feature 利用率和可解释性之间找到可扩展的折中。虽然提供的全文片段没有完整展开全部工程细节，但从摘要和正文可见，作者非常重视训练稳定性、特征死亡、容量不足与过完备字典之间的平衡。这不是简单把 F 调大，而是用经验缩放关系去选 feature 数、正则强度和训练算力。

另一个重要选择是只在中间层 residual stream 上训练，而不是 MLP 激活或更深层表示。原因有三：残差流维度较小，训练和推理更便宜；残差流是各子模块共享的通信通道，更可能承载通用语义特征；中间层通常兼具局部语义和全局抽象，既不太浅也不太任务化。这个选择很合理，也意味着论文结论主要适用于“中层残差表示可解释”，不应直接外推到所有层和所有子空间。

分析上，作者不是只展示一些漂亮 feature，而是从多个角度验证 feature 的语义性：看它们在不同语言中的触发样本；看是否会被图像输入激活，尽管 SAE 只在文本激活上训练；看它们是响应具体实体，还是也响应对概念的抽象讨论；再进一步做 steering，测试提升某个 feature activation 是否会按解释方向改变模型输出。这个从“可读”到“可控”的链条，是全文最有分量的部分。
summary.experiments:
最关键的实验结果有四类。第一，规模结果：作者在 Claude 3 Sonnet 的中层 residual stream 上训练了最高 3400 万特征的 SAE，这本身已经说明 dictionary learning 可以扩展到生产级模型，而不是停留在小 transformer。第二，可解释性结果：抽出的特征覆盖具体实体、地点、语言现象、代码错误、讽刺等抽象概念，而且不是单一模板触发。摘要明确指出这些特征具有 multilingual 和 multimodal 性质，甚至在只用文本激活训练 SAE 的情况下，也能在图像输入上泛化激活，这说明特征更像共享内部表示，而不是文本表面模式。第三，因果验证：这些特征可用于 steering model behavior，并且行为变化与特征解释一致，这比单纯 nearest-neighbor 样例展示更强。第四，缩放规律：作者用 scaling laws 指导 SAE 设计，意味着 feature 数量增加并非盲目堆大，而是伴随可预测的重建/稀疏性收益。

从提供的正文片段里，可以确认的具体数字是“up to 34 million features”。其余如训练 token 数、激活样本规模、重建误差下降幅度、feature density、死特征比例、不同 SAE 容量之间的对比曲线，在片段中没有完整给出，不能编造。精读时应重点找这些图表：1）SAE loss 或 explained variance 随 feature 数扩展的曲线；2）feature activation sparsity 与 reconstruction 的 trade-off；3）多语言、多模态 feature 案例；4）steering 实验的定量结果；5）特征质量随层位或训练配置变化的分析。如果论文给出了 feature 召回、自动解释评分或人工审查统计，这些都比单个案例更值得看。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇需要精读。建议顺序是：先看方法总览，确认 SAE 的目标函数、归一化方式和 feature activation 定义；这里的 decoder norm 加权 L1 是一个不能跳过的细节。然后看 scaling law 和训练配置部分，理解作者如何决定 feature 数、稀疏强度和训练预算，这部分决定了“为什么这次能在大模型上做成，而不是以前那种小规模实验”。接着重点看 feature analysis 和 steering 部分。前者回答“这些特征到底是不是语义单元”，后者回答“这些特征是否有行为因果性”。最后再回头看局限性：只分析中间层、只分析 residual stream、模型是 proprietary、部分坐标轴和单位被隐藏，这些都会影响外部复现和结论外推。

如果时间有限，优先看：1）方法与损失函数；2）scaling law 图；3）多语言/多模态 feature 案例；4）steering 实验。真正值得深挖的点有三个：一是 monosemanticity 在大模型里到底是普遍现象还是局部现象；二是文本训练出的 SAE 为什么能抓到图像相关特征，这和统一多模态表示有什么关系；三是这些 feature 能否成为研究预训练动态、对齐干预和 reward hacking 的测量工具。
summary.authors_note: Anthropic 工作。论文内容明确围绕 Claude 3 Sonnet 展开，延续了 Anthropic 在 superposition、toy models、Towards Monosemanticity、SAE 训练更新等一系列机制分析路线。具体作者名单在给定全文片段中未完整出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a long-standing question in mechanistic interpretability: do sparse autoencoders actually scale to production-grade foundation models, or do they only work in small transformers and toy settings? Concretely, the authors train very large SAEs on the middle-layer residual stream of Claude 3 Sonnet and test three things: whether large models contain many stable interpretable features, whether those features generalize across languages, modalities, and levels of abstraction, and whether the extracted features are not merely descriptive but behaviorally meaningful under intervention.
summary_en.importance: This does not directly change pretraining objectives or data recipes, but it matters for pretraining research because it upgrades representation analysis from small-model evidence to a realistic frontier model. Many discussions around superposition, feature reuse, concept composition, and internal abstraction have relied on limited-scale evidence. Here, the claim is stronger: a production model appears to admit a large sparse feature basis with substantial semantic coherence. That matters in three ways. First, it gives pretraining researchers a more concrete handle on internal learning dynamics beyond aggregate loss. Second, multilingual and multimodal feature generalization suggests that the model is not merely memorizing token-level statistics, but organizing information in shared latent directions. Third, if such features can be steered, they become practical tools for alignment, safety analysis, refusal behavior, and failure diagnosis. Within interpretability, this is a substantial scaling result rather than a small methodological tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is not a new architecture but a large-scale engineering and analysis pipeline for sparse autoencoders. The conceptual starting point is the linear representation hypothesis together with the superposition hypothesis: meaningful concepts correspond to directions in activation space, and high-dimensional networks can pack many more features than dimensions by using approximately orthogonal directions. SAEs are used as a sparse dictionary-learning approximation to recover those directions.

The authors collect activations from the middle-layer residual stream of Claude 3 Sonnet and apply scalar normalization so that the average squared L2 norm matches the residual dimension D. The SAE itself is standard: an encoder maps D-dimensional activations into an F-dimensional overcomplete feature space, followed by ReLU to produce nonnegative sparse feature activations; a decoder linearly reconstructs the original activation. Training minimizes reconstruction error plus an L1 sparsity penalty. A crucial detail is that the L1 term is weighted by the norm of each decoder column. This stabilizes the interpretation of unit-normalized decoder vectors as feature directions and prevents a degenerate rescaling trick where the model shrinks activations and inflates decoder norms without changing the reconstruction. That detail is central to making feature activations interpretable.

The main technical contribution is scaling this setup aggressively and using scaling laws to choose hyperparameters and capacity, rather than relying on ad hoc small-scale tuning. The paper reports SAEs with up to 34 million features. The challenge is not just making F large, but balancing reconstruction quality, sparsity, feature utilization, dead features, and training cost in a regime large enough to probe a production model. Even from the partial text, it is clear that the authors treat scaling behavior as a first-class object, not an afterthought.

Another important design choice is to focus on the middle-layer residual stream rather than MLP activations or very late layers. The reasons are sensible: the residual stream is smaller and cheaper to model; it is the shared communication channel across submodules; and middle layers often contain a useful mix of local semantics and abstract structure. This also means the conclusions are strongest for mid-layer residual representations and should not be overgeneralized to every layer or subspace.

The analysis is broader than showcasing a few attractive neurons. The authors examine whether features fire across multiple languages, whether they activate on image inputs despite text-only SAE training, whether they respond to concrete instances as well as abstract discussion of a concept, and whether directly steering feature activations changes model behavior in the predicted direction. That progression from readable features to controllable features is the most important part of the paper.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four headline empirical results. First, scale: the authors train SAEs with up to 34 million features on the middle-layer residual stream of Claude 3 Sonnet, showing that dictionary learning can be pushed to a production model rather than remaining a small-model technique. Second, interpretability: the learned features cover named entities, places, linguistic phenomena, code errors, sarcasm, and other abstract concepts, and they are not limited to narrow lexical templates. Third, generalization: the abstract and examples indicate that features are multilingual and multimodal, including activation on image inputs even though the SAE was trained only on text activations. That is a strong sign that the features track internal shared representations rather than surface text patterns. Fourth, intervention: the extracted features can be used to steer model behavior in ways consistent with their semantic interpretation, which is stronger evidence than nearest-neighbor examples alone.

The concrete number available from the provided text is the largest SAE size: 34 million features. Other quantitative details that would matter for a full technical readout, such as activation dataset size, reconstruction metrics, sparsity levels, dead-feature rates, and the exact scaling curves, are not fully present in the excerpt and should not be invented. When reading the paper, the most important figures to inspect are: reconstruction or explained-variance scaling with feature count; the sparsity-reconstruction trade-off; multilingual and multimodal feature case studies; quantitative steering results; and any analysis of feature quality across training settings or layer positions. If the paper includes automated feature scoring or human evaluation statistics, those are more informative than isolated examples.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one deserves a careful read. Start with the method section and make sure the loss, normalization, and feature-activation definition are clear; the decoder-norm-weighted L1 term is easy to skip but important. Then read the scaling-law and training-configuration sections closely, because that is where the paper explains why SAE training can work at this scale instead of remaining a boutique small-model exercise. After that, spend most of the time on the feature-analysis and steering sections. The former answers whether the learned units are genuinely semantic; the latter addresses whether they have causal relevance for behavior. Finally, read the limitations with care: only the middle layer is analyzed, only the residual stream is modeled, the base model is proprietary, and some axes or units are intentionally hidden, all of which affect reproducibility and external validity.

If time is limited, prioritize four parts: the objective and normalization, the scaling-law plots, the multilingual/multimodal feature examples, and the steering experiments. The deepest follow-up questions are whether monosemanticity is widespread or only local in large models, why a text-trained SAE can recover image-relevant features, and whether these features can become practical probes for pretraining dynamics, alignment interventions, and reward-hacking analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: Anthropic. The work is clearly part of Anthropic’s interpretability line around superposition, toy models, Towards Monosemanticity, and subsequent SAE training updates. The full author list is not visible in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 里程碑级工作——SAE在生产级大模型上的可行性被证实，这改变了我对大规模可解释性研究前景的判断。安全特征识别部分对对齐研究也有直接启示。
recommendation.en: Milestone work — SAE feasibility on production-scale large models is confirmed, changing the outlook for large-scale interpretability research. The safety feature identification also has direct implications for alignment research.

paper.title: Mechanistic origins of catastrophic forgetting: why RL preserves circuits better than SFT?
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) frequently induces catastrophic forgetting of prior capabilities. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning (RL) retains prior capabilities more effectively than supervised fine-tuning (SFT), attributing this to policy-gradient updates remaining closer to the base policy \cite{shenfeld2025rl}. We extend this behavioral account to the mechanistic level and ask whether RL's advantage is mirrored by stronger preservation of internal computational cir

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解释一个具体现象：为什么在同一类能力迁移或领域适配中，RL 往往比 SFT 更少遗忘原模型能力。它不只看 benchmark 分数和 KL drift，而是把问题推进到 attention head 级别，检查 fine-tuning 是否破坏了原模型中支撑能力的内部 circuit。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与 base model 接口。它提示，持续训练或领域适配的风险不只是参数偏移，也包括已有计算子图被改写。RL 的优势不一定来自更强的任务拟合，而可能来自更新更保守、对原有 circuit 的破坏更少。这对 continual pretrain、domain adaptation、RL-based adaptation 都有参考意义：优化目标的选择会改变模型内部能力的保留方式，而不仅改变输出分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步复现行为层面的遗忘差异：以 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 为底座，先用 completion-only cross entropy 做科学问答 SFT，再在 SFT 模型上用 Dr.GRPO 继续优化。RL 使用 group size 64、两步 refinement，且没有显式 KL penalty。第二步用 Differential Binary Masking 做 circuit discovery。DBM 在 head 级别学习一个 mask，把 base activation 与 source/counterfactual activation 插值，目标是在保持 mask 稀疏的同时提高 target answer 概率。第三步比较 base、SFT、RL 各自发现的 head mask，定义 differential circuit vulnerability：如果某个 head 在 SFT 中比在 RL 中明显弱化，就把它视为更容易被 SFT 破坏的 vulnerable head。这个设计的关键点是把“RL 更接近 base policy”转成了“RL 是否保留更多 base circuit”的可测问题。
summary.experiments: 实验模型是 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct。适配任务是科学问答，保留能力评测覆盖 commonsense reasoning、factuality、instruction following 和 code generation。行为层面，SFT 对新任务适配更快，但 KL drift 更大，旧能力下降更明显；RL 更接近 base policy，保留能力更好，但有时对新任务优化不足。机制层面，DBM 发现 RL 保留了更大比例的 base circuit，head-level contribution 更稳定；SFT 更容易集中改写部分 head，导致 circuit faithfulness 下降。文中还构造了 chemistry QA 的三类 counterfactual triplets，包括 answer-key swap、molecule swap 和 task-type swap，用于定位哪些 head 参与特定问答机制。需要注意的是，RL 模型是在 SFT 模型上继续训练得到的，因此实验更准确地比较的是“SFT 后继续 RL”相对于“SFT 停止点”的保留效果，而不是完全独立的 base-to-RL 与 base-to-SFT 等预算对照。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看 Methodology 中 DBM circuit discovery、differential circuit vulnerability 的定义，以及 Experiments 中 KL drift、retention benchmark 和 circuit faithfulness 的对应关系。预计阅读 20 到 30 分钟。值得细看的点是：RL 没有显式 KL penalty，但仍表现出更保守的 circuit 更新；这说明 policy-gradient 的采样分布和 advantage weighting 本身可能已经限制了更新方向。需要谨慎看待的点是实验规模较小，只用了 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和科学问答适配任务，结论更适合作为机制假设，而不是通用规律。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why RL-based adaptation tends to preserve prior capabilities better than SFT. Instead of stopping at benchmark retention or KL drift, it examines whether the internal attention-head circuits that support earlier capabilities are less disrupted under RL.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is at the boundary between base training, continual adaptation, and post-training. The result suggests that forgetting is not only a matter of parameter distance or output drift; it can be read as selective damage to computational subgraphs. RL appears to be a more conservative adaptation objective, preserving more of the base model’s circuits while often trading off fast task fitting. This is relevant for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and RL-based updating of foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three parts. First, the authors reproduce the behavioral retention gap using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The model is adapted to scientific QA with completion-only SFT, then further optimized with Dr.GRPO. The RL setup uses group size 64, two refinement steps, and no explicit KL penalty. Second, they identify circuits with Differential Binary Masking. DBM learns sparse head-level masks that interpolate between base and counterfactual activations, optimizing the probability of a target answer while penalizing mask size. Third, they compare masks discovered in the base, SFT, and RL models. A head is treated as differentially vulnerable when its mask weight is substantially lower after SFT than after RL. This turns the behavioral claim that RL stays closer to the base policy into a mechanistic question: does RL keep more of the base circuit functional?
summary_en.experiments: All experiments use Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. The adaptation task is scientific question answering, and retention is evaluated on commonsense reasoning, factuality, instruction following, and code generation. At the behavioral level, SFT adapts faster but drifts further from the base policy and forgets more prior capability. RL stays closer to the base model and preserves more retention performance, while sometimes under-optimizing the new task. At the mechanistic level, DBM indicates that RL preserves a larger fraction of the base circuit and keeps head-level contributions more stable. SFT more often weakens or rewrites heads that remain active under RL. For chemistry QA, the circuit probes use counterfactual triplets based on answer-key swaps, molecule swaps, and task-type swaps. A limitation is that the RL model is initialized from the SFT model, so the comparison mainly captures the effect of continuing with RL after SFT rather than a clean equal-budget base-to-RL versus base-to-SFT comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with attention to the Methodology section, especially the DBM setup and the definition of differential circuit vulnerability. Then check the experiments linking KL drift, retention scores, circuit faithfulness, and head-level mask changes. A 20–30 minute read is enough for the main idea. The most useful detail is that RL shows better circuit preservation even without an explicit KL penalty, suggesting that the policy-gradient update and sampling distribution can already impose a conservative bias. The main caveat is scope: the study uses one 3B instruct model and one scientific QA adaptation setting, so the result is best read as a mechanistic hypothesis to test further.

recommendation.zh: 从 Mechanistic Interpretability 角度解释 RL vs SFT 在灾难性遗忘上的差异，提出了 head 级别的电路脆弱性指标，对理解 post-train 动态和 alignment tax 很有价值。
recommendation.en: Explains the difference in catastrophic forgetting between RL and SFT from a Mechanistic Interpretability perspective, proposing a head-level circuit vulnerability metric; valuable for understanding post-train dynamics and alignment tax.

paper.title: MechELK: A Mechanistic Interpretability Framework for Eliciting Latent Knowledge in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) frequently encode factual and reasoning knowledge in their internal representations that is not faithfully reflected in their surface-level outputs -- a phenomenon known as \emph{latent knowledge}. Existing approaches to eliciting latent knowledge, such as Contrastive Consistency Search (CCS), rely on contrastive activation patterns and struggle with complex multi-step reasoning tasks, while mechanistic interpretability tools have primarily been used to \emph{underst

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 latent knowledge elicitation：模型内部可能已经编码了正确事实或推理结果，但标准解码没有把它表达出来。已有 CCS 依赖对比样本和一致性假设，在多步推理、长上下文和欺骗性行为检测上容易退化；普通 probing 又难区分“模型真的知道”与“探针抓到了相关特征”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它把机制可解释工具从“解释行为”推进到“验证表示中是否存在可用知识”。这类方法可用于能力评估、对齐评估和训练动态分析：输出指标不再是唯一观测信号，残差流中的可干预特征也可以成为评估对象。贡献量级属于方法框架级，而不是预训练 recipe；更适合作为模型诊断工具来读。
summary.technical_approach: MechELK 是三阶段流程。Locate 阶段在不同层的 residual stream 上使用 SAE 分解候选特征，并结合 activation patching 找出与目标知识最相关的方向。Verify 阶段引入 Causal Knowledge Score，测量沿某个特征方向注入或扰动时，正确答案 log-prob 或表达概率的因果变化；这比只训练线性探针更强，因为它要求特征对输出有可干预的因果作用。Elicit 阶段使用 representation engineering，把确认后的方向作为干预信号，引导模型把内部知识表达出来。和 CCS 相比，它不只依赖正反样本的激活差异；和标准 activation patching 相比，它试图把因果贡献定位到 SAE feature，而不是整层激活。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在三个 latent knowledge 相关 benchmark 上优于 CCS，平均 elicitation accuracy 提升 6.2%。在 deceptive alignment detection 上提升 11.4%，这是最贴近安全评估的结果。Verify 阶段相对直接 probing 将 false positives 降低 34%，说明因果验证确实过滤了一部分只相关、不承载知识的特征。实验重点不是模型规模扩展，而是验证 Locate-Verify-Elicit 三个环节各自的必要性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。优先看方法部分中 latent knowledge 的操作性定义、CKS 公式、Locate/Verify/Elicit 的接口，以及实验里的 false positive 分析。真正值得细看的点是 CKS：它是否只是在局部线性区间内有效，干预强度 α 如何选，SAE feature 的稀疏性和可解释性是否影响结果。若用于预训练诊断，还需要看 failure modes：哪些知识能被恢复，哪些只是输出层偏置或 prompt 条件变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets latent knowledge elicitation: a language model may internally encode the correct fact or reasoning state while failing, refusing, or being steered away from expressing it in ordinary decoding. Prior methods such as CCS depend on contrastive pairs and consistency assumptions, and they become fragile on multi-step reasoning, long-context settings, and deceptive-behavior probes. Simple probes are also insufficient because they can pick up correlates rather than knowledge-bearing features.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. It turns mechanistic interpretability tools into a way to test whether knowledge is present in internal representations, not just whether it appears in model outputs. This can inform capability evaluation, alignment evaluation, and training-dynamics analysis. The contribution is a framework for representation-level measurement rather than a new pretraining objective or scaling recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: MechELK uses a three-stage pipeline. The Locate stage scans residual-stream activations across layers, applies SAE-based feature decomposition, and uses activation patching to identify candidate directions associated with a query. The Verify stage introduces the Causal Knowledge Score, which measures whether perturbing a specific feature direction causally increases expression of the correct answer. This is stricter than linear probing because the feature must affect the model’s behavior under intervention. The Elicit stage then uses representation engineering to steer the model toward expressing the recovered knowledge. Compared with CCS, the method relies less on hand-built contrastive pairs; compared with standard patching, it attributes effects to feature directions rather than whole activations.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on three latent-knowledge benchmarks, with an average elicitation accuracy improvement of 6.2% over CCS. The largest reported gain is on deceptive alignment detection, where MechELK improves by 11.4%. The Verify stage reduces false positives by 34% relative to direct probing, suggesting that causal filtering removes a meaningful fraction of spurious directions. The experiments mainly support the necessity of the Locate-Verify-Elicit decomposition rather than a claim about scaling behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Focus on the operational definition of latent knowledge, the CKS formulation, and the interfaces between Locate, Verify, and Elicit. The key technical question is whether CKS remains reliable outside small local interventions: how the intervention strength is chosen, how SAE feature quality affects attribution, and how failure cases are handled. For pretraining diagnostics, the failure-mode analysis is more useful than the headline accuracy numbers.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和实验消融即可；若 causal probing 真能压住 SAE 伪特征，这是 latent knowledge 线的有用工程化框架。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and ablations; if causal probing really filters SAE artifacts, this is a useful engineering frame for latent-knowledge work.

paper.title: Internal Representation, Not Clinical Knowledge: Where Apparent LLM Triage Failures Originate
paper.abstract: Patient-voiced clinical-triage benchmarks report high under-triage rates for consumer LLMs for constrained multiple-choice output, yet the same cases score differently with free-text. We ask whether output format changes the model's \emph{clinical representation} or only the mapping from a preserved representation to an answer. Using sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features in Gemma 3 4B/12B IT and Qwen3-8B, we find the same medical features fire on the shared clinical narrative under both formats but

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么同一临床分诊案例在多选格式下表现差、在自由文本格式下表现不同：是医学知识缺失，还是内部表征到答案格式的映射失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。虽然任务是医学分诊，但核心问题是 LLM 的输出格式敏感性、decision token 表征、SAE 特征归因，这对评测设计和能力诊断有较强参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Gemma 3 4B/12B IT 和 Qwen3-8B 上使用 sparse autoencoder features。作者比较共享临床叙事在不同输出格式下激活的医学特征，并检查多选 decision token 处的特征是否延续；再用自然语言 autoencoder verbalization、decision-token logit attribution、top-feature characterization 三种方法交叉验证。
summary.experiments: 实验模型包括 Gemma 3 4B IT、Gemma 3 12B IT 和 Qwen3-8B。行为层面比较 constrained multiple-choice 与 free-text 输出，控制 structured/natural-language input、option-order shuffle，并观察错误主要由 off-by-one 类型 gap 主导。摘要未给出样本量和具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether apparent LLM failures on clinical triage under multiple-choice output reflect missing clinical knowledge or a failure in mapping an internal representation to the constrained answer format.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis paper. Although the task is clinical triage, the core issue is output-format sensitivity, decision-token representation, and SAE-based attribution, which matters for capability evaluation and benchmark design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze sparse-autoencoder features in Gemma 3 4B/12B IT and Qwen3-8B. They compare medical feature activations on the shared clinical narrative across formats and inspect whether those features remain active at the multiple-choice decision token. They triangulate with natural-language autoencoder verbalization, decision-token logit attribution, and top-feature characterization.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses Gemma 3 4B IT, Gemma 3 12B IT, and Qwen3-8B. Behaviorally, it compares constrained multiple-choice and free-text outputs, tests structured and natural-language inputs, shuffles option order to rule out positional bias, and reports that the gap is dominated by off-by-one errors. The abstract does not include sample counts or exact numerical deltas.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 SAE 归因部分；它提醒评测失败常是接口映射坏了，不是知识没学到。
recommendation.en: Read the SAE attribution sections; it is a useful warning that benchmark failures can be interface-mapping failures, not missing knowledge.

paper.title: One Mask to Rule Them All: On Hidden Facts after Editing and How to Find Them
paper.abstract: Knowledge editing methods such as ROME and MEMIT update factual associations in transformer models by modifying MLP weights. While evaluated mainly by output behavior, their internal mechanism remains underexplored. We investigate whether edits rely on a common mechanism, regardless of which fact is modified. Despite fact-specific weight changes, we argue that ROME and MEMIT target the same subset of weights critical for maintaining edits. To isolate this subset, we train a compact binary mask o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 ROME/MEMIT 这类 locate-and-edit 知识编辑方法到底是在“改写知识”，还是通过某种共享的内部机制压制原有事实的输出。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于机制分析，而不是给出新的预训练 recipe。它提醒知识编辑的行为成功不等于参数中的事实已被可靠替换。对于持续预训练、模型修补、模型安全和编辑可检测性，这个结论有实际含义：局部 MLP 更新可能只是向模型注入强信号，改变后续注意力路径，而不是稳定地重构知识表示。因此，用输出命中率评估编辑成功会高估编辑的语义一致性和可泛化性。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是训练一个紧凑的二值 mask，作用在 ROME/MEMIT 修改过的权重矩阵上。mask 的目标不是重新编辑模型，而是找出哪些被修改的权重位置对维持编辑结果是必要的。训练目标包含三部分：第一，恢复原事实，使 pruned model 对原对象的概率高于编辑对象；第二，最小化被移除的权重比例，避免用大范围破坏来制造恢复效果；第三，保持模型行为接近原模型，减少无关退化。关键设计是训练单个 mask 覆盖多个语义不同的编辑事实。如果不同事实的编辑依赖各自独立的参数变化，单个 mask 不应泛化；如果单个 mask 能逆转未见编辑，则说明编辑共享某类功能结构。论文进一步分析 mask 的作用位置，认为它主要消除后层的过度注意力信号，而不是清除 MLP 中的原知识路径。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是，一个只移除较小比例编辑权重的 mask，通常少于 10%，可以在训练编辑上逆转超过 80% 的编辑，在未见编辑上逆转超过 70%。这说明不同事实编辑虽然更新内容不同，但维持编辑的关键权重位置有共享性。更强的证据来自预注入实验：在编辑前应用该 mask，编辑成功率从约 98% 降到 38%，说明这些权重位置不仅足以用于逆转编辑，也对编辑成功有必要性。机制分析显示，被 mask 消除的是后续层对编辑信号的异常注意力放大；MLP 路径仍能保留原事实相关信息。这支持“压制原知识检索”而非“删除并重写知识”的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中提出的 conceptual puzzle：分布式知识为什么能被少量层编辑覆盖。Methodology 里看 mask 的三项约束，因为这是论文把“共享机制”从观察变成可检验假设的关键。实验部分优先看三类结果：mask 的训练/测试逆转率、不同剪枝比例下的效果、编辑前注入 mask 对成功率的影响。机制图和注意力分析值得快速看，用来判断“overattention”解释是否充分。对预训练研究者来说，最有用的是评估思路：不要只看最终 token 输出，要追踪编辑信号如何通过层间路径获得支配性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether locate-and-edit methods such as ROME and MEMIT truly overwrite factual knowledge, or whether they preserve the old fact and force the model to output the edited fact through a shared internal mechanism.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. It shows that behavioral edit success can be a weak proxy for actual knowledge replacement. This matters for continual pretraining, model patching, safety auditing, and edit detection: a local MLP update may inject an amplified control signal that changes later attention behavior, while the original factual pathway remains available. Output-only evaluation can therefore overstate the reliability and semantic consistency of an edit.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train a compact binary mask over the edited weight matrices produced by ROME or MEMIT. The mask is designed to identify which modified weight entries are necessary for maintaining an edit. It is optimized with three constraints: restore the original fact by making the pruned edited model prefer the old object over the new one; remove as few weights as possible; and preserve the model’s general behavior. The key test is to train one mask across semantically diverse edits. If edits were fact-specific at the level of critical parameters, such a mask should not generalize. If the same mask reverses unseen edits, then different edits rely on a common functional structure. The follow-up analysis suggests that the mask removes amplified attention signals in later layers, while MLP pathways carrying the original fact remain intact.
summary_en.experiments: A single small mask, typically pruning less than 10% of the edited weights, reverses more than 80% of edits on the training set and more than 70% on held-out edits. This supports the claim that diverse edits share critical weight positions. A stronger necessity test applies the mask before the editing procedure; edit success drops from about 98% to 38%, indicating that the same mechanism is not only sufficient for reversal but also important for producing successful edits. The mechanistic analysis points to reduced over-attention to the injected edited signal in later layers, rather than removal of factual content from the MLP pathway.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the conceptual puzzle in the introduction: if knowledge is distributed, why can a small local edit override retrieval? Then read the mask objective in the methodology, especially the restoration, minimality, and behavior-preservation terms. In the experiments, focus on mask reversal rates on train and held-out edits, the pruning-ratio tradeoff, and the pre-edit mask injection result. The attention analysis is worth checking to judge whether the over-attention explanation is convincing. The useful takeaway is methodological: edit evaluation should inspect internal routing and signal amplification, not only final-token behavior.

recommendation.zh: 读 mask 实验和 overattention 分析；结论若稳，知识编辑更像门控抑制而非写入事实。
recommendation.en: Read the mask experiments and the overattention analysis; if stable, knowledge editing looks more like gated suppression than factual rewriting.

paper.title: Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Model internals encode rich information about how a large language model (LLM) processes its training data; however, post-training data engineering largely relies on external signals and ignores rich intrinsic signals lying in model internals. We propose SAERL, a data engineering framework for LLM reinforcement learning (RL). It models three intrinsic data properties: diversity, difficulty, and quality, using model internals extracted with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE), an advanced mechanistic interp

summary.core_problem: 在 RL post-training 的数据工程里（选哪些样本、怎么排 curriculum、怎么组 batch），主流做法依赖外部信号（偏好标注、verifier、pass rate、启发式难度等），成本高且覆盖不全。论文要解决的问题是：能否直接用模型内部表征（尤其是 SAE 提取的稀疏特征激活）来刻画“多样性/难度/质量”三类内禀数据属性，并把它们落成可执行的数据工程操作，从而提升 RL 训练效率与最终效果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对“pretrain ↔ posttrain 闭环”有现实意义：它把 mechanistic interpretability 工具（SAE）变成可用的训练信号，用于替代/补充昂贵外部信号的数据筛选与课程学习。启发点在于：1）内部表征可作为数据属性的统一接口（diversity/difficulty/quality），比表面统计更贴近模型真实学习状态；2）如果该信号稳定，未来可能迁移到 continual pretrain / mid-train 的数据调度与退火阶段。整体贡献量级属于“工程可落地的信号源扩展”，而不是提出新的 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法框架 SaeRL 把 SAE 激活空间当作数据工程的坐标系，并将三类属性分别对应到三类操作：
1）质量（quality）→ 过滤：训练一个基于 SAE 表征的 quality probe，用来把原始数据池过滤到更接近目标分布（论文动机是：表面特征如长度、TeX 比例、step 数只能部分反映质量；SAE 激活能更直接反映“是否像目标推理分布”）。
2）难度（difficulty）→ curriculum：用 SAE 表征训练回归器（文中用 ElasticNet）预测连续难度分数；然后在每个语义簇内做“easy-to-hard”的局部轨迹排序。这里的关键取舍是：不做全局单调 curriculum（容易把不同技能混在一起导致局部不连贯），而是“先聚类再局部排序”，让难度递进发生在相近技能/语义区域。
3）多样性（diversity）→ batching：先在 SAE 空间聚类得到多个簇，再跨簇交错取 batch 以覆盖更多特征区域；同时做“moderate batch mixing”（从相邻 batch 交换一小段 tail 样本）在不破坏 batch 内一致性的前提下增加覆盖。这里隐含的训练动态假设是：RL 更新对 batch 组成很敏感，过度混合会让梯度方向噪声变大，完全不混合又会导致模式坍缩/覆盖不足。
动机实验部分还验证了 SAE 表征确实携带可用信号：用线性 probe 预测 DeepMath 的 topic label（含 82 个 leaf topics）显著优于 majority baseline；难度回归在分布外仍保留正相关信号，说明不是简单长度/主题代理。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的总体结论是：在数学推理 RL post-training 上，SaeRL 在不同模型尺度与不同 RL 算法下都能提升性能与效率，并且三组件（过滤/课程/batching）各自有贡献（消融支持）。摘要里提到平均准确率提升约 3.00%。
从全文已给出的细节看，关键支撑实验包括：
- 表征可用性验证：SAE 特征用于 topic 线性分类（DeepMath，多粒度标签，含 82 leaf topics）显著优于 majority baseline；
- 难度信号：ElasticNet 基于 SAE 表征预测连续难度分数，in-distribution 预测强，且在分布移位下仍保持正信号；
- 质量信号：以 PRM800K 等数据为例，论证 SAE 激活能区分目标分布样本与噪声/偏离样本（全文此处在截断内容后续应有具体指标与阈值策略）。
由于提供的全文片段未包含完整表格数字（除 3% 提升外），参数量、训练步数、数据规模、不同 RL 算法的具体增益需要以论文表格为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Motivating Finding 的三组 probe（topic 预测、难度回归、质量区分）：这是“SAE 信号是否值得用”的证据链。
- 再看方法三步（filter → cluster+local curriculum → interleaved batching+moderate mixing）的具体实现细节：尤其是聚类粒度、难度校准方式、mixing 的比例与相邻 batch 定义。
- 最后看消融：三组件各自带来多少增益、是否存在交互（例如过滤是否改变难度分布，进而影响 curriculum）。
如果只想判断是否可迁移到自家 pipeline：重点看 quality probe 的训练数据来源与标注方式（是否仍依赖外部信号），以及 SAE 训练/提取的成本与稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: RL post-training performance is highly sensitive to data engineering (which samples to use, how to order them, and how to batch them), yet most pipelines rely on expensive external signals (human preferences, verifiers, pass rates, heuristic difficulty). The paper asks whether intrinsic signals from model internals—specifically sparse feature activations extracted by Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs)—can reliably model three data properties (diversity, difficulty, quality) and be turned into concrete, actionable operations for RL data engineering.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining recipe paper, but relevant to the pretrain–posttrain loop: it operationalizes mechanistic interpretability artifacts (SAE features) as training-time signals for filtering, curriculum, and batching. The main value is pragmatic: a unified internal representation space that may reduce dependence on costly external supervision and better reflect what the model actually finds hard/easy or in-/out-of-distribution. If robust, the same idea could extend to continual pretraining or mid-training data scheduling, though this work focuses on RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SaeRL treats SAE activation space as the coordinate system for data engineering and maps three intrinsic properties to three operations:
1) Quality → filtering: train an SAE-based quality probe to filter a raw pool toward the target reasoning distribution (arguing surface heuristics like length/TeX ratio/step count are insufficient).
2) Difficulty → curriculum: train a regressor (ElasticNet) on SAE representations to predict a continuous difficulty score; then build curricula as local easy-to-hard trajectories within each SAE-space cluster (a deliberate choice over a single global curriculum to preserve skill/topic coherence).
3) Diversity → batching: cluster samples in SAE space, interleave batches across clusters to increase coverage, and apply “moderate batch mixing” by swapping a small tail portion between nearby batches—aiming to improve diversity without destroying within-batch coherence (important for stable RL gradients).
The motivating section supports the premise with probes: SAE features predict topic labels (DeepMath, including 82 leaf topics) well above a majority baseline; SAE-based difficulty prediction remains positively informative under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is an average accuracy gain of about +3.00% on math reasoning RL post-training, reported to hold across model scales and RL algorithms, with ablations showing each component (filtering, curriculum, batching) contributes.
From the provided full-text excerpt, the key empirical pillars are:
- Topic/semantic structure: linear probes on SAE features predict DeepMath topic labels across granularities, including 82 leaf topics, outperforming majority baselines.
- Difficulty signal: ElasticNet regression from SAE features predicts in-distribution difficulty strongly and retains a positive signal under distribution shift.
- Quality signal: experiments (referencing PRM800K and others) argue SAE activations help separate target-distribution samples from noisy/OOD data (the excerpt is truncated before the detailed metrics).
Exact model sizes, dataset sizes, and per-setting deltas are not fully visible in the provided content and should be taken from the paper’s tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the “Motivating Finding” probes first; they are the justification for using SAE space at all.
- Then read the three-step pipeline details (quality probe training, clustering choices, difficulty calibration, and the batch interleaving/mixing rule).
- Finally, check ablations to see whether gains are additive or dominated by one component.
If evaluating adoption, focus on: (i) what supervision the quality probe needs (does it reintroduce external labels?), and (ii) the cost/stability of training and extracting SAE features at scale.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和消融：若 SAE 信号真能稳定迁移，RL 数据选择不必只靠 reward 和外部标签。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: if SAE signals transfer robustly, RL data selection need not rely only on rewards and external labels.

paper.title: Mechanistically Interpreting the Role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR for LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) is empirically shown to notably enhance the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in mathematics and programming. However, the mechanistic role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate RLVR through the lens of difficulty-wise and one-sample analysis. We find that sample difficulty has a non-monotonic effect on RLVR: easy and medium-difficulty problems yield the stronges

summary.core_problem: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR，如GRPO类方法）已成为提升LLM推理能力的主流后训练范式，但现有方法普遍对训练样本按难度统一处理，样本难度如何影响RLVR的优化动态、模型内部推理机制的演化过程，以及为什么过难样本反而会损害模型能力，这些机制层面的问题一直没有被清晰解释。
summary.importance: 首次从机制层面解释了RLVR中样本难度的非单调作用，打破了“越难的训练样本越有效”的常见认知；其基于可解释性工具的内部特征分析方法，为后训练的数据筛选、课程设计、信用分配提供了底层依据，直接指导RLVR训练流程的优化。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 以当前策略在样本上的采样成功率为难度代理，将样本分为易、中、难三个区间，通过控制变量的子集训练和单样本放大实验，观测不同难度样本对奖励动态、优化稳定性和下游性能的影响；2. 提出时序稀疏自编码器（T-SAE），从推理轨迹的激活值中提取稀疏的推理特征，跟踪训练过程中不同难度样本对各类推理特征的激活频率和强度的影响，从内部表征层面解释难度的作用机制；3. 基于分析结论提出两种优化干预：将过难的正向求解问题转化为反向推理变体提升信号质量，以及基于推理特征动态的优化方法（RFGO），用特征移动量重加权token级更新、为零方差样本组提供特征级代理奖励。
summary.experiments: 核心发现包括：1. 样本难度对RLVR效果存在非单调影响，中等难度样本带来最强、最稳定的推理能力提升，过易样本信号弱，过难样本不仅学习信号弱，还会因偶然获得奖励的捷径轨迹被相对优势归一化放大，诱导答案重复、跳过必要计算等退化行为，甚至损害模型原有能力；2. 内部特征层面，易样本主要强化直接回答和基础计算特征、抑制深思熟虑的推理特征，难样本强化复杂逻辑推理特征但弱化计算相关特征，只有中等难度样本能同时平衡强化计算和多步推理两类特征；3. 提出的两种难度感知干预能有效提升难样本的利用率和RLVR的整体效果。实验基于Qwen2.5-math-1.5B和7B模型开展。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第2章的优化动态分析和核心实验结论，重点关注不同难度样本的失效模式分析；精读第3章的T-SAE设计和内部特征演化分析，这是论文的核心创新；两种干预方法的章节可作为分析结论的验证选读；附录的相关工作和补充实验可按需查阅。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR, such as GRPO-style methods) has become the dominant post-training paradigm for improving LLM reasoning ability. However, existing methods generally treat training samples uniformly regardless of difficulty. Mechanistic questions such as how sample difficulty affects RLVR optimization dynamics, the evolution of the model's internal reasoning mechanisms, and why overly hard samples反而损害模型能力 have not been clearly explained.
summary_en.importance: It is the first work to explain the non-monotonic effect of sample difficulty in RLVR at the mechanistic level, breaking the common perception that harder training samples are more effective. Its internal feature analysis method based on interpretability tools provides a underlying basis for post-training data selection, curriculum design, and credit assignment, directly guiding the optimization of RLVR training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Taking the sampling success rate of the current policy on a sample as the difficulty proxy, samples are divided into three intervals: easy, medium, and hard. Through controlled subset training and single-sample amplification experiments, the impact of samples of different difficulties on reward dynamics, optimization stability, and downstream performance is observed; 2. A Temporal Sparse Autoencoder (T-SAE) is proposed to extract sparse reasoning features from activations along reasoning trajectories, track the impact of samples of different difficulties on the activation frequency and intensity of various reasoning features during training, and explain the mechanism of difficulty from the internal representation level; 3. Based on the analysis conclusions, two optimization interventions are proposed: transforming overly hard forward problem-solving tasks into backward reasoning variants to improve signal quality, and Reasoning Feature-Guided Optimization (RFGO), which reweights token-level updates with feature movement and provides feature-level proxy rewards for zero-variance sample groups.
summary_en.experiments: Core findings include: 1. Sample difficulty has a non-monotonic effect on RLVR performance. Medium-difficulty samples bring the strongest and most stable reasoning ability improvement. Too easy samples provide weak signals, while overly hard samples not only have weak learning signals, but also induce degenerate behaviors such as answer repetition and skipping necessary calculations, and even damage the model's original ability, because shortcut trajectories that accidentally get rewarded are amplified by relative advantage normalization; 2. At the internal feature level, easy samples mainly reinforce direct answer and basic computation features while suppressing deliberative reasoning features, hard samples reinforce complex logical reasoning features but weaken computation-related features, only medium-difficulty samples can simultaneously balance and strengthen both computation and multi-step reasoning features; 3. The two proposed difficulty-aware interventions can effectively improve the utilization of hard samples and the overall effect of RLVR. Experiments are conducted based on Qwen2.5-math-1.5B and 7B models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Chapter 2 carefully for optimization dynamics analysis and core experimental conclusions, focusing on the failure mode analysis of samples of different difficulties; read Chapter 3 carefully for T-SAE design and internal feature evolution analysis, which is the core innovation of the paper; the chapters on the two intervention methods can be read optionally as verification of the analysis conclusions; related work and supplementary experiments in the appendix can be consulted as needed.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部 RLVR 数据分桶复现；“难题越多越好”的 prior 被削弱，关键看奖励信号密度而非题面难度。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing on internal RLVR buckets now; it weakens the “harder is better” prior and shifts attention to reward-signal density rather than nominal difficulty.

paper.title: Where Does Toxicity Live? Mechanistic Localization and Targeted Suppression in Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models frequently generate toxic, hateful, or harmful content, yet existing mitigation methods rely on costly retraining or output-level filtering with no mechanistic insight into where toxicity originates internally. We introduce Meow2X and TRNE, two complementary retraining-free frameworks that localize toxicity to specific layers and neurons by analyzing activation differentials between toxic and neutral prompts, then suppress them via inference-time scaling or minimal rank-one

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关心的是：模型内部到底哪里承载了 toxicity，以及能否在不重训的前提下做有针对性的抑制。相比常见的安全对齐路线，它不试图通过 SFT、RLHF 或额外分类器从外部约束输出，而是把问题改写成一个机制定位问题：毒性输入与中性输入在各层激活上有什么稳定差异，这些差异集中在哪些层、哪些神经元，能否据此做最小干预。对基座预训练本身，它不是直接相关工作；但对理解模型内部表征、训练后行为编辑、以及“坏行为是否局部化”这个问题，有一定参考价值。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它支持一种较强的局部化假设：至少在作者测试的模型和数据上，toxicity 并不是均匀弥散在全网，而是更集中在少数层，尤其偏早层的 attention/MLP 组件。这类结果会影响人们如何理解预训练中概念表征的形成位置，以及后续做 targeted editing、concept erasure、safety patching 时该从哪里下手。第二，它展示了两种无需完整重训的干预方式：可逆的推理时激活缩放，以及持久化的 rank-one 权重编辑。前者更像诊断工具，后者更像轻量模型修补。贡献量级上，这是一篇机制分析加后处理干预的工作，不属于预训练 recipe 创新；如果只关心数据、scaling、优化，它优先级不高，但如果你关心 mechanistic localization 和 post-hoc model editing，可以泛读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由 Meow2X 和 TRNE 两部分组成，核心共识是“先定位，再抑制”。

Meow2X 是纯推理时、参数冻结的方法。作者准备 toxic prompts 集合和 neutral prompts 集合，对模型每一层的 attention block、MLP block 或两者同时注册 forward hooks，收集隐藏状态并在 token 与 batch 维度上求平均，得到 toxic 与 neutral 两类输入在每层的均值激活向量。然后计算 activation differential Δ^l = μ_t^l - μ_n^l，并把各神经元绝对差值聚合成层级 toxicity score，用来给层排序。作者还定义了一个 neuron contribution ratio：把 |Δ^l| 超过 90 分位数的神经元视为 toxic neurons，统计这些高差异神经元贡献了多少层内总差异，用来判断毒性是集中在少量神经元还是分散在整层。选层策略有两种：Top-k，或基于均值和标准差的动态阈值。定位完成后，在推理时对这些层的输出做缩放抑制。摘要和方法部分显示它支持不同 intervention scope：只改 attention、只改 MLP、或两者都改。这个方法的优点是完全可逆、无需梯度、实现简单；缺点是它依赖 toxic/neutral 对比集的代表性，而且“均值激活差异”是比较粗的统计量，未必能区分真正的因果特征和伴随特征。

TRNE 则试图把这种定位转成持久化编辑。它用 contrastive gradient norms 来找与 toxic/neutral 区分最相关的层，然后在对应投影矩阵上施加最小 rank-one 更新，并加 norm constraint 控制改动幅度。作者强调这个过程不需要完整 gradient descent 训练，而是一次性的小编辑。可以把它理解成把“毒性方向”直接写进某个线性映射的修正项里，从而在后续推理中持续压制相关表征。与 Meow2X 相比，TRNE 的好处是部署时不需要 hooks；代价是它不再完全可逆，而且如果定位不准，持久化编辑更容易伤到通用能力。

与已有 toxic neuron suppression 工作相比，这篇的区别主要在于：不是先验指定某些神经元或固定概念，而是先用数据驱动方式在层级上做选择，再决定干预范围；同时把 attention 与 MLP 分开评估，而不是把整个 block 当黑箱。
summary.experiments:
作者在 5 个语言模型、2 个 benchmark、90 组配置上做评估，配置维度包括模型、数据集、干预组件范围以及不同 intervention strategy。摘要给出的总体结论是，两种方法都能稳定降低 toxicity，同时尽量保持语言建模质量。全文中最值得注意的实验结论不是某个单点分数，而是结构性发现：toxicity 在早层更集中，而且通常由少量高贡献神经元主导，而不是均匀分布在所有层。这为 targeted suppression 提供了经验依据。

Meow2X 方面，作者比较了 Top-k 与动态阈值选层，也比较了只抑制 attention、只抑制 MLP、以及同时抑制两者的效果。一般来说，针对检测到的少数高分层做缩放，比对全模型统一降幅更能兼顾安全性和语言质量。TRNE 方面，作者展示了最小 rank-one 编辑在多模型上也能带来毒性下降，而且因为编辑幅度受约束，语言建模退化相对可控。摘要没有给出具体 benchmark 名称和逐项数值，但明确提到使用 dual safety evaluators，这意味着安全性结论不是依赖单一 judge。

如果从研究价值看，实验最有用的部分是 layer-wise localization 分析和不同组件范围的对比，而不是 detox 分数本身。因为后者很容易受 evaluator、prompt 分布和阈值影响；前者更接近可迁移的机制观察。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议投入太多时间。先看 Introduction，确认它解决的是 post-hoc detox 而不是训练期安全。然后直接看 Methodology 里 Meow2X 的 layer scoring 和 neuron concentration 定义，理解作者到底用什么统计量来声称“毒性在这里”。接着看实验部分关于 layer distribution、early-layer concentration、以及 attention/MLP scope ablation 的图表，这些比最终 detox 分数更有信息量。最后再看 TRNE 的 rank-one edit 公式和质量保持结果，判断这种编辑是否足够稳。

预计 20 分钟左右可以完成有效阅读。若只看一半，优先看：层定位方法、选层策略、不同组件干预对比、以及语言质量保持指标。一个值得保留的疑问是：activation differential 抓到的是“毒性语义”本身，还是“带有攻击性词汇/风格的表面统计特征”；如果后者占比很高，这类方法的泛化边界会比较明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where toxicity is encoded inside a language model, and whether it can be suppressed without retraining. Instead of relying on SFT, RLHF, or output filtering, it reframes detoxification as a mechanistic localization problem: what internal activation patterns differ systematically between toxic and neutral inputs, which layers and neurons carry those differences, and whether minimal interventions can reduce harmful behavior. This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to representation localization, post-hoc editing, and the broader question of whether undesirable behaviors are internally localized.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect but real. First, it supports a localized-representation view: in the tested models, toxicity is not uniformly distributed across the network, but appears concentrated in a small subset of layers, especially earlier ones. That matters for how one thinks about where concepts form during pretraining and how targeted editing or concept erasure should be designed. Second, it compares two lightweight intervention styles: reversible inference-time activation scaling and persistent rank-one weight editing. The former is useful as a diagnostic and deployment-time patch; the latter is closer to a lightweight model repair. This is not a training-recipe contribution, so it is not high priority for someone focused on data, scaling, or optimization, but it is worth skimming if mechanistic localization and post-hoc model editing are of interest.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proposes two methods, Meow2X and TRNE, built around a shared idea: localize first, suppress second.

Meow2X is a parameter-frozen inference-time method. The authors prepare toxic and neutral prompt sets, register forward hooks on attention blocks, MLP blocks, or both, and collect hidden activations layer by layer. For each layer, they average activations across tokens and batches to obtain mean vectors for toxic and neutral inputs, then compute an activation differential Δ^l = μ_t^l - μ_n^l. A scalar toxicity score is formed by aggregating absolute neuron-wise differences, and layers are ranked by this score. They also define a neuron concentration statistic: neurons whose absolute differential exceeds the 90th percentile are treated as toxic neurons, and their share of the total layer differential is measured. This is meant to tell whether toxicity is concentrated in a few neurons or spread across the layer. Layers are selected either by Top-k or by a dynamic threshold based on the mean and standard deviation of layer scores. Once selected, those layers are suppressed at inference time by scaling their outputs. The method supports different intervention scopes: attention only, MLP only, or both. The appeal is simplicity, reversibility, and no need for optimization. The limitation is that mean activation differences are a coarse statistic and may capture correlates rather than causal features.

TRNE turns localization into a persistent edit. It uses contrastive gradient norms to identify layers most associated with toxic versus neutral behavior, then applies a minimal rank-one update to the relevant projection matrix under a norm constraint. The authors emphasize that this is not full gradient-descent retraining, but a lightweight one-shot edit. Intuitively, it writes a corrective direction into the weight matrix so that future generations are less likely to express the targeted toxic behavior. Compared with Meow2X, TRNE removes the need for runtime hooks, but it is no longer fully reversible and may carry a higher risk of collateral damage if localization is imperfect.

Relative to prior toxic-neuron suppression work, the main distinction is that the paper does not start from a fixed concept or a manually chosen neuron set. It first performs data-driven layer selection, and it evaluates attention and MLP components separately rather than treating the whole block as a single unit.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers five language models, two benchmarks, and 90 configurations spanning model choice, dataset, intervention scope, and intervention strategy. The headline result is that both methods reduce toxicity consistently while trying to preserve language modeling quality. The most useful experimental finding is structural rather than leaderboard-like: toxicity appears concentrated in earlier layers and often in a relatively small subset of high-contribution neurons, rather than being evenly distributed throughout the network. That observation is what justifies targeted suppression.

For Meow2X, the paper compares Top-k versus dynamic-threshold layer selection, and also compares attention-only, MLP-only, and joint interventions. The general pattern is that suppressing a small set of high-scoring layers works better than applying uniform damping everywhere, especially when balancing safety against language quality. For TRNE, the paper shows that minimal rank-one edits can also reduce toxicity across models, with relatively controlled degradation because the edit magnitude is norm-constrained. The abstract mentions dual safety evaluators, which is useful because it reduces dependence on a single judge.

From a research perspective, the most informative experiments are the layer-wise localization analyses and the component-scope ablations, not the final detox scores themselves. The latter are sensitive to evaluator choice, prompt distribution, and thresholding; the former are more likely to transfer as mechanistic observations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper rather than a deep-read paper. Start with the introduction to confirm that the contribution is post-hoc detoxification rather than training-time safety. Then go straight to the Meow2X methodology and inspect the exact layer-scoring and neuron-concentration definitions. That tells you what evidence the paper uses when it claims toxicity lives in specific layers. After that, read the experiments on layer distribution, early-layer concentration, and attention-versus-MLP ablations. Those figures are more informative than the final detox numbers. Finally, look at the TRNE rank-one edit formulation and the quality-preservation results to judge how stable the persistent edit seems.

A useful skim should take about 20 minutes. If reading selectively, prioritize the localization method, layer-selection strategy, component-scope comparisons, and language-quality metrics. One question worth keeping in mind is whether activation differentials are isolating toxicity as a semantic concept, or mostly picking up surface lexical and stylistic correlates. If the latter dominates, the generalization boundary of the method may be fairly narrow.

recommendation.zh: 基于激活差异的属性定位方法可复用到其他特征的机制分析，早期MLP层编码毒性的结论可指导轻量对齐编辑，重点看§4和§5
recommendation.en: The activation-based attribute localization method can be generalized to other feature analysis, the early-MLP toxicity encoding finding can guide lightweight alignment edits, focus on §4 and §5

paper.title: Revealing Algorithmic Deductive Circuits for Logical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong reasoning performance by incorporating functional symbolic representations that abstractly describe graph traversal algorithms and step-by-step reasoning in few-shot learning settings. However, it remains unclear how LLMs genuinely understand the abstract meaning of each reasoning step and the overall algorithm from only a limited number of demonstrations. This work aims to localize the attention heads responsible for

summary.core_problem: 在符号辅助 CoT 的演绎推理任务中，LLM 是如何在内部实现“按算法执行”的：哪些注意力头负责单步推理的关键决策（选前提、停止选前提、选规则），这些头之间传递什么信息，以及它们对最终推理路径的因果作用有多大。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，而是机制分析/可解释性工作。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：它把“推理步骤的关键 token 位点”与“可定位的注意力头电路”对应起来，提供了一种更细粒度的诊断框架，可用于评估不同预训练/中期训练配方是否真的改变了推理电路（而不只是改变表面输出）。此外，它强调了少数“高不确定 token”对推理轨迹的支配作用，这对构造更有效的训练信号（例如在这些位点做 targeted loss / curriculum / verifier shaping）有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Symbolic-Aided CoT 框架下，把演绎推理形式化为推理图上的遍历过程（示例提到 BFS/DFS 的演示会诱导不同的遍历偏好）。先做一个定位步骤：把 CoT 中的组成步骤与对应的 token logits 对齐，找出跨模型家族都“难解码”的不确定 token（通常是决定推理分支的起始 token，例如选择哪个前提字母、是否停止选前提、选择哪条规则）。然后用因果中介分析（CMA）与 activation/path patching 去找“对这些不确定 token 的 logit 变化有因果贡献”的注意力头子集，并进一步恢复这些头之间的信息流图，形成一个由多个子电路组成的 circuit network（分别对应 premise selection / termination / rule selection）。最后通过 knock-out（移除/抑制这些头）在标准演绎推理基准上验证电路的可迁移性与必要性。
summary.experiments:
实验主线包括三部分：
1) 统计性预实验：在合成数据上识别不确定 token 位点，并观察其在不同模型/规模上普遍存在。
2) 电路抽取：构造“干净 vs 污染”的提示对（针对每个推理组件分别污染），用 activation patching/path patching 找关键注意力头与信息流。
3) 因果验证：对抽取出的头做 knock-out，并在 ProntoQA 等演绎推理基准上评估性能下降，以证明这些头对推理步骤执行是必要的。
当前提供的全文片段未包含具体模型列表、层/头数量、以及 knock-out 后的定量跌幅表格，因此无法可靠给出数值级结论；精读需要直接看实验章节的电路可视化图与性能表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看他们如何定义并自动对齐“推理组件 ↔ token 位点”，以及“不确定 token”的判据（这决定了后续 CMA 的目标是否合理）。
- 重点看数据构造：clean/corrupted prompt 的污染方式是否只改变一个组件、是否引入分布外噪声。
- 看 circuit network 的信息流图：哪些层的头在读 KB snapshot、哪些在实现遍历偏好（BFS/DFS），哪些在把已证明事实写回。
- 最后看 knock-out 的泛化验证：是否跨任务/跨提示模板仍然成立，还是只对合成格式有效。

summary_en.core_problem: In symbolic-aided CoT deductive reasoning, what internal mechanisms enable an LLM to execute an algorithm-like multi-step procedure: which attention heads causally implement key step decisions (premise selection, termination, rule selection), what information they carry, and how they interact as a circuit network.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper; it is mechanistic interpretability. The indirect relevance to pretraining is diagnostic: it links a small set of trajectory-steering ‘uncertain tokens’ to identifiable attention-head circuits, offering a way to test whether changes in pretraining/mid-training actually modify reasoning circuitry rather than just surface-form outputs. The emphasis on a few high-leverage token positions also suggests targeted training signals (loss reweighting, curricula, verifier shaping) that focus on branch-defining decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under Symbolic-Aided CoT, the reasoning process is formalized as inference-graph traversal, with demonstrations potentially inducing traversal strategies (e.g., BFS vs DFS preferences). The pipeline is: (1) align constituent reasoning steps to token-level logits and identify ‘uncertain tokens’ that consistently steer the reasoning path (e.g., the first token choosing a premise label, the token deciding whether to stop selecting premises, the token choosing a rule); (2) apply causal mediation analysis with activation patching and path patching to find the subset of attention heads that causally drive logit changes at those uncertain tokens; (3) reconstruct information-flow graphs among these heads, yielding a circuit network with subcircuits per reasoning component; (4) validate necessity/generalization by knocking out the identified heads and measuring degradation on established deductive reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: Three experimental blocks: (i) preliminary analyses on synthetic data to locate uncertain token positions and show they persist across model families/sizes; (ii) circuit extraction using paired clean vs corrupted prompts per reasoning component, enabling activation/path patching attribution; (iii) causal validation via head knock-outs evaluated on benchmarks such as ProntoQA. The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables (models used, number of heads, exact performance drops), so numeric claims should be checked directly in the results section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the step-to-token alignment method and the operational definition of ‘uncertain tokens’; this is the foundation for the entire causal analysis.
- Inspect how clean/corrupted prompt pairs are constructed and whether corruption isolates a single component without introducing distribution shift artifacts.
- Study the circuit-network visualizations: which layers/heads read the KB snapshot, which encode traversal preferences, and which propagate proven facts.
- Check knock-out generalization: does the circuit remain important across tasks and prompt templates, or only within the synthetic symbolic format?

recommendation.zh: 读 §因果中介和 head 类型即可；若定位稳定，会给 CoT circuit 分析一个较干净的拆分模板。
recommendation.en: Read the causal mediation and head-typing parts; if stable, this gives a clean template for dissecting CoT circuits.

paper.title: Tracing Computation Density in LLMs
paper.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) are comprised of billions of parameters arranged in deep and wide computational graphs, but it is not clear that they exploit their full capacity for all inputs. We introduce the s-Trace method to efficiently estimate the subgraph of size s that best approximates a full model output. With this method, we find the computation in a variety of LLMs to be organized in two distinct phases. A small subgraph mostly composed of early-layer nodes can reconst

summary.core_problem: 论文试图回答一个直接问题：LLM 在每个输入上是否真的需要执行完整计算图，还是只需要一个输入相关的稀疏子图就能近似复现完整模型的输出分布。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“计算量是否随输入难度动态变化”从工程假设变成了可测量对象。结果显示，不同 7B 到 14B 模型在相似输入上的计算密度模式相近，且与输出熵、词频等信号相关。这对动态路由、早退、稀疏激活、MoE token routing、训练时按样本难度分配算力都有参考意义。它不是直接提出新的预训练 recipe，但提供了一个分析模型内部计算分配的工具。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 s-Trace。给定一个输入和完整模型输出分布，算法寻找大小为 s 的子图，使该子图尽可能重构完整模型的输出概率分布。它借鉴 automated circuit discovery 和 Information Flow Route 的归因思路，不是为某个特定任务找 circuit，而是把 circuit discovery 改造成通用的输出重构测量。作者改变子图预算 s，观察从极小子图到较大子图时，输出分布重构质量如何变化。关键设计点是用子图大小作为计算预算，用与完整输出分布的一致性作为目标，从而避免只看最终 token 是否相同这一过粗指标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 10 个 7B 到 14B 规模的 LLM。主要发现是两阶段结构。第一阶段是 construction phase：在约 10^-4 到 10^-3 的完整模型规模下，少量节点，尤其是早层节点，对输出头部概率质量有强影响；约 10^-3 时出现稳定的 minimal core，已经能较好恢复输出分布头部。第二阶段是 refinement phase：超过约 10^-2 后，子图已经重构约 40% 到 60% 的预测概率质量，新增节点多来自后层，并且 attention head 占比上升，边际收益变小，更多是在补充完整分布的细节。作者还报告计算密度与模型输出熵正相关，对低频词预测时密度更高，说明该度量可能捕捉到输入难度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对“effective computation”的定义，方法部分中 s-Trace 如何从 IFR 扩展而来，以及展示两阶段计算结构的主图。实验部分可重点看三个问题：不同模型的 trace 是否一致；早层和后层节点在不同预算下如何迁移；计算密度与输出熵、词频的相关性是否稳定。若关心动态推理或 MoE routing，可以进一步看它的密度指标能否作为 token-level compute allocation 的训练或评估信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether an LLM needs to execute its full computation graph for every input, or whether a much smaller input-specific subgraph can faithfully approximate the full model’s output distribution.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the measurement framework. It turns input-dependent compute allocation from an engineering intuition into something that can be estimated and compared. The finding that 7B–14B models show similar compute-density patterns on similar inputs, and that density correlates with output entropy and word rarity, is relevant to dynamic routing, early exiting, sparse activation, MoE routing, and difficulty-aware compute allocation during training. The paper does not propose a new pretraining recipe, but it gives a useful lens for studying how trained models spend computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is s-Trace. For a given input and the full model’s output distribution, it estimates a subgraph of size s that best reconstructs that distribution. The method builds on automated circuit discovery and the Information Flow Route framework, but repurposes them from task-specific circuit identification to generic output reconstruction. By sweeping the subgraph budget s, the authors obtain a compute-performance curve: how much of the full prediction distribution can be recovered as more nodes are added. The important choice is to optimize reconstruction of the full probability distribution, rather than only checking whether the top predicted token is preserved.
summary_en.experiments: The study analyzes 10 LLMs in the 7B to 14B range. The main empirical result is a two-phase organization of computation. In the construction phase, starting around 10^-4 of the full model size and becoming stable near 10^-3, a small core dominated by early-layer nodes has large marginal impact and can recover the head of the output distribution. In the refinement phase, beyond roughly 10^-2 of the full graph, the trace has already reconstructed about 40% to 60% of the prediction probability mass. Additional nodes, increasingly from later layers and attention heads, provide smaller refinements to the full distribution. The paper also reports that compute density is positively correlated with output entropy and increases for rarer words.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the definition of effective computation in the introduction, the s-Trace construction and its relation to IFR in the method section, and the main figures showing the two-phase trace. The most useful experimental details are the cross-model consistency of traces, the layer-wise shift from early construction to later refinement, and the correlations with entropy and word frequency. For readers working on dynamic inference or MoE routing, the key question is whether compute density can serve as a token-level signal for routing or curriculum design.

recommendation.zh: 读 s-Trace 定义和两阶段结果即可；若结论稳，动态计算不应只按层早退来设计。
recommendation.en: Read the s-Trace setup and the two-phase finding; if robust, adaptive compute should not be designed as layerwise early exit only.

paper.title: Confidence and Calibration of Activation Oracles for Reliable Interpretation of Language Model Internals
paper.abstract: Activation oracles aim to make the activations of other models legible to humans and yield promising results compared to white-box interpretability techniques. However, uncertainty quantification (UQ) for the natural-language outputs of such activation oracles is so far understudied. Here, we investigate 6 different methods for estimating the confidence of activation oracles and evaluate how well-calibrated their confidence scores are. Our experiments on 6,000 samples per oracle (varying verbali

summary.core_problem: 激活oracle是将目标大模型隐藏状态翻译为自然语言的可解释性工具，其推理时残差流会被注入其他模型的激活向量，属于受 steering 扰动的特殊模型。目前这类模型输出的置信度估计与校准问题尚未被研究，而其下游对齐审计、欺骗检测、隐藏目标提取等场景都依赖可靠的置信度信号支撑决策。
summary.importance: 提供了激活oracle场景下的首个不确定性量化基准，验证了普通LLM常用置信度方法在steered模型上的适用性，复现了普通LLM上已观测到的口头自报告置信度偏差现象，给出了可直接落地的校准方法选型依据，对预训练模型可解释性工具的工程落地有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 选取6种置信度估计方法进行对比：3种为普通LLM常用基线的适配版本，包括答案词联合对数概率、温度引导的bootstrap众数频率、自由形式数值自报告；另外3种为针对steered激活oracle设计的新方法，包括MCMC功率采样链接受率、多MCMC链交叉一致性、steering系数扫描的解码稳定性。所有方法在禁忌词探测任务上测试，采用ECE、Brier分数、AUROC等校准与排序指标评估。
summary.experiments: 在已发布的Qwen3-8B激活oracle和新训练的Qwen3.6-27B激活oracle上测试，每个配置跑6000个样本。结果显示温度bootstrap是校准效果最好的方法：8B模型下采样温度T=1.0时ECE为5.7%，远优于对数概率基线的25.5%；27B模型下T=1.5时ECE为10.3%，优于对数概率基线的13.1%。自由形式数值自报告校准效果最差，27B模型上对错误答案的平均置信度（98.9%）甚至高于正确答案（97.6%）。专门设计的MCMC接受率等steered专属方法效果不佳，因为steered后的输出条件分布在贪心答案处过于尖锐，无法区分正确与错误输出，AUROC仅为0.53-0.60。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节的校准性能对比结果，以及第4节对不同方法失效原因的分析。预计阅读时间15-20分钟，不需要深入研究激活oracle的训练细节，核心关注置信度方法的选型结论和steered模型的特殊校准特性即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation oracles are fine-tuned language models that translate target models' hidden states into natural language for interpretability. As steered models whose residual streams are perturbed with activations from another model at inference, they lack validated uncertainty quantification (UQ) pipelines, even though downstream use cases including alignment auditing, deception detection, and hidden objective extraction require calibrated confidence signals to support actionable decisions.
summary_en.importance: This work presents the first UQ benchmark for activation oracles, validates the performance of common LLM confidence estimation methods under the steered setting, replicates the verbalized confidence gap previously observed in standard LLMs, and provides a practical recipe for calibrated UQ method selection. It offers practical reference for engineering deployment of interpretability tools for pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Six confidence estimation methods are benchmarked: three adapted from standard LLM UQ baselines, including joint token log-probability of predicted answers, temperature-bootstrap mode frequency, and free-form numeric self-report; three designed specifically for steered activation oracles, including MCMC power-sampling acceptance ratio, cross-chain agreement of multiple MCMC runs, and decoding stability across steering coefficient sweeps. All methods are tested on the secret-word taboo task and evaluated with calibration and ranking metrics including ECE, Brier score, and AUROC.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two activation oracles: a released Qwen3-8B oracle and a newly trained Qwen3.6-27B oracle, with 6,000 samples per configuration per model. Temperature-bootstrap mode frequency achieves the best calibration: it reaches 5.7% ECE on Qwen3-8B at sampling temperature T=1.0, far outperforming the 25.5% ECE of the log-probability baseline; on Qwen3.6-27B it reaches 10.3% ECE at T=1.5, outperforming the 13.1% ECE of the log-probability baseline. Free-form numeric self-report performs worst: on the 27B oracle, average confidence in wrong answers (98.9%) is higher than in correct answers (97.6%). Steered-specific methods such as MCMC acceptance ratio underperform, as the conditional distribution of steered outputs is sharply peaked at the greedy answer, making it unable to distinguish correct and wrong outputs, with AUROC only between 0.53 and 0.60.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 for calibration performance comparisons and Section 4 for failure mode analysis of different UQ methods. Expected reading time is 15–20 minutes. No deep dive into activation oracle training details is required; focus on the method selection conclusions and unique calibration properties of steered models.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和校准表即可；它改变的是“解释器输出能否直接信任”的 prior，适合纳入内部 interp 工具评估。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration tables; it updates the prior on trusting interpreter outputs and fits internal interp-tool evaluation.

paper.title: MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to gene

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否把 mechanistic interpretability 里高度依赖人工设计和单任务分析的 circuit discovery，改写成一个可学习、可迁移的强化学习问题。具体地说，作者希望训练一个策略，在冻结的 GPT-2 small 上通过逐步选择并消融 attention head，自动找出对某个行为最关键、但对一般语言建模损伤较小的头部子集。难点不在“做 ablation”，而在于如何定义一个足够稳定的奖励，让 agent 学到任务特异电路，而不是只学会破坏模型最脆弱的通用头。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏机制分析与自动化解释工具，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它把 circuit discovery 从离线打分问题变成 sequential decision problem，说明解释工作也可以有可迁移策略，而不必每个任务重做一套 pipeline。第二，文中设计的 contrastive reward 很有意思：用目标任务损伤减去自然文本上的一般语言建模损伤，试图分离 task-specific heads 和 general-purpose heads。这个想法对训练信号设计有参考价值，尤其是在想从“有害但不专属”的因果因素里剥离出“真正任务相关”的因素时。若从 LLM 基座研究角度看，它更像是 mechanistic interpretability 的方法论文，而不是 pretrain recipe 论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把 GPT-2 small 的 144 个 attention heads 视为离散动作空间。每一步动作就是选择一个 head，在 hook_z 位置把该 head 输出置零，观察该消融对任务指标和控制指标的影响。环境是一个标准 Gymnasium MDP，episode 最多 50 步，且同一 episode 内不能重复选择同一 head。训练任务只有两个：induction 和 IOI。每次 reset 时随机采样任务并重新生成 batch，避免策略记住固定 head 排名。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分。对目标任务，使用 ablation 前后 logit difference 的下降作为损伤；对控制任务，使用自然英文文本上的 cross-entropy 上升作为一般语言建模损伤；最终 reward 是两者的差。这样，若某个 head 对所有任务都重要，消融它会同时伤害目标任务和一般文本，净奖励不会太高；若某个 head 主要服务于当前任务，reward 才会显著为正。观测包括三部分：当前任务 one-hot、已尝试 head 的 mask、已尝试 head 的归一化 reward 向量。后两者让策略能在单个 episode 内根据已获得反馈调整后续搜索。策略网络是一个小型 actor-critic MLP，输入 290 维，经过两层 256 隐层，输出 144 维动作分布和价值头。训练用 PPO，8 个并行环境，共 2e5 环境步。作者还加了一个 best-of-K 决策包装：策略先采样 K 个候选动作，环境并行评估后选 reward 最高者执行。K=1 是普通 PPO，K=5 则相当于给策略加了轻量规划/重采样。泛化测试使用训练中未见过的 docstring completion 任务，检查策略是否学到了可迁移的结构先验，而不是只记住 induction/IOI 的局部模式。
summary.experiments: 实验核心结论是：一个在 induction 和 IOI 上训练的 PPO 策略，能够在训练任务上接近每个 episode 的 oracle 选头表现，并在未见过的 docstring completion 上也有不错的迁移。摘要提到其偏好的 heads 与已有人工或半自动分析得到的已知电路有重合，这说明策略学到的不是纯噪声启发式。全文给出的关键设置包括：模型是 GPT-2 small，动作空间 144，episode 长度 50，8 个并行环境，训练总步数 2×10^5；best-of-K 评估报告 K∈{1,5}。从方法设计看，最重要的实验应包括四类：一是训练曲线，比较单环境 PPO 崩塌与多环境 PPO 稳定训练；二是 reward 设计消融，验证若去掉 control cross-entropy 项，策略会偏向通用脆弱头而不是任务电路；三是与 oracle、随机、可能还有简单贪心基线的比较；四是 held-out docstring 迁移。提供的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体百分比，因此不应虚构数值。但可以明确的是，作者把“泛化到未见任务”作为主要卖点，而不是只在单任务上复现已知头部。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读方法和实验，不必深究 RL 细节。先看 Introduction，明确它要替代的是 ACDC、EAP 这类单任务电路发现流程。然后直接看 Method 里的 reward 定义，这是整篇最有信息量的地方；如果 reward 不成立，后面的 PPO 只是实现细节。接着看 observation 设计和 best-of-K 包装，理解作者为什么把问题做成 sequential search，而不是一次性给 144 个头打分。实验部分优先看三类图表：reward 消融、训练任务与 held-out 任务上的 oracle gap、以及被选 heads 与已知 induction/IOI 电路的重合情况。若只想判断是否值得继续跟，可以用 20-30 分钟读完方法和主要结果。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 contrastive reward 是否真的隔离了 task-specific computation，还是只是偏好“对控制集伤害较小”的头；二是动作空间目前只覆盖 attention heads，若扩展到 MLP、residual stream 或 path-level intervention，RL 是否仍然可扩展。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether circuit discovery in mechanistic interpretability can be turned from a bespoke, task-by-task analysis pipeline into a learnable reinforcement-learning problem. Concretely, the goal is to train an agent that interacts with a frozen GPT-2 small by ablating attention heads one at a time and identifying heads that are causally important for a target behavior while being relatively unimportant for general language modeling. The hard part is not ablation itself, but reward design: the agent must discover task-specific circuitry rather than simply attack globally fragile heads.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, so skim is the right level. Still, it has two useful ideas. First, it reframes circuit discovery as a sequential decision problem, suggesting that interpretability procedures may admit transferable policies rather than requiring a fresh handcrafted pipeline for every task. Second, the contrastive reward is the main contribution: damage on the target task is offset by damage on a natural-text control objective, which is an attempt to separate task-specific heads from general-purpose heads. That reward construction is relevant beyond interpretability because it is a concrete example of how to isolate a specialized causal signal from a broader capability signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment is built on frozen GPT-2 small with 12 layers and 12 heads per layer, giving 144 discrete actions. Each action selects one attention head and zero-ablates its output at hook_z. Episodes last up to 50 steps, and repeated selection of the same head within an episode is masked out. Training uses two tasks only, induction and IOI. At every reset, the environment samples one of these tasks and regenerates a fresh batch, so the policy cannot simply memorize a fixed ranking of heads. The reward is the key design choice. For the target task, the paper measures the drop in a task-specific logit-difference metric after ablation. For a control batch of natural English text from WikiText, it measures the increase in cross-entropy. The final reward is the difference between these two effects. Heads that are broadly useful to the model should hurt both the target task and ordinary language modeling, yielding a smaller net reward; heads that are disproportionately important for the target task should receive larger positive reward. The observation includes a one-hot task indicator, a binary mask of previously tried heads, and a vector of normalized rewards for heads already tested in the current episode. This lets the policy adapt its search online within an episode. The policy itself is a small feedforward actor-critic trained with PPO over 8 parallel environments for 2e5 environment steps. At inference time, the authors also add a best-of-K wrapper: the policy samples K candidate actions, the environment scores them in parallel, and the highest-reward action is executed. Generalization is tested on a held-out docstring-completion task never seen during training.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical claim is that a single PPO policy trained on induction and IOI can approach per-episode oracle performance on those tasks and also transfer to an unseen docstring-completion task. The abstract further states that the heads preferred by the learned policy overlap with known circuits identified by prior manual or semi-automated analyses, which is important because it suggests the policy is not merely exploiting noise. The key experimental setup is explicit: GPT-2 small, 144 actions, episode length 50, 8 parallel environments, 2×10^5 total environment steps, and evaluation with K in {1,5}. The most informative experiments are likely the reward ablations, comparisons against oracle and random baselines, training stability with vectorized PPO versus the collapsed single-environment variant, and transfer to the held-out docstring task. The provided text fragment does not include the full result tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. The important point is that the paper is trying to demonstrate policy-level generalization in circuit discovery, not just recovery of known heads on one benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a methods paper with a focused empirical demonstration. Start with the introduction to place it relative to ACDC and EAP, then go straight to the reward definition in the method section. If the contrastive reward is not convincing, the PPO machinery is secondary. After that, read the observation design and the best-of-K decision wrapper to understand why the authors formulate the problem as sequential search rather than one-shot head scoring. In the experiments, prioritize reward ablations, the gap to oracle on train and held-out tasks, and the overlap between selected heads and known induction/IOI circuits. A 20-30 minute pass is enough to decide whether the idea is worth following. The main questions worth probing are whether the control-text subtraction truly isolates task-specific computation, and whether the approach would remain tractable if extended beyond attention heads to MLPs, residual stream components, or path-level interventions.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法和 reward 设计；结论还停在 GPT-2 small 头级搜索，但自动化 circuit discovery 的 setup 比单篇案例分析更可复用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and reward design; the evidence is still GPT-2-small head search, but the automated circuit-discovery setup is more reusable than another hand-built case study.

paper.title: Continuous-Depth Field Theory for Transformer Patching and Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability often uses activation patching, causal tracing, path patching, and steering directions to reveal behaviorally meaningful directions in Transformer activation space. This paper develops a field-theoretic framework for organizing and predicting such interventions. Treating the residual stream as a depth-token field, we formulate patching as localized source insertion, patch effects as sensitivity-field predictions, downstream propagation as empirical Green-function res

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图为 Transformer 中的 activation patching、causal tracing、path patching 和 steering direction 提供一个统一的响应理论框架，把局部激活干预的效果表示为 residual stream 上的敏感度场和传播算子。
