summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值主要在机制分析工具层面。预训练模型的行为通常由层、token、head、残差子空间共同决定，逐点枚举 patching 成本高，也难以形成可迁移的结构描述。该工作把 residual stream 视为 depth-token field，把 patching 视为局部 source insertion，用 linear response、Green function 和 adjoint inverse problem 组织干预结果。它不直接改进训练，但有助于把 mechanistic interpretability 从经验枚举推进到可预测、可组合的响应估计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 Transformer 的 residual stream 记为深度 t 和 token 位置 x 上的场 R(t,x)。对 residual activation 的局部干预被写成 source J(t,x)。在局部线性区域内，某个输出 observable，例如 logit difference，对干预的一阶变化由 sensitivity field a(t,x) 预测；扰动从一个 depth-token site 向后续层和位置传播，则由经验 Green-response operator G 描述。这样，patching 不只是测量单个干预效果，也可以被写成一个受约束的逆问题：给定期望的 residual displacement 或行为变化，求一个稀疏、受约束的 source J，使其经 G 传播后产生目标响应。作者还讨论了 adjoint variational formulation，用来推断 patch site 和 residual direction。与常规 activation patching 的区别在于，它试图估计一组响应算子来预测一族干预，而不是逐层逐 token 枚举。
summary.experiments: 实验在 GPT-2-style 自回归 Transformer 上进行，主要验证局部线性响应是否可用。作者测量 localized residual-field interventions 对 residual-field difference 和 logit-difference 的影响。结果显示，小扰动存在有界的局部线性区间；一阶敏感度可以预测许多 patch effect；局部干预会产生结构化且各向异性的残差传播；传播在深度上呈现近似 composition；高敏感度 site 和 sliced Green operators 能给出较低维的响应描述；prompt-induced residual displacement 在部分情况下能迁移答案行为。实验更像是框架验证，而不是大规模模型结论。需要注意，线性近似的边界、非线性饱和、跨模型尺度迁移仍是开放问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 residual stream as depth-token field 的定义，以及 localized source、sensitivity field、Green-response operator 三个对象的关系。方法部分重点看 patch-site inference 如何被写成 constrained inverse problem，这比连续场符号本身更有信息量。实验部分看 local linearity、superposition、sensitivity prediction 和 sliced Green operators 的图表即可。对预训练研究者，重点不是场论形式，而是它能否把 patching 从单点诊断变成可复用的响应测量；如果只关心训练 recipe，可以低优先级阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a unified response-theoretic framework for activation patching, causal tracing, path patching, and steering in Transformers. It asks whether local interventions in the residual stream can be organized and predicted through sensitivity fields and propagation operators over depth and token position.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly in mechanistic interpretability. Pretrained Transformer behavior is distributed across layers, tokens, heads, and residual subspaces; exhaustive patch enumeration is expensive and often hard to generalize. This work represents the residual stream as a depth-token field and formulates patching as localized source insertion. Linear response, empirical Green functions, and adjoint inverse problems provide a more structured way to describe and predict interventions. It is not a training method, but it may help build better diagnostic tools for pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The residual stream is treated as a field R(t,x), where t indexes depth and x indexes token position. A localized activation intervention is written as a source J(t,x). In a local linear regime, the first-order effect on an observable, such as a logit difference, is predicted by a sensitivity field a(t,x). The downstream propagation of a perturbation is described by an empirical Green-response operator G, which maps an injected perturbation at one depth-token site to residual or behavioral changes downstream. Patch selection is then formulated as a constrained inverse problem: given a desired residual displacement or behavioral shift, infer a sparse admissible source J whose propagated response matches the target. The adjoint variational view provides a route to infer patch sites and residual directions. This differs from standard patching by estimating reusable response quantities instead of measuring each intervention independently.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical tests use GPT-2-style autoregressive Transformers. The paper applies localized residual-field interventions and measures induced residual-field differences and logit-difference changes. The reported findings support a bounded local linear regime for small perturbations, approximate superposition, first-order sensitivity predictions of patch effects, structured anisotropic residual propagation, approximate composition across depth, and tractable lower-dimensional descriptions through high-sensitivity sites and sliced Green operators. Prompt-induced residual displacements partially transfer answer behavior. These are best read as first-pass validation of the response framework rather than evidence for large-scale model behavior. The main limitations are the locality of the linear approximation, nonlinear failure modes, and the still-speculative nature of cross-model response transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Start with the definitions of the residual stream as a depth-token field and the mapping from patching to localized source insertion. Then focus on the roles of the sensitivity field and empirical Green-response operator. The most useful technical part is the constrained inverse formulation for patch-site inference; the continuum notation is less important than the discrete response quantities measured in finite Transformers. In the experiments, prioritize local linearity, superposition, sensitivity prediction, and sliced Green operator results. For pretraining researchers, the main question is whether these response measurements can become reusable diagnostics for large pretrained models; if the goal is training recipe improvement, this can be read at lower priority.

recommendation.zh: 用场论视角统一 Transformer 的 activation patching 和信息流分析，理论框架很优美，对深入理解模型内部机制和可解释性研究有启发，建议阅读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Unifies activation patching and information flow analysis in Transformers using a field-theoretic perspective; the theoretical framework is elegant and inspiring for deep understanding of internal mechanisms and interpretability research. Recommend reading the methodology section.

paper.title: Is Inference Mediated by Distinct Semantic Structures in LLMs? A Mechanistic Interpretation
paper.abstract: Predicting a label correctly does not necessarily require representing the operation that produces it. Transformer representations are known to carry label-level information, but whether they encode semantic operations producing those labels is unclear. We investigate this in Natural Language Inference using controlled premise-hypothesis pairs that differ by a single semantic transformation. Using layer-wise activations, we estimate operation-level subspaces via SVD and test their causal relevan

summary.core_problem: LLM 做对 NLI 标签时，是否真的表示了产生该标签的语义操作，而不只是编码了标签相关特征。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析：把语义变换从标签预测中拆出来，用可解码性和激活干预同时检验操作级表示，对理解模型内部语义计算有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构造只相差一个语义变换的 premise-hypothesis 对，提取不同层激活；用 SVD 估计操作级子空间，再用 activation steering 测试这些方向是否因果影响输出；还做跨操作 steering，观察不同语义操作子空间之间的干扰。
summary.experiments: 在四个开源 decoder-only 模型上实验。语义变换效应可被以 84.8%-99% 准确率解码，并且相对随机子空间更显著；steering 能因果改变预测，但不同模型可操控性不同；跨操作干预显示子空间有重叠和结构化干扰。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Manchester、University of Sheffield、Idiap Research Institute 和 CRUK National Biomarker Centre。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLMs that predict NLI labels correctly encode the semantic operations that generate those labels, rather than merely label-correlated features.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It separates operation-level semantics from label prediction and combines decodability with causal activation steering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build controlled premise-hypothesis pairs differing by a single semantic transformation, extract layer-wise activations, estimate operation subspaces via SVD, and test causal relevance with activation steering. Cross-operation steering is used to study interference between semantic operations.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover four open-weight decoder models. Transformation effects are decodable with 84.8%-99% accuracy and outperform random-subspace baselines. Steering causally changes predictions, with model-dependent steerability, and cross-operation steering reveals overlapping subspaces and structured interference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Manchester, University of Sheffield, Idiap Research Institute, and CRUK National Biomarker Centre.

recommendation.zh: 价值在因果 steering 而非探针准确率；读 subspace 构造和跨操作干扰，能校准对语义表示的 prior。
recommendation.en: The useful part is causal steering, not probe accuracy; read the subspace construction and cross-operation interference.

institutions: CRUK National Biomarker Centre, University of Manchester

paper.title: Do Factual Recall Mechanisms Carry over from Text to Speech in Multimodal Language Models?
paper.abstract: In recent years, several Speech Language Models (SLMs) that represent speech and written text jointly have been presented. The question then emerges about how model-internal mechanisms are similar and different when operating in the two modalities. We focus on how these systems encode, store, and retrieve factual knowledge, which has previously been investigated for text-only models. To investigate mechanisms behind the storage and recall of factual association in SLMs, we leverage Causal Mediat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是一个很具体但重要的问题：文本 LLM 中已经较清楚的“事实回忆”内部机制，到了语音输入的多模态语言模型里，是否还以相同方式存在。作者不是看最终答对率，而是看事实关联在模型内部哪里被编码、哪里被传递、哪些层和位置对正确答案最有因果作用。对象是 SpiritLM 这类把离散语音 token 与文本 token 统一送入 Llama2 骨干的模型，因此问题可以进一步拆成两层：一是语音输入能否触发与文本输入相似的 factual recall 回路；二是这种能力来自语音侧独立学到的机制，还是主要借用了文本骨干里已有的知识回忆结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于提出新训练方法，而在于给“统一 token 空间是否真的统一了知识机制”这个问题提供了机制层证据。结论偏克制：speech-to-text 下确实能观察到事实定位信号，但明显弱于 text-to-text，而且局部化程度更差。这说明把语音离散化后接到文本骨干上，并不自动意味着两种模态共享了同等强度的知识检索机制。对做语音 LM、语音-文本统一预训练、跨模态 tokenizer 和 alignment 的人，这个结果有直接启发：如果目标是让语音输入也能稳定调用参数知识，光靠离散 token 接口和联合训练可能不够，训练目标、模态桥接层和数据配比都可能是瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者把文本模型里常用的 Causal Mediation Analysis / Causal Tracing 扩展到多模态设置。具体做法沿用 activation patching 范式：先对干净输入跑一次，缓存各层隐藏状态；再对被破坏的输入跑一次，观察目标答案概率下降；最后在破坏输入的前提下，把某一层某一位置的激活替换成干净运行中的值，测量答案概率恢复了多少，用 Indirect Effect 量化该组件对事实回忆的因果贡献。这里的关键不是公式，而是如何把这套分析搬到语音输入上。

模型方面，SpiritLM 采用离散语音 token 与文本 token 的交错序列建模。语音由 HuBERT 离散化，文本用 Llama2 tokenizer，并用模态声明 token 区分当前段落是 speech 还是 text。作者因此可以像分析文本 token 一样分析语音 token 对后续文本答案生成的影响。

数据方面，他们从 Meng 等人的 Known facts 数据集出发，为 prompt、subject、object 构造语音版本。语音由 MeloTTS 合成，再用人工检查和 Whisper-small 转写做质量核验。文中给出的 prompt 转写 WER 约为 19%，说明语音样本可用，但也留下一个需要记住的解释变量：speech 侧机制变弱，部分可能来自 TTS/ASR 误差和离散化损失，而不全是模型内部没有形成对应回路。

实验设计主要比较两种设置：T→T，即文本输入文本输出；S→T，即语音输入文本输出。作者考察不同层、不同 token 位置、不同组件上的 Average Indirect Effect，试图复现文本 LLM 中常见的“中层 MLP 存储事实关联”的现象，并检查这种现象在 speech 输入下是否仍然成立。全文传达出的核心发现是：T→T 下能看到更清晰、更集中的事实恢复热点；S→T 下也有可检测信号，但更弱、更分散，说明语音输入到参数知识的映射并不如文本路径直接。
summary.experiments:
从全文可提炼的实验信息主要有四点。

第一，数据构造规模沿用 Known 数据集，接近 1000 条 factual prompts，并为每条样本补齐语音版本。这使得分析对象是“模型已知事实”的受控集合，而不是开放域问答混合噪声。

第二，语音数据质量做了额外校验。作者用 Whisper-small 对合成 prompt 转写，报告 WER 为 19%。这个数字不算低，但足以支持机制分析；同时它也提醒读者，speech-to-text 的因果效应偏弱时，不能把原因全部归结为模型知识机制缺失。

第三，核心结果是机制差异而不是任务分数差异。T→T 条件下，事实回忆的因果贡献更容易定位，和既有文本 LLM 研究一致，重要信号更集中在特定层段与组件；S→T 条件下，作者观察到“weaker but detectable traces of factual localization”，也就是存在局部可恢复的事实信号，但幅度更小、稳定性更差，说明文本中的 factual recall 机制只发生了部分迁移。

第四，这篇文章的价值主要来自负结果式发现：统一骨干并没有让 speech 输入天然继承 text 输入的全部知识调用路径。若从预训练角度解读，这意味着 speech tokenization、跨模态对齐方式、以及 speech-text 混合训练目标，都会影响参数知识能否被语音侧有效访问。

由于给出的全文片段没有完整表格和全部数值，能确定的硬数字主要是数据规模约 1000 和语音 prompt 的 19% WER；其余结果更适合按机制趋势理解，而不是记单点分数。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议按“新方法论文”去读，重点是它怎样把文本 mechanistic interpretability 工具迁到语音-文本统一模型上。

建议先看 Introduction，明确问题边界：作者研究的是 factual recall mechanism，而不是语音识别性能。然后看 Methodology 里 CMA / causal tracing 的三步流程，尤其是 clean run、corrupted run、patched run 三者的关系，以及 Indirect Effect / Average Indirect Effect 的定义。这里读懂后，后面的图基本都能自己解释。

接着重点看 SpiritLM 的输入表示方式和数据构造部分。要注意 HuBERT 离散语音 token、模态声明 token、以及 TTS 合成数据的质量控制，因为这些决定了实验结论能否外推到其他 speech LM。最后看结果图时，不要只问“哪一层最高”，更该问“speech 条件下热点是否更分散、是否从中层 MLP 转向更依赖输入邻近位置、是否说明跨模态映射仍是瓶颈”。

如果时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线。若想深挖，值得进一步思考两件事：一是若换成原生语音预训练而非 LLM-backbone speech model，结论会不会更弱；二是若加入更强的 speech-text alignment 或共享语义 tokenizer，factual localization 是否会更接近文本路径。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: do the factual recall mechanisms identified in text-only LLMs transfer to speech-conditioned multimodal language models? The focus is not end-task accuracy, but the internal causal pathway of factual retrieval: where factual associations are stored, which layers mediate them, and whether speech inputs can trigger the same retrieval circuitry as text inputs. Using SpiritLM, which feeds discrete speech tokens and text tokens into a Llama2 backbone, the paper further separates two possibilities: speech may develop its own factual localization mechanism, or it may only weakly reuse the text-side mechanism already present in the backbone.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The main result is restrained but useful: speech-to-text inference shows detectable factual localization, yet it is weaker and less sharply localized than text-to-text inference. That matters for unified multimodal pretraining because it suggests that sharing a token space and a backbone does not automatically imply shared knowledge-retrieval behavior. For speech LM, speech-text joint pretraining, and multimodal tokenization work, this is a concrete warning: discrete speech tokens plus interleaved training may be enough for interface-level unification, but not enough for speech inputs to access parametric knowledge as reliably as text inputs do.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper extends causal mediation analysis, specifically causal tracing / activation patching, from text-only factual recall studies to a multimodal setting. The procedure follows the standard three-run setup. First, run the model on a clean prompt and cache hidden states. Second, corrupt the input and measure the drop in probability assigned to the correct object token. Third, rerun the corrupted input while restoring one selected activation from the clean run, and measure how much the correct answer probability recovers. This recovery defines the indirect effect of that component, and averaging across prompts yields AIE maps over layers, positions, and components.

The key adaptation is to make this work for speech-conditioned prompting. SpiritLM is well suited for that because it represents speech as discrete HuBERT tokens, text with the Llama2 tokenizer, and uses modality declaration tokens to interleave both streams in one autoregressive backbone. That makes speech tokens analyzable in the same intervention framework used for text tokens.

For data, the authors start from the Known dataset of factual prompts used in prior factual localization work and create speech counterparts for prompts, subjects, and objects. Audio is synthesized with MeloTTS, then checked through manual inspection and Whisper-small transcription. The reported prompt WER is about 19%, which is good enough to support the analysis but also important for interpretation: weaker speech-side localization may partly reflect synthesis / transcription / discretization noise, not only missing internal mechanisms.

The main comparison is between T→T and S→T. The paper examines whether the familiar text-LM pattern, where factual associations are often mediated by mid-layer MLP states, reappears under speech input. The answer is only partially yes. Text input produces clearer and stronger restoration hotspots, while speech input yields weaker and more diffuse causal traces, suggesting that the mapping from speech tokens to parametric factual knowledge is less direct.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is more about mechanism patterns than benchmark scores.

First, the study uses roughly 1,000 factual prompts from the Known dataset and augments them with speech versions. This keeps the analysis focused on controlled factual associations rather than open-domain QA noise.

Second, the speech data quality is explicitly checked. Whisper-small transcription of synthesized prompts gives a 19% WER. That number is not negligible, and it should be kept in mind when interpreting weaker S→T effects.

Third, the central result is that T→T reproduces clearer factual localization, consistent with prior text-only work, whereas S→T shows weaker but still detectable traces. In other words, factual recall mechanisms do carry over, but only partially. The signal is less concentrated and less robust under speech input.

Fourth, the paper is useful partly because of what it does not find. A unified backbone does not guarantee that speech inputs inherit the full factual retrieval pathway available to text inputs. From a pretraining perspective, this points to possible bottlenecks in speech tokenization, cross-modal alignment, and the objective used to mix speech and text during training.

The full text provided here does not include all tables and exact effect magnitudes, so the hard numbers that can be stated confidently are mainly the dataset size scale and the 19% WER. The rest is best read as a qualitative mechanistic pattern rather than a leaderboard-style result.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read it as a mechanistic probe of multimodal pretraining, not as a new training recipe.

Start with the introduction to fix the scope: the target is factual recall mechanisms, not speech recognition quality. Then read the methodology carefully, especially the clean / corrupted / patched runs and the definition of indirect effect. Once that is clear, the result figures become much easier to interpret.

Pay close attention to the SpiritLM input format and the speech data construction pipeline. HuBERT discretization, modality tokens, and TTS-generated prompts are not implementation details here; they shape what the conclusions actually mean. When reading the result plots, the right question is not only which layer peaks, but whether speech causes the signal to become weaker, more diffuse, or shifted away from the canonical mid-layer factual pathway seen in text LMs.

About 30 to 40 minutes is enough for the main idea. If you want to go deeper, the natural follow-up questions are whether native speech-pretrained models would show even weaker localization, and whether stronger speech-text alignment or shared semantic tokenization could make speech-side factual recall look more like the text pathway.

recommendation.zh: 如果你把语音 token 当“另一种文本”来训，这篇会提醒你这个 prior 过于乐观；先看方法设定和 text-vs-speech 的 mediation 差异，足够决定后续是否复现。
recommendation.en: If you treat speech tokens as just another text stream, this paper is a useful correction; read the mediation setup and the text-vs-speech gap before deciding whether to replicate.

paper.title: From Correlation to Cause: A Five-Stage Methodology for Feature Analysis in Transformer Language Models
paper.abstract: We propose a five-stage methodology for causal feature analysis in transformer language models (probe design, feature extraction, causal validation, robustness testing, and deployment integration) and demonstrate it end-to-end on GPT-2 small performing the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task. Activation patching recovers the canonical IOI circuit (layer-9 head 9 alone gives recovery +1.02). A sparse autoencoder recovers per-name selective features with effect sizes of 30 to 50 activation u

summary.core_problem: 如何把“激活/特征与行为相关”推进到“特征对行为有因果作用”的可复用流程：在 Transformer LM 里，探针、SAE 特征、activation patching、消融/干预各自都有已知失效模式，单点方法很容易得出过度自信的解释。论文要解决的是：给出一套端到端的方法学，把相关性证据、可读的特征、因果验证、稳健性与部署决策连接起来，并在一个有相对明确机制参照的任务（GPT-2 small 上的 IOI）上跑通。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在“训练 recipe”，而在“理解与治理预训练模型内部表征”的方法学：它把 mechanistic interpretability 常用工具组织成可审计的流水线，并强调一个更贴近真实大模型的因果区间——很多看起来很强的特征是“部分因果（causal but not necessary）”，选择性强不等于对输出最关键。这类结论会影响后续做数据/训练干预时的归因方式：不要把 SAE 的“单语义特征”直接当作可控旋钮，而要用因果验证与稳健性测试校准。
summary.technical_approach:
五阶段流程：
1) Probe design：先把要找的机制/特征、判定标准、以及“相关 vs 因果”的证据门槛写清楚，避免事后挑选。
2) Feature extraction：用稀疏自编码器（SAE）等把激活分解成候选特征；论文也讨论了 NLA（Natural Language Autoencoder）路线，并借用其评估概念（fidelity/可靠性分层）。
3) Causal validation：用干预验证候选是否被下游读取。IOI 上用 activation patching/causal tracing 复现经典 IOI circuit，并对 SAE 特征做定向干预/消融，区分“能影响输出”与“只是可分离地编码了信息”。
4) Robustness testing：在分布变化、改写、微调等条件下检查结论是否稳定，避免只在单一提示模板上成立。
5) Deployment integration：把解释结果转成可操作的部署决策（阈值、配置选择、预期成本），用一个带显式 FP/FN 成本的客服草拟场景做示例，强调解释工具需要与治理/监控层组合并量化收益。
核心观察是：模型里大量特征处在“中间因果态”——选择性很强、相关性很高，但对最终 logit 的必要性有限；因此需要把 patching（定位信息流）与 SAE（给出可读特征）再加上干预（验证下游是否使用）串起来。
summary.experiments:
主要在 GPT-2 small + IOI：
- Activation patching 阶段复现 IOI 经典电路；文中给出 layer 9 head 9 单头即可实现约 +1.02 的 single-head causal recovery（以其定义的恢复指标计）。
- SAE 阶段得到“按名字选择性激活”的特征，报告的激活效应量很大（约 30–50 activation units 量级）。
- 因果验证显示这些特征“有因果性但非必要”：消融带来约 0.7 的 logit 降幅（文中表述为与目标方向一致的 -logit reduction），但不足以解释全部行为。
- 论文还把 NLA 的 fidelity（方差解释比例）与 reliability stratification（哪些解释更可能对应因果内容）框架迁移到 SAE 特征评估上，用来说明“高重构/高选择性”与“高因果贡献”并不总一致。
（注：给定你提供的全文片段不完整，稳健性/部署集成部分的具体数表与更多消融细节无法逐项复述；但论文主线实验围绕 IOI 电路复现 + SAE 特征提取 + 干预验证展开。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看方法学总览与每阶段的失败模式清单：它决定了这篇文章的“可迁移价值”。
- IOI 复现部分重点看 activation patching 的定位结果（尤其是单头恢复的定义与度量），再看 SAE 特征的选择性展示与干预设置。
- 重点盯住“causal but not necessary”的证据链：相关性指标、干预幅度、以及为何不足以构成必要条件。
- 如果关心把 interpretability 接到工程决策，直接看 deployment integration 如何把阈值/成本函数写成可计算的选择问题（即使成本是假设的，也能学到接口形式）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn “features correlate with behavior” into a disciplined, end-to-end workflow that supports causal claims about internal representations in Transformer LMs. Individual tools—probes, SAEs, activation patching, ablations—each have known failure modes, and using any single one often leads to overconfident stories. The paper aims to compose these tools into a reusable methodology and demonstrate it on a pretrained model (GPT-2 small) and a task with a relatively well-studied mechanism (IOI).
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-recipe paper; its value to foundation-model researchers is methodological: it operationalizes mechanistic interpretability as a pipeline with explicit evidence thresholds, robustness checks, and a path to deployment decisions. A key empirical message is that real LMs often sit in an intermediate causal regime: highly selective or highly correlated features can be only partially causal, and “monosemantic-looking” SAE features are not automatically reliable control knobs. That affects how one should attribute effects when doing data/training interventions or safety monitoring on pretrained models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A five-stage methodology:
1) Probe design: pre-register what is being searched for and what would count as detection vs mere correlation.
2) Feature extraction: decompose activations into candidate features (primarily via sparse autoencoders; the paper also discusses Natural Language Autoencoders and borrows their evaluation notions).
3) Causal validation: intervene to test whether candidates have causal force (and whether downstream computation actually reads them).
4) Robustness testing: stress-test under distribution shift, paraphrases, and fine-tuning.
5) Deployment integration: translate interpretability outputs into operational choices (thresholds/configs) under explicit cost assumptions.
On IOI, activation patching is used to localize the canonical circuit, while SAEs provide interpretable candidate features; targeted interventions/ablations then separate “encodes information” from “is used causally.”
summary_en.experiments:
On GPT-2 small + IOI:
- Activation patching recovers the canonical IOI circuit; the paper reports that layer-9 head-9 alone achieves about +1.02 single-head causal recovery under their metric.
- SAE extraction yields name-selective features with very large activation effect sizes (~30–50 activation units).
- Causal validation suggests these features are causal but not necessary: ablation yields roughly a 0.7 logit reduction aligned with the target direction, but does not fully account for behavior.
- The paper adapts NLA-style evaluation (fidelity as variance explained; reliability stratification linking explanation types to causal content) to analyze SAE features, highlighting mismatches between reconstruction/selectivity and causal impact.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt is incomplete, so additional robustness/deployment quantitative tables cannot be exhaustively enumerated here.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
- Read the five-stage blueprint and the failure-mode discussion first; that’s the transferable part.
- In the IOI section, focus on (a) how causal recovery is defined/measured in activation patching, and (b) how SAE features are selected and then intervened upon.
- Track the evidence chain behind “causal but not necessary”: correlation metrics vs intervention magnitudes vs necessity claims.
- If you care about production interfaces, jump to the deployment-integration section to see how interpretability signals are converted into thresholding and expected-cost calculations.

recommendation.zh: 结论比方法更值得看：它提醒你别把 SAE 的“可解释”误当“因果”；读结果段和消融表就够，setup 仍偏小玩具。
recommendation.en: The takeaway matters more than the framework: do not confuse SAE interpretability with causality; read the ablation tables and results, but treat it as a small-scale toy setup.

paper.title: Geometry-Adaptive Explainer for Faithful Dictionary-Based Interpretability under Distribution Shift
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to explain a model's behavior by identifying causally responsible internal structures. Dictionary-based explainers such as sparse autoencoders and transcoders are a primary tool, but their faithfulness under out-of-distribution (OOD) shift has received little systematic attention. We show that distribution shift rotates the subspace that the model actively uses, misaligning the explainer's dictionary trained on in-distribution (ID) activations. We formalize this

summary.core_problem: 基于稀疏自编码器等字典的可解释性工具，在分布偏移下与模型OOD激活子空间错位，导致解释忠实度大幅下降
summary.importance: 原理分析+方法创新，首次形式化分布偏移下字典解释的忠实度gap，提出无需梯度的轻量适配方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出几何自适应解释器（GAE），仅用无标注OOD激活数据，在保留原有特征结构的前提下将ID训练的字典重新对齐到OOD激活子空间
summary.experiments: 理论证明GAE优于未适配的ID解释器，实验验证其可显著降低OOD下的解释忠实度损失
summary.authors_note: 合作机构包括哈佛大学

summary_en.core_problem: Dictionary-based interpretability tools such as sparse autoencoders misalign with model OOD activation subspace under distribution shift, leading to significant drop in explanation faithfulness
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis + methodological innovation, first formalizes the faithfulness gap of dictionary explanation under distribution shift, proposes a gradient-free lightweight adaptation scheme
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Geometry-Adaptive Explainer (GAE), which only uses unlabeled OOD activations to realign ID-trained dictionary to OOD active subspace while preserving original feature structure
summary_en.experiments: Theoretically proves GAE outperforms unadapted ID explainers, experiments verify it significantly reduces explanation faithfulness loss under OOD
summary_en.authors_note: Collaborating institutions include Harvard University

recommendation.zh: 针对字典可解释性OOD失效给出轻量适配方案，仅作为可解释性方向文献备查，不用读正文
recommendation.en: Provides lightweight adaptation for OOD failure of dictionary-based interpretability, only for literature reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: MLLMs Know When Before Speaking: Revealing and Recovering Temporal Grounding via Attention Cues
paper.abstract: Video temporal grounding (VTG), which localizes the start and end times of a queried event in an untrimmed video, is a key test of whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) understand not only what happens but also when it happens. Although modern MLLMs describe video content fluently, their timestamp predictions remain unreliable, while existing remedies either require costly post-training on temporal annotations or rely on coarse training-free heuristics. In this work, we probe the cros

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么MLLM在视频时间定位任务上常常“看懂了但说不对”，并尝试在不额外时序标注训练的情况下恢复这种时间 grounding 能力。
summary.importance: 价值主要在机制分析：它把视频MLLM的失败拆成prefill阶段已形成时间定位信号、但在自回归生成阶段被冲掉的perception-generation gap。这类分析对理解多模态解码失真有启发，但离基座预训练仍有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者通过分析跨模态注意力，识别出在prefill阶段会把query-to-video注意力集中到真实时间区间的一小组Temporal Grounding Heads（TG-Heads）。随后指出在AR解码时，答案token会把注意力从该区间拉走，转向视觉显著但与时间无关的区域。方法上围绕这些attention cues做恢复，而不是依赖额外标注后训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模和具体基线，但核心实验是对比prefill与decoding阶段的注意力行为，并验证利用TG-Heads线索可以改善视频时间定位。更像诊断+轻量修复，而非通用训练范式改进。
summary.authors_note: 港科大与西安交大合作，偏多模态机制分析。

summary_en.core_problem: It investigates why MLLMs often appear to know the correct temporal interval in videos but fail to output reliable timestamps, and how to recover that ability without costly temporal supervision.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic: it frames the failure as a perception-generation gap, where temporal grounding exists during prefill but is lost during autoregressive decoding. This is useful for understanding multimodal decoding distortions, though still one step removed from core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: By probing cross-modal attention, the paper identifies a sparse set of Temporal Grounding Heads (TG-Heads) that focus query-to-video attention on the target interval during prefill. It then shows that answer-token decoding shifts attention away from that interval toward visually salient but temporally irrelevant regions, and uses these attention cues for recovery.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or exact baselines. The key experiments compare attention behavior between prefill and decoding, and show that exploiting TG-Head signals improves temporal grounding without extra temporal annotation training.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between HKUST and Xi’an Jiaotong University, positioned as multimodal mechanism analysis.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点像“模型知道但解码说坏了”的视频版证据；若你关心多模态生成失真，只看TG-Heads分析和prefill/decoding对比即可。
recommendation.en: This is basically a video-side instance of 'the model knows it before decoding corrupts it'; if you care about multimodal generation drift, just read the TG-Head analysis and the prefill-vs-decoding comparison.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Post-Hoc Understanding of Metaphor Processing in Decoder-Only Language Models via Conditional Scale Entropy
paper.abstract: Metaphor requires a language model to resolve a token whose contextual meaning diverges from its basic literal sense. Understanding how transformer models organize this reinterpretation across depth remains an open problem in mechanistic interpretability. We introduce conditional scale entropy (CSE), a wavelet-derived measure of how broadly transformer computation engages across frequency scales at each layer position. Two theorems establish that CSE is invariant to update magnitude, isolating t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 decoder-only Transformer 在处理隐喻 token 时，残差流跨层更新的组织方式是否不同于字面用法。核心不是提升模型能力，而是提出一个可测量的解释性指标：conditional scale entropy，简称 CSE。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对机制分析有一定参考价值。CSE 试图把残差轨迹的跨层结构与更新幅度分开，因此可以作为分析模型内部计算组织的一种工具。对基座研究员更有用的部分，不是隐喻任务本身，而是方法能否迁移到训练动态、能力形成、层间协同和表示重排的分析上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从目标 token 的 residual trajectory 出发，即从 embedding 到各层输出的一串隐藏状态。作者先构造 metaphor-literal minimal pairs，再把每层 residual update 投影到一个归一化的平均差异方向 v* 上。这样高维更新被转成按层索引的一维信号。随后对这个信号做连续小波变换，得到不同层位置、不同频率尺度上的能量分布，再定义 CSE 来衡量某一层附近的计算是否分散到更多尺度。论文给出两个理论性质：CSE 对更新幅度不敏感，主要反映尺度分布结构；并且可用 majorization 关系刻画尺度分布的有序性。这个设计的目的，是避免把“大更新”误认为“更复杂的跨层组织”。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个 decoder-only 架构，参数量从 124M 到 20B，包括 GPT-2 系列、LLaMA-2 7B 和 GPT-oss 系列。数据包括 25 组受控 minimal pairs，以及 200 组自然 VUA pairs。主要结果是：隐喻 token 在连续层位置上产生显著更高的 CSE，并通过 cluster-based permutation correction。作者还做了 specificity controls：当句子只在语义复杂度或句法复杂度上变化时，没有出现同样的 CSE 抬升；matched-meaning triples 显示该效应更接近表达方式的 figurative mode，而不只是命题内容。leave-one-out 检查表明，用剩余样本估计的 v* 对 held-out pair 仍有正确方向的分离。论文也指出，在比较过的频谱量中，CSE 是跨模型和跨刺激设置最稳定的指标。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–25 分钟。优先看方法部分：residual trajectory、mean-difference projection、CWT scalogram 和 CSE 定义。理论部分只需把握一个要点：CSE 试图消除更新幅度影响，关注跨层尺度结构。实验部分重点看 minimal-pair 设计、VUA 迁移、cluster permutation correction 和 specificity controls。若只关心预训练机制，可跳过大部分隐喻语言学背景，重点思考 CSE 是否可用于分析训练过程中某些能力出现时的层间协同变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether decoder-only Transformers organize their residual-stream computation differently when processing metaphorical token usages versus literal usages. The contribution is not a better language model, but a post-hoc interpretability measure called conditional scale entropy, or CSE.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pre-training practice is limited, but the method is relevant to mechanistic analysis. CSE is designed to separate the structure of layer-wise computation from the magnitude of residual updates. For foundation-model researchers, the useful idea is not the metaphor task itself, but the possibility of using scale-structured residual trajectories to analyze capability formation, layer coordination, or training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method treats the hidden states of a target token across layers as a residual trajectory. For metaphor-literal minimal pairs, the authors compute a normalized mean-difference direction v* from residual updates, then project each high-dimensional layer update onto that direction. This yields a one-dimensional signal indexed by depth. A continuous wavelet transform is then applied to obtain a scalogram over layer positions and frequency scales. CSE measures how broadly the computation at a given depth is distributed across scales. The theoretical claims are that CSE is invariant to update magnitude and ordered by majorization of the normalized scale distribution. This is meant to distinguish broad multi-layer reorganization from simply larger residual updates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five decoder-only architectures ranging from 124M to 20B parameters, including the GPT-2 family, LLaMA-2 7B, and GPT-oss models. The stimulus sets include 25 controlled minimal pairs and 200 naturalistic VUA pairs. The main empirical finding is that metaphorical tokens show significantly higher CSE over contiguous layer positions, with cluster-based permutation correction. Specificity controls show that the effect is not reproduced by literal sentences differing only in semantic or syntactic complexity. A matched-meaning triples experiment suggests that the signal tracks figurative mode of expression rather than propositional content alone. Leave-one-out tests indicate that the learned projection direction remains stable enough to separate held-out pairs. Among the spectral quantities tested, CSE is reported as the most stable across architectures and stimulus regimes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–25 minutes. Focus on the method: residual trajectories, mean-difference projection, continuous wavelet transform, and the CSE definition. The theoretical section is useful mainly for understanding why CSE is not just measuring update size. In the experiments, read the minimal-pair setup, VUA transfer, cluster-based permutation correction, and specificity controls. If the goal is pre-training analysis, most of the metaphor background can be skipped; the more transferable question is whether CSE can be used to track changes in layer coordination during training.

recommendation.zh: 提出的CSE指标可用于分析不同语义处理的层分布，重点看§3的指标定义和§4的跨模型实验结果
recommendation.en: The proposed CSE metric can be used to analyze layer distribution of different semantic processing, focus on §3 metric definition and §4 cross-model experimental results

paper.title: A Sharper Picture of Generalization in Transformers
paper.abstract: We study transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains from the perspective of the Fourier Spectra of their target functions. In contrast to prior work (Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger and Tewari, 2024), which derived generalization bounds from Rademacher complexity, we investigate the feasibility of obtaining generalization bounds via PAC-Bayes theory. We show that sparse spectra concentrated on low-degree components enable low-sharpness constructions with good generalization propertie

summary.core_problem: 解决Transformer在布尔域上的泛化行为缺乏严谨理论解释的问题，明确目标函数频谱特性、损失景观锐度与泛化性能之间的关联。
summary.importance: 为Transformer泛化机制提供了可验证的理论框架，可用于指导预训练流程设计，通过适配目标函数频谱特性调整训练策略或模型结构，提升模型泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 基于目标函数的傅里叶-沃尔什谱，证明只要频谱稀疏度不超过上下文长度，稀疏、低阶分量集中的谱即可构造低锐度的平坦极小值；结合Oracle PAC-Bayes界推导非空的泛化界，同时开展机制可解释性研究验证理论构造与真实Transformer行为的一致性。
summary.experiments: 实验使用2层1头、无层归一化的小Transformer，在由稀疏傅里叶-沃尔什展开生成的布尔域实值函数上训练，结果验证了泛化间隔随目标函数的谱阶数超线性增长，谱稀疏度越高，阶数增长带来的泛化间隔上升速率越快，与理论预测一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读推荐关注第1节核心理论框架、2.1节实证验证部分、图1的理论界与实证结果对比，以及附录A的泛化界实例化流程，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: To fill the gap of rigorous theoretical explanation for transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains, and clarify the correlation between target function spectral properties, loss landscape sharpness and generalization performance.
summary_en.importance: It provides a verifiable theoretical framework for transformer generalization mechanisms, which can guide pre-training recipe design to improve model generalization by adjusting training strategies or model architectures to match target function spectral properties.
summary_en.technical_approach: Based on the Fourier-Walsh spectra of target functions, it proves that boolean functions with spectra concentrated on sparse low-degree components can be implemented by low-sharpness flat minima as long as spectral sparsity is no larger than context length. It then derives a non-vacuous Oracle PAC-Bayes generalization bound for low-sharpness learners, and conducts mechanistic interpretability studies to verify the alignment between theoretical constructions and real transformer behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on 2-layer 1-head transformers without layer norm, trained on real-valued boolean domain functions generated from sparse Fourier-Walsh expansions. Results confirm that generalization gap grows super-linearly with spectral degree of target functions, and higher spectral sparsity accelerates this growth rate, which matches theoretical predictions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 for core theoretical framework, Section 2.1 for empirical validation, Figure 1 for comparison between theoretical bound and empirical results, and Appendix A for generalization bound instantiation procedure. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 泛化边界推导的傅里叶谱+PAC-Bayes新视角，做Transformer泛化机制研究看§3和§4.2即可
recommendation.en: New perspective of Fourier spectra + PAC-Bayes for generalization bound derivation, read §3 and §4.2 for Transformer generalization mechanism research

paper.title: From Circuit Evidence to Mechanistic Theory: An Inductive Logic Approach
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability produces circuit-level causal analyses of neural network behaviour, but discovered circuits often remain isolated experimental artefacts: there is no shared formal representation for what circuits compute, how they relate, or when two findings provide evidence for the same mechanism. This work provides a formal infrastructure for cumulative mechanistic science by treating circuit interpretation as inductive theory construction. Each circuit is characterised at two le

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是机制可解释性中的“发现难以积累”问题。现有 circuit analysis 能用 activation patching、attribution 等方法找出对行为有因果影响的稀疏子图，但这些发现通常停留在单个模型、单个任务和单套实验协议里。论文尝试给 circuit 发现建立一套形式化表示，使不同实验中的机制主张可以比较、细化、复用。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在机制分析的基础设施。它关心的是：当模型规模、任务、prompt split 变化时，某类机制是否仍然以可识别的结构存在。这个问题对研究 induction head、copy circuit、事实回忆 circuit、推理相关 circuit 的跨规模稳定性有参考价值。贡献量级偏方法框架，不是一个已经能直接改变预训练流程的结果；更适合作为机制研究中的表示语言和实验组织方式来读。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 circuit interpretation 表述为 inductive theory construction。每个 circuit 被编码成一个 logical identity，包含 Causal Functional Signature、architectural signature、ILP 学到的理论以及验证统计。CFS 描述 circuit “做什么”，用 token position 的因果归因证据和两级 role 标注来刻画：一层是跨任务共享的 linguistic role，另一层是任务内部的 task-specific role。architectural signature 描述 circuit “如何实现”，由 inductive logic programming 从结构谓词中学习得到，例如节点类型、层位置、边、相对规模、layer span、component ratio、motif，以及归一化 faithfulness。和普通图 kernel 或分类器不同，ILP 的目标不是只给 circuit 分类，而是产出可读、可比较、可被 θ-subsumption 检查的逻辑规则。这个取舍牺牲了一部分端到端拟合能力，换来机制主张的可检验性和可组合性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个任务、3 个模型，共 15 个初始 circuit，并扩展到每个模型 30 个 circuit，包含 10 个任务和 3 个 prompt split。论文报告 ILP architectural signature 在结构区分能力上相对 Weisfeiler-Lehman kernel 和 random forest baseline 有约 3–4 倍优势。方法还使用归一化 faithfulness 指标衡量 circuit 保留行为的程度：将 circuit 表现相对 ablation 和完整模型表现进行归一化。现有片段没有给出具体模型名称和每个任务的详细分数，因此实验结论应主要理解为“逻辑表示比通用图相似度更适合组织 circuit 证据”，而不是某个机制结论已经被充分证明。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 里对 MI fragmentation 的问题定义，以及 Methodology 中四层 ground facts 表示、CFS 和 τ_arch 的分工。值得细看的是 θ-subsumption 如何用于判断两个机制描述的包含、细化或冲突关系。实验部分重点看与 WL kernel、random forest 的对比，以及 prompt split 和跨模型 transfer 的失败案例；失败案例比平均分更能说明这种抽象会丢掉哪些机制细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a coherence problem in mechanistic interpretability. Circuit discovery methods can identify sparse causal subgraphs, but the resulting findings often remain tied to a particular model, task, dataset, and intervention protocol. The goal is to give circuit findings a formal representation so that mechanistic claims can be compared, refined, and reused across experiments.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to researchers who study training dynamics and emergent mechanisms. It provides a way to ask whether a mechanism found in one scale or task has a structurally and functionally related counterpart elsewhere. This matters for studying induction-style behavior, retrieval circuits, copying behavior, and reasoning-related components across model families. The impact is best viewed as an infrastructure proposal for cumulative mechanistic analysis rather than a result that immediately changes a training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method frames circuit interpretation as inductive theory construction. Each circuit is assigned a logical identity consisting of a Causal Functional Signature, an architectural signature, an ILP-learned theory, and validation statistics. The Causal Functional Signature describes what the circuit computes, grounding component behavior in causal attribution evidence over token positions and using two role levels: shared linguistic roles for cross-task comparison and task-specific roles for within-task structure. The architectural signature describes how the mechanism is realized structurally. It is learned with inductive logic programming over typed ground facts such as node type, layer, edge, component ratio, relative size, layer span, motifs, and normalized faithfulness. Unlike graph kernels or standard classifiers, the ILP representation is meant to produce explicit logical rules that support testing and θ-subsumption-based comparison.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation starts from 15 circuits across 5 tasks and 3 models, and scales to 30 circuits per model across 10 tasks and 3 prompt splits. The reported result is that ILP architectural signatures achieve roughly a 3–4x structural separation advantage over Weisfeiler-Lehman kernel and random-forest baselines. The framework also records normalized faithfulness, comparing the circuit’s task performance against ablated and full-model performance. The available text does not specify the exact model names or per-task scores, so the main empirical claim should be read as evidence that logical signatures are more useful than generic graph similarity for organizing circuit evidence, not as a definitive claim about any single mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation in the introduction, then read the methodology around the four-layer fact representation, the CFS/τ_arch split, and the use of θ-subsumption. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison with WL kernels and random forests, plus any transfer and prompt-split analyses. The most informative parts are likely the failure modes, because they show what information is lost when a circuit is abstracted into a portable logical signature.

recommendation.zh: mechanistic interpretability的形式化方法论有长期价值，ILP+因果功能签名的组合是新颖的跨尺度机制比较方案，建议看§3的CFS定义和§4的ILP学习部分
recommendation.en: Formal methodology for mechanistic interpretability with long-term value; the ILP+CFS approach for cross-scale mechanism comparison is novel; read §3 for CFS definition and §4 for ILP learning

institutions: CRUK National Biomarker Centre, University of Manchester

paper.title: Markovian Circuit Tracing for Transformer State Dynamic
paper.abstract: Many sequence computations are easier to study as movement through internal states than as isolated local circuits. We introduce Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT), a diagnostic pipeline for testing whether transformer activations contain coarse state-transition structure. The benchmark uses synthetic Hidden Markov Model (HMM) tasks where latent states, transition matrices, Bayesian belief vectors, Bayes-optimal predictions, and forced-state counterfactual targets are known exactly. Across six HMM

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 在序列建模中是否学到了可解释的粗粒度状态转移结构，而不只是局部电路或 token-level 统计。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析与诊断工具。它把 transformer 内部表征是否接近 Bayesian belief state 这个问题放到可控的 HMM 合成环境里测，适合做表征与状态空间解释的干净实验。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Markovian Circuit Tracing（MCT）诊断流程：先在已知潜状态、转移矩阵、Bayes 最优预测和反事实目标的 HMM 任务上训练小型因果 Transformer，再从残差流中抽取状态抽象，分析其是否编码 belief information、是否恢复转移信号，并通过 state forcing/activation patching 测试因果作用。
summary.experiments: 在 6 类 HMM family、每类 3 个随机种子上评测 tiny causal transformers。模型达到接近 Bayes 最优的 next-token 预测，平均 excess loss 为 0.0138。结果显示残差激活中含有部分 Bayesian belief 信息；在 persistent、低状态数设定下更容易恢复粗状态转移，在 ambiguous emission 和 6-state 设定下更弱。最强证据来自 state forcing：将中层残差 patch 到目标状态可系统性改变后续 token 分布。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether Transformers learn interpretable coarse state-transition structure in sequence modeling, rather than merely local circuits or token-level statistics.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic interpretability and diagnostic contribution. It studies whether internal representations approximate Bayesian belief states in a controlled HMM setting, which makes the measurement cleaner than typical natural-language analyses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Markovian Circuit Tracing (MCT): train tiny causal Transformers on synthetic HMM tasks where latent states, transition matrices, Bayes-optimal predictions, and counterfactual targets are exactly known; then extract state abstractions from residual activations, test whether they encode belief information, recover transition structure, and causally affect predictions via state forcing and activation patching.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on six HMM families with three seeds each. Tiny causal Transformers achieve near-Bayes next-token prediction with mean excess loss of 0.0138. Residual activations contain partial Bayesian belief information; coarse transition structure is easier to recover in persistent and low-state regimes, and weaker under ambiguous emissions and six-state settings. The strongest evidence comes from state forcing, where patching a residual state toward a target state systematically shifts future token distributions.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接改 pretrain recipe，但 setup 很干净；若你关心 LM 是否学成 belief-state machine，只看 state forcing 那部分就够了。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the setup is unusually clean; if you care whether LMs learn belief-state machines, read the state-forcing section and ignore the rest.

paper.title: Where Does Authorship Signal Emerge in Encoder-Based Language Models?
paper.abstract: Authorship attribution models fine-tuned with the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ four-fold in performance depending only on their scoring mechanism. We use mechanistic interpretability tools to explain this gap. Stylistic features such as word length, punctuation density, and function-word frequency are equally available at every layer in every model, including in an off-the-shelf control encoder, hence the gap not coming from representation quality. Instead, causal intervent

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体但很有代表性的问题：在同一个预训练 encoder、同一份数据、同一种对比学习损失下，为什么仅仅更换 scoring / pooling 机制，就会让 authorship attribution 的性能出现约四倍差距。作者要区分两种解释：一种是不同 scorer 让 encoder 学到了不同质量的内部表示；另一种是底层风格特征其实各层都有，差距主要来自 scorer 如何迫使这些特征在网络中被整合、并在何处变成对最终决策因果必要的信号。论文的结论偏向后者：特征可读性并不是瓶颈，真正决定性能的是 scorer 改变了梯度结构和训练动态，从而改变 authorship signal 在 encoder 中出现和巩固的层位。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但对做预训练和表征学习的人有明确启发。它提醒人不要把“下游性能差异”直接归因于 backbone 表征质量。很多时候，预训练模型早已编码了足够多的低层统计与风格特征，真正的差别来自 readout 头如何组织梯度、如何决定哪些层必须承担信息压缩与整合。这个观察对 pooling 设计、contrastive fine-tuning、retrieval scorer、甚至多模态对齐头都有参考价值。更重要的是，论文把 feature availability 和 feature use 分开讨论，这个框架对分析预训练表示是否“学到了某种能力”很有用：能线性读出，不等于模型在当前目标下会因果性地使用它。
summary.technical_approach:
作者研究的是 Kulumba 等人训练的一组对比式 authorship attribution 模型。它们共享同一个预训练 encoder、同样的数据和 InfoNCE 训练目标，差别只在 scoring 机制：

1. Mean pooling：先把 passage 的 token 表示取平均，再做 cosine similarity。它要求 encoder 在单个向量里压缩整段文本的信息。
2. Late interaction, LI：保留 token-level 表示，用 MaxSim 之类的 token-to-token 匹配来打分。它不要求所有信息都提前压进一个全局向量。
3. Patch pooling：介于两者之间，把相邻 token 组成 patch 后先局部平均，再做 late interaction。

分析工具主要有三类。

第一类是线性 probe，用来测“风格特征是否存在于各层表示中”。作者探测的特征包括词长、标点密度、功能词频率、大小写等。结果显示，这些特征在所有模型、几乎所有层、甚至一个未针对该任务微调的 control encoder 中都能被线性读出。也就是说，fine-tuning 并没有创造这些特征。

第二类是 causal intervention，具体是 residual stream patching。做法是：给定 anchor、positive、negative 三元组，用 clean positive 和 corrupt negative 分别前向；然后在某一层把 negative 的隐藏状态替换成 positive 的对应状态，再看最终 same-author 评分恢复多少。这个实验测的是“某层表示对正确作者判断的因果贡献”。结果表明，mean pooling 模型在较早到中间层就已经把 authorship signal 整合到足以影响最终判断；LI 模型则把这种整合推迟到更后层，因为它可以依赖 token-level 匹配，不必过早压缩。

第三类是从梯度结构解释上述差异。mean pooling 的梯度会把所有 token 通过平均操作耦合起来，迫使中早层就形成可全局汇聚的作者风格表示；LI 的梯度更局部，允许不同 token 保留细粒度风格线索，到后层或 scorer 端再完成利用。patch pooling 则处在中间，形成一个连续谱，而不是二元对立。

论文还结合 alignment–uniformity 分析训练动态。作者观察到，不同 scorer 不只是最终 readout 不同，而是沿着不同的优化路径塑造 encoder：mean pooling 更早追求全局对齐，LI 则允许表示空间在更长阶段内保留局部结构。这解释了为什么两者即便共享 backbone，最终有效深度和可利用信息也不同。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文片段可确认的关键结果有几类。

1. 性能差距：在同样 backbone、数据和损失下，仅 scorer 不同就能带来约四倍性能差距。这是整篇论文的起点。

2. Feature availability：线性 probe 显示，词长、标点、功能词频率等风格特征在所有层都可读，而且在 off-the-shelf control encoder 中也存在。这说明性能差距不能简单解释为“某个 scorer 学到了更好的风格表示”。

3. Causal layer localization：residual stream patching 显示，mean pooling 模型的 authorship signal 在早层到中层就已变成因果必要；LI 模型则把关键贡献推迟到更晚层。这个结果比 probe 更重要，因为它区分了“可读出”与“被使用”。

4. Patch pooling 作为中间态：bigram patch（n=2）在行为上位于 mean pooling 和 LI 之间，支持作者关于“梯度结构决定整合层位”的解释，而不是偶然的架构差异。

5. 训练动态：alignment / uniformity 分析表明，不同 scorer 在 fine-tuning 过程中走出不同轨迹。虽然正文片段没有给出具体数值，但作者明确强调，差异体现在何时开始压缩作者信号、以及表示空间何时失去局部细节。

这篇论文的实验价值主要在机制证据链完整：probe 证明特征一直都在，patching 证明何处被因果使用，梯度分析解释为什么会这样，训练动态说明这种差异是如何形成的。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合做机制分析类泛读，重点不在任务本身，而在分析框架。

先看 Introduction，抓住作者要区分的两个命题：representation quality 差异，还是 readout-induced consolidation 差异。这个问题在很多 encoder fine-tuning 场景都成立。

然后看 Background 里三种 scorer 的定义，尤其是 mean pooling、late interaction、patch pooling 的数学形式。要想清楚它们对梯度传播路径的约束分别是什么。

正文里最值得看的部分是三块：
1. 线性 probe 结果：确认 feature availability 基本不变。
2. Residual stream patching：这是整篇最关键的因果证据，建议仔细看图和实验设置。
3. 梯度结构与训练动态分析：这里解释“为什么 signal emergence 的层位会不同”，也是最能迁移到别的任务的部分。

如果时间有限，30 分钟左右可以读完核心逻辑。若要深挖，建议思考两个延伸问题：第一，这种 scorer-induced depth shift 是否也会出现在 retrieval、reranker、VLM 对齐头中；第二，预训练阶段若显式鼓励某种 pooling 友好的结构，是否会改变 fine-tuning 时的最优 scorer 选择。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise but broadly relevant question: why can authorship-attribution models, trained with the same pretrained encoder, the same data, and the same contrastive loss, differ by roughly 4x in performance solely because of the scoring mechanism? The authors separate two hypotheses. One is that different scorers induce different internal representations in the encoder. The other is that stylistic features are already present throughout the network, and the real difference is where the scorer forces those features to be consolidated into causally necessary authorship signal. The paper supports the second view: feature availability is not the bottleneck; the scorer changes gradient structure and training dynamics, which in turn changes where authorship signal emerges and becomes necessary.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for anyone working on representation learning, contrastive fine-tuning, or readout design. The main lesson is that downstream performance gaps should not be attributed too quickly to backbone representation quality. A pretrained encoder may already encode the relevant low-level statistics and style cues; the decisive factor can instead be how the scoring head organizes gradients and where it forces information compression. That insight matters beyond authorship attribution: it is relevant to pooling design, retrieval scoring, rerankers, and multimodal alignment heads. The paper is especially valuable for its distinction between feature availability and feature use. Linear decodability does not imply causal use under a given objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study analyzes a family of contrastive authorship-attribution models from prior work. They share the same pretrained encoder, the same training data, and the same InfoNCE objective. The only difference is the scoring mechanism:

1. Mean pooling: token representations are averaged into a single passage vector, then compared with cosine similarity. This forces the encoder to compress passage-level information into one vector.
2. Late interaction (LI): token-level representations are preserved and compared with a MaxSim-style token-to-token scorer. This avoids early global compression.
3. Patch pooling: an intermediate design where contiguous token patches are mean-pooled first, then scored with late interaction.

The analysis uses three main tools.

First, linear probes test whether stylistic features are present in hidden states across layers. The probed features include word length, punctuation density, function-word frequency, capitalization, and related style cues. The result is that these features are linearly recoverable from nearly all layers in all models, including an off-the-shelf control encoder. Fine-tuning does not create them.

Second, the paper uses causal intervention via residual stream patching. Given an anchor, a same-author positive, and a different-author negative, the model runs a clean forward pass on the positive and a corrupt pass on the negative. At a chosen layer, the negative hidden state is replaced with the positive hidden state, and the final score recovery is measured. This identifies where in the encoder the relevant authorship signal becomes causally important. Mean-pooling models consolidate that signal by early-to-mid layers, whereas LI models defer consolidation to later layers because token-level matching remains available downstream.

Third, the paper explains the difference through gradient structure. Mean pooling couples all token representations through the averaging operation, so the encoder is pressured to form globally aggregatable authorship features relatively early. LI produces more local gradients and allows fine-grained stylistic cues to remain distributed across tokens until later layers or the scorer itself. Patch pooling behaves as an intermediate case, which supports the gradient-based explanation.

The paper also studies training dynamics through alignment and uniformity. The claim is that different scorers do not merely read out the same encoder differently at the end; they drive the encoder along different optimization trajectories. Mean pooling pushes earlier global alignment, while LI preserves local structure for longer.
summary_en.experiments:
The key empirical findings, based on the provided full-text excerpt, are as follows.

1. Performance gap: with the same backbone, data, and loss, changing only the scorer can produce an approximately four-fold difference in authorship-attribution performance. This is the motivating puzzle.

2. Feature availability: linear probes show that stylistic features such as word length, punctuation, and function-word usage are readable from all models at nearly all layers, and even from an off-the-shelf control encoder. So the gap cannot be explained simply by one scorer learning better style representations.

3. Causal localization across layers: residual stream patching shows that in mean-pooling models, authorship signal becomes causally necessary by early or middle layers, whereas in LI models the critical contribution is shifted later. This is more informative than probing because it distinguishes readable information from actually used information.

4. Patch pooling as an intermediate case: bigram patch pooling (n=2) behaves between mean pooling and LI, which strengthens the claim that the effect is driven by scorer-induced gradient structure rather than an arbitrary architectural quirk.

5. Training dynamics: alignment/uniformity analysis indicates that the scorers induce different optimization trajectories during fine-tuning. The excerpt does not expose all numerical details, but the paper’s argument is that the main difference lies in when the model starts compressing authorship signal and when the representation space loses local detail.

The experimental strength of the paper is the coherence of the evidence chain: probes show the features are already there, patching shows where they become causally used, gradient analysis explains why, and training dynamics shows how the divergence develops.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim for researchers interested in mechanisms rather than the task itself.

Start with the introduction and keep the two competing hypotheses in mind: is the gap due to different representation quality, or due to scorer-induced consolidation of already available features? That framing generalizes well beyond authorship attribution.

Then read the background section carefully, especially the mathematical definitions of mean pooling, late interaction, and patch pooling. The important question is how each scorer constrains gradient flow and information compression.

The most valuable parts of the paper are three sections:
1. The linear-probe results, which establish that feature availability is largely invariant.
2. The residual-stream patching analysis, which is the central causal evidence.
3. The gradient-structure and training-dynamics discussion, which explains why signal emergence shifts across layers and is the most transferable part of the paper.

If time is limited, about 30 minutes is enough to extract the main mechanism. If you want to go deeper, two follow-up questions are worth thinking about: whether scorer-induced depth shifts also appear in retrieval, reranking, or VLM alignment heads; and whether pretraining objectives that favor pooling-friendly structure would change the best scorer choice during fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不在 LLM 主航道，但 setup 很干净：它提醒你别把“表征里有信息”误当成“优化能把信息用出来”；看梯度结构分析那部分就够。
recommendation.en: Not core LLM work, but the setup is clean: it is a good reminder that ‘information exists in the representation’ does not mean optimization can use it; read the gradient-structure analysis.

paper.title: Transformers Linearly Represent Highly Structured World Models
paper.abstract: Do transformers, when trained on sequential reasoning traces, build internal models of the underlying task? And if so, does the structure of those internal representations mirror the structure of the domain? We train an 8-layer transformer on Sudoku solving traces and perform a mechanistic analysis of its internal computation. We establish two results. First, the model builds a substructure world model: it does not represent the board state cell by cell, as a human analyst would expect, but orga

summary.core_problem: 探究训练在数独求解轨迹上的Transformer是否会形成与任务约束结构匹配的内部世界模型，以及这类组合约束满足任务下的表示几何是否与之前Othello等游戏的逐单元表示模式一致
summary.importance: 为机制可解释性和预训练模型推理机制研究提供参考，验证了Transformer内部表示会自适应任务底层约束结构，而非统一采用人类直觉的表面状态拆分方式，可为推理类预训练任务的设计提供机制层面的参考
summary.technical_approach: 训练8层因果Transformer在带回溯的Norvig风格数独求解轨迹上，采用已有的探针+激活修补的机制分析方法，分别验证亚结构表示、注意力对齐、专用推理电路三类特征。和现有Othello、国际象棋等任务的世界模型研究的区别是，选择了约束跨亚结构关联的数独任务，而非逐单元独立状态的游戏任务
summary.experiments: 在15万 held-out测试集上达到98.4%的单单元格准确率、97.5%的整张数独准确率；中层的（亚结构,数字）对线性探针准确率达到100%，而逐单元探针仅到80%；识别到中层注意力头会对齐行、列、宫等亚结构，OV电路会抑制亚结构中已出现数字的logits；最终MLP层存在一组单语义神经元专门检测单元格的唯一可填数字（裸单规则）
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3、4、5节的核心发现部分，跳过数独规则和探针技术细节，预计阅读时间15分钟，核心结论可快速对应到推理类预训练模型的表示设计参考

summary_en.core_problem: Investigate whether transformers trained on Sudoku solving traces form internal world models matching the underlying task constraint structure, and whether the representation geometry of such combinatorial constraint satisfaction tasks aligns with the cell-wise representation pattern observed in previous studies on games like Othello
summary_en.importance: Provides reference for mechanistic interpretability and pre-trained model reasoning mechanism research, verifies that transformer internal representations adapt to the underlying constraint structure of tasks instead of uniformly adopting the surface state decomposition intuitive to humans, which can offer mechanism-level reference for the design of reasoning-focused pre-training tasks
summary_en.technical_approach: Train an 8-layer causal transformer on Norvig-style Sudoku solving traces with backtracking, adopt the existing probe + activation patching mechanistic analysis method to verify three features: substructure representation, attention alignment, and dedicated reasoning circuits. Different from previous world model studies on tasks like Othello and chess, this work chooses Sudoku, a task with constraints correlated across substructures, rather than games with cell-wise independent states
summary_en.experiments: Achieves 98.4% per-cell accuracy and 97.5% per-grid accuracy on 150k held-out test puzzles; linear probes for (substructure, digit) pairs in mid-layers reach 100% exact match accuracy, while per-cell probes only plateau at 80%; mid-layer attention heads are found to align with substructures like rows, columns and boxes, and OV circuits suppress logits of digits already present in the attended substructure; a set of monosemantic neurons in the final MLP layer are identified to specifically detect the only valid digit for a cell (naked single rule)
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core findings in Sections 3, 4 and 5 during skimming, skip Sudoku rule descriptions and technical details of probing methods. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. Core conclusions can be quickly mapped to representation design references for reasoning-focused pre-training models

recommendation.zh: 机制分析质量不错，约束代数塑造世界模型几何这个发现对思考pretrain数据如何诱导结构化表示有启发，建议看§3-§4的分析部分。
recommendation.en: Quality mechanistic analysis; finding that constraint algebra shapes world model geometry is informative for thinking about how pretraining data induces structured representations. Recommend reading §3-§4.

paper.title: Language-Switching Triggers Take a Latent Detour Through Language Models
paper.abstract: Backdoor attacks on language models pose a growing security concern, yet the internal mechanisms by which a trigger sequence hijacks model computations remain poorly understood. We identify a circuit underlying a language-switching backdoor in an 8B-parameter autoregressive language model, where a three-word Latin trigger (nine tokens) redirects English output to French. We decompose the circuit into three phases: (1) distributed attention heads at early layers compose the trigger tokens into th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是语言模型后门触发器如何在内部电路中传播并劫持输出，尤其是语言切换型 backdoor 的具体机制。
summary.importance: 价值在机制分析而不是防御工程。它把一个 8B 自回归模型中的语言切换后门分解成可定位的三阶段电路，并指出触发信号会绕开自然语言身份方向，在正交子空间中传播。这对安全、可解释性和表示空间分析都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者定位了一个由三词拉丁语 trigger 激活的 backdoor circuit：早层分布式 attention heads 将 trigger 组合并汇聚到最后一个位置；中层在与自然 language-identity direction 正交的子空间中传递该信号；最终层 MLP 把该潜变量映射成法语 logits。论文还发现整个电路经过单一位置的 serial bottleneck，对该位置做 corruption 可完全抑制触发，但也会损伤正常能力。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是一个 8B 参数自回归语言模型，任务是将英文输出劫持为法语。核心结果不是 benchmark 分数，而是 circuit tracing、子空间分解和干预实验：包括不同层和位置的 corruption/ablation，以及对 language-identity direction 的对比分析。摘要未给出更多定量指标，但机制链条相对完整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how a backdoor trigger propagates through a language model’s internal circuit and hijacks generation, focusing on a language-switching backdoor.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mechanistic rather than defensive engineering. It decomposes a language-switching backdoor in an 8B autoregressive model into a three-stage circuit and shows that the trigger signal travels through a subspace orthogonal to the model’s natural language-identity direction. This matters for safety, interpretability, and representation analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify a backdoor circuit activated by a three-word Latin trigger: early distributed attention heads compose the trigger and route it to the final sequence position; mid-layers propagate the signal in a subspace orthogonal to the natural language-identity direction; the final-layer MLP converts that latent signal into French logits. They also find a serial bottleneck at a single position: corrupting it fully suppresses the trigger but harms normal capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use an 8B autoregressive language model with a backdoor that redirects English outputs into French. The key evidence is not benchmark performance but circuit tracing, subspace analysis, and intervention studies, including layer/position corruption and comparisons against the language-identity direction. The abstract does not provide more quantitative detail, but the mechanistic story is fairly specific.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但机制做得比多数安全工作干净；重点看“正交子空间传播”和单位置 bottleneck，能直接启发你做表示层面的异常检测。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the mechanism work looks cleaner than most safety papers; focus on the orthogonal-subspace propagation and the single-position bottleneck if you care about representation-level anomaly detection.

paper.title: Where Does Authorship Signal Emerge in Encoder-Based Language Models?
paper.abstract: Authorship attribution models fine-tuned with the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ four-fold in performance depending only on their scoring mechanism. We use mechanistic interpretability tools to explain this gap. Stylistic features such as word length, punctuation density, and function-word frequency are equally available at every layer in every model, including in an off-the-shelf control encoder, hence the gap not coming from representation quality. Instead, causal intervent

summary.core_problem: 解释为什么同一个预训练 encoder、同一数据和同一 loss 下，作者归因模型只因 scoring mechanism 不同就出现数倍性能差距。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把下游任务性能差异从“表示是否足够好”转向“梯度和读出头如何迫使信息在层间聚合”，对理解 encoder fine-tuning 动态有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 mechanistic interpretability 和因果干预分析不同 scorer。论文比较 mean pooling 与 late interaction 等读出方式，发现风格特征在各层都可访问，但 scorer 的梯度结构决定作者信号在早中层还是后层被整合。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕作者归因任务展开，控制 pretrained encoder、数据和 loss，仅改变 scoring mechanism；报告性能可相差约四倍。还包含 off-the-shelf control encoder、层间特征探测、因果 intervention 和训练轨迹分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why authorship attribution models built on the same pretrained encoder, data, and loss can differ by up to four-fold simply because of the scoring mechanism.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It shifts the explanation from representation quality to how readout heads and gradients force task information to consolidate across layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use mechanistic interpretability tools and causal interventions to compare scoring mechanisms such as mean pooling and late interaction. They show that stylistic cues are broadly available, while the scorer determines where authorship evidence is consolidated.
summary_en.experiments: The study controls the pretrained encoder, data, and loss, varying only the scorer on authorship attribution. It reports up to a four-fold performance gap and analyzes control encoders, layer-wise probes, causal interventions, and training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 作为 encoder fine-tuning 机制案例可备查；对 pretrain 决策影响弱，只看梯度结构解释即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as an encoder fine-tuning mechanism case; weak for pretraining decisions, so the gradient-structure explanation is the only part to read.

paper.title: Judge Circuits
paper.abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the dominant paradigm for grading model outputs at scale, yet the same model assigns systematically different scores when its output format changes (e.g., a 1-5 rating vs. a True/False label). Existing diagnoses of these format-induced inconsistencies stop at the input-output level. Using Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching (PEAP), we causally investigate the internal mechanism in Gemma-3, Qwen2.5, and Llama-3. We find that judgments across structured understanding

summary.core_problem: LLM-as-a-judge 在不同输出格式（如 1-5 分、True/False、多分类标签）下会出现系统性打分不一致。论文要回答的不是“模型是否一致”，而是“这种不一致在模型计算图的哪一段产生”：到底是评判能力本身不稳定，还是把内部评判结果“路由/翻译”为特定格式输出时出错。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接改进型工作，但对“用 LLM 做评测/奖励/安全判别”这条训练信号链很关键：如果 judge 的不一致主要来自末端格式路由，而内部评判子系统相对稳定，那么（1）评测与 RM 数据收集可以更有针对性地做格式校准；（2）可以把“评判能力”视为可定位、可干预的子电路，减少把 judge 当黑箱带来的噪声；（3）提示了架构与规模会影响“评判模块化程度”，这会反过来影响用该模型做 judge 或做 RM teacher 的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上走的是机制可解释/电路发现路线。核心假设是两段式：中后层 MLP 中存在跨任务共享的 Latent Evaluator（抽象评判核心），而不同输出格式依赖不同的 Task Formatter/输出路由把该评判映射到具体 token（分数、标签）。

具体做法：
1) 用 PEAP（Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching）在 Transformer 的“边”（跨层、跨 token 的连接）粒度做归因与因果 patch，适配 judge 任务常见的跨 span 依赖（如 premise/hypothesis 分离）。在每个数据集上构造对比 minimal pairs（正确 vs 错误评分/标签的干净-污染对），用 patching 找到能解释输出差异的稀疏关键边集合（top-k，k≤200）。
2) 交叉任务验证：在结构化理解（CoLA/MNLI/STS-B）、开放式偏好（RewardBench）、主观情感（Yelp）之间比较电路重叠，发现共享的稀疏子图主要落在中后层 MLP。
3) 三种独立因果探针做一致性校验，降低“电路不唯一/可替代路径”带来的不确定性：累计 edge patching、子空间 steering、跨格式 activation transfer。后者直接检验“同一内部评判表征能否在不同输出格式间迁移”，用来支持“评判稳定、路由不稳”的分解。
4) 模块化检验：对发现的 Latent Evaluator 做 zero-ablation，观察是否能在不显著破坏世界知识/一般能力的情况下让评判崩塌；并比较不同模型/规模（Qwen 7B/14B、Gemma 12B/27B、Llama 8B）上这种可分离性是否成立。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 5 个 judge 场景数据集：CoLA、MultiNLI、STS-B、RewardBench、Yelp；模型为 Gemma-3-12B-it/27B-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/14B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（TransformerLens 接入）。每个任务用 100-200（MNLI 500）个对比 minimal pairs，并做 split-half reliability 检查电路 IoU 稳定性。

关键结论型结果（论文给出的定性/结构性结果为主）：
- 跨任务共享的评判电路高度稀疏，可在 top-k≤200 条边内恢复；共享部分集中在中后层 MLP，形成“Latent Evaluator”子图。
- 架构/规模影响模块化：Qwen 在 7B 就表现出较强的“评判-知识”可分离性；Gemma-3-12B 上评判与世界知识更纠缠，做 Latent Evaluator 的消融会同时伤到知识相关行为；Gemma-3-27B 才更接近模块化。
- 在模块化更强的模型上，zero-ablation Latent Evaluator 会让 judge 能力塌缩，但世界知识相对保留，支持“评判核心是可定位子系统”。
- 跨格式不一致主要定位在末端格式路由/formatter：内部评判表征更稳定，但映射到不同输出 token 的路径会引入系统性偏差。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“假设—定位—因果验证—架构差异”顺序读：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“routing vs evaluation failure”的问题重述，明确论文要解释的是格式不一致的来源。
- 重点看电路发现与验证的三件套：PEAP 如何处理跨 token 边；以及累计 patching / steering / activation transfer 三种因果探针如何相互印证（对应方法与主实验图表）。
- 精读模块化实验：Latent Evaluator 的 zero-ablation 对 judge 与世界知识的差异影响，以及 Gemma 12B vs 27B、Qwen 7B 的对比，这部分最能转化为“如何选 judge / 如何做 judge 校准”的工程判断。
- 如果时间有限：优先看电路稀疏性（top-k≤200）、共享位置（中后层 MLP）、以及跨格式 activation transfer 的证据链。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-as-a-judge systems exhibit systematic score inconsistencies when the required output format changes (e.g., 1–5 ratings vs. True/False vs. multi-class labels). The paper pinpoints where this inconsistency originates in the model’s computation: is the underlying evaluation unstable, or does the failure happen when a stable internal judgment is routed into different output formats?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper per se, but it matters for the reliability of evaluation and training signals that sit on top of pretrained models (leaderboards, reward modeling, safety moderation). If the inconsistency is largely a formatting/routing issue rather than an evaluation issue, then (i) judge calibration can target the formatter without perturbing the core evaluator, (ii) reward/label collection pipelines can reduce noise by controlling format routing, and (iii) architectural/scale-dependent modularity becomes a practical criterion when selecting judge models or teacher models for RM.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work follows a mechanistic interpretability/circuit-discovery approach. The central decomposition is: a shared, abstract Latent Evaluator subgraph (primarily in mid-to-late MLP blocks) computes a stable judgment, while format-specific terminal pathways (Task Formatters) map that judgment into the requested output tokens.

Pipeline:
1) Construct contrastive minimal pairs (clean vs. corrupted prompts with matched token structure) for multiple judging tasks.
2) Use PEAP (Position-aware Edge Attribution Patching) to attribute and causally test cross-token edges efficiently—important because judge prompts often require integrating separated spans (premise vs. hypothesis, instruction vs. candidate answer).
3) Identify sparse top-k edge subgraphs (k ≤ 200) that explain judgment behavior, and test cross-task overlap to isolate a generalized evaluator circuit.
4) Triangulate with three independent causal probes to reduce non-identifiability: cumulative edge patching, subspace steering, and cross-format activation transfer (testing whether internal evaluator activations can be transplanted across output formats).
5) Validate modularity via zero-ablation of the Latent Evaluator and measure whether judgment collapses while world knowledge remains intact; compare this separability across model families and scales.
summary_en.experiments:
Tasks/datasets: CoLA, MultiNLI, STS-B (structured understanding), RewardBench (open-ended preference judging), Yelp (ordinal sentiment). Models: Gemma-3-12B-it/27B-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/14B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (via TransformerLens). Minimal-pair subsets are ~100–200 per dataset (MNLI capped at 500) with split-half checks for circuit IoU stability.

Main empirical takeaways are structural/causal rather than leaderboard-style numbers:
- A highly sparse shared circuit (recoverable with top-k ≤ 200 edges) supports judgment across tasks, concentrated in mid-to-late MLPs.
- Modularity is architecture/scale dependent: Qwen shows evaluator/knowledge separability already at 7B; Gemma-3-12B exhibits stronger entanglement (ablations harm both judgment and knowledge), while Gemma-3-27B is more modular.
- Cross-format inconsistency localizes to format-specific routing/formatters: internal evaluator representations are comparatively stable, but the final mapping to different output tokens introduces systematic shifts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in the order: hypothesis → circuit localization → causal validation → architecture/scale comparison.
- Start with the problem reframing (routing vs. evaluation failure) to understand what is being explained.
- Focus on the PEAP methodology details and why cross-token edges matter for judging prompts.
- Spend time on the three-way causal validation (patching/steering/activation transfer); the activation-transfer evidence is the cleanest support for the evaluator/formatter split.
- Don’t skip the ablation-based modularity section (Gemma 12B vs 27B, Qwen 7B): it’s the most actionable part for choosing/calibrating judge models.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 judge 的“格式敏感”拆成共享评判子图和脆弱输出映射；只看电路定位与 ablation 结果就够，能指导你别把 judge 分数当真值。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly decomposes judge format sensitivity into a shared evaluator circuit plus a fragile output mapper; read the circuit localization and ablation sections if you rely on LLM judges.

institutions: BIFOLD – Berlin Institute for the Foundations of Learning and Data
German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
Centre for European Research in Trusted AI (CERTAIN)

paper.title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions
paper.abstract: Instruction-tuned language models exhibit behavioural fairness in high-stakes decisions while retaining biased associations in their internal representations. However, whether these suppressed representations can affect model outputs - and whether such causal potency is symmetric across demographic groups - remains unknown. We investigate the use of open-weight models for mortgage underwriting using matched applications that differ only in racially-associated names and reveal a critical disconne

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个被输出公平性掩盖的问题：instruction-tuned LLM 在高风险决策中可能给出表面公平的审批结果，但内部仍保留并放大人口属性相关表征；这些隐藏表征是否能因果影响决策，以及这种影响是否具有方向不对称性，是论文的核心问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发较明确。对齐训练可能没有删除敏感属性表征，而是在输出路径上压制其影响。这样的模型可以通过 activation steering、prompt engineering 或少量参数微调重新释放隐藏信号。对基座研究来说，这说明“行为评测通过”不等于“内部表征被清除”；需要把层级表征、因果干预和输出行为一起看，尤其是在研究 instruction tuning、RLHF、safety tuning 对预训练表征的改写程度时。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 mortgage underwriting 作为受控测试场景，构造 matched-pair prompts：信用相关特征保持不变，只替换带有种族关联的姓名。先测输出层面的审批率和置信边际，再逐层比较不同人口属性条件下的 hidden states。方法重点是因果干预。普通 activation steering 用某一层的人口属性方向去干预同层表示，观察审批结果是否翻转。论文进一步提出 cross-layer steering：用后层中更强的人口属性差异信号，去干预中间层中更容易被 steering 改变的表示，以验证后层差异是否只是累积噪声，还是仍然是决策相关信号。作者还加入 placebo tests，排除结果只是姓名 token 差异导致；并测试 prompt engineering、LoRA 式少量参数微调和 sparse autoencoder 归因。
summary.experiments: 主要结果是：多个开源 instruction-tuned 模型在输出层面表现出审批率和置信边际的群体 parity，但隐藏状态中人口属性表征会随层数单调放大。Gemma-3 中平均 hidden-state difference 从接近 0 增长到约 1200，直到倒数第二层。Activation steering 显示这些表征具有决策相关性，重新注入关键层后可造成接近完全的决策翻转。影响具有方向不对称性：某些 steering 方向有效，反向干预弱得多；并且模型之间方向不同，Gemma-3 与 Qwen2.5 呈现相反的不对称模式。后层在局部 steering 下可能不敏感，尤其是 Gemma-3；cross-layer steering 说明后层差异并非无关噪声，而是可以通过中间层干预重新影响决策。攻击实验中，一个外部 LLM 可迭代调 prompt，使模型对 Black-associated names 产生显著不利偏差；少量 LoRA 微调也可诱导稳定偏差，单层可训练参数少于 6000。SAE 未能把这种表征差异可靠归因到具体特征，说明复杂社会属性的机制定位仍然困难。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若关注表征安全可精读方法和干预实验。先看 matched-pair 数据构造，确认信用变量是否严格受控。再看逐层 hidden-state divergence 曲线，尤其是 Gemma-3 从 0 到约 1200 的放大过程。重点读 activation steering 和 cross-layer steering 的定义、干预层选择、方向向量构造方式，以及 placebo tests。实验部分优先看三组结果：输出 parity 与内部 divergence 的并存；方向不对称的模型差异；少量 LoRA 参数如何绕过输出层抑制。对预训练研究最有用的点是“抑制而非消除”的机制假设，以及它对 alignment 后表征可操控性的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether fair-looking outputs are enough when instruction-tuned LLMs are used for high-stakes decisions. In a mortgage-underwriting setup, the models can show output-level parity while still carrying amplified demographic representations internally. The central question is whether these suppressed representations are causally relevant to decisions, and whether their effects are symmetric across demographic groups.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining and post-training research is the distinction between removing a representation and suppressing its effect at the output. The results suggest that instruction tuning or safety tuning may leave sensitive latent features intact, while learning to block their influence in normal decoding. Those features can be reactivated by activation steering, adversarial prompting, or very small parameter updates. This is a useful warning for evaluating alignment: behavioral audits alone do not show whether pretraining-era representations have been erased, transformed, or merely gated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use mortgage underwriting as a controlled audit environment.
