They construct matched prompt pairs where credit-relevant variables are fixed and only racially associated names are changed. They first measure approval rates and confidence margins, then compare hidden states layer by layer across demographic conditions. The core method is causal intervention. Standard activation steering injects a demographic direction at a given layer and measures whether the underwriting decision changes. The paper adds cross-layer steering: late-layer demographic signals are used to intervene at middle layers that are more sensitive to steering. This tests whether late-layer divergence is decision-relevant rather than accumulated representational noise. The study also includes placebo tests, prompt-engineering attacks, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and sparse-autoencoder attribution attempts.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple open-weight instruction-tuned models, output behavior remains approximately fair in approval rates and confidence margins, but hidden demographic divergence grows across layers. In Gemma-3, the average hidden-state difference rises from near 0 to roughly 1200 by the penultimate layer. Activation steering shows causal potency: reinjecting these signals at sensitive layers can produce near-complete decision reversals. The effect is asymmetric. Steering in one demographic direction changes decisions strongly, while the reverse direction has much weaker impact; the direction of this asymmetry differs across models, with Gemma-3 and Qwen2.5 showing opposite patterns. Later layers may be locally insensitive to direct steering, especially in Gemma-3, but cross-layer steering shows that late-layer divergence can still affect decisions through middle-layer interventions. An attacker LLM can iteratively tune prompts to induce bias against applicants with Black-associated names without explicitly asking for biased behavior. A minimal LoRA-style update with fewer than 6,000 trainable parameters in one layer can also create consistent bias. Sparse autoencoders fail to cleanly localize the divergence to specific interpretable features.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 minute skim is sufficient for general pretraining readers; the intervention sections deserve closer reading for representation-safety work. Start with the matched-pair audit design to check how credit variables are controlled. Then inspect the layer-wise hidden-state divergence curves, especially the Gemma-3 growth from near 0 to about 1200. The most important technical sections are activation steering, cross-layer steering, construction of the steering directions, layer choice, and placebo tests. In the results, focus on three findings: output parity coexisting with internal divergence, directional asymmetry across models, and the ability of tiny LoRA updates to bypass output-level suppression. The useful conceptual point is suppression rather than elimination of sensitive representations after alignment.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练方法，但会动摇“输出公平≈内部去偏”的偷懒假设；重点看层间干预和不对称翻转，适合做对齐表征审计的人读。
recommendation.en: It does not change training recipes, but it should unsettle the lazy assumption that fair outputs imply debiased internals; focus on the layer interventions and asymmetric reversals.

paper.title: Artificial Aphasias in Lesioned Language Models
paper.abstract: Aphasias, selective language impairments which can arise from brain damage, reveal the functional organization of human language by providing causal links between affected brain regions and specific symptom profiles. Drawing on this literature, we introduce an aphasia-inspired technique to characterize the emergent functional organization of language models (LMs). We ``lesion'' (zero-out) model parameters and measure the effects of this intervention against clinical aphasia symptoms, as diagnose

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个机制解释问题：如果像研究人类失语症那样，对语言模型的特定参数矩阵做因果干预，能否得到稳定、细粒度的语言功能损伤图谱。
summary.importance: 论文对预训练方法没有直接改进，但对理解 Transformer 内部功能分工有启发。它把模型损伤后的行为从粗粒度 benchmark 分数，转成类似临床失语评估的症状分布。这个视角适合分析不同模块、不同层在语言生成中的作用，也能约束一些过强的类脑叙事：模型确实会出现类似失语症的文本症状，但症状组合和人类并不一致，不能简单说模型复现了人类失语亚型。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是对约 1B 参数的 decoder-only LM 做参数级 lesion。作者选择 Llama 3.2、Gemma 3、OLMo 2 的多个 base 或 instruction-tuned 变体，按层、按组件、按严重程度 zero-out 权重矩阵。被干预的组件包括 attention 中的 Q、K、V、O，以及 FFN 中的 Gate、Up、Down。每个 lesioned model 生成文本后，用 Text Aphasia Battery（TAB）打标签，得到症状分布。TAB 是为文本输出设计的失语症评估工具，能标注更细的语言错误类型。作者还把 6000 条 AphasiaBank 人类失语样本映射到同一标签空间，用于比较模型损伤和人类损伤的相似与差异。技术重点不在提出新模型，而在建立一个可重复的“干预—生成—症状剖面”测量管线。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 5 个约 1B 参数的 decoder-only 模型变体，跨 Llama 3.2-1B、Gemma 3-1B-Instruct、OLMo-2-1B 及其 instruction-tuned 版本。模型层数不同，Gemma 为 26 层，Llama 和 OLMo 为 16 层；头数也不同，OLMo 为 16，Gemma 为 8。作者在 7 类组件、多个层和 5 个 lesion severity 下生成并评分，共得到 112,426 条 severity 大于 0 的 lesion 记录。主要发现有三点。第一，attention 组件和 FFN 组件的损伤会产生系统性不同的症状剖面。第二，症状随层深变化，而且语义和句法缺陷比音系和流畅性缺陷更早出现在浅层，这和一些直觉不完全一致。第三，某些 LM lesion 在粗粒度标签上看起来更接近某些人类失语亚型，但细看症状组成和整体症状负担，与 AphasiaBank 人类样本差异很大。这个结果支持使用细粒度症状分布，而不是只做“像 Broca 还是 Wernicke”这样的粗分类。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议约 20–30 分钟。先看 Methods，确认 lesion 的粒度：是 zero-out 权重矩阵，而不是 activation patching 或 head ablation；同时看 TAB 标签体系，因为所有结论都依赖这个 readout。结果部分重点看组件差异、层深趋势、模型族一致性，以及和 AphasiaBank 的对照。若做 mechanistic interpretability，可以重点关注 Q/K/V/O 与 Gate/Up/Down 的症状差异；若关心预训练表征形成，可以关注语义、句法、音系、流畅性缺陷随深度出现的顺序。阅读时需要保留一个限制：1B 级模型和文本-only TAB 只能反映生成行为层面的损伤，不等价于定位模型内部的完整语言功能模块。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether lesion-style causal interventions, inspired by clinical aphasia research, can reveal stable and fine-grained functional organization inside language models.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method contribution, but it is useful for mechanism-level analysis of Transformer language models. Instead of measuring damage with coarse benchmark accuracy, the paper profiles the linguistic symptoms induced by parameter ablations. The main value is methodological: it provides a behavioral map linking components and layers to different failure profiles. It also cautions against overly strong brain-model analogies. Lesioned LMs can produce aphasia-like text symptoms, but their symptom composition and severity patterns differ substantially from human aphasia.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors perform parameter-level lesions on around-1B-parameter decoder-only LMs. They zero out selected weight matrices by layer, component, and severity. The ablated components include attention Q, K, V, and O matrices, as well as FFN Gate, Up, and Down matrices. After each lesion, the model generates text, and the outputs are scored using the Text Aphasia Battery, a text-only diagnostic scheme designed for language-model outputs. The resulting TAB label distribution is treated as the symptom profile of that lesion. For comparison, the authors also score 6,000 AphasiaBank human aphasia responses in the same label space. The contribution is therefore a reproducible intervention-to-symptom pipeline, rather than a new architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The sweep covers five approximately 1B-parameter decoder-only model variants from Llama 3.2, Gemma 3, and OLMo 2, including base and instruction-tuned variants where available. The families differ in depth and attention structure: Gemma has 26 layers, while Llama and OLMo have 16; OLMo has 16 heads and Gemma has 8. Across seven component types, layers, and five lesion severities, the study produces 112,426 scored lesion records with severity greater than zero. Three results are central. First, attention and FFN lesions induce systematically different symptom profiles across models. Second, symptom profiles vary with depth: semantic and syntactic deficits appear earlier than phonological and fluency deficits. Third, some LM lesions look closer to certain coarse human aphasia categories than others, but detailed symptom distributions and total symptom burden differ sharply from human AphasiaBank samples. This supports fine-grained symptom profiling over coarse subtype matching.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 20–30 minutes. Start with the Methods section to verify the intervention: this is weight-matrix zeroing, not activation patching or isolated head ablation. Also inspect the TAB label space, since all conclusions depend on that behavioral readout. In the results, focus on component-level differences, depth trends, consistency across model families, and the AphasiaBank comparison. For mechanistic interpretability, the most relevant part is the contrast between Q/K/V/O and Gate/Up/Down lesions. For pretraining-oriented readers, the depth ordering of semantic, syntactic, phonological, and fluency failures is the main signal. The main limitation to keep in mind is that 1B-scale text-only models and TAB-scored generations expose behavioral failure profiles, not a complete localization of language functions inside the network.

recommendation.zh: TAB把“模型坏在哪”变成可量化症状谱，适合做模块分工的因果读出；但lesion粒度与归因很敏感，别过度解读Q/K差异。
recommendation.en: TAB turns “how the model breaks” into a measurable symptom spectrum—useful for causal module-role probing; but lesion granularity makes attribution fragile, so don’t over-interpret Q/K differences.

institutions: Wu Tsai Neurosciences Institute, Stanford University

paper.title: The Rate-Distortion-Polysemanticity Tradeoff in SAEs
paper.abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) that can accurately reconstruct their input (minimizing distortion) by making efficient use of few features (minimizing the rate) often fail to learn monosemantic representations (highly interpretable), limiting their usefulness for mechanistic interpretability. In this paper, we characterise this tension in learning faithful, efficient, and interpretable explanations, introducing the Rate-Distortion-Polysemanticity tradeoff in SAEs. Under toy-modeling assumptions, we

summary.core_problem: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在神经网络激活解释中存在三个难以同时满足的目标：忠实重建（低失真）、高效编码（低速率/高稀疏度）和单语义可解释性（每个特征对应一个概念）。当前 SAE 训练优化前两者（通过 MSE 和 L1 稀疏正则），但最优解往往产出多语义特征（一个特征混合多个无关概念），限制了其在机制可解释性中的实际价值。论文系统刻画了这三者之间的固有张力，建立了率-失真-多语义性（RDP）权衡框架。
summary.importance: 该论文为 SAE 研究提供了一个统一的信息论视角：多语义性并非偶然的训练 artifact，而是数据分布中概念共现概率、模型容量和优化目标共同作用的必然结果。其核心结论——收紧单语义约束必然增加率或失真——对可解释性研究有范式级别的影响：它意味着当前通过调参（如增大字典宽度、提高稀疏度）来追求单语义的做法存在理论极限。此外，论文导出的多语义性度量指标的必要单调性条件，为评估和筛选现实世界中的可解释性指标提供了理论依据。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 SAE 视为一个通信系统：编码器计算稀疏编码（速率），解码器重建激活（失真），在此经典率失真框架基础上引入多语义性作为第三个维度。关键步骤包括：(1) 假设数据生成过程（DGP）存在真实概念方向，定义多语义性为学习到的 SAE 原子与真实概念之间的对齐程度；(2) 在玩具模型假设下，通过理论分析证明 RDP 权衡的存在性：当概念频繁共现时，受宽度和速率约束的 SAE 会选择联合表示它们以降低失真，导致多语义性；(3) 导出多语义性度量必须满足的单调性条件：在固定速率下，多语义性应随失真下降而上升（或不变），反之亦然；(4) 应用该条件评估开源 SAE 的多种多语义性代理指标。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Gemma 和 GPT-2 的开源 SAE（Karvonen et al., 2025）上评估了多种多语义性度量。没有一种广泛使用的指标完全通过单调性检验，但可以通过检验结果排序。令人意外的是，基于 LLM 的昂贵指标 AutoInterp（Paulo et al., 2025）表现反而不如简单基线。玩具模型实验展示了可控的 RDP 帕累托前沿：当概念共现概率从 0 增加到 0.5 时，最优 SAE 的多语义性评分单调上升，验证了理论预测。论文未使用超大规模模型或数据集，核心贡献主要是理论性的。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节（RDP 权衡的理论分析）和第 4 节（玩具模型构造与分析），这是论文的核心创新。图 1 展示了 RDP 权衡的基本直觉，值得先看以建立直观理解。第 5 节的多语义性度量评估部分对做实际 SAE 实验的研究者最有价值——它告诉你哪些指标基本不可靠。附录 C 的相关工作讨论提供了信息论与 SAE 交叉领域的全面梳理。对于预训练研究者，最值得深挖的点是：数据中共现结构如何被模型内化，以及这种内化与可解释性的根本冲突——这与预训练数据配比和 tokenizer 设计有深层联系。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在提供的全文内容中标注。从引用风格和研究方向看，作者可能来自欧洲或北美的学术机构（如 DeepMind、MIT、斯坦福或牛津的可解释性研究团队）。该文属于机制可解释性与信息论交叉方向，是目前 SAE 理论研究中最系统的工作之一。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for explaining neural network activations face three conflicting desiderata: faithful reconstruction (low distortion), efficient coding (low rate/high sparsity), and monosemantic interpretability (each feature maps to one concept). Current SAEs optimize the first two via MSE and sparsity regularization, but their optima routinely produce polysemantic features that mix unrelated concepts, degrading their utility for mechanistic interpretability. This paper systematically characterizes this inherent tension, establishing the Rate-Distortion-Polysemanticity (RDP) tradeoff framework.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a unifying information-theoretic perspective on SAE research: polysemanticity is not an accidental training artifact but an inevitable outcome of the interaction between concept co-occurrence probabilities in the data distribution, model capacity, and the optimization objective. Its core finding—that tightening the monosemanticity constraint necessarily increases either rate or distortion—has paradigm-level implications: there is a theoretical limit to how monosemantic SAEs can become through parameter tuning alone. The derived monotonicity conditions for polysemanticity metrics also provide a theoretical criterion for evaluating and ranking real-world interpretability metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames SAE as a communication system where the encoder computes a sparse code (rate) and the decoder reconstructs the activation (distortion), adding polysemanticity as a third dimension to the classic rate-distortion problem. Key steps: (1) Assuming a data-generating process (DGP) with ground-truth concept directions, polysemanticity is defined as the alignment between learned SAE atoms and true concepts. (2) Under toy-model assumptions, the RDP tradeoff is proved theoretically: when concepts frequently co-occur, a width- and rate-constrained SAE reduces distortion by representing them jointly, inducing polysemanticity. (3) Monotonicity conditions are derived: for a valid polysemanticity metric, fixing rate, polysemanticity should increase (or not decrease) as distortion decreases, and vice versa. (4) These conditions are applied to evaluate multiple polysemanticity proxies on open-source SAEs.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates various polysemanticity metrics on open-source SAEs for Gemma and GPT-2 (Karvonen et al., 2025). No widely-used metric fully passes the monotonicity test, but the criterion enables ranking. Surprisingly, expensive LLM-based metrics like AutoInterp (Paulo et al., 2025) perform worse than simpler baselines. Toy model experiments demonstrate a controlled RDP Pareto frontier: as concept co-occurrence probability increases from 0 to 0.5, the optimal SAE's polysemanticity score increases monotonically, confirming theoretical predictions. No very large models or datasets were used—core contributions are primarily theoretical.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (theoretical analysis of RDP tradeoff) and Section 4 (toy model construction and analysis), which contain the core innovations. Figure 1 provides the basic intuition for the RDP tradeoff and should be read first. Section 5's evaluation of polysemanticity metrics is most valuable for practitioners—it reveals which metrics are fundamentally unreliable. Appendix C's related work discussion provides a comprehensive survey of the information theory and SAE intersection. For pretraining researchers, the most thought-provoking connection is how co-occurrence structures in data are internalized by models, and the fundamental tension this creates with interpretability—a deep link to pretraining data mixture and tokenizer design.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided content. The research lies at the intersection of mechanistic interpretability and information theory, representing one of the most systematic theoretical treatments of SAEs to date.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接修正“SAE 只要训好就会单义”的 prior；建议先看理论命题和 feature co-occurrence 那段，若成立，很多 interpretability 负结果就不是工程问题而是目标错了。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that better-trained SAEs should become monosemantic; read the theory and the feature co-occurrence analysis first, because if it holds, many interpretability failures are objective-level, not optimization-level.

paper.title: Dynamics of the Transformer Residual Stream: Coupling Spectral Geometry to Network Topology
paper.abstract: Large language models are remarkably capable, yet how computation propagates through their layers remains poorly understood. A growing line of work treats depth as discrete time and the residual stream as a dynamical system, where each layer's nonlinear update has a local linear description. However, previous analyses have relied on scalar summaries or approximate linearizations, leaving the full spectral geometry of trained LLMs unknown. We perform full Jacobian eigendecomposition across three

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是训练后的 Transformer 残差流在层间如何传播计算。更具体地说，作者不满足于用单个标量去概括 Jacobian，而是直接对生产级 LLM 每一层的真实 Jacobian 做完整谱分解，想回答三个问题：训练到底在残差流动力学里安装了什么结构；哪些现象来自架构本身，哪些来自训练；以及这种动力学结构是否和残差流通道之间的中尺度拓扑组织有关。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不是改进 loss 或架构，而是提供了一种更细的训练后动力学视角。它给出的结论很具体：训练会沿深度形成单调的非正规性梯度，早层更像旋转主导、晚层更接近对称算子；同时多层复合 Jacobian 会把扰动逐步压进极少数有效通道，形成低秩瓶颈。这个结果对理解深层 Transformer 的信息路由、稳定性、特征压缩和层功能分工都有启发。更重要的是，作者用 OLMo 的 step-0 检查点把“架构效应”和“训练效应”拆开了，这比只看训练后模型更有解释力。对做训练动态、机制分析、甚至 residual stream 相关架构改造的人，这篇都值得记住结论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者把每个 Transformer block 看成离散时间动力系统的一步：h_{l+1}=h_l+f_l(h_l)，对应局部线性化 Jacobian J_l=∂h_{l+1}/∂h_l。与很多只看平均线性映射、冻结非线性近似 Jacobian、或只统计谱范数/迹的工作不同，这里做的是 production-scale 模型逐层 exact Jacobian 的完整 eigendecomposition 和 singular value analysis。对象包括 Llama 3.1 8B、OLMo 3 7B、Gemma 4 E4B；其中 OLMo 还取了 step 0、471k、1.41M 三个训练阶段。

论文的核心发现有三层。第一层是谱几何。训练后 Jacobian 沿深度出现单调变化：前层非正规性更强，复特征值占主导，表现出更明显的旋转/剪切动力学；后层更接近对称，谱结构更像选择性放大或压缩。文中提到约 98% 的特征值以复共轭对出现，这说明残差流局部动力学里旋转成分不是边角料，而是主导现象。第二层是跨层复合后的维度漏斗。单层看未必极端，但把 Jacobian 连乘后，扰动会被 funnel 到很少的有效方向，三种架构里最终只有约 4 到 40 个 effective channels 承担主要传播。第三层是把动力学和拓扑联系起来。作者基于激活相关性构图，再做 community detection，发现处在社区边界的 residual units 会被 Jacobian 有选择地放大或抑制，而且符号依赖于层所处的算子类型：近对称层更倾向放大边界单元，非正规层更倾向抑制它们。

最关键的技术设计是 step-0 null model。因为 step 0 与训练后模型共享架构、深度和连接方式，只差权重，所以能较干净地判断某个现象是 wiring 自带，还是训练安装进去的。作者据此认为：深度分区和相邻层子空间解耦更多是架构属性；非正规性梯度、维度 funneling、以及 community-boundary coupling 则是训练逐步形成的。另一个有意思的分析是 Schur decomposition 干预。作者把 Jacobian 的非正规部分“置零”，观察 rank collapse 是否被破坏，由此论证非正规结构不是可有可无的谱装饰，而和残差流实际执行的计算有关。
summary.experiments:
实验主体不是传统 benchmark，而是三类分析。

第一类是逐层谱分析。作者在 Llama 3.1 8B、OLMo 3 7B、Gemma 4 E4B 上做完整 Jacobian 特征分解，发现深度上的非正规性梯度具有一致性：早层更 rotation-dominated，晚层更 near-symmetric。约 98% 的特征值成复共轭对，说明复杂谱结构在真实训练后模型里非常普遍。

第二类是训练过程分析。OLMo 的 step 0、471k、1.41M 对比显示，某些现象在初始化时就存在，例如部分 depth regimes 和相邻层子空间解耦；但非正规性梯度和低维 funneling 是随训练逐步增强的。论文摘要里给了一个很具体的数字：community topology 与 Jacobian dynamics 的耦合在 OLMo 上对应的 FDR-significant layers 从 0 增加到 14，再到 24，说明这是训练中单调出现的性质，而不是随机初始化就有。

第三类是复合 Jacobian 与有效通道数分析。把多层 Jacobian 连乘后，扰动传播被压缩到约 4 到 40 个 effective channels，且这一现象跨三种架构都存在。这是全文最值得记住的数字之一，因为它把“残差流很高维”与“真正承担长程传播的方向很少”这两件事放在了一起。

如果看消融和干预，Schur-based 去非正规化实验很关键。作者发现去掉非正规结构会破坏某些 rank collapse 模式，说明非正规性与计算功能相关，而不是训练噪声。虽然这类结果不直接对应下游分数，但对理解训练后网络的内部组织很有分量。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题读，不适合扫摘要。先看 Introduction 末尾列出的三组贡献，建立阅读坐标。随后直接看逐层 Jacobian 谱图，重点理解三个量：non-normality、complex eigenvalue structure、composed Jacobian 的有效秩/有效通道数。然后看 OLMo 三个 checkpoint 的对比图，这是区分 architecture vs training 的关键证据。再看 activation-correlation graph 与 community detection 那部分，理解作者为什么说拓扑耦合是 learned property。最后看 Schur decomposition 干预实验，它决定了“非正规性是否只是描述性现象”这个问题。

如果只给 30 分钟，建议读：Introduction 后半 → 主谱图和 depth regime 图 → OLMo checkpoint 对比 → composed Jacobian funneling 图 → Schur 干预。若准备精读，最好顺手复习 non-normal operator、Schur decomposition、pseudospectrum 相关背景，否则容易只记住结论，抓不住机制。对做 pretrain dynamics 的人，值得思考的不是“这个现象能不能直接提分”，而是它是否解释了深层 Transformer 为什么能同时保持稳定传播和强压缩。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how computation propagates through the transformer residual stream after training. More precisely, it asks what the true layerwise Jacobians of production-scale LLMs look like, what aspects of their geometry come from architecture versus training, and whether those dynamical properties are coupled to mesoscale organization in the residual stream itself. Instead of reducing each layer to a scalar summary, the authors compute full eigendecompositions of exact Jacobians and analyze the resulting spectral geometry across depth.
summary_en.importance: This is not a paper about improving pretraining recipes directly. Its value is that it gives a sharper post-training dynamical picture of what pretraining installs into a transformer. The main result is concrete: training creates a monotonic depthwise gradient in non-normality, with early layers behaving more like rotation-dominated operators and late layers becoming closer to symmetric ones; at the same time, composed Jacobians funnel perturbations into a very small number of effective channels. That matters for how we think about signal propagation, compression, stability, and functional specialization across depth. The use of OLMo step-0 as a null model is especially useful because it separates architectural effects from learned ones rather than conflating them.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Each transformer block is treated as one step of a discrete dynamical system on the residual stream, h_{l+1} = h_l + f_l(h_l), with local linearization given by the exact Jacobian J_l = ∂h_{l+1}/∂h_l. The methodological difference from much prior work is important: the paper does not rely on averaged linear maps, detached Jacobians with frozen nonlinearities, or scalar proxies such as norms and traces. It computes exact per-layer Jacobians and performs full eigenvalue and singular-value analysis on three production-scale models: Llama 3.1 8B, OLMo 3 7B, and Gemma 4 E4B. For OLMo, the same analysis is repeated at initialization, an intermediate checkpoint, and the final pretraining checkpoint.

The first major finding is spectral. Trained Jacobians exhibit a monotonic depthwise transition: early layers are strongly non-normal and dominated by complex eigen-structure, consistent with rotational or shear-like dynamics, while later layers are closer to symmetric operators that behave more like selective amplification or contraction. The paper reports that roughly 98% of eigenvalues occur in complex-conjugate pairs, which means rotational structure is not incidental.

The second finding appears when Jacobians are composed across depth. Even if individual layers are not extremely low-rank, the product of Jacobians funnels perturbations into a tiny set of effective directions. Across all three architectures, the number of effective channels is only about 4 to 40. This gives a concrete form to the idea of progressive dimensional bottlenecking in the residual stream.

The third finding links dynamics to topology. The authors build activation-correlation graphs over residual-stream units and run community detection. Units that sit at community boundaries are preferentially amplified or suppressed by the Jacobian, and the sign depends on operator type: near-symmetric layers tend to amplify boundary units, while strongly non-normal layers tend to suppress them.

The step-0 null model is one of the strongest parts of the paper. Because the initialized OLMo shares architecture and wiring with the trained model, phenomena present at step 0 are interpreted as architectural, while those that emerge only during training are attributed to learning. On that basis, the paper argues that depth regimes and adjacent-layer subspace decoupling are largely architectural, whereas the non-normality gradient, dimensional funneling, and topology-dynamics coupling are learned. The Schur-decomposition intervention is also notable: by zeroing the non-normal component and checking whether rank-collapse structure survives, the authors argue that non-normality is functionally involved in computation rather than being a decorative spectral artifact.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical contribution is analytical rather than benchmark-driven.

First, the paper performs full layerwise spectral analysis on Llama 3.1 8B, OLMo 3 7B, and Gemma 4 E4B. The same qualitative pattern appears across all three: a depthwise non-normality gradient from rotation-dominated early layers to near-symmetric late layers. About 98% of eigenvalues appear in complex-conjugate pairs, indicating that complex spectral structure is pervasive in trained LLM Jacobians.

Second, the OLMo checkpoint study separates training effects from architectural ones. Comparing step 0, step 471k, and step 1.41M shows that some structure is already present at initialization, such as parts of the depth regime organization and adjacent-layer subspace decoupling. In contrast, the non-normality gradient and dimensional funneling strengthen during training. One especially concrete result is that the coupling between activation-graph community topology and Jacobian dynamics grows monotonically over training, with the number of FDR-significant layers increasing from 0 to 14 to 24.

Third, the composed-Jacobian analysis shows that perturbations are funneled into only about 4 to 40 effective channels across all three architectures. That is arguably the most memorable quantitative result in the paper because it turns a vague intuition about compression into a specific scale.

The intervention analysis matters too. When the non-normal component is removed via Schur decomposition, the rank-collapse structure is disrupted in ways that suggest non-normality is computationally relevant. These are not downstream-task numbers, but they are strong evidence about internal organization learned during pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This paper is best read with a clear agenda rather than skimmed casually. Start with the end of the introduction, where the authors state the three main claims. Then go straight to the layerwise spectral figures and focus on three objects: non-normality, complex eigenvalue structure, and the effective rank or effective-channel count of composed Jacobians. After that, read the OLMo checkpoint comparison carefully, because that is where the architecture-versus-training argument is actually supported. Then move to the activation-correlation graph and community-detection section to understand why the topology coupling is described as learned. Finish with the Schur-decomposition intervention, which addresses whether non-normality is merely descriptive or functionally important.

If only 30 minutes are available, read in this order: second half of the introduction, main spectral figures, OLMo checkpoint comparison, composed-Jacobian funneling analysis, then the Schur intervention. For a deeper read, it helps to refresh non-normal operators and Schur decomposition beforehand; otherwise it is easy to remember the headline findings without understanding the mechanism. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is not whether this immediately improves loss curves, but whether it explains how deep transformers can combine stable propagation with aggressive compression of useful directions.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接改训练 recipe，但会改你看 residual stream 的坐标系；先读谱梯度和 low-rank bottleneck 两个结果，值得拿内部 activation 分析复现。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your training recipe tomorrow, but it may change how you think about the residual stream; read the spectral-gradient and low-rank-bottleneck results first and try to reproduce them on your internal models.

paper.title: Exemplar Partitioning for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: We introduce Exemplar Partitioning (EP), an unsupervised method for constructing interpretable feature dictionaries from large language model activations with $\sim 10^{3}\times$ fewer tokens than comparable sparse autoencoders (SAEs). An EP dictionary is a Voronoi partition of activation space, built by leader-clustering streamed activations within a distance threshold. Each region is anchored by an observed exemplar that serves as both its membership criterion and intervention direction; dicti

summary.core_problem: 当前主流的无监督特征发现方法稀疏自编码器（SAE）需要百万到十亿级token的训练数据，且字典大小固定、生成的特征字典无法直接跨层、跨模型、跨训练 checkpoint 比较，限制了机制可解释性研究的效率和可对比性。
summary.importance: 提出了一种比SAE数据效率高三个数量级的无监督特征字典构建方法，且字典具备跨场景可比性，为机制可解释性研究提供了更轻量、更易跨模型对比的特征分析工具，也为理解LLM激活空间的固有结构提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: Exemplar Partitioning（EP）采用流式leader聚类的方式构建激活空间的Voronoi划分：首先通过校准激活样本计算距离阈值的百分位值，保证阈值跨层跨模型可比；每个聚类区域的锚点是真实观测到的激活样本（而非学习得到的centroid），既保证了区域的语义连贯性，也避免了聚类中心偏移导致的不稳定；字典大小由激活空间的几何结构和距离阈值共同决定，无需预先指定。
summary.experiments: 构建相同分辨率的特征字典时，EP所需的token数量比SAE少约1000倍；由于锚点是固定的真实激活样本，来自同一数据流、不同层/模型/训练阶段的字典可以直接对比，可追踪特定特征区域的演化过程。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2章EP与SAE的核心设计差异对比，以及流式聚类的稳定性分析；距离阈值的校准方法部分可帮助理解如何调整字典分辨率，预计阅读时间15-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), the current dominant unsupervised feature discovery method, require millions to billions of tokens for training, use a fixed dictionary size, and the generated feature dictionaries cannot be directly compared across layers, models, or training checkpoints, limiting the efficiency and comparability of mechanistic interpretability research.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an unsupervised feature dictionary construction method with three orders of magnitude higher data efficiency than SAEs, and the dictionaries have cross-scenario comparability. It provides a lighter, more easily cross-model comparable feature analysis tool for mechanistic interpretability research, and also offers a new perspective for understanding the inherent structure of LLM activation space.
summary_en.technical_approach: Exemplar Partitioning (EP) constructs a Voronoi partition of activation space using streaming leader clustering: first, the percentile value of the distance threshold is calculated through calibration activation samples to ensure the threshold is comparable across layers and models; the anchor of each cluster region is a real observed activation sample (rather than a learned centroid), which not only ensures the semantic coherence of the region but also avoids instability caused by cluster center drift; the dictionary size is determined jointly by the geometric structure of the activation space and the distance threshold, without pre-specification.
summary_en.experiments: When constructing feature dictionaries of the same resolution, EP requires approximately 1000 times fewer tokens than SAEs; since the anchors are fixed real activation samples, dictionaries from the same data stream across different layers/models/training stages can be directly compared, enabling tracking of the evolution of specific feature regions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core design difference comparison between EP and SAE in Chapter 2, as well as the stability analysis of streaming clustering; the distance threshold calibration method section helps understand how to adjust dictionary resolution. Estimated reading time: 15-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和 benchmark 设置；若 1000× token 节省成立，SAE 不是唯一默认工具，但先检查干预指标是否干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method and benchmark setup; if the 1000x token saving holds, SAEs stop being the default, but the intervention metrics need scrutiny.

paper.title: When Are Two Networks the Same? Tensor Similarity for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability aims to break models into meaningful parts; verifying that two such parts implement the same computation is a prerequisite. Existing similarity measures evaluate either empirical behaviour, leaving them blind to out-of-distribution mechanisms, or basis-dependent parameters, meaning they disregard weight-space symmetries. To address these issues for the class of tensor-based models, we introduce a weight-based metric, tensor similarity, that is invariant to such symme

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）研究缺乏一个严格的度量标准来验证两个神经网络组件是否执行相同的计算。现有相似性度量存在根本缺陷：基于行为（输入-输出对）的度量无法泛化到分布外且检测不到后门；基于参数的度量（如矩阵相似性）对权重空间对称性（如神经元重排）敏感。需要一个同时满足数据集独立性、对称性不变性和可扩展性的相似性度量。
summary.importance: 对LLM预训练研究中的机制分析和训练动态监测有实用价值。张量相似性提供了一种在权重空间层面追踪功能等价性的方法，可用于：检测训练过程中的功能相变（如grokking）、验证模型组件的功能等价性、监测灾难性遗忘和后门注入。这为预训练研究中分析模型内部机制变化提供了新工具。
summary.technical_approach: 提出张量相似性（tensor similarity）——一种基于权重的度量，对神经网络的参数化对称性（如神经元置换、层间分布变化）保持不变。该方法以张量网络（使用双线性层和乘积注意力替代非线性激活和softmax注意力的多项式网络）为基础，将余弦相似度从向量推广到张量模型，通过高效递归算法评估全局功能等价性。核心创新：(1) 张量代数框架下的权重相似性度量，同时满足数据集独立、对称性不变和可计算三个准则；(2) 可追溯每个组件对总相似度的贡献；(3) 在轻微结构扰动下有良好的退化特性。代价是模型需要使用张量/多项式架构。
summary.experiments: 实验验证了张量相似性在多个领域的判别能力：(1) 追踪视觉模型中的灾难性遗忘；(2) 检测模块化算术任务中的grokking-like相变；(3) 监测语言模型训练动态。结果显示张量相似性比现有度量（行为相似性、矩阵相似性）以更高保真度追踪功能训练动态，能够发现其他方法遗漏的功能变化。具体数值细节需参考原文。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点关注第2章（理论）中张量相似性的构造和对称性不变性的证明，以及第3章（实验）中训练动态追踪的结果。对LLM训练动态分析和机制解读有工具层面的参考价值。预计阅读时间：40-50分钟，张量代数背景不足者可跳过数学推导部分。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括tdooms等（代码仓库在github.com/tdooms/tensor-similarity），机构信息未在提供内容中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Mechanistic interpretability lacks a rigorous metric to verify whether two neural network components implement the same computation. Existing similarity measures have fundamental flaws: behavior-based metrics (input-output pairs) fail to generalize OOD and cannot detect backdoors; parameter-based metrics (matrix similarity) are sensitive to weight-space symmetries (neuron permutations). A metric satisfying dataset independence, symmetry invariance, and tractable scalability is needed.
summary_en.importance: Practical value for mechanism analysis and training dynamics monitoring in LLM pretraining. Tensor similarity provides a weight-space method to track functional equivalence, applicable to: detecting functional phase transitions during training (e.g., grokking), validating functional equivalence of model components, monitoring catastrophic forgetting and backdoor injection. It offers a new tool for analyzing internal mechanism changes in pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tensor similarity is a weight-based metric invariant to neural network parameterization symmetries (neuron permutation, cross-layer distribution shifts). It is built on tensor networks—polynomial networks using bilinear layers and product attention instead of non-linear activations and softmax attention. The method extends cosine similarity from vectors to tensor models via an efficient recursive algorithm assessing global functional equivalence. Key innovations: (1) tensor-algebraic weight similarity satisfying all three criteria; (2) attribution of each component's contribution to total similarity; (3) graceful degradation under minor structural perturbations. The trade-off is requiring tensor/polynomial architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments validate discriminative power across domains: (1) tracking catastrophic forgetting in vision models; (2) detecting grokking-like phase transitions in modular arithmetic; (3) monitoring language model training dynamics. Tensor similarity tracks functional training dynamics with higher fidelity than existing metrics (behavioral similarity, matrix similarity) and exposes functional changes missed by other methods. Specific numerical details require referring to the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Chapter 2 (Theory) for the tensor similarity construction and symmetry invariance proofs, and Chapter 3 (Experiments) for training dynamics tracking results. Provides tool-level value for LLM training dynamics analysis and mechanistic interpretability. Estimated reading time: 40-50 minutes; readers without tensor algebra background can skip mathematical derivations.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include tdooms et al. (code at github.com/tdooms/tensor-similarity). Institution information not explicitly provided in available content.

recommendation.zh: 提出了一种对权重空间对称性不变的张量相似度度量，为机制可解释性提供了一个更干净的代数工具，值得关注其在分析 grokking 等训练动态时的表现。
recommendation.en: Proposes a tensor similarity metric invariant to weight-space symmetries, providing a cleaner algebraic tool for mechanistic interpretability. Worth noting its performance in analyzing training dynamics like grokking.

paper.title: Rethinking Layer Relevance in Large Language Models Beyond Cosine Similarity
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized natural language processing. Understanding their internal mechanisms is crucial for developing more interpretable and optimized architectures. Mechanistic interpretability has led to the development of various methods for assessing layer relevance, with cosine similarity being a widely used tool in the field. On this work, we demonstrate that cosine similarity is a poor proxy for the actual performance degradation caused by layer removal. Our theo

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释与结构剪枝里常用“层输入/输出表征的余弦相似度”来衡量层是否重要，但这个指标是否真的反映“删掉该层会让任务性能掉多少”并不清楚。论文要解决的问题是：余弦相似度作为 layer relevance proxy 的可靠性边界在哪里、为什么会失真、以及用什么更贴近真实影响的度量替代。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于提出新训练法，而在于纠正一类被广泛使用的分析/剪枝信号：用余弦相似度判断“冗余层”会系统性误导机制分析结论，也会把剪枝策略带偏。对做训练动态分析、层级退火/裁剪、以及用表征相似度解释“哪些层在做推理”的工作，这篇提供了一个更稳的评估基线：以实际性能退化作为 relevance，并展示旧结论在新度量下会改变（例如推理任务是否真的需要更多层）。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 形式化定义 cosine-similarity relevance：用 1-cos(h_in, h_out) 衡量层改变表征的幅度，并指出它是局部、几何上的度量。
2) 理论反例：构造/证明存在一类层，能让输入输出余弦相似度任意接近 1（即“看起来几乎没变”），但该层引入的微小扰动会被后续层放大，导致最终输出发生巨大变化，性能可从完美到归零。核心机制是“下游放大 + 雪崩效应”，说明余弦相似度无法上界删除层的函数级影响。
3) 实证验证：在多种 LLM 上逐层做 ablation（单独移除某一层并重新评测），计算真实 accuracy drop，并与余弦相似度相关性对比，发现相关性弱到中等，且在研究的绝大多数情形下（文中表述为 90%+）余弦相似度会高估或低估真实重要性。
4) 用 accuracy-drop relevance 复刻并改写既有结论：
- 复刻 He et al. 的“层相关性热力图”，但把颜色含义改为删层后的准确率变化，显示 relevance 强烈依赖数据集/任务，且会暴露出余弦相似度看不出的关键层。
- 复刻 Gromov et al. 的“按不相关层剪掉看推理任务掉多少”，但改为按训练集上的真实 accuracy drop 排序剪层，得到更温和的退化曲线，从而挑战“推理任务需要几乎所有层”的解释。
5) 结构化剪枝应用：在 task-dependent 与 task-independent 两种设置下，用 accuracy-drop relevance 作为剪枝排序信号，与 Taylor 近似、cosine、FinerCut 等对比，报告更好的保真度；同时指出 task-independent 会对校准数据集敏感。
summary.experiments:
关键现象与数字主要围绕“余弦相似度与真实性能退化不一致”。文中给出一个强例：在 OLMo 上，按余弦相似度看第 16 层属于低相关（图示为黄色），但单独移除该层会在 10 个数据集上带来平均 66% 的准确率下降；在 ARC-C 上甚至降到接近随机水平。
复刻剪枝实验时，按 accuracy-drop 排序剪层，在 HellaSwag 上即使移除约 22% 的层仍可保持 75%+ 的准确率（用来反驳“推理任务必须依赖全部层”的强结论）。
此外，论文强调相关性统计上往往只有 weak/moderate，且在 90%+ 的案例里 cosine 会显著偏离真实性能影响（方向可能相反：把关键层判成不重要，或把不重要层判成关键）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看引言里 OLMo layer 16 的反例与 Figure 1（两种 relevance 可视化的对照），把“局部几何相似”与“全局函数影响”区分开。
- 精读理论部分的反例证明：关注“微小扰动如何被下游放大”的条件与构造，这决定了为什么 cosine 没法做上界。
- 看复刻 Gromov/He 的实验段落与 Figure 2：重点是结论如何因度量改变而改变。
- 若关心剪枝落地，直接看 structured pruning 的 task-dependent vs task-independent 对比，以及对 calibration dataset 敏感性的讨论（这部分决定可用性边界）。

summary_en.core_problem: Cosine similarity between a layer’s input and output representations is widely used as a proxy for “layer relevance” in mechanistic interpretability and layer pruning. The paper asks whether this proxy actually tracks what practitioners care about—performance degradation under layer removal—and, if not, why it fails and what metric should replace it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining algorithm, but it matters for how pretraining researchers interpret and modify pretrained Transformers. If cosine-based relevance is unreliable, then conclusions about “which layers do reasoning” and pruning/annealing decisions derived from it can be systematically wrong. The paper pushes a more faithful (but expensive) baseline—direct accuracy drop under layer ablation—and shows that prior narratives can change when evaluated with that metric.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Define the cosine-similarity relevance score as a local measure of representational change (1 − cos between layer input/output).
2) Provide a theoretical worst-case construction: a layer can have arbitrarily high cosine similarity (i.e., appear to do almost nothing) while being functionally critical, because a tiny perturbation introduced at that layer can be amplified by downstream layers, yielding a “snowball” effect that flips final predictions.
3) Empirically test the theory via per-layer ablations across multiple LLMs and tasks, measuring true relevance as the accuracy drop from removing a single layer, and correlating it with cosine-based scores; correlations are often weak to moderate.
4) Re-run prior cosine-driven analyses with the accuracy-drop metric: reproduce layer-relevance heatmaps (in the style of He et al.) and pruning studies (in the style of Gromov et al.), showing materially different interpretations.
5) Apply the metric to structured layer pruning, comparing against cosine similarity, Taylor-style approximations, and FinerCut; accuracy-drop ranking performs best, with a noted sensitivity to the calibration dataset in task-independent pruning.
summary_en.experiments:
A salient example: in OLMo, a layer that looks low-relevance under cosine similarity (layer 16) causes a large average accuracy drop when removed—reported as ~66% averaged over 10 datasets—and can reduce ARC-C performance to near chance.
In a replicated pruning study, ranking layers by actual accuracy drop allows removing ~22% of layers while keeping >75% accuracy on HellaSwag, weakening the claim that reasoning tasks necessarily require (almost) all layers.
Across studied settings, cosine similarity misestimates true relevance in the vast majority of cases (reported as 90%+), sometimes in the most harmful direction (critical layers appearing “irrelevant”).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Start with the motivating counterexample and the side-by-side relevance visualizations (Figure 1) to internalize the failure mode.
- Read the theoretical section carefully: focus on the amplification mechanism and why cosine similarity cannot upper-bound functional impact.
- Check the replication of prior analyses (notably the pruning curve figure) to see how conclusions shift under the new metric.
- If you care about practical pruning, read the structured pruning section and the discussion on calibration-set sensitivity for task-independent use.

recommendation.zh: 修正了机制可解释性领域的常用错误指标，做层剪枝或模型压缩时不要用余弦相似度判断层重要性，看§3的实证结果即可。
recommendation.en: This work disproves cosine similarity as a reliable proxy for layer relevance in LLMs, refer to §3 empirical results if working on model pruning or interpretability.

paper.title: Dual-Pathway Circuits of Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in bridging visual perception and natural language understanding, enabling a wide range of multimodal reasoning tasks. However, they often produce object hallucinations, describing content absent from the input image, which limits their reliability and interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-Pathway Circuit Analysis, a framework that identifies and characterizes hallucination-related circuits in VLMs fo

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 VLM 为什么会在对象存在性问题上产生幻觉。作者没有把幻觉只看成输出层或解码策略的问题，而是追问视觉证据在网络内部如何被传递、在哪里被削弱，以及哪些组件会推动模型回答不存在的对象为“yes”。对象存在性问题相对干净，因为标签是二元的，能减少属性识别和关系推理带来的干扰。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制分析和训练信号诊断。论文显示，不同视觉接入方式的 VLM 中可能形成相似的“视觉 grounding pathway”和“hallucination pathway”。这说明幻觉不一定只是某个架构的局部缺陷，也可能是图文预训练、指令微调和语言先验共同塑造出的稳定计算结构。对基座研究员来说，这类结果有助于把 hallucination mitigation 从后处理和解码约束，推进到训练目标、数据配比和中间表示监督的设计层面。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把语言模型中的 activation patching 扩展到 VLM。作者对五类结构不同的 VLM 做统一分析，但为不同视觉接入方式写了适配器：有的模型直接拼接视觉 embedding，有的用 MLP projector，有的通过 cross-attention 注入视觉信息。每个样本运行 clean pass、corrupt pass 和 patch pass。corrupt pass 在第 0 层视觉 token 上加入 3σ 高斯噪声，使视觉信息基本失效；patch pass 只恢复某一层某一组件的 clean activation。评估指标是最终 token 位置上正确答案与错误答案的 logit 差。若恢复某组件能显著提升该差值，说明该组件承载了视觉证据。作者进一步用 Welch t-test、Benjamini-Hochberg 多重校正和 Cohen’s d 筛出与正确样本、幻觉样本差异显著的组件。d>0 的组件归为 visual grounding pathway，d<0 的组件归为 hallucination pathway。论文还提出 Conditional Pathway Analysis，用来分析同一路径内组件之间的条件依赖，发现 grounding pathway 在正确样本和幻觉样本之间存在 polarity flip，这一点单组件 patching 不容易看出来。
summary.experiments: 实验在每个模型 1000 个 POPE-adversarial 样本上做 patching，样本被分成正确回答“no”和幻觉回答“yes”两组。筛选电路时要求校正后 p<0.05 且 |Cohen’s d|>0.3。主要发现是五个结构不同的 VLM 都出现双路径组织：一条路径支持视觉证据传递，另一条路径更容易推动语言先验式的错误回答。因果验证采用 component-wise suppression，对 hallucination pathway 做定向抑制，最多可降低 76% 的对象幻觉，同时准确率代价不超过 2 个百分点。作者还比较了 matched static-direction baseline，发现逐组件缩放更有效，说明问题不只是某个固定方向上的全局偏置。迁移实验显示，该电路能迁移到 AMBER 的关系幻觉，但不能很好迁移到属性幻觉，提示对象存在和关系判断可能共享部分视觉-语言竞争机制，而属性错误涉及更细粒度的视觉表征。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Methodology，重点看 activation patching 如何适配不同 VLM 架构，以及 visual token corruption 的设定是否足够可比。实验部分优先看 Section 5.1 的双路径定位、Section 5.2 的 Conditional Pathway Analysis、Section 5.5 的 suppression 因果验证、Section 5.6 的 AMBER 迁移。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。值得细看的是 CPA 的定义和 polarity flip 的统计稳定性；如果要把这类方法用于训练诊断，还需要关注 patching 组件粒度、视觉破坏方式和答案 token 选择对结论的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why VLMs hallucinate objects in binary object-existence questions. It treats hallucination as an internal computation problem rather than only a decoding or post-hoc correction problem: where does visual evidence flow, where is it weakened, and which components push the model toward saying that an absent object exists.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is mechanistic diagnosis. The paper reports a shared dual-pathway structure across architecturally different VLMs: a visual grounding pathway and a hallucination pathway. This suggests that object hallucination may be shaped by training data, multimodal alignment, and language priors, not only by one specific connector design. For base-model work, this points toward training-time interventions: better visual evidence supervision, data mixtures that reduce language-prior shortcuts, and mid-training diagnostics on internal pathways.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors extend activation patching to VLMs. Because VLMs inject visual information differently, they implement model-specific adapters for direct visual-token concatenation, MLP projectors, and cross-attention based integration. For each image-question pair, they run a clean pass, a corrupt pass, and a patch pass. The corrupt pass injects 3σ Gaussian noise into visual tokens at layer 0, reducing visual evidence to near chance. The patch pass restores one layer-component activation from the clean run. The indirect effect is measured by the final-token logit gap between the correct and incorrect answer. Components are selected by comparing normalized indirect-effect distributions between correct and hallucinating samples, using Welch’s t-test, Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and a Cohen’s d threshold. Positive-effect components are assigned to the visual grounding pathway; negative-effect components are assigned to the hallucination pathway. Conditional Pathway Analysis then studies within-pathway interactions and reveals a polarity flip in the grounding pathway that standard component-level patching would miss.
summary_en.experiments: The main patching study uses 1,000 POPE-adversarial samples per model. A component enters the circuit if it has corrected p<0.05 and |Cohen’s d|>0.3. Across five VLMs, the authors find a consistent dual-pathway organization. Component-wise suppression of the hallucination pathway reduces object hallucination by up to 76% with no more than a 2 percentage-point accuracy cost. Static-direction baselines are weaker than per-component scaling, which argues against a simple global bias direction explanation. The circuit transfers to relational hallucination on AMBER but not to attribute hallucination, suggesting that object existence and relation errors share more computation than fine-grained attribute errors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Methodology first to understand how activation patching is adapted to different VLM interfaces. Then focus on Section 5.1 for dual-pathway localization, Section 5.2 for Conditional Pathway Analysis, Section 5.5 for causal suppression, and Section 5.6 for transfer to AMBER. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes. The most useful details are the corruption protocol, component granularity, statistical selection rules, and the exact definition of the polarity flip.

recommendation.zh: 只看电路定位和CPA结果；若五个VLM结论一致，可作为多模态预训练接地失败的诊断模板。
recommendation.en: Read the circuit localization and CPA results; if the five-VLM pattern holds, it is a useful diagnostic template for grounding failures in multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: Not Just RLHF: Why Alignment Alone Won't Fix Multi-Agent Sycophancy
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent pipelines flip from correct to incorrect answers under simulated peer disagreement at rates we term yield, a vulnerability widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy. We test this attribution across four model families and find it largely wrong: pretrained base models exhibit the same substitution pattern as their Instruct variants, averaging higher yield than Instruct. Using activation patching, we localize the corruption to a narrow mid-layer window where attention carr

summary.core_problem: 多Agent系统中模型易受同伴观点影响翻转正确答案的问题，普遍被归因于RLHF导致的迎合性，但该归因从未经过基座模型对照和机制层面的验证。
summary.importance: 推翻了多Agent迎合性由RLHF导致的主流认知，明确该问题的源头是预训练阶段就存在的机制，同时定位了故障发生的层范围，为多Agent系统的安全性优化提供了明确方向：无需盲目修改对齐流程，可直接针对中间层做防御或调整Pipeline结构。
summary.technical_approach: 对四个模型家族的基座和指令微调版本做对照测试，用激活补丁方法定位故障发生的网络层位置，拆解攻击面的两个独立影响因子，测试不同缓解方案的效果。
summary.experiments: 在Llama、Mistral、Gemma、Qwen四个模型家族上测试，12组模型×条件中有10组基座模型的答案翻转率高于或等于指令微调版本；故障被定位在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的L14~L18层，补丁L18及以上层可恢复96%的正确概率损失；攻击面由渠道框架和共识强度两个因子组成，3v1多数共识下两者交互带来47.5个百分点的翻转率提升；单个持正确观点的异议者可降低54~73个百分点的翻转率，效果优于系统提示防御方案。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看激活补丁的定位结果、基座和指令模型的对照实验数据、两因子攻击面的拆解部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The problem that models in multi-agent systems tend to flip correct answers under peer influence is widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy, but this attribution has never been verified with base model control groups and mechanism-level analysis.
summary_en.importance: It overturns the mainstream cognition that multi-agent sycophancy is caused by RLHF, clarifies that the problem originates from mechanisms existing in the pre-training stage, and locates the layer range where the failure occurs. It provides a clear direction for security optimization of multi-agent systems: there is no need to blindly modify the alignment process, and defenses can be made for middle layers or pipeline structures can be adjusted directly.
summary_en.technical_approach: Conduct controlled tests on base and instruction-tuned versions of four model families, use activation patching to locate the network layer where the failure occurs, disassemble two independent influencing factors of the attack surface, and test the effect of different mitigation schemes.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on four model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen), the answer flip rate of base models is higher than or equal to that of instruction-tuned versions in 10 of 12 model × condition groups; the failure is located at layers 14~18 of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, patching layers ≥18 can restore 96% of the correct probability loss; the attack surface consists of two factors: channel framing and consensus strength, their interaction brings 47.5 percentage points increase in flip rate under 3v1 majority consensus; a single dissenter with correct views can reduce the flip rate by 54~73 percentage points, outperforming system prompt defense schemes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the localization results of activation patching, the controlled experimental data of base and instruction models, and the disassembly of the two-factor attack surface. Estimated reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了谄媚性全来自RLHF的固有认知，将缺陷根源推回预训练阶段，重点看中层激活定位的实验设计
recommendation.en: Overturns the prior that sycophancy comes only from RLHF, traces the defect root back to pretraining; focus on the mid-layer activation localization experiments.

paper.title: Descriptive Collision in Sparse Autoencoder Auto-Interpretability: When One Explanation Describes Many Features
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are now standard tools for decomposing language model activations into interpretable features, and automated interpretability pipelines routinely assign each feature a short natural-language explanation. Existing critiques of this practice focus on polysemanticity -- one feature with many meanings -- or on whether explanations predict activations. We identify a complementary, structurally distinct problem we call descriptive collision: many distinct SAE features admit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是 SAE 特征本身是否可解释，而是“解释是否能唯一指向特征”。作者指出，现有 auto-interpretability 评估默认把问题设成：给定一个特征，解释是否准确描述它的激活模式；但即便解释是对的，也可能同时适用于很多别的特征。作者把这种 many-features-to-one-explanation 的现象定义为 descriptive collision，并把它和 polysemanticity 区分开：polysemanticity 是一个特征对应多个语义，collision 是多个特征共享同一个语义描述。前者损害解释完整性，后者损害解释辨识性。论文要解决的核心问题，就是现有基于自然语言解释的 SAE 自动解释与打分体系，是否真的在“识别 feature”，还是只是在给 feature 所在的粗语义簇贴标签。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于改进 loss 或架构，而在于给 mechanistic interpretability 里一条常用工作流做了方法学拆解。SAE 已经成为分析 LLM 内部表征的标准工具之一，很多后续结论都建立在“feature 有自然语言标签，且标签可被自动评分验证”这个前提上。作者指出，这个前提缺了一块：高 detection score 只能说明解释抓住了某种可预测模式，不能说明它区分了该 feature 与其他相近 feature。这个问题一旦成立，会影响 feature-level attribution、circuit tracing、feature intervention 结果的可信度边界。贡献量级更像“评估协议层面的校正”，不是提出新 SAE 训练法，但它触及的是解释链条里很基础的一环，因此对依赖 SAE 做 LLM 内部分析的人有现实影响。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是定义。作者把 explanation function 形式化为 E: F→Σ*，并定义 collision cluster，即所有共享同一解释字符串的 feature 集合。进一步用 mutual information I(F;A) 衡量 explanation 对 feature 身份的区分能力，称为 descriptive resolution。这个定义很干净，因为它把“解释是否提供了足够多的信息”从语义直觉变成了可计算的信息量问题：如果标签空间远小于 feature 空间，残余歧义是结构性存在的，而不是某个解释器写得不够好。第二层是经验重分析。作者没有重新训练 SAE，也没有调用 LLM 重新生成解释，而是拿 Marks 等人公开的人类标注语料做分析。这样做的好处是噪声更低，能先证明 collision 在高质量人工标签下都已经很严重，那么在更模板化、更保守的 LLM 自动解释里只会更严重。第三层是评估批判与修正。作者证明 detection-style scoring 在 collision-equivalent features 之间具有不变性：如果两个 feature 共享同一解释，基于“解释能否预测 feature 何时激活”的检测式分数，无法证明这个解释识别的是当前 feature 而不是同簇别的 feature。为此作者提出两个修正方向：一是 discrimination scoring，要求解释不仅能预测目标 feature 的激活，还要能把它和碰撞簇中的其他 feature 区分开；二是 collision-adjusted detection，在原有检测分数上引入对碰撞的校正。文中还给了伪代码，并讨论了计算代价。整体上，这不是一个新模型，而是对 auto-interp 评价目标的重新定义：从“描述得对不对”推进到“描述得是否足以识别”。
summary.experiments: 实验部分以公开人工标注集的统计重分析为主，不是大规模新训练。数据来自 Sparse Feature Circuits 相关公开语料，去重后共 722 个标注特征，覆盖 Gemma 2 2B SAE 的 470 个特征和 Pythia 70M SAE 的 277 个特征。核心数字很明确：722 个特征只对应 235 个不同的 annotation string，平均每个标注字符串被复用 3.07 次；82.1% 的特征至少与另一个特征共享同一标注；最常见的字符串“plural nouns”对应 101 个不同特征，跨越 Pythia 70M 与 Gemma 2 2B、18 个层位和 4 类模型组件。这个结果说明 collision 不是局部偶发现象，而是跨模型、跨层、跨组件都存在。论文的理论部分还给出一个命题：对 detection-style 评分，只要 feature 处于同一 collision cluster，替换成簇内其他 feature 不改变该类评分的判别逻辑，因此高分不能作为 feature identification 的证据。作者没有做新的 intervention 实验，也没有比较不同 LLM explainer 的 collision 率，这一点是边界，也是后续工作空间。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Definitions，抓住作者到底在批评什么：不是解释错，而是解释不够区分。然后看 empirical evidence 的表格和几个最常见 collision case，理解问题规模。接着看理论命题，重点不是证明技巧，而是 detection score 为什么天然忽略 feature identity。最后看作者提出的 discrimination scoring 和 collision-adjusted detection，理解它们各自补哪一块。预计 25-35 分钟能读完主线。若你平时用 SAE 标签做 feature clustering、circuit tracing 或自动筛选 feature，值得多花一点时间想一个问题：你当前 pipeline 里，解释是被当作“语义摘要”还是“feature 标识符”；这篇文章指出这两者不能混用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower but more damaging question than standard SAE auto-interpretability critiques: even if a natural-language explanation is accurate, does it uniquely identify the feature? The authors argue that current pipelines mostly evaluate explanation adequacy for a fixed feature, but ignore a dual failure mode where many distinct SAE features admit the same explanation. They call this descriptive collision. It is different from polysemanticity: polysemanticity is one feature mapping to multiple meanings, while collision is multiple features mapping to one description. The core problem is therefore not whether explanations are truthful, but whether explanation-based evaluation can certify feature identity rather than merely assign a coarse semantic label to a cluster of features.
summary_en.importance: Its value is methodological rather than architectural, but the target is central. SAE-based feature decomposition is now a common tool for interpreting LLM representations, and many downstream claims rely on the assumption that feature labels produced by humans or LLMs are meaningful and can be validated by detection-style scores. This paper shows that such scores may validate semantic overlap without validating identification. That matters for feature attribution, circuit analysis, intervention studies, and any workflow that treats a short explanation as if it were a stable handle on a specific latent. The contribution is not a new SAE training recipe; it is a correction to what current auto-interpretability metrics can and cannot certify.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proceeds in three steps. First, it formalizes the issue. An explanation function E maps features to strings, and the collision cluster of a feature is the set of all features sharing the same explanation. The authors then define descriptive resolution as the mutual information I(F; A) between a uniformly sampled feature F and its assigned explanation A = E(F). This is a useful move because it turns a vague concern about label reuse into an information bottleneck statement: if the explanation space is much smaller than the feature space, ambiguity is structurally unavoidable. Second, the paper performs a reanalysis of a public human-annotated SAE feature corpus rather than generating new labels. This choice is deliberate. Human labels are a cleaner, higher-variance descriptive source than current LLM explainers, so showing severe collision there strengthens the claim that machine-generated labels should be at least as collision-prone. Third, the paper critiques existing evaluation. It proves that detection-style explanation scores are invariant under substitution among collision-equivalent features, meaning a high score cannot establish that the explanation identifies the intended feature rather than another feature in the same collision class. To address this, the authors propose two corrective directions: discrimination scoring, which asks whether an explanation distinguishes the target feature from colliding alternatives, and collision-adjusted detection, which modifies standard detection-style evaluation to account for ambiguity. The paper also provides pseudocode and discusses computational cost. The main conceptual shift is from explanation correctness to explanation identifiability.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section is a statistical reanalysis rather than a new large-scale training study. The dataset comes from the public human-annotated corpus associated with Sparse Feature Circuits. After deduplication, it contains 722 annotated features: 470 from Gemma 2 2B SAEs and 277 from Pythia 70M SAEs. The headline numbers are strong. Those 722 features correspond to only 235 distinct annotation strings. The mean annotation string is reused across 3.07 features. 82.1% of features share their annotation with at least one other feature. The most frequent label, “plural nouns,” is assigned to 101 distinct features spanning both model families, 18 layers, and four model components. This makes collision look structural rather than anecdotal. On the theoretical side, the paper proves a proposition showing that detection-style scoring cannot distinguish among features within the same collision cluster, so high explanation scores do not imply successful feature identification. The paper does not include new intervention experiments, new SAE training runs, or a comparison of collision rates across different LLM explainers; those are left for follow-up work.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the formal definitions. The key is to understand that the critique is not “the explanation is wrong,” but “the explanation is too non-specific to identify the feature.” Then read the empirical table and the examples of repeated labels to get a sense of scale. After that, look at the proposition about detection-style score invariance; the proof itself is simple, but the implication is the main point. Finally, read the sections on discrimination scoring and collision-adjusted detection to see what a better evaluation target would look like. About 25 to 35 minutes is enough for the main thread. If you use SAE labels for feature search, clustering, or circuit tracing, it is worth pausing on one practical question: are your labels acting as semantic summaries, or as identifiers? The paper argues that current pipelines often conflate the two.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 SAE 自动解释中的 'descriptive collision' 现象（多个 feature 对应同一个解释），对做 mech interp 和特征级控制的研究员是很好的避坑指南，建议看量化分析部分。
recommendation.en: Reveals the 'descriptive collision' phenomenon in SAE automated interpretation (multiple features mapping to the same explanation), serving as a great pitfall guide for mech interp and feature-level control researchers. Skim the quantitative analysis.

paper.title: When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction
paper.abstract: Large language models can follow complex instructions in a single turn, yet over long multi-turn interactions they often lose the thread of instructions, persona, and rules. This degradation has been measured behaviorally but not mechanistically explained. We propose a channel-transition account: goal-defining tokens become less accessible through attention, while goal-related information may persist in residual representations. We introduce the Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR), measuring attentio

summary.core_problem: 解释多轮对话中模型为何会逐步“丢掉系统提示里的目标/规则/人设”，并给出可预测、可诊断的机制指标。论文提出一个两通道解释：目标信息一开始主要通过注意力通道从系统提示 token 直接可达；随着轮次增长，注意力对这些 token 的可达性下降并进入“关闭”区间，之后行为更多依赖残差流里先前写入的内部表征是否还保留了目标状态。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对训练动态与架构选择有直接启发：1）把“长对话失忆/失规”从纯行为现象变成可测的内部量（GAR），便于做架构对比与回归测试；2）揭示不同架构在残差通道保留目标信息的深度位置差异很大（层 2 到层 27），这会影响你如何做中期训练（mid-train）或对齐训练来强化长程遵循；3）对长上下文训练的一个现实提醒：仅靠扩大窗口不等于目标 token 可达，位置衰减与注意力分配会产生“可达性阈值”。
summary.technical_approach:
提出“channel-transition account”。把目标条件化信息的跨轮传播分为两条路径：
- Attention channel：生成时对系统提示中“目标定义 token 集合”的注意力质量。
- Residual channel：早期层在残差流中写入并在后续位置/轮次中保留的目标相关表征。

三个工具：
1）GAR（Goal Accessibility Ratio）：统计生成 token 对目标 token 的注意力质量（跨层跨头平均）。它不是通用质量分数，而是架构相关的诊断量。
2）Sliding-window ablation：用滑动窗口裁剪上下文，因果地“关闭”对系统提示的直接注意力通道，并观察行为何时崩。
3）Residual-stream probes：在线性可分性层面探测残差流中是否仍可解码出“本回合是否能回忆/遵循目标”的结果变量，用 AUC 衡量；并用输入 embedding 探针作对照，证明信号不是来自浅层词面。

作者把“注意力关闭点”与窗口大小建立了近线性的剂量-反应关系，从而能参数化预测多轮失败发生的轮次。
summary.experiments:
覆盖四个开源架构（Mistral、Qwen、LLaMA、Mixtral）：
- GAR 在所有架构上随轮次单调下降（每个架构 Mann-Kendall p < 1e-7）。
- 通过 sliding-window ablation，关闭点与窗口大小呈线性剂量-反应关系（R^2 > 0.999），说明这是一个强可预测的几何/位置信号，而非偶然行为波动。
- 残差流线性探针可以高精度预测每个 episode 的回忆/遵循结果，AUC 最高到 0.99；对 input embedding 的探针接近随机，支持“残差通道确实携带目标状态”。
- 目标信息在网络中变得线性可解码的层深因架构差异很大：最浅到第 2 层，最深到第 27 层。
- 架构差异的行为侧表现：Mistral 在关闭后仍保留较多目标条件化行为且随目标复杂度呈渐变退化；LLaMA/Qwen 更像对复杂度不敏感的整体失败；Mixtral 出现中层深度附近的“相变式”可解码性跃迁。

这些结果更像机制诊断而非刷榜；它的价值在于给长对话遵循问题提供了可复现实验范式与可量化指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1 的两通道示意与 GAR 定义，理解作者把问题拆成“注意力可达性”与“残差保留”。
2）看 GAR 随轮次下降的主图，以及不同架构的对比图，抓住“关闭点”概念。
3）看 sliding-window ablation 的线性剂量-反应结果（R^2>0.999 那张图/表），这是最强的因果证据。
4）看 residual probe 的 AUC 结果与“可解码层深”分析，理解为什么不同架构关闭后的失败形态不同。
5）如果你做长上下文/多轮对齐训练，建议把 GAR 当成回归指标：在 mid-train 或 cooldown 后测 GAR 曲线是否右移、残差可解码层是否前移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why LLMs gradually lose adherence to system-prompt goals (instructions/persona/rules) over long multi-turn interactions, and proposes a mechanistic, predictive diagnostic. It argues for a two-channel transition: early on, goal tokens are directly accessible via attention; as turns progress, attention to those goal-defining tokens decays and eventually enters a “closure” regime, after which behavior depends on whether goal state has been preserved indirectly in residual-stream representations.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for architecture/optimization-facing researchers because it turns a messy behavioral failure into measurable internal quantities. GAR can serve as a regression metric for long-dialogue instruction-following. The finding that goal information becomes linearly decodable at very different depths across architectures (layer ~2 to ~27) suggests that “what survives after attention closure” is an architectural property—relevant when designing mid-training or alignment interventions for long-context and multi-turn settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed channel-transition account decomposes goal-conditioned state propagation into:
- An attention channel: direct attention mass from generated tokens to goal-defining tokens in the system prompt.
- A residual channel: goal-related information written into and carried by the residual stream.

Three instruments:
1) Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR): average attention mass from generated tokens to the goal-token set, aggregated across heads/layers.
2) Sliding-window ablations: causally close the attention channel by truncating context windows and observing when compliance collapses.
3) Linear residual-stream probes: test whether per-episode compliance/recall outcomes are decodable from residual activations (AUC), with input-embedding probes as a control.

A key claim is that the turn at which attention “closes” is parametrically predictable from window size (a near-perfect linear dose-response).
summary_en.experiments:
Across four open-weight architectures (Mistral, Qwen, LLaMA, Mixtral):
- GAR declines monotonically with turn count for every architecture (Mann–Kendall p < 1e-7).
- Sliding-window ablations show a linear dose-response between window size and the crossover/closure turn (R^2 > 0.999), supporting a strong causal link.
- Residual-stream probes predict per-episode recall/compliance with AUC up to 0.99, while input-embedding probes are near chance—evidence that goal state persists in residual representations even when attention access fades.
- The layer at which goal information becomes linearly decodable varies widely by architecture (as early as layer 2, as late as layer 27).
- Post-closure behavioral differences: Mistral degrades more gracefully with goal complexity; LLaMA/Qwen fail more uniformly; Mixtral shows a sharp mid-depth “phase-transition-like” rise in decodability.

Overall, the contribution is a reproducible diagnostic framework rather than a performance benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
1) Start with the two-channel schematic and the GAR definition.
2) Look at the main GAR-vs-turn plots and identify the closure regime per architecture.
3) Read the sliding-window ablation section and the linear dose-response result (R^2 > 0.999); this is the strongest causal evidence.
4) Review the residual-probe AUC results and the “decodable depth” analysis to understand architecture-specific failure modes.
5) If you work on long-context or multi-turn alignment, consider GAR as a regression metric to track whether mid-training/cooldown shifts the closure point or changes residual retention.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 GAR、残差 probe 和因果干预；它提醒长对话失控不等于信息消失，而是读出通道坏了。
recommendation.en: Skim GAR, residual probes, and causal interventions; the useful prior shift is that multi-turn failure can be a broken readout channel, not erased information.

paper.title: Routers Learn the Geometry of Their Experts: Geometric Coupling in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models enable scaling language models efficiently, but training them remains challenging, as routing can collapse onto few experts and auxiliary load-balancing losses can reduce specialization. Motivated by these hurdles, we study how routing decisions in SMoEs are formed mechanistically. First, we reveal a geometric coupling between routers and their corresponding experts. For a given token, the router weights for the selected expert and the expert weights proce

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章要解决的不是“MoE 为什么能省算力”这种宏观问题，而是一个更底层、也更难回答的问题：Sparse MoE 里的 router 到底学到了什么几何结构，为什么路由会塌缩，为什么常见的 load-balancing loss 一边改善负载均衡，一边又伤害 expert specialization。作者试图从梯度和表示几何出发，把 router 与 expert 之间的关系讲清楚，而不是把路由器当成一个黑盒打分模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值很高，尤其对大规模 MoE 训练。文章的贡献不在于提出一个立刻替代现有工业路由器的方案，而在于给出一个机制层面的解释框架：router 与其对应 expert 在训练中会沿着相同输入方向累积更新，形成几何耦合；而常见 auxiliary balancing loss 会向所有 router 方向注入与输入相关的梯度，导致不同 expert 的 router 方向被拉近，从而削弱 specialization。这个结论直接触及 MoE 训练里的核心张力：负载均衡与专家分工不是两个独立旋钮，而是在参数几何上彼此牵连。对设计更稳的路由损失、理解 expert collapse、分析 DeepSeek/OLMoE 一类大模型中的专家分工，都有实质参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线分三层。第一层是理论分析。作者从标准 top-k sparse MoE 层的前向和反向推导出一个很关键的结论：对于某个被分配到 expert i 的 token，router 中与 expert i 对应的权重向量，以及 expert i 内部处理该 token 的权重，会沿着同一个输入 hidden state 方向接收梯度，差别主要在标量系数。也就是说，router 和 expert 虽然是两个模块，但它们不是各学各的；在被路由 token 的条件下，它们共享了同一组“输入方向历史”，因此会形成 matched router–expert directions。这个结论并不是“共享计算图所以梯度相关”那么泛，而是更强的输入方向对齐。第二层是经验验证。作者在一个从头训练的 1B 级 SMoE 上，比较 router 对 expert 的打分排序与该 expert 内部神经元激活强度，发现 router 排名更高的 expert，内部响应也更强；这说明路由决策并非外部硬分配，而是与 expert 的内部计算几何一致。第三层是对 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的再解释。常见 balancing loss 为了让各 expert 使用更均匀，会对每个 token 的所有 router 权重都施加更新，而不是只更新被选中的 expert。这会把原本由 routed token history 形成的 expert-specific 方向混合掉。作者理论上说明了这一点，并在实验中观察到：加入 auxiliary loss 后，不同 router weight vectors 的相似度接近提升到原来的 3 倍，几何上更趋同。基于这个分析，作者进一步提出一个 parameter-free centroid router：不用学习 router 权重，而是让每个 expert 维护其已接收 hidden states 的在线 K-Means/EMA 质心，路由时按与质心的 cosine similarity 选择 expert，并配合 sign-updated bias 调整负载。这个设计不是为了追求更高上限，而是验证“router 学到的很大一部分就是各 expert 所覆盖 token 分布的几何中心”。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕三个问题展开。第一，几何耦合是否真实存在。作者在约 1B 参数的 SMoE 上从头训练约 50B tokens，观察 router 排名与 expert 激活之间的对应关系，结果显示被 router 排得更高的 expert，在处理同一 token 时也有更强的内部激活，这支持了理论中的耦合假设。第二，auxiliary balancing loss 如何改变几何。作者训练两套除 balancing 规则外完全相同的 1B SMoE，对比 router 权重方向的相似性，发现带 auxiliary loss 的模型中，不同 router 向量彼此更接近，近似达到无该损失时的 3 倍相似度；同时负载更均衡，但 specialization 被削弱。第三，centroid router 能否复现 learned router 的主要功能。结果是它在所有变体里取得了最低的 load imbalance，同时 perplexity 与不使用 auxiliary loss 的 learned router 接近，只是有温和退化。摘要里没有给出完整 PPL 数字，但全文的重点不是绝对困惑度，而是证明一个非参数、基于聚类中心的路由器已经能覆盖 learned routing 的相当一部分作用。值得注意的是，作者把“更均衡”和“更好语言建模”明确分开讨论，没有把负载指标改善直接包装成整体质量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇需要精读。先看理论部分，重点抓住 router 权重与 expert 权重对同一 token 的梯度方向为何会对齐。这里最好顺着公式把链式法则推一遍，否则后面的几何结论容易看成直觉描述。然后看经验部分里 router score 与 expert activation 的对应图，这一节把“几何耦合”从公式落到可观测现象。接着重点看 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的分析与相似度统计，这是全文最直接影响 MoE 训练实践的部分：它解释了为什么常见 balancing 虽然有效，却可能把 router 学成一组彼此相近的方向。最后看 centroid router 的实现细节，尤其是 online K-Means/EMA 更新、cosine routing 和 bias 调整方式。阅读时建议把它当成一个机制论文，而不是一个追求 benchmark 最优的模型论文。最值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种几何耦合在 top-1、top-2、shared expert、capacity constraint 等工业设定下是否仍然成立；二是能否据此设计只在未选 expert 上施加更弱、或更去方向化的 balancing 信号，从而少破坏 specialization。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a mechanistic question at the heart of sparse MoE training: what geometry does the router actually learn, why does routing collapse happen, and why do standard load-balancing losses improve utilization while often weakening expert specialization? Instead of treating the router as a black-box scorer, the authors analyze the joint geometry of router and experts during training.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant to pretraining, especially for large-scale MoE language models. The main contribution is not a drop-in industrial routing recipe, but a useful explanatory framework. The paper shows that router directions and their matched expert directions are geometrically coupled through training gradients, and that common auxiliary balancing losses interfere with this coupling by pushing all router directions with input-dependent gradients. That directly reframes a central MoE tension: load balancing and specialization are not independent knobs; they interact through parameter geometry. This has clear implications for routing-loss design, expert-collapse analysis, and interpretation of expert specialization in systems such as DeepSeek-style or OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three layers. First is the theoretical analysis. Starting from a standard sparse top-k MoE layer, the authors derive that for a token routed to expert i, the router weight vector associated with expert i and the expert weights processing that token receive gradients along the same input hidden-state direction, differing mainly by scalar coefficients. This is stronger than the generic statement that both modules are in the same computation graph. It means matched router–expert pairs accumulate updates from the same routed-token history and therefore evolve as coupled geometric directions. Second is empirical validation. In a 1B-scale SMoE trained from scratch, the paper compares router scores with the internal activations of experts on the same token and finds that experts ranked higher by the router also respond more strongly internally. So routing is not merely an external assignment layer; it is mirrored in expert computation. Third is a reinterpretation of the auxiliary load-balancing loss. Because this loss sends gradients to every router direction on every token, not only to selected experts, it mixes expert-specific directions and weakens the natural coupling induced by routed-token history. The paper supports this both theoretically and empirically. Motivated by that view, the authors introduce a parameter-free centroid router: each expert maintains an online K-Means or EMA centroid of the hidden states assigned to it, and routing is done by cosine similarity to these centroids, with sign-updated biases for load control. The point is not to beat learned routers outright, but to test whether a large part of routing can be explained as geometric summarization of expert-specific token regions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments address three questions. First, does geometric coupling appear in practice? On a roughly 1B-parameter SMoE trained from scratch on about 50B tokens, the paper shows that experts receiving higher router scores also exhibit stronger internal activations for the same token, which supports the coupling hypothesis. Second, how does auxiliary balancing alter geometry? The authors train two otherwise matched 1B SMoEs differing only in the balancing rule and measure similarity among router directions. With the auxiliary loss, distinct router vectors become nearly three times more similar, indicating stronger directional homogenization. Load balance improves, but specialization weakens. Third, can a centroid router recover much of the learned router’s function? The answer is largely yes: the centroid router achieves the lowest load imbalance among the tested variants while keeping perplexity close to the learned router trained without the auxiliary loss, with only a modest degradation. The paper is careful not to conflate better utilization with better language modeling; the empirical emphasis is on explaining routing behavior rather than claiming absolute perplexity gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one deserves a careful read. Start with the theory section and work through the gradient derivation; the key idea is why router and expert updates align along the same token direction. Without that, the later geometric claims can sound more intuitive than they really are. Then read the plots comparing router scores and expert activations, since they turn the theory into an observable training phenomenon. After that, focus on the analysis of the auxiliary load-balancing loss and the router-direction similarity statistics; this is the part with the clearest practical consequence for MoE training. Finish with the centroid-router section, especially the online K-Means or EMA update rule, cosine routing, and bias adjustment. The paper is best read as a mechanism paper, not as a benchmark paper. Two follow-up questions are especially worth thinking about: whether the same coupling survives in industrial settings with top-2 routing, shared experts, and capacity constraints; and whether one can design balancing signals that regulate load without injecting strongly direction-collapsing gradients into all router vectors.

recommendation.zh: 极佳的 MoE 机制分析工作！揭示了 Router 和 Expert 梯度更新的几何耦合，解释了为什么 load-balancing loss 会损害专业化，做 MoE 预训练的同学必须精读其理论推导和 1B 模型的实证分析。
recommendation.en: Excellent mechanistic analysis of MoE! Reveals the geometric coupling of gradient updates between routers and experts, explaining why load-balancing loss harms specialization. A must-read for anyone doing MoE pretraining, especially the theoretical derivation and 1B empirical analysis.

institutions: Blavatnik School of Computer Science and AI, Tel Aviv University

paper.title: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks, yet their internal decision-making processes remain largely opaque, limiting our ability to inspect, control, and systematically improve them. This opacity motivates a growing body of research in mechanistic interpretability, with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) emerging as one of the most promising tools for decomposing model activations into sparse, interpretable feature representations. We introduce Qwen-Scope, an op

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把 sparse autoencoder 从事后解释工具推进到模型开发接口：不仅用 SAE 分解 Qwen 系列模型的内部激活，还尝试用这些稀疏特征做 steering、评测分析、数据构造和后训练干预。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的价值主要在机制分析和训练闭环。SAE 特征如果足够稳定，可以成为一种表示层 API：帮助定位模型行为来源，分析 benchmark 覆盖和冗余，筛选或合成训练数据，并给 SFT/RL 提供更细粒度的训练信号。它不是预训练算法论文，但对模型调试、数据治理、post-train 反馈 pretrain 的流程有实用参考。
summary.technical_approach: Qwen-Scope 释放了覆盖 Qwen3 与 Qwen3.5 的 SAE 组件，共 7 个模型变体、14 组 SAE，包含 dense 和 MoE 架构。SAE 通过过完备稀疏字典重构模型激活，使每个输入只激活少量 latent feature，从而把高维 hidden state 拆成可检查、可干预的方向。应用层面包括四类：推理时 feature steering，用于控制语言、概念和偏好；用 feature coverage 分析评测集能力覆盖、冗余和表示集中；用 SAE 特征做多语 toxicity 分类与安全数据合成；在后训练中加入特征级约束，例如 SFT 时压制语言特定特征以减少 code-switching，RL 时 steering 重复相关特征来合成少见的负样本 rollout。
summary.experiments: 给出的内容强调应用验证而非单一 benchmark 数字。主要结果包括：feature-level intervention 可以在不改模型权重的情况下改变输出行为；feature coverage 可用于分析评测集之间的重叠和冗余；SAE 特征可迁移到数据分类与安全数据合成；在 SFT 中加入抑制语言特定特征的辅助损失可减少 code-switching；在 RL 中利用重复相关特征合成负例，为 endless repetition 提供更明确的训练信号。具体指标、层选择、字典规模、稀疏度和消融数字需要看正文表格和附录。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若准备复现实验则再细读训练细节。优先看 Section 2，确认 SAE 覆盖的模型、层、训练数据、稀疏约束和重构质量。然后选择性阅读 Section 3 的 steering、Section 4 的 feature coverage 评测分析、Section 7–8 的 SFT/RL 应用。对预训练研究员更有用的是 feature coverage 能否成为数据覆盖代理指标，以及特征级辅助损失是否会引入能力副作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The work turns sparse autoencoders from a post-hoc interpretability tool into a practical interface for developing Qwen-family language models. It aims to use sparse features not only to inspect activations, but also to steer behavior, analyze evaluations, build data workflows, and guide post-training.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly in mechanistic analysis and the pretrain-posttrain feedback loop. If SAE features are stable and reusable, they can serve as a representation-level API for model debugging: identifying behavioral causes, measuring benchmark coverage, filtering or synthesizing data, and creating more targeted SFT or RL signals. This is not a new pretraining method, but it is useful infrastructure for model development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Qwen-Scope releases 14 groups of SAEs across 7 Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 variants, covering both dense and mixture-of-experts backbones. Each SAE learns an overcomplete sparse dictionary that reconstructs internal activations with a small number of active latent features. The paper then demonstrates four use cases: inference-time feature steering for language, concepts, and preferences; feature coverage as a proxy for benchmark overlap and redundancy; data-centric workflows such as multilingual toxicity classification and safety-oriented data synthesis; and post-training interventions, including an SFT auxiliary loss that suppresses language-specific features to reduce code-switching and an RL workflow that steers repetition-related features to create rare negative rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content describes a broad application suite rather than a single numerical result.
