The reported findings are that feature-level interventions can steer behavior without changing weights, feature coverage can expose redundancy and representational concentration in evaluation sets, SAE features can support data classification and safety data synthesis, and feature-guided losses or rollouts can be used in SFT and RL. Exact metrics, dictionary sizes, sparsity settings, reconstruction losses, and ablation results should be checked in the corresponding tables and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. Start with Section 2 to inspect the released SAE coverage, training setup, activation sites, sparsity choices, and reconstruction quality. Then read Section 3 for steering, Section 4 for feature coverage over benchmarks, and Sections 7–8 for SFT and RL applications. For pretraining researchers, the most relevant questions are whether feature coverage can act as a proxy for data or benchmark coverage, and whether feature-level auxiliary objectives introduce hidden capability trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 更像工具链论文，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；但如果你在做 SAE/feature steering，只看资源覆盖、MoE 支持和几个开发用例就够了。
recommendation.en: This is more tooling than new science, so it will not shift your pretraining prior; still, if you care about SAEs or feature steering, check the asset coverage, MoE support, and a few concrete development use cases.

paper.title: Targeted Neuron Modulation via Contrastive Pair Search
paper.abstract: Language models are instruction-tuned to refuse harmful requests, but the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. Popular steering methods operate on the residual stream and degrade output coherence at high intervention strengths, limiting their practical use. We introduce contrastive neuron attribution (CNA), which identifies the 0.1% of MLP neurons whose activations most distinguish harmful from benign prompts, requiring only forward passes with no gradients or auxiliary

summary.core_problem: 现有基于残差流的大模型行为干预方法粒度太粗，高干预强度下会严重损害输出连贯性，且对齐微调后模型的拒答行为在神经元层面的形成机制尚不清晰，缺乏精准定位和调控拒答相关神经元回路的方法。
summary.importance: 验证了大模型对齐微调过程中会形成稀疏、稳定的拒答相关神经元回路，而非复用基础模型原有的功能模块，为理解对齐的机制起源提供了直接的神经元级证据；同时提供了一种无需梯度、无需额外训练的轻量行为调控方法，相比残差流干预方法在效果和输出质量上更优。
summary.technical_approach: 提出对比神经元归因（CNA）方法，将对比激活的思路从残差流维度下沉到单个MLP神经元维度：分别输入有害和无害两组对比提示，记录最后一个token位置的MLP神经元激活值，计算每个神经元在两组提示下的平均激活差，选取激活差绝对值最大的0.1%神经元作为目标回路，通过置零这些神经元的激活实现对拒答行为的调控。该方法仅需要前向传播，无需梯度或额外训练。
summary.experiments: 在Llama和Qwen两个架构、1B到72B参数量的基础模型和指令微调模型上开展实验：在指令微调模型中置0.1%的MLP神经元激活，可在JBB-Behaviors越狱基准上降低超过50%的拒答率，同时保持输出的连贯性和流畅度，所有参数量级和架构下效果一致；在基础模型上执行相同操作不会改变拒答行为，只会调整输出内容，证明拒答回路是对齐微调过程中新形成的功能结构。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3节方法部分的神经元选择和干预逻辑，第4节的基础模型与指令微调模型的对比实验结果是核心结论支撑，可关注不同参数量下的一致性表现，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing residual-stream-based LLM behavior steering methods are too coarse-grained and severely degrade output coherence at high intervention strengths. In addition, the neuron-level formation mechanism of refusal behavior in alignment-fine-tuned models remains unclear, lacking methods to accurately locate and modulate refusal-related neuron circuits.
summary_en.importance: It validates that sparse and stable refusal-related neuron circuits are formed during alignment fine-tuning, rather than reusing existing functional modules in base models, providing direct neuron-level evidence for understanding the mechanistic origin of alignment. It also proposes a lightweight behavior steering method that requires no gradients or additional training, outperforming residual-stream intervention methods in both effect and output quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Contrastive Neuron Attribution (CNA) is proposed, extending the contrastive activation idea from the residual stream dimension to individual MLP neurons: two sets of contrastive prompts (harmful vs. benign) are fed into the model, MLP neuron activations at the last token position are recorded, the average activation difference of each neuron between the two sets is computed, and the top 0.1% of neurons by absolute activation difference are selected as the target circuit. Refusal behavior is modulated by clamping these neurons' activations to zero. This method only requires forward passes with no gradients or additional training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on base and instruct variants of Llama and Qwen architectures with parameters ranging from 1B to 72B: clamping 0.1% of MLP neuron activations in instruct models reduces refusal rates by over 50% on the JBB-Behaviors jailbreak benchmark while maintaining output coherence and fluency, with consistent results across all model sizes and architectures. Applying the same operation to base models does not change refusal behavior but only adjusts output content, proving that refusal circuits are new functional structures formed during alignment fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the neuron selection and intervention logic in the method section (Section 3). The comparative experiment results between base and instruct models in Section 4 are the core support for the conclusion; pay attention to the consistent performance across different parameter scales. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 通过对比搜索定位极少数 MLP 神经元来控制模型拒绝行为，且对比了 base 和 instruct 模型的差异，对理解 alignment 机制和设计更精细的 steering 方法有启发，建议阅读实验分析部分。
recommendation.en: Locates a tiny fraction of MLP neurons via contrastive search to control refusal behavior, comparing base and instruct models; insightful for understanding alignment mechanisms and designing finer steering methods, worth skimming the experimental analysis.

paper.title: Stories in Space: In-Context Learning Trajectories in Conceptual Belief Space
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) update their behavior in context, which can be viewed as a form of Bayesian inference. However, the structure of the latent hypothesis space over which this inference operates remains unclear. In this work, we propose that LLMs assign beliefs over a low-dimensional geometric space - a conceptual belief space - and that in-context learning corresponds to a trajectory through this space as beliefs are updated over time. Using story understanding as a natural setting fo

summary.core_problem: 解释自由文本场景下的 in-context learning（ICL）动态：当模型读故事、不断接收新信息时，它的“信念更新”并不总是像 few-shot 分类那样单调稳定。论文试图回答：这种非线性更新背后，是否存在一个低维、带几何结构的潜在“概念信念空间”，使得 ICL 可以被理解为在该空间中的轨迹运动，并且这种结构能同时在行为与内部表征中被观测到。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接改动不多，但对“ICL 机制如何落在表征空间里”给了一个可操作的分析框架：把 ICL 从离散的“选哪个假设”扩展为连续几何空间中的“轨迹”。如果这个假设在更多任务上成立，它会影响两类预训练研究：
- 训练目标与表征：什么样的预训练信号会诱导出更低维、更可线性读出的概念坐标系。
- 训练动态与可控性：通过对隐藏状态的线性干预来改变 ICL 轨迹，提示“可控 ICL”可能不必依赖权重更新或外部工具，而是依赖表征几何的可分解性。
summary.technical_approach:
论文把 Bayesian ICL 的“假设空间”具体化为带度量的概念空间，并把“信念”定义为概念空间上的分布，从而得到一个更高一层的信念空间。
1) 概念空间（conceptual space）：借鉴 Gärdenfors 的 conceptual spaces，把概念表示为低维属性空间中的区域，空间带有距离度量，距离刻画相似性。
2) 概念信念空间（conceptual belief space）：把点从“概念空间中的位置”提升为“概念空间上的概率分布”，并在分布空间上定义度量，从而可以把信念更新看成连续轨迹。
3) 任务设置：用 story understanding 作为动态证据累积的自然场景。故事推进会引入新事件/主题/意图线索，使模型需要不断修正对潜在概念的判断。
4) 三类证据链：
- 行为层：模型输出随上下文推进呈现可解释的更新轨迹。
- 表征层：隐藏状态可被线性 probe 映射到该低维空间坐标，从而预测行为。
- 干预层：对隐藏表征做定向干预可以“转向”轨迹，进而改变后续 ICL 行为。
整体取舍是：不强行拟合完整的贝叶斯更新过程（因为自由文本证据结构太复杂），而是先验证是否存在稳定的低维几何结构可承载这种更新。
summary.experiments:
论文声称的关键结果包括：
- 低维流形：信念更新可被描述为低维、结构化流形上的平滑轨迹，而不是高维随机游走。
- 行为-表征一致性：用线性 probe 读取隐藏表示，可以在该空间中预测模型的行为变化。
- 可控性：通过对隐藏表示的干预，能够系统性改变 ICL 轨迹。
注：你提供的全文片段未包含实验设置细节（具体模型、数据、维度选择、评价指标）与定量结果表；若要给出数字级总结，需要补齐方法与实验章节的表格/附录内容。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先读方法框架：Conceptual space 与 Conceptual belief space 的定义，以及他们如何把 Bayesian ICL 的“假设”连续化。
- 重点看他们如何把“故事理解”任务参数化成可测的信念变量（通常决定了后续所有分析是否站得住）。
- 结果部分优先看两块：线性 probe 的可预测性（证明结构可读出）与 representation intervention（证明结构可操控）。
- 如果时间有限，可以跳过较长的认知科学背景综述，直接抓住：空间定义→可视化/降维证据→probe→干预这条主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in common Bayesian accounts of in-context learning: in free-form text (e.g., story understanding), belief updates are often non-monotonic and idiosyncratic, and it is unclear what latent hypothesis space the model is effectively performing inference over. The authors hypothesize a low-dimensional, geometric “conceptual belief space,” where ICL corresponds to a trajectory as the model updates beliefs over time.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a mechanism/representation paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but concrete: if ICL dynamics are constrained to low-dimensional structured manifolds that are linearly readable and steerable, then pretraining objectives and data distributions that shape representation geometry may be the real levers behind robust, controllable ICL. It also suggests a path to controlling ICL without weight updates—via representation-level interventions—provided the geometry is stable.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work instantiates the Bayesian ‘hypothesis space’ as a metric conceptual space and lifts it to a belief space of distributions.
1) Conceptual space: following Gärdenfors, concepts live in a low-dimensional attribute space with a distance metric encoding similarity; concepts correspond to regions.
2) Conceptual belief space: beliefs are probability distributions over the conceptual space; belief updating becomes motion (a trajectory) in this lifted space.
3) Setting: story understanding is used as a natural sequential evidence-accumulation environment, where new narrative information forces continual belief revision.
4) Evidence stack:
- Behavioral: model outputs over story progression reflect systematic belief changes.
- Representational: linear probes on hidden states predict positions/updates in the proposed space.
- Interventional: manipulating hidden representations can steer the trajectory and alter subsequent ICL behavior.
A key design choice is to avoid fully specifying the Bayesian update rule for arbitrary text; instead, the paper tests whether a stable low-dimensional geometry exists that can support such dynamics.
summary_en.experiments:
Claimed empirical results:
- Belief updates lie on low-dimensional, structured manifolds and follow smooth trajectories.
- Linear probes on internal representations predict behavioral belief updates in that space.
- Representation interventions steer trajectories, changing downstream in-context behavior.
Note: the provided excerpt does not include the concrete experimental protocol (models, datasets, dimensionality choices, metrics) or quantitative tables. Precise numbers require the full methods/results sections and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Focus on the formal definitions of conceptual space and conceptual belief space, and how they operationalize ‘belief’ for sequential text.
- Check how the story task is parameterized into measurable belief variables; this is the linchpin for the rest.
- In results, prioritize (i) probe predictability (readout) and (ii) representation intervention (steering), since these are the strongest tests of the hypothesis.
- The cognitive-science motivation can be skimmed if time is limited; keep the pipeline: space definition → manifold/trajectory evidence → probe → intervention.

recommendation.zh: 只看表征轨迹和干预实验；若 setup 足够干净，它会把 ICL 的“贝叶斯类比”变成可操作的测量对象。
recommendation.en: Read the trajectory and intervention sections; if the setup is clean, it turns the Bayesian ICL analogy into something measurable.

paper.title: Tool Calling is Linearly Readable and Steerable in Language Models
paper.abstract: When a tool-calling agent picks the wrong tool, the failure is invisible until execution: the email gets sent, the meeting gets missed. Probing 12 instruction-tuned models across Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Qwen 2.5, and Llama 3.1 (270M to 27B), we find the identity of the chosen tool is linearly readable and steerable inside the model. Adding the mean-difference between two tools' average internal activations switches which tool the model selects at 77-100% accuracy on name-only single-turn prompts (93-10

summary.core_problem: 论文问的是：工具调用模型在输出工具名之前，内部是否已经形成了可读、可干预的工具选择表示。这个问题的风险点在于，错误工具调用通常要到执行后才暴露。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把工具选择从纯行为层面的 agent 失败，拉回到表示学习和指令微调接口。实验显示，base 模型中已经存在较强的工具身份信号，指令微调更多是在把这个信号接到输出层，而不是从零产生该能力。这对理解 pretrain 到 tool-use posttrain 的迁移有价值，也提示工具调用安全监控可以直接读 residual stream，而不一定依赖额外分类器或执行后反馈。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 mean-difference steering。先收集某个工具在若干查询下的平均 hidden activation，再用目标工具均值减去源工具均值得到方向向量。生成时把这个向量加到 residual stream 上，观察模型是否切换工具。论文还做了 PCA、matched-prompt control、activation patching 和 circuit tracing，避免把共享 prompt 结构误判为工具专用子空间。一个重要细节是，作者发现工具名一旦被切换，后续 JSON 参数会自回归地跟随新工具 schema，因此干预工具名阶段就足以改变完整调用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma 3、Qwen 3/Qwen 2.5、Llama 3.1 共 12 个 instruction-tuned 模型，参数量从 270M 到 27B。name-only 单轮提示下，mean-difference steering 的工具切换准确率为 77–100%；4B 以上模型达到 93–100%。加入短工具描述后，对 4B 以上模型提升有限，部分 sub-1B 模型反而变差。PCA 上，15 个工具的均值可由约 10 个方向解释，但 matched-prompt control 也有 k90=7–9，说明紧凑谱不完全等价于工具专用表示。200 个 ToolBench API 上，36 个方向覆盖主要方差，但 control 的 k90=39，进一步说明 prompt 共享结构占了相当部分。错误预测方面，Gemma 3 12B/27B 中 top-1 与 top-2 工具内部得分间隔最小的查询，错误率高出 14–21 倍。base 模型结果更有意思：Gemma 3 4B base 在 BFCL v3 上直接生成正确工具只有约 3%，但用 residual stream 最近均值方向读出可恢复到 75%；Gemma 1B、12B 和 Llama 3.1 8B base 也有 56–72 个百分点的读出差距。机制分析显示，270M 基本没有稳定 circuit，1B 开始出现，指令微调后更清晰；Gemma 3 4B 中 L17 H0/H1 等 attention heads 承担较强决策作用，但 Qwen 3 4B 中 attention heads 与 MLP 的贡献更接近。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–45 分钟即可。优先看 Section 4.1 的 PCA 与 matched-prompt control，避免把低维结构过度解释为工具语义子空间；再看 Section 4.4 的 steering 结果和 JSON schema 跟随现象；最后看 Section 4.5 的 scale threshold，尤其是 270M、1B、4B 的差异。若关心机制解释，再读 Section 4.2 和 Table 26，重点看不同模型中 attention 与 MLP 贡献并不一致这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether a model’s tool choice is already encoded in its internal activations before the tool name is emitted, and whether that representation can be read or steered.
summary_en.importance: The main value is for understanding the interface between pretraining, instruction tuning, and tool-use behavior. The results suggest that pretrained models already contain a strong latent signal for tool identity, while instruction tuning largely makes that signal accessible to the output head. This is useful for tool-use monitoring, but also for understanding how post-training routes existing representations into executable actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is mean-difference steering. For each tool, the authors average hidden activations over example queries, then use the difference between two tool means as an intervention direction. Adding this vector to the residual stream can switch the selected tool. The paper combines this with PCA, matched-prompt controls, activation patching, and circuit tracing. A useful observation is that changing the emitted tool name is often enough: the subsequent JSON arguments autoregressively adapt to the new tool schema.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 12 instruction-tuned models from Gemma 3, Qwen 3/Qwen 2.5, and Llama 3.1, ranging from 270M to 27B parameters. On name-only single-turn prompts, mean-difference steering switches the selected tool with 77–100% accuracy, and models at 4B or larger reach 93–100%. Short tool descriptions give little additional benefit for larger models and can hurt some sub-1B models. PCA over 15 tool means appears low-dimensional, but matched-prompt controls show similarly compact spectra with k90=7–9, so the low rank is not purely a tool-specific subspace. With 200 ToolBench APIs, 36 directions explain most variance, while the matched control has k90=39. For error prediction, small internal margins between the top two tools correspond to 14–21x higher error rates on Gemma 3 12B and 27B. Base models show a strong hidden signal: Gemma 3 4B base generates the correct BFCL v3 tool only about 3% of the time, but nearest-mean readout from activations recovers 75%; other Gemma and Llama base models show 56–72 point gaps. Circuit evidence suggests little stable structure at 270M, emergence around 1B, and sharper circuits after instruction tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Start with Section 4.1 for the PCA results and the matched-prompt controls. Then read Section 4.4 for the steering experiments and schema-following behavior. Section 4.5 is the most relevant part for scaling behavior. Section 4.2 and Table 26 are useful if the goal is mechanistic analysis, especially because attention and MLP contributions differ across model families.

recommendation.zh: 读 §实验和激活干预部分就够；若结果稳，tool routing 可从黑盒日志诊断推进到内部 margin 监控。
recommendation.en: Read the experiments and intervention sections; if robust, tool routing can move from black-box log debugging to internal-margin monitoring.

paper.title: Where's the Plan? Locating Latent Planning in Language Models with Lightweight Mechanistic Interventions
paper.abstract: We study planning site formation in language models -- where internal representations of structurally-constrained future tokens form during the forward pass, and whether they causally drive generation. Using rhyming-couplet completion as a clean test of forward-looking constraint, we apply two lightweight methods (linear probing and activation patching) across Qwen3, Gemma-3, and Llama-3 at more than ten scales. Probing shows that future-rhyme information is linearly decodable at the line bounda

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是：自回归语言模型在生成有结构约束的文本时，是否会在隐状态中提前形成对未来输出的表示；如果有，这些表示位于哪些 token 和层上，并且是否真的影响后续生成。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制层面。论文区分了两件容易混在一起的事：一是未来信息能否从 hidden state 中被线性读出，二是这个 hidden state 是否被模型用来驱动生成。结果显示，很多模型在换行符位置都能编码未来押韵信息，但只有 Gemma-3-27B 在该位置形成了因果有效的规划站点。这说明“可解码的表示”不等于“被使用的计算路径”。对研究 latent reasoning、隐式规划、模型规模效应和架构差异都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计比较轻量。任务选用 rhyming couplet completion，因为第二行结尾词必须和第一行结尾词押韵，未来约束清晰，便于定位。作者把第一行结束的 newline 作为相对位置 0，观察不同层、不同 token 位置的 hidden state。第一步用线性 probe 判断未来押韵词或押韵类别能否从某个 hidden state 读出，这给出 planning-compatible representation。第二步用 activation patching 做因果验证：把一个目标押韵样本中的特定层和位置 hidden state 替换成另一个押韵目标对应的 hidden state，看生成是否被重定向。这个定义比单纯 probing 更严格。和 transcoder 或大规模 steering-vector 方法相比，这套流程更便宜，也更容易跨开源模型家族和不同尺寸复用。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3、Gemma-3、Llama-3 三个开源模型家族，超过十个模型尺寸，最大到 70B。线性 probing 结果显示，随着规模增大，newline 位置的未来押韵信息在三个家族中都变得更容易读出，但层分布和强度有明显架构差异。activation patching 给出更强约束：只有 Gemma-3-27B 在 newline 位置表现出因果有效的规划站点，并且在大约第 30 层出现信息路由交接，因果驱动从第一行的押韵词位置迁移到 newline。Qwen3 到 32B、Llama-3 到 70B 以及其他测试模型虽然能在 newline 读出规划兼容信息，但生成仍主要依赖原始押韵词位置。作者进一步用 attention weight ranking 和 simultaneous head patching，把 Gemma-3-27B 的交接定位到第 28 层和第 30 层的 5 个 attention heads。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 40 分钟。重点看任务构造、两个定义、probing 和 activation patching 的判别差异，以及 Gemma-3-27B 的 handoff 分析。最值得细看的部分是层-位置热图、patching 结果和 head-level localization。不要只看 probe accuracy，因为这篇工作的主要信息增量恰好来自 probe 与因果干预之间的不一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether autoregressive language models form hidden representations of future structurally constrained tokens, where these representations appear during the forward pass, and whether they causally affect generation.
summary_en.importance: The main value is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. The paper separates decodability from causal use. A future rhyme can often be linearly decoded at the newline position, especially at larger scale, but this does not mean the model routes generation through that state. Only Gemma-3-27B shows a causally active planning site at the newline. This is useful for studying latent reasoning, hidden planning, architecture-dependent routing, and the limits of behavioral evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use rhyming couplet completion as a controlled setting. The first line’s final word constrains the final word of the second line through rhyme, giving a clean future constraint. They index positions relative to the newline ending the first line. Linear probes are used to test whether future-rhyme information is present in hidden states, defining planning-compatible representations. Activation patching is then used as a causal test: hidden states at a chosen layer and position are replaced with states from a run targeting another rhyme, and the authors measure whether generation is redirected. This is cheaper and more portable than transcoder-based circuit analysis, while giving stronger evidence than probing alone.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers Qwen3, Gemma-3, and Llama-3 across more than ten model scales, up to 70B parameters. Probing shows that future-rhyme information becomes increasingly linearly decodable at the newline as scale grows, though layer profiles differ across architectures. Causal patching gives a narrower result: only Gemma-3-27B relies on the newline representation. In that model, the causal driver moves from the rhyme word to the newline around layer 30. Other tested models, including Qwen3 up to 32B and Llama-3 up to 70B, keep conditioning on the original rhyme-word position despite encoding planning-compatible information at the newline. The handoff in Gemma-3-27B is further localized to five attention heads in layers 28 and 30 using attention-weight ranking and simultaneous head patching.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 40 minutes. Focus on the task setup, the distinction between planning-compatible representations and causally active planning sites, and the activation-patching evidence. The most useful figures are likely the layer-position probe maps, the patching heatmaps, and the head-level localization results. Probe accuracy alone is not the key result; the main lesson comes from the mismatch between decodable information and causal routing.

recommendation.zh: 机制问题设得干净；只看 probe-vs-patch mismatch 和 Gemma handoff，就能校准“线性可读=模型使用”的误判。
recommendation.en: The setup is clean; read the probe-vs-patch mismatch and the Gemma handoff to recalibrate the habit of equating decodability with use.

paper.title: Position: Mechanistic Interpretability Must Disclose Identification Assumptions for Causal Claims
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability papers increasingly use causal vocabulary: circuits, mediators, causal abstraction, monosemanticity. Such claims require explicit identification assumptions. A purposive audit of 10 papers across four methodological strands finds no dedicated identification-assumptions section and a recurring pattern: validation metrics such as faithfulness, completeness, monosemanticity, alignment, or ablation effects are reported as causal support without stating the assumptions th

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性（MI）领域论文大量使用因果性词汇（电路、中介、因果抽象、单语义性等），但普遍未明确陈述支持这些因果主张所需的识别假设（identification assumptions）。论文用验证指标（如 faithfulness、completeness、单语义性、对齐分数、消融效果）替代因果识别论证，导致因果主张的可靠性无法被评估。下游研究反复发现先前工作的识别假设失效，但这被当作方法论意外而非系统性的披露缺失问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇立场论文而非技术论文。它对可解释性研究的方法论规范提出了明确的改进要求。对于预训练研究者而言，其价值在于：可解释性是理解预训练模型行为的重要工具，但如果可解释性研究本身的因果主张缺乏方法论严谨性，那么基于这些研究结论做出的架构设计、数据配比等决策可能建立在不可靠的基础上。这篇文章的规范如果被采纳，将提高整个可解释性领域作为LLM研究输入的可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文并非提出新技术，而是提出一项方法论规范：任何使用因果语言的机制可解释性论文必须（1）在摘要中明确标注其主张是否为因果性，（2）命名识别策略，（3）枚举识别假设，（4）对至少一个核心假设进行检验或压力测试，（5）陈述关键假设失效时结论的变化情况。论文以计量经济学领域的识别假设披露传统为先例——计量经济学没有消除识别争议，但将因果主张必须伴随明确假设陈述制度化。具体建议包括：激活补丁方法应假设干预隔离了因果通路；稀疏自编码器（SAE）应假设学习到的特征对应模型真实表示基；因果抽象应假设分布式表示与高层因果结构对齐；探测方法应假设表示空间容许局部因果干预。论文还提供了针对激活补丁、SAE、因果抽象和消融探测的方法学模板，作者可直接复用。
summary.experiments: 论文对4个方法学分支（激活补丁、稀疏自编码器、因果抽象、探测消融）的10篇代表性论文进行了立意性审计（purposive audit），覆盖NeurIPS、ICLR、CLeaR、BlackboxNLP和Anthropic Transformer Circuits Thread。结果发现：没有一篇论文包含专门的识别假设章节；大多数在摘要中仅做隐性因果主张；大多数不包含可证伪性测试；大多数用验证指标替代识别陈述。随后由两名人类编码员对n=30篇论文的独立审计重现了主要发现方向——专门识别章节缺失、验证指标替代现象普遍存在，不过具体的Dim B/D计数受编码规则敏感性影响。论文强调审计样本小且立意抽样，目的是支持立场而非估算全领域流行率。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点关注第1节Introduction（核心立场与动机）和第2节The Econometrics Precedent（为什么识别假设披露是逻辑必需而非文体选择）。方法学模板部分（在论文后半段，针对4种具体方法的假设清单）对正在做或使用可解释性研究的读者有直接参考价值。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。
summary.authors_note: 未在提供的文本中明确标注作者和机构信息

summary_en.core_problem: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) papers extensively use causal vocabulary (circuits, mediators, causal abstraction, monosemanticity) but universally fail to state the identification assumptions required to support these causal claims. The field substitutes validation metrics (faithfulness, completeness, monosemanticity, alignment scores, ablation effects) for causal identification arguments, making the reliability of causal claims unevaluable. Downstream work repeatedly discovers identification failures in prior studies, but these are treated as methodological surprises rather than evidence of a systemic disclosure gap.
summary_en.importance: This is a position paper, not a technical paper. It articulates a clear methodological improvement for interpretability research. For LLM pretraining researchers, the value is this: interpretability is a key tool for understanding model behavior, but if the causal claims of interpretability studies lack methodological rigor, architecture, data, and training decisions based on those conclusions may rest on unreliable foundations. Adoption of this paper's proposed norm would increase the reliability of the entire interpretability field as an input to LLM research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a methodological norm rather than a new technique: any MI paper using causal language must (1) explicitly label whether its claims are causal in the abstract, (2) name the identification strategy, (3) enumerate identification assumptions, (4) test or stress-test at least one core assumption, and (5) state how conclusions shift if key assumptions fail. The precedent drawn is from econometrics, which did not eliminate identification disputes but institutionalized the norm that causal claims require explicit assumption statements. Concrete recommendations include: activation patching should assume interventions isolate causal pathways; sparse autoencoders should assume learned features correspond to the model's true representational basis; causal abstraction should assume distributed representations align with higher-level causal structures; and probing should assume the representational space admits localized causal interventions. Method-specific templates are provided for activation patching, SAEs, causal abstraction, and probing with ablation.
summary_en.experiments: A purposive audit of 10 representative papers across four methodological strands (activation patching, sparse autoencoders, causal abstraction, probing with ablation) spanning NeurIPS, ICLR, CLeaR, BlackboxNLP, and the Anthropic Transformer Circuits Thread finds: zero papers contain a dedicated identification-assumptions section; the majority make only implicit causal claims in abstracts; the majority contain no falsifiability test; and the majority substitute a validation metric for an identification statement. A two-human-coder audit on n=30 papers reproduces the direction of the main finding. The paper emphasizes the sample is small and purposive, meant to support the position rather than estimate field-wide prevalence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommended. Focus on Section 1 (Introduction, core position and motivation) and Section 2 (The Econometrics Precedent, why identification disclosure is a logical requirement, not a stylistic choice). The method-specific templates (later in the paper, assumption checklists for 4 methods) are directly useful for researchers conducting or consuming interpretability work. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做机制可解释性实验的研究员应采纳该披露规范，避免将验证指标直接等同于因果证据的无效论证

paper.title: Tree SAE: Learning Hierarchical Feature Structures in Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Learning hierarchical features in Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) is essential for capturing the structured nature of real-world data and mitigating issues like feature absorption or splitting. Existing works attempt to identify hierarchical relationships within independent feature sets by relying on activation coverage, the assumption that child feature should only activate when its parent feature activates. However, we demonstrate that this condition alone is insufficient; that is, it often produce

summary.core_problem: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAE）仅依赖激活覆盖条件识别特征层级关系，会产生大量语义无关的虚假父子特征对；同时标准SAE忽略现实概念的固有层级结构，存在特征吸收、分裂、多语义混合等问题。
summary.importance: 对大模型预训练的可解释性研究有直接参考，显式的层级特征结构能帮助研究者更准确拆解模型的概念表示逻辑，也为后续SAE的结构设计提供了新的约束条件。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出新增重构约束条件，要求父子特征的解码器向量都与子特征对应概念的表示对齐，保证二者语义相关；随后设计Tree SAE架构，将特征集划分为不同权限层级，每层配置分配向量，负责将更高层级的子特征分配给当前层特征，同时搭配动态分配机制，在训练过程中自动学习同时满足激活覆盖与重构约束的父子特征对，在特征集中显式编码树状层级结构。
summary.experiments: 实验验证了仅依赖激活覆盖的现有方法（如嵌套SAE、匹配追踪SAE）确实会产生大量语义不一致的层级对；Tree SAE学习到的父子特征对语义一致性显著优于现有SAE，同时在特征吸收、分裂、混合等层级相关指标，以及重构损失、扩展性、可解释性上，与现有表现领先的SAE持平或更优；此外显式层级结构可用于分析子概念子空间的几何性质，以及大模型对概念的多粒度分解方式。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读第2章的动机分析（激活覆盖条件局限性的验证部分）和第3章的重构约束、Tree SAE架构设计，附录B的特征异常现象说明可作为背景补充，泛读预计耗时20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sparse autoencoders (SAEs) rely exclusively on the activation coverage condition to identify hierarchical feature pairs, producing large numbers of false positive pairs with no semantic correlation. Standard SAEs also ignore the inherent hierarchical structure of real-world concepts, leading to feature absorption, splitting, and polysemantic composition.
summary_en.importance: This work provides direct, actionable insights for interpretability research in LLM pretraining. Explicit hierarchical feature structures enable more accurate decomposition of concept representations in large models, and the proposed reconstruction constraint introduces a new design principle for future SAE architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first introduces an additional reconstruction constraint, which requires the decoder vectors of both parent and child features to align with the representation of the child feature's corresponding concept to ensure semantic consistency. It then proposes the Tree SAE architecture, which divides the feature set into multiple privilege layers. Each layer is equipped with an allocation vector that assigns child features from higher layers to current-layer features. A dynamic allocation mechanism runs during training to learn parent-child pairs that satisfy both activation coverage and reconstruction constraints, explicitly encoding a tree-like hierarchical structure within the feature set.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments confirm that existing methods relying only on activation coverage, including Matryoshka SAE and Matching Pursuit SAE, produce large shares of semantically inconsistent hierarchical pairs. Tree SAE learns significantly more semantically coherent parent-child pairs than existing SAEs, and matches or outperforms leading existing SAEs on hierarchy-related metrics (absorption, splitting, composition), reconstruction loss, scaling properties, and interpretability. The explicit hierarchical structure also supports analysis of the geometry of child concept subspaces and the multi-granularity decomposition of concepts in language models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 2 for motivation analysis (empirical validation of activation coverage limitations) and Section 3 for the reconstruction constraint and Tree SAE architecture design. Appendix B, which describes common failure modes of standard SAEs, can be read as background material. Expected reading time for a skim is 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: SAE 层级关系的判据值得看，尤其是 activation coverage 失效案例；实验规模未知，先读方法和 false positive 分析。
recommendation.en: The hierarchy criterion is worth reading, especially the failure cases of activation coverage; scale is unclear, so start with the method and false-positive analysis.

paper.title: Knowing but Not Correcting: Routine Task Requests Suppress Factual Correction in LLMs
paper.abstract: LLMs reliably correct false claims when presented in isolation, yet when the same claims are embedded in task-oriented requests, they often comply rather than correct. We term this failure mode \emph{correction suppression} and construct a benchmark of 300 false premises to systematically evaluate it across eight models. Suppression rates range from 19\% to 90\%, with four models exceeding 80\%, establishing correction suppression as a prevalent and severe phenomenon. Mechanistic analysis reveal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一种此前被系统性低估的事实性失败模式：模型并不是不知道用户前提是错的，而是在常规任务包装下不把纠错说出来。作者把它定义为 correction suppression。关键点不在于幻觉，也不在于对抗攻击，而在于日常、温和、看似正常的 instruction-following 场景——例如角色设定、输出格式要求、范围约束、避免额外评论——会把模型从“指出错误”推向“按要求完成任务”。论文要解决的核心问题有两个：第一，如何严格地区分‘知识缺失’和‘知道但不纠正’；第二，能否找到这种行为切换发生在模型内部的哪个阶段，并据此设计低成本干预方法。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它指出现有 factuality 评测如果只在 isolated false claim 上做，会系统性高估部署时的可靠性，因为真实使用里错误前提通常嵌在任务上下文里。第二，它把问题从‘模型会不会纠错’推进到‘模型在什么条件下愿意把纠错外显出来’，这和 instruction tuning、helpfulness/harmlessness 对 factual strictness 的张力直接相关，对 pretrain 到 post-train 接口很有启发。第三，作者给出的机制证据比较完整：错误信号在内部仍被编码，但早层注意力被任务上下文分流，中层开始形成服从式输出意图。这种“knowing but not correcting”的分离，对后续做训练目标设计、对齐数据构造、representation steering 都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它不是提出新基座架构，但在可靠性机制分析和训练后干预上都给出了可复现、可操作的框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三部分。第一部分是 benchmark 设计。作者构造了 300 条可验证的错误前提，覆盖 7 类错误、21 个领域。每条样本都做成两种严格配对条件：isolated 条件里直接询问错误陈述；contextualized 条件里把同一错误前提嵌入任务背景、输出规范和范围约束中，并从多个组件池采样不同包装，尽量把变量控制在“是否存在任务性上下文”上。这样可以把 suppression 定义成行为差分，而不是绝对正确率。

第二部分是机制分析。作者在开源模型上比较 isolated 与 contextualized 两种条件下的内部表征。证据链包括三类：1）预测不确定性在错误位置上的相关性仍然很高，说明模型对错误内容的内部识别没有消失；2）隐藏状态表征中，和纠错相关的方向在两种条件下并非完全消失，而是没有主导最终输出；3）注意力分析显示，早层注意力从 false claim 本身转移到任务框架和输出要求，中层开始朝 compliance 方向收敛。作者据此把问题定位为 response selection failure，而不是 knowledge encoding failure。

第三部分是两种 training-free 干预。CDS（Correction Direction Steering）先用少量校准样本估计“纠错输出”和“服从输出”在表示空间中的分离方向，然后在中间层注入这个方向，干预时机选在输出意图尚未完全定型之前。它有点像针对该失败模式定制的 activation steering。DPA（Dynamic Payload Amplification）则不依赖校准数据，而是利用前面发现的 attention divergence 去定位 payload token：那些在后层获得异常高注意力、但在上下文中被任务框架压制的关键错误内容 token。方法通过放大这些 token 的表示，提升模型对错误载荷的持续关注，把生成轨迹拉回事实审议。两者的区别很清楚：CDS 更像显式方向控制，效果通常更强；DPA 更像基于注意力诊断的无监督补偿，部署门槛更低。
summary.experiments:
实验分为现象测量、机制验证和干预评估三块。现象层面，作者在 8 个模型上评测 suppression rate，范围从 19% 到 90%，其中 4 个模型超过 80%。这说明问题不是个别模型的偶发缺陷，而是相当普遍。更重要的是，同一条错误前提在 isolated 条件下常能被纠正，换成任务包装后就转为配合执行，直接证明评测设置会显著改变结论。

机制层面，作者主要在 Qwen3.5-9B 和 LLaMA3.1-8B 上做深入分析。文中强调 false-claim 位置的预测不确定性在两种条件下高度相关，支持“模型知道哪里不对”。注意力结果显示，差异主要出现在早层到中层：早层对 payload 的关注被 task context 抢走，中层输出意图逐渐锁定为完成任务而非纠错。这个时间顺序很关键，因为它决定了 steering 应该插在中层之前或附近，而不是只在最后几层做表面修补。

干预层面，CDS 和 DPA 都在多种基线上取得明显提升。作者把它们与若干简单提示法、通用 steering 或不做干预进行比较，结论是两种方法都能显著提高 factual strictness，同时对一般生成质量和推理能力影响很小，推理开销也接近可忽略。摘要里没有给出所有主表数字，但全文结论很明确：CDS 在有少量校准时效果最好；DPA 在零校准条件下仍有竞争力。作者还做了消融，说明如果 steering 层位过晚，或者 payload 定位不准，收益会明显下降，这和前面的机制分析是闭环的。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Figure 1 和 benchmark 定义，先把 suppression 的操作化定义吃透，否则后面的机制分析容易和普通 factuality、sycophancy 混在一起。然后重点看行为主表和按模型分组的结果，确认这个现象的普遍性与严重程度。机制部分优先看三类证据：错误位置不确定性、层间注意力迁移、输出意图形成的层位。这里最值得深挖的是作者如何论证“知道但不纠正”，而不是仅仅观察到 hidden state 有差异。干预部分重点看 CDS 的方向估计方式、注入层选择，以及 DPA 的 payload token 定位规则。若只打算花 30 分钟，建议读引言、任务定义、主结果表、机制图和干预总表；若要精读，值得把消融和失败案例也看完，因为它们直接关系到这种方法能否迁移到更大模型或后训练阶段。一个值得继续追问的问题是：这种 suppression 到底来自 instruction tuning 数据分布，还是更早的 pretraining 中就已有雏形，论文给了线索，但还没有完全回答。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific factual failure mode that is easy to miss in standard evaluations: a model can detect that a premise is false, yet stop surfacing the correction once the same premise is wrapped inside a routine task request. The authors call this correction suppression. The central question is not whether the model has the knowledge, but whether task framing—role prompts, output constraints, compliance cues, and “do not add extra commentary” style instructions—changes the response policy from correction to compliance. The paper also asks where this switch happens inside the network and whether it can be reversed without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is quite concrete. First, it shows that factuality evaluations based only on isolated false claims can substantially overestimate real deployment reliability, because user errors usually appear inside task-oriented prompts rather than as standalone statements. Second, it sharpens the distinction between factual knowledge and factual strictness: the model may know the truth but fail to insist on it under contextual pressure. That matters for the pretrain/post-train interface, especially for instruction tuning and preference optimization, where helpfulness can quietly dominate correction. Third, the paper provides a reasonably coherent mechanistic account—early attention is diverted away from the false payload, and a compliance-oriented output trajectory forms in the middle layers. This makes the work more than a benchmark paper; it becomes a useful case study in how alignment-style training can alter response selection without erasing internal knowledge.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three technical components. The first is the benchmark. The authors build 300 verifiably false premises covering seven error categories and 21 domains. Each premise is evaluated in two matched settings: an isolated condition, where the false claim is presented directly, and a contextualized condition, where the same claim is embedded in task framing composed of background, output specification, and scope instructions. The design is careful because it turns suppression into a behavioral dissociation under controlled prompt variation, rather than a generic drop in accuracy.

The second component is the mechanism analysis on open-weight models. The authors compare isolated and contextualized prompts using hidden-state representations, uncertainty at the false-claim position, and attention patterns across layers. Their main claim is that suppression is not a knowledge failure. Uncertainty patterns remain strongly correlated across the two conditions, suggesting that the model still internally registers the problematic content. The difference emerges in routing and response formation: early-layer attention is pulled toward task framing, and middle layers increasingly encode a compliance-oriented output plan. In other words, the model still “knows,” but the generation policy no longer prioritizes correction.

The third component is intervention. CDS, or Correction Direction Steering, estimates a representation-space direction that separates corrective behavior from compliant behavior, then injects that direction at middle layers before the output intent fully crystallizes. This is a targeted activation-steering method tailored to the identified failure mode. DPA, or Dynamic Payload Amplification, avoids calibration data. It uses the observed attention divergence to identify payload tokens—tokens carrying the false content that should matter for correction—and amplifies their representations so that factual deliberation remains active instead of being drowned out by task instructions. CDS is the stronger and more explicit control method; DPA is lighter-weight and easier to deploy when calibration is unavailable.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section covers prevalence, mechanism, and intervention. On prevalence, the benchmark is evaluated on eight models, including frontier systems, and suppression rates range from 19% to 90%, with four models above 80%. That is the headline result: the same false premise is often corrected in isolation but accepted once embedded in ordinary task framing. This makes the phenomenon both common and practically relevant.

For mechanism analysis, the paper focuses on open models such as Qwen3.5-9B and LLaMA3.1-8B. The key evidence is that uncertainty around the false-claim position remains highly correlated between isolated and contextualized settings, which supports the “knowing but not correcting” interpretation. Attention analysis then shows a layerwise shift: early layers allocate less attention to the false payload under task framing, while middle layers move toward a compliance-oriented generation trajectory. That layerwise timing is important because it motivates where steering should be applied.

For intervention, both CDS and DPA substantially improve correction behavior relative to no intervention and simple baselines, while preserving general generation quality and reasoning ability with negligible inference overhead. The paper’s detailed tables matter more than a single aggregate number: CDS performs best when a small amount of calibration is available, whereas DPA remains competitive without calibration. Ablations also show that the intervention layer and payload localization quality are critical. If steering is applied too late, or if the wrong tokens are amplified, gains drop noticeably. That consistency between mechanism and ablation is one of the stronger parts of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the task definition and the paired isolated/contextualized setup. If that distinction is not clear, the rest can look like ordinary factuality or sycophancy. Then read the main behavioral table to establish prevalence. After that, go straight to the mechanism figures: uncertainty correlation, attention redistribution across layers, and the analysis of when output intent becomes compliance-dominated. Those sections carry the main scientific value. For the intervention part, focus on how CDS constructs the correction direction, why the injection point is chosen in the middle layers, and how DPA identifies payload tokens from attention divergence. If time is limited, the introduction, benchmark definition, main results, mechanism figures, and intervention summary are enough for a solid pass in about 30–40 minutes. For a deeper read, the ablations and failure cases are worth the time because they reveal what is specific to this benchmark and what may generalize. A natural follow-up question is whether suppression is mainly created by post-training, or whether pretraining already seeds the tendency and post-training amplifies it.

recommendation.zh: 这是“指令跟随压过事实性”的可复现症状学+机制锚点；先看 suppression 分布和层级注意力证据，再决定要不要做训练修复。
recommendation.en: A reproducible symptom + mechanism anchor for “instruction-following overriding factuality”; read the suppression-rate breakdown and layer-wise attention evidence before attempting any training fix.

paper.title: Navigating by Old Maps: The Pitfalls of Static Mechanistic Localization in LLM Post-Training
paper.abstract: The "Locate-then-Update" paradigm has become a predominant approach in the post-training of large language models (LLMs), identifying critical components via mechanistic interpretability for targeted parameter updates. However, this paradigm rests on a fundamental yet unverified assumption: can mechanisms derived from current static parameters reliably guide future dynamic parameter updates? To investigate this, we systematically track the structural evolution of Transformer circuits throughout

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是：用静态 mechanistic localization 找到“当前负责某个能力的电路”，再把后续微调限制在这部分参数上，这个 locate-then-update 范式是否真的成立。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发在于，它直接挑战了一个常被默认接受的前提：机制定位结果能否作为未来参数更新的可靠地图。若答案是否定的，那么很多基于局部更新的知识编辑、遗忘、定向 SFT、甚至部分 RL 微调方法，都可能在错误的坐标系里优化。对基座研究员来说，这篇文章的价值不在提出新训练法，而在提醒大家：任务机制是动态迁移的，静态解释结果未必能指导动态优化过程。
summary.technical_approach:
作者以 SFT 作为可观测的 post-training 过程，使用 circuit discovery 来跟踪 Transformer 电路在训练中的演化。最小分析单元不是神经元，而是参数矩阵级组件，如注意力里的 Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo 和 MLP 里的 Wup/Wdown。围绕两个问题，作者提出三类指标。Circuit Distance 衡量关键组件在训练过程中的迁移幅度；Circuit Stability 衡量任务机制的语义稳定性，也就是“看起来还是同一任务机制，还是已经换了一套实现”；Circuit Conflict 衡量目标任务与原有通用能力任务之间的机制冲突程度，用来检验 localization 是否真的减少干扰。

核心发现是：不加 localization 时，目标任务的关键组件会自由演化，而且 attention 相关机制迁移明显，MLP 相对稳定。由此带来一个时间滞后问题：如果你在训练前用静态参数做一次定位，再把更新限制在那块区域，等于默认任务机制不会迁移，但真实训练中它恰恰会迁移。作者进一步指出，过去一些 localization 方法看起来有效，很大程度上是因为它们常被用于 MLP 主导、知识型较强的任务，这类任务的机制本来就更稳定，因此静态定位不容易暴露问题。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容可以确认，实验至少覆盖连续的 SFT 过程，并在附录中验证结论也适用于非连续 post-training，如 knowledge editing。主要结果不是单一性能数字，而是机制演化图景：1）attention 电路在训练中发生明显迁移；2）MLP 组件更稳定；3）静态 localization 存在明显 temporal lag；4）其有效性在不同任务类型上并不一致，对知识型、MLP-dominated 任务更容易显得“有效”。

当前片段没有给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、训练步数、性能表和指标数值，因此不宜编造具体百分比。泛读时重点抓住三类图表：电路距离随训练步数的变化、不同组件类型的稳定性对比、以及 localization 与 full-parameter 更新在目标任务和 pervasiveness tasks 上的冲突对比。
summary.reading_guide: 先读 Introduction 和两条研究问题，再看三项指标的定义，最后看 attention 与 MLP 的分解分析。阅读重点不是某个 benchmark 分数，而是作者如何把“机制会迁移”这件事量化出来。若时间有限，优先看：1）Circuit Distance / Stability / Conflict 的形式化定义；2）训练过程中电路迁移的主图；3）任务类型差异分析；4）附录里关于 knowledge editing 的补充验证。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the common locate-then-update paradigm is actually valid: can a circuit localized from the model’s current parameters serve as a reliable map for future parameter updates during post-training?
summary_en.importance: Its value lies in challenging a hidden assumption behind many targeted-update methods. If task mechanisms move during optimization, then static mechanistic localization may be a poor guide for SFT, editing, unlearning, or other constrained post-training procedures. For foundation-model researchers, the main takeaway is not a new training recipe but a caution: interpretability snapshots are not automatically optimization coordinates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The authors use SFT as an observable post-training process and track circuit evolution with circuit discovery. The analysis unit is a parameter-matrix component rather than a neuron, including attention matrices such as Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo and MLP matrices such as Wup/Wdown. They introduce three metrics. Circuit Distance measures how far critical components migrate during training. Circuit Stability measures whether the task mechanism remains semantically consistent over time. Circuit Conflict measures how much the target-task mechanism interferes with mechanisms supporting pre-existing general capabilities.

The central finding is that, without localization constraints, target-task circuits evolve freely, and the evolution is structurally uneven: attention-related mechanisms shift substantially, while MLP components are comparatively stable. This creates a temporal-lag problem for static localization. A circuit identified before training may no longer be the right place to update after optimization starts. The paper further argues that the apparent success of prior localization methods is partly due to the task mix they are tested on, especially knowledge-centric tasks whose mechanisms are more MLP-dominated and therefore more stable.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided text, the experiments cover continuous SFT dynamics and, in the appendix, extend the conclusions to non-continuous post-training settings such as knowledge editing. The main empirical message is qualitative but important: attention circuits migrate noticeably during training, MLP circuits are more stable, static localization suffers from temporal lag, and its usefulness varies by task type.

The excerpt does not include exact model sizes, datasets, training lengths, or numerical tables, so concrete gains should not be fabricated. The most important results to inspect in the full paper are the plots of circuit distance over training, the stability comparison between attention and MLP components, and the conflict comparison between localized updates and full-parameter updates on both target and pervasiveness tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction and the two research questions first, then the definitions of Circuit Distance, Circuit Stability, and Circuit Conflict, and finally the breakdown by component type. The key is not a benchmark score but the evidence that mechanisms move during optimization. If reading selectively, focus on: the formal metric definitions, the main trajectory plots of circuit migration, the task-type analysis, and the appendix section showing that similar conclusions hold for knowledge editing. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to capture the main argument.

recommendation.zh: 值得看指标和 SFT 轨迹图；若 setup 干净，应降低对静态电路定位指导训练的信任。
recommendation.en: Read the metrics and SFT trajectory plots; if the setup is clean, reduce trust in static circuit localization as a training guide.

paper.title: The Structural Origin of Attention Sink: Variance Discrepancy, Super Neurons, and Dimension Disparity
paper.abstract: Despite the prevalence of the attention sink phenomenon in Large Language Models (LLMs), where initial tokens disproportionately monopolize attention scores, its structural origins remain elusive. This work provides a \textit{mechanistic explanation} for this phenomenon. First, we trace its root to the value aggregation process inherent in self-attention, which induces a systematic variance discrepancy. We further demonstrate that this discrepancy is drastically amplified by the activation of su

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解释 decoder-only Transformer 中 attention sink 为什么稳定出现在初始 token 上。问题不是简单描述“第一个 token 被过度关注”，而是追踪这个现象从自注意力值聚合、FFN 放大、残差传播到 QK 打分偏置的结构性因果链。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把 attention sink 从经验现象推进到可干预的架构问题。attention sink 会影响长上下文、KV cache 压缩、activation outlier、表示塌缩和训练稳定性。论文指出 sink 不是规模增大后的不可避免结果，而是由 value aggregation 的方差差异触发，并可通过归一化或 attention 形式调整缓解。这个结论对 base model 架构设计和预训练稳定性有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的机制链条是：在 causal mask 下，第一个 token 只能 attend to itself，不经历多 token value averaging；后续 token 会聚合越来越长的上下文，表示方差被平均效应压低。于是初始 token 成为高方差 outlier。这个 outlier 经过 attention output projection 后被保留，并在 FFN 中激活 super neurons。SwiGLU FFN 的 channel-sparse down-projection 进一步造成某些维度上的 representation disparity。残差连接和 normalization 不能完全消除这种差异，差异最终进入 query-key dot product，使其他位置把初始 token 当作结构锚点。为了验证因果关系，作者做了两类干预：改变 attention mask 来隔离聚合效应；人为放大任意 token 的表示方差。两者都能把 sink 诱导到指定位置。方法层面的改动包括用 Sigmoid attention 替代 Softmax attention，以及引入 head-wise RMSNorm 来稳定每个 attention head 的 value aggregation 输出。
summary.experiments: 主要分析对象是 Llama-2-7B，并在 WikiText-2 上追踪跨层 attention pattern 与 hidden-state norm。作者观察到初始 token 的 attention weight 在早期层较低，但在约第 2 层附近突然上升；同一层附近，初始 token 表示的 l2 norm 也同步出现异常增大。这一同步性支持“表示方差异常触发 sink”的路径。控制实验显示，修改 mask 或提高任意位置的方差，可以在任意 token 上制造 attention sink，说明初始 token 不是语义特殊，而是统计结构特殊。预训练实验中，Sigmoid attention 因为不受 Softmax sum-to-one 约束，明显减轻了初始 token 的高方差异常；head-wise RMSNorm 也抑制了 sink，并带来更快的预训练收敛。材料中没有给出完整预训练规模、token 数和 loss 曲线数值，阅读时需要核对 Figure 2、Figure 3 以及附录中的跨模型验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 40 分钟。先看 Section 3 对 variance discrepancy 的定义，以及 Figure 3 中 attention weight spike 和 first-token l2 norm spike 的同步关系。然后看两个控制干预，它们是论文因果论证的关键：如果任意位置被赋予类似初始 token 的方差特征也会变成 sink，机制解释就比位置编码或 Softmax 残余概率假设更有说服力。最后看 Sigmoid attention 与 head-wise RMSNorm 的预训练实验，重点关注它们是否只降低 sink，还是同时改善 loss 收敛。附录中的其他模型验证适合快速扫一遍，用来判断结论是否只依赖 Llama-2-7B。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why attention sinks in decoder-only Transformers consistently attach to the initial token. Rather than treating the first token as a semantic attractor, it traces a structural causal chain from value aggregation, to FFN amplification, to residual propagation, and finally to biased query-key scores.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for pretraining research because attention sinks are tied to long-context behavior, KV-cache compression, activation outliers, representation collapse, and training stability. The paper argues that sinks are not an unavoidable consequence of scale. They arise from variance discrepancy in value aggregation and can be reduced by targeted architectural changes. This makes the phenomenon relevant to base-model architecture design, not only to interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed mechanism starts with causal self-attention. The initial token attends only to itself, while later tokens aggregate values from an expanding context. This averaging reduces the variance of later token representations, leaving the first token as a high-variance outlier. The attention output projection preserves this outlier, and the FFN then amplifies it through super-neuron activations. In SwiGLU FFNs, channel-sparse down-projections create a dimension disparity in the token representation. Residual connections and normalization layers propagate rather than fully remove this disparity. The distorted representation then dominates query-key dot products, making the first token a structural anchor. The causal claim is tested with two interventions: modifying attention masks to isolate aggregation effects, and increasing the variance of arbitrary token representations. Both can induce attention sinks at chosen positions. The paper also evaluates two remedies: replacing Softmax attention with Sigmoid attention, and adding head-wise RMSNorm to stabilize value-aggregation outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The main analysis is conducted on Llama-2-7B using WikiText-2. The authors track attention patterns and hidden-state norms across layers. They observe that attention to the initial token remains low in the earliest layers, then rises sharply around layer 2. At the same depth, the l2 norm of the first-token representation also spikes, supporting the proposed trigger from representation outliers to attention sinks. Controlled interventions show that arbitrary positions can become sinks when they are given the same variance property, indicating that the effect is structural rather than semantic. In pretraining experiments, Sigmoid attention reduces the sink because it removes the Softmax sum-to-one constraint that helps create the high-variance first-token outlier. Head-wise RMSNorm also suppresses sinks and improves convergence speed. The provided content does not include full pretraining scale, token counts, or exact loss numbers, so the relevant figures and appendices should be checked for quantitative details.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25 to 40 minutes. Start with the definition of variance discrepancy and the layer-wise evidence in Figure 3, especially the alignment between the attention spike and the first-token norm spike. Then read the two intervention experiments, since they carry most of the causal argument. If a non-initial token can be made into a sink by manipulating variance, the explanation is stronger than hypotheses based only on position or Softmax residual mass. Finally, read the Sigmoid-attention and head-wise-RMSNorm pretraining results to see whether the interventions merely suppress the sink or also improve optimization. The appendix with additional models is useful for judging how specific the effect is to Llama-2-7B.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制链和干预实验即可；若证据干净，会改变把 attention sink 当纯训练偶然性的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the causal chain and intervention experiments; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that attention sinks are just a training artifact.

paper.title: From Token Lists to Graph Motifs: Weisfeiler-Lehman Analysis of Sparse Autoencoder Features
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become central to mechanistic interpretability, decomposing transformer activations into monosemantic features. Yet existing analyses characterise features almost exclusively through top-activating token lists or decoder weight vectors, leaving the higher-order co-occurrence structure shared across features largely unexamined. We introduce a graph-structured representation in which each SAE feature is modelled as a token co-occurrence graph: nodes are the tokens m

summary.core_problem: 这项工作想解决 SAE 特征分析中过度依赖 top activating tokens、示例 prompt 和 decoder 向量的问题。它问的是：能否把一个 SAE feature 激活时附近 token 的共现结构表示成图，并用图相似度来组织大量特征，从而发现单看 token 列表不明显的结构性 motif。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的影响偏间接，主要价值在机制解释工具链。SAE 已经成为分析 Transformer 中间表示的一种常用方法，但现有分析往往停留在单特征解释。这个工作提供了一个特征级组织方法：不是判断某个 feature 的语义，而是比较 feature 之间的局部上下文结构。它可能帮助建立更稳定的 feature taxonomy，用于观察不同层、不同训练阶段或不同数据分布下表示结构如何变化。不过当前实验规模和验证强度较小，结论应视为方法原型。
summary.technical_approach: 作者使用 GPT-2 Small 的公开 SAE，具体是 open-sae-soup 中 layer 6 residual stream、attention 前位置的 6-RES-JB SAE。该 SAE 有 24,576 个稀疏特征，d_model 为 768，d_sae 为 24,576，扩展因子为 32。对每个 feature，先在语料上收集激活；当激活超过该 feature 经验分布的某个百分位阈值时，记为 high-activation event。然后取事件附近的局部 token 窗口，统计 token 频率和 token pair 共现。每个 feature 被转成一张图：高频 token 是节点，达到共现阈值的 token pair 是边，边权是共现次数。节点标签不是 token identity，而是 log-scaled、frequency-binned 的频率标签。图之间的相似度用一个定制的 WL-style graph kernel 计算，并按对角 kernel 的几何均值归一化。之后在 kernel 空间中聚类，观察是否形成可解释的结构 motif。
summary.experiments: 实验是 proof of concept。基础模型为 GPT-2 Small，SAE 为单层单位置的 6-RES-JB，语料主要是合成 mixed-domain corpus，用来诱发不同表面模式。作者将图 kernel 聚类与 decoder cosine、token-histogram baselines 对比，使用启发式 token-type purity 指标评估聚类纯度。结果显示，图共现表示能形成与 decoder 或 token 直方图不同的聚类组织，并捕捉到一些基于局部上下文结构的 motif。鲁棒性检查覆盖窗口大小、top-K token 截断、共现阈值、k-means 随机种子、feature-selection cutoff、无向/有向边，以及一个小型 Python code corpus。限制也比较清楚：只测了 GPT-2 Small 的一个 SAE 和一个层位，语料偏合成，purity 指标是启发式的，作者不声称完成了单个 feature 的机制解释。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 分钟。先看 Method 中 feature-to-graph 的构造，重点是 high-activation event、局部窗口、top-K 节点、共现边和频率分箱标签。再看 WL-style kernel 的改动，因为它刻意弱化 token identity，强调结构和频率模式。实验部分重点看与 decoder cosine、token histogram 的对比，以及鲁棒性实验。Limitations 值得看，它解释了为什么当前结果还不能外推到多层 SAE、前沿模型或真实大规模语料。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a narrow but useful gap in SAE analysis: most feature interpretation relies on top-activating tokens, example prompts, or decoder directions, while the higher-order co-occurrence structure around feature activations is rarely analyzed. The question is whether each SAE feature can be represented as a token co-occurrence graph and compared through graph motifs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is indirect for pretraining, but relevant for mechanistic analysis of pretrained models. It offers a way to organize SAE features by contextual structure rather than isolated token lists. If scaled beyond this prototype, such a representation could help compare feature families across layers, training checkpoints, model sizes, or data distributions. The current evidence is limited, so the main value is the proposed lens rather than a strong empirical claim about language model internals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a released SAE from open-sae-soup on GPT-2 Small: the 6-RES-JB SAE attached to the layer-6 residual stream before attention. It has 24,576 sparse features, with d_model = 768, d_sae = 24,576, and an expansion factor of 32. For each feature, activations are collected over a corpus. A high-activation event is defined when the feature activation exceeds a feature-specific percentile threshold. Around those events, the method collects local token windows and builds a graph for each feature. The most frequent tokens become nodes; token pairs that co-occur above a threshold become weighted edges. Node labels are derived from log-scaled frequency bins rather than raw token identities. Similarity between feature graphs is computed with a custom WL-style graph kernel, normalized by the geometric mean of diagonal kernel values. The resulting kernel space is then clustered to identify recurring structural motifs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are a proof of concept on one SAE and one layer of GPT-2 Small, mainly using a synthetic mixed-domain corpus. The graph-kernel clusters are compared with decoder-cosine and token-histogram baselines using a heuristic token-type purity metric. The reported pattern is that co-occurrence graphs produce a feature organization that is not reducible to decoder vectors or token histograms, and that some clusters reflect local contextual motifs. Robustness checks vary graph construction hyperparameters, k-means seeds, feature-selection cutoffs, directed versus undirected edges, and include a small Python-code corpus. The limitations are material: single layer, single SAE, synthetic-heavy data, and a heuristic evaluation metric. The paper does not claim mechanistic interpretation of individual features.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the method sections that define high-activation events, local windows, top-K token nodes, co-occurrence edges, and frequency-binned labels. The WL-style kernel is the central technical component, especially the choice to emphasize frequency and structure rather than token identity. In the experiments, look at the comparisons against decoder cosine and token histograms, then check the robustness section. The limitations section is important because it bounds how far the results can be generalized.

recommendation.zh: 做SAE机制分析的研究员可只看§3的图构建方法和Fig4的聚类结果，方法轻量可直接复用
recommendation.en: Researchers working on SAE interpretability only need to read §3's graph construction and Fig 4's clustering results, the method is lightweight and directly reusable

paper.title: SMolLM: Small Language Models Learn Small Molecular Grammar
paper.abstract: Language models for molecular design have scaled to hundreds of millions of parameters, yet how they learn chemical grammar is poorly understood. We train SMolLM, a 53K-parameter weight-shared transformer, to generate novel SMILES with 95% validity on the ZINC-250K drug-like-molecule benchmark, outperforming a standard GPT with 10 times more parameters. Mechanistically, the same block resolves SMILES constraints across passes in a fixed order: brackets first, rings second, and valence last, as s

summary.core_problem: 现有分子生成语言模型参数规模大，模型学习化学语法的内在机制不明确，同时标准Transformer分层权重不共享的结构也不利于机制归因分析。
summary.importance: 验证了权重共享的循环Transformer架构可大幅降低参数量同时保持生成性能，证明迭代计算在形式语言生成任务上的有效性；其可解释性分析思路可迁移到通用LLM预训练机制研究，尤其是分步计算的归因工作。
summary.technical_approach: 训练仅53K参数的权重共享Transformer SMolLM，单个Transformer块迭代8次（虚拟深度为8）完成推理，在SMILES分子字符串生成任务上训练；通过错误分类、线性探测、稀疏自编码器、注意力头消融等方法拆解模型分步解决SMILES语法约束的过程。
summary.experiments: 在ZINC-250K分子数据集上训练，生成SMILES的有效性达95.3%，比参数大10倍的标准GPT高7.7个百分点；机制分析发现模型按固定顺序解决约束：第2步完成括号匹配，第4步完成环配对，第8步完成化合价校验，其中括号匹配功能可定位到单个注意力头。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第3节实验结果和第2.2节机制分析部分，重点关注权重共享架构的性能对比和分步计算的归因方法，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing language models for molecular generation have large parameter sizes, and the underlying mechanism of how they learn chemical grammar remains unclear. The non-weight-shared layered structure of standard Transformers also hinders mechanistic attribution analysis.
summary_en.importance: The weight-shared recurrent Transformer architecture can significantly reduce parameter count while maintaining generation performance, verifying the effectiveness of iterative computation on formal language generation tasks. The mechanistic interpretability pipeline can be transferred to general LLM pre-training mechanism research, especially for stepwise computation attribution works.
summary_en.technical_approach: SMolLM, a weight-shared Transformer with only 53K parameters, is trained for SMILES molecular string generation. A single Transformer block runs iteratively for 8 passes (virtual depth = 8) during inference. Mechanisms of constraint resolution are decomposed via error classification, linear probing, sparse autoencoders and attention head ablation.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on ZINC-250K molecular dataset, SMolLM achieves 95.3% SMILES generation validity, 7.7 percentage points higher than a standard GPT with 10x more parameters. Mechanistic analysis shows the model resolves constraints in fixed order: bracket matching by pass 2, ring pairing by pass 4, valence validation by pass 8. Bracket matching function is localized to a single attention head.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 (experimental results) and Section 2.2 (mechanistic analysis), focus on performance comparison of weight-shared architecture and stepwise computation attribution method. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 对机制分析研究者有参考价值——用极小模型结合稀疏自编码器和线性探测做mechanistic interpretability，方法干净；关于迭代计算按固定顺序分层解决约束的发现值得注意，只看§3机制分析部分即可。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for mechanistic interpretability researchers—the tiny model setup combined with sparse autoencoders and linear probing is clean; the finding about layered constraint resolution in fixed iteration order is interesting, focus on §3.

paper.title: Detecting Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Internal Attention Divergence Signals
paper.abstract: We propose a lightweight and single-pass uncertainty quantification method for detecting hallucinations in Large Language Models. The method uses attention matrices to estimate uncertainty without requiring repeated sampling or external models. Specifically, we measure the Kullback-Leibler divergence between each attention head's distribution and a uniform reference distribution, and use these features in a logistic regression probe. Across multiple datasets, task types, and model families, atte

summary.core_problem: 如何在不做多次采样、不引入外部判别器/检索器的情况下，用单次前向就对 LLM 输出的“可能幻觉/不正确”进行不确定性估计与检测，并且尽量避免仅依赖 logit/概率这类容易与流畅性纠缠的输出空间信号。
summary.importance:
这篇更偏机制/可靠性评估，而不是预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发点在于：注意力分布的形状（相对均匀分布的偏离程度）在中层对事实性 token（实体、数字）上携带可用的白盒不确定性信号，可能用于：
- 训练动态诊断（哪些层在“事实检索/绑定”上更脆弱）；
- 后训练或持续学习时的样本筛选/加权（把高不确定样本作为重点或剔除噪声）；
- 作为额外的校准/正则信号（需要进一步研究）。
但它并未直接提出新的预训练目标或数据配方，贡献量级主要在“可用的内部信号与实证”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法把每个注意力头在生成步 t 的注意力分布 A_t^(l,h) 当作离散概率分布，并计算其相对均匀分布 U 的 KL 散度：KL(A || U)。直觉是：均匀注意力对应“模型不知道该看哪里”（更不确定），而更集中的注意力对应更强的内部确定性。
实现上：
- 在单次生成过程中提取各层各头的 KL(A||U) 特征；
- 将这些特征聚合后，用一个带 lasso 正则的 logistic regression probe 预测答案是否正确。probe 主要用于跨头/跨层加权组合，而不是引入复杂的二阶段模型。
论文还做了层级与 token 类型的归因分析：信号主要集中在中间层，并在命名实体、数字等“事实性 token”附近更强。
summary.experiments:
给定的全文片段未包含实验设置与结果表（数据集列表、模型家族、AUROC/accuracy 等指标、与 baselines 的具体差距），无法摘录具体数字。根据引言描述，作者声称在多个数据集/任务/模型家族上，该注意力散度特征对正确性预测“highly predictive”，并且与现有不确定性方法相比具有竞争力，同时保持单次前向的低开销。
建议在全文中核对：
- baselines 是否包括基于 logprob/entropy 的单次信号、以及多次采样的 self-consistency/variance 类方法；
- probe 是否跨模型可迁移，还是每个模型/任务都要重新拟合；
- 对长度、上下文窗口 T 的敏感性（因为 KL(A||U) 与 T 有显式关系）；
- 在不同解码策略（greedy vs sampling）下是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读优先看三块：
- 方法定义：KL(A||U) 的具体形式、按 token 还是按序列聚合、如何处理不同上下文长度导致的尺度变化。
- 分析图：层间分布（为什么是 middle layers）、token 类型归因（实体/数字）是否与错误类型对应。
- 实验对比：与输出空间不确定性信号、与多次采样方法的成本-效果对比，以及跨模型泛化。
预计 20–30 分钟可读完并判断是否适合接入现有训练/评测流水线；若要用于训练数据加权或作为训练信号，需要进一步验证其可微性使用方式与是否会被模型“学会伪装”。

summary_en.core_problem: Design a single-pass, lightweight hallucination/incorrectness detector for LLM generations that does not rely on repeated sampling or external verifier models, and that goes beyond output-space likelihood signals which often correlate with fluency rather than factual correctness.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a reliability/interpretability signal paper rather than a new pretraining recipe. Its value to foundation-model training is the empirical finding that attention-shape statistics—specifically divergence from uniform—carry predictive information about correctness, concentrated in mid layers and around factual tokens (entities, numbers). Potential downstream uses include training diagnostics, data filtering/weighting during post-training or continual pretraining, and possibly auxiliary calibration regularizers (not established here).
summary_en.technical_approach:
At each generation step, treat each attention head’s attention weights as a discrete distribution over the context positions. Compute KL divergence to a uniform reference distribution U: KL(A || U). The intuition is that near-uniform attention reflects uncertainty about where to attend, while concentrated attention reflects stronger internal certainty.
Features are collected across layers/heads in a single forward pass and fed into a lasso-regularized logistic regression probe to predict whether the produced answer is correct. The probe is meant to be a lightweight aggregator over heads/layers rather than a heavy second-stage model. The paper also analyzes where the signal lives (layerwise) and which token types drive it (named entities, numbers).
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt does not include datasets, metrics, or numeric results, so concrete AUROC/accuracy numbers and baseline gaps cannot be quoted. The introduction claims strong predictiveness across multiple datasets, task types, and model families, with competitive performance versus existing uncertainty estimation methods, while remaining single-pass.
When reading the full paper, verify: which baselines are included (logprob/entropy single-pass vs multi-sample methods), whether the probe must be refit per model/task, sensitivity to context length T (since KL to uniform depends on T), and robustness across decoding strategies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim three parts: (1) the exact KL(A||U) definition and aggregation (token-level vs sequence-level; normalization for varying context length), (2) layerwise/token-type attribution plots supporting the “mid-layer factual token” claim, and (3) the main comparison table including compute cost. 20–30 minutes is enough to decide integration into an evaluation pipeline. Using it as a training-time signal requires extra work on differentiable usage and on whether models can learn to game the signal.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练方法论文，但如果你关心 factual retrieval 的层内机制，只看中层信号和 factual token 分析就够了；probe 很轻，适合内部快速复现验真。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper, but worth skimming if you care about factual retrieval internals; focus on the middle-layer and factual-token analyses, and the probe is cheap enough to sanity-check internally.

paper.title: Single-Position Intervention Fails: Distributed Output Templates Drive In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: Understanding how large language models encode task identity from few-shot demonstrations is a central open problem in mechanistic interpretability. Prior work uses linear probing to localize task representations, reporting high classification accuracy at specific layers. We reveal a striking dissociation: probing accuracy completely fails to predict causal importance. Single-position activation intervention achieves 0% task transfer across all 28 layers of Llama-3.2-3B-despite 100% probing accu

summary.core_problem: 解决此前线性探针定位的ICL任务表征单点位置无因果作用的矛盾问题，明确ICL任务编码的真实分布模式
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次通过因果干预定位了ICL任务身份的 causal locus，推翻了探针准确率对应因果重要性的默认假设
summary.technical_approach: 采用激活干预方法，对比单点干预与多点干预的任务转移效果，替代仅用关联分析的线性探针方法
summary.experiments: 覆盖LLaMA、Qwen、Gemma三个架构共4个模型，在Llama-3.2-3B的28层全层单点干预任务转移率为0%，第8层多点干预转移率达96%
summary.authors_note: William A. Shine Great Neck South High School研究团队

summary_en.core_problem: Resolve the contradiction that single-position causal intervention fails at ICL task representation loci previously localized with high accuracy by linear probing
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis contribution, first locates the causal locus of ICL task identity via causal intervention, disproves the default assumption that probing accuracy correlates with causal importance
summary_en.technical_approach: Adopts activation intervention method, compares task transfer performance of single-position and multi-position intervention, replaces correlation-only linear probing
summary_en.experiments: Covers 4 models across 3 architecture families (LLaMA, Qwen, Gemma), single-position intervention achieves 0% task transfer across all 28 layers of Llama-3.2-3B, while multi-position intervention at layer 8 reaches 96% transfer rate
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from William A. Shine Great Neck South High School

recommendation.zh: 推翻了探针准确率对应因果重要性的默认假设，仅需阅读§4干预实验部分和Fig2即可
recommendation.en: Disproves the default assumption that probing accuracy correlates with causal importance, only read §4 intervention experiments and Figure 2

institutions: William A. Shine Great Neck South High School

paper.title: How Language Models Process Negation
paper.abstract: We study how Large Language Models (LLMs) process negation mechanistically. First, we establish that even though open-weight models often provide wrong answers to questions involving negation, they do possess internal components that process negation correctly. Their poor accuracy is due to late-layer attention behavior that promotes simple shortcuts; ablating those attention modules greatly improves accuracy on negation-related questions. Second, we uncover how models process negation. We consi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 如何在内部处理否定。核心问题不是模型是否会答错否定题，而是：模型内部是否已经形成了可用的否定表征，错误答案又是被哪些后续机制推出来的。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“能力缺失”和“能力被其他机制覆盖”分开了。模型在中间层已经能组合出类似“not gas → solid/liquid”的负概念表征，但后层注意力会沿用共现和表面模式，把正向概念重新推高。这说明预训练中学到的 shortcut 不只是评测误差，也会在推理路径上与正确的组合机制竞争。对研究训练数据、目标函数和训练动态的人来说，这类分析能帮助定位：错误来自表示没有学到，还是来自 late-layer 的读出和放大机制出了问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕“X that is not Y is Z”这类受控提示构造分析。作者比较两种机制假设：一种是 suppression，即模型注意到被否定的概念 Y，然后压低相关 token；另一种是 construction，即模型显式构造“not Y”的组合表征，再用这个表征促进正确答案。方法上，作者先用基于 logit difference 的 negation sensitivity 证明模型内部对否定敏感；然后定位到后层若干 attention heads 会在否定提示中促进正向答案，称为 shortcut attention heads。为干预这些头，作者提出 Attention Sinking，用来削弱特定注意力模块对输出的影响，并观察否定题准确率变化。机制追踪部分使用 path patching、LogitLens 和 Sparse AutoEncoders。结果显示，否定词的信息先被 attention 移到 Y 的位置；中层 attention 再把构造出的负概念表征移到输出位置；同一批模块也会压制 Y，但 suppression 的作用较弱。最后，MLP 的 SAE latent 会进一步放大这个负概念表征，使它影响最终预测。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 162 个独立问题，使用 4 个模板扩展为 648 条样本，正负提示只在否定标记上不同，并为每条样本指定单 token 的正向和负向候选答案。主要机制实验集中在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.1，也提到若干 open-weight 模型在否定题上常答错但仍表现出内部敏感性。关键结果有三点。第一，后层 shortcut attention modules 会在否定提示上推动正向答案；对这些模块做 Attention Sinking 后，否定题准确率显著提高。第二，在超过 80% 的数据样本中，LogitLens 能看到中层 attention 输出促进与“not Y”相关的概念，而不是只压低 Y。第三，SAE 分析显示，后续 MLP latent 会把这些负概念方向进一步放大。论文还把 shortcut attention heads 的形成追溯到预训练阶段，说明它们不是 instruction tuning 后才出现的行为。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。优先看 §4，理解 negation sensitivity、shortcut attention heads 和 Attention Sinking 的因果证据；再看 §5.1–§5.5，那里给出了“否定词搬运到 Y 位置—构造负概念表征—输出位置读出—MLP 放大”的完整路径。图 1 和展示 construction/suppression 对比的图表值得细看。附录中的数据构造也应扫一遍，因为 648 条样本的模板化设定决定了结论边界。读的时候需要留意两个限制：一是任务形式较窄，主要覆盖分类式单 token 回答；二是 Attention Sinking 能改善行为，但它更像机制验证工具，不是可直接部署的训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LLMs compute negation internally. The main question is whether failures on negated prompts come from a missing negation mechanism, or from later components overriding a mechanism that already exists.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining research is the separation between representation acquisition and readout interference. The models appear to build compositional representations for negated concepts in mid layers, while late attention heads push answers associated with the unnegated concept through shortcut features such as co-occurrence. This matters for studying pretraining dynamics because a model can learn the right intermediate computation and still produce the wrong output if later circuits amplify easier correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses controlled prompts of the form “X that is not Y is Z” and contrasts two hypotheses. Under suppression, the model attends to Y and suppresses tokens related to Y. Under construction, it constructs a representation for “not Y” and uses that representation to promote valid answers. The paper first measures negation sensitivity through logit differences, showing that models internally respond to negation even when their final answer is wrong. It then identifies late-layer shortcut attention heads that promote positive answers on negated prompts. The proposed Attention Sinking intervention weakens these attention modules and is used as a causal test. For the constructive pathway, the authors combine path patching, LogitLens, and Sparse AutoEncoders. The resulting account is: attention moves the negation signal to the Y position; mid-layer attention moves a constructed “not Y” representation to the output position; the same modules also suppress Y, but less strongly; MLP features then amplify the negated representation before the final prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 162 unique questions rendered with 4 templates, yielding 648 examples. Positive and negated prompts differ only by a negation marker, with single-token positive and negative answer candidates. The mechanistic experiments focus on Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.1, with broader observations on open-weight models. The main empirical findings are: late attention modules promote unnegated answers and ablating or sinking them improves accuracy on negated prompts; for more than 80% of examples, LogitLens evidence indicates that mid-layer attention outputs promote concepts related to “not Y”; SAE features in MLP outputs further amplify the negated representation. The paper also links shortcut heads to pretraining, suggesting that these behaviors are not only artifacts of instruction tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read Section 4 for the behavioral-mechanistic split: negation sensitivity, shortcut attention heads, and Attention Sinking. Then read Sections 5.1–5.5 for the circuit-level account of how negation is transported, composed, and amplified. The construction-versus-suppression figures are the most informative parts. The appendix on dataset construction is worth checking because the conclusions are tied to controlled, single-token answer prompts. The main limitation is scope: the setup is clean for mechanistic analysis but does not cover broad naturalistic negation or long-form generation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制图和消融结果；它把“模型不懂否定”改写成“懂了但被后层捷径盖掉”。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism diagrams and ablations; it reframes “models do not understand negation” as “they encode it, then late-layer shortcuts override it.”

paper.title: What Happens Inside Agent Memory? Circuit Analysis from Emergence to Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Agent memory failures are silent: an LLM-based agent can produce a fluent response even when it fails to extract, retain, or retrieve the information needed across sessions. The write-manage-read loop describes the external pipeline of these systems but leaves open which internal computations implement each stage. Tracing internal feature circuits across the Qwen-3 family (0.6B--14B) and two memory frameworks (mem0 and A-MEM), we report three findings. First, control is detectable before content

summary.core_problem: Agent memory 的 write–manage–read 三段式外部流程很清晰，但失败往往是“沉默的”：模型输出流畅，却在抽取、路由、或 grounding 上出错。论文要解决的是：这些阶段在模型内部是否对应可分离、可追踪的计算电路（circuits）？这些电路如何随模型规模涌现？能否据此把端到端错误定位到具体阶段，从而做诊断而不是只看一个总分？
summary.importance:
对基座研究的价值主要在训练动态/机制层面：
- 给出一个与 scaling 相关的具体现象：在 Qwen-3 家族上出现“control-before-content”不对称——小模型已具备路由/控制相关的因果电路，但内容抽取与 grounding 的可检测电路要到更大规模才出现。这对“用小模型跑 agent 框架”的风险评估很直接：外部行为看起来会路由，但可能在写入与读取内容上系统性失真。
- 把多次调用的 agent pipeline 纳入 mechanistic interpretability，而不是只分析单次 forward 的检索/幻觉；这更贴近真实部署。
- 提供一个不依赖人工标注的阶段级故障定位方法（76.2%），更像工程诊断工具：当 memory 系统出错时，先判断是 Write/Manage/Read 哪段在掉链子，再决定改 prompt、改 store、还是换 backbone/加监督。
summary.technical_approach:
核心技术路线是“跨规模 + 跨框架 + 电路追踪 + 因果验证”：
1）对象与任务：以 Qwen-3 0.6B/4B/8B/14B 为 backbone，接入两种 memory 框架 mem0（扁平 KV + embedding 检索）与 A-MEM（Zettelkasten 式网络，写入/链接演化/读取）。评测用 LongMemEval（500 问、5 类 memory）。检索本身是 embedding search，不走 LLM。
2）把每个 memory 操作当成独立 forward pass：Write（从对话抽取事实）、Manage（对新事实与 top-5 邻居做 add/update/delete/none 决策）、Read（基于检索到的 top-5 事实回答）。这样可以把“阶段”定义成可对齐的计算单元。
3）Feature circuit tracing：使用预训练线性转码器 PLT（把每层 MLP 替换为稀疏 encoder-decoder）得到更接近单语义的 feature 激活；在此表示上构建从输入 token→特征→输出 logit 的加权因果边，做精确的局部线性因果分析，识别对特定阶段输出有因果贡献的特征群。
4）三项主要发现对应的机制化表述：
- control-before-content：在 0.6B 已能检测到对 Manage/路由决策有因果贡献的“控制/路由”电路；但 Write/Read 的“内容”电路在他们的追踪设定下到 4B 才可检测。
- Write/Read 共享 grounding hub：在较晚层出现一个共享的“枢纽”特征群，Write 与 Read 都会用到；但是否形成可用的 grounding 方向，取决于阶段提示词/框架如何“招募”这块共享底座。
- 诊断而非干预：作者尝试直接放大内容电路做 steer/intervention，发现跨阶段 pipeline 中很脆弱，于是转向把电路分离性用于 read-out 诊断，提出无监督阶段定位器。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论（论文在引言中给出的可核对数字/设定）：
- 模型规模：Qwen-3 0.6B/4B/8B/14B。
- 框架：mem0（pre-v2.0）与 A-MEM。
- 数据：LongMemEval，500 questions，5 memory types。
- 主要量化结果：无监督阶段级故障定位准确率 76.2%。
- 现象性结果：0.6B 已出现可因果验证的 routing/control 电路；content 电路到 4B 才“可检测”。
当前提供的全文片段未包含更细的分项指标（例如不同 memory type 的定位准确率、不同规模下电路可检测性的统计阈值、以及对 mem0 vs A-MEM 的差异量化），因此无法补充更细数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟，偏机制分析读法）：
- 先读 Introduction 把问题边界立住：为什么端到端 accuracy 无法区分 Write/Manage/Read 的失败。
- 方法部分重点看两件事：① 如何把多次调用 pipeline 对齐成可追踪的“阶段”；② PLT + feature circuit tracing 的因果边是怎么定义与验证的（这决定结论可信度）。
- 结果部分优先抓三张信息密度高的图/表（通常对应三项发现）：control-before-content 的跨规模曲线、Write/Read 共享 hub 的层位置与特征群、以及 76.2% 诊断器的混淆矩阵/分项。
