paper.title: Subliminal Steering: Stronger Encoding of Hidden Signals
paper.abstract: Subliminal learning describes a student language model inheriting a behavioral bias by fine-tuning on seemingly innocuous data generated by a biased teacher model. Prior work has begun to characterize this phenomenon but leaves open questions about the scope of signals it can transfer, the mechanisms that explain it, and the precision with which a bias can be encoded by seemingly unrelated data. We tackle all three problems by introducing subliminal steering, a variant of subliminal learning in

summary.core_problem: 研究“subliminal learning（潜意识学习）”里一个更强、更可控的信号注入方式：当学生模型只在看似无关的教师生成数据上做微调时，究竟能转移多复杂的偏置信号、转移的机制是什么、以及这种信号能被数据以多高精度编码与恢复。
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续训练的直接启示是：训练数据里可能存在人类与常规审计都难以察觉的“激活层面”统计信号，且这种信号可以在微调阶段稳定写入学生模型的表征空间。它把“数据投毒/后门”从显式触发词推进到更隐蔽的表征方向（steering vector）层面，并给出可操作的检测线索（hidden-state shift 与 vector recovery）。对做数据治理、持续预训练数据混入、以及对齐阶段数据来源控制的团队，这类机制性证据比单纯的现象报告更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把以往 prompt-based 的 subliminal learning，替换为 activation steering 版本的“subliminal steering”。
1) Steering vector 训练：冻结教师模型参数，只在残差流（residual stream）里学习一个向量 vc，使得在一组评测提示 E 上，模型更倾向生成目标字符串 yc（可以是单词，也可以是多词短语/命题）。优化目标是 yc 的 token-level 交叉熵；用 Adam；训练时注入强度 α=1。
2) Steered generation 造数：在教师生成与偏置无关的任务数据（文中用随机三位数序列生成）时，把 α·vc 注入到指定层集合 L、所有 token 位置，从而让“无关数据”携带偏置。
3) 学生微调：学生用 LoRA 在教师生成数据上做 next-token 微调；评估偏置是否转移，用一组偏置相关提示下目标字符串概率提升来度量，并与无偏教师生成数据的对照微调比较。
4) 机制分析（表征对齐）：比较学生微调前后 hidden states，发现存在与原始 vc 对齐的系统性位移，并且位移主要出现在教师注入的同一批层附近，暗示转移的不只是行为结果，而是“方向性表征结构”。
5) 精度分析（vector recovery）：冻结学生基座，仅用教师生成数据的 NLL 训练一个同参数化的残差向量 v̂，结果 v̂ 与 vc 具有高 cosine 相似度；并且把 v̂ 用于中性提示时能诱导模型 verbalize 出被编码的信号（包括多词短语）。这相当于给出一种在“假设攻击方式为 subliminal steering”条件下的反向恢复方法。
summary.experiments:
全文主结论围绕三组实验：
- 范围/可转移性：相较系统提示词的 subliminal learning，subliminal steering 在简单单词偏置上更稳定，并且能转移“复杂偏置”（多词短语/关系性命题），而 prompt-based 在文中给出的复杂偏置例子（如“AI is superior to humans”）上失败。
- 机制证据：学生模型 hidden-state 出现沿 vc 方向的位移，且层定位与教师注入层一致；并且简单偏置与复杂偏置的位移幅度相近，支持“激活方向被写入”的解释。
- 可恢复性：在冻结学生的情况下，仅通过在 subliminal 数据上的 next-token loss 优化一个向量即可恢复出与 vc 高 cosine 相似度的向量，并能在中性提示上触发 verbalization，说明数据中携带的信号足够精确。
（注：你提供的全文片段未包含具体模型规模、数据量、图表数值与提升幅度；若需要精确数字，需要补充实验章节/附录内容。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“方法→机制→恢复”顺序读：
- 先看 Subliminal Steering 章节里 vc 的训练目标、注入位置（残差流、层集合 L、所有 token）、以及 steered generation 的数据构造细节；这里决定了它为何比 system prompt 更稳定。
- 再看 hidden-state shift 的分析图/表：重点是位移与 vc 的对齐度、以及位移集中在哪些层，是否与注入层严格对应。
- 最后看 vector recovery：它把‘数据携带信号’从现象变成可估计对象。关注优化设置（冻结哪些参数、在哪个位置放向量、训练信号只有 NLL）以及 verbalization 的评测方式。
泛读时间：30–45 分钟可抓住主线；精读（含复现实验）需要对照代码仓库。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how far “subliminal learning” can go when the training data looks innocuous: what kinds of hidden signals can be transferred from a biased teacher to a student, what exactly is transferred (behavior vs. representation), and how precisely such a signal can be encoded—and even recovered—from the teacher-generated data.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and continual training practice, the key message is that datasets can carry hard-to-audit, activation-level statistical signatures that reliably imprint into a model during finetuning. The work strengthens the threat model beyond prompt-conditioned teachers: a single learned steering direction can act as a high-bandwidth covert channel. It also provides concrete forensic hooks (layer-localized hidden-state shifts; recoverable steering vectors) that are closer to mechanism than prior purely behavioral demonstrations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They replace prompt-based subliminal learning with an activation-steering variant called “subliminal steering.”
- Learn a steering vector vc with the base model frozen: inject vc into the residual stream at every token position across a chosen layer set L, and optimize vc (Adam) to increase likelihood of a target string yc over an evaluation prompt set E.
- Use the steered teacher to generate seemingly unrelated training data (their running setup uses prompts that ask for random 3-digit number sequences), producing a dataset that is semantically neutral but statistically biased.
- Finetune a student model on this dataset using LoRA with standard next-token loss; measure transfer by increased probability of yc on bias-related evaluation prompts relative to both the base model and a control finetuned on unsteered data.
- Mechanistic probe: compare student hidden states pre/post finetuning and find a consistent shift aligned with vc, concentrated around the same layers where the teacher applied steering.
- Precision probe (“vector recovery”): freeze the student and fit a single residual-stream vector v̂ using only NLL on the subliminal dataset; v̂ ends up highly cosine-aligned with vc and can induce verbalization of the encoded bias when applied to neutral prompts.
summary_en.experiments:
Three empirical claims structure the results:
1) Scope: subliminal steering transfers simple single-token preferences more reliably than system-prompt subliminal learning, and it also transfers multi-word/relational “complex biases” (where prompt-based setups fail on examples like “AI is superior to humans”).
2) Mechanism: finetuned students exhibit a vc-aligned hidden-state displacement, localized to the teacher’s steered layers; the displacement magnitude is comparable for simple and complex biases.
3) Recoverability: fitting a single vector on the subliminal dataset (student frozen) recovers a direction with high cosine similarity to vc and triggers bias verbalization under neutral prompts.
(Concrete model sizes, dataset sizes, and numeric deltas are not present in the provided full-text excerpt; they likely live in the experiments/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in the order that matches the causal chain:
- “Subliminal Steering” section: how vc is trained, where it is injected (residual stream, layer set L, all token positions), and how the neutral-looking dataset is generated.
- Hidden-state shift analysis: focus on alignment metrics with vc and the layer localization evidence.
- “Vector recovery”: the exact parameterization (single vector), what is frozen, the loss signal (pure NLL), and how verbalization is evaluated.
Skim time: ~30–45 minutes for the main idea; longer if you want to map the method to data-poisoning defenses and reproduce via the released code.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改变你对合成数据“表面无害即可安全”的 prior；先看方法设定和机制证据，若 setup 干净，蒸馏与数据过滤策略都该重审。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that superficially harmless synthetic data is safe; read the setup and mechanistic evidence first, and if the causal design is clean, revisit distillation and data-filtering assumptions.

paper.title: When Chain-of-Thought Fails, the Solution Hides in the Hidden States
paper.abstract: Whether intermediate reasoning is computationally useful or merely explanatory depends on whether chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens contain task-relevant information. We present a mechanistic causal analysis of CoT on GSM8K using activation patching: transferring token-level hidden states from a CoT generation to a direct-answer run for the same question, then measuring the effect on final-answer accuracy. Across models, generating after patching yields substantially higher accuracy than both direct

summary.core_problem: CoT 推理失败时，模型内部是否仍已形成“足以导出正确答案”的任务相关表征？如果有，这些信息在 CoT 序列的哪些 token、哪些层里最可恢复，失败又是“信息缺失”还是“信息没被正确读出/利用”？
summary.importance: 这篇工作不直接改预训练，但对“推理能力从何而来、CoT token 的功能是什么”给了可操作的因果证据：CoT 的可用信息往往存在于隐藏状态里，即使表面 CoT 文本是错的。对基座研究的启发主要在两点：1）评估/训练不应只看生成的 CoT 文本质量，隐藏状态可能已经完成了关键计算；2）为后续的训练目标设计（例如更短的 reasoning、latent reasoning、或对隐藏状态施加约束/蒸馏）提供了机制线索：信息集中在中后层、早期位置、且语言 token（动词/实体）比纯数字 token 更“可读出”。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 token 级 activation patching 的因果干预。对同一道 GSM8K 题，构造两条运行：
- source：CoT 提示（生成一段推理再给答案），缓存每个生成 token 在每一层 transformer block 输出的 residual stream hidden state。
- target：direct-answer 提示（要求只给最终答案，不展示步骤），在 target 前向中选定层 l，把 target 的“最后一个位置”的 hidden state 替换为 source 中某个 CoT token 在同层的 hidden state，然后从该状态继续自回归生成，观察最终答案是否变对。
关键设计取舍：
- 选 direct-answer 作为 target，是为了让 baseline 更弱，从而把提升归因到被 patch 进来的 CoT 表征。
- patch 到 target 的最后位置（而不是中间位置），作者声称经验上干预效应最强（附录里有对比）。这相当于测试“把某个 CoT token 的表征当作最终决策时刻的上下文摘要”是否足以驱动正确解。
- 对 source token 做语义角色标注（动词、实体、操作符、数字等），统计不同 token 类型的 patch 成功率差异，用来回答“信息到底藏在语言结构里还是算术符号里”。
论文的主要结论链条是：若某个 CoT token 的 hidden state 被搬运到 direct-answer 的决策位置后能显著提高正确率，则该 token 的表征包含可被模型后续解码为正确答案的任务相关信息；进一步用 success density 衡量信息是否在整段 trace 中广泛存在，区分“偶然某点有信息”与“整段推理都在维持可用状态”。
summary.experiments:
实验设置：LLaMA 3.1 8B-Instruct 与 Qwen 2.5 7B-Instruct，在 GSM8K test（1,319 题）上做零样本对比与 patching 干预。论文报告的关键现象包括：
- patch 后继续生成的准确率，显著高于 direct-answer baseline，也常常高于原始 CoT 运行本身（即原 CoT 文本给错答案，但其某些 token 的 hidden state 仍可“救回”正确答案）。
- 可恢复信息在层与位置上不均匀：更集中在中后层；在 token 位置上偏向更早的 CoT token（作者的解释倾向于：早期语言规划/问题表征阶段已形成解题轨迹，后续 token 可能引入噪声或偏航）。
- token 类型差异明显：动词/实体等语言 token 的 patch 更容易触发“带推理的正确解”；数字/操作符 token 更容易让模型直接跳到一个答案（但往往不对），像是在绕开推理过程。
- patch 往往导致更短的输出，但准确率仍超过原始 CoT，暗示“完整可读的长 CoT 文本”不是获得高准确率的必要条件。
你给的全文片段没有包含 Table 1 与各图表的具体数值区间；若需要精确提升幅度、各层 PSR/密度曲线、以及不同语义角色的成功率，请补充 PDF 中对应表格/图的数值。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30-45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（patching 流程示意）和方法部分对“patch 到 target 最后位置”的动机与对照实验（附录 E）。这是理解因果结论是否站得住的关键。
- 重点看作者定义的三个指标：patch accuracy / success density / PSR，它们分别回答“有没有信息”“信息分布广不广”“相对基线提升多少”。
- 看层×位置热力图（通常是论文最有信息量的图）：确认信息集中在中后层、早期 token 的证据强度。
- 看语义角色分组结果（Table/Appendix C）：动词/实体 vs 数字/运算符的差异，是论文最可迁移到训练目标设计的观察。
- 如果只想抓结论：读引言末段的贡献点 + 结果部分的主图即可；如果想复现或扩展到别的任务，方法与附录的 prompt、patch 细节必须细读。

summary_en.core_problem: When a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) run produces an incorrect reasoning trace and final answer, does the model’s hidden state still contain recoverable task-relevant information sufficient to generate the correct answer? If yes, where (layers/positions/token roles) is that information encoded, and what distinguishes successful vs failed reasoning traces?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it provides causal, mechanistic evidence about what CoT is doing internally. The main takeaway for foundation-model researchers is that judging reasoning purely from the emitted CoT text can be misleading: even “wrong” CoT text can carry hidden states that enable correct solutions when read out differently. The layer/position/token-role localization (mid-to-late layers, earlier tokens, language tokens outperform numeric/operator tokens) is actionable for designing shorter reasoning, latent-reasoning objectives, or distillation targets that supervise internal representations rather than verbose traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They use token-level activation patching as a causal intervention. For each GSM8K question, they run:
- a source CoT prompt, cache residual-stream hidden states for every generated CoT token at multiple layers;
- a target direct-answer prompt (no steps), then at a chosen layer replace the hidden state at the final target position with the cached hidden state from a specific source CoT token at the same layer, and continue generation.
If the patched run yields the correct final answer, that source token’s hidden state is treated as containing recoverable task-relevant information.
Key methodological choices: using direct-answer as the target to create a low-accuracy baseline; patching at the final target position because it empirically maximizes effect size; and grouping source tokens by semantic roles (verbs/entities/operands/operators, etc.) to test whether “useful information” is tied to linguistic structure vs explicit arithmetic symbols.
They summarize outcomes with metrics like patch accuracy (existence of any successful patch per example) and success density (how broadly success is distributed across layer×token interventions), aiming to distinguish “information exists but is sparse” from “information is broadly maintained across the trace.”
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: LLaMA 3.1 8B-Instruct and Qwen 2.5 7B-Instruct on GSM8K test (1,319 problems), zero-shot prompting plus exhaustive layer×token patching.
Reported qualitative findings:
- Patched generations often outperform both the direct-answer baseline and the original CoT run, including cases where the original CoT is incorrect—evidence that hidden states can encode a correct solution even when the textual trace fails.
- Recoverability is not uniform: it concentrates in mid-to-late layers and earlier CoT positions.
- Token-role effects: patching language tokens (verbs/entities) more often triggers correct, reasoning-like continuations; patching numeric/operator tokens tends to shortcut to an answer that is frequently wrong.
- Patched outputs are often shorter yet more accurate than full CoT, suggesting long explicit traces are not necessary for performance.
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the exact numeric deltas/plots; to report precise improvements and per-layer/role success rates, the main tables/figures from the PDF are needed.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Start with the main patching schematic (Figure 1) and the justification/controls for patching into the final target position (they cite Appendix E).
- Focus on how they define and use patch accuracy vs success density vs PSR; these determine what their claims actually mean.
- Inspect the layer×position heatmaps: they carry most of the mechanistic signal.
- Read the semantic-role analysis (and Appendix C) to understand why language tokens outperform arithmetic tokens—this is the most transferable insight for training-objective ideas.
- If you want to extend the method to other tasks/models, read the prompt templates and intervention details in the appendices carefully.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设计和 layer/token 分布图；它会修正“错 CoT 等于无用计算”的直觉，值得做内部复现。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and layer/token distribution plots; it usefully weakens the intuition that a wrong CoT means useless computation.

paper.title: How LLMs Detect and Correct Their Own Errors: The Role of Internal Confidence Signals
paper.abstract: Large language models can detect their own errors and sometimes correct them without external feedback, but the underlying mechanisms remain unknown. We investigate this through the lens of second-order models of confidence from decision neuroscience. In a first-order system, confidence derives from the generation signal itself and is therefore maximal for the chosen response, precluding error detection. Second-order models posit a partially independent evaluative signal that can disagree with t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 为什么能在没有外部反馈时发现并修正自己的错误。核心问题不是“自我纠错是否有效”，而是模型内部是否存在一个相对独立于生成概率的评估信号，用来判断答案是否错，以及是否还有能力修正。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对机制分析和 posttrain 设计都有直接启发。许多自我纠错方法只看外部行为：让模型反思、验证、再回答。但如果错误检测依赖的是一个独立的内部 confidence/evaluation 表征，那么训练时只优化最终答案或 verbal confidence 可能会漏掉关键监督信号。论文把 token log-probability、verbal confidence、内部激活三者拆开，说明生成时的 argmax 信号不足以解释错误检测。对预训练研究来说，这提示模型在 next-token 训练中可能自然形成“生成信号”和“评估信号”的分工；对后训练来说，PANL 这类位置的内部表征可能是训练 verifier、自检、拒答、主动求助和可修正性预测的更好接口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文借用决策神经科学中的 first-order / second-order confidence 框架。first-order 模型中，置信度来自同一个生成变量；对应到 LLM，就是 token log-probability。这个信号在 greedy decoding 下总是偏向已选答案，因此难以解释模型为什么会怀疑自己的答案。second-order 模型假设存在部分独立的评估变量。论文关注 post-answer newline token，简称 PANL，也就是答案之后的换行位置。此前 Kumaran et al. 2026 发现 PANL 上缓存了能因果影响 verbal confidence 的表征，并且与生成时 log-probability 可分离。当前工作进一步检验 PANL 是否支持错误检测和自我修正。实验采用 verify-then-correct 范式：模型先回答，再报告置信度或验证答案，随后尝试修正。分析上分三层：第一，比较 verbal confidence 与 token log-probability 对错误检测的预测力；第二，用 PANL activations 预测错误检测，并控制 verbal confidence；第三，检验 PANL 是否能预测“错误答案是否可被修正”，这是行为信号难以做到的部分。因果层面，论文使用 activation patching，在答案信息被破坏时注入或恢复 PANL 信号，观察错误检测行为是否被救回；还做 joint ablation，区分 PANL 与 last answer token 中共享的评估成分和答案内容成分。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma 3 27B 和 Qwen 2.5 7B，任务包括 TriviaQA 和 MNLI。主要行为结果是：verbal confidence 对错误检测的预测明显强于 token log-probabilities，说明仅用生成概率无法解释模型是否会发现错误。表示层结果是：PANL activations 在控制 verbal confidence 后仍能预测错误检测，说明内部评估信号没有完全外显为自然语言置信度。更关键的是，PANL 能预测哪些错误在 correction step 中会被修正，而 token log-probability、verbal confidence 以及其他行为信号组合都不能稳定预测这一点。因果实验显示，当答案信息被腐蚀时，PANL activation patching 可以恢复错误检测行为；joint ablation 表明评估信号分布在 PANL 和 last answer token 上，但 PANL 更干净地隔离了评估成分，因为它已经位于完整答案之后，可以回看问题和答案而不再承担生成答案 token 的任务。全文没有在提供内容中给出具体 AUC、准确率或效应量数字，因此不应把结论理解为一个只由单一指标支撑的 benchmark 结果；它的价值在于行为预测、表示预测和因果干预三类证据彼此对齐。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先读 Introduction 中 first-order 与 second-order confidence 的定义，尤其是 Figure 1 对 X_act 和 X_eval 的区分。重点关注 verify-then-correct 设计，因为它把“发现错误”和“修正错误”分开，这比只看最终答案是否变好更干净。随后看 PANL probing 的回归或分类设置：哪些变量被控制，token log-probability、verbal confidence、PANL activation 分别提供了多少增量信息。因果部分要细读 activation patching 和 joint ablation，尤其是为什么 PANL 比 last answer token 更适合作为评估表征的位置。若时间有限，优先看实验方法、主结果表、因果干预图，以及附录中关于 recall/recognition 类比和 second-order 框架的解释。值得深挖的问题是：PANL 信号是否可通过训练显式增强；它是否存在于多轮对话、CoT、代码和数学任务中；能否作为 reward model、verifier 或 uncertainty head 的训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why LLMs can sometimes detect and fix their own errors without external feedback. The central question is whether the model has an internal evaluative signal that is partly independent of the generation signal, and whether that signal predicts both error detection and correctability.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to mechanistic analysis and the interface between pretraining and posttraining. Many self-correction pipelines only observe behavior: ask the model to verify, reflect, and answer again. This paper separates token log-probability, verbal confidence, and internal activations. The result suggests that next-token-trained models can develop a division between answer generation and answer evaluation. For posttraining, this matters because verbal confidence may be a lossy readout. Internal positions such as the post-answer newline may provide a better target for training verifiers, calibrated abstention, help-seeking, and correction policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames confidence using the first-order versus second-order distinction from decision neuroscience. In a first-order account, the same signal determines the chosen response and confidence in that response. The LLM analogue is token log-probability. Under greedy decoding, this signal is tied to the selected answer and therefore gives a weak account of why the model would later judge its own answer as wrong. A second-order account introduces a partly independent evaluative variable. The paper focuses on the post-answer newline token, or PANL. Prior work by Kumaran et al. 2026 found that PANL caches a confidence representation that causally drives verbal confidence and dissociates from generation-time log-probabilities. This work tests whether the same representation supports error detection and self-correction. The experimental paradigm is verify-then-correct: generate an answer, elicit or measure confidence and verification behavior, then allow a correction attempt. The analysis asks whether verbal confidence predicts error detection beyond log-probabilities, whether PANL activations predict error detection beyond verbal confidence, and whether PANL predicts which errors can be corrected. Causal evidence comes from activation patching and joint ablation, including settings where answer information is corrupted.
summary_en.experiments: The findings are reported across Gemma 3 27B and Qwen 2.5 7B, on TriviaQA and MNLI. Behaviorally, verbal confidence predicts verification outcomes much better than token log-probabilities, which argues against a pure first-order account. Representationally, PANL activations still predict error detection after controlling for verbal confidence, indicating that the internal evaluative signal is not fully exposed in the model’s verbal report. The strongest result is on correctability: PANL predicts which erroneous answers will be successfully revised, while behavioral signals, including log-probability and verbal confidence, fail to do so reliably. Activation patching shows a causal role: PANL signals can rescue error detection when answer information is corrupted. Joint ablation suggests that the evaluative signal is shared across PANL and the last answer token, but PANL isolates it more cleanly because it occurs after the full answer has been produced and can attend back over the question-answer pair. The provided text does not include exact AUCs, accuracies, or effect sizes, so the result should be read as a convergent behavioral, representational, and causal argument rather than as a single-number benchmark claim.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the introduction’s definition of first-order and second-order confidence, especially the distinction between X_act and X_eval in Figure 1. Then inspect the verify-then-correct setup, because the separation between detecting an error and successfully correcting it is the key design choice. For the probing results, focus on the control variables: generation log-probabilities, verbal confidence, and PANL activations should be compared by incremental predictive value. The causal section is the most important part to read in detail: activation patching tests sufficiency, while joint ablation clarifies how PANL differs from the last answer token. If time is limited, prioritize the main result tables, the causal intervention figures, and the appendix discussion linking the mechanism to recall versus recognition. Useful follow-up questions are whether PANL-like signals appear in chain-of-thought, code, math, and multi-turn dialogue, and whether they can be trained directly as verifier or uncertainty targets.

recommendation.zh: 读 PANL 干预实验即可；若因果链干净，它会修正“logprob≈置信度”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the PANL intervention experiments; if the causal chain is clean, it weakens the default habit of treating log-probability as confidence.

paper.title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
paper.abstract: One of the most common complaints about large language models (LLMs) is their prompt sensitivity -- that is, the fact that their ability to perform a task or provide a correct answer to a question can depend unpredictably on the way the question is posed. We investigate this variation by comparing two very different but commonly-used styles of prompting: instruction-based prompts, which describe the task in natural language, and example-based prompts, which provide in-context few-shot demonstrat

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究同一个任务在 instruction prompt 和 few-shot example prompt 下为什么会出现明显性能波动。核心问题不是再证明 prompt sensitivity 存在，而是定位两类提示方式是否调用了共享的内部任务表示，以及这种共享表示的激活强弱能否解释行为差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制层面。它把 prompt 形式差异和模型内部的任务表示强度联系起来，说明同一任务可能有跨提示风格共享的“词汇化任务表示”，而不是完全依赖每种 prompt 格式各自的机制。这有助于理解 ICL、instruction following 和任务执行之间的接口，也对预训练数据中 instruction、demonstration、definition 类样本的配比和混合方式有间接参考价值。贡献量级偏机制分析，不是新的训练目标或架构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 vocabulary projection 解码单个 attention head 的输出，寻找那些输出词汇语义上描述任务本身的 head。作者称这类表示为 lexical task representation。例如在 Antonym 任务中，相关 head 解码出的高概率词不是某个输入词的反义词，而是 “opposite”“reverse” 这类任务定义词。它与 function vector 的区别在于：function vector 更偏向由 few-shot ICL 格式诱发，并作为触发任务执行的向量；lexical task representation 更像对任务含义的显式词汇化编码，并能在 instruction prompt 和 example prompt 之间共享。随后作者把这类 lexical task heads 与负责知识或属性提取的 retrieval heads 区分开，分析前者如何调制后者，使模型从输入主体中抽取正确属性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个自回归 Transformer 模型、3 个模型家族、17 个简单任务、3 个组合任务和 1 个自由形式代码生成任务。主文结果主要基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。任务包括类似属性抽取、反义词、翻译等需要明确任务语义的设置。关键结果有三点：第一，lexical task heads 在 instruction-based 和 example-based prompts 中都能被识别出来，说明它们不是单一 prompt 模板的产物。第二，这些 head 的激活强度与不同 prompt 下的性能波动相关。第三，因果干预显示，lexical task heads 对任务表现有可测贡献；在 17 个任务中，它们至少解释约 10%，最高可到约 90% 的任务性能差异。作者还把 retrieval heads 作为执行侧组件，展示 lexical task representation 的强弱会影响 retrieval heads 取回正确答案的能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。重点看第 2.2 节，理解 lexical task heads 的定义、筛选标准和 vocabulary projection 方法；再看第 2.3 节，确认这些 head 为什么能被称为跨 prompt 风格共享；第 2.4.1 节最关键，那里连接了激活强度、retrieval heads 和行为波动。附录 G.1 值得扫一遍，因为 10% 到 90% 的因果贡献范围决定了结论的强弱。附录 I 可用于区分 lexical task representation 和 function vector，避免把两者混在一起。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why semantically equivalent tasks can show large performance variation under instruction-style prompts versus few-shot example prompts. The target is not prompt sensitivity as a surface phenomenon, but whether different prompt formats activate a shared internal task representation whose strength predicts the observed behavioral variability.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining research is mechanistic. The results suggest that instruction following and in-context learning may share a lexicalized representation of task meaning, rather than relying only on format-specific circuits. This informs how to think about the interface between definitions, demonstrations, and task execution in pretraining mixtures. It is not a new training recipe, but it gives useful evidence about what kinds of internal representations pretraining can induce.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key tool is projecting individual attention-head outputs into vocabulary space and inspecting whether the decoded tokens describe the task itself. Heads are classified as producing lexical task representations when their decoded vocabulary matches the task definition rather than the answer. For an antonym task, for example, such heads decode words like “opposite” or “reverse,” not a specific antonym for the query word. This differs from function vectors, which are usually extracted from in-context demonstrations and act more like task-triggering vectors. The paper also separates these lexical task heads from retrieval heads, which retrieve subject-specific attributes or answers. The proposed mechanism is that lexical task heads encode what task should be done, and their activation strength modulates retrieval heads that execute the task.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span 13 autoregressive Transformer language models from three model families, 17 simple tasks, three compositional tasks, and one free-form code generation task. The main results are reported on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The central findings are: lexical task heads appear under both instruction-based and example-based prompts; their activation strength correlates with prompt-level performance variation; and causal interventions on these heads explain a nontrivial portion of task performance, ranging from at least about 10% to as much as about 90% across the 17 tasks. The retrieval-head analysis supports a two-part picture: task meaning is encoded by lexical task heads, while answer extraction is handled by retrieval heads whose effectiveness depends on the strength of the task representation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Read Section 2.2 for the definition and identification procedure for lexical task heads. Section 2.3 is important for the claim that the mechanism is shared across prompt styles. Section 2.4.1 is the main causal story linking activation strength, retrieval heads, and behavioral variability. Appendix G.1 is worth checking for the intervention effect sizes, and Appendix I is useful for separating lexical task representations from function vectors.

recommendation.zh: 读 lexical task heads 的定位实验；它把 prompt sensitivity 从玄学拉回可测机制。
recommendation.en: Read the lexical-task-head localization experiments; they turn prompt sensitivity into a measurable mechanism rather than prompt folklore.

paper.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong implicit personalization ability, yet most existing approaches treat this behavior as a black box, relying on prompt engineering or fine tuning on user data. In this work, we adopt a mechanistic interpretability perspective and hypothesize the existence of a sparse set of Preference Heads, attention heads that encode user specific stylistic and topical preferences and exert a causal influence on generation. We introduce Differential Preference Steering

summary.core_problem: 解释并利用 LLM 的“隐式个性化”能力：模型如何在不微调的情况下根据用户历史/画像呈现不同风格与偏好？作者提出一个可检验的机制假设：个性化主要由少量稀疏的注意力头（Preference Heads）承载，并且这些头对生成有可观测的因果影响。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限（更偏机制分析 + 解码期干预），但对两类研究有启发：
1) 机制层面：把“个性化/风格”从黑盒行为拆成可定位的电路组件，提供了可复用的因果发现范式（head-level causal masking + 贡献度量）。
2) post-train 接口：给出一种 training-free 的个性化路径，可能减少为每个用户做 LoRA/微调的需求；同时也提示在对齐/偏好建模时，模型内部可能存在可分离的偏好通路，值得在训练中显式正则或约束。

从筛选角度，它不是预训练方法论文，但属于“机制分析/可控生成”里相对有结构的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
两步：发现 + 利用。

(1) Preference Heads 发现：
- 用因果 masking 分析对每个 attention head 做干预（屏蔽/移除该 head 的输出），观察对“用户对齐生成”的影响。
- 定义 Preference Contribution Score (PCS)：度量某个 head 对偏好对齐程度的因果贡献（论文表述为直接测量 head 对 user-aligned generation 的 causal impact）。核心是把‘相关性’变成‘可干预的贡献’，避免仅凭激活强度或注意力模式做归因。

(2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS) 解码期个性化：
- 在解码时对比“启用 Preference Heads”与“抑制 Preference Heads”两种预测分布，取差分信号并放大，用来提升偏好一致的续写、压制更通用/中性的续写。
- 进一步做 cluster-aware steering：考虑用户异质性，让相似用户共享部分偏好电路（减少每个用户单独找 head 的成本，并提升稳定性）。

与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 这类对比解码的区别在于：DPS 的对比对象不是层/检索头等预定义结构，而是通过因果分析定位到的“个性化相关头”。
summary.experiments:
模型：LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct、Qwen2-7B-Instruct。
数据与任务：LaMP 个性化基准，覆盖生成（headline、scholarly title、tweet paraphrase 等）与预测类任务（分类/回归，如 citation identification、movie tagging、product rating）。
指标：生成用 ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR；分类用 Acc/F1；回归用 MAE/RMSE。
对比基线：CAD、DoLa、DeCoRe（均为解码期干预/对比类方法）。

从全文描述的结论层面：DPS 在多个开源指令模型与多类 LaMP 任务上提升个性化一致性/风格对齐，同时保持内容连贯与计算效率；并通过“mask 掉这些 heads 会破坏个性化行为”来支持其因果性主张。具体提升幅度需要结合论文实验表格逐项查看（摘要未给出统一的绝对数字）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 先读方法部分 PCS 的定义与 head masking 的实现细节：干预发生在什么位置（head 输出/attention weights/OV 投影之后）、如何避免与 dropout/kv-cache 等实现细节混淆、PCS 的统计是否跨样本/跨用户聚合。
- 再读 DPS 的解码公式：差分分布如何与原 logits 合成、放大系数如何选、是否引入温度/归一化以避免退化。
- 实验部分重点看：
  - 与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 的对比表（不同任务类型是否一致受益）；
  - “mask preference heads 会破坏个性化”的因果验证；
  - cluster-aware 版本是否显著减少 per-user 搜索成本。
- 预计不需要逐字精读数据集介绍；把时间留给消融与可视化（head 分布、激活模式与风格维度的对应）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLM personalization mechanistically interpretable and controllable: instead of treating user-specific style/topic adaptation as a black box, it hypothesizes that a sparse set of attention heads (“Preference Heads”) causally mediates personalized generation.
summary_en.importance: It is closer to mechanistic interpretability plus decoding-time control than pretraining. Still, it matters to foundation-model researchers in two ways: (1) it offers a reusable causal-discovery recipe at the head level (masking + contribution scoring) for isolating circuits behind high-level behaviors; (2) it suggests a training-free personalization path that could reduce per-user fine-tuning, and hints that preference/alignment signals may flow through partially separable internal pathways—useful when thinking about how post-training interfaces with the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two stages: identify and steer.

1) Identifying Preference Heads:
- Perform causal masking interventions on individual attention heads (ablate/mask a head) and measure the impact on user-aligned outputs.
- Define a Preference Contribution Score (PCS) to quantify each head’s causal contribution to preference-aligned generation, aiming to move from correlational attribution to intervention-based evidence.

2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS):
- At decoding time, contrast the model’s token distribution with Preference Heads enabled vs. suppressed, then amplify the differential signal to promote preference-consistent continuations and suppress generic ones.
- Extend to cluster-aware steering so users with similar profiles can share partially overlapping preference circuits, reducing per-user overhead.

Compared with CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe, DPS’s contrast set is not a fixed structural choice (layers, retrieval heads) but a causally discovered subset tied to personalization.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen2-7B-Instruct.
Benchmark: LaMP, covering both user-conditioned generation tasks and prediction tasks (classification/regression).
Metrics: ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR for generation; Accuracy/F1 for classification; MAE/RMSE for regression.
Baselines: CAD, DoLa, DeCoRe.

Reported outcomes: DPS improves personalization fidelity/style alignment across models and tasks while maintaining coherence and efficiency; masking the identified heads disrupts personalized behavior, supporting the causal claim. Exact deltas are table-dependent and should be read directly from the main results tables (the provided excerpt does not include consolidated numbers).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Read the PCS definition and the exact masking intervention: where the ablation is applied (head output vs. attention weights), how scores are aggregated across users/examples, and how they control for confounds.
- Read the DPS decoding equation carefully: how the differential distribution is combined with base logits, how the steering strength is chosen, and what normalization/temperature is used to avoid degeneration.
- In experiments, focus on: (a) head-to-head comparisons vs. CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe across task types, (b) causal validation via masking, (c) cluster-aware steering’s cost/benefit.
- Spend less time on dataset boilerplate; prioritize ablations and interpretability visualizations (which heads, which layers, and how activations map to style/topic dimensions).

recommendation.zh: 如果你做机制分析，这篇值得看 head-level 因果识别是否真有稀疏性；若只是做 pretrain，可只读 PCS 定义和 ablation，别把“功能定位”过早当成稳定事实。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the head-level causal identification if you do mech interp; if you are mainly a pretraining person, just inspect the PCS definition and ablations, and do not over-trust functional localization too early.

paper.title: Slot Machines: How LLMs Keep Track of Multiple Entities
paper.abstract: Language models must bind entities to the attributes they possess and maintain several such binding relationships within a context. We study how multiple entities are represented across token positions and whether single tokens can carry bindings for more than one entity. We introduce a multi-slot probing approach that disentangles a single token's residual stream activation to recover information about both the currently described entity and the immediately preceding one. These two kinds of inf

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是语言模型如何在上下文里同时跟踪多个实体，并把实体与属性、关系绑定起来。更具体地说，它问了一个比常见 probing 更细的问题：单个 token 位置的残差流里，是否能同时承载不止一个实体的信息；如果能，这些信息是怎么分槽存放的，又被模型拿去做什么计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制层面。很多时候我们说模型“记住了信息”，但这并不等于这些信息能被后续电路自由调用。论文把“信息存在”与“信息被使用”区分开来，指出模型即便在一个 token 上编码了当前实体和前一个实体两套表示，后者的可用性也可能受限。这对理解上下文表示、绑定机制、关系推理失败模式，以及为什么一些模型在多实体推理上表现脆弱，都有帮助。它不是直接改进 pretrain 方法的论文，但对分析训练后模型学到了什么表示结构，价值是实在的。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是作者提出的 multi-slot probing。传统 probe 往往默认一个 token 位置主要对应一种语义子空间，或者至多恢复一个主导概念。这里作者显式假设同一 token 可能混合了多个实体相关表示，并尝试在无监督条件下把这些“槽位”拆出来。

实验默认用 Qwen3-32B，在人工构造的多实体描述语料上分析残差流。作者发现最稳定的两类槽位是 current-entity slot 和 prior-entity slot：前者编码当前正在描述的实体，后者编码紧邻之前那个实体。两者对同一属性的表示方向大体正交，说明这不是同一表示的轻微扰动，而更像模型内部为不同角色分配了不同子空间。

论文随后分析这些槽位的功能差异。prior-entity slot 并非无用，它支持某些关系性计算，例如顺序判断、冲突检测等；但它又不是一个通用可读写记忆。作者发现它通常不能被下游计算直接拿来做显式回忆，也不稳定支持“谁具有某属性”这类绑定查询。也就是说，模型内部确实保留了前一个实体的信息，但后续电路未必把它接到所有需要的任务上。这解释了为什么一些模型在需要把两组绑定关系压在同一 token 上时会失败。
summary.experiments:
论文做了几层实验。第一层是表示层面的 probing：在包含 8 个实体、15 种语义上较分离 trait 的 10,000 条 prompts 上，检查不同 token 位置能否恢复多个实体信息。结论是单 token 上最可靠地能恢复当前实体和前一个实体的信息，而且这两个槽位近似正交。

第二层是功能层面的干预或任务分析：作者测试这些槽位是否参与不同类型的下游计算。结果显示 prior-entity slot 对 relational inference 有帮助，比如顺序和冲突相关任务；但对 explicit recall 和 binding retrieval 的支持明显不足，即使 probe 已经证明相关信息“在那里”。

第三层是行为层面的外部验证。作者构造了需要在同一位置同时维持两组绑定关系的例子，例如“Alice prepares..., Bob consumes...”这类交叉句式。多数主流大模型，包括 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct、DeepSeek-V3.2、GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Claude Sonnet-3.5，都在这类任务上吃力；更新一代的 Claude Opus-4.5 和 Gemini-3-Pro 则能答对。这个结果很有意思，因为它把内部表示限制和外部行为失败对应了起来，也暗示更强模型可能发展出了更可用的多实体绑定机制。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先看 Section 2，再看 Section 4 和 Section 5。Section 2 解释 multi-slot probing 的设定，以及 current/prior slot 的发现，这是整篇的基础。Section 3 可以帮助理解 prior slot 到底能做什么，但如果时间有限，可以先跳到 Section 4，看作者如何证明“有信息”不等于“能调用”。Section 5 则把机制分析落到具体失败案例上，读起来最直观。

阅读时要特别留意两点。第一，作者说“orthogonal slots”时，含义不是严格数学独立，而是表示方向和可恢复内容明显分离。第二，不要把 probe 可解码性直接等同于模型真实使用的计算路径；这篇工作的价值恰恰在于反复区分这两者。

如果只是判断是否值得深入，40 分钟左右足够：读引言、Section 2 的方法与主图、Section 4 的负结果、Section 5 的行为案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how language models track multiple entities in context and bind them to their attributes and relations. More specifically, it asks a sharper question than standard probing work: can a single token position carry information about more than one entity at once, and if so, how is that information partitioned and used downstream?
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. The paper makes a useful distinction between information being present in the representation and that information being functionally available to the model’s later computations. That matters for understanding entity binding, context representations, and failure modes in multi-entity reasoning. It helps explain why a model may appear to “know” multiple bindings under probing, yet still fail on tasks that require those bindings to be jointly manipulated. This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to anyone trying to understand what current pretraining actually induces in internal representations.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key method is a multi-slot probing framework. Standard probes often assume that a token position is dominated by a single semantic role or concept. Here, the authors explicitly allow a single residual-stream state to multiplex multiple entity-related representations, and they try to disentangle those slots in an unsupervised way.

Using Qwen3-32B as the default analysis model, they construct synthetic prompts with multiple entities and inspect residual activations across token positions. The main finding is that two slots are especially robust: a current-entity slot and a prior-entity slot. The current slot tracks the entity currently being described; the prior slot tracks the immediately preceding entity. Importantly, these slots are largely orthogonal, meaning that “trait X for the current entity” and “trait X for the prior entity” are not just weak variants of the same direction but occupy distinct representational subspaces.

The paper then studies what these slots are used for. The prior-entity slot is not merely epiphenomenal: it supports relational computations such as order-sensitive reasoning and conflict detection. But it is not a general-purpose memory interface. The authors find that downstream computations usually do not use it for explicit recall or for direct binding retrieval, even when probing shows that the relevant information is encoded there. In other words, the model stores prior-entity information, but later circuits do not seem to route that information into all tasks that would benefit from it. This provides a mechanistic explanation for failures on prompts that require two bindings to be maintained on the same token position.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has three layers. First, there is representational probing. On 10,000 prompts describing eight entities with one of 15 semantically distinct traits, the authors test whether multiple entity states can be recovered from a single token position. The answer is yes: the most reliable recoverable signals correspond to the current entity and the immediately previous entity, and these slots are approximately orthogonal.

Second, there is functional analysis. The paper tests whether these slots participate in different downstream computations. The prior-entity slot helps with relational inferences such as sequence order and conflict detection, but it is much less useful for explicit recall or for answering binding-style questions like “who has trait X?”, even though probing indicates that the information is encoded.

Third, there is behavioral validation on carefully designed prompts that require multiple bindings to coexist at one position, such as crossed role-assignment examples involving Alice and Bob. Many strong models, including Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct, DeepSeek-V3.2, GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Claude Sonnet-3.5, struggle on these tasks. Newer frontier models such as Claude Opus-4.5 and Gemini-3-Pro succeed. That comparison is useful because it links an internal representational limitation to an observable reasoning failure, while also suggesting that newer models may have developed more usable multi-entity binding mechanisms.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Section 2. That is where the multi-slot probing setup is introduced and where the current/prior slot distinction is established. Then read Section 4, which is arguably the most important part conceptually: it shows that decodable information is not the same as functionally used information. Section 5 is the most intuitive bridge to behavior, because it turns the mechanistic findings into concrete failure cases.

Two reading cautions matter. First, when the paper says the slots are orthogonal, the practical meaning is representational separation, not perfect mathematical independence. Second, do not equate probe success with the model’s actual computation path; the paper’s main point is precisely that these can diverge.

For triage, around 40 minutes is enough: introduction, Section 2 methods and main figures, Section 4 negative results, and Section 5 behavioral examples.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“一个 token 只表示当前对象”的朴素看法；先看 slot 正交性和功能分工实验，若 setup 站得住，实体绑定电路分析要换问题设定。
recommendation.en: This should update the naive view that a token only represents the current entity; start with the slot orthogonality and functional-role experiments, because if the setup is clean, entity-binding circuit analysis needs a different framing.

paper.title: Can We Locate and Prevent Stereotypes in LLMs?
paper.abstract: Stereotypes in large language models (LLMs) can perpetuate harmful societal biases. Despite the widespread use of models, little is known about where these biases reside in the neural network. This study investigates the internal mechanisms of GPT 2 Small and Llama 3.2 to locate stereotype related activations. We explore two approaches: identifying individual contrastive neuron activations that encode stereotypes, and detecting attention heads that contribute heavily to biased outputs. Our exper

summary.core_problem: 如何在模型内部定位“刻板印象/偏见”相关的表征与计算路径，并据此做定向干预以减少偏见输出。
summary.importance: 属于机制分析+安全方向：尝试把“偏见”从输出层面的现象，落到可操作的内部单元（神经元/注意力头）上，为可解释性缓解（activation editing / head ablation）提供线索。
summary.technical_approach: 两条线：1）用对比式触发（stereotype vs. non-stereotype prompts）寻找差分激活显著的“对比神经元”；2）用注意力头贡献度分析，找对偏见输出影响最大的 heads，并尝试形成可复用的“bias fingerprint”。
summary.experiments: 对象为 GPT-2 Small 与 Llama 3.2（具体版本/规模以正文为准）；主要报告定位到的神经元/注意力头集合及其对偏见输出的贡献，目标是展示可定位性与初步缓解效果（摘要未给出定量缓解幅度与对照设置细节）。
summary.authors_note: UC Davis

summary_en.core_problem: How to localize stereotype-related representations/computation inside LLMs and use targeted interventions to reduce biased generations.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic interpretability for safety: moves bias from an output-level symptom to actionable internal units (neurons/attention heads), potentially enabling activation editing or head-level mitigation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two tracks: (1) contrastive prompting to identify neurons with large activation deltas between stereotype vs non-stereotype conditions; (2) attribution-style analysis to find attention heads that disproportionately drive biased outputs, forming a 'bias fingerprint'.
summary_en.experiments: Studies GPT-2 Small and Llama 3.2 (exact variants/sizes per paper); reports identified neuron/head sets and their contribution to biased outputs, with preliminary mitigation attempts (abstract lacks clean quantitative deltas and controls).
summary_en.authors_note: UC Davis

recommendation.zh: 更像安全可解释性的探索性作业：方法不新、setup 可能不够干净；只需扫结果可复现性与干预是否稳健。
recommendation.en: Exploratory safety interpretability with likely noisy attribution; skim for whether the neuron/head interventions are robust and reproducible, not for new methodology.

paper.title: Convergent Evolution: How Different Language Models Learn Similar Number Representations
paper.abstract: Language models trained on natural text learn to represent numbers using periodic features with dominant periods at $T=2, 5, 10$. In this paper, we identify a two-tiered hierarchy of these features: while Transformers, Linear RNNs, LSTMs, and classical word embeddings trained in different ways all learn features that have period-$T$ spikes in the Fourier domain, only some learn geometrically separable features that can be used to linearly classify a number mod-$T$. To explain this incongruity, w

summary.core_problem: 很多工作把“数字 token embedding 出现 T=2/5/10 的傅里叶尖峰”解读为模型学到了可用的数概念结构。但全文给出的核心问题更尖锐：为什么几乎所有系统（Transformer、线性 RNN、LSTM、传统词向量，甚至仅语料频次分布）都会出现相似的频谱尖峰（spectral convergence），但只有一部分系统的数字 embedding 才能把 n mod T 线性可分（geometric convergence）？也就是：频谱尖峰到底来自数据/分词的统计偏置，还是来自模型学到的可计算结构；以及什么条件决定“尖峰”能否转化为可线性解码的模结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要在“机制归因”和“数据-分词-优化-架构耦合”两点。第一，它把一个常见的机制解释（数字 embedding 的周期结构=模型学会了模运算）拆成两层，并证明“有尖峰”并不等价于“可线性读出模类”，避免把数据诱导的统计结构误当成模型能力。第二，它用受控训练把几类因素（数据中的数字共现与跨数字交互、上下文长度、架构、优化器、tokenizer）逐一剥离，给出更工程化的结论：哪些信号会让几何可分出现，哪些只会保留频谱尖峰。这类结论对做数据配比、tokenizer 设计、以及解释训练动态（为什么某些结构在某些架构里“长出来”）都直接有用。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三块。
1) 现象与度量：固定研究对象为 0..999 的数字 token embedding e(n)。沿 token index 做 DFT，观察功率谱在 1/T 处的尖峰（T=2/5/10）。同时用线性 probe（T 类 logistic regression）预测 n mod T，作为“几何可分/可线性读出”的 operational 定义。
2) 理论区分：给出结论“傅里叶域稀疏（有尖峰）是 mod-T 可分的必要条件，但不是充分条件”。直观上，尖峰只说明 embedding 在 token 序上有周期分量；但要线性分开 residue class，需要这些周期分量在几何上形成可被一个线性分类器稳定切分的簇/方向结构。论文用定理（Theorem 1）形式化了这种不充分性，并解释了为何两个系统可以有几乎相同的频谱，却 probe 准确率天差地别。
3) 结构归因式的受控实验：在相同规模（文中强调 300M 参数）与相同训练数据的条件下，系统性改变单一因素来观察“尖峰是否仍在”与“probe 是否掉到随机”。数据侧做逐步去除：削弱文本-数字共现、削弱跨数字交互、缩短上下文等；架构侧对比 Transformer、线性 RNN、LSTM；优化侧比较不同优化器在相同架构下对几何可分的影响；tokenizer 侧用“从零训练加法”任务对比单 token vs 多 token 表示数字，展示多 token 加法会强迫出现模子问题（例如按位/按块的模 1000 结构），从而更稳定地产生圆形/周期表示，而单 token 加法存在多种可行策略，表示会更依赖优化路径（optimizer-dependent）。
summary.experiments:
全文实验的关键不是单一 SOTA 数字，而是“同频谱、不同可分性”的对照与消融趋势。
- 广泛性：在多种已发布模型与非 Transformer 系统、以及 GloVe/FastText 中都观察到 T=2/5/10 的尖峰；甚至仅统计训练语料中数字 token 的频次分布也出现相似频谱（用来支持“数据/分词诱导”的解释）。
- 两层收敛：spectral convergence 几乎处处存在；geometric convergence 只在部分系统出现。文中给出强对照：Transformer 与线性 RNN（在约 10B token 训练设置下）能把 mod-T 线性 probe 做到很高，而 LSTM 在相同数据下即使尖峰更显著，probe 仍接近随机水平。
- 数据消融：逐步移除文本-数字共现、跨数字交互、或缩短上下文长度，会显著降低 mod-T probe；但傅里叶尖峰在这些条件下仍然顽固存在，支持“尖峰更像数据统计投影，几何可分需要额外语义/组合信号”的判断。
- 架构/优化：架构对几何可分是决定性的（Transformer/线性 RNN vs LSTM）；优化器在某些设置下会改变是否学到可分结构，但不会改变尖峰出现这一事实。
- tokenizer 与任务约束：在从零训练的加法任务里，多 token 表示数字会迫使模型解决按位/按块的模子问题，从而更稳定地产生周期/圆形结构；单 token 表示数字时，模型可能走不同捷径，导致表示对优化路径更敏感、结果更不稳定。
（注：你给的全文片段未包含所有表格具体数值；上述以论文主线结论与对照关系为主，数字细节应以正文图表为准。）
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按“先建立区分，再看归因”走。
- 先看问题设定与度量：Problem Setup 里 DFT 的定义、Fourier spike 的 operational 定义、以及 mod-T 线性 probe 的设置。这里决定了后面所有结论的可比性。
- 重点看理论段落（含 Theorem 1）：抓住“必要不充分”的条件到底卡在哪里。建议对照论文给出的反例/解释：同样的频谱稀疏如何对应到不同的几何布局。
- 重点看三组受控实验：
  1) 数据信号逐步移除的消融（最能说明‘尖峰不等于能力’）；
  2) 架构对照（Transformer/线性 RNN/LSTM 在同数据同规模下的 probe 差异）；
  3) tokenizer + 加法任务（多 token 强约束如何“逼出”模结构）。
- 如果时间有限：只看 Figure 1/2（广泛性与语料频谱）、以及架构对照与数据消融对应的主图，就能把论文的核心论证链条串起来。

summary_en.core_problem: Prior work often treats Fourier spikes (dominant periods around T=2/5/10) in number token embeddings as evidence that LMs learn structured numerical representations. The paper’s actual core question is sharper: why do Fourier spikes ("spectral convergence") appear almost universally—across Transformers, linear RNNs, LSTMs, classical word embeddings, and even the raw corpus frequency of number tokens—while only some systems yield embeddings where residue classes n mod T are linearly decodable ("geometric convergence")? In other words, what part is a data/tokenization-induced statistical artifact, and what part reflects a learned, functionally usable modular structure—and which training conditions control the transition from spectral to geometric convergence?
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly methodological and interpretability-relevant for pretraining research. (1) It cleanly separates two phenomena that are frequently conflated: periodic spectra vs linearly usable modular codes. This prevents over-interpreting a ubiquitous spectral signature as a learned arithmetic capability. (2) It runs controlled “structure attribution” experiments that isolate how data signals (text–number co-occurrence, cross-number interactions, context length), architecture choice, optimizer, and tokenizer jointly determine whether modular structure becomes linearly accessible. These findings are directly actionable for data design, tokenizer decisions, and for understanding training dynamics where certain representations reliably emerge in some architectures but not others.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The approach has three pillars.
1) Metrics and setup: focus on embeddings e(n) for number tokens n in 0..999 (aligned with common tokenizers where these are single tokens). Compute a DFT along the token index and measure power at frequencies 1/T to identify spikes. Separately, train a linear probe (T-way logistic regression) to predict n mod T from e(n), operationalizing “geometric separability.”
2) Theory: prove that Fourier-domain sparsity/spikes are necessary but not sufficient for mod-T linear separability (Theorem 1). Intuitively, a periodic component in the sequence of embeddings does not guarantee that residue classes form linearly separable clusters; two systems can share near-identical spectra yet differ drastically in the geometry relevant to linear decoding.
3) Controlled attribution experiments: train ~300M-parameter models on matched data while perturbing one factor at a time. Data-side perturbations progressively remove (i) text–number co-occurrence, (ii) cross-number interaction signals, and (iii) long-context dependencies. Architecture comparisons include Transformers vs linear RNNs vs LSTMs under identical data. Optimizer comparisons test whether optimization path affects geometric convergence even when spectral convergence is stable. Tokenizer effects are probed via training-from-scratch addition tasks: multi-token numbers force modular subproblems (e.g., digit/block-wise modulo constraints), making circular/periodic representations more stable; single-token numbers admit multiple solution strategies, making learned representations more optimizer-dependent.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story is built around contrasts and ablations rather than a single headline benchmark.
- Universality: T=2/5/10 spikes are observed across many released LMs and non-Transformer sequence models, plus GloVe/FastText; strikingly, the corpus-level frequency distribution of number tokens already exhibits a similar periodic spectrum.
- Two-tier outcome: spectral convergence is near-universal; geometric convergence is not. A key controlled contrast: Transformers and linear RNNs (in large-token training settings) yield high mod-T probe accuracy, while LSTMs trained on the same data can show even stronger spikes yet remain near chance on mod-T probing.
- Data ablations: removing co-occurrence, cross-number interactions, or reducing context length degrades mod-T probe accuracy substantially, while Fourier spikes persist—supporting the claim that spikes are largely data/tokenization-driven, whereas linear decodability requires additional structured signals.
- Architecture/optimizer: architecture is decisive for geometric convergence; optimizer can affect whether separable structure emerges in some settings, but does not eliminate the spectral spikes.
- Tokenizer/task constraint: in addition-from-scratch, multi-token number representations more reliably induce modular/circular features due to forced modulo subproblems; single-token setups allow alternative shortcuts, leading to higher variance and optimizer dependence.
(Note: the provided full-text excerpt does not include all numeric tables; exact probe accuracies and training details should be taken from the corresponding figures/tables in the paper.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in the order that mirrors the argument.
- Start with the formal setup: how the DFT is computed over e(n), what counts as a Fourier spike, and how the mod-T linear probe is defined.
- Then read the theorem section carefully (Theorem 1): the paper’s main conceptual move is the “necessary but not sufficient” separation; understanding the geometric failure modes is the point.
- Spend most time on the controlled experiments:
  (i) data-signal removal ablations (best evidence that spikes ≠ usable structure),
  (ii) architecture-matched comparisons (Transformer/linear RNN vs LSTM),
  (iii) tokenizer + addition task (why multi-token constraints reliably produce modular codes).
- If time is tight: focus on the early figures showing universality (including corpus frequency spectrum) and the architecture/ablation figures that juxtapose stable spikes with collapsing probe accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你看 probing 结果的方式：看到周期峰值别急着说模型学会了数论结构，先区分 Fourier 稀疏和几何可分；建议直接复现它的 tokenizer/optimizer ablation。
recommendation.en: This should change how you read probing results: a Fourier spike does not mean the model learned modular structure; separate spectral sparsity from geometric separability and replicate the tokenizer/optimizer ablations.

paper.title: Transformer Layers as Painters
paper.abstract:
ML, Biotech, Hardware, and Coordination Problems. Sometimes I write about hard problems and how to solve them.

LLM Neuroanatomy III: Why RYS Works — The Language-Agnostic Middle Posted Mar 26, 2026 Updated Apr 20, 2026 By David Noel Ng 44 min read LLM Neuroanatomy III: Why RYS Works — The Language-Agnostic Middle Contents LLM Neuroanatomy III: Why RYS Works — The Language-Agnostic Middle If you haven’t heard about the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, don’t worry, I hadn’t either until I saw a comment on

summary.core_problem: 这篇试图把前两篇的经验观察收束成一个更清楚的机制命题：为什么 RYS 只在中层有效，以及这种“可重复的中层”是否对应一个语言无关、甚至跨代码与 LaTeX 的共享语义空间。它关心的不是单次 hack，而是 Transformer 内部表示与可编辑性的关系。
summary.key_insights: 最值得记住的是作者把两件事绑在了一起：共享语义空间出现在哪里，层复制就在哪里最可能有效。文章在五个前沿模型上复查三段式结构，并把比较从自然语言扩展到代码和 LaTeX，论点是中层更按语义/主题组织，而不是按表面语言组织；因此复制这些层，相当于增加抽象计算步数，而不是破坏输入解析或输出成形。对基座研究的意义在于，这给“深度的功能分区”“跨模态/跨语言统一表示”“无训练架构手术的边界”提供了一个可操作的观察框架，也和已有 multilingual interpretability 文献形成了较好的对接。
summary.limits: 文章比前两篇成熟，但仍然停留在博客层面的证据整合。它更像对已有 interpretability 结果的工程化利用与再组织，而不是严格的新理论。‘语言无关中层’并不等于真正独立于训练语料和 tokenizer；扩展到代码、LaTeX 的结论也还需要更系统的任务验证，尤其是对生成质量、校准和长程推理稳定性的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Part III tries to turn the earlier observations into a sharper mechanistic claim: RYS works specifically in the middle because that is where a language-agnostic semantic space lives, and that space may extend beyond natural language into code and LaTeX-like symbolic forms.
summary_en.key_insights: The strongest idea here is the alignment between representation geometry and model surgery: the layers that can be duplicated profitably are the same layers where surface-form differences collapse and semantic structure dominates. The author revisits the three-phase anatomy across five frontier models, including MoEs, and argues that middle layers are organized more by meaning than by language. For pretraining work, this is useful because it links multilingual representation sharing, functional depth specialization, and zero-training architectural edits under one concrete hypothesis.
summary_en.limits: Even in this more careful version, the evidence remains blog-grade rather than publication-grade. Much of the conceptual framing is an engineering synthesis of prior multilingual interpretability results plus new probing. The broader claims still need stronger controls, wider replication, and clearer evidence that the effect survives beyond the chosen models and probes.

The Sapir-Whorf hypothesis is simply the idea that the language you think in shapes or determines what you can think, and has been debated in linguistics for nearly a century. paper.title: Hallucination as Trajectory Commitment: Causal Evidence for Asymmetric Attractor Dynamics in Transformer Generation
paper.abstract: We present causal evidence that hallucination in autoregressive language models is an early trajectory commitment governed by asymmetric attractor dynamics. Using same-prompt bifurcation, in which we repeatedly sample identical inputs to observe spontaneous divergence, we isolate trajectory dynamics from prompt-level confounds. On Qwen2.5-1.5B across 61 prompts spanning six categories, 27 prompts (44.3%) bifurcate with factual and hallucinated trajectories diverging at the first generated token

summary.core_problem: 论文要回答的问题是：LLM 的 hallucination 到底是在生成早期就进入了一条错误轨迹，还是后面逐步偏离；这种错误轨迹一旦形成，是否容易被纠正。作者试图把“相关性观察”推进到“因果机制判断”，用同一 prompt 下的分叉采样和 activation patching，直接测量正确轨迹与幻觉轨迹之间的可逆性和不对称性。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 hallucination 从“输出错误”重新表述成“残差流状态空间中的轨迹承诺问题”。这个视角比常见的 probe 检测更接近训练动力学和表示几何：如果错误轨迹是一个容易进入、难以逃离的 attractor basin，那么单纯在输出层做校准或 rerank 可能治标不治本，而更有效的干预点可能在中后层的状态演化。对做机制分析、truthfulness、RL pretrain 或后训练纠偏的人，这个结论有参考价值；但论文规模较小，只在单一 1.5B 模型上做了较强定性的因果证据，离普适结论还有距离。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。第一步是 same-prompt bifurcation。作者不比较不同 prompt 的正确/错误回答，因为那会把 prompt 语义差异和轨迹差异混在一起；而是对同一个 prompt 在非零温度下重复采样，筛出既能生成正确答案也能生成 hallucinated 答案的“分叉 prompt”。这样可以把初始输入固定住，把差异尽量归因到采样路径和内部状态演化。

第二步是 bidirectional activation patching。对每个分叉 prompt，分别收集正确运行和幻觉运行的完整 hidden-state cache，关注 28 层 transformer 每一层、每个生成步的 residual stream post-attention 表征。然后在某个 layer-step 位置，把目标轨迹的激活替换成另一类轨迹的激活，再继续自回归生成。作者做了两种主实验：H→C，测试能否把幻觉轨迹纠正；C→H，测试能否把正确轨迹污染。并配了三个控制：随机 prompt 的 correct 激活、同 prompt 的 wrong-to-wrong 激活、未 patch 基线。

核心贡献不是 patching 技术本身，而是由 patching 得到的因果不对称性：把 hallucinated activation 注入正确轨迹很容易把输出带偏；反过来，把 correct activation 注入幻觉轨迹，纠正效果明显更弱，而且往往需要持续多步干预。这支持作者提出的 asymmetric attractor dynamics 解释。与已有工作相比，区别在于它不满足于“某层可线性探测 hallucination”，而是问“某层状态是否足以改变后续轨迹”。
summary.experiments:
实验全部在 Qwen2.5-1.5B 上完成，模型为 28 层、d_model=1536。数据集包含 61 个 prompt，覆盖 factual、false premise、confabulation、leading、multi-hop、math 六类。每个 prompt 以温度 τ=0.7 采样 20 次；若同一 prompt 至少有 2 个正确完成和 2 个 hallucinated 完成，则记为 bifurcating。结果是 27/61 个 prompt，即 44.3%，出现了这种分叉现象。

轨迹分离时间上，作者报告许多分叉 prompt 在第一个生成 token 就已明显分化：step 0 时 KL=0，step 1 时 KL>1.0，说明分歧不是在长程生成后才累积出来，而是很早就决定了方向。表示层面，作者用 layer×step 的 Cohen’s d 热图看 correct 与 hallucinated hidden states 的分离程度，显示中后层存在显著可分区域。

最关键的是 patching 结果。摘要给出的代表性数字是：在 layer 20，把 hallucinated activation 注入 correct trajectory，87.5% 的试验会把原本正确的生成污染成错误；而在 layer 24，把 correct activation 注入 hallucinated trajectory，只有 33.3% 能恢复正确。并且作者指出，纠正通常需要 sustained multi-step intervention，单次 patch 很难稳定把错误轨迹拉回。这一组结果支撑“易入难出”的 attractor 解释。控制实验的作用也很重要：随机 prompt 的 correct 激活不能产生同等效果，说明不是任意‘看起来正确’的状态都能修复；wrong-to-wrong 也排除了‘只要改一下激活就会变’这种平凡解释。

局限也很明显。样本规模不大，prompt 分类和正确/错误判定依赖 substring matching，模型只有一个 1.5B 开源模型，且 patching 只在 residual stream post-attention、最后 token 位置进行。因此结论更适合作为机制假设和因果证据雏形，而不是关于所有 LLM hallucination 的一般定律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。

第一，看 same-prompt bifurcation 的定义和筛选流程。这是全文最关键的实验设计，因为它决定了作者是否真的把 prompt-level confound 控住了。重点看 prompt 分类、正确/幻觉标签规则，以及 bifurcating prompt 的筛选门槛。

第二，看 divergence onset 和 hidden-state separation 的图。它们回答“分叉发生得有多早、在哪些层最明显”。如果你关心训练动态或表示几何，这部分比最终 patch 成功率更有启发。

第三，重点看 activation patching 主结果和控制实验。尤其要看 C→H 与 H→C 的成功率差异、最有效层位于哪里、单步 patch 与多步 patch 的差别。作者的核心判断几乎都建立在这里。

如果时间有限，20–30 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读：读方法设计、主结果图、控制实验和讨论部分即可。若要深挖，建议进一步思考两个问题：为什么最强干预层出现在中后层而不是更早层；以及这种不对称 attractor 是否可能来自采样温度、解码策略或训练语料中的错误先验，而不只是模型内部动力学本身。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question about hallucination: does an autoregressive LM commit to a hallucinated continuation very early in generation, and once that commitment is made, is it causally reversible? Rather than treating hallucination as a generic output error, the paper studies it as a trajectory-level phenomenon inside the transformer’s residual stream.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and model-mechanism research, the main value is conceptual. The paper reframes hallucination as trajectory commitment in state space, with an asymmetric attractor structure: entering a hallucinated basin is easy, escaping it is hard. That perspective is more useful than simple hidden-state probing if one cares about where training or post-training interventions should act. It suggests that output-layer calibration alone may be too late, and that truthfulness may depend on stabilizing internal trajectories before they lock in. The evidence is still narrow: one 1.5B model, a small prompt set, and a qualitative causal story rather than a broad scaling result. So this is a mechanism paper to skim for ideas, not a definitive account of hallucination.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two parts. First, the authors introduce same-prompt bifurcation. Instead of comparing different prompts that happen to yield correct versus hallucinated outputs, they repeatedly sample the exact same prompt at nonzero temperature and keep prompts for which both outcomes occur. This is meant to isolate trajectory-level divergence from prompt-level semantic confounds.

Second, they run bidirectional activation patching on those bifurcating prompts. For each prompt, they cache full hidden states from multiple correct runs and multiple hallucinated runs, using the residual stream after attention across all 28 layers and generation steps. At a chosen layer and step, they replace the target run’s activation with the source run’s activation and continue autoregressive decoding. Two main directions are tested: hallucinated-to-correct (can a bad trajectory be repaired?) and correct-to-hallucinated (can a good trajectory be corrupted?). They also include controls: patching from a different prompt, patching hallucinated-to-hallucinated, and an unpatched baseline.

The technical novelty is not activation patching itself, but the causal asymmetry revealed by patching. Prior work often shows that hallucination is detectable in hidden states. This paper asks a stronger question: are those states sufficient to redirect the generation trajectory? The answer appears asymmetric: hallucinated states can derail correct trajectories much more easily than correct states can rescue hallucinated ones.
summary_en.experiments:
All experiments are run on Qwen2.5-1.5B, a 28-layer transformer with d_model = 1536. The prompt set contains 61 prompts across six categories: factual, false premise, confabulation, leading, multi-hop, and math. Each prompt is sampled 20 times at temperature 0.7. A prompt is marked as bifurcating if it yields at least two correct completions and at least two hallucinated completions. By this criterion, 27 of 61 prompts, or 44.3%, bifurcate.

The paper reports that divergence often happens extremely early. For many bifurcating prompts, the KL divergence between the mean output distributions of correct and hallucinated runs is zero at step 0 and already exceeds 1.0 at step 1. That supports the claim that the trajectory split is an early commitment, not a late drift. Hidden-state separation heatmaps based on Cohen’s d further show strong class separation in mid-to-late layers.

The headline causal result is the patching asymmetry. Injecting a hallucinated activation into a correct trajectory corrupts the output in 87.5% of trials at layer 20, while injecting a correct activation into a hallucinated trajectory recovers the correct output in only 33.3% of trials at layer 24. The paper also notes that successful correction usually requires sustained multi-step intervention, whereas corruption is easier to trigger with a single patch. The controls matter: random-prompt correct activations do not produce the same effect, and wrong-to-wrong patching helps rule out the trivial explanation that any perturbation can change the outcome.

The limitations are substantial. The study uses one relatively small model, a modest prompt set, substring-based labeling, and a specific patching location in the residual stream. So the results should be read as strong causal evidence for a plausible mechanism, not as a universal law of LLM hallucination.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the experimental design, especially the definition of bifurcating prompts. That is the paper’s cleanest idea, because it tries to hold the prompt fixed while exposing trajectory-level stochastic divergence.

Then read the divergence-onset analysis and the hidden-state separation plots. Those sections answer when the split happens and where in the network the two trajectories become distinguishable. If you care about training dynamics or internal geometry, these plots are more informative than the final patching percentages alone.

After that, focus on the bidirectional patching results and the controls. The paper’s main claim stands or falls on the asymmetry between correct-to-hallucinated corruption and hallucinated-to-correct repair. Pay attention to which layers are most effective, and whether single-step versus multi-step patching changes the picture.

A useful skim takes about 20 to 30 minutes: method setup, main figures, controls, and discussion. If you want to think beyond the paper, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: why the strongest interventions appear in mid-to-late layers rather than the earliest layers, and how much of the observed asymmetry might depend on decoding temperature, sampling noise, or training-data priors rather than an intrinsic attractor geometry alone.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把幻觉从“解码末端失误”改成“首 token 早承诺”的动力学问题；先看 bifurcation 设定和 patching 结果，外推到大模型前要保留怀疑。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it reframes hallucination from a late decoding mistake into an early-token commitment problem; read the bifurcation setup and patching results, but keep your skepticism on scaling.

paper.title: Disentangling Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs: A Methodological Investigation of Internal Mechanisms
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities, yet their internal mechanisms for handling reasoning-intensive tasks remain underexplored. To advance the understanding of model-internal processing mechanisms, we present an investigation of how LLMs perform arithmetic operations by examining internal mechanisms during task execution. Using early decoding, we trace how next-token predictions are constructed across layers. Our experiments reveal that while the models recogni

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的不是“模型会不会算术”，而是“模型在内部是怎样把算术题做出来的”。作者把问题收得很窄，只看加减法、只看单 token 数字、只看零样本推理，用 early decoding（也就是 logit lens）沿层追踪 next-token 表征，试图分清三件事：模型何时识别出这是算术任务，何时形成正确结果，以及 attention 和 MLP 在这个过程中分别承担什么角色。相比只看最终准确率，这个问题更接近机制层面的解释：如果一个模型能算对，它到底是在做近似算法式处理，还是只是靠记忆、模板匹配或局部统计偏好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响不在于提出了新的训练方法，而在于给出了一种较清楚的机制性观察框架。论文的主要贡献有两点。第一，它把“算术能力”拆成了任务识别、信息传播、结果聚合三个阶段，说明正确答案通常不是在早层逐步显现，而是在后层才被明确写入 logits。第二，它比较了强弱两个模型后发现，算术能力较好的模型内部更接近一种模块分工：attention 负责把输入中的关键信息搬运到后续位置，MLP 负责把这些信息组合成结果；能力较弱的模型则缺少这种稳定分工。这个结论对理解预训练中能力形成很有启发，因为它暗示“会做题”不只是参数更多，而是中间计算路径更有结构。对做 scaling、训练动态、mechanistic interpretability 的人，这篇文章的价值主要是提供了一个可操作的分析切口，而不是给出定论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者采用的是非常克制的设置。数据是人工构造的加减法题，prompt 形式固定为“Please calculate a +/- b =”，并严格把操作数和结果控制在 520 以内，以保证 GPT-2 XL 和 GPT-NeoX-20B 的 tokenizer 都把数字编码成单 token。这样做的原因很明确：如果数字被拆成多个 token，层间表征变化会混入 tokenizer 影响，难以判断模型是在做算术还是在做 token 级拼接。

分析分三部分。第一部分看“何时识别任务、何时生成答案”。作者在每层 attention/MLP 更新后，把 residual stream 通过 LM head 投到词表空间，观察中间最可能 token。结果显示，模型往往在较早层就把高概率质量放到与算术任务相关的区域，但正确结果 token 通常要到最后几层才稳定出现。这说明早层更像是在建立任务上下文，后层才完成结果写出。

第二部分看“输入信息如何传播”。作者追踪中间预测与输入 token 的关系，发现强模型中 attention 模块更常把操作数、运算符等输入信息沿层传递，而 MLP 更像在这些已传播的信息上做聚合和变换。这个观察与一些已有工作中“attention 负责路由、MLP 负责存储/变换”的结论一致，但这里是在算术任务上给出了更具体的证据。

第三部分看“操作数如何组合”。作者不仅看两操作数，还看三操作数设置，试图判断模型是否只是记住常见配对，还是在执行某种函数式组合。论文给出的证据是：模型常表现出一种不对称处理方式，一个操作数更像‘参数’或‘条件’，另一个操作数被按运算符和该参数进行变换。这种现象说明内部计算并非纯粹检索式回忆，而更接近局部算法化处理。

与更激进的因果干预方法相比，这篇论文主要依赖 early decoding 观察，而不是大规模 activation patching、head ablation 或路径归因。因此它的优点是简单、可复现、解释直观；代价是因果性较弱，很多结论仍是“强指示”而不是严格证明。
summary.experiments:
实验对象是两个能力差异明显的 decoder-only 模型：GPT-NeoX-20B 和 GPT-2 XL。数据方面，作者为加法和减法各构造 small/large 两组数据；small 中操作数和结果都不超过 99，每个数据集 500 个唯一 query；整体上又把所有数字限制在 520 以内，以保证单 token 数字表示。论文正文主要展示加法，减法结果放在附录，并说明结构上相似。

关键结果有四类。第一，任务识别早、正确结果晚：中间 logits 在前中层已经表现出“这是算术题”的迹象，但正确答案 token 往往只在最后几层才成为主导预测。第二，强模型和弱模型的差别不只是最终准确率，而是层内组织方式不同。GPT-NeoX-20B 在算术上表现更好，同时呈现出更清楚的 attention/MLP 分工；GPT-2 XL 则没有这种稳定模式。第三，输入传播与结果聚合在模块上可分离：attention 更新后更容易看到与输入 token 对齐的中间预测，MLP 更新后更容易看到向结果 token 收敛。第四，在多操作数设置下，模型并非简单逐 token 背诵答案，而是显示出某种组合规则。

需要注意的是，这篇论文的实验更偏机制观察，不是 benchmark 导向，因此正文里更强调层级趋势、可视化和模块差异，而不是大量任务分数表。若从方法可信度看，最重要的控制变量其实不是数字本身，而是 tokenizer 单 token 约束和零样本设置，这两点让结果更容易解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题—方法—三组实验—局限”来读，30 到 45 分钟足够抓住主线。

优先看 Introduction，先明确作者不是在做算术 benchmark，而是在做内部机制拆解。接着看 Methodology，重点理解 early decoding 的使用方式，以及为什么要把数字限制在单 token 范围内。然后直接看三组实验对应的图：一组看正确答案在哪些层出现，一组看 attention/MLP 对输入传播和结果聚合的不同作用，一组看两操作数与三操作数时的组合模式。读图时不要只看颜色变化，要看作者如何把中间 token 预测解释为“任务识别”“信息搬运”“结果形成”。

如果时间有限，可以略过附录中的减法细节，因为作者已经说明结构类似。更值得留意的是论文的边界：它主要基于 logit lens 观察，因果强度有限；任务也只覆盖小整数加减法，不能直接外推到一般数学推理。真正值得带走的点只有一个：算术能力较强的模型，内部计算路径更像有组织的分工，而不是均匀分散地‘一起做一点’。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanism question rather than a capability question: not whether LLMs can do arithmetic, but how they internally construct arithmetic answers. It narrows the setting on purpose—zero-shot addition and subtraction, single-token numbers, decoder-only models—and uses early decoding/logit lens to trace the next-token representation across layers. The goal is to separate three stages: when the model recognizes the task as arithmetic, when the correct result emerges, and how attention and MLP blocks contribute differently. This matters because final accuracy alone cannot tell whether the model is doing something algorithm-like, relying on memorized associations, or following shallow token statistics.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly analytical, not methodological. The paper gives a clean decomposition of arithmetic behavior into task recognition, information propagation, and result aggregation. The main empirical claim is that stronger arithmetic models show a clearer internal division of labor: attention modules propagate relevant input information, while MLP modules aggregate it into the final result. Weaker models do not show this pattern as clearly. For pretraining research, this is useful because it suggests that capability gains are not only about scale or memorization; they may also reflect more structured internal computation paths. The paper does not settle the broader question of mathematical reasoning in LLMs, but it provides a concrete and controlled case study that is useful for mechanistic analysis and for thinking about how reasoning-like behavior forms during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is deliberately controlled. The authors build synthetic arithmetic datasets with prompts of the form “Please calculate a +/- b =”. They constrain operands and results to be at most 520 so that both GPT-2 XL and GPT-NeoX-20B represent each number as a single token. This design choice is important: if numbers were split into multiple tokens, tokenizer effects would interfere with any interpretation of layerwise behavior.

The analysis has three parts. First, they study when the task is recognized and when the answer is formed. After each attention and MLP update, they project the residual stream through the LM head and inspect the intermediate top predictions. The main pattern is that arithmetic-task awareness appears early, but the correct result token only becomes dominant in the final layers. This suggests early layers set up the task context, while later layers write the answer.

Second, they study how input information is propagated. By tracking intermediate predictions and their relation to input tokens, they argue that in stronger models attention blocks are more involved in carrying operand and operator information forward, whereas MLP blocks are more involved in combining that information into an answer representation. This aligns with prior observations that attention often acts as a routing mechanism and MLPs as transformation/aggregation modules, but here the claim is grounded in arithmetic behavior.

Third, they examine how operands are combined, including both two-operand and three-operand settings. The evidence suggests that the model is not merely recalling frequent operand-result pairs. Instead, one operand often behaves like an argument or conditioning signal, while the other is transformed depending on the operator and that argument. The authors interpret this as evidence for function-like processing beyond pure factual retrieval.

Compared with stronger causal tools such as activation patching or systematic ablations, the paper relies mostly on observational evidence from early decoding. That makes the method simple and interpretable, but also limits the strength of causal claims.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments compare two decoder-only models with clearly different arithmetic ability: GPT-NeoX-20B and GPT-2 XL. For both addition and subtraction, the authors build small and large datasets; the small setting keeps operands and results within 99, and each dataset contains 500 unique queries. Across all settings, numbers are capped at 520 to preserve single-token representations. The main paper focuses on addition and reports subtraction in the appendix, noting that the qualitative patterns are similar.

There are four main findings. First, task recognition happens early, but correct answer generation happens late: intermediate logits indicate arithmetic-related processing in early and middle layers, while the correct result token usually stabilizes only near the top of the network. Second, the difference between the stronger and weaker model is not just final accuracy; it is also a difference in internal organization. GPT-NeoX-20B shows a clearer attention/MLP division of labor, while GPT-2 XL does not. Third, information propagation and result aggregation appear partially separable at the module level: attention updates more often align with input-token propagation, and MLP updates more often move the representation toward the final result. Fourth, in multi-operand settings the model behavior looks more compositional than simple token-level memorization.

This is not a benchmark-heavy paper. The evidence is mostly in layerwise trends, visualizations, and module comparisons rather than large tables of task scores. The most important experimental controls are the zero-shot setup and the single-token number constraint, because they make the interpretation of intermediate states much cleaner.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, read it as a mechanism paper, not as a math-reasoning benchmark. Start with the introduction to understand the scope: the paper is about internal processing of arithmetic, not about improving arithmetic performance. Then read the methodology section carefully enough to understand how early decoding is applied and why the tokenizer control matters.

After that, go straight to the figures corresponding to the three experimental questions: when the answer appears across layers, how attention and MLP blocks differ in propagating versus aggregating information, and how operand combination behaves in two- and three-operand settings. The useful reading habit here is to connect each visualization to a specific mechanistic claim rather than treating the plots as generic interpretability figures.

If time is limited, the subtraction appendix can be skipped because the main text already states that the structure is similar. The main caveat to keep in mind is that the paper offers strong observational evidence, not hard causal proof. The main takeaway is simple: better arithmetic models seem to have more structured internal role separation, and that is likely more informative than accuracy alone.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作不直接改训练配方，但它把“算术能力来自哪里”拆得比常见 probing 更干净；重点看层间 early decoding 轨迹，别把“功能分工”过度外推到一般推理。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training recipe tomorrow, but it gives a cleaner decomposition of arithmetic competence than typical probing; read the layer-wise early-decoding evidence, but do not overgeneralize the attention/MLP split to all reasoning.

paper.title: The Long Delay to Arithmetic Generalization: When Learned Representations Outrun Behavior

summary.core_problem: 论文要解释 encoder–decoder Transformer 在算法算术任务（以一步 Collatz 预测为例）中典型的“先拟合训练集、长时间测试集不泛化、随后突然泛化（grokking）”的长延迟现象：延迟究竟来自“算术结构学得晚”（表示未形成），还是“结构早已学到但读不出来”（decoder 读出/访问瓶颈）。作者主张并用全文证据支持后者：encoder 很早就形成了与任务相关的结构（如奇偶/剩余类），但 decoder 长时间无法把这些结构稳定转化为逐 token 的正确输出，导致行为层面的泛化被显著推迟。
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续学习研究的直接启发在于：1）把“能力—行为脱钩”从抽象现象落到可操作的架构瓶颈定位（encoder 表示 vs decoder 读出），为解释 grokking/延迟泛化提供了更可检验的机制；2）强调“表示已具备但访问受限”这一类失败模式，提示我们在大模型预训练中，很多看似“没学会”的能力可能是“读出/对齐/解码策略/目标函数”导致的不可用；3）系统展示 numeral base（可视作 tokenizer/表示选择的一部分）对 decoder 可学习性的强影响，属于“表示/分词作为归纳偏置影响训练动力学”的强案例；4）通过 encoder/decoder 置换、rewind 等因果式干预，为后续研究提供了一套可迁移的方法学（bottleneck localization），可用于分析长上下文、工具使用、推理等任务中类似的延迟现象。
summary.technical_approach:
核心技术路线是“表征探针 + 训练分布对照 + 因果干预（模块移植/回滚）+ base sweep”的组合来定位延迟来源。
1）任务与表征设定：一步 Collatz 映射 T(n)=n/2（偶）或 3n+1（奇），输入输出都用 base-b 的数字序列（MSD→LSD）表示，encoder 读入 n 的 digits，decoder 自回归生成 T(n) 的 digits（teacher forcing 训练，greedy 解码评测）。作者强调该任务同时包含分支（奇偶）、剩余类线索、以及 carry 传播等局部/非局部计算，且难例与易例混合，适合观察“结构先出现但难以读出”。
2）“结构是否早学到”的证据：对 encoder 隐状态做线性探针（parity probe）来测量是否已编码奇偶/剩余结构。全文关键点是：在序列级准确率仍接近随机/低水平时，线性探针已接近满分，说明 encoder 表示空间已线性可分地包含关键算术属性。
3）“读出是否为瓶颈”的因果干预：
- Encoder transplant：把已训练好的 encoder 移植到一个“新初始化 decoder”的模型中继续训练，观察 grokking 是否显著提前；若提前，说明 encoder 结构已足够，瓶颈在 decoder 学会如何使用。
- Decoder transplant / rewind：相反地移植/回滚 decoder（或仅重置 decoder）来测试 plateau 是否主要由 decoder 造成。作者报告“只回滚 decoder 基本消除长平台”，并且“移植训练好的 decoder 反而会主动拖慢/破坏”，强化了“decoder 读出学习困难且可能形成错误读出策略”的观点。
4）Tokenizer/表示（numeral base）作为归纳偏置：作者做 15 个 base 的 sweep，分析不同 base 下局部可计算性差异：在偶数 base 下，n/2 分支可用一位 lookahead 局部计算；而 3n+1 分支需要跨位 carry 传播，base 的选择改变 carry 结构与局部模式可见性，从而改变 decoder 的可学习性。极端例子是 binary：作者发现训练崩溃后“塌陷且不恢复”，表明某些表示会让 decoder 的读出学习几乎不可达。
5）边界条件（可迁移性）：用 Collatz 训练出的 encoder 去迁移到 GCD 预测，转移效果差，说明这里 encoder 学到的结构更像“任务特化的可分解线索”（如奇偶/剩余模式组合），而非可复用的通用算术原语；这也提醒预训练中“早期学到的结构”未必等价于“可迁移能力”。
summary.experiments:
从全文可提取的关键实验设置与数字如下：
- 数据：每个训练 step 采样 1000 个整数 n∈[1,10000]；测试为固定 5000 个未见整数。任务数据为程序生成（无噪声）。
- 默认 base：多数瓶颈定位/探针/decoder 容量实验使用 base 8；另有 15-base sweep。
- 关键现象与定量：
1）表示先于行为：线性 parity probe 在约 2k steps 达到 99.7%（encoder 已强编码奇偶），但此时序列级输出准确率仍约 38%（接近低水平），随后还会经历数万 steps 的长平台。
2）读出瓶颈的因果证据：给“新 decoder + 已训练 encoder”可将 grokking 加速约 2.75×；仅 rewinding/重置 decoder 基本移除长平台；而移植训练好的 decoder 会“主动干扰/拖慢”（全文表述为 actively…，指向 decoder 可能固化了不良读出）。
3）base sweep：不同 base 的最终可达精度差异显著；与任务算术对齐的 base 能达到高准确率；binary 出现塌陷并且无法恢复（never recovers），显示表示选择对训练动力学与可达解空间有决定性影响。
4）迁移：Collatz encoder → GCD 预测迁移差（poorly transfer），作为“结构并非通用原语”的边界条件。
- 论文还强调评测采用 greedy 解码而非 teacher-forcing accuracy，这一点对“平台期”观测很关键：即使 token-level 条件概率在改善，greedy 序列级正确率也可能长期不动，进一步放大“行为延迟”。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（按贡献密度排序）：
1）§5.1（表示探针）与相关图表：重点看 parity probe 99.7%@2k vs 序列准确率 38% 的时间对齐曲线，理解作者如何论证“encoder 结构早已形成”。
2）§5.2（瓶颈定位的因果干预）：这是全文最关键的机制证据。建议逐条核对：encoder transplant 的训练曲线、decoder rewind 的对照、以及“trained decoder 反而有害”的实验设定（是否冻结/是否同学习率/是否同数据）。这里值得深挖的是：decoder 为什么会形成难以纠正的读出（优化地形/局部极小/表征错配）。
3）§5.3（base 作为归纳偏置）：建议结合作者对 n/2 分支局部可计算、3n+1 分支 carry 传播的分析，理解“哪些 base 让读出更线性/更局部”。这部分对 tokenizer/数字表示设计最有启发。
4）§5.5（迁移边界）：用来校准结论外推范围——“encoder 早学到结构”不等于“学到可复用算法”。
5）Appendix（数据生成/实现细节）：如果你想复现或把方法迁移到别的算法任务（加法/乘法/模运算/排序），需要确认 digit 顺序（MSD→LSD）、训练 teacher forcing、评测 greedy 的细节，因为这些会显著影响 grokking 形态。
